The minister answered that the Waarborgfonds is liable for mining damage to private persons, that no structural damage to homes has been found, that the municipality handles communication, that the adjacent building was unoccupied apart from a foundation's use, and that lessons will be discussed after remediation finishes in June 2021.
Some time after the shaft is tapped, remediation of the shaft begins.
Vervolgens wordt enige tijd na het aanboren van de schacht de sanering aangevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars CZ en VGZ verhogen hun premies voor 2021’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about health insurers CZ and VGZ raising their 2021 premiums above the budget forecast, the causes, compensation for those unable to pay, budget policies, reserves, and contract negotiations. The minister explained the premium gap (about 5 euro per year) as driven by higher expenditure and reserve drawdown, pointed to the healthcare allowance for compensation, rejected a single basic policy and banning budget policies, and said contract negotiations in medical specialist care were slow and being monitored.
I have asked the NZa to monitor the contracting process; they will hold a checkpoint in early December and inform me about it.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om het contracteerproces te monitoren, zij zullen begin december een peilmoment houden en mij daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het niet vergoeden van explantatie van borstimplantaten

An MP asks the minister about a petition and calls for reimbursement of breast implant removal (explantation) for all women, plus a protocol and a diagnostic test. The minister answers that removal is covered when medically necessary, will ask the Zorginstituut to re-examine its 2018 standpoint, and says the protocol talks are ongoing and the Platinum Screen evidence is insufficient.
As indicated above, under current laws and regulations, removal of breast implants is part of the basic package when there is a medical necessity for removal.

Zoals hierboven al aangegeven is, volgens de huidige wet- en regelgeving, explantatie van borstimplantaten onderdeel van het basispakket wanneer er sprake is van een medische noodzaak voor verwijdering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Nijboer en Moorlag over de slechte toegankelijkheid van huisartsenspoedzorg in Noordoost-Groningen

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about the reduction of night-time GP emergency car visits in Noordoost-Groningen, the loss of the Delfzijl post, and the erosion of acute care in the region. The minister replied that GPs and insurers are responsible for 24-hour care, that the inspectorate found no patient-safety breach so far, that a draft AMvB on acute care would require careful process if closures were decided, and that no signals of unacceptable care had been received.
I have currently received no signals from the relevant supervisory bodies that the quality or availability of care is at stake.
Ik heb op dit moment geen signalen ontvangen van de betreffende toezichthouders dat kwaliteit of beschikbaarheid van zorg in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen, Ellemeet, Kerstens en Ploumen over de anti-abortus lobby van de Krijgsmacht Bisschop

MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence whether the Military Bishop's letter calling abortion 'child sacrifices' fits Defence norms, whether the Military Ordinariate is funded by Defence, and whether he will talk to the bishop about using his title for political lobbying. The government answered that the statements do not fit Defence values, that the title is not an official Defence title and the bishop is responsible for his own statements, that the Ordinariate receives no Defence funding, and that it will not separately engage with the bishop on the matter.
No, these statements do not fit within the norms and values of Defence.
Nee, deze uitlatingen passen niet binnen de normen en waarden van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht 'Amnesty legt activiteiten in India voorlopig stil na blokkade bankrekeningen'

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers about the Indian freezing of Amnesty International's bank accounts, which forced the organisation to halt activities, and whether the government shares concern about shrinking civil society space and about the Indian government's actions against human rights groups. The minister acknowledged concern about the pressure on human rights organisations, said the Indian investigation concerns foreign funding rules, declined to pre-judge its outcome, and said the Netherlands raised the matter with Indian and EU counterparts.
The Netherlands raised the matter together with EU partners with various Indian interlocutors in New Delhi and Brussels.
Nederland heeft de kwestie gezamenlijk met EU-partners aan de orde gesteld bij diverse Indiase gesprekspartners in New Delhi en Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over een demonstratieverbod bij abortusklinieken

An MP asked the health minister whether a Arnhem ban on demonstrations within 500 metres of an abortion clinic is welcome, whether other municipalities take similar measures, and whether a nationwide ban is needed after clinics asked for one. The minister answered that local mayors under the Public Manifestations Act must judge measures case by case, that other municipalities use varied arrangements, and that a national ban is not considered, while promoting knowledge exchange among municipalities.
Under the Wom, local authorities must assess per demonstration whether measures are necessary, which is also why a national ban is not under consideration.
Op grond van de Wom dient het lokale gezag per demonstratie te beoordelen of maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn, een landelijk verbod is ook daarom niet in beeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Wilders, Graus, Emiel van Dijk, Regterschot, Nijkerken-De Haan, Raemakers, Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk, Öztürk en Wassenberg over het advies van de Raad van Europa over a

Multiple MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the Council of Europe's view that Limburgish and other regional languages need more government attention, and what the government does to promote them. The minister answered that the government gives ample attention to regional languages, pointed to the 2019 Limburgish convenant with the province, the symposia, education and childcare provisions, and the province's leading role, without committing to new obligations such as recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
The government is not working on recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
De regering werkt niet aan het erkennen van het Limburgs als overheidstaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over de loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked the government how it responds to the European Committee of Social Rights finding that the Netherlands falls short on closing the gender pay gap, and what measures are being taken. The state secretary answers that the ECSR found shortcomings on pay transparency and effective measures, that the gap is narrowing only slowly, points to the Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie, the diversity-in-top measures and a forthcoming study on public-sector pay gaps, and says a certification scheme and other transparency measures are still being studied.

The cabinet will come with a position on the private member's bill this autumn, now that the proposal and the response to the Council of State's advice have been submitted to the House of Representatives.
Het kabinet zal dit najaar met een standpunt komen over het initiatiefwetsvoorstel nu het voorstel en de reactie op het advies van de Raad van State is ingediend bij de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Ploumen over onafhankelijk advies over welke lessen geleerd kunnen worden van de coronamaatregelen

MPs Hijink and Ploumen asked how the government is implementing the motion on independent lessons-learned advice on the corona measures, whether a kwartiermaker for evaluation was appointed with party ties to the minister, and whether the evaluation will be truly independent. The minister replied that over 90 external experts contributed through the Lessons Learned trajectory, that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid is conducting an independent evaluation, and that the government is accountable to parliament on the evaluation's design and results.
On how the evaluation is shaped and its results, the cabinet will account to your House.
Over de wijze waarop evaluatie wordt vormgegeven en de resultaten ervan legt het kabinet verantwoording af aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Ploumen over een sinkhole in Kerkrade

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a sinkhole in Kerkrade caused by sanitising an old mine shaft, covering instability, funding, liability, resident information, lessons learned and damage to neighbouring homes. The minister answered that the shaft is being sanitised, funded through a 12 million euro package, that damage claims go to the Waarborgfonds Mijnbouwschade, and that the municipality is monitoring nearby homes, with a follow-up consultation planned.
After the remediation, this historic shaft will be stabilised and safe.
Na de sanering is deze historische schacht gestabiliseerd en veilig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het ontlopen van strafvervolging na genitale verminking

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked whether parents can evade prosecution for female genital mutilation by moving to the United Kingdom, and what measures and EU action are possible. The minister answered that no loophole exists in UK law, that the government sees no need for further UK contact or EU action, and that the police and prosecutors can act, including prosecution of mutilation abroad.
I am not aware that Somali status holders move with the aim of avoiding prosecution for cutting their daughters.
Het is mij niet bekend dat Somalische statushouders verhuizen met als doel om strafvervolging voor het besnijden van hun dochters te ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het nauwelijks openbaar maken van medicijnonderzoek

An MP asked the minister why only about 3% of clinical drug trial results are published, whether patients and money are at risk, why the UK and Ireland publish far more, and how the CBG and the EU rules enforce registration. The minister answers that registration is a voluntary guideline-based duty for now, that the binding EU regulation is expected to take effect around end-2021, and that the Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd, not the CBG, supervises compliance.
When the EU regulation on clinical trials enters into force, the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate will also be able to impose sanctions if the publication obligations are not met.

Als de verordening klinisch geneesmiddelenonderzoek in werking treedt, krijgt de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd ook de mogelijkheid om sancties uit te oefenen als niet wordt voldaan aan de betreffende verplichtingen met betrekking tot openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het bericht 'Kopzorgen KNVB om duel Jong Oranje in Belarus: Veiligheid boven alles'

Two MPs asked whether the Netherlands should intervene over Jong Oranje playing in Belarus amid health and political risks, and whether UEFA should cancel the match. The government said the football decisions and quarantine exemption are for the KNVB and UEFA, that it advised on local health and safety but did not contact UEFA, and that it actively raises human rights concerns through multilateral bodies.
The cabinet is of the view that it is not for the government but for UEFA and affiliated federations themselves to decide whether it is desirable to play football in a country like Belarus.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het niet aan de overheid, maar aan de UEFA en aangesloten bonden zelf is om te bepalen of het wenselijk is in een land als Wit-Rusland te voetballen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘VS zet hoofdaanklager Internationaal Strafhof op zwarte lijst’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about US sanctions placing the ICC chief prosecutor and Court staff on a blacklist, and what the Netherlands has done bilaterally and in the EU to prevent or respond to them. The minister answered that the government repeatedly urged the US not to escalate, is pursuing EU options such as the Anti-Boycott Regulation, and is working with banks to limit the impact on the Court, while stressing the Court must keep functioning.
Over recent months close contact has been maintained with the Court, various banks and our European partners.
Afgelopen maanden is nauw contact onderhouden met het Strafhof, verschillende banken en onze Europese partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over de ontvoering van Insiya naar India

Two PvdA MPs asked the Ministers of Legal Protection and Foreign Affairs why Insiya, abducted to India, has not been returned to her mother despite court rulings, what steps the Netherlands has taken, and whether the minister has raised the case with India. The minister agreed the situation is unsatisfactory, said Dutch court rulings cannot be enforced in India and the case is raised diplomatically, and declined to detail pending Indian proceedings without parties' consent.
I can and may only inform you about proceedings pending between parties in India with the consent of the parties involved.
Over in India aanhangige procedures tussen partijen kan en mag ik u alleen met toestemming van betrokken partijen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Nijboer over vermogen van het Wit-Russische regime bij Nederlandse brievenbusfirma’s

MPs Ploumen and Nijboer asked whether the Belarusian Lukashenko regime holds assets in Dutch letterbox companies, whether such assets should be frozen and how to prevent them. The minister answered that the government is unaware of such assets, that individual cases cannot be commented on absent sanctions, and that EU sanctions, client due diligence and tighter trust office rules are the instruments, while national unilateral measures are not possible under current law.
I cannot make statements about individual cases as long as no sanctions apply to those persons or regimes.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik geen uitspraken doen, zolang er geen sprake is van sancties die van toepassing zijn op die personen of regimes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de bedreiging van Nobelprijswinnaar Denis Mukwege

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about renewed death threats against Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege and the reduced UN MONUSCO protection for him and his hospital, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that MONUSCO will keep contributing via training Congolese police, an early alert system, a safe room and joint patrols, that the Netherlands is pressing the UN and Congolese authorities, and that Dutch staff are exploring a new security contribution with Mukwege's team.
The Netherlands has urged the UN to provide adequate protection for Dr. Mukwege.
Nederland heeft bij de VN aangedrongen op adequate bescherming voor dr. Mukwege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Raan over de beveiliging van Nobelprijswinnaar dr. Denis Mukwege

MPs asked whether MONUSCO protection of Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege and the Panzi hospital is sufficient, whether Nederland will play a role in his security, and whether he should be protected. The minister answered that Nederland pressed the UN for adequate protection, MONUSCO assigned Nepalese troops to the compound and committed to continued protection, and Nederland is exploring a new contribution to security without a formal request from Mukwege.
For this reason, the Netherlands has in recent weeks pressed the UN for adequate protection for Dr. Mukwege.
Nederland heeft daarom de afgelopen weken bij de VN aangedrongen op adequate bescherming voor dr. Mukwege.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de invoering van een suikertaks

MP Ploumen asks the State Secretary for Health why a sugar tax was dropped from the National Prevention Agreement and whether industry lobbying influenced that decision. The State Secretary says a sugar tax remains a possible instrument but was not chosen because the agreement sets other sugar-reduction targets, denies yielding to industry, and promises further monitoring and a RIVM study of additional measures.
I am not choosing this measure at this time because in the National Prevention Agreement I have made other agreements on sugar reduction.
Ik kies op dit moment niet voor deze maatregel omdat ik in het Nationaal Preventieakkoord andere afspraken heb gemaakt over suikerreductie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over ergernis en chaos bij werving van mensen voor bron- en contactonderzoek

An MP from the PvdA asks the health minister about frustration and chaos in recruiting contact tracers for COVID-19, the shortage of staff, the lack of uniform requirements and pay across GGDs, and who is responsible for public health. The minister answers that recruitment is ongoing, the shortage mainly concerns infectious disease doctors, a capacity plan has been sent to parliament, and that responsibilities are set out in the Public Health Act, without committing to new uniform standards.
I unfortunately can never guarantee that there is always sufficient capacity available to carry out contact tracing in line with the protocol in all regions.
Ik kan helaas nooit garanderen dat er altijd voldoende capaciteit beschikbaar is voor het uitvoeren van het BCO conform het protocol in alle regio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de (kritieke) situatie van twee mensenrechtenadvocaten in Turkije

Ploumen asks the Foreign Minister about the critical situation of two Turkish human rights lawyers, Ebru Timtik and Aytaç Ünsal, convicted in an unfair trial and on hunger strike, and what the government will do about it. Minister Blok says the Netherlands regularly raises rule-of-law concerns with Turkey, backs the EU statement, and reports that Timtik died and Ünsal was provisionally released.
The Netherlands regularly raises these concerns at all levels, in clear terms, both multilaterally and in bilateral contacts with Turkey.
Nederland stelt deze zorgen regelmatig en op alle niveaus in duidelijke bewoordingen aan de orde, zowel multilateraal als in bilaterale contacten met Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het verbieden van intimidatie van vrouwen buiten abortusklinieken

An MP asked the health minister whether a court ruling on a municipal buffer zone around an abortion clinic obliges all municipalities to create such zones, and whether the minister will act nationally against intimidation of women outside clinics. The minister replied that municipal mayors are primarily responsible under the Public Manifestations Act, that local circumstances differ, that the ruling is provisional, and that he will not impose buffer zones nationally, though he will keep discussing the situation with municipalities.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Ploumen over een wegverzakking in Kerkrade

Two MPs asked about a road collapse in Kerkrade caused by a historic mine shaft, including how it happened, safety measures, and compensation. The minister answered that the shaft is being located and sealed under an existing programme, that a worker was injured when a drilling rig slid into the collapse, and that residents' financial damage will be settled between authorities.
With the municipality of Kerkrade it has been agreed to consult the parties involved after the sealing of shaft DOM-37 on whether this event gives cause for adjustments to the programme.
Met de gemeente Kerkrade is afgesproken om na de sanering van de DOM-37-schacht met de betrokken partijen te overleggen of deze gebeurtenis aanleiding geeft tot aanpassingen in het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Ngo’s: hele modewereld betrokken bij dwangarbeid Oeigoeren'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about reports that the fashion industry is linked to forced labour of Uyghurs in China, including what concrete steps were taken, whether companies should be mapped, and whether further international reactions would follow. The ministers answered that the Netherlands raises Xinjiang human rights bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Human Rights Council, that companies bear primary due diligence responsibility, that no overview of linked companies exists, and that further raising of the issue is planned.
The cabinet has no overview of companies that are linked through their supply chain to the situation in Xinjiang.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van bedrijven die via hun toeleveringsketen zijn gelinkt aan de situatie in Xinjiang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over Nederlanders die nog altijd vastzitten in Marokko

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister why a Dutch family and their newborn remained stuck in Morocco despite reopened borders, and what was being done to help them and other stranded Dutch citizens. The minister answered that Moroccan COVID-19 border closures continue with some exceptions, that the embassy's regular travel document services were suspended from 20 March to 12 July, that the ministry does not comment on individual cases, and that repatriation flights and commercial routes are available.
The ministry does not make substantive statements about individual cases.
Het ministerie doet geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over uitgevoerde doodvonnissen in Bahrein

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister how many death sentences were carried out in Bahrain since 2017, how often the Netherlands objected bilaterally, what it does on prison conditions and torture, and whether it will push for an EU moratorium. The minister answered that no official figures exist, that concerns are raised in bilateral, multilateral and EU channels, and that the Netherlands and EU have issued statements calling for a moratorium.
According to Bahraini human rights organisations, 18 persons have currently been sentenced to death since 2017.
Volgens Bahreinse mensenrechtenorganisaties zijn er momenteel 18 personen veroordeeld tot de doodstraf sinds 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over schadelijke behandelingen tegen autisme

An MP asked the Health Minister about harmful alternative treatments for autism such as CEASE therapy, HDT and homeopathic prophylaxis, including their effectiveness, prevalence and whether the Wet BIG should be changed. The state secretary said the claims are unacceptable, that no scientific evidence supports them, that enforcement options exist, and committed to examining legal avenues with IGJ and CBG after the summer.
I intend, together with the IGJ and CBG, to look into possible (legal) avenues through which the approach to possibly harmful homeopathic treatments or prophylaxis could be improved.
Ik ben van plan om, samen met IGJ en CBG, te kijken naar mogelijke (wettelijke) ingangen, waardoor de aanpak van mogelijk schadelijke homeopathische behandelingen of profylaxe kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over beïnvloeding van Europees onderzoek door de farmaceutische industrie

MP Ploumen asked the health minister about reports that the pharmaceutical industry influenced European research funding (IMI) on epidemic vaccines, and whether mandatory transparency rules for industry payments are needed. The minister acknowledged the importance of public interest safeguards, said IMI decision-making is shared between public and private partners, referred to the IMI open letter for details, saw no need for further steps now, and stated the existing voluntary Transparantieregister Zorg works broadly well with an evaluation planned.
It is important that public interests are properly safeguarded in European research and innovation programmes.
Het is van belang dat publieke belangen goed worden geborgd in Europese onderzoeks- en innovatieprogramma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht dat Polen zich wil terugtrekken uit het verdrag dat geweld tegen vrouwen bestrijdt

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they share concern over Poland's reported plan to withdraw from the Istanbul Convention on violence against women, whether they will contact Polish counterparts, and whether they will support Polish civil society groups. The government answered that it shares the concern, that no withdrawal decision yet exists in Poland, that a joint démarche was made on 7 August, that the Netherlands will not withdraw, and that support for Polish organisations will be considered if warranted.

The cabinet will continue to follow the matter and, after the ruling of the Polish Constitutional Court and a possible decision by the Polish government, will assess whether and what further action is appropriate and most effective.

Het kabinet blijft de zaak volgen en zal na de uitspraak van het Pools Constitutioneel Hof en een mogelijk besluit van de Poolse regering bezien of en welke verdere actie opportuun is en het meest effectief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over een wetswijziging in Roemenië waarmee het recht om te zijn wie je bent wordt ondermijnd

Two MPs asked the government about a Romanian amendment banning the teaching of gender as a concept separate from biological sex, and how the EU and the Netherlands would respond. The minister said the amendment awaits presidential approval and a Constitutional Court ruling, and listed EU-level and Dutch efforts to support LHBTI rights, without announcing a concrete sanction.
The ongoing legislative process, as well as the public debate about it in Romanian society, are therefore of concern to the cabinet.
Het nog lopende wetstraject, alsmede de maatschappelijke discussie daarover in de Roemeense samenleving, hebben daarom de aandacht van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Tunisia: Two-Year Sentence for Homosexuality’

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign ministers about a Tunisian court sentence of two years for homosexuality, including whether the Netherlands had raised concerns, condemned forced anal examinations as torture, and what the Tunisian LGBTI equality commission's stalling means for the relationship. The minister answered that the embassy monitors the case, the Netherlands opposes criminalisation and forced anal examinations and raises LGBTI rights in bilateral and multilateral fora, and that progress on the equality commission has been slow, with the Netherlands continuing to press for implementation.

The embassy is in close contact with the NGO supporting the two convicted men with legal advice and will decide in consultation with those involved whether contact with the Tunisian authorities is desirable.

De ambassade staat in nauw contact met de NGO die de twee veroordeelden bijstaat met juridisch advies en zal in samenspraak met betrokkenen besluiten of contact met Tunesische autoriteiten wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de impact van racisme op de gezondheid

An MP asked the health minister about the effects of racism and discrimination on health, including mental health and ethnic health gaps, and whether research and care should address this. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to campaigns, diversity in medical research and inclusive research groups, and referred to other ministries' work, without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet is committed to countering this as much as possible.
Het kabinet maakt zich er sterk voor om dit zoveel mogelijk tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Roemenië schrapt seksuele voorlichting’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister about Romania dropping mandatory sex education under church pressure, its effect on women and LGBTI rights, and whether the government will raise concerns with Romania. The minister replied that the law is under review by the Constitutional Court, that the government monitors such developments closely, and that the embassy works with civil society on women's and LGBTI rights, without committing to a new concrete step toward Romania.
The cabinet appreciates the involvement of the various Romanian actors in this and considers it at this stage up to them to set the course for Romania.
Het kabinet waardeert de betrokkenheid van de diverse Roemeense spelers hierin en acht het in dit stadium aan hen om de koers voor Roemenië te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het niet vergoeden van explantatie van borstimplantaten

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister for Medical Care why insurers refuse to reimburse breast implant explantation for patients with systemic complaints, despite supporting medical opinions, and why patients must pursue lengthy appeals. The Minister replied that insurers assess reimbursement case by case under the Zorgverzekeringswet, that disputes can go to the SKGZ, and that he will press insurers to discuss with the Zorginstituut when explantation counts as insured care.
It is primarily the task of health insurers to determine which care may be counted as insured care.
Het is primair de taak van zorgverzekeraars om te bepalen welke zorg tot verzekerde zorg gerekend mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de onzekerheid bij fysiotherapeuten als gevolg van de continuiteitsbijdrage

Ploumen asked the Minister about legal uncertainty among physiotherapists over the ZN continuity contribution, the lower reimbursement rate for catch-up care, and whether physiotherapists would turn to the NOW scheme instead. The Minister defended the scheme as avoiding double payment, said he is unaware of physiotherapists shifting to NOW, and stated he is in ongoing talks with insurers.
I am in continuous discussion with the health insurers about the continuity contribution, the restart of regular care and catch-up care.
Antwoord 7 Ik ben doorlopend in gesprek met de zorgverzekeraars over de continuiteïtsbijdrage, het opstarten van de reguliere zorg en de inhaalzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Ploumen en Ellemeet over de Inclusieve Vaccin Alliantie

Three MPs asked the Minister of Health how the Inclusive Vaccine Alliance relates to the COVID-19 pool and ACT, whether it undermines global access, and how prices and pharmaceutical deals would be controlled. The minister answered that the initiatives are complementary, that the Alliance includes solidarity with low- and middle-income countries, and that price and supply agreements are being pursued, but gave no firm commitments on joining the pool or conditioning public funding.
I believe several paths must be pursued to make a safe and effective COVID-19 vaccine available as quickly as possible.
Ik ben van mening dat er verschillende paden bewandeld moeten worden om zo snel mogelijk een veilig en effectief vaccin tegen COVID-19 beschikbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat Nederland geen gebruik maakt van Europese mondkapjes

MP Ploumen asked why the Netherlands did not request subsidised face masks via the EU RescEU stockpile despite shortages, and whether it would use RescEU in future. The minister said the Netherlands was not eligible in the peak period, that other countries had greater need, and that it has pursued other EU instruments and will request RescEU support in future emergencies.
The Netherlands therefore did not submit a request for support from the European Civil Protection Mechanism (rescEU).
Nederland heeft daarom geen verzoek om ondersteuning vanuit het Europese civiele Beschermingsmechanisme (rescEU) ingediend.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het nijpende huisartsentekort

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the ministers about the worsening general practitioner shortage, including whether the duty of care can still be met, the impact on quality of care, administrative burdens, training capacity and additional funding. The minister answered that insurers have a leading role under the duty of care, that the ministry and the LHV will support regions, and that additional funds and measures such as task-shifting and digital care are being pursued, without committing to new legislation.

The Ministry of VWS and the Dutch GP association LHV will, with the help of a bureau, go into the regions to provide support and help regions increase access to GP care in both the short and long term.

Het Ministerie van VWS en de Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging (LHV) gaan met medewerking van een bureau regio's in om ondersteuning te bieden en regio's te helpen met de toegankelijkheid van huisartsenzorg te verhogen voor zowel de korte als lange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de financiële problemen bij Sanquin

An MP asked the minister about Sanquin's financial problems, their effect on COVID-19 plasma research, and the consequences of a possible partnership or takeover of Sanquin Plasma Products by a foreign party. The minister answered that the Stichting Sanquin is not in financial trouble, that research is not delayed, and that Sanquin's statutory tasks would be preserved under any new partner subject to ministerial approval.
The Ministry of VWS has regular contact with the Stichting Sanquin and SPP.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft regelmatig contact met de Stichting Sanquin en SPP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over de Nederlandse kernwapentaak en de Duitse kernwapendiscussie

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the government about Dutch nuclear weapons tasks, past nuclear exercises and consultations, US nuclear weapons in Europe, and German debate on nuclear deterrence. The ministers largely declined to give details on nuclear decision-making, exercises and US weapons arrangements, citing binding alliance agreements and security, while pointing to NATO unanimity and committing to arms-control and de-escalation work.
Regarding agreements and procedures for nuclear decision-making and execution of the nuclear weapons task, no statements can be made on the basis of alliance and legally binding agreements.

Over afspraken en procedures voor nucleaire besluitvorming en uitvoering van de kernwapentaak kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de dood van George Floyd als gevolg van racistisch politiegeweld

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about George Floyd's death, press arrests and force against protesters in the US, and whether he raised concerns with his US counterpart. The minister condemned the killing, said the Netherlands expressed concern in a videoconference with Secretary Pompeo, and largely deferred to US institutions to investigate and prosecute.
The cabinet trusts that the American democratic rule of law will investigate the death of George Floyd and that justice will be done.
Het kabinet vertrouwt erop dat de Amerikaanse democratische rechtstaat de dood van George Floyd zal onderzoeken en dat recht zal worden gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over bezoekverboden aan niet-coronapatienten in Limburgse ziekenhuizen

An MP asked whether hospitals in Limburg still maintain visitor bans for non-COVID patients and what the guidelines are. The minister replied that since 2 June no Limburg hospital has a full ban, that hospitals set their own visiting arrangements (one visitor per day at the named hospitals), and that there are no specific national guidelines on visits.
There are no specific guidelines regarding hospital visits for (non-)COVID patients.
Er zijn geen specifieke richtlijnen met betrekking tot ziekenhuisbezoek aan (niet-)coronapatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat fabrikanten van bekkenbodemmatjes aanwezig zijn in de operatiekamers

MP Ploumen asked the health minister about reports that manufacturers' product specialists attend operations involving pelvic floor mesh, including whether patients must consent and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. The minister said such presence can support safe care, that patients should be informed though formal consent is not required under the WGBO, and that the IGJ sees no need for a separate investigation.
I am not aware of how often manufacturers are specifically present at the placement of pelvic floor mesh.
Het is mij niet bekend hoe vaak fabrikanten specifiek bij de plaatsing van bekkenbodemmatjes aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Ploumen over het optreden van China

MPs Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about alleged Chinese pressure on an EU COVID-19 disinformation report, Chinese attempts to influence officials, the Hong Kong national security law, and Chinese control of the Paracel and Spratly islands. The minister answered that the EU's High Representative denied any watering down, that the government promotes independent analysis and information-sharing, that it condemns the Hong Kong measures together with the EU and will keep monitoring, and that an EU-wide response to the island control is unlikely to succeed, though it will raise maritime security in the EU.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that all parties refrain from actions that undermine the rule of law and the autonomy of Hong Kong within the People's Republic of China.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat alle partijen zich onthouden van acties die de rechtsstaat en de autonomie van Hongkong binnen de Volksrepubliek China ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen en Kuiken over de omvang en aanpak van seksuele intimidatie en geweld jegens meisjes en vrouwen in Amsterdam

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers about the scale of sexual harassment and violence against girls and women in Amsterdam, the city's measures, and whether a national gender-sensitive approach and VNG coordination are needed. The government welcomed Amsterdam's measures, pointed to national research, a pending review of the Istanbul Convention recommendations, VNG coordination work and planned extensions of the Veilige Steden programme, and noted new sex offence legislation and extra funding for vice teams.
Together with the other relevant departments, NGOs and experts, I will in the coming period discuss the recommendations in the evaluation report, including this one.
Samen met de andere betrokken departementen, NGO's en experts ga ik de komende tijd in gesprek over aanbevelingen in het evaluatierapport, waaronder deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de toegang tot abortushulpverlening ten tijde van de coronacrisis

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister of Health whether women unable to reach abortion clinics during the COVID-19 measures, and whether telemedicine abortion and pharmacy dispensing should be allowed. The minister replied that abortion care remains available, that case-by-case solutions are offered, and that telemedicine abortion is not considered medically responsible care, so no system change is planned.
Also during this corona crisis, Dutch abortion care is available and accessible.
Ook tijdens deze coronacrisis is de Nederlandse abortushulpverlening namelijk beschikbaar en toegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de berichten ‘Regio wil hulp minister bij ziekenhuissoap’ en ‘Nieuwe aflevering in ziekenhuissoap: vertrouwen opgezegd in Raad van Toezicht’

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked the minister about the crisis at Santiz hospitals in the Achterhoek, including the withdrawal of confidence by the medical staff, the proposed fusion, and the delayed Slingeland hospital rebuild. The minister said the situation is undesirable, that IGJ placed Santiz under intensified supervision, that a defusion study is being commissioned, and that an independent explorer has been appointed to restart the regional group.
Also, as of 15 May 2020, the IGJ has placed Santiz under intensified supervision.
Ook heeft de IGJ per 15 mei 2020 Santiz onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'Protesten in HongKong laaien weer op na ‘coronastop’: zeker 230 arrestaties'

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about police violence against protesters and journalists in Hong Kong, Chinese interference in Hong Kong's autonomy, and whether the government would act at EU and bilateral level, including support for universal suffrage and an independent inquiry into police conduct. The minister answered that the government is concerned, shares the EU's statement on national security legislation, has raised concerns with Beijing and Hong Kong authorities, and supports universal suffrage and an independent inquiry in EU settings.

The government has repeatedly conveyed its concerns over the past year to both the central government in Beijing and the local government in Hong Kong, and will continue to do so as long as there is reason to.

Het kabinet heeft het afgelopen jaar herhaaldelijk zorgen overgebracht aan zowel de centrale overheid in Peking als de lokale overheid in Hongkong, en zal dat blijven doen zolang daar aanleiding toe is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'China: Free Covid-19 Activists, ‘Citizen Journalists’

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Chinese COVID-19 citizen journalists had disappeared, and about censorship's effect on China's official information. The minister affirmed the importance of independent journalism, said he would raise the issue in the EU-China human rights dialogue, and noted the EU had already called for the release of detained citizen journalists.
No, but the cabinet is willing to raise this issue in the human rights dialogues with China of the Netherlands and the EU.
Nee, maar het kabinet is bereid aandacht te vragen voor deze kwestie in het kader van de mensenrechtendialogen met China van Nederland en de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het geneesmiddelenbeleid tijdens de coronacrisis

An MP asks the health minister whether postponing the tightening of drug price rules (Wgp) costs the health budget about 150 million euros, whether drug shortages during the coronavirus crisis justify this, whether the minister will enforce stockholding duties, and how preferential purchasing by insurers and a reported amoxicillin shortage are handled. The minister defends the postponement as a general measure for supply continuity, says maximum prices can be lifted for specific shortage drugs, reports that shortage monitoring is in place, and declines to share detailed purchase and stock data about insurers and the amoxicillin batch.
The Shortage and Defect Reporting Point has, as I understand it, received no signals of reduced stock at marketing authorisation holders before 1 April 2020.
Het Meldpunt Geneesmiddelentekorten en -defecten (Meldpunt tekorten) heeft naar ik begrijp geen signalen ontvangen van verminderde voorraad bij handelsvergunninghouders voorafgaand aan 1 april 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over onzekerheid bij fysiotherapeuten als gevolg van uitblijven van informatie over de  continuiteitsbijdrage van  Zorgverzekeraars Nederland

An MP asked the health minister about uncertainty among physiotherapists over the continuity contribution promised by health insurers, including the amount, conditions and timing, and whether the government would intervene. The minister replied that insurers had set out the scheme in letters of 5 April and 1 May, that advance payments were available from mid-April for listed branches, and that the contribution can be applied for from 15 May based on normal insured revenue.
Care providers can apply for the continuity contribution from 15 May.
Zorgaanbieders kunnen de continuïteitsbijdrage vanaf 15 mei as. aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over Europese aanbesteding van medische apparatuur en hulpmiddelen

Ploumen asked the health minister about Dutch participation in EU joint procurement of protective equipment, delivery timelines, the rescEU stockpile and EU civil protection contributions. The minister answered that Nederland joined all four joint procurements, but none of the products can be delivered in the short term, with lead times up to 52 weeks, and that Nederland is still considering participation in rescEU.
Member states' bids in the various procurement procedures are confidential.
De inzet van de lidstaten op de verschillende aanbestedingsprocedures is vertrouwelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlanders in Marokko in het licht van de pandemie

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how many Dutch citizens remain stranded in Morocco, why Morocco is refusing repatriation, what pressure the government applies, and what the EU and other member states are doing. The minister answered that over 1000 are registered, four special repatriation flights and some ambulance flights have taken place, Morocco cooperates on urgent cases, and the government continues to press for repatriation within EU coordination.
The aim of the Netherlands is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘China wil de ‘klus’ in Hongkong afmaken’

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the April 2020 arrests of fifteen pro-democracy figures in Hong Kong, whether it will coordinate with EU partners and contact Beijing, and how it reads the Liaison Office's claim that the Basic Law's Article 22 does not bind it. Minister Blok answered that the government and the EU will closely monitor the cases, will seek clarification if needed, and restated that Hong Kong's autonomy under One Country, Two Systems must be respected, while leaving the Liaison Office interpretation to Hong Kong's own legal debate.
The cabinet, together with the EU, will closely follow the further course of their cases.
Het kabinet zal, mede in EU-verband, het verdere verloop van hun zaken nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de aanhoudende intimidatie van vrouwen buiten abortusklinieken

MP Ploumen asked ministers why intimidation of women outside abortion clinics continues despite earlier debates and motions, and what measures are being taken, including whether municipalities have sufficient powers, buffer zones, group bans, and criminal law changes. The government answers that it finds such intimidation undesirable but that demonstration rights are constitutionally protected, that municipalities report sufficient powers under the Wom, that criminal law can address misconduct, and that it will keep consulting municipalities and clinics and inform parliament annually without proposing legislative change.
Municipalities have indicated that they have sufficient powers to steer the demonstrations in the right direction.
Gemeenten hebben aangeven dat zij over genoeg bevoegdheden beschikken om de demonstraties in goede banen te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Krol en Van Raan over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Mr Singh (J.S.), a Dutch prisoner in the United States, including whether a transfer request was received, whether Nederland can start a transfer procedure, whether a clemency request was made without his knowledge, and what efforts are made on humanitarian grounds. The government answered that no formal transfer request has been received, that the US was told he does not meet the binding criteria, that it expressed humanitarian support diplomatically, and that the initiative lies primarily with Mr J.S.
As far as the question concerns the specific circumstances of detainee J.S., I must inform you that no statements can be made about this for privacy reasons.
Voor zover de vraag ziet op de specifieke omstandigheden van gedetineerde J.S. moet ik u mededelen dat er in het kader van de privacy hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het testen van politieagenten op corona

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether police officers, boa's and enforcement staff know they can be tested for COVID-19 after work incidents, whether testing is available without a spitting or coughing incident, and whether GGD capacity suffices. The minister answered that information is provided through internal channels, that testing is possible after a work incident or with symptoms on advice of the occupational doctor, that testing is being broadened from 18 May and 1 June, and that GGD capacity is sufficient.

That is why it has been agreed that professionals in enforcement and supervision (including police officers, boa's and other enforcers) can also be tested if a work incident (spitting, coughing, resuscitation, fight or forcible arrest) has possibly exposed them to infection.

Daarom is afgesproken dat professionals in handhaving en toezicht (waaronder o.a. agenten, boa’s en andere handhavers) ook getest kunnen worden als zij door een incident tijdens het werk (spugen, hoesten, reanimatie, vechtpartij of aanhouding met geweld) een mogelijke besmetting hebben opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Sazias over hoge parkeerkosten bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Ploumen and Sazias asked whether hospital staff working extra hours during the coronavirus crisis should be exempted from paid parking costs, since public transport is limited. The Minister agreed in principle and said the hospital umbrella organisations NVZ and NFU report that most hospitals have waived or sharply reduced parking fees during the crisis, possibly in consultation with municipalities.
I have contacted the umbrella organisations of hospitals, the NVZ and NFU.
Ik heb contact gezocht met de koepelorganisaties van ziekenhuizen, de NVZ en NFU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het lot van vrouwelijke activisten in Saudi-Arabië

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the detention of Saudi women's rights activists, including a princess and her daughter, and what has been done to raise their case. The minister says the case was raised in general terms during a February 2020 visit and in multilateral fora, that the trials are paused due to COVID-19, and that the embassy will keep raising women's rights.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the improvement of women's rights in Saudi Arabia in both bilateral contacts and in the appropriate multilateral fora, as well as at EU level.
Nederland zal in zowel bilaterale contacten als in de daarvoor geëigende multilaterale fora, alsook in EU-verband, aandacht blijven vragen voor de verbetering van vrouwenrechten in Saoedi-Arabië
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het delen van corona-patenten door farmaceuten

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about concerns over affordable access to future COVID-19 medicines and vaccines, whether Costa Rica's call for a WHO patent pool should be endorsed, and the pharmaceutical industry's stance on global access. The minister acknowledged the concerns and the need for solidarity, said patent pools can strengthen follow-on innovation and the government will publicly support a global COVID-19 pool at the WHO assembly, and said industry has an important role and the government will raise this with it.
the government will, before and during the WHO's annual assembly, show leadership and explicitly speak out in favour of such a global COVID-19 pool and actively support the WHO in this.
zal de regering voorafgaand, en tijdens, de jaarlijkse vergadering van de WHO leiderschap tonen en zich expliciet uitspreken voor zo’n wereldwijde COVID-19 pool en de WHO hierbij actief steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de toegang tot abortushulpverlening ten tijden van de coronacrisis

MP Ploumen asks the Health Minister whether abortion care remains accessible during the coronavirus crisis, whether clinics should stay open, whether costs should be covered for undocumented migrants and foreign students, and whether medical abortion pills could be prescribed for home use as in the UK. The minister answers that abortion care remains available, that clinics are open with adapted consultation and visitor rules, that the existing maximum tariff allows lower fees, and that home use of pills is rejected because it does not fit careful, medically verified care.
In addition, I want to emphasise again that at present I have received no signals from the Dutch abortion sector or the Dutch Society of Abortion Doctors that call for a change in current policy.

Daarnaast wil ik nogmaals benadrukken dat ik op dit moment vanuit de Nederlandse abortussector dan wel het Nederlands Genootschap van Abortusartsen geen signalen heb ontvangen die nopen tot een aanpassing van het huidige beleid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over in Marokko gestrande reizigers

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked why about 3,000 Dutch travellers remained stranded in Morocco, what the government was doing to repatriate them, and whether it would show leniency on extra costs. The minister confirmed the figure, described diplomatic efforts with Morocco and the EU, but refused a cost-leniency scheme, citing personal responsibility and budget constraints while offering payment arrangements.
I have made a pressing appeal to Morocco to make this possible.
Ik heb een klemmend beroep op Marokko gedaan om dit mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het niet kunnen vervolgen van Syriëgangers

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether a court's refusal to continue prosecuting a Syria returnee who is not in the Netherlands means serious crimes go unpunished, and whether government policy on repatriation will change. The government answered that the court has postponed its decision to 2 June 2020, that courts judge each case on its circumstances, and that it is studying the effects of the ruling and will inform the House if policy changes.
If the current policy changes, the House will be informed about this.
Indien verandering van het huidige beleid plaatsvindt, zal de Kamer hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het gereedstellen van het Bronovo ziekenhuis

MP Ploumen asked the Minister for Medical Care whether the closed Bronovo hospital in The Hague could be made ready to receive patients and COVID-19 patients, what care it could offer, whether its location is suitable compared with Ahoy, and whether the minister will act quickly. The minister referred to the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219) as his answer, without addressing the questions on substance in this document.
The written questions from MP Ploumen (PvdA) to the Minister for Medical Care (2020Z06114) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ploumen (PvdA) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06114 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de effecten van de coronacrisis op kraamverzorgenden

An MP asked whether midwifery assistants (kraamverzorgenden) who have close contact with clients lack protective equipment and testing, whether they are included in the regional acute care consultation, and when equipment and testing will be made available. The minister answered by referring to the COVID-19 update letter to parliament, a cross-reference rather than a substantive answer.
The written questions from MP Ploumen (PvdA) to the Minister for Medical Care (2020Z06227) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 219).
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ploumen (PvdA) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06227 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219 ).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Wijngaarden, Ploumen, Van Ojik, van der Graaf, Van der Staaij, van Nispen over het onderzoek van Levada Centrum onder de Russische bevolking naar de publieke opinie over Ned

MPs asked the government about a Levada Centre survey of Russian public opinion on the Netherlands and MH17, including willingness to pay compensation, access to facts, and whether Russians could follow the trial in Russian. The government said it was aware of the survey, that trial information is available online in English and via the Dutch embassy, and that the judiciary chose to livestream the trial in English; a Russian-language livestream of the first session was made by Current Time and the government is looking into Russian summaries.

Within the limits of the law, the judiciary, partly because of the broad and diverse international involvement, decided to set up a livestream so the MH17 trial can be followed worldwide and in English as well as Dutch.

Binnen de mogelijkheden van de wet heeft de Rechtspraak, mede vanwege de brede en diverse internationale betrokkenheid, besloten om een livestream in te richten waardoor het MH17-proces wereldwijd en naast het Nederlands, ook in het Engels te volgen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over “menstruatie-armoede in Nederland”

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government will tackle period poverty, including by providing free menstrual products as Scotland does. The state secretary answered that the government favours an integrated poverty approach with municipalities responsible, mentioned school sexuality education and a few municipalities exploring stadspas access, and declined to commit to free provision.
Zie hiervoor het antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht dat voormalige IS-strijders mogelijk zullen worden overgebracht naar een (te bouwen) instelling in de Ninevé vlakte

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of and had responded to reports that former IS fighters might be transferred to a planned facility in the Nineveh Plain, and what role the Netherlands would take. The minister answered that the transfer concerns Iraqi nationals, is primarily Iraq's responsibility, that the Netherlands remains in dialogue with Iraq and partners, and that no official transfer decision appears to have been taken.
The transfer to Iraq referred to in the article concerns only people with Iraqi nationality.
De in het artikel aangehaalde overplaatsing naar Irak betreft alleen mensen met de Iraakse nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens, Van Dijk, Moorlag en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het Coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party (PvdA) asked the ministers of health, social affairs, economic affairs and the state secretary of justice about IC bed capacity, care for budget holders, immigration detention during the coronavirus crisis, temporary worker and self-employed income support, Schiphol security staff conditions, childcare leave and state support for firms. The minister answered most questions substantively, describing measures and plans, while declining to commit to a fixed IC bed scenario beyond referring to earlier letters and saying the 40-hour norm and PBM supplies were still under review.
I refer you to that for brevity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht dat het RIVM het sombere scenario uit ziet komen

Labour MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked the health minister about reports that RIVM now expects the gloomier COVID-19 scenario, and why its ICU length-of-stay and capacity assumptions differ from the 25 March briefing. The minister's reply refers to a separate written answer on the current state of affairs (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200) rather than answering the questions directly.
have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 200)
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200 )
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Tienduizenden Oeigoeren slachtoffer van dwangarbeid voor bekende merken‘

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether the government would investigate Dutch companies using Uyghur forced labour, press China for access and act in the EU and UN. The ministers say the government is raising Uyghur rights bilaterally and multilaterally, expects firms to conduct due diligence under OECD guidelines without government investigation, and plans a business information session postponed due to coronavirus.
It is the responsibility of these companies to map whether they are linked to companies where Uyghurs are employed. The cabinet does not investigate this.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van deze bedrijven om in kaart te brengen of zij gelinkt zijn aan bedrijven waar Oeigoeren tewerkgesteld worden. Het kabinet doet hier geen onderzoek naar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

PvdA MPs asked the health ministers how far the Netherlands follows WHO advice on testing for COVID-19, whether test kits, staff, laboratory capacity and protective equipment are sufficient, and how ICU capacity, public information and distancing rules are handled. The minister answered that testing is targeted due to global shortages under a national guideline with a taskforce, that protective equipment is distributed under a central procurement and regional distribution structure, and that information is clear and updated, while largely restating existing policy and referring to a separate Kamerbrief for ICU capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Gerven over het bericht dat onbevoegd personeel van hulpmiddelenfabrikanten in de operatiekamers van ziekenhuizen meehelpen bij operaties

MPs Ploumen and Van Gerven asked whether manufacturer product specialists assisting in operating theatres without a patient being informed is undesirable, and whether all hospitals should be asked to map such presence. The Minister replied that product specialists may give technical support under the operating surgeon's responsibility, that informing patients is advisable but not always legally required, that the IGJ has received no such signals, and that no further survey or additional measures are planned.
I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bijna een miljoen Syriërs zitten als ratten in de val in Idlib – of is er nog hoop?‘

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about the humanitarian crisis in Idlib, Syria, and what it is doing to protect displaced civilians and secure aid access. The minister outlined Dutch humanitarian funding channels, EU and UN diplomacy, and the Turkey-Russia ceasefire arrangements, without committing to new national measures beyond existing funding.
The Netherlands provides humanitarian aid in several ways to alleviate the needs of the refugees in Idlib.
Nederland levert op verschillende manieren humanitaire hulp om de noden van de vluchtelingen in Idlib te lenigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Koopmans, Karabulut, Voordwind en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘In Saudi Arabia, contacting the EU is a crime,

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports that contacting an EU or Dutch embassy is treated as a crime in Saudi Arabia, and whether EU diplomats may attend trials of women's rights activists. The minister answered that the government regards such contacts as legitimate, has raised the matter repeatedly with Saudi authorities, and that EU diplomats have so far been refused access to hearings despite continued efforts.
It is correct that EU diplomats, including Dutch diplomats, have not been granted access to court hearings since autumn 2018.
Het klopt dat EU-diplomaten, waaronder Nederlandse diplomaten, sinds het najaar van 2018 geen toegang hebben gekregen tot hoorzittingen van rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de naleving van coronamaatregelen door privéklinieken

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether private clinics (ZBCs) can manage non-urgent care during the COVID-19 crisis, whether dual-employed staff are protected, whether ZBCs are expected to add beds like in Italy, and whether they follow RIVM guidelines and how this is supervised. The minister answered that clinics postpone non-urgent procedures, share staff and equipment via ROAZ, must follow RIVM/IGJ guidelines, and that the IGJ supervises quality of care as usual.
I assume that everyone adheres to the RIVM guidelines, including the ZBCs.
Ik ga ervan uit dat iedereen zich houdt aan de richtlijnen van het RIVM, ook de ZBC’s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ploumen over het bericht in het programma Argos dat onbevoegd personeel van hulpmiddelenfabrikanten in de operatiekamers van ziekenhuizen meehelpen bij operaties

MPs Van Gerven and Ploumen asked the Minister for Medical Care about a Argos report that unqualified staff of medical device manufacturers assist in operating theatres. The minister answered that no specific rules apply, that existing general frameworks govern this, that the IGJ has received no reports of unauthorised involvement, and that no new specific guidelines are needed, though the IGJ will raise the issue with hospitals and a self-regulatory body will review practice.

The inspectorate has no reports of unauthorised involvement of staff of medical device manufacturers in operations, and no indications that this presence in practice prevents surgeons and other care providers from fulfilling their responsibility for good and safe care.

De inspectie heeft geen meldingen van ongeoorloofde betrokkenheid van personeel van hulpmiddelenfabrikanten bij operaties en ook geen aanwijzingen dat deze aanwezigheid er in de praktijk toe leidt dat operateurs en andere zorgverleners hun verantwoordelijkheid voor goede en veilige zorg niet kunnen invullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Ploumen over de actie van een verkoper van blenders waarbij moeders worden opgeroepen hun kind niet te vaccineren

MPs Diertens and Ploumen asked the state secretary about a seller's campaign offering a free blender to mothers who refrain from vaccinating their children against whooping cough. The state secretary answered that the Advertising Code Commission rebuked the campaign, that no legal sanctions apply because no statutory rules were broken, that the IGJ contacted the company and the campaign was stopped, but that contacting parents directly is not possible under privacy law.
No, we do not have data for this and we (or the IGJ) cannot request it from the website owner because of privacy legislation.
Nee, we beschikken niet over gegevens hiervoor en wij (of de IGJ) kunnen die ook niet opvragen bij de eigenaar van de website vanwege de privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over gendersensitieve zorg en het College Beoordeling Geneesmiddelen (CBG)

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister of Medical Care about gender-sensitive drug research, whether the trial populations match target patients, and whether the CBG requires gender differences in medicine labels and the SmPC. The Minister answered that representative inclusion is checked during authorisation, sex differences are analysed in subgroups, and gender differences are already reflected in product information, while declining to provide counts of labels or dossiers with gender differences and citing workload.

Answering these questions would require manually reviewing very large numbers of dossiers and package leaflets; with many thousands of medicines on the Dutch market this would place a disproportionate burden on the CBG's limited capacity.

De beantwoording van deze vragen zou het handmatig doornemen van zeer grote hoeveelheden dossiers en bijsluiters vereisen; bij de vele duizenden medicijnen op de Nederlandse markt zou dit een onevenredig beslag leggen op de beperkt beschikbare capaciteit van het CBG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het zogeheten 'Istanboel 10'-proces

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about the 'Istanbul 10' trial of eleven human rights defenders arrested in 2017, including concerns about fair trial and the use of Turkish anti-terror law. The minister answered that the Netherlands cannot judge individual prosecutions, monitors the hearings with EU partners, has raised the rule of law and fair trial with Turkey including in EU and UN settings, and continues to support civil society.
The Netherlands may and cannot, however, interfere in the legal proceedings in another state.
Nederland mag en kan zich echter niet mengen in de rechtsgang in een andere staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Hindu minor girl who was forcefully converted renounces Islam; Pakistani mullahs demand death penalty'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the abduction and forced conversion of a Hindu minor girl in Pakistan and calls for the death penalty against her. The minister said the court annulled the marriage and prosecuted the man, that no evidence shows a clear increase in such cases, and that human rights are raised with Pakistan and the EU, including opposition to the death penalty.
It is positive to note that on 19 February the court in Jacobabad declared the marriage of Mehak Kumari void because she is a minor.
Het is positief te vernemen dat op 19 februari de rechtbank in Jacobabad het huwelijk van Mehak Kumari nietig heeft verklaard, omdat zij minderjarig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het intrekken van perskaarten in Turkije

MPs from SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey revoked press cards of journalists from the paper Evrensel, whether this fits a pattern of state repression, and whether the Netherlands will press Turkey on press freedom. The minister answered that the Evrensel revocations were reversed, that Turkey has revoked nearly 3,804 press cards since 2015, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom concerns with Turkey at all levels, including with the Turkish foreign minister and within the EU and Council of Europe.
The Netherlands therefore continuously raises concerns about the lack of press freedom in Turkey with Turkey at all levels.
Nederland brengt daarom in contacten met Turkije voortdurend en op alle niveaus de zorgen over het gebrek aan persvrijheid in Turkije op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de vergoeding van fysiotherapie bij chronische COPD

An MP asks why physiotherapy reimbursement for chronic COPD patients depends on whether they needed antibiotics or prednisone in the previous year, and whether this creates perverse incentives and access problems. The Minister answers that treatment is adjusted to current health status via GOLD severity categories, that physiotherapy is in the basic package since 2019, and that the MP's concerns about antibiotic prescribing and insurance refusals are not shared, while noting the competitive supplementary insurance market offers ample coverage.
For patients with COPD it is important that they receive appropriate care.
Voor patiënten met COPD is het van belang dat zij passende zorg krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de manier waarop het zorgstelsel klantvriendelijker kan worden

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister of Medical Care how the health insurance system could become more customer-friendly, including mid-year switching during patient stops and transparency on insurer contracts with providers. Minister Bruins rejected mid-year switching as impractical and weakening insurers' bargaining power, and pointed to existing rules, planned research and outcome-information initiatives.
I do not agree with the proposal to make mid-year switching possible, so that someone could always go to the provider of their choice.
Ik ben het niet eens met het voorstel om tussentijds overstappen mogelijk te maken, zodat iemand altijd bij de aanbieder van zijn voorkeur terecht zou kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de besnijdenis van Nederlandse meisjes in het buitenland

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about the cutting of Dutch girls abroad and what measures it takes to prevent and detect it. The minister answers that FGM is strictly prohibited and that prevention, reporting via Veilig Thuis, and an action agenda are being pursued, while noting that outcomes are not known and that Kenya has been raised with its authorities.
I will continue to invest in tackling FGM over the coming years together with my colleague for Legal Protection.
Ik blijf de komende jaren samen met mijn collega voor Rechtsbescherming investeren in de aanpak van VGV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Ploumen over de actie van een verkoper van blenders waarbij moeders worden opgeroepen hun kind niet te vaccineren

MPs Diertens and Ploumen asked whether the state secretary knew of a blender seller's campaign urging mothers not to vaccinate their children, and what could be done against commercial parties exploiting parental fears. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care had been notified, contacted the blog owner, and mentioned strengthening citizens' media literacy.
The Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care (IGJ) received a report from the RIVM.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) heeft een melding van het RIVM gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over onvoldoende aandacht voor man-vrouwverschillen in de zorg

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether doctors and boards pay too little attention to sex-specific symptoms in women and whether gender-specific care should be evaluated under the Zorgevaluatie en Gepast Gebruik programme. The Minister said the scientific associations must update guidelines, that gender differences will be addressed in existing ZonMw research, and that insurers' role is limited because decisions are made in shared decision-making.
I see no reason to start another programme focused on gender aspects.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om nog een programma te starten wat op genderaspecten gericht is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over haperend ziekenvervoer in Overijssel

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about disrupted patient transport to hospitals in Overijssel after insurers Zilveren Kruis and Eno switched ambulance-transport provider, and whether insurers meet their duty of care and should open a dedicated phone line. The Minister said the insurers have taken measures such as extra phone lines and alternative booking options, that the supervisor NZa must judge compliance with the duty of care, and that the Minister has been in regular contact with the insurers and will not open a special line but notes an existing Vervoerslijn number.
It is up to the supervisor of health insurers, the Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets' healthcare arm NZa, to assess whether Zilveren Kruis and Eno have met their statutory duty of care.
Het is aan de toezichthouder op zorgverzekeraars, de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit, om te beoordelen of Zilveren Kruis en Eno aan hun wettelijke zorgplicht hebben voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de mogelijke gevolgen van de richtlijn nevenbevindingen bij het bevolkingsonderzoek borstkanker

MP Ploumen asks why enlarged lymph nodes, calcifications, leaking breast implants and loose pacemaker wires seen on breast cancer screening mammograms are not reported to women and their GPs, and whether the guidance will change. The State Secretary defends the policy of reporting only exceptional findings on medical grounds, says the implant-leak section of the guidance will be amended in spring 2020, and undertakes to make the RIVM website more explicit about this.
The implementation framework will be amended in the new edition of March/April 2020 in the section on incidental findings.
Het uitvoeringskader zal in de nieuwe uitgave van maart/april 2020 op het onderdeel nevenbevindingen worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het niet toelaten van een geneesmiddel dat vooral effectief is voor vrouwen met hartklachten

MP Ploumen asks why ranolazine, said to benefit women with angina, is not reimbursed in the Netherlands, and whether the 2010 Zorginstituut assessment still holds given sex differences in effect and new evidence. Minister Bruins answers that the Zorginstituut advised against reimbursement in 2010, that no new evidence has been submitted, that the manufacturer may request a reassessment, and that the drug is not on the Dutch market.
It is not for me to assess the effectiveness of a medicine. In this case that is for the Zorginstituut.
Het is niet aan mij om de effectiviteit van een geneesmiddel te beoordelen. Dat is in dit geval aan het Zorginstituut.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van der Staaij over de gebeurtenissen op 1 december in West Papoea

MPs Ploumen and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about the harsh Indonesian response to 1 December demonstrations in West Papua, including police entering a church and detaining people.
