The minister said over a hundred people were arrested, most released, that Papua human rights are a standing agenda item in bilateral and EU dialogue, and that the issue will be raised during the March state visit.
The situation in Papua will therefore also be raised during the state visit in March.
De situatie in Papua zal daarom ook tijdens het Staatsbezoek van maart a.s. aan de orde worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over legale en veilige abortus in Europa

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about access to legal and safe abortion in Europe, including the claimed figure of 15 million women without access, prosecutions in some countries, and whether the government will raise this with other states and the Commission. The minister says he does not recognise the 15 million figure, lists countries with restrictions, and says the Netherlands raises SRHR concerns in regular contacts while avoiding counterproductive steps, without committing to a new initiative.
The figure of 15 million women is not known to me.
Het aantal van 15 miljoen vrouwen is mij niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het uitblijven van een gezamenlijke verklaring van de Europese lidstaten aangaande de beleidsverandering van de Verenigde Staten met betrekking tot Israëlische nederzettingen o

MP Ploumen asks the Foreign Minister about the failure of a joint EU statement criticising the US shift on Israeli settlements, reportedly blocked by Hungary, and whether the Netherlands will issue its own statement. The minister replies that Dutch and EU policy is unchanged, that the High Representative already restated the position on behalf of the EU, and that the Netherlands sees no need for a separate statement, without committing to new action.
The cabinet attaches importance to EU unity on the Middle East peace process and compliance with international law.
Het kabinet hecht aan EU-eensgezindheid op het Midden-Oosten Vredesproces en de naleving van internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'EU diplomat ordered to leave Malawi after protesting police rape allegations’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that an EU diplomat was ordered to leave Malawi after protesting police rape allegations, and what the Netherlands had done about police violence against women and press freedom in Malawi. The minister replied that EDEO found the reports of expulsion incorrect, that the EU delegation is monitoring the situation and raised violence against women in the November 2019 political dialogue, and that the issue will remain on the agenda.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the dialogue between the EU and Malawi closely, and will ask the EU to keep raising violence against women and freedom of expression in the political dialogue.
Nederland zal de dialoog tussen de EU en Malawi met aandacht blijven volgen, en de EU vragen het geweld tegen vrouwen en de vrijheid van meningsuiting in de politieke dialoog op te blijven brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat vrouwen meer kans hebben om bij een auto-ongeluk te overlijden

Labour MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a US study showing women face higher injury risk in car crashes applies to the Netherlands, and whether crash tests should be adapted to women. The minister answered that the US study cannot be directly applied to the Dutch situation, that existing tests already represent average women and smaller persons, and that the RDW is involved in regulation and dummy development.
The study is based on accident figures from the United States. That the conclusions are directly applicable to the Dutch situation cannot be said on the basis of this single American study.

Het onderzoek is gebaseerd op ongevalscijfers uit de Verenigde Staten. Dat de conclusies één op één toepasbaar zijn voor de Nederlandse situatie kan op basis van dit enkele Amerikaanse onderzoek niet worden gezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat Jeugdzorg het kabinet verzoekt twee IS-kinderen uit Syrië terug te halen

Two PvdA MPs asked whether youth care had requested repatriation of two IS-linked children from Syria, how the government responded, and what happens to them and to other Dutch children in Syrian camps. The government confirmed receipt of a letter from a Dutch child protection organisation on 15 October, said it is in close contact with that organisation, but declined to disclose steps taken, citing no diplomatic presence and restraint on individual cases.
Beyond that, the cabinet cannot currently provide information on the steps being taken to implement this request.
Voor het overige geldt dat het kabinet op dit moment geen mededelingen kan doen over de stappen die worden gezet ter uitvoering van dit verzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over een voormalige vruchtbaarheidskliniek in Oosterbeek

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked about a former fertility clinic in Oosterbeek where a doctor may have fathered around 150 children, asking about the legal framework of the 1970s-80s, whether affected children can find their donor, and what the ministers will do to help. The Minister replied that no specific donor-registration law existed before 2004 and no evidence shows the clinic was illegal then, and that missing clinic records mean donors cannot be traced, so the only option left is free registration in the Fiom KID-DNA databank.
The administration of this fertility clinic is missing, so it is not possible to determine from it which donors donated at this clinic.
De administratie van deze vruchtbaarheidskliniek ontbreekt, zodat het niet mogelijk is op basis daarvan te achterhalen welke donoren in deze kliniek hebben gedoneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Regenwoudmaffia’ vermoordt en bedreigt inwoners Amazone’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul ask the ministers how the government responds to reports of violence and threats against Amazon forest defenders by illegal logging networks, and to Bolsonaro's criticism of conservation groups. The ministers say they have raised deforestation and rights concerns with Brazil, note that the legal framework exists but enforcement and political will fall short, and describe trade and sustainability initiatives.
It must be noted that the legal framework to act against criminal organisations exists, but the financial resources and political will to enforce that framework are lacking.
Geconstateerd moet worden dat het wetgevend kader om op te treden tegen criminele organisaties aanwezig is, maar de financiële middelen en de politieke wil om dat kader te handhaven tekort schieten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de aardbeving op de Molukken

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the minister about the humanitarian situation after the earthquake and aftershocks on the Moluccas, and whether Indonesia had requested international aid. The minister answered that Indonesia made no international aid request, that local authorities lead relief, and that the Netherlands supports EU satellite mapping and standing humanitarian channels if requested.
However, he confirmed to me that the Indonesian provincial and local governments have themselves taken up the relief efforts, together with local organisations.
Wel heb ik van hem bevestigd gekregen dat de Indonesische provinciale en lokale overheden zelf de hulpverlening ter hand hebben genomen, samen met lokale organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over menstruatie-armoede in Nederland

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about period poverty in the Netherlands, citing research by De Bovengrondse and Plan International and asking whether women should have access to good menstrual products and whether free products for pupils and students, as in Scotland, will be introduced. The minister agrees women should have access, points to school sexual education and a planned handreiking on poverty for schools, and concludes existing policy is sufficient without new measures specific to menstrual poverty.
The research gives no reason to take policy measures specifically aimed at this sub-aspect of poverty beyond the cabinet's current efforts.
Het onderzoek geeft geen aanleiding om bovenop de huidige inzet van het kabinet beleidsmaatregelen te nemen specifiek gericht op dit deelaspect van armoede.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over de sluiting van een afdeling in het OLVG Oost door personeelstekort

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the minister why the OLVG Oost hospital closed its haematology and oncology ward due to staff shortages, what the consequences for patients and quality of care are, whether the ministry was informed beforehand, and whether it will address housing and pay conditions for care staff. The minister confirmed the closure, said care remains available nearby at OLVG West within 10 km, said the ministry was not informed beforehand since insurers hold the duty of care, and pointed to housing priority schemes, existing pay funds and the Werken in de Zorg programme without committing to new funds.
The health insurer has a duty of care and is therefore responsible for providing accessible, good-quality care.
De zorgverzekeraar heeft zorgplicht en is daarmee verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van toegankelijk en kwalitatief goede zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat Amerikaanse diplomaten samenwerken met conservatieve staten om seksuele en reproductieve rechten in te perken

Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the US administration was building a coalition of socially conservative governments to restrict sexual and reproductive rights, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government answered that it shares concern, is opposing SRGR rollbacks in UN texts and with allies, and will keep raising the issue with US authorities.
The Netherlands will continue to emphasise the importance of SRGR and its concerns on this matter to the appropriate American authorities.
Nederland zal het belang van SRGR en de Nederlandse zorgen terzake blijven benadrukken bij de geëigende Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Ojik over Nederlanders die meevechten in de burgeroorlog in Oekraïne

MPs Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the minister about reports that eight Dutch nationals were fighting in the Ukraine conflict on both sides, and about monitoring, return, and measures. The minister answered that the figures could not be confirmed, that the source report gave no substantiation, and that no further details were known, while referring to the integrated approach to extremism and terrorism for radicalised individuals.
Figures on Dutch nationals who would take or would have taken part in the fighting in Ukraine, however, cannot be confirmed.
Cijfers over Nederlanders die deel zouden nemen of deel zouden hebben genomen aan de strijd in Oekraïne, kunnen echter niet worden bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de situatie in Al-Hol

Two Labour MPs asked the government about security and child welfare in the Al-Hol camp for IS-affiliated women and children, including Dutch nationals, after reports that Kurdish forces were losing control there. The government answered that it received no Kurdish warning, that it cannot give precise figures or child health information because it has no diplomatic presence in northeast Syria, that it is concerned about escape risks from Turkish operations and has raised this with allies, and that it is not changing its policy against actively repatriating children.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over borstvergrotingen pillen

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about food supplements sold as breast enlargement pills whose long-term health effects are unknown, and about why the NVWA has not acted despite reports to Lareb. The minister answers that the NVWA can only act if a product is shown to be harmful, that EFSA found no evidence of harm at the concentrations tested, and that a RIVM literature review has been commissioned with possible follow-up steps and a letter to parliament in spring.
Depending on the outcome of this, I will look at possible follow-up steps.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomst hiervan kijk ik naar mogelijke vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de situatie in Chili

Three MPs asked the Dutch Foreign Minister about the protests in Chile, including excessive police force, deaths and mass arrests, and whether the government had condemned the violence and raised concerns with the Chilean counterpart. The minister condemned violence on all sides, said the government shares UN concerns and awaits the OHCHR investigation and the national human rights institute's review before considering further steps.
The cabinet is awaiting the outcome of the OHCHR investigation before considering possible steps.
Het kabinet wacht de uitkomst van het OHCHR-onderzoek af, alvorens mogelijke stappen te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Ploumen en Van den Hul over de rechten van LHBTI-gemeenschap en persvrijheid in Polen

MPs Asscher, Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister about anti-LGBTI rhetoric by Poland's ruling PiS party, local 'LGBT-free' declarations, and press freedom in Poland. The minister acknowledged concern about the rhetoric, noted the gap between campaign rhetoric and concrete policy, and described Dutch diplomatic engagement and support for Polish civil society, while saying the press remains diverse and Poland's rule-of-law developments are monitored.

The cabinet follows developments in Poland that could affect this diversity and includes them in concerns Netherlands already actively raises bilaterally, in the EU and multilaterally about the rule of law.
Het kabinet volgt ontwikkelingen in Polen die deze diversiteit kunnen raken en betrekt die bij zorgen die Nederland nu al actief uit in bilateraal, EU- en multilateraal verband over de rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Over een nieuwe moord op eigenzinnige vrouw in Libië'

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a new murder of an outspoken woman in Libya, the situation of women there, and whether a sanctions regime for crimes against women should be created. The minister answered that the security situation is worrying, that the Netherlands supports the UN-led political process, and that it has pressed for investigation of the disappearance of Seham Sergiwa and added sexual-violence criteria to existing UN sanctions regimes.
The cabinet notes with concern that enforced disappearances are increasingly taking place in Libya.
Het kabinet constateert met zorg dat er in toenemende mate gedwongen verdwijningen plaatsvinden in Libië
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Russia invites Albania, North Macedonia to join the Eurasian Union’

MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Russia invited Albania and North Macedonia to join the Eurasian Economic Union, and about the Dutch response. The minister replied that no formal invitation was known to have been sent, that Dutch contact with EU partners and the two countries continues, and that Nederland supports their EU accession perspective and reform efforts.
To my knowledge, no formal invitation was sent to Albania or North Macedonia to join the Eurasian Economic Union.
Er is bij mijn weten geen formele uitnodiging aan Albanië of Noord-Macedonië gestuurd om lid te worden van de Euraziatische Economische Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de situatie in het kamp Al-Hol in Syrisch Koerdistan

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked about the situation in Al-Hol camp, the repatriation of Dutch IS women and children (including a court order to make efforts for their return) and Iraq's reported demands for payment to prosecute foreign fighters. The government referred to earlier letters, said the detention orders cannot currently be carried out safely, stated it is seeking solutions with Schengen partners including prosecution in the region, and said it is too early to discuss compensation for Iraq.
The examination of the possibility of executing the detention orders issued by the Rotterdam court is ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid van de uitvoering van de bevelen gevangenneming van de rechtbank van Rotterdam duurt voort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Bahrein brengt drie terrorisme-verdachten ter dood’

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister why there is no verifiable data on the number of Bahraini politicians and human rights activists detained since 2011, how often and at what level human rights concerns are raised with Bahrain, and whether the issue was raised at the UN Human Rights Council and in EU working groups. The minister answered that thousands are estimated to be detained but no official figures exist because Bahrain treats them as terrorists, that concerns were raised at high official level in April and August 2019, that the situation is discussed in EU working groups and the informal EU human rights dialogue, and that the Netherlands did not specifically raise Bahrain at the 42nd Human Rights Council session.
However, because the Bahraini authorities regard these prisoners as terrorists or supporters of terrorism, no official figures are available.
Echter, omdat de Bahreinse autoriteiten deze gevangenen als terroristen of als supporters van terrorisme beschouwt, zijn er geen officiële cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over de patiëntenstop van Zilveren Kruis-verzekerden bij ziekenhuisgroep ZGT

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the Minister for Medical Care about a patient stop imposed by hospital group ZGT on Zilveren Kruis insured patients, its consequences for access and quality, and what could be done for affected patients. The minister answered that referrals of Zilveren Kruis patients with new elective care needs are temporarily routed to insurer-brokered care, that this is a matter between the parties under the care duty which the NZa monitors, and that he is watchful but not directly worried about recurring patient stops.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over bloedvergieten op Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about deadly violence in Wamena, Papua, on 23 September 2019, the Indonesian demonstration ban, the end of the Dutch contribution to the Community Policing Programme, and Dutch diplomatic efforts. The minister answered that the causes and casualty breakdown remain unclear, described the programme's results, and said Dutch diplomacy on Papua continues at ministerial and senior official level.
The cabinet closely follows developments in Papua and gives priority to raising these developments as a standing item with the Indonesian authorities.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in Papua nauwgezet, en geeft er prioriteit aan deze ontwikkelingen als vast onderdeel bij de Indonesische autoriteiten aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Ploumen over de Nieuwsuur-uitzending 'Nederlandse regering heeft morele verplichting West-Papoea te helpen'

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on a Dutch moral obligation toward West Papua, reports of deaths in Papua unrest, and whether the Netherlands would press Indonesia on human rights. The minister answered that at least 32 died in Wamena with casualties on several sides, that the Netherlands raises Papua in dialogue with Indonesia while fully respecting its territorial integrity, and that it sees no reason to revise its earlier position on the Drooglever report.
I see no reason to revise the position set out in the letters to parliament of 22 November 2005 and 29 April 2016.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de lijn in de Kamerbrieven van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V, en van 29 april 2016, stuk 2420, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het (mogelijke) gebruik van chemische wapens bij de Turkse inval in Noord Syrië

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister how the government views reports that Turkey used white phosphorus in its incursion into northern Syria, what it would do if use were confirmed, and whether it had contacted European and NATO partners and what instruments it has. Minister Blok answered that white phosphorus is not prohibited per se under humanitarian law, that no unlawful use can yet be concluded, that the OPCW's investigation is hampered by insecurity, and that if unlawful use is shown he would press for measures in the EU, NATO and the OPCW.
If it is shown that there has indeed been unlawful use of white phosphorus by Turkey, I will consult with my counterparts in EU and NATO contexts and in the OPCW and press for appropriate measures.

Indien wordt aangetoond dat er inderdaad sprake is van niet-geoorloofd gebruik van witte fosfor door Turkije, zal ik in EU-verband, NAVO-verband en in de OPCW in overleg treden met mijn ambtgenoten en aandringen op gepaste maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Karabulut over Marokkaanse journaliste die veroordeeld is vanwege een abortus

MPs Ploumen and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of Moroccan journalist Hajar Raissouni for illegal abortion and sex outside marriage, and whether the Netherlands would act for her release and for women's access to safe abortion. The minister said the Netherlands supports sexual and reproductive rights broadly but does not fund specific abortion programmes in Morocco, noted that clemency had been granted to Raissouni, her doctor and her partner, and declined to speculate on motives or raise the case with his Moroccan counterpart.
I therefore see no reason to discuss this with my counterpart.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om hierover in gesprek te treden met mijn ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht dat transgenderzorg wordt belemmerd door een monopolie

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the minister about reports that a monopoly position of Amsterdam UMC hinders transgender care and about waiting times exceeding two years. The minister acknowledges the waiting times, points to a care coordinator's efforts to reduce them and expand capacity, and says he sees no evidence of deliberate discouragement by Amsterdam UMC.
I agree that everyone in the Netherlands is entitled, within the existing norms, to the care included in the basic package of the Health Insurance Act.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat iedereen in Nederland binnen de daarvoor bestaande normen recht heeft op de zorg die in het basispakket van de Zorgverzekeringswet zit.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Ploumen, Voordewind, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Jaar na dood Khashoggi: zaken doen met de kroonprins kan weer’

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi Arabia's incomplete accountability for the killing of Jamal Khashoggi, the crown prince's responsibility, pressure for openness, trade missions, sanctions and attending the G20. The minister answered that the Saudi account remains incomplete, that the Netherlands keeps pressing bilaterally and in UN and EU fora, that no government-led trade missions are planned, and that sanctions lack international consensus while an EU human rights sanctions regime is being pursued.
The cabinet will continue to press for this in bilateral and multilateral contexts.
Het kabinet zal hier in bilateraal en multilateraal verband op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over het bezoek van premier Rutte aan Indonesië

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the topics of Rutte's visit to Indonesia, including the military crackdown in Papua, and whether the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights would be invited to Papua. The government answered that human rights and Papua were discussed, that the Netherlands urged a prompt UN visit, and that the visit is now up to the UN and Indonesian authorities to arrange.
The aim of this conversation was to stress that dialogue and restraint are important to reach a lasting solution.
De inzet van dit gesprek was te benadrukken dat dialoog en terughoudendheid belangrijk zijn om tot een duurzame oplossing te komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de reden van de vertraging bij de evaluatie van het Transparantieregister Zorg

Rep. Ploumen asked why the evaluation of the Transparantieregister Zorg (healthcare transparency register) was delayed beyond the promised summer 2019, its research questions and methodology, and whether it could be sent before the budget debate. Minister Bruins answered that the evaluation by IVM takes longer than planned, the results are expected before the Christmas recess, and he provided the research questions and design.
The evaluation unfortunately takes more time than was planned.
De evaluatie neemt helaas meer tijd in beslag dan gepland was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over anticonceptie in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about access to contraception, including whether it should be covered by the basic health insurance package, and about costs and usage figures. The minister answered that contraception is covered up to age 21, that cost is not a reason to restrict access, that no data exist on several requested figures, and that the cost of adding all methods to the package would run to tens of millions of euros.
There are no exact figures, but the report Sexual Health in the Netherlands 2017 gives percentages for the use of the various contraceptive methods.
Er zijn geen exacte cijfers, maar in het rapport Seksuele Gezondheid in Nederland 2017 worden wel percentages gegeven over gebruik van de diverse anticonceptie methoden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het faillissement van GGZ-instelling Vincere Groep

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of addiction and mental health provider Vincere Groep, including effects on patients, staff, waiting lists and causes. The State Secretary answered that the curator handles care transfer and causes, that IGJ and NZa supervise continuity of care, and that the provider was responsible for its own finances, while committing to no concrete new action beyond monitoring.
It is up to the curator of Vincere Groep to investigate the causes of the bankruptcy.
Het is aan de curator van de Vincere Groep om onderzoek te doen naar de oorzaken van het faillissement.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het terughalen van Duitse kinderen uit Syrië door Duitsland

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the Dutch ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the government knew in advance of Germany's repatriation of children from Syria, how many Dutch children remain in Syrian camps, and why the Netherlands does not repatriate them. The ministers answered that the Netherlands was not informed beforehand, that active repatriation is not government policy except possibly for orphans, that about 85 children with a Dutch link are in SDF camps, and that the government will study the return of orphans.
It is unknown how many Dutch children are currently in Syrian camps.
Het is onbekend hoeveel Nederlandse kinderen zich momenteel in Syrische kampen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de aanhoudende onlusten in Papua

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about Indonesian military repression of protests in West Papua, including deaths, Dutch responsibility, and support for a new independence referendum. The minister said Indonesia is responsible for security, Dutch embassy monitors the situation, the territorial integrity of Indonesia is respected, and the issue is raised in bilateral dialogue including a visit by the UN High Commissioner.
It is not for the Dutch government to judge the advisability of a new referendum on independence.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse regering om te oordelen over de opportuniteit van een nieuw referendum over onafhankelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over de toegankelijkheid van de tijdelijke huisvesting van de Tweede Kamer voor blinden en slechtzienden

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Interior whether blind and visually impaired people will have good access to the Tweede Kamer's temporary accommodation, including an audio model of the chamber, and which other facilities will be provided. The State Secretary agreed access should be good, but said placing the audio model is a matter for the Tweede Kamer organisation, suggested it be moved over, and said the public areas will meet the ITs Publiek accessibility standard while other areas keep existing facilities.

Placing an audio model as part of the facilities in the temporary accommodation is, however, due to the division of roles between the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the users of the temporary accommodation, a matter for the Tweede Kamer organisation.

Het plaatsen van een audiomaquette als onderdeel van de voorzieningen in de tijdelijke huisvesting is echter vanwege de rolverdeling tussen het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf en de gebruikers van de tijdelijke huisvesting, een zaak van de Tweede Kamerorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Bahrein brengt drie terrorisme-verdachten ter dood'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he had raised with Bahrain the execution of three terrorism suspects, whether he had condemned it, and about the human rights situation and UN action on Bahrain since 2011. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty, that an EU statement condemned the executions, that the human rights situation has worsened according to several sources, and that Bahrain was raised in the UPR, but gave no specific new commitments.
The figures on this are extremely difficult to establish because no verifiable information is available.
De getallen hierover zijn bijzonder moeilijk vast te stellen omdat er geen verifieerbare informatie beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de toename van het gebruik van lachgas in het verkeer.

An MP asked the state secretary about the sharp rise in nitrous oxide (laughing gas) incidents in traffic and whether measures would be taken to raise awareness among young people and reduce sales. The government called the rise worrying, pointed to a Trimbos handbook, a planned youth campaign and a pending risk assessment, and said municipal consultations would follow, but answered the questions late.
In the autumn I will, together with the Ministry of Justice and Security, inform your House further on this.
In het najaar zal ik samen met het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid uw Kamer hierover nader berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over Nederlandse kinderen die vastzitten in Syrische opvangkampen.

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the ministers about Dutch children held in Syrian camps, including how many have trauma, what support they receive, and whether the government will bring them home. The government answered that at least 85 such children are in Kurdish-run camps, that aid agencies decide where help goes, and that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their children, while promising care and a multidisciplinary team for children who return.

Government policy, as confirmed in the Minister of Justice and Security's letter to the House of 21 February 2019, is still that the Netherlands does not help travellers leave unsafe areas in Syria and Iraq.

Het kabinetsbeleid, zoals ook bevestigd in de brief van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid aan uw Kamer van 21 februari 2019, is nog steeds dat Nederland uitreizigers niet helpt bij het verlaten van onveilig gebied in Syrië en Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de huisartsenpost in Limburg die onder druk komt te staan

An MP asked the minister about shortages of GP assistants and practice support staff in Limburg, the impact on care quality, recognition of the profession and the limited number of training internships. The minister said insurers and regional actors are working on solutions, the inspectorate has received no reports on this, and the government is funding internships and a regional workforce programme.
Enquiries with the IGJ show that the inspectorate has so far received no signals in which a shortage of GP assistants is mentioned.
Navraag bij de IGJ leert dat bij de inspectie tot nu toe geen signalen zijn binnengekomen waarbij een tekort aan doktersassistenten wordt genoemd.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat mensen onvoldoende op de hoogte zijn om een passende zorgverzekering te kiezen

Ploumen asked the health minister how to ensure people are properly informed about the 2020 cut in the maximum collective discount for health insurance and whether they are overinsured with collective policies. Minister Bruins answered that insurers and comparison sites bear primary responsibility, that the government provides general information and campaigns, and that the NZa supervises compliance.
I have called on health insurers to inform their policyholders about the reduction of the maximum collective discount from 10% to 5%.
Ik heb zorgverzekeraars opgeroepen om hun verzekerden te informeren over de verlaging van de maximale collectiviteitskorting van 10% naar 5%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, en Van Raan over een aanval op de democratie in Turkije

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's removal of elected HDP and CHP mayors and appointment of state supervisors, and whether the Netherlands and EU would condemn it and what consequences would follow. The minister answered that the government shares EU and Council of Europe concerns, supports the EU's public statements, raises the issue bilaterally, and backed halting accession talks, though that proposal lacked support and talks have stalled.
The government does not have precise figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over precieze aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de inperking van vrijheden in Brazilië onder president Bolsonaro

Ploumen asks the Foreign Minister about restrictions on cultural, sexual and democratic freedoms in Brazil under Bolsonaro, including the Rio mayor's censorship of a comic showing two kissing men. Minister Blok answers that the Brazilian Supreme Court overturned the ban, that Netherlands raises human rights concerns with Brazilian authorities and in the EU, but gives no concrete new step.
The day after the mayor's decision, the Brazilian Supreme Court declared it unconstitutional, ruling that freedom of expression is an essential part of a democracy.

Daags na het besluit van de burgemeester werd dat onconstitutioneel verklaard door het Braziliaanse Hooggerechtshof, dat oordeelde dat vrijheid van meningsuiting een essentieel onderdeel is van een democratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat Iran vrouwelijke activistes steeds harder straft

Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports that Iran is handing down ever harsher sentences to women activists, including 24 years for removing a headscarf, and what he was doing to improve women's rights there. Minister Blok answered that the government raises women's rights and human rights with Iran regularly in bilateral, UN and EU settings, and is very concerned about the sentences, but commits to no new concrete step beyond continued advocacy.
The Netherlands is outspoken about the dire human rights situation in Iran and regularly calls on Iran, in both bilateral and multilateral fora, to improve the situation.
Nederland is uitgesproken over de schrijnende mensenrechtensituatie in Iran en roept Iran met regelmaat en in zowel bilaterale als multilaterale fora op de situatie te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de financiële ondersteuning van Europese anti-abortus clubs door Amerikaanse miljardairs

An MP asked the health minister whether he is concerned that US billionaires fund European anti-abortion groups seeking to influence policy, whether Dutch organisations receive similar funding, and whether women's right to choose should be defended. The minister said donor acceptance is up to the organisations, he is unaware of funding of Dutch groups beyond their public reports showing reliance on donations, and he firmly supports women's free access to abortion care within the existing Dutch law.
I consider it important that every woman considering a termination can make a well-considered choice freely.
Ik acht het van belang dat iedere vrouw die een zwangerschapsafbreking overweegt, in vrijheid een weloverwogen keuze kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Ploumen over stank- en vliegenoverlast in Brunssum en Stein

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Ploumen asked the state secretary about odour and fly nuisance from plastic waste recyclers in Brunssum and Stein, and whether such firms may operate close to homes. The state secretary sympathised, explained that the province is the licensing authority and has started enforcement because the firm has not met preventive obligations, and said she is discussing an integrated sector approach with the industry.
The province is of the view that the provisions are not being sufficiently complied with by the company concerned and has therefore started an enforcement procedure.
De provincie is van mening dat deze bepalingen door het bedrijf in kwestie niet in voldoende mate worden nagekomen en heeft daarom een handhavingstraject in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over een verboden lhbti-manifestatie op de Westoever

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed that the Palestinian police banning an LGBTI event on the West Bank and calling on citizens to report activists of Al-Qaws was unacceptable, and whether he would raise concerns with the Palestinian Authority. The minister answered that the police statement had been withdrawn, that the Netherlands urges the PA to respect freedoms of expression and assembly and has raised the matter with the PA, including the prime minister, and has expressed support to Al-Qaws.
The Dutch representative in Ramallah immediately raised the matter with the PA, including the prime minister.
De Nederlandse vertegenwoordiger in Ramallah heeft de zaak terstond opgebracht bij de PA, waaronder de premier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de ontbossing van het Braziliaanse Amazonegebied

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether they share concern over rising Amazon deforestation under Bolsonaro, whether the Netherlands has raised it, and whether Germany's suspension of environmental aid should be matched. The government says it shares the concern, has raised deforestation with Brazil through several channels, will keep doing so, but declines to match Germany's aid suspension and is still deliberating on further steps.
The Netherlands expresses its concern about the increasing deforestation at every suitable opportunity, both when it is in the news and when it is not.
Nederland uit bij alle in aanmerking komende gelegenheden zijn zorgen over de toenemende ontbossing, zowel wanneer dit in het nieuws is, als wanneer dit niet in het nieuws is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de baby en peuter van een Nederlandse vader die zich zonder ouders in een kamp in Noord-Syrië bevinden

Two MPs from the PvdA ask about two young children of a Dutch jihadist without parents in a camp in northern Syria, including their health, why they were not brought back, and whether consular help can be requested. The government says it cannot comment on individual cases, denies diplomats visited the camp, distinguishes this case from the French repatriation, and notes consular assistance requires a request from the Dutch national or their representative.
As you know, the cabinet cannot go into individual cases in more detail.
Zoals u weet kan het kabinet hier niet nader ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de benarde situatie van Papua’s in Indonesië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the reported deaths from hunger and disease and displacement in Papua, whether Indonesia was being raised, and about the Netherlands' responsibility given its colonial history and the 1969 Act of Free Choice. The minister said the figures are disputed, that Papua is raised regularly in bilateral and EU human rights dialogue, and that the Netherlands respects Indonesia's territorial integrity.
Papua is now part of the Republic of Indonesia and the Dutch government fully respects Indonesia's territorial integrity.
Papua is nu een onderdeel van de Republiek Indonesië en de Nederlandse regering respecteert de territoriale integriteit van Indonesië volledig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het voorkomen van vrouwelijke genitale verminking in Nederland

An MP asked the health and justice ministers why no convictions have followed the 1993 ban on female genital mutilation, how many girls are at risk, what protections exist for girls travelling abroad, and how many reports professionals make. The government explains VGV is prosecuted as (aggravated) assault since no specific offence exists, outlines prevention, child protection and travel-permission measures, and says it will report further measures by end 2019.
The Public Prosecution Service does not record for violent offences whether FGM is involved, because there is no specific criminal offence in the Criminal Code.
Het Openbaar Ministerie registreert bij geweldsdelicten niet of sprake is van VGV, omdat er geen specifieke strafbaarstelling bestaat in het Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het gebrekkige toezicht op de data van patiënten

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked how patient data is protected, whether a US company had access to anonymised data, whether patients are informed about research use, and about monopoly risks in digital care. The minister answered that responsibility lies mainly with care providers, that the software in question is not used in the Netherlands, that anonymised or consented research is the rule, and promised further letters and debate.
Hospitals themselves bear responsibility for their patient management software and what they agree with suppliers in their contracts.
Ziekenhuizen dragen zelf de verantwoordelijkheid voor hun software voor patiëntenbeheer en hetgeen ze afspreken met de leveranciers in hun contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de extra wachttijd voor VGZ- verzekerden bij Zuyderland

An MP asks whether the extra 8-week waiting time for VGZ-insured patients at Zuyderland hospital is acceptable and what the government will do for affected patients. The minister answers that the waiting time follows agreed budget caps between insurer and hospital, that VGZ offers referral support, that the NZa oversees the insurer's duty of care, and that no specific measures will be taken.
I am not worried about patients insured with VGZ.
Ik maak mij geen zorgen over patiënten die bij VGZ verzekerd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Diks over het door de Chinese autoriteiten oppakken van activist(en) die zich onder meer inzetten voor hiv-/aidspatiënten

MPs Ploumen, Van den Hul and Diks asked the ministers whether they would seek clarity on the charge against Chinese NGO workers detained for alleged subversion, and how this relates to China's UNAIDS chairmanship. The ministers answered that the embassy follows the case, raises it through the EU and the bilateral human rights dialogue, and that the chair is performing correctly, while concerns about NGO pressure will continue to be raised.
Concerns about individual cases, such as the arrest of Cheng Yuan, Liu Yongze and Xiao Wu, are raised through the bilateral human rights dialogue or in meetings of the UN Human Rights Council.

Zorgen over individuele gevallen, zoals de arrestatie van Cheng Yuan, Liu Yongze en Xiao Wu, worden via de bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog overgebracht of in vergaderingen van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad aan de orde gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Moorlag over de gevolgen van lachgasgebruik voor het Klimaat

PvdA MPs asked whether recreational nitrous oxide use and its climate impact are known to users and how much it adds to emissions. The government answered that users are not aware of the climate effects, estimated the emissions as small relative to national totals, and said a risk assessment due in November will guide any health measures, while no specific climate policy is planned.
Pending the advice, the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport is examining various policy options so that appropriate national measures can be taken quickly once the assessment is final.

In afwachting van het advies worden door het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport diverse beleidsopties bekeken zodat wanneer de beoordeling definitief is, snel passende landelijke maatregelen kunnen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de demonstraties in Hong Kong

MP Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister about the Hong Kong protests, Beijing's growing influence, police violence, freedom of expression and whether the government raised concerns with China. Minister Blok condemned violence on all sides, supported an inclusive dialogue and the EU statement, reaffirmed Hong Kong's autonomy under the Basic Law, and said he raised developments with Wang Yi on 19 June, without committing to new steps toward China.
The cabinet fully supports the statement by the High Representative, which was drawn up in consultation with the EU member states.
Het kabinet staat volledig achter de verklaring van de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger, die in samenspraak met de EU-lidstaten tot stand is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat Minister-President Rutte volgende week voor de tweede maal President Trump bezoekt

Ploumen (PvdA) asked whether PM Rutte would raise human rights, climate, Iran, Saudi Arabia, migrant children and abortion rights with President Trump, and why he had not met the Saudi crown prince at the G20. Minister Blok answered that trade, investment, security and Iran were discussed, that the confidential nature of talks prevents detail, and that no bilateral meeting with the crown prince took place.
Due to the confidential nature of these conversations, it is not possible to go into specifically all the topics discussed.
Omwille van het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze gesprekken kan niet specifiek worden ingegaan op alle onderwerpen die besproken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van het lid Ploumen over de opnieuw opgelegde celstraf voor een Chinese internetdissident en de slechte gezondheidszorg in Chinese detentie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the renewed prison sentence of Chinese internet dissident Huang Qi and poor medical care in Chinese detention, and whether the government would raise these with Chinese authorities. The minister said the government shares the concerns, supports the EU statement, raised Huang Qi's fair trial at the 2018 human rights dialogue, and will raise his situation again at the next dialogue.
A next bilateral human rights dialogue with China offers an opportunity to again raise concerns about Huang Qi's conviction with the Chinese authorities.
Een volgende bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog met China biedt gelegenheid om opnieuw zorgen over de veroordeling van Huang Qi over te brengen aan de Chinese autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Ploumen over het faillissement van Huize de Berg

MPs Hijink and Ploumen asked the minister about the bankruptcy of Huize de Berg, a convent whose facilities staff were sold to a commercial group, including whether staff are owed wages and whether a sister company restart is planned. The minister answered that the bankruptcy concerns the hospitality subsidiary, not care provision, that the causes are for the curator to investigate, that workers may claim wage guarantees via UWV, and that Blueprint Group denies planning a restart, and provided an overview of group entities.
From my position I cannot pass judgment on this specific case.
Ik kan vanuit mijn positie geen oordeel vellen over dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Nijboer over het sluiten van bankrekeningen van Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen

MPs Ploumen and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether banks are increasingly closing accounts of Dutch citizens living abroad, why, and whether additional rules apply. The minister confirmed the trend, said banks set their own client strategy and risk profile within existing law, and committed to consulting banks on access to services for Dutch citizens abroad.
I will consult with banks to discuss developments regarding access for Dutch citizens abroad to banking services.
Ik zal in overleg treden met banken om te spreken over de ontwikkelingen rond de toegang van Nederlanders in het buitenland tot dienstverlening van banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Karabulut over de groeiende angst onder activisten om naar Marokko te gaan

Two MPs (Ploumen, Karabulut) asked whether the government is aware of fear among activists about travelling to Morocco, whether signals of insecurity were received, and whether a complaints point or stronger action is warranted. The minister replied that travel decisions are personal, no signals of increased insecurity were received, consular help is available, and the Rif cities carry a yellow travel advisory with no reason yet for stronger action.
Neither the Ministry of Foreign Affairs nor the embassy has received signals of increased insecurity.
Er zijn noch bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken noch bij de ambassade signalen binnen gekomen over toegenomen onveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het hoge aantal burgerslachtoffers van explosieve wapens in dichtbevolkte gebieden

The MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about the high share of civilian victims of explosive weapons in populated areas, citing a 2019 NGO report and asking about past trends, UN calls and a planned Austrian conference. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns such harm, relies on IHL, arms control treaties and export controls, funds explosive-remnant clearance, and will raise the issue at the conference.

Yes. The Netherlands will, in line with its existing position described in the answers to questions two, three and four, condemn the large number of civilian victims from the use of explosive weapons in populated areas.

Ja. Nederland zal daar, conform de bestaande inzet zoals omschreven in de beantwoording van vragen twee, drie en vier, het grote aantal burgerslachtoffers als gevolg van het gebruik van explosieve wapens in dichtbevolkte gebieden aan de kaak stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het groeiend tekort aan doktersassistenten

MP Ploumen asked the Minister of Medical Care about the growing shortage of doctor's assistants, their role as gatekeepers, and whether they should be legally recognised under the Wet BIG. The minister answered that insurers and regional parties are addressing access problems, no IGJ signals about the shortage have been received, and the shortage is being tackled via the Werken in de Zorg action programme.
Nivel conducted surveys among GP practices in all labour market regions as part of a study I commissioned with the LHV last year.

Het Nivel heeft in alle arbeidsmarktregio's enquêtes uitgezet onder huisartsenpraktijken in het kader van een onderzoek waarvoor ik samen met de Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging (LHV) vorig jaar opdracht heb gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over “strijdsters voor vrouwenrechten in Afghanistan die steeds verder in het nauw komen”

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares concern that women's rights activists in Afghanistan are increasingly squeezed, whether the PM raised Afghan peace talks with Trump, and what the government will do about women's rights after US and NATO withdrawal. Minister Blok answered that the situation is concerning, the PM did not discuss Afghanistan, the government raises women's rights with partners, and lists existing programmes and embassy activities.

Yes. In contacts with all international partners, including the United States, the cabinet emphasises that the Afghan peace process must lead to an outcome that protects the human rights of all citizens, including women and minorities.

Ja. Het kabinet benadrukt in contacten met alle internationale partners, waaronder de Verenigde Staten, dat het Afghaanse vredesproces moet leiden tot een uitkomst waarbij de mensenrechten van alle burgers, inclusief vrouwen en minderheden, worden beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Bijna één op drie ziekenhuisvacatures moeilijk te vervullen’

Kerstens and Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that nearly a third of hospital vacancies are hard to fill, and about hospital staff turnover and collective labour agreement offers. Minister Bruins acknowledged hard-to-fill vacancies, provided turnover figures showing a net inflow of about 1,900 workers, and said that pay is a matter for social partners while the ministry provides extra funds for pay growth.
It is up to social partners to make good agreements on attractive collective labour agreements given this room.
Het is aan sociale partners om gegeven deze ruimte goede afspraken te maken over aantrekkelijke cao's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de tekortschietende registratie van borstimplantaten

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about news that only half of hospitals had their breast implant registration in order, and whether women's medical risks were adequately protected. The minister answered that registration is being phased in until 1 January 2020, that about half of hospitals have implemented the GDSN link, and that the IGJ and CIBG will monitor compliance and enforce where needed.
I will continue to closely monitor the connection of clinics and hospitals together with the IGJ and the CIBG.
De aansluiting van klinieken en ziekenhuizen blijf ik nauwlettend in de gaten houden samen met de IGJ en het CIBG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Madagascar: Take decisive steps to end torture and killings by security forces’

MPs Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty International's call on Madagascar to end impunity for torture and killings by security forces and to address prison conditions. The minister answered that Netherlands supports the call, will raise it via EU political dialogue and the UN Universal Periodic Review, but has no embassy in Madagascar and cannot verify prison conditions or the number of detained minors.
The Netherlands has no embassy or career consulate in Madagascar and therefore cannot draw on its own observations.
Nederland heeft geen ambassade of beroepsconsulaat in Madagaskar en kan derhalve niet uit eigen waarnemingen putten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Van der  Staaij over het Nederlandse kind Duncan en de Spaanse kinderbescherming

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the case of a Dutch child with Down syndrome held under Spanish child protection and whether he should be reunited with his mother quickly. The minister said the matter falls to the competent Spanish authority, that the ministry is following the case and has mediated contact, and withheld case details citing data protection.
For reasons of personal data protection, I cannot give your House any details about the individual case.
Omwille van persoonsgegevensbescherming kan ik uw Kamer geen details geven over de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘VN-rapport: Bewijs dat Saoedische kroonprins achter moord Khashoggi zit’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to a UN special rapporteur's report finding credible evidence that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman bears responsibility for the murder of journalist Jamal Khashoggi, and asked about contact with the rapporteur, whether the killing is an international crime, and further EU sanctions. The minister replied that the Netherlands and the EU condemn the murder, call on Saudi Arabia to cooperate fully with investigations, engaged with the rapporteur at the Human Rights Council, and will keep pressing bilaterally and multilaterally, but that there is currently no support for UN sanctions and priority is given to an EU human rights sanctions regime.
The cabinet will continue to press this in bilateral and multilateral contexts.
Het kabinet zal hier in bilateraal en multilateraal verband op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat jonge vrouwen die Saoedi-Arabië ontvluchten om een gedwongen huwelijk en seksueel misbruik te voorkomen

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister and justice state secretary about reports that two young Saudi women fleeing forced marriage were refused boarding in Georgia, whether they would be admitted, and what the government was doing on Saudi women's rights. The minister said the reports could not be confirmed, no visa application was made, asylum for such women runs only through UNHCR resettlement, and that Nederland repeatedly raises women's rights bilaterally and in the EU and UN.
Because of the small numbers, it is not possible for privacy and technical reasons to state what the asylum motives are.
Vanwege de kleine aantallen is het om privacy technische redenen niet mogelijk aan te geven wat de asielmotieven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over de aanpak van de overlast door de eikenprocessierups

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers how the government will tackle the large-scale nuisance from the oak processionary caterpillar, including whether a national approach is needed. The minister acknowledges the increased nuisance, points to a new knowledge platform and RIVM/GGD information, and states that municipalities bear a duty of care, so the response is decentralised, with the ministry providing national coordination.

At national level I also take the lead, among other things through knowledge dissemination, research that is being set up and carried out, and sharing insights on controlling the oak processionary caterpillar.

Landelijk wordt ook regie genomen door mij, onder andere via kennisverspreiding, onderzoek dat wordt opgezet en uitgevoerd en het delen van inzichten ten aanzien van de bestrijding van de eikenprocessierups.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de architectenrel op het Binnenhof

MP Ploumen asks the State Secretary for the Interior about reports that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf considered Koen van Velsen as executive architect for the Binnenhof renovation, his time as interim Rijksbouwmeester, and why OMA was chosen. The State Secretary answers that Van Velsen was discussed for design phases but no appointment followed due to unresolved business terms, that his prior role did not block an appointment, and that Pi de Bruijn was not considered.
These discussions did not lead to an appointment.
Deze gesprekken hebben niet tot een aanstelling geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de ontmoeting met de Chinese collega Wang Yi waarin de sterke band en het belang van internationale samenwerking besproken werd

Ploumen asked Foreign Minister Blok whether human rights abuses in China were raised during his meeting with Wang Yi, and about facial recognition and the social credit system. Blok answered that he raised freedom of religion, especially in Xinjiang, and met human rights activists, and that the Netherlands raises these issues with China, while he declined to discuss facial recognition and social credit in that meeting, offering to put social credit on the agenda of a future human rights dialogue.
I am willing to put the subject on the agenda of the next bilateral human rights dialogue with China, which may take place this autumn.
Ik ben bereid om het onderwerp te agenderen voor de volgende bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog met China die mogelijk dit najaar zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Nijboer en Van den Hul over Nederlandse verzekeraars die meer kunnen doen om medicijnen betaalbaar te maken

Three PvdA MPs asked whether Dutch insurers such as Aegon and Allianz, which invest heavily in pharmaceutical firms, should press those firms on medicine prices, tax payment and the Access to Medicine Index investor pledge. The minister answered that insurers are responsible for their own investment policy, pointed to existing IMVO covenant commitments and the OECD guidelines, encouraged signing the pledge, and saw no reason for further measures on transparency.
Institutional investors, including insurers, are responsible for their own investment policy and decide themselves in which companies to invest.
Institutionele beleggers, waaronder verzekeraars, zijn verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen beleggingsbeleid en bepalen zelf in welke bedrijven belegd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over geneesmiddelentekorten

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about drug shortages in the Netherlands, referring to a press article and asking whether the government would adopt proposed measures and report on the status of each earlier recommendation. The minister declined to give a substantive view yet, pointing to ongoing studies (Gupta Strategists, IGJ evaluation, RIVM review) with results due later in 2019, and promised a status letter and further information once these are available.
I am aware of the article, but at this moment I find it premature to give my opinion on this and to go into the measures mentioned.
Ik ben op de hoogte van het artikel, maar ik vind het op dit moment prematuur om mijn mening hierover te geven en in te gaan op de genoemde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de oprichting van een tribunaal om IS-strijders te vervolgen

MPs asked whether the government had discussed an international tribunal for IS fighters with Sweden, whether it will pursue genocide prosecutions and join a Swedish-invited conference, and whether a prosecutor is assigned. The government confirmed talks with Sweden and UN partners, said it is seeking expert advice on an international tribunal due 8 July 2019, and said the Public Prosecution Service will report on a dedicated prosecutor before the recess.
The Public Prosecution Service is expected to inform the cabinet before the recess whether a special prosecutor specifically for prosecuting ISIS fighters for genocide would add value.

Het OM zal het kabinet naar verwachting voor het reces nog informeren of daarnaast een speciale officier van justitie specifiek voor de vervolging van ISIS-strijders voor genocide van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het terughalen van Nederlandse kinderen uit Syrië

Two PvdA MPs asked whether MIVD staff or Dutch diplomats regularly visit the Al-Roj camp in Syria to prepare repatriation, how often delegations have visited, and whether the Netherlands prepares for returning children and their parents. The ministers declined to comment publicly on intelligence service methods, called the report of biweekly diplomatic visits incorrect, and stated that returnees will be brought back in a controlled manner for prosecution while children are treated as victims and childcare plans are ready.
No public statements are made about the working methods of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over de werkwijze van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten wordt in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over onrust onder BIG geregistreerde verpleegkundigen met een diploma van voor 2012

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked the Minister about unrest among experienced nurses with pre-2012 diplomas who must take a course or test to register as regieverpleegkundige under the Wet BIG II, and about attrition, competencies and recognition of prior learning. The Minister defends the 2012 cut-off and the transitional scheme as broadly supported, says the test or course is needed to show competencies, and says the EVC option will be examined.
The possibilities for this still need to be examined during the development of the training programme.
De mogelijkheden hiervan dienen nog te worden onderzocht tijdens de ontwikkeling van het scholingsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen, Van den Hul, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht ‘IND stuurt yezidi’s terug naar kampen in Noord-Irak, VN ongerust’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether Iraqi Yezidis are being returned to camps in Northern Iraq despite UNHCR concern, and whether Kurdish camps can absorb them. The State Secretary answered that Yezidis from other parts of Iraq who fled to the Kurdistan Region and lived there long-term are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, so the vulnerable minority policy applies, and that the Kurdish shelter situation is not generally inadequate.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to give extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi’s
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over de voorgenomen uitbreiding van een geitenhouderij in Hurwenen

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether the expansion of a goat farm in Hurwenen from 7,000 to over 13,000 goats was acceptable, given a RIVM link to pneumonia risk, and whether the minister would impose a national expansion ban or intervene in this case. The minister replied that land-use and environmental decisions rest with municipalities and provinces, that a flawed permit application led to the permit being granted by operation of law, that follow-up health research is expected in 2021, and that no national ban is being considered.
The municipality concerned acknowledged, according to the Zembla broadcast, that the permit application was not handled properly and that errors were made.
De betreffende gemeente heeft, blijkens de uitzending van het programma Zembla, erkend dat op de vergunningaanvraag niet goed is gereageerd en dat er fouten zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de patiëntenzorg die in gevaar is op de spoedeisende hulp van het LUMC

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about overcrowding and endangered patient care at the emergency department of the Leiden University Medical Centre, including reports of delayed care and a patient death. The minister answers by referring to a letter to parliament, stating the Inspectorate sees no current unacceptable risks, that the hospital board is taking measures and must monitor them, and that the Inspectorate and hospital have acted on the situation.
The Inspectorate has no reason to assume that there are currently unacceptable risks.
De Inspectie heeft geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat er op dit moment sprake is van onaanvaardbare risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over hartinfarcten die voor vrouwen bijna dubbel zo vaak fataal zijn dan voor mannen

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the minister whether women's heart attacks and cardiac arrests are more often fatal than men's, and what measures are taken on reanimation, symptom recognition and research funding. The minister disputed the framing, attributed the poorer survival to cardiac-arrest rhythm differences, and listed existing campaigns, guidelines and research programmes, without committing to new measures.
A cardiac arrest in women is also less quickly recognised because the symptoms are less clear.
Ook wordt een hartstilstand bij vrouwen minder snel herkend omdat de symptomen minder duidelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het tekort aan doktersassistenten

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about a shortage of practice assistants (doktersassistenten) that could force GP practices to close this summer, including its effects on access, safety and regional care. The Minister says insurers and regional plans will address access, the inspectorate has received no reports of safety risks, and the government is pursuing a broad workforce action programme without committing to new specific measures.
In addition, there are opportunities in GP care to make better use of task shifting and job carving.
Daarnaast liggen er in de huisartsenzorg kansen om taakherschikking en job carving beter te benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘VN annuleert mensenrechtensessies wegens geldgebrek’

Ploumen (PvdA) asks the Foreign Minister about reports that the UN is cancelling human rights sessions due to lack of funds, and about the effects on complaints, country reports and Dutch cases. Minister Blok replies that no treaty body sessions have yet been cancelled, that OHCHR confirmed the 2019 sessions will proceed, that the funding problems stem from a cash-flow shortage, a 2017 budget cut and staffing limits, and that the Netherlands paid its contribution and urges late-paying states to pay.
Together with the other EU member states, the Netherlands consistently urges countries in arrears to meet their payment obligations.
Nederland roept samen met de andere lidstaten van de Europese Unie landen die in gebreke blijven consequent op hun betalingsverplichtingen na te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Ploumen over het bericht dat er nieuw bewijs is van China's missie om de moskeeën in Xinjiang te verwoesten

MPs Kuzu and Ploumen asked the government about reports that China is demolishing mosques and shrines in Xinjiang, whether this violates universal human rights, and what the Netherlands and the EU have done to press China. The ministers answer that the demolitions fit a broader pattern of restricted freedoms in Xinjiang that they consider contrary to international human rights norms, list bilateral, EU and UN initiatives, and say they will keep pressing for meaningful access for UN experts to Xinjiang.
The cabinet continues to call for meaningful access to Xinjiang for UN (human rights) experts, including the High Commissioner for Human Rights.
Het kabinet blijft pleiten voor betekenisvolle toegang tot Xinjiang voor (mensenrechten)experts van de VN, waaronder de Hoge Commissaris voor de Mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het overlijden van gijzelaar Ewold Horn in de Filipijnen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the death of Dutch hostage Ewold Horn in the Philippines, including whether the government knew of a planned rescue operation, what steps it took, and whether it had dialogue with Abu Sayyaf. The minister said local authorities are responsible for resolution, declined to detail the government's efforts or the planned operation for reasons of confidentiality, and dismissed critics' claims as made without knowledge of the efforts.

To avoid harming the Dutch government's capacity to act in this and future cases, in the interest of relations with third countries and international organisations, and thus for the safety of all Dutch nationals abroad, I will not make further statements about this case or the Dutch government's efforts in it.

Om de slagkracht van de Nederlandse overheid in deze en toekomstige zaken niet te schaden, in het belang van de relaties met derde landen en internationale organisaties en dus voor de veiligheid van alle Nederlanders in het buitenland, doe ik geen nadere mededelingen over deze zaak en de inspanningen van de Nederlandse overheid daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘U.S. sanctions Congo election officials, says they obstructed vote’

MP Ploumen asks the government whether it knows of US sanctions on Congolese election officials for obstructing the vote, and about corruption, the effects of EU and US sanctions, network-based sanctioning and criminal money flows in the DRC. Minister Blok answers that the Netherlands is in contact with the US, that EU and US sanctions target individuals obstructing the election, that network-based sanctions were not an EU criterion, and that tracing illicit money flows is being pursued with partners such as The Sentry.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VVD en CDA zien geen heil in terughalen IS-kinderen’

MPs Ploumen, Kuiken and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about the situation of Dutch IS women and children held in Syrian camps, their ability to reach Dutch consulates, the Red Cross offer to bring children to Erbil, and calls for an international tribunal. The government answered that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult jihadist travellers and their children, that conditions in Al-Hol are very poor, and that it is working on options for prosecution with international partners while stating no tribunal has yet been agreed.
The cabinet sees the children in this matter first and foremost as victims.
Het kabinet ziet de kinderen in deze kwestie in de eerste plaats als slachtoffer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Dissidenten uit Hongkong krijgen voor het eerst asiel in Duitsland’

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign and justice ministers about Hong Kong's proposed extradition law to China, its risks for Dutch citizens and firms, and German asylum grants to Hong Kong dissidents. The government said it had raised concerns with Hong Kong's leader and the EU, that the law was suspended, and that asylum decisions do not reflect on the rule of law in the country of origin.
The cabinet will closely follow developments and, if necessary, consider what the consequences should be for cooperation with Hong Kong on the surrender of fugitive offenders.

Het kabinet zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en zal zo nodig bezien wat de eventuele gevolgen zouden moeten zijn voor de samenwerking met Hongkong op het gebied van overlevering van voortvluchtige delinquenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over bodyguards die nodig zijn om vrouwen te begeleiden naar een abortuskliniek

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the health minister about volunteer bodyguards escorting women to abortion clinics and whether the government will act against increasingly militant anti-abortion demonstrators. The minister said the initiative is lawful, that protecting women is a matter for mayors, and that measures depend on local circumstances; he pointed to a recent letter and a debate instead of new measures.
Whether measures are necessary and justified depends on all relevant facts and (local) circumstances, and is therefore an assessment that can only be made locally by the mayor.

Of maatregelen noodzakelijk en gerechtvaardigd zijn, is afhankelijk van alle relevante feiten en (plaatselijke) omstandigheden, en daarmee een beoordeling die alleen lokaal door de burgemeester kan worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Geleijnse over hoge parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Ploumen and Geleijnse asked the Minister whether hospitals profit from parking revenue, whether they inform patients about ways to limit parking costs, and whether insurers will act. The Minister said he keeps no overview of parking revenue, that parking policy is the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, and that the issue was raised with hospitals in consultation without any firm commitment to further investigation.
I do not keep an overview of the revenues from parking fees at hospitals or whether hospitals keep money from them.
Ik houd geen overzicht bij van de opbrengsten van parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen en of ziekenhuizen daar geld aan overhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de vergoeding van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen

An MP asks whether IVF for egg donors and women unable to produce good eggs due to cancer or early menopause should be reimbursed, and why this differs from organ donation coverage. The minister says donor treatment is not covered because donors lack their own medical indication, and commits to asking the Zorginstituut for advice on this question.
I will ask the Zorginstituut to advise me on reimbursement under the basic package in the situation where the insured has a medical fertility problem.
Ik zal het Zorginstituut vragen mij te adviseren over vergoeding ten laste van het basispakket in de situatie dat er sprake is van een medisch vruchtbaarheidsprobleem bij de verzekerde
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over menstruatie-armoede in Nederland

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked whether period poverty, the inability to afford menstrual products, occurs in the Netherlands and whether the government would investigate it. The state secretary replied that there is no evidence yet, that the feminist platform De Bovengrondse is researching it with results due in August, and that the government will decide on further steps after those results.
On the basis of the outcomes we will determine whether and which further steps are necessary or desirable.
Op basis van de uitkomsten zullen wij bepalen of en welke verdere stappen nodig dan wel wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het feit dat Nederland tegen openheid over ontwikkelkosten van geneesmiddelen heeft gestemd

An MP asks why the Netherlands supported transparency on drug prices and trial outcomes but opposed transparency on trial and R&D costs at the WHA, and why the resolution text was weakened. The minister denies the Netherlands opposed R&D cost transparency, says the resolution was adopted by consensus, and defends confidential price deals as necessary for access while calling for future price transparency.
During the negotiations on the resolution, the Netherlands made no statements contrary to transparency of trial costs and development costs.
Nederland heeft tijdens de onderhandelingen over de resolutie geen uitspraken gedaan die indruisen tegen transparantie van kosten van trials en ontwikkelingskosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht dat de VS een steeds steviger abortusbeleid voert

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers about reports that the US is tightening anti-abortion funding rules abroad, asking for the government's reaction, diplomatic steps, and ways to offset the effects.
