The minister said the government regrets the measures, has raised concerns with US officials, and points to continued SRGR funding and several parliamentary amendments being implemented.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over maatregelen tegen Amerikaanse sancties tegen Iran

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked whether the EU anti-boycott regulation against US sanctions on Iran is effective and whether the US sanctions are unlawful, and what steps can protect the JCPOA and trade with Iran. The ministers answered that the regulation is in place but unused by Dutch firms, that INSTEX is being developed, that Dutch firms decide independently to cut trade, and that the Netherlands remains committed to the JCPOA.
The cabinet has no figures on the trading activities of individual Dutch companies with Iran.
Het kabinet heeft geen cijfers over de handelsactiviteiten van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven met Iran.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over advocaten die de toegang tot de Verenigde Staten wordt geweigerd

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether US entry bans against lawyers defending terrorism suspects could deter Dutch lawyers, and whether the minister would consult the US ambassador. The minister agreed lawyers must practise freely, said US entry decisions are sovereign and based on many criteria, and reported that US authorities referred to general policy and would not address individual cases; the government will keep monitoring the situation.
Lawyers must be free in the exercise of their profession, given the important role they play in realising the right of suspects to a fair trial.
Advocaten moeten vrij zijn in de uitoefening van hun beroep, gelet op de belangrijke rol die zij spelen in de verwezenlijking van het recht van verdachten op een eerlijk proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de te lange wachtlijsten in de transgenderzorg

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about long waiting lists in gender-affirming care, including Amsterdam UMC's waiting times, staffing shortages, a planned Radboud UMC youth service, and a priority scheme for trans youth. The minister acknowledged the waits are undesirable, pointed to a navigator (kwartiermaker) advisory process and capacity expansions, and left prioritisation largely to insurers and providers.
I too find the long waiting lists for gender-affirming care undesirable.
Ook ik vind de lange wachtlijsten voor transgenderzorg onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Vijf jaar na de grote ontvoering door Boko Haram, zijn nog 112 schoolmeisjes niet vrij’

An MP asked why the government has made no concrete proposal to Nigeria to help find the 112 still-missing Chibok schoolgirls, and asked about trauma support, satellite imagery, NGO contacts and gender-violence programmes. The ministers answered that Nigeria has made no request for help, that Dutch psychosocial aid already reaches Boko Haram victims, and that other states are handling satellite sharing and support.
This is a matter between third countries and Nigeria, in which the Netherlands is not involved.
Dit is een zaak tussen derde landen en Nigeria, waar Nederland niet bij betrokken is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Kritiek op Saoedi’s? Dan dreigt gevaar'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the risk to critical journalists and dissidents from Saudi Arabia, including contacts with Norwegian and US intelligence, EU coordination, and calls for divestment. The minister replied that concerns about Saudi human rights are shared, that intelligence contacts are not discussed publicly, and that the Netherlands opposes boycotts or sanctions while continuing critical dialogue.
The government does not publicly comment on specific contacts between Dutch and foreign intelligence and security services.
De regering gaat in het openbaar niet in op concrete contacten tussen Nederlandse en buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over mogelijke beïnvloeding bij het opstellen van richtlijnen

MP Ploumen asks the Minister of Medical Care about the lowered LDL target of 1.8 in the new cardiovascular risk guideline, possible industry influence on its drafting, and the financial ties of committee members to drug makers. The minister replies that the 1.8 target applies only to very high-risk patients, that the guideline's drafters say they worked independently, that expected cost increases are limited, and that disclosure rules and the Health Inspectorate govern conflicts of interest, with the Transparency Register evaluation pending.
Professional groups are themselves responsible for the quality of their care and the guidelines for it.
Beroepsgroepen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van hun zorg en de richtlijnen daarvoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Voordewind over het bericht ‘De jezidi’s zijn hun familie en cultuur kwijt’

MPs Ploumen, Van den Hul and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Yazidi women and children remain missing or enslaved, the role of Yazidi support organisations, Syrian regime action, aid withdrawal from Duhok and psychosocial programmes. The ministers answered that about 3,083 Yazidis were still held or missing as of late 2018, outlined existing Dutch and EU support, and committed to no new concrete steps beyond ongoing programmes and an October 2019 conference.
The Netherlands has no diplomatic relations with the Assad regime and the cabinet has no independent information on regime actions to free possibly enslaved Yazidis.
Nederland onderhoudt geen diplomatieke betrekkingen met het Assad-regime en het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over regime-acties om mogelijke tot slaaf gemaakte jezidi’s te bevrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bowing to U.S. demands, UN waters down resolution on sexual violence in conflict’

Two MPs asked the Dutch ministers about reports that the UN Security Council watered down a resolution on sexual violence in conflict under US veto pressure, including the removal of sexual and reproductive health language and the weakened reference to the ICC. The government said it regrets the US threat, supports reproductive health language and the French position, sees no direct consequences for victim assistance or UNFPA funding, and explained the ICC reference change as a compromise.
The Netherlands explicitly spoke out for sexual and reproductive health and rights during its intervention in the open debate.
Nederland heeft zich tijdens de interventie in het open debat expliciet uitgesproken voor seksuele en reproductieve gezondheid en rechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het samengaan van VBOK en Siriz

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the State Secretary whether the merger of VBOK into Siriz, a counselling provider, would undermine the neutral and non-directive character of abortion choice counselling and whether funding should be reviewed. The State Secretary replied that the open house quality criteria, central training and independent expert review, together with IGJ supervision, adequately safeguard quality, and that he will monitor any new structure.
As I informed you earlier, the independent experts I will appoint will assess whether this has indeed happened as I have now agreed with the parties.
Zoals ik u eerder informeerde, zullen de onafhankelijk deskundigen die ik zal aanstellen gaan beoordelen of dit ook werkelijk is gebeurd zoals ik nu met partijen heb afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen over ontvoeren en uithuwelijken van meisjes naar het buitenland

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen asked the government about abduction and forced marriage of girls abroad, including whether children aged twelve and under are affected, the role of teachers, legal options to block travel, and possible exit bans. The government answered that child marriages are hard to detect, pointed to the meldcode and existing child-protection measures, noted that preparing a forced marriage abroad is already punishable under article 285c Sr, and said further measures are being explored within the 'Geweld hoort nergens thuis' programme.
Child marriages are an invisible and complex problem.
Kindhuwelijken zijn een onzichtbaar en complex probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over gevaren van het gebruik van lachgas

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reports of people falling ill from recreational nitrous oxide use, rising poisoning reports, frostbite risk, and whether the NVWA should enforce and national policy should be introduced. The state secretary acknowledged the rise in reports, requested a new risk assessment, said frostbite is caused by careless consumer use rather than the product so NVWA enforcement is not its role, and promised to consult municipalities and VNG on further measures.
Therefore I asked the Coordination Point for Assessment and Monitoring of New Drugs (CAM) last month to carry out a new risk assessment of nitrous oxide.
Daarom heb ik het Coördinatiepunt Assessment en Monitoring Nieuwe Drugs (CAM) eind vorige maand gevraagd een nieuwe risicobeoordeling van lachgas uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Bangladesh: Rohingya Refugee Students Expelled'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Bangladesh bars Rohingya refugee children from formal education and aid groups struggle to provide schooling. The minister acknowledged the gaps, said the government raises access to education with Bangladesh and donors, and pointed to Dutch funding for Education Cannot Wait.
I raised the lack of access to education with the authorities and asked them to be more open to solutions that offer Rohingya children the necessary education.
Ik heb het gebrek aan toegang tot onderwijs aan de orde gesteld en de autoriteiten gevraagd meer open te staan voor oplossingen die Rohingya-kinderen noodzakelijk onderwijs bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het doodvonnis voor de Jemenitische bahá’í de heer Hamed bin Haydara

MP Ploumen asks the Foreign Minister whether he knows the death penalty is sought against Yemeni Bahá'í Hamed bin Haydara, whether the government has contacted the Houthi authorities, his lawyer, and the community, and whether it will investigate the treatment of the Bahá'í. The minister confirms awareness, says Nederland raised the case within the EU and has no direct contact with the lawyer or Houthi authorities, and promises to monitor the situation and keep the House informed.
The Netherlands is closely following the situation of the community in Yemen, as part of the broader situation in the country, and will keep the House informed of relevant developments.
Nederland volgt de situatie van de gemeenschap in Jemen op de voet, als onderdeel van de bredere situatie in het land, en zal de Kamer op de hoogte blijven houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het verlagen van R&D en het beschikbaar maken van nieuwe geneesmiddelen voor patiënten voor wie geen behandeling bestaat

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about lowering R&D costs and making new drugs available to patients without alternatives, including post-phase-2 reimbursement and real-world evidence. The Minister answers that R&D costs do not directly determine drug prices, that reimbursement is limited to registered drugs meeting the 'state of science and practice' criterion, that named-patient and compassionate-use routes exist, and that a separate regime for orphan drugs and conditionals is being developed.
In addition, I am continuing to work on the scheme for orphan drugs and conditionals.
Daarnaast werk ik verder aan de regeling voor weesgeneesmiddelen en conditionals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de vergoeding van glucosemeter die de kwaliteit van leven aanzienlijk verbeterd

An MP asks the minister why research showing wider benefit of the FreeStyle Libre glucose sensor has not led to reimbursement, what it would cost, and whether the Zorginstituut will be asked to advise quickly. The minister replies that the Zorginstituut is developing a standpoint with the Ronde Tafel Diabeteszorg, cost estimates are given, and a decision on type 1 patients is expected by end 2019, so no new advice is requested.
I therefore see no reason at this time to ask the Zorginstituut for additional advice, since the Zorginstituut is already working on a standpoint
Ik zie daarom nu geen aanleiding het Zorginstituut om een aanvullend advies te vragen, aangezien het Zorginstituut reeds werkt aan een standpunt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Dochtertje van Nederlandse Syriëganger overleden in vluchtelingenkamp’

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about reports that a Dutch Syria-returnee's young daughter died in the Al Hol camp, the camp conditions, and whether Dutch women and children would be brought back. The ministers acknowledged the dire humanitarian conditions and the child deaths, but said the Netherlands does not actively repatriate its nationals from Syria, separating children from parents is undesirable and legally complex, and consular assistance is only given if they report to a Dutch mission in the region.
The Netherlands takes no action aimed at or supporting the active repatriation of Dutch travellers to Syria.
Nederland onderneemt geen actie gericht op of ondersteunend aan het actief terughalen van Nederlandse uitreizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over doodstraf voor homo’s in Brunei

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether the Syariah Penal Code phases 2 and 3 in Brunei, including death by stoning, would take effect and what Dutch and international pressure could prevent this. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands and the EU raised concerns, issued statements and pressed Brunei, that a moratorium on the death penalty was announced, and that Dutch support for civil society and LGBTI rights continues.
The cabinet has taken note with great concern of Brunei's decision to introduce phases 2 and 3 of the Syariah Penal Code.
Het kabinet heeft met veel zorg kennisgenomen van het besluit van Brunei om fase 2 en 3 van de Syariah Penal Code in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Saoedi-Arabië executeert 37 gevangenen om terrorisme’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Saudi Arabia's execution of 37 prisoners convicted of terrorism, including the use of the 2014 counterterrorism law against activists and critics, and whether sanctions were considered. The minister condemned the executions, said Nederland opposes the death penalty and raised concerns in EU and UN settings, but stated that sanctions lack the required international political consensus and gave no concrete new measures.
Imposing sanctions requires broad international political agreement.
Voor het instellen van sancties is internationaal brede politieke overeenstemming nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Moorlag over het bericht dat vaginaal douchen schade oplevert bij vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Moorlag asked whether vaginal douching products that claim health benefits, and that can cause harm, should be acted upon and whether more public information is needed. The minister says existing guidance already advises against douching, that the IGJ and NVWA have received almost no complaints, and that no further measures are currently warranted.
I currently see no reason to take further measures.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Niger, part 1: At the centre of a brewing militant storm’

Two Dutch MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about rising displacement, violence and instability in Niger's Tillabéri and Tahoua regions and the Dutch response. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, is supporting UNHCR and Niger with EUR 100 million for 2019–2022, and is focusing on stability, youth and governance, without any institutional or oversight change.
The Netherlands supports UNHCR with an unearmarked contribution of EUR 33 million.
Nederland steunt UNHCR met een ongeoormerkte bijdrage van EUR 33 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen over de toegang weigeren van een haatprediker tot Nederland

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether the government would refuse entry to a preacher whose statements about LGBTI people and the Holocaust they condemned, and what legal powers exist to deny or expel him. The Secretary of State answered that hate speech has no place in the Dutch rule of law, referred to the earlier integrated approach to extremist speakers and the LGBTI safety action plan, and stated that measures have been taken to prevent the person's entry into the Schengen zone.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘It Wasn’t Just Khashoggi: A Saudi Prince’s Brutal Drive to Crush Dissent’

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a Saudi intervention team targeting dissidents, Saudi human rights abuses, detention conditions and the arrest of women's rights activists. The minister could not confirm the intervention team, said Dutch concerns are raised bilaterally and multilaterally including a joint UN statement, and noted that embassy access to trials had been refused four times.
I cannot provide any information on the exact content of these contacts with partners.
Over de exacte inhoud van deze contacten met partners kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de richtlijn nevenbevindingen bij het bevolkingsonderzoek borstkanker

An MP asked whether the RIVM guideline on incidental findings in breast cancer screening should be revised, given reports linking breast implants to ALCL, and whether implant leakage or wear should be reported to GPs. The state secretary said responsibility for implant maintenance lies with the care provider and patient, that the guideline is under review, and that the professional groups will be asked to act with care and inform parliament before summer.
I will inform the House before the summer about the professional groups' judgment and how incidental findings will be handled in future.
Ik zal de Kamer voor de zomer nader informeren over het oordeel van de beroepsgroepen en hoe in de toekomst om wordt gegaan met nevenbevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over een keurmerk voor voedsel

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether the government would adopt the Nutriscore food labelling system, citing a Consumentenbond survey of snacks. The Secretary of State said the government is still comparing European logos and running consumer research, will decide after summer and no later than end 2019, and gave no commitment to Nutriscore.
I expect to inform you after the summer, but no later than the end of 2019, about the outcomes of the studies and my decision on the new food choice logo.
Ik verwacht u na de zomer, maar uiterlijk eind 2019 te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken en mijn beslissing over het nieuwe voedselkeuzelogo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Vijf jaar na grote ontvoering Boko Haram, zijn nog 112 schoolmeisjes niet vrij’

An MP asked whether the government knows the testimony of escaped Chibok schoolgirls, has contacted Nigeria on the still-missing girls, is willing to help the search, and will raise the case at the UN. The government condemns the abductions, says it has raised the issue with Nigeria since 2014, will assist if Nigeria asks, and will keep drawing attention to the case in UN and EU settings.
The Netherlands will continue to draw attention to these schoolgirls and other Boko Haram victims in the UN for as long as necessary.
Nederland blijft ook in VN-verband, zo lang als nodig is, aandacht vragen voor deze schoolmeisjes en andere slachtoffers van Boko Haram.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over landbouwgif in Drenthe

Two MPs asked the ministers whether residents near lily cultivation in Drenthe should be concerned about 57 pesticides found in soil and vegetables, and whether the government would investigate health risks and cumulative effects. The minister acknowledged residents' concern, stated that all measured levels stayed below safe thresholds, and pointed to ongoing OBO exposure research and a Gezondheidsraad advisory request, without committing to new limits.
The cabinet will ask the Health Council to include this issue in its advice, as announced in the letter to the House of 10 April.
Het kabinet zal de Gezondheidsraad vragen om dit vraagstuk te betrekken in hun advies, zoals aangekondigd in de brief aan uw Kamer van 10 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Ploumen en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Westerveld hoopt op snelle publicatie van RIVM rapport’

MPs Moorlag, Ploumen and Nijboer asked about a news report on Westerveld hoping for quick publication of a RIVM report on pesticide exposure, when it was completed, and what legal tools municipalities have to protect residents from pesticide exposure via zoning. The minister answered that the RIVM reports were sent to the House on 10 April, and that municipalities can use zoning plans and the precautionary principle to set buffer zones, with about 50 metres a commonly accepted rule of thumb, while the exposure study shows no unacceptable risk at that distance.
Yes, this is possible and is already happening.
Ja, dit kan en vindt ook al plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het bericht dat maagdenvlieshersteloperaties in Nederlandse klinieken worden uitgevoerd

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health whether he was aware of reports that hymen-restoration operations are performed in Dutch clinics, what he thought of it, and what steps he would take against clinics, better inform young women, and protect them. The minister called such operations unacceptable, said he is talking with doctors and the inspectorate and will study the possibility of a ban, reporting results before year end.

I am in talks with doctors, among other things about using the domestic violence and child abuse reporting code, and I will talk with the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate about how they can tighten supervision if needed

Ik ben in gesprek met artsen onder andere over het gebruik van de meldcode huiselijke geweld en kindermishandeling, ga ik in gesprek met de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd hoe zij het toezicht aan kunnen scherpen als dit nodig is

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het vervolgen, martelen en vermoorden van lesbiennes, homoseksuelen, biseksuelen, transgenders en mensen met een intersekse-conditie (LHBTI’s) in Tsjetsjenië

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government what it has done since April 2018 to raise persecution, torture and killings of LGBTI people in Chechnya, including follow-up with Benedek, the Equal Rights Coalition, UN bodies and the question of quiet diplomacy. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the issue through the OSCE Vienna and Moscow mechanisms, the EU, the Human Rights Council and the Equal Rights Coalition, that violence has not structurally decreased, and that quiet diplomacy has no general criteria but depends on context.
The Netherlands regularly raises the gross human rights violations in Chechnya, including violence against lesbian, gay, bisexual, trans and intersex persons (LGBTI), with Russia in various ways.

Nederland brengt de grove mensenrechtenschendingen in Tsjetsjenië, waaronder het geweld tegen lesbische, homoseksuele, biseksuele, trans en intersekse personen (LHBTI's), op diverse manieren regelmatig onder de aandacht bij Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mensenrechten in Iran gruwelijk geschonden’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the deteriorating human rights situation in Iran, including executions, harsh crackdowns, the morality police and the appointment of Ebrahim Raisi as head of the judiciary. The minister answered that the government shares concerns, raises them multilaterally, bilaterally and through the EU, but does not comment on appointments in other countries.
The cabinet does not concern itself with appointments in other countries.
Het kabinet gaat niet over benoemingen in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over veroordelingen van activisten in de Rif

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked whether the minister would condemn the upheld prison sentences against Rif activists in Morocco, call for their release, and summon the Moroccan ambassador. The minister said the Netherlands has already expressed its view in earlier letters, raised the matter during visits, and sees no purpose in summoning the ambassador, while noting cassation remains possible.
I do not consider it opportune to summon the Moroccan ambassador over this issue.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om de Marokkaanse ambassadeur over deze kwestie te ontbieden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de rol van verzekeraars bij 'de juiste zorg op de juiste plek'

An MP asked the Minister whether health insurers are withholding the 70 million euro transformation funds for 'the right care in the right place' and how this affects hospitals' experimentation. The minister says lokal agreements are made within regular contracting, that the NZa will analyse the contracts by June, and that he cannot guarantee the funds will be spent but will report to parliament before the summer recess.
I currently have no insight into the agreements made locally on the use of these transformation funds.
Ik heb op dit moment geen inzicht in de afspraken die lokaal zijn gemaakt over de inzet van deze transformatiemiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over de uitzending van het tv-programma Kassa over de hoge afhandelingskosten van medicijnrollen

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked the minister about a Kassa broadcast on high fees for weekly medication packaging and whether prices could be justified and made transparent. The minister said weekly dispensing fees average about €3.50 and vary by pharmacy, that the NZa is reviewing a possible flat-fee model, and that a decision is expected before summer.
The NZa is reviewing this with all parties involved. I am awaiting this exercise.
De NZa bekijkt dit met alle betrokken partijen. Ik wacht deze exercitie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over de mogelijke invoering van twee wetten in Guatemala

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs whether he shares concerns about Guatemalan bills 5377 (amnesty for wartime crimes 1990-1996) and 5257 (stricter rules for NGOs), and what their status is. The minister shares the concerns, reports that the Netherlands raised them bilaterally, in an EU High Representative statement and with donors, and says the bills are pending a third reading with uncertain timing.
Yes, I am aware of the concerns of human rights organisations and UN experts about laws no. 5377 and no. 5257. I indeed share these concerns.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de zorgen van mensenrechtenorganisaties en VN-experts over de wetten nr. 5377 en nr. 5257. Ik deel deze zorgen inderdaad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Ploumen over onvoldoende toegang tot seksuele en reproductieve zorg voor ongedocumenteerde vrouwen

MPs Ellemeet and Ploumen asked whether undocumented women face barriers to sexual and reproductive care, including unaffordable abortion care despite the maximum tariff, and whether the government will act. Minister De Jonge replied that the maximum tariff gives clinics flexibility and financial buffers, that existing prevention programmes reach high-risk groups, and that he sees no need for additional measures.
I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat het aantal vrouwen met een borstimplantaat dat lymfeklierkanker heeft gekregen explosief is gestegen

MP Ploumen asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of rising breast implant-associated ALCL cases, whether women are adequately informed, whether incidents are reported to the IGJ and made public, and what measures will be taken. The Minister answered that ALCL reporting increased partly due to awareness and more implantations, that research and a RIVM assessment of the French ban are underway, that incidents will be reported directly to the IGJ after a likely law change, and that stopping implant use is not legally possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de vergoeding van kunstmatige inseminatie

MP Ploumen asked the Minister of Medical Care why single women and lesbian couples are denied reimbursement for donor insemination while women with a male partner without semen are covered, and whether this constitutes discrimination. The Minister answered that reimbursement requires a medical indication under the Zorgverzekeringswet, which single women and lesbian couples lack, and that a decision on government funding for such treatments is expected around summer.
That is not the case when a male partner is absent.
Dat is niet het geval bij het ontbreken van een mannelijke partner.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het bericht dat lipfillers worden verstrekt aan minderjarigen door zowel artsen als onbevoegden

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about reports that lip fillers are administered to minors by doctors and unqualified providers, and about the IGJ's supervision. The Minister acknowledged concern, reported several signals and two notifications received by the IGJ, explained the risk-based and complaint-based supervision approach, and said the IGJ has sufficient enforcement powers and that the BIG law now explicitly covers cosmetic treatments from 1 April 2019.
In addition, the IGJ takes into account in its risk-based supervision whether fillers are placed in patients under 18 without medical necessity.
Daarnaast neemt de IGJ in haar risicotoezicht mee of fillers worden geplaatst bij patiënten onder de 18 jaar zonder medische noodzaak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het bericht waarin minister Bruins aangeeft dat vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen voor alleenstaanden en lesbische vrouwen tijdelijk toch vergoed wordt

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked why the minister does not immediately decide to structurally reimburse insemination for single and lesbian women, and about the timing and handling of reimbursement decisions. The minister replies that reimbursement without a medical indication cannot be funded under the Zvw, that a decision on the government's role will be taken around the summer after further analysis, and that Parliament will be informed then.
The House of Representatives will be informed around the summer about the cabinet's intentions regarding the government's role in financing fertility treatments.
De Tweede Kamer wordt rond de zomer geïnformeerd over de voornemens van het kabinet omtrent de rol van de overheid in de financiering van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat kraamverzorgenden achter blijven in salaris

Ploumen asked the minister about reports that kraamverzorgenden earn below the minimum wage when standby hours are counted, and about shortages and working conditions. The minister said pay for standby shifts is a matter for social partners in the cao, that the NZa will start a cost study, and that he passed the petition's findings to the NZa.
It is up to the social partners to make agreements in the cao on the conditions of these shifts.
Het is aan de sociale partners om via de cao afspraken te maken over de voorwaarden van deze diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'It Wasn’t Just Khashoggi: A Saudi Prince’s Brutal Drive to Crush Dissent'

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister how he views reports of a Saudi intervention team allegedly surveilling, detaining and torturing dissidents, whether he has information on secret detention sites, and what concerns he has about pre-trial detention. The minister said the reports cannot be confirmed, that Netherlands shares concern about the human rights situation and has raised it bilaterally and in the UN Human Rights Council, and that the Netherlands has no independent information on secret detention sites.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot confirm the reporting about the existence of the said intervention team.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kan de berichtgeving over het bestaan van het genoemde interventieteam niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat patiënten kankermedicijnen kregen uit een afgekeurde Chinese fabriek

MP Ploumen asked whether cancer patients received medicines made from ingredients from a rejected Chinese factory, why the IGJ allowed two such ingredients to stay on the market, and why it did not name the manufacturers or inform patients and doctors. Minister Bruins answered that the IGJ judged the two critical medicines necessary and found no contamination, withheld manufacturer names under confidentiality law before the registration holders agreed to disclosure, and said the IGJ will talk with patient and professional groups about communication.

Under article 10(1)(c) of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, information is withheld where it concerns business and manufacturing data confidentially provided to the government by natural or legal persons.

Op grond van artikel 10, lid 1, aanhef en onder c van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob) blijft het verstrekken van informatie achterwege indien dit bedrijfs- en fabricagegegevens betreft die door natuurlijke personen of rechtspersonen vertrouwelijk aan de overheid zijn meegedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht dat artiesten niet welkom zijn in Nederland

MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked whether artists refused entry to the Netherlands should be allowed to visit more easily, and whether detention of artists on unclear grounds is acceptable. The minister replied that refusals follow EU Schengen rules, that cultural exchange is valued, and that existing facilitation schemes such as Orange Carpet apply, with each visa application still assessed individually.
A decision to refuse entry and place persons in custody is always a decision surrounded by safeguards and reasoned on the basis of national, international and European legal obligations.

Een besluit om de toegang te weigeren en personen in bewaring te plaatsen is altijd op grond van de (inter)nationale en Europese juridische verplichtingen een met waarborgen omkleed en gemotiveerd besluit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de krimpende bewegingsruimte, democratische vrijheden en veiligheid van mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about threats to human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, including an Israeli UN envoy's insult to B'Tselem, a law affecting Breaking the Silence, and the deportation order against Human Rights Watch's Omar Shakir. The government answered that it shares concern about intimidation and shrinking civic space, has protested at the UN and bilaterally, and will keep raising the issues with Israeli and Palestinian authorities together with the EU.

The government, together with the EU, is concerned about the increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, partly caused by bills that restrict the space of civil society organisations.

Het kabinet is, samen met de EU, bezorgd over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, mede veroorzaakt door wetsvoorstellen die de ruimte van maatschappelijke organisaties beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Egypt: Set Independent Torture Inquiry’

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether he would act on Human Rights Watch reports of systematic torture and enforced disappearances in Egypt, including contact with allies, sanctions, and raising the issue at the UN Human Rights Council. Minister Blok answered that the cabinet is very concerned, raises the issue in EU channels, supports independent investigation and UN rapporteur access, but sees no case for sanctions and will press for an EU statement at the Council.
The cabinet considers extensive and independent investigation, which HRW also calls for, therefore important.
Het kabinet acht uitgebreid en onafhankelijk onderzoek, waartoe HRW ook oproept, daarom belangrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over het uitzetten van een journalist door Marokko

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about the expulsion of a Dutch journalist from Morocco, the reasons given, and whether the government would press Morocco on press freedom and the health of an imprisoned Rif protest leader. The minister answered that the journalist lacked accreditation as Morocco legally allows, that a French journalist was expelled for the same reason in 2018, that press freedom is raised bilaterally, and that the appeals and the ambassador's monitoring continue, while the detainee's health reportedly is relatively good.
I see no reason to do so.
Daar zie ik geen reden toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht 'Bendes stropen Oeganda af om vrouwen genitaal te verminken'

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers about reports of female genital mutilation in eastern Uganda, its rising numbers, and the government's response with the Ugandan authorities, UNFPA, Equality Now, Reach and a trade mission. The ministers answered that the government takes the reports seriously, is engaged with Ugandan authorities, UNFPA and NGOs, and will brief trade mission participants on responsible business including eastern Uganda.
The cabinet takes the reporting, on the practice of genital mutilation as well as the cited numbers of girls and women, very seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de berichtgeving, over de praktijk van genitale verminking maar ook over de genoemde aantallen meisjes en vrouwen, zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de vergoeding van kunstmatige inseminatie

MP Ploumen asked whether insemination for single women and lesbian couples had been reimbursed for social reasons, how many used it, and whether the basic insurance would be amended to cover such cases. The minister replied that absence of a male partner is not a medical indication, insurers are tightening checks, and he will not amend the Zorgverzekeringswet because it would fundamentally change the insured package and undermine solidarity.
I therefore do not intend to amend the Health Insurance Act to this effect.
Ik ben dan ook niet van plan de Zorgverzekeringswet hierop aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van Gerven en Ploumen over de ambulancezorg in de gemeente Gennep

MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about the closure of the Gennep ambulance post, response times against the 15-minute norm, the role of insurers VGZ and CZ, cross-border mutual aid, and whether regional mayors must be consulted before closures. The Minister said the norm applies regionally, insurers did not fund the Gennep post directly, mutual-aid arrangements were tightened, and a national action plan and an AMvB on acute care availability are in progress, but no binding consultation duty for ambulance post closures.
This norm relates to the level of the (safety) region and not to the level of individual municipalities.
Deze norm heeft betrekking op het niveau van de (veiligheids)regio en niet op het niveau van individuele gemeenten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Ellemeet over demonstranten die vrouwen intimideren voor abortusklinieken

Three MPs asked whether anti-abortion demonstrators intimidating women outside clinics is acceptable, how far demonstration rights extend, whether such conduct is criminal, and whether the government will meet clinics and municipalities. The minister said such intimidation is undesirable, that demonstrations are widespread but usually not intimidating, that municipalities can impose conditions and APV rules may cover the conduct, and that a joint meeting with clinics and municipalities will be held before the summer recess.
With due regard to the substantive responsibilities of local government, I will invite the municipalities concerned and the abortion clinics to a joint consultation before the summer recess.
Met inachtneming van de inhoudelijke verantwoordelijkheden van het lokale gezag, zal ik voor het zomerreces de betrokken gemeenten en de abortusklinieken uitnodigen voor een gezamenlijk overleg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de mogelijkheid om gentherapie toegankelijk en betaalbaar te houden voor wie dat nodig heeft

An MP asks the health minister whether gene therapies could be paid in instalments tied to patient survival and quality of life to keep them affordable. The minister says pricing is for the Zorginstituut to advise on, that Kymriah has no price agreement for its approved indication, and that the instalment model will be considered only once a concrete case arises, with no commitment on the calculation requested.
I am willing to look into this further if a case arises in which this is possible.
Ik ben bereid om hier verder naar te kijken indien er zich een casus voordoet waarbij dit mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het vertrek van VN-gezant Patrick Cammaert uit Jemen

Three MPs asked the ministers about the early departure of UN envoy Patrick Cammaert from Yemen, the stalled Hodeidah ceasefire and redeployment talks, humanitarian effects and Houthi refusal to negotiate. The ministers confirmed the short mandate was known, reported that the ceasefire largely holds despite delays, outlined humanitarian funding and ongoing contacts with the UN and EU, and gave limited detail on the Crisis Group report and Houthi motives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het vervolgen, martelen en vermoorden van LHBTI’s in Tsjetsjenië

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers whether they condemn the persecution, torture and killing of LGBTI people in Chechnya, how they will act toward Russia, and what diplomatic steps are taken. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU, OSCE, Council of Europe and Equal Rights Coalition, and will bring it to the UN Human Rights Council, while keeping some diplomatic steps non-public.
For effective influence, the Netherlands and like-minded countries will also need to use quiet diplomacy, where it is crucial that steps are taken outside the public domain.
Ten behoeve van effectieve beïnvloeding zullen Nederland en gelijkgezinden ook gebruik moeten maken van stille diplomatie, waarbij het cruciaal is dat stappen worden gezet buiten het publieke domein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het (mogelijke) gebruik van chemische middelen tijdens militaire operatie in West Papoea door het door het Indonesische leger

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports of possible chemical weapons use by the Indonesian military in West Papua and whether the Netherlands would seek an independent fact-finding mission. The minister answered that Indonesia denies the reports, that neither local sources nor the OPCW can confirm them, and that he sees no reason yet for an independent investigation, while Nederland continues to press for free access for NGOs and journalists.
In view of the above answer, I currently see no reason to call for an international independent investigation.
Gezien het bovenstaande antwoord zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding voor een oproep tot het instellen van een internationaal onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het feit dat slachtoffers van seksueel geweld die een beroep doen op het Centrum Seksueel Geweld daarvoor hun eigen risico moeten aanspreken

Two PvdA MPs asked why sexual violence victims using Centrum Seksueel Geweld must pay their Zvw deductible and whether this deters reporting. The government confirms the deductible applies to medical care, points to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven compensation and a planned one-year temporary arrangement to reimburse the deductible in the acute phase, but does not abolish the deductible.
The deductible does not relate to the criminal law aspect of sexual violence, but to the provision of care.
Het eigen risico heeft geen betrekking op het strafrechtelijk aspect van seksueel geweld, maar op de zorgverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis Bronovo dicht door tekort aan personeel'

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked about the closure of Bronovo hospital due to staff shortages, requesting an overview of hospitals with staff-related service cuts, vacancy and self-employed figures, and measures to address shortages. The minister said staffing is one cause among several in HMC's consolidation to two sites, cited national capacity data without a list of affected hospitals, and pointed to funding and the Werken in de Zorg programme as measures.
There is no overview of hospitals that must postpone or relocate care due to a staff shortage.
Er is geen overzicht van ziekenhuizen die zorg moeten uitstellen of verplaatsen vanwege een tekort aan personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over beperking van de geitenhouderij

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether provinces restricting goat farming, which may push farms into other provinces, call for national policy such as a national settlement ban or herd cap, given the health risks. The minister answered that eight provinces have temporary bans on new or expanded stables under the precautionary principle, that municipalities and provinces may set their own conditions, and that no national ban or cap is being considered until the cause of the elevated pneumonia risk is found, with follow-up research due in 2020.
A national settlement ban or a national maximum on the number of goats is not being considered at this time for that reason.
Een nationaal vestigingsverbod of een nationaal maximum aan het aantal geiten wordt om die reden op dit moment niet overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de heimelijke zuivering door de Zimbabwaanse overheid

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of disappearances and a crackdown on activists, union leaders and opposition MPs in Zimbabwe, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the embassy monitors the situation, and that the Netherlands has pressed for an EU statement and raised concerns with Zimbabwean officials, without announcing a concrete new domestic-accountability measure.
The cabinet is very concerned about the human rights situation in Zimbabwe, in particular freedom of expression.
Het kabinet maakt zich grote zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie in Zimbabwe, in het bijzonder de vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat er weer een farmaceut is die de prijs van een weesgeneesmiddel maar liefst zes keer verhoogd

An MP asked whether the government will act against Novartis raising the price of the orphan drug Lutathera from about 16,000 euro per course (hospital-made) to over 90,000 euro, and what steps will prevent such pricing. The minister condemned the price rise, said he met Novartis which could not justify it, said existing rules allow hospital compounding, and promised a NFU-led commission report on responsible licensing and further information on reimbursement abroad.
I have made clear that I disapprove of this conduct and will not accept it.
Ik heb laten weten dat ik deze handelwijze afkeur en niet wil accepteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat de rechter de Belgische overheid heeft opgedragen kinderen uit Syrië terug te halen

Two MPs (Ploumen and Kuiken, PvdA) asked the foreign minister about a Brussels court order for Belgium to repatriate six children from Syria, and whether Dutch policy and cooperation with Belgium should change. The minister answered that the Netherlands does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children, that consular assistance is discretionary, and that the government will keep monitoring developments.
The cabinet does not actively pursue the repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children from Syria.
Het kabinet zet niet actief in op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen uit Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de onjuiste informatie die door apothekers verspreid wordt over geneesmiddelentekorten

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the minister whether apothecaries are wrong to blame low Dutch drug prices for shortages, including the KNMP's claim and questions on the 2018 oral contraceptive shortage, stockpiling duties, and whether agreements with industry would be put to parliament first. Minister Bruins answers that shortages are a global supply-chain problem, that low prices are not proven as the cause, that stockpile arrangements are still under discussion with stakeholders, and that he will not commit to submitting binding agreements to parliament in advance.
Are you willing to commit to making no binding agreement or arrangement with pharmacists, wholesalers and pharmaceutical manufacturers without first submitting it to the House? If not, why not?

Bent u bereid toe te zeggen dat u geen bindende overeenkomst of afspraak met apothekers, groothandels en farmaceutische fabrikanten maakt zonder deze eerst aan de Kamer voor te leggen? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over de veroordeling in Egypte van Amal Fathy

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the government about the conviction in Egypt of women's rights defender Amal Fathy and whether it would press for her release and a presidential pardon. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands follows the case closely, has raised concerns bilaterally and within EU channels, will keep doing so, and that Fathy can still appeal to the Court of Cassation or seek a pardon, but did not commit to specific further steps beyond consultation with EU partners.
It is not for the ministry to provide information about this.
Het is niet aan het ministerie om hierover informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de noodzaak van nationale regie om de zorg betaalbaar te houden

Opposition MP Ploumen asked the Minister for Medical Care whether national steering is needed to improve cooperation between hospitals and primary care and spread best practices to keep care affordable, and how cooperation fits with competition under the current system. The Minister replied that regional and local cooperation is preferred, that hoofdlijnenakkoorden with sector parties set joint targets, that national steering is not seen as necessary, and that he will facilitate a best-practice website and monitor substitution, committing to ongoing support but not to a national plan.
A national approach does insufficient justice to this fact; there must be room for regional or local tailoring.
Een landelijke aanpak doet aan dit gegeven onvoldoende recht, er moet ruimte zijn voor regionaal of lokaal maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de houding van dit kabinet ten aanzien van medische ethische onderwerpen

Labour MP Ploumen asks the health minister why the cabinet gives little attention to medical ethics and voluntary end of life, and about the status of promised research and discussions. The minister rejects the claim of avoiding the topic, points to the medical ethics memo, research on people with a persistent wish to die (results due end 2019), and planned information and discussion activities.
I agree with you that the topic of voluntary end of life is an important social issue.
Ik ben het met u eens dat het onderwerp voltooid leven een maatschappelijk belangrijk thema is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de gang van zaken rond de mogelijke sluiting van het Bronovo ziekenhuis

Labour MP Ploumen asks the Minister of Medical Care about the possible closure of Bronovo hospital in The Hague, including the reported confidential restructuring plan, the timing of information to residents, staff, insurers and the municipality, and when the ministry was informed. The Minister answers that no decision has been taken, that the board will publish a preferred scenario on 24 January before consulting stakeholders, and that the ministry was informed by phone in December 2018 and January 2019, while declining to confirm the existence of a restructuring plan.
I do not have a restructuring plan.
Ik beschik niet over een herstructureringsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de repressie tegen Nicaraguaanse ngo’s

MPs from five parties asked the Dutch foreign and development ministers about Nicaragua's dissolution of NGOs including CENIDH, police raids on NGOs and the Confidencial newsroom, seizure of Dutch-funded assets, and the anti-terror law 977 used against civil society. The ministers confirmed the raids and seizures, said Nederland raised the issue with the Nicaraguan ambassador and within the EU, and shared the concern that civil society is under pressure.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation and, where possible, including within the EU, continue to speak out against repression in Nicaragua.
Nederland zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en waar mogelijk zich, onder meer in EU-verband, blijven uitspreken tegen onderdrukking in Nicaragua.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over het bericht dat de visa van 11 onderzoekers van CICIG door Guatemala zijn ingetrokken

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the minister about Guatemala expelling 11 CICIG investigators and revoking their visas and immunity, and whether the Netherlands would condemn this and support CICIG's mandate. The minister condemned Guatemala's termination of the UN agreement, said the Netherlands backs CICIG and a renewed mandate, and reported EU and G13 statements and diplomatic contacts, while declining to commit to a specific new step beyond existing advocacy.
The international community has sharply condemned the Guatemalan government's termination of the CICIG agreement.
De internationale gemeenschap heeft het opzeggen van het CICIG-akkoord door de Guatemalteekse regering scherp veroordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over de detentie van anti-slavernij activisten in Mauritanië

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked about the detention of anti-slavery activist Biram Dah Abeid in Mauritania, the conditions and fairness of his trial, and whether the minister would press Mauritania to stop repressing anti-slavery activists. The minister answered that Abeid was arrested in August 2018, released on 31 December 2018, that the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns with Mauritanian authorities, and that Dutch support for local human rights NGOs continues.
Information on the exact conditions in detention and the course of the trial was limited.
Informatie over de exacte omstandigheden in detentie en verloop van het proces was beperkt beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over arrestaties tijdens mensenrechtendemonstraties in West-Papoea

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister about mass arrests of protesters at Human Rights Day demonstrations in West Papua, the fairness of their trials, progress on human rights in Indonesia, the Dutch Community Policing Programme, and whether the Netherlands will keep pressing Indonesia on press freedom and violence against Papuans. The minister answered that roughly 132-137 people were detained and released without charge in a context of tension, that all were freed and will not be prosecuted, that human rights concerns remain despite socio-economic progress, and that the Netherlands raises these points bilaterally and within the EU.
All persons arrested have since been released. They will not be prosecuted.
Alle opgepakte personen zijn inmiddels weer vrijgelaten. Zij zullen niet vervolgd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat verzekerden in Deventer niet meer terecht kunnen bij het ziekenhuis omdat de verzekeraar te weinig zorg heeft ingekocht

An MP asks whether it is acceptable that insured patients in Deventer face waiting lists because Zilveren Kruis bought too little hospital care, and whether the insurer is meeting its duty of care. The minister says patients will be offered the choice between accepting the longer wait at Deventer Hospital or referral to another provider in the region, that the insurer is responsible for ensuring this, and that he has contacted the insurer and hospital.
In this case it is for Zilveren Kruis to ensure this, given the duty of care the insurer has towards its insured.
Het is in deze casus aan Zilveren Kruis om dat zeker te stellen, gezien de zorgplicht die de verzekeraar heeft richting zijn verzekerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat de contracten tussen zorgverzekeraars en ziekenhuizen weer niet op tijd zijn afgesloten

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why hospital-insurer contracts were again not concluded on time, what this means for insured people, and whether the market model is failing. The minister acknowledged slower contracting, pointed to existing insurer information duties and NZa enforcement, and said the government expects more contracts soon while promising better information for insured persons.
For that reason, any uncertainty about additional payments for non-contracted providers must be kept as limited as possible and will be reduced in the coming weeks.
Om die reden moet een eventuele onduidelijkheid over bijbetalingen bij nog niet-gecontracteerde partijen zo beperkt mogelijk zijn en de komende weken worden verminderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht Saudi Arabia Allegedly Tortured Women’s Rights Activists Before Khashoggi Murder

MPs Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked whether the government knows of reports that Saudi Arabia detained eight women's rights activists for exercising free expression and allegedly tortured them, and what it will do, bilaterally, in the EU and with partners, to condemn this and seek release. The minister replied that the Netherlands raised concerns with the Saudi ambassador, in multilateral fora and through EU channels, promoted a formal EU-Saudi human rights dialogue, and works with the embassy to gather information, while weighing public versus quiet diplomacy case by case.
The Netherlands, together with partners, weighs case by case what degree of public attention is most effective, with the wishes of the persons concerned or their families being decisive.
Nederland maakt samen met partners per geval de afweging welke mate van publieke aandacht het meest effectief is, waarbij de wensen van de betrokkenen zelf, of hun families, leidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het anticonceptiepil-tekort en het feit dat KNMP en Bogin het niet nodig vinden de geneesmiddelenprijzen zo laag mogelijk te houden

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the Minister for Medical Care about the contraceptive pill shortage and whether pharmacist and generics bodies KNMP and Bogin contribute to the problem by resisting low drug prices. The Minister answered that supply is recovering, plans a mandatory four-month stock obligation, will report on shortage causes and inspection of late reporting, and rejected the claim that low prices cause shortages.
As I indicated in my letter of 30 November, I will also evaluate this specific case of supply problems with the contraceptive pill and inform the House of the outcome.

Zoals ik heb aangegeven in mijn Kamerbrief van 30 november jongstleden zal ik ook deze specifieke casus van de leveringsproblemen met de anticonceptiepil evalueren en uw Kamer over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de resultaten van prijsonderhandelingen met farmaceuten

MP Ploumen asked the Minister of Medical Care about the savings from drug price negotiations with pharmaceutical firms, the basis for claiming they reached the maximum achievable result, and transparency over drug pricing. The Minister explained the EUR 130 million saving calculation, said he cannot disclose which drugs or savings due to confidentiality agreements, and committed to pressing industry for transparency via dialogue and international cooperation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het nut van marktwerking in de ziekenhuiszorg

Ploumen (PvdA) asks whether the price and quality of hospital care can be overseen when prices are not transparent, why hospitals get different tariffs for the same treatment, and whether the market label fits hospital care. Minister Bruins defends negotiated contracting by insurers as cost-restraining and consumer-choice enhancing, rejects full NZa price setting, and points to incremental price-transparency measures with possible obligations if progress lags in 2019.
I do not agree with that statement.
Ik ben het niet eens met die uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat VGZ-verzekerden op de wachtlijst moeten bij Zuyderland omdat de verzekeraar te weinig zorg heeft ingekocht

An MP asked the minister whether it is acceptable that VGZ-insured patients face an eight-week waiting list at Zuyderland because the insurer bought too little care, and about the insurer's duty of care and the NZa's oversight. The minister answered that patients can choose to accept the wait or be referred elsewhere, that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care, and that a letter on waiting-list stops will follow.
The NZa oversees that health insurers comply with their duty of care and intervenes where necessary.
De NZa ziet erop toe dat zorgverzekeraars de zorgplicht naleven, en grijpt indien nodig in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Nederlandse vrouw moet langer wachten op anticonceptiepil’

MPs Ellemeet and Ploumen asked about a shortage of contraceptive pills and whether the preferential reimbursement policy of insurers contributes to it. The minister said supply should recover in December 2018 or January 2019, that the shortage stems from production problems rather than preference policy, and that the measures taken will be evaluated.
In the working group on medicine shortages I will evaluate the measures taken to prevent medicine shortages based on the cases from 2017 and 2018.
In de werkgroep geneesmiddeltekorten zal ik de genomen maatregelen om geneesmiddelentekorten te voorkómen evalueren op basis van de casuïstiek uit 2017 en 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over omkoping van artsen door een bedrijf voor medische hulpmiddelen

An MP asked the minister whether the FIOD suspects a medical device company of bribing doctors, which company it is, the scale of the bribery, whether the FIU looked at other transactions, and whether self-regulation through the Transparency Register is sufficient. The minister confirmed the investigation but declined to name the company or give details because the criminal investigation is ongoing and the FIU findings are state-confidential, and rejected the view that self-regulation is insufficient, pointing to a pending evaluation of the register.
Because of the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot give you further information about this case, and therefore also not about the scale and possible involvement of persons and care institutions.
In verband met het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik u geen nadere informatie geven over deze zaak en dus ook niet over de omvang en eventuele betrokkenheid van personen en zorginstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken een deal sloot met een van martelingen verdachte Venezolaanse minister

Ploumen (PvdA) asked whether Foreign Minister Blok's signed April 2018 border agreement with Venezuela, signed in Caracas with a vice-president suspected of torture, was appropriate and whether it sent a wrong signal, and asked about Aruba's objections and a Venezuelan consul linked to drug crime. Blok answered that the delegation composition is the receiving country's prerogative, EU sanctions were not yet in force at the meeting, the agreement was signed with the Caribbean partners, and the Aruban premiers were kept informed, and referred to earlier answers for the consul question.
Moreover, individual sanctions measures do not preclude a meeting with persons who appear on the sanctions list.
Overigens staan individuele sanctiemaatregelen een ontmoeting met personen die op de sanctielijst voorkomen niet in de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de The Hague Youth Declaration on Human Rights in Action van 20 oktober 2018

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about the Hague Youth Declaration on Human Rights in Action adopted at the One Young World Summit, including its relevance to human rights promotion and how the government will publicise it among young people. The minister answered that the government sponsored youth participation, supports youth voice initiatives in the Netherlands, and will promote the declaration in line with existing human rights policy, without committing to a new concrete step.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat de farmaceutische industrie werkt aan een vrijwillige gedragscode

MP Ploumen asked the health minister about 44 pharmaceutical firms developing a voluntary code of conduct on drug pricing, whether it is credible, whether a convenant is being negotiated, and whether the Chamber will see it first. The minister welcomed the self-regulation initiative but rejected binding industry codes, said talks on a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding are ongoing, and declined to pre-submit it to Parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat het betalen van artsen/onderzoekers door de farmaceutische industrie kennelijk een lucratief marketinginstrument is

Ploumen asked the minister about reports that GSK resumed paying doctors and researchers for marketing, whether such payments are effective and lucrative, and whether all payments are transparently recorded in the Transparantieregister Zorg, including whether it can be circumvented and whether statutory regulation is needed. The minister said pharma-doctor cooperation can be legitimate, pointed to existing gift-ban rules and the IGJ's supervisory role, acknowledged that clinical drug research is not in the register, and referred to earlier letters for the absence of a statutory basis for the register.
Nevertheless, the qualifications she gives, by which she lumps the entire pharmaceutical industry together, must remain at Ms Godlee's own account.
Niettemin dienen de kwalificaties die zij geeft – en waarmee zij de gehele farmaceutische industrie over één kam scheert – voor rekening van mevrouw Godlee te blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Ploumen over het bericht dat Nederland farmaceuten helpt om belasting te ontwijken

MPs Nijboer and Ploumen asked the government about reports that the Netherlands helps pharmaceutical companies avoid tax, including undisclosed arrangements, transparency, and effects on developing countries. The State Secretary of Finance answered that individual tax affairs cannot be discussed under article 67 AWR, and listed general anti-avoidance measures, the position on country-by-country reporting, and EU work on pharmaceutical patent protection.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual companies.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het feit dat de het dreigende faillissement van de IJsselmeerziekenhuizen en het Slotervaartziekenhuis mogelijk al eerder bekend was

An MP asked whether two meetings organised by Achmea about the financial distress of two hospitals were attended by ministry officials, what was discussed, and whether the minister was informed. The minister answered that ministry officials were not present, that he was unaware of the meetings, and that the ministry has no minutes, while referring to an earlier letter on when VWS and supervisors were informed.
I was not aware that these meetings took place.
Het was mij niet bekend dat deze bijeenkomsten hebben plaats gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Khashoggi vermoord op last koningshuis'

Ploumen asked whether the government had verified reports that journalist Khashoggi was killed on orders of the Saudi royal household, whether it had contacted Turkish and European counterparts, and whether a planned trade mission to Saudi Arabia would be postponed. The government answered that it contacted Turkey, that the EU and E3 called on Saudi Arabia to cooperate, and referred to letters of 18 and 30 October 2018 for its full position, without giving a substantive answer on the Saudi trade mission or the consequences for relations.
For a comprehensive cabinet appraisal, I refer the House to the letter on policy towards Saudi Arabia dated 18 October 2018.
Voor een uitgebreide kabinetsappreciatie, verwijs ik uw Kamer naar de Kamerbrief «Beleid ten aanzien van Saoedi-Arabië», dd. 18 oktober 2018
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over apothekers die een voorschrift van een arts negeren

An MP asks about pharmacists dispensing a different, cheaper medicine than the one prescribed by the doctor, and whether cost considerations justify it. The minister says a prescription cannot simply be ignored, that the criterion is medical responsibility, and that a bestuurlijk overleg with all parties will set principles for switching medicines.
A prescription cannot simply be ignored.
Een recept kan niet zomaar worden genegeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een verwoestende nieuwe drug in webshops te koop is

Two PvdA MPs asked whether phenibut, a highly addictive substance sold as a food supplement in webshops, could be bought by minors and why it is not banned under the Opium Act. The State Secretary for Health answered that minors cannot be excluded from access, that a CAM risk study is underway with results expected this year, and that measures including a possible ban will be considered afterwards.
Based on the research results and the CAM advice, I will consider measures to take, such as a possible ban.
Op basis van de onderzoeksresultaten en het advies van het CAM zal ik mij beraden op te treffen maatregelen, zoals een eventueel verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat de MammaPrint niet vergoed wordt

MP Ploumen asked the Minister of Medical Care about the decision not to reimburse the MammaPrint breast cancer test, including the reasons for the Zorginstituut's negative advice, the stance of professionals, foreign reimbursement practice, and whether it could still be reimbursed. The Minister answered that the Zorginstituut found no proven clinical benefit, that he is bound by the statutory test of proven effectiveness and by the Van den Berg motion, and that patients should discuss concerns with their doctor.
The Zorginstituut has the statutory task of judging whether care is effective and reimbursed from the basic package.
Het Zorginstituut heeft de wettelijke taak om te oordelen of zorg effectief is en vergoed wordt uit het basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het bericht dat de pro-life beweging Siriz geen objectieve informatie geeft aan zwangere vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked whether the government shares concerns that counselling organisation Siriz, funded for unwanted-pregnancy support, steered women with leading chat questions and whether subsidies should change. The State Secretary answered that new quality criteria and an open-house funding model will apply from 2019, that organisations may hold their values but must not steer the woman's choice, and that the matter will be discussed with the parties.
For me it is important that all choice-support conversations must meet the same quality standards.
Voor mij is het daarbij belangrijk dat alle keuzehulpgesprekken moeten voldoen aan dezelfde kwaliteitsstandaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Escalatie President Guatemala weert corruptie-aanklager VN’

MPs asked the ministers about Guatemala's refusal to renew the UN anti-corruption commission CICIG and about the government's response, protection of human rights defenders, and intimidation of NGOs. The ministers said they regret the non-renewal, cite Dutch funding, EU statements and the Shelter City programme, and promised continued monitoring and raising of the issue with Guatemalan authorities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will continue to closely monitor the situation and keep raising it with the Guatemalan government.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en blijven aankaarten bij de Guatemalteekse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Rooijen, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Kuzu over de uitvoering van de motie inzake Magnitsky-sancties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he had formally proposed an EU human rights sanctions regime, how other member states reacted, and why he doubts a national Magnitsky-style regime would be effective, as well as whether he will implement the Omtzigt motion. The minister answered that he proposed an EU global human rights sanctions regime at the Gymnich meeting, that some states were positive and none openly negative, that a formal proposal is deferred until support exists, that a national regime would be ineffective given Schengen, and that he will pursue the EU route and report after a November meeting.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is organising a senior-official meeting in November for EU member states and like-minded countries to further develop the concept of a human rights sanctions regime.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken organiseert in november een hoogambtelijke bijeenkomst voor EU-lidstaten en enkele gelijkgezinde landen om het concept van een mensenrechtensanctieregime verder te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat een groeiend aantal geneesmiddelen tijdelijk niet leverbaar is

MP Ploumen asked the health minister about reports that a growing number of medicines are temporarily unavailable, including whether shortages are increasing and what legal tools exist to prevent them. The minister replied that shortages are mostly supply delays usually covered by alternatives, that reports rose in 2017 and 2018, and that existing instruments such as higher fines and temporary import of foreign medicines will be evaluated.
I will evaluate the measures taken in the Medicine Shortages Working Group based on the 2017 and 2018 data, to assess whether the existing measures suffice or whether stricter measures are needed.

Ik zal de genomen maatregelen evalueren in de Werkgroep Geneesmiddelentekorten op basis van de gegevens van 2017 en 2018 ten einde te beoordelen of de bestaande maatregelen volstaan of dat het verzwaren van maatregelen nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het bericht 'Opvang op Griekse eilanden kraakt'

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked about reports that reception conditions on Greek islands are inhumane, including child suicide attempts, and about EU monitoring and asylum procedure reform. The Dutch state secretary acknowledged the concerns, attributed problems mainly to overcrowding and slow asylum procedures, described EU and Dutch support and new Greek asylum law, but said no exact figures on child suicide attempts were available and opposed transfers to the mainland as a long-term solution.
Inquiries have revealed that no exact figures on suicide attempts can be obtained.
Navraag heeft geleerd dat geen exacte cijfers over pogingen tot zelfmoord zijn te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het rapport van de onafhankelijke, internationale VN Fact Finding Missie over Myanmar

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the UN fact-finding mission report on Myanmar, which found genocidal intent, crimes against humanity and war crimes, and what steps Netherlands will take on the matter. The minister said the findings are very worrying, that genocide requires a very high evidentiary bar and recognition would ideally follow a UN Security Council resolution or international court ruling, and that Netherlands will push for ICC referral, an evidence-gathering mechanism and EU-led resolutions while noting China's likely veto.

The cabinet is of the view that impunity must always be combated and that the FFM, through this report, further substantiates the strong call that Netherlands previously made for perpetrators to be brought to justice.
Het kabinet is van mening dat straffeloosheid altijd moet worden bestreden en dat de FMM door middel van dit rapport verdere onderbouwing geeft aan de sterke oproep
