Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Kanada fordert Unterstützung von Maas'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the pressure Saudi Arabia exerted on the Netherlands in 2017 over a UN Human Rights Council resolution compares to the pressure now on Canada, whether Canada requested support, and whether the Netherlands will publicly back Canada and raise the matter with Germany and the EU. The minister replies that the Saudi-Canada dispute differs in kind, that Canada made no such request, and that the Netherlands has raised concerns about detained activists at EU level via a demarche.
Canada has not made such a request to the Netherlands.
Canada heeft niet een dergelijk verzoek aan Nederland gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over de hongerstaking van gedetineerde Rif-activisten in Marokko

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about the hunger strike of detained Rif activists in Morocco, including Nasser Zefzafi's health, contacts with Moroccan authorities, review of the verdicts and calls for release. The minister confirmed the hunger strike ended after most demands were met, said the embassy is in contact with lawyers but not detainees, and declined to request release or better treatment, citing that verdicts and appeal are still pending.
Regarding the treatment of Mr Zefzafi and other political prisoners, I do not have information that would support a request for better treatment.
Wat betreft de behandeling van de heer Zefzafi en andere politieke gevangenen, beschik ik niet over informatie die een verzoek om betere behandeling zou kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Raan over het bericht dat de VS alle hulp aan UNRWA stopt

MPs asked the government how it views the US decision to halt all funding to UNRWA, and whether it will press Washington, increase its own contribution, and address the wider political consequences. The government regrets the US decision, says it opposes politicising humanitarian aid, pledges to raise the issue with the US and other donors, and keeps its existing 13 million euro annual contribution while deferring any extra funding to year-end review.
As usual, at the end of the year the cabinet will assess, within existing humanitarian aid agreements, which additional Dutch contributions based on the humanitarian imperative are desirable.

Zoals gebruikelijk beoordeelt het kabinet aan het einde van het jaar binnen de bestaande afspraken over humanitaire hulp welke aanvullende Nederlandse bijdragen op basis van het humanitair imperatief wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over studenten met een hiv-besmetting die niet worden behandeld

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers whether they knew of international students with untreated HIV, how large the problem was, and whether they would help find a solution with insurers and universities. The minister said there is no registration of the group, that he will commission research into its size and nature, that private insurers' exclusions are their and the universities' responsibility, and that he will participate in talks if that helps.
I will therefore have research carried out into the scope and nature of the problem in order to gain insight into the risk to public health.
Ik zal daarom onderzoek laten doen naar de omvang en aard van de problematiek om zicht te krijgen op het risico voor de volksgezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat Maleisische vrouwen stokslagen krijgen omdat zij op vrouwen vallen

Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister how the government views caning of two Malaysian women for a same-sex relationship and what it will do about human rights for LGBTI people in Malaysia. Minister Blok condemned the caning, said the ambassador raised the case with authorities, and outlined ongoing human rights engagement while noting that sharia courts fall under the states.
I will also raise the issue at my next meeting with my counterpart Saifuddin Abdullah.
Ik zal de kwestie bij mijn volgende gesprek met mijn ambtsgenoot Saifuddin Abdullah eveneens aan de orde stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Agnes Mulder, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de berichten dat tegen vijf Soedische mensenrechtenactivistes de doodstraf is geëist

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that prosecutors sought the death penalty against five Saudi human rights activists, including one woman, and whether the trial is fair and what pressure the Netherlands can exert. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, opposes the death penalty, raises concerns with Saudi authorities and through EU channels including a joint demarche, and will raise the issue at the November UPR, but gave limited information on the trial itself.
The cabinet is following developments, including the trial of the female activist mentioned in the reports, closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen, waaronder het proces van de in de berichtgeving genoemde vrouwelijke activist, op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over de arrestatie van Bobi Wine

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and alleged torture of Bobi Wine in Uganda, whether he had contacted his counterpart, and how pressure could be applied for his release. The minister condemned the arrest, described EU joint démarches, consular visits and contacts with Ugandan officials, and said Netherlands would continue to raise human rights concerns with Uganda.
I share the concerns about the human rights situation in Uganda and will continue to raise them with the Ugandan government in a European context.
Ik deel de zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie in Uganda en blijf die in Europees verband aan de orde stellen bij de Ugandese regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het bericht dat de Koerden Nederlandse vrouwen naar IS-gebied terugsturen

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether Kurdish authorities are sending Dutch women and children back to IS-held territory and what the government will do to prevent this. Minister Grapperhaus said such reports could not be confirmed, that the government does not actively pursue repatriation from Syria and Iraq given diplomatic and security considerations, and that contact with Kurdish authorities via their Benelux representation has been ongoing.
This weighing leads the cabinet not to actively pursue the repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children from Syria and Iraq.
Deze afweging leidt ertoe dat het kabinet niet actief inzet op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen uit Syrië en Irak.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de uitspraken van vicepremier de Jonge en vicepremier Ollongren naar aanleiding van de uitspraken van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken tijdens een bijeenkomst met Nederlandse

MP Ploumen asked the Prime Minister whether the deputy PMs' remarks defending Foreign Minister Blok, who remains in office after controversial comments at a closed meeting, were appropriate and whether the cabinet stands behind his apologies. The Prime Minister answered that Blok acknowledged his remarks were unwise, regretted them and withdrew them, that the cabinet supports this, and that the question of his remaining in office is for parliament to address in a forthcoming debate.
There will still be a debate in the House of Representatives on the Minister Blok's statements. The House decides on what will be raised in it.
Over de uitspraken van Minister Blok volgt nog een debat in de Tweede Kamer. De Kamer gaat over hetgeen daarin aan de orde zal worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het teruglopend aantal vrouwen dat deelneemt aan het bevolkingsonderzoek baarmoederhalskanker

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary why participation in the cervical cancer screening programme has fallen and which subgroups are missed. The state secretary answered that participation is monitored, an evaluation is planned for 2019, and lessons from other countries are limited.
In 2019 an evaluation will be carried out focusing in particular on participation by the different groups.
In 2019 wordt een evaluatie uitgevoerd die zich met name gaat richten op de deelname door de verschillende groepen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat NRC journalist Koen Greven geen toestemming heeft gekregen om zijn werk te doen in Marokko

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how he assesses Morocco's restrictions on press freedom, including the ban on NRC journalist Koen Greven working in Al Hoceima, and whether he would raise it urgently with Moroccan authorities. The minister said the Dutch ambassador raised the case, Moroccan authorities cited missing accreditation, and the embassy offers journalists guidance and the Netherlands supports press-freedom organisations.
This matter was raised by the Dutch ambassador in Rabat on 20 July with the Moroccan Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Deze kwestie is door de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Rabat op 20 juli jl. opgebracht bij het Marokkaanse Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het niet langer beschikbaar zijn van implanteerbare insulinepompen

MP Ploumen asks the minister whether the manufacturer Medtronic's discontinuation of implantable insulin pumps, with no reliable alternative in sight, is acceptable and what the government is doing about patients left without pumps. The minister confirms the discontinuation, says he has urged Medtronic to continue production and supported an alternative-pump initiative, but states he cannot legally compel manufacturers to produce or supply medical devices.
I cannot legally force manufacturers of medical devices to produce or supply medical devices.
Ik kan fabrikanten van medische hulpmiddelen bij wet niet dwingen tot productie of leveren van medische hulpmiddelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over uitspraken tijdens de bijeenkomst met Nederlandse werknemers van internationale organisaties, bedrijven en ambtenaren op het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

Rep. Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether he stands by remarks made at a closed staff meeting, including claims about genetic predisposition to exclusion and burden sharing in EU asylum policy, and what contacts and damage control followed. The minister regrets the wording, says it was meant to provoke discussion, denies any intent to justify racism, and reports contacts with Caribbean premiers, Suriname and other countries, while declining to speculate on reciprocal cases.
I should not have done that, certainly not in my role as Minister of Foreign Affairs. I regret this.
Dat had ik niet moeten doen, zeker niet in mijn rol als Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken. Dit spijt mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Diks, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma en Agnes Mulder over de arrestatie van opnieuw twee vrouwenrechtenactivisten in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two more Saudi women's rights activists, whether it constitutes an attack on the movement, what joint EU steps were taken, and how the government supports civil society. The minister said the government is concerned, an EU demarche was delivered on 8 August urging clarification of charges and fair treatment, but Saudi space for civil society is limited.

On 8 August the Chargé d'Affaires of the European diplomatic mission, together with the European countries present in Riyadh including the Netherlands, delivered a demarche to the Saudi Foreign Minister.

Op 8 augustus jl. voerde de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Europese diplomatieke missie samen met de in Riyad aanwezige Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, een demarche uit bij de Saoedische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het lot van Nederlandse IS-kinderen

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked the Justice Minister whether the government would actively seek the return of Dutch women and their children held in Kurdish camps in Syria, including after arrest warrants were issued for three women. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children, citing child welfare alongside security, diplomatic and regional considerations, and only passed the warrants to local authorities.
The cabinet does not actively pursue the return of adult travellers and their minor children.
Het kabinet zet niet actief in op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over de inning Eritrese diasporabelasting nadat de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde persona non grata is verklaard

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the dwangmatige inning of Eritrean diaspora tax has changed since the Eritrean chargé was declared persona non grata, whether reports and prosecutions have increased, and whether a central reporting point should be created. The minister answered that no new chargé has been appointed, that there are no indications of change in reports, that a study on banning diaspora tax is underway, and that a special reporting point is not considered necessary.
The cabinet is currently examining the possibilities for a ban on diaspora tax in the Netherlands, in line with the motion by MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden met betrekking tot een verbod op diasporabelasting in Nederland, conform de motie van de leden Karabulut en van Ojik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht minister Blok: ‘Suriname is een mislukte staat, door etnische opdeling’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about his remarks calling Suriname a failed state, comments on integration in the Netherlands and Singapore's migration policy, and remarks about migrants being beaten in Warsaw and Prague. The minister acknowledged the remarks, said they were made at a closed meeting to provoke discussion, admitted the claim about beatings was speculative, and reaffirmed the government's EU migration position.
As the published footage shows, I said "They are probably literally being beaten up." I acknowledge that this statement is speculative.
Zoals uit de gepubliceerde beelden blijkt heb ik gezegd «Ze worden waarschijnlijk letterlijk in elkaar geslagen». Ik erken dat die uitspraak speculatief is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘The summon of Feminist and Woman Human Right Defender Mozn Hassan to investigation within the Context of the NGO Foreign Funding Case’ dd 18 juni 2

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether the government had raised concerns with Egypt over the summoning and questioning of human rights defender Mozn Hassan in the NGO foreign funding case, and about pressure on civil society. The ministers answered that the case is still under investigation, that concerns were raised bilaterally and at EU level, and that the embassy is monitoring it, without directly intervening in the court process.
The specific case of Mozn Hassan is still before the court, so direct political intervention is not opportune.
De specifieke zaak van Mozn Hassan is nog onder de rechter, waardoor directe politieke interventie niet opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het optreden van veiligheidstroepen in Papua

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about Amnesty International's report on killings by Indonesian security forces in Papua and whether the government will raise impunity, independent investigation and the Dutch-funded community policing programme with Indonesia. The minister acknowledges the report's findings as serious, says human rights in Papua are raised in diplomatic contacts and were discussed during his visit, but does not commit to a new independent investigation or changes to the programme.

The cabinet considers it important that state security personnel exercise their use-of-force mandate within the limits of proportionality, and that the possibility of thorough and independent investigation exists.

In algemene zin vindt het kabinet het belangrijk staatsveiligheidspersoneel zijn geweldsmandaat uitoefent binnen de grenzen van proportionaliteit, en dat de mogelijkheid bestaat tot gedegen en onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over inhumaan optreden Franse grenspolitie jegens migrantenkinderen

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the government how it responds to reports of abuse of migrant children by French border police and whether it will raise child protection and EU burden-sharing at EU level. The State Secretary answered that the government monitors EU-acquis compliance, relies on the Commission to assess violations, and points to EU reform negotiations and existing child-specific safeguards, without committing to a new investigation.
The cabinet critically monitors both the implementation and compliance with the EU acquis, without assumptions, and uses bilateral and multilateral channels to raise our concerns where appropriate.

Het kabinet volgt, zonder aannames, zowel de implementatie als naleving van het EU-acquis kritisch, en maakt gebruik van bilaterale en multilaterale kanalen om onze zorgen, waar opportuun, over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'News: Open letter for the release of Human Rights Defenders in Niger'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about arrests of human rights defenders in Niger, the closure of a television station, uranium-gate, press freedom and the Dutch embassy opening. The government answered that the EU monitors the court cases, that prisoner welfare projects exist, that it has no direct stake in uranium-gate, and that human rights can be raised in general terms.
The Netherlands and the various EU representations will continue to follow developments in this case closely.
Nederland en de verschillende EU-vertegen woordigingen blijven de ontwikkelingen van deze zaak op de voet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de overlast ten gevolge van lachgas

Labour MP Ploumen asked the ministers about nitrous oxide (lachgas) nuisance, including the status of voluntary sales restrictions, prevention materials, possible repressive measures, municipal powers and reported nuisance. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that voluntary measures are being agreed with retailers, Trimbos is developing prevention materials, monitoring continues and further measures will be considered if voluntary steps fail.
If it turns out that the voluntary restrictive measures and additional prevention efforts do not have the desired effect, I will consider possible additional measures.
Wanneer blijkt dat de vrijwillige beperkende maatregelen en extra inzet op preventie niet het gewenste effect heeft, zal ik mij beraden op mogelijke extra maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'VN: Amerika overtreedt mensenrechten met scheiden migrantengezinnen'

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister whether the US breach of human rights by separating migrant families is a concern, whether allies should be held to human rights standards, and whether the minister would contact US and European counterparts and raise the issue during the Prime Minister's visit. The minister answered that Dutch human rights policy applies to all countries, that concerns were conveyed diplomatically, and that the matter is for the US democratic debate and courts to resolve, without committing to further action.
The concerns that exist in Dutch society have been conveyed to the US through diplomatic channels.
De zorgen die in de Nederlandse samenleving bestaan zijn via diplomatieke weg aan de VS overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Syrië komende maand voorzitter is van de VN-Conferentie over Ontwapening

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Syria's rotating presidency of the UN Conference on Disarmament, given the regime's use of chemical weapons, undermines UN credibility and whether the Netherlands would raise objections with the UN Secretary-General. The minister agreed Syria lacks moral authority, said the Netherlands has reduced its representation and will leave sessions if Syria misuses the chair, but declined to raise the matter with the Secretary-General because the Conference is autonomous.
The Netherlands will immediately leave the meetings when Syria uses its chairmanship position politically.
Nederland zal de vergaderingen terstond verlaten wanneer Syrië in voorzitterscapaciteit zijn positie politiek aanwendt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het rapport 'The Use of UN Sanctions to Address Conflict-Related Sexual Violence'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report finding UN sanctions weakly used against conflict-related sexual violence, and whether the government would act on it, including a proposed global thematic sanctions regime. The minister responded that the Netherlands supports using sanctions, notes some progress in the Central African Republic regime, but gives only a general commitment to revisit the thematic regime proposal in September.
I will also take into account the position of like-minded members of the UN Security Council.
Ik zal daarbij ook nader betrekken de positie van gelijkgezinde leden van de VN-veiligheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het terugsturen van vrouwen en kinderen naar IS-gebied

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that Syrian Kurds were sending detained jihadi brides and their children back to IS-held territory, and whether Belgian intelligence had shared information and whether Dutch women and children were affected. The minister said the signals could not yet be confirmed, that European intelligence services cooperate and share information on travellers where necessary, but that he could not discuss specific cases.
I cannot go into specific cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het lot van Nederlandse IS-kinderen

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the whereabouts and safety of Dutch children of IS members, including reports that some may be moved back into IS territory. The minister answered that at least 145 such children remain in the conflict zone and at least 30 elsewhere in the region, that contact with Kurdish authorities is structural but not formal with the groups running the camps, and that the government does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their children while continuing to monitor the situation.
This weighing leads to the cabinet not actively pursuing the repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children from Syria and Iraq.
Deze weging leidt ertoe dat dat het kabinet niet actief inzet op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen uit Syrië en Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Beroerde arbeidsomstandigheden in kraamzorg’

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the minister about reports of poor working conditions in midwifery care, including structural overtime and inability to take holidays or sick leave. The minister said the monitor's findings are important signals if representative, that employers must follow existing rules, and that the sector is working on workload reduction, workforce planning, and an academy, with a subsidy for workforce planning.
There are no detailed projections known about the expected shortages of midwifery care staff.
Er zijn geen gedetailleerde ramingen bekend over de (te verwachten) tekorten aan kraamverzorgenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat er ernstige fouten zijn gemaakt bij darmkankeronderzoeken

MP Ploumen asked the state secretary about reports that serious errors occurred in the bowel cancer screening, where 604 participants never received results. The state secretary acknowledged the failure, said affected people were contacted personally, and said the IT system has been fixed and other screening programmes checked.
I regret that due to this combination of circumstances this group of 604 participants received no feedback.
Ik betreur het dat door deze samenloop van omstandigheden deze groep van 604 deelnemers geen terugkoppeling heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Transgenders ten einde raad: transitie stopt na faillissement instelling’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Minister of Medical Care about the bankruptcy of Psycho Informa Instellingen, which forced around 130 transgender patients to halt gender transition treatment, and asked about continuity of care, insurers' duty and protection of patient records. The Minister regrets the bankruptcy, says the matter was discussed in a VWS transgender care consultation where insurers advised patients to seek bemiddeling, confirms insurers have a duty of care, and points to professional record-keeping rules and curator obligations for patient files.
I regret that an institution has been declared bankrupt, as a result of which dozens of clients, including transgender people, cannot continue their treatment at this mental health institution.
Ik vind het te betreuren dat een instelling failliet is verklaard als gevolg waarvan tientallen cliënten, waaronder transgenders hun behandeling bij deze GGZ-instelling niet kunnen vervolgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de uitspraak 201700522/1/A3 van de Raad van State en het bericht ‘Gevolgen van vernietiging IS door Nederlandse bommen blijven geheim’

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands' air strikes against IS can be traced in the weekly Defence overview alongside CENTCOM reports, whether more detail will be published, and whether the Dutch weapon deployments reported to the Public Prosecution Service will be shared with parliament. The minister replied that coalition strikes cannot be attributed to individual countries, that the Dutch weekly overview has been expanded in detail, and that parliament has been informed confidentially and openly, while assessment of investigations is for the prosecutor.
Attacks cannot be traced back to countries from this reporting.
Aanvallen zijn hieruit niet te herleiden naar landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Amnesty: duizenden vrouwen en meisjes verkracht door leger Nigeria’

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Dutch government whether it knew of Amnesty's report on rape of women and girls by Nigerian soldiers in camps, and what it would do, including raising the matter at the UN Security Council and considering a thematic sanctions regime. The government said it is aware of the report, supports women's rights projects in Nigeria, will raise the allegations with the EU and in the EU-Nigeria human rights dialogue, and opposes a global thematic sanctions regime as ineffective.
Following Amnesty International's report, the EU plans to enter into dialogue with key actors in the federal government and security agencies.
Naar aanleiding van het rapport van Amnesty International is de EU van plan een dialoog aan te gaan met belangrijke actoren in de federale regering en veiligheidsagentschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Ze vermoordde haar man toen hij haar verkrachtte. Nu krijgt Noura (19) de doodstraf’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the case of Noura, 19, sentenced to death in Sudan after killing her husband, whether she was a victim of sexual abuse acting in self-defence, and what he would do to stop the execution. The minister confirmed awareness, said the embassy found the facts plausible, that the appeal court must decide, and that the Netherlands made strong representations jointly with the EU, but that annulment was not yet an option while the appeal is pending.
Once it is clear what ruling the appeal court has made, the Cabinet will consider which follow-up steps are necessary and possible.
Nadat duidelijk is geworden welke uitspraak de rechter in hoger beroep heeft gedaan, zal het Kabinet bezien welke vervolgstappen nodig en mogelijk zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Becker, Diks, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Prominente Saudische vrouwenrechtenactivisten opgepakt’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of Saudi women's rights activists were only for campaigning for women's right to drive, and whether the government would raise the matter bilaterally and in the EU and call for their release. The minister said the detainees are suspected of conspiracy with foreign powers and financing hostile actors, that Nederland raised concerns with the Saudi foreign minister and is consulting partners including in the EU, and that it remains concerned about repression of dissent.
The Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the detention of the activists and press for proper treatment.
Nederland zal aandacht blijven vragen voor de aanhoudingen van de activisten en aandringen op goede behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over een MIVD-operatie in Afghanistan

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked the Defence Minister about reports that former MIVD staff in Afghanistan fear for their lives after a major's public admission of a secret operation, and about protection, a years-long procedure, and a possible lawsuit. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to comment on intelligence operations and individual cases, and said no lawsuit has been filed, only a lawyer's letter that is being studied.
As you know, I do not make public statements about intelligence operations and individual cases.
Zoals bij u bekend is, doe ik over inlichtingenoperaties en individuele gevallen in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over kernwapenbeleid

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the Dutch government about US nuclear modernisation (B61 bombs, the F-35 nuclear role, transport and accident safety) and whether the Netherlands should refuse nuclear weapons. The minister declined to give locations, numbers and transport details on alliance grounds, said the F-35 will take over the nuclear-capable role from the F-16 in line with prior policy, and pointed to a forthcoming AIV advisory report.
As the House is aware, under alliance arrangements no information can be provided on the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe.
Zoals de Kamer bekend kunnen op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over het afbreken van een inlichtingenoperatie naar aanleiding van de verklaring van een oud-commando

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked the Minister of Defence whether special forces were recalled early from a mission after a former commando's statement about a hostage incident, whether the operation was an intelligence operation under the intelligence services act, and whether democratic oversight of secret operations should be improved. The minister declined to comment publicly on intelligence operations, stated that no state secrets were disclosed and that officials assess their own statements, and referred to a separate letter on oversight of special operations; the Public Prosecution Service is investigating the statement.
Do you share the view that democratic oversight, given the major impact of such missions on society and the revelations of Major Kroon, should be improved?
Deelt u de opvatting dat de democratische controle, gezien de grote impact van dergelijke missies op samenleving alsmede de onthullingen van majoor Kroon, verbeterd dient te worden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over ‘The Rohingya children trafficked for sex’.

An MP asked the foreign and development ministers about reports that Rohingya girls in Bangladeshi refugee camps are trafficked into sex work, what protective measures will be taken, and what concrete steps the Netherlands will take on UN calls to protect women in conflict, including a thematic sanctions regime. The ministers said the Netherlands will press Bangladesh, the UN and aid agencies for protection measures and raise the issue at the World Bank meetings, but they judged a global thematic sanctions regime unlikely to succeed and preferred adding sexual violence to country-specific sanctions regimes and using the International Criminal Court.
The Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation will attend a meeting in Washington on 21 April together with UNHCR and Bangladesh.
Zo zal de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking op 21 april in Washington samen met UNHCR en Bangladesh een bijeenkomst bijwonen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht dat in Limburg scholen miljoenen aan onderwijsgeld mislopen

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether Limburg schools lose millions in disadvantage funding under the current allocation rules and what the minister will do about it. Minister Slob acknowledged problems with the current weighting scheme and administration, said a new CBS-based allocation system is being developed with a target of 2019–2020, and said additional structural funds are being added.
That is why I am currently working on a new allocation system.
Daarom werk ik momenteel aan een nieuwe verdeelsystematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Luchtmacht baas wil extra aandacht voor veiligheidscultuur na lekken'

MP Ploumen asked the Defence Minister about the Air Force commander's email to staff stressing safety culture after leaks to the press, questioning whether staff felt unable to raise concerns internally. The state secretary replied that the commander's email was a routine daily order encouraging reporting through existing channels, described the reporting and anonymous-report procedures, and announced measures in a safety action plan to improve reporting willingness.
In the action plan 'A safe defence organisation' sent to your House on 28 March, Defence commits to measures to increase staff willingness to report and to strengthen its capacity to learn.

In het op 28 maart jongstleden aan uw Kamer verstuurde plan van aanpak «Een veilige defensieorganisatie» nemen we als Defensie maatregelen om de meldingsbereidheid bij medewerkers te verhogen en het lerend vermogen te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Rol Belgie in geheime operatie tegen IS’

MPs Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch intelligence supports the US-led operation Gallant Phoenix against IS, including Dutch involvement in searching a database in Jordan, and whether they had contacted their Belgian counterpart. The minister said there was no contact with the Belgian minister, that Nederland shares intelligence within the anti-ISIS coalition, and that for operational security she does not comment on specific intelligence activities.
For reasons of operational security, the cabinet makes no statements about specific activities in the intelligence domain.
In het kader van de operationele veiligheid doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over specifieke werkzaamheden in het inlichtingendomein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Ten Broeke, Karabulut en De Roon over de onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs asked the minister about the expulsion of a BBC journalist from Papua, press freedom, deteriorating human rights, and Dutch police training in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the expulsion, said foreign journalists need permits, described Dutch support for press freedom and the Community Policing Programme, and said human rights including Papua are raised in bilateral and EU/UN dialogue.
Enquiries showed that the BBC journalist indeed had to leave the province.
Bij navraag is gebleken dat de BBC-journaliste inderdaad de provincie moest verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Rechten van meisjes blijven internationaal onderbelicht’

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about a Plan International report finding girls' rights rarely named in international treaties. The minister answered that girls' rights are covered by existing conventions, that the government will push for explicit mention in new negotiations and UN resolutions, and that it will press states to withdraw reservations.
Therefore the cabinet will advocate explicit mention of girls' rights when negotiations take place on new binding treaties
Daarom zal het kabinet pleiten voor een expliciete vermelding van de rechten van meisjes wanneer onderhandelingen plaatsvinden over nieuwe bindende verdragen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Oijk en Karabulut over het bericht 'De onderkoning van Congo'

MPs Ploumen, Van Oijk and Karabulut asked about press reports on Dan Gertler, his listing on the US Magnitsky sanctions list, whether Dutch authorities investigated Fleurette Group, whether EU or Dutch sanctions are possible, and what Dutch measures exist against foreign corruption. The minister says the cabinet is concerned, is closely informed about the US investigation and sanctions, notes the EU has no Magnitsky-type regime, and describes the Dutch integrated anti-corruption approach with enforcement left to the OM and FIOD.
This matter now has the full attention of the Dutch enforcement authorities.
Deze kwestie heeft inmiddels de volledige aandacht van de Nederlandse handhavingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Onderzoekers OPCW linken Syrië aan grote sarinaanval in 2013’

Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the OPCW reports linking Syria to the 2013 sarin attack, what consequences it attaches, whether Assad has a future in Syria, and what the earlier OPCW findings have led to. Minister Kaag answered that the reports cannot yet be confirmed, that the government keeps pressing Syria in the UN and OPCW, and that no majority exists yet for direct consequences, pointing to accountability initiatives such as the IIIM and EU sanctions.
The cabinet is therefore working, both inside and outside the UN Security Council and together with like-minded countries, to stop the use of chemical weapons in Syria.
Het kabinet zet zich daarom, zowel binnen als buiten de VN-Veiligheidsraad, samen met gelijkgezinde landen in om het gebruik van chemische wapens in Syrië te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘voorbereiding kernramp kan beter’

MPs Ploumen and Van Dijk asked whether the government accepts the Safety Board's findings that the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany are inadequately prepared for a nuclear disaster, and how it will improve information to the public and cross-border cooperation. The state secretary accepts the Board's recommendations, promises a cabinet response with specific measures, says the ANVS will make incident information more accessible, and says cross-border issues will be raised in bilateral talks.
I endorse the recommendations of the OVV.
Ik onderschrijf de aanbevelingen van de OVV.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het opinieartikel ‘Wordt het niet tijd om Nederland iets ruimer te zien dan de Randstad? Kabinet, ik bied u Zuid Limburg’

PvdA MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about an opinion piece urging a broader view of the Netherlands beyond the Randstad, with Zuid-Limburg as a TriState growth region. The minister responds that the government will look beyond the Randstad, that regions bear primary responsibility for spatial development, and that cross-border action and the National Environmental Vision will be pursued, with an update to parliament promised in spring 2018.
The State Secretary of BZK will inform the House of Representatives in more detail on progress in spring 2018.
De Staatssecretaris van BZK zal in het voorjaar van 2018 de Tweede Kamer over de voortgang hieromtrent nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat ‘Wees een voorbeeld, geen bullebak’

MP Ploumen asked the State Secretary for Defence about a doctoral study finding that initiation rituals at the Royal Military Academy go too far, and whether rules and a ban on hazing should be tightened. The government answered that harmful practices have been changed, that some rituals remain useful, that a defence-wide directive from 2013 is being revised to sharpen commander responsibility, and that the study has been sent to the social safe workplace commission.
This 2013 directive is currently being revised.
Deze aanwijzing uit 2013 wordt momenteel herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over integriteit van het lokaal bestuur in Limburg

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked the Minister of Interior whether the appointment of a controversial alderman in Brunssum, which the mayor and the Limburg commissioner of the King considered a threat to governability, was acceptable and what tools mayors and commissioners have when integrity is at stake. The Minister said she had requested an official report, appointed an acting mayor with a mandate to restore relations, and promised to report by Q1 2018 on whether the legal toolkit should be expanded.
I aim to inform your House further on this in the first quarter of 2018.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hierover in het eerste kwartaal van 2018 nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Moorlag over het bericht dat België zijn kerncentrales langer zou openhouden

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Belgium's Tihange and Doel nuclear plants would stay open beyond 2025, whether this breaks Belgian phase-out commitments, and what the Netherlands will do to press for closure and raise it at EU level. The minister replied that Belgian energy-pact negotiations are pending, that Nederland relies on the coalition agreement, that nuclear safety is primarily Belgium's responsibility, that the ANVS has strengthened cooperation with the Belgian regulator, and that the issue can be raised through EU energy-plan consultation and bilateral channels.
The safety of the Belgian plants is first and foremost a Belgian responsibility.
De veiligheid van de Belgische centrales is op de eerste plaats een Belgische verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Geweld tegen Rohingya: 'Massaslachtingen met honderden doden''

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about reports of mass killings and possible ethnic cleansing of Rohingya by the Myanmar army, including sexual violence, and about psychosocial aid and UN Security Council sanctions. The government expressed serious concern, called for cooperation with the UN Fact Finding Mission and humanitarian access, outlined funding for sexual violence support, and said thematic sanctions face substantial resistance in the Security Council.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about reports of human rights violations by the Myanmar army against Rohingya in Rakhine State.
Het kabinet maakt zich ernstige zorgen over berichten over mensenrechtenschendingen door het Myanmarese leger tegen Rohingya in Rakhine State
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Geheime deal: veel meer IS’ers mochten Raqqa ontvluchten’

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew hundreds of ISIS fighters had been allowed safe passage out of Raqqa, what he thought of it, where they went, and whether he would raise the evacuation decision with the anti-ISIS coalition. Minister Zijlstra said the coalition was not involved in or informed beforehand of the local deal, that the government finds it concerning that some armed fighters benefited, that tribal leaders reportedly handed most released fighters to local tribes after SDF screening, and that Nederland raised concerns with the coalition's envoy and informed the Kamer on the same day.
The Coalition was not involved in the talks that led to this agreement, nor was the Netherlands informed of it in advance.
De Coalitie was niet betrokken bij de gesprekken die tot deze afspraak hebben geleid, noch is Nederland hierover vooraf geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Militairen mishandeld bij ontgroeningsritueel’

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports of soldiers being abused during initiation rituals at the Schaarsbergen barracks, the union's call to abolish such rituals, and related reporting, measures, complaint channels, drugs use and prosecution. The government answered that a domestic investigation was conducted with prosecutor consent, rights-related measures were taken, an independent external inquiry is underway, and that it sees no reason to change prosecution policy.
The way reports and reporters are handled is part of the independent external investigation.
De wijze waarop met meldingen en melders wordt omgegaan maakt deel uit van het onafhankelijk externe onderzoek.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het behalen van de huidige doelstellingen binnen het Bangladesh Veiligheidsakkoord en de verlenging van het akkoord

Voordewind asked whether the minister knows that not all Dutch apparel brands have signed the new Bangladesh Safety Accord, whether she will press Dutch signatories to meet the targets by May 2018, how many Dutch brands source from Bangladesh, whether accord membership is required under the Dutch textile covenant, and what she will do to urge firms to sign the extended accord. Minister Kaag answered that the targets are about 80 percent realised, that the covenant is the channel for pressure, that the number of Dutch importers is unknown (about 20 percent of Dutch clothing comes from Bangladesh), that accord membership is advised but not required, and that the government supports signing the successor accord and aims for 50 percent market coverage by the covenant in 2018.
The exact number of Dutch clothing brands importing clothing from Bangladesh is not known.
Het exacte aantal Nederlandse kledingmerken dat kleding importeert vanuit Bangladesh is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse technologie in Zuid-Koreaanse fregatten die o.a. aan Egypte worden doorverkocht

MP Karabulut asked whether Dutch technology (Thales/Hollandse Signaal radar and C3 systems) aboard South Korean Po Hang-class corvettes resold to Egypt and other countries was authorised, and on what grounds. The ministers confirmed Dutch consent was given for transfers to Egypt, the Philippines, Peru and Vietnam based on EU criteria assessment, and that export licences apply to re-exports from third countries.
The Netherlands previously consented to the resale of South Korean ships with Dutch equipment on board to the Philippines, Peru and Vietnam.
Nederland heeft eerder ingestemd met de doorverkoop van Zuid-Koreaanse schepen met aan boord Nederlandse apparatuur aan de Filipijnen, Peru en Vietnam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg en De Roon over het bericht dat Robert Mugabe benoemd is tot goodwill-ambassadeur van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO)

PVV MPs asked whether Robert Mugabe's appointment as WHO goodwill ambassador was justified, and whether Dutch funding or membership should be suspended or withdrawn if it was not reversed. The minister answered that the appointment was unfounded, that the Netherlands had lobbied for its withdrawal, which the WHO did, and that no further measures were needed.
It is good that this decision has been withdrawn. Therefore there is no need to take further measures.
Het is goed dat dit besluit is ingetrokken. Daarom is er geen noodzaak om verdere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over de benoeming van de Zimbabwaanse president Robert Mugabe door de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) tot 'goodwill ambassador'

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the WHO's appointment of Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe as goodwill ambassador, its purpose, rationale and formal status, and what the government will do. The minister answers that the appointment was withdrawn after Dutch protest, that the WHO gave no reasons or formal mandate, and that no further measures are needed beyond monitoring the WHO.
No, the WHO has not provided further information on this.
Nee, de WHO heeft hier geen nadere informatie over verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over mensenrechtenschendingen tegen Burundese vluchtelingen

An MP asked the foreign and trade ministers about human rights violations against Burundian refugees in Congo, including shootings, EU diplomatic pressure, MONUSCO's protection role, refugee camp conditions and the safety of returnees to Burundi. The government condemned the violence, reported that Congolese authorities and MONUSCO opened investigations, and said Burundi's repression and economic weakness make returns risky.
The cabinet is shocked by the incident and condemns the disproportionate use of force by the Congolese security services.
Het kabinet is geschokt door het incident en veroordeelt het disproportioneel gebruik van geweld door de Congolese veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'Israëls aanval op Palestijns onderwijs: complete school weg'

An MP asked the government about the Israeli demolition of a Palestinian school at Jubbet adh Dhib, which was EU-funded, and the violence against residents, and asked what steps the EU and the Netherlands would take. The government condemned the demolition and confiscation of Palestinian property, said it would raise the issue through EU joint action and dialogue, but did not commit to specific new measures beyond considering further steps if asked by the EU.
The cabinet condemns the demolition and confiscation of Palestinian property, regardless of whether it was financed by the EU or not.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de sloop en confiscatie van Palestijnse bezittingen, ongeacht of deze door de EU zijn gefinancierd of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over het bericht dat België de hulp aan Palestijnse scholen opschort

MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg asked whether Dutch aid money had gone to Palestinian schools that were named after a terrorist and glorify violence, and whether a ban on all Dutch funding to such schools is warranted. The ministers answered that the Netherlands does not fund schools directly, that glorification of violence is unacceptable, that the EU and Netherlands press both parties on incitement, and that they do not agree that no Dutch money should go to Palestinian schools.
The Netherlands does not provide direct funding to schools, so also not to this particular school.
Nederland geeft geen directe financiering aan scholen, dus ook niet aan deze bewuste school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Van den Bosch over landen die in Nederland onderdelen voor massavernietigingswapens proberen te kopen

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers whether countries such as Iran, Syria and Pakistan are procuring weapons-of-mass-destruction components in the Netherlands, what has been done about successful purchases, what extra measures are needed, how businesses and SMEs are made aware of the risk, and whether a blacklist of intermediaries exists. The government confirmed the risk, described export-control and awareness measures, and declined to publish a blacklist or specific case details for national security reasons.
The cabinet does not make public statements about case matters that touch on the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van den Hul en Diks over moderne slavernij, kinderarbeid en onveilig en ongezond werk in Indiase granietgroeves die aan Nederlandse en Europese markt leveren

Three MPs asked the government about modern slavery, child labour and unsafe work in Indian granite quarries supplying Dutch and European markets, and what Dutch companies, procurement and diplomacy will do about it. The minister acknowledges serious abuses, points to OECD due diligence duties, an IMVO sector convenant under negotiation, procurement conditions and raising the issue in EU-India human rights dialogue, but offers no binding new measures and leaves much to the Indian government and ILO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Van Brenk over het onderzoek 'De schaduwzijden van Graniet'

MPs Sazias and Van Brenk asked the government about a report on modern slavery, child labour and dangerous conditions in South Indian granite quarries, including what the government is doing with importing firms, procurement and the multi-stakeholder natural stone covenant. The Minister says a covenant is being negotiated with the sector, will raise the issue in the EU-India human rights dialogue and with the ILO, expects companies to carry out due diligence under the OECD guidelines, and notes that public procurement and decentralised governments are being engaged, though no mandatory transparency rules are planned.
Are you prepared to require companies to be fully transparent about their supply chain policy regarding their duty of care to promote human rights?
Bent u bereid bedrijven te verplichten volledig transparant te zijn over hun keten (beleid) op het gebied van hun zorgplicht voor het bevorderen van mensenrechten?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat graniet gedolven wordt door kinderhanden

An SP MP asked the minister about a report that granite sold in the Netherlands is quarried by children in India, including how many Dutch firms are involved, what sanctions a proposed child labour due diligence law would impose, and whether the granite sector covenant will include sanctions. The minister confirmed the report, said the government has no figures, raised the issue in EU-India human rights dialogue and with the ILO, said the covenant is still under negotiation, and described fines and prosecution under the proposed law.
The cabinet has no figures on the precise number of Dutch companies involved.
Over het precieze aantal Nederlandse bedrijven dat daarbij betrokken is, heeft het kabinet geen cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oijk en Diks over de inbeslagname door Israël van een door Nederland gesubsidieerd zonne-energieproject in het Palestijnse dorp Jubbet adh Dhib

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether Israel would return seized Dutch-subsidised solar panels in Jubbet adh Dhib, compensate the damage, and how the Israeli permit regime relates to humanitarian obligations and EU responses. The government reported that the panels were returned to COMET-ME as a temporary solution pending a zoning plan decision, gave permit statistics showing very few Palestinian approvals in Area C, and described EU efforts to press Israel on demolitions while declining to answer some questions on Israel's intentions.
It is not for the cabinet to answer this question about the intentions of the Israeli government.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om deze vraag naar voornemens van de Israëlische regering te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kwint over de 1,4 miljoen euro die Nederland steekt in een onderwijsbedrijf voor de allerarmsten

Two SP MPs asked the minister whether the indirect 1.4 million euro Dutch investment in Bridge International Academies, a profit-seeking school operator, is responsible given reported quality, pricing, teacher pay and transparency problems, and what action was taken. The minister defended the investment as supporting affordable private education, reported contact with Bridge and ongoing independent evaluations, and declined to withdraw the support.
The cabinet sees no reason to recover this indirect support.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om deze indirecte steun terug te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Amhaouch over de consequentie van Basel IV regels voor het financieringsmechanisme ten behoeve van ontwikkelingssamenwerking

CDA MPs asked whether Basel IV capital rules would deter bank financing of development countries and sought measures to protect such lending. The government answered that the Basel framework is risk-based without geographic distinction, that negotiations are ongoing, and that it would consider the EU implementation and impact assessment before setting its position.
It is not yet certain that higher capital requirements for investments in developing countries will be a result of the new Basel Committee regulation.
Het staat echter nog niet vast dat een verhoging van kapitaaleisen voor investeringen in ontwikkelingslanden een resultante van de nieuwe regelgeving van het Bazelse comité zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een veetransport naar West-Siberië

An MP asked the government about a planned road transport of around 5,000 dairy cows from the Netherlands and Germany to West Siberia, and whether it complies with EU animal transport rules. The government answered that the NVWA is not aware the transport is ordered by Danone, that a travel plan must be assessed before approval, pregnant animals are restricted, and that no permanent veterinary supervision can be enforced outside the EU.
The NVWA supervises the planning and, prior to transport, the conditions under which such transports take place.
De NVWA ziet toe op de planning en voorafgaand aan het transport op de condities waaronder dergelijke transporten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Von Martels over CETA en het succes van de op de Canadese markt aanwezige genetisch gemodificeerde zalm

Two CDA MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade whether genetically modified salmon sold in Canada could reach the Dutch market under CETA, and how origin labelling and EU rules apply. The minister answered that GM animals and derived products are not authorised in the EU, that export to the EU is not allowed, that CETA contains no provisions on GM fish and changes nothing to EU GMO rules, and that EU labelling rules make fish origin traceable.
CETA contains no agreements on EU imports of genetically modified fish.
In CETA zijn geen afspraken gemaakt over de EU-import van genetisch gemodificeerde vis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de recente ontwikkelingen rondom CETA

An SP MP asked the trade minister about Belgium's request for a Court of Justice opinion on the CETA investment court system, its effect on provisional application and ratification, Poland's objections, and fast-track ratification of EU trade deals. The minister answered that the investment court provisions are excluded from provisional application, that the Court request does not require other states' support, that Poland's stance does not directly affect provisional application, and that the government favours broad trade agreements while the EU-Singapore opinion shapes competence.
The cabinet is in favour of broad, deep, sustainable and inclusive trade agreements.
Het kabinet is voorstander van brede, diepgaande, duurzame en inclusieve handelsakkoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de protectionistische houding van de Verenigde Staten binnen de World Trade Organisation

The MP Becker asks the minister whether the United States is blocking appointments to the WTO Appellate Body to influence its course, and what the consequences are for the WTO, the EU and the Netherlands. The minister confirms the US has twice blocked reappointments and raises procedural objections, calls this worrying and undesirable, and says the Netherlands and EU will keep raising the issue bilaterally and within WTO and EU settings.
This mechanism is a crucial part of the rules-based multilateral trading system.
Dit mechanisme is cruciaal onderdeel van het op regels gebaseerde multilaterale handelssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie van de Rohingya in Myanmar

An MP from DENK asked the Dutch foreign minister, in 18 questions, about the Rohingya crisis in Myanmar, including the humanitarian toll, army conduct, blocked aid, possible genocide, refugee intake and trade with Myanmar. The minister condemned the violence, called on Myanmar's authorities to protect civilians and allow aid, pledged extra humanitarian funding and backed a UN Fact Finding Mission, but declined to halt trade or commit to large-scale resettlement.
The cabinet has, in recent weeks, taken note with horror of the reports of violence in Rakhine State.
Het kabinet heeft de afgelopen weken met afschuw kennisgenomen van de berichten over het geweld in Rakhine State
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over terreurkampen voor Palestijnse kinderen georganiseerd door o.a. de Verenigde Naties

MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg (PVV) asked the government how many children attend alleged Hamas and UNRWA 'terror camps' and whether Dutch funding to UNRWA should stop. The government distinguishes Hamas camps from UNRWA summer camps, says it has no evidence of terrorist links to UNRWA camps, and refuses to halt UNRWA funding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘World Bank must stop encouraging harmful tax competition’

An SP MP asked the Finance and Development Cooperation ministers about the World Bank's Doing Business report, which she says encourages tax competition and a Washington-consensus market ideology, and about ignoring OECD/IMF evidence on tax incentives and FDI. The government rejects the ideology critique, defends the report's tax indicator as having a threshold against tax races, notes Dutch anti-avoidance efforts, and says it will discuss the concerns with the Dutch World Bank executive director.

The cabinet is of the view that the way the World Bank measures the tax burden on small and medium enterprises in the Doing Business report does not encourage entrepreneurs to engage in tax avoidance.

Het kabinet is van mening dat de wijze waarop de Wereldbank in het Doing Business -rapport de belastingdruk voor het midden- en kleinbedrijf in kaart brengt ondernemers niet aanmoedigt tot belastingontwijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bericht dat Frankrijk de import van palmolie en onduurzame soja gaat verbieden

An MP asked whether the government will follow France in banning imports of unsustainable palm oil and soy to protect forests, and about Dutch responsibility for deforestation and the reliance on voluntary certification schemes. The minister answered that the government opposes import bans in principle, prefers sustainability in producing countries and voluntary standards (RSPO, RTRS), and rejects any contradiction in its climate and forest policy.

The cabinet is in principle not in favour of import bans, and instead works on making production in the countries themselves more sustainable and on increasing demand for sustainable palm oil and soy.

Het kabinet is in beginsel geen voorstander van importverboden, en werkt in plaats daarvan aan de verduurzaming van de productie in de landen zelf en aan het vergroten van de vraag naar duurzame palmolie en soja.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over migratie via Niger

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked the government about migration through Niger, EU missions, funding, smuggling laws and prosecutions, economic alternatives for smugglers, and migrants abandoned in the desert. The minister answered in detail on each question, describing EUCAP and EU funding, Niger's laws and arrests, and economic alternatives, but gave no firm new commitments.
The Netherlands is urging the Red Cross and IOM to register that information better, so that left-behind family members can also be informed.
Nederland dringt er bij het Rode Kruis en de IOM op aan om die informatie beter te registreren, zodat ook achtergebleven familieleden geïnformeerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de totstandkoming van een fiscaal gunstige tegemoetkoming aan chemieconcern ICL

Green Left MP Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance and the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Trade about emails suggesting a tax ruling was agreed with chemical group ICL, despite the State Secretary's claim that he did not know one existed, and about related audit, negotiation and subsidy questions. The government declined to confirm or deny a ruling citing tax secrecy, described the ICL correspondence as a letter of intent and pre-meeting, and rejected the characterisation of negotiation and subsidy as reflecting actual practice.

As indicated in the thirty-member debate of 5 July, the cabinet cannot, because of the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, confirm or deny whether an APA or ATR was issued to ICL.

Zoals in het dertigledendebat van 5 juli jl. is aangegeven, kan het kabinet vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen niet bevestigen of ontkennen of een APA (Advance Pricing Agreement) of ATR (Advance Tax Ruling) is afgegeven aan ICL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over hoge reiskosten binnen de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the WHO spent about 200 million USD on travel in 2016, exceeding spending on AIDS, malaria and TB, and about luxury travel by staff. The minister confirmed the figures, said most travel costs relate to external experts and member-state representatives, defended the comparison with other agencies as not like-for-like, and said the Netherlands will keep pressing the WHO for cost efficiency without changing its WHO funding policy.
The Netherlands will continue to hold the WHO to account on this and urge it to achieve greater cost efficiency.
Nederland zal de WHO hierop blijven aanspreken en de WHO aansporen om grotere kostenefficiëntie te bewerkstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van der Lee over belastingontwijking door mijnbouwbedrijven via Nederland

MPs Diks and Van der Lee asked the government about tax avoidance by mining companies using Dutch financing and holding companies, including the lack of employees, trust offices, treaty misuse, UBO register access for developing-country tax authorities, and whether tax avoidance should be a priority in mining sector convenants. The State Secretary answered that Dutch structures are a risk signal but tax evasion was not proven, pointed to BEPS measures, the MLI, Addis Tax Initiative, planned partial public UBO register access, and said tax avoidance would be actively raised in convenant prioritisation.
The government will actively raise the theme of tax avoidance for consideration when setting the convenant priorities.
De overheid zal het thema belastingontwijking actief ter overweging inbrengen bij de vaststelling van de convenantprioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Amhaouch over de afbraak en inbeslagname van door Nederland gefinancierd zonne-energie project door Israël

MPs Knops and Amhaouch asked whether Israeli authorities demolished and largely confiscated a Dutch-funded solar project in Jubbet adh Dhib without notice, and about its harm, legal obligations, and Dutch and EU responses. The ministers confirmed the demolition, reported about 40,000 euro in damage, said Israel has promised to return the panels after Dutch protests, and noted ongoing talks and EU coordination.
Prime Minister Netanyahu has informed the Netherlands by letter that the panels will be returned to the Netherlands.
Premier Netanyahu heeft per brief laten weten dat de panelen teruggegeven zullen worden aan Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat Israël een Nederlands ontwikkelingsproject heeft gesloopt

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch development projects in Israeli-controlled Area C without permits fit Dutch policy, and whether the embassy notified Israeli authorities that the Dutch-funded project was seized. The government answered that Israel rarely issues permits, that it need not disclose donors, that the seizure lacked a prior stop-work order, and that it will leave coordination to implementing agencies without announcing a change.
As long as there is no fundamental change in the permit system, the cabinet will leave it to the implementing organisations to decide the extent to which they coordinate with the Israeli authorities.

Zolang er geen fundamentele verandering in het vergunningstelsel komt, zal het kabinet het aan de uitvoerende organisaties laten om te bepalen in welke mate zij wel of niet coördineren met de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de cholera uitbraak in Jemen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the cholera outbreak in Yemen, Saudi-led coalition blockades that obstruct humanitarian aid, and Dutch arms exports to Egyptian and UAE navies involved in the blockade. The minister pointed to a EUR 4.5 million contribution, said the coalition and parties share responsibility, reported that Save the Children shipments were held, and stated arms export licences are checked case by case, with calls for lifting restrictions on aid but no commitment to halt exports.
The cabinet does not have data on other cases in which humanitarian aid was stopped at sea.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over gegevens over andere gevallen waarin humanitaire hulp op zee is tegengehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de voortgang van het opruimen van de Nigerdelta

MP Karabulut asks the minister about slow progress in cleaning up oil pollution in the Niger Delta, including the Nigerian and Shell responses to the 2011 UNEP report, funding, drinking water, the RENA method, Shell's claims of completed cleanups, Dutch support, and whether the OECD National Contact Point study will cover Shell. The minister answers that the Netherlands presses all parties for faster action, that progress is step-by-step but limited, that the polluter-pays principle applies to SPDC with NNPC funding, and that the NCP study is ongoing with conclusions to be shared with the Chamber.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over een politieteam in Indonesië tegen LHBT'ers (Lesbiënnes, Homoseksuelen, Biseksuelen en Transgenders) moet opsporen

MPs Van Helvert, Ten Broeke and Voordewind asked about a planned West Java police unit to hunt LHBT people, alleged threats of harsh punishment, Dutch aid to Indonesia, and whether the Netherlands will act via EU dialogue. The government says the unit has not been formally established, confirms the Netherlands raised LHBTI concerns bilaterally and via the EU, lists aid being phased out by 2020 while support to civil society continues, and commits to raising the issue in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Groothuizen over een recordaantal kinderen dat op de vlucht is

Two D66 MPs asked about the record number of children on the move, including whether the Netherlands would lead an alliance, how EU child-rights violations are prevented, the status of the pledge to bring 750 refugee children from Italy and Greece, and whether NGOs would be invited. The minister answered that the government supports child-focused programmes abroad, cannot provide a full overview of EU violations, reports about 750 minors relocated, and will invite the NGOs to talk.
The cabinet does not have a complete overview of reported violations and the actions taken against them.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een totaaloverzicht van gemelde schendingen en de acties die daartegen worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de onhoudbare situatie aangaande de cholera-epidemie in Jemen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the cholera epidemic in Yemen, including the scale of infections, funding levels, obstacles to aid and whether the UN Security Council and the UK should act more. The minister answered that the Netherlands contributes humanitarian aid and water programmes, has no specific cholera budget, and that the Netherlands will press partners and the Security Council, with no new binding commitments.
No specific budget has been allocated to combating the cholera epidemic.
Er is geen specifiek budget toegekend aan de bestrijding van de cholera-epidemie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over de vluchtelingencrisis in Oeganda

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether donor countries were failing to meet their pledges for South Sudanese refugees in Uganda, and what Dutch support would be provided. The minister answered that donors pledged USD 358 million at the Solidarity Summit, that the Netherlands committed EUR 5.5 million for refugees and host communities, and that the government will keep pressing other donors to disburse their pledges.
The cabinet is willing to do so and has decided to contribute EUR 5.5 million to sustainable, integrated solutions for the reception and protection of refugees and their host communities.
Het kabinet is hiertoe bereid en heeft besloten om EUR 5,5 miljoen bij te dragen aan duurzame, geïntegreerde oplossingen voor de opvang en bescherming van vluchtelingen en hun gastgemeenschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over wapenexport naar landen die betrokken zijn bij de oorlog in Jemen

Two SP MPs asked the government about arms exports to Yemen coalition states (Egypt, UAE navies), Airbus's tax ruling, investments by pension funds and banks in Airbus, and tax facilitation of Airbus. The government said it refuses export licences for coalition states where goods may be used in combat in Yemen, declined to disclose sales volumes and tax ruling details citing confidentiality, and said banks and pension funds are addressed through due-diligence and OECD guideline frameworks.
However, under the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, no information about individual taxpayers can be provided.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de AWR kan echter geen informatie over individuele belastingplichtigen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over het bezoek van de Mozambikaanse president aan Nederland

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why President Nyusi of Mozambique was received in the Netherlands before the hidden-debt fraud investigation concluded, and about his role and the government's response. The ministers answered that the topic was raised in talks, that the independent audit and criminal investigation are ongoing, and that aid resumption depends on concrete action.
In that context, the need for concrete follow-up with possible criminal prosecution was central.
Daarin is de noodzaak tot concrete opvolging met eventuele strafrechtelijke vervolging centraal gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over het bericht “TiSA and the threat to public banks”

Two SP MPs asked the trade and finance ministers about a report claiming the TiSA services agreement threatens public banks and government regulatory room. The minister rejects this, arguing TiSA contains prudential and public-service carve-outs and leaves governments free to regulate.
The cabinet does not share the thrust of the publication.
Het kabinet deelt de strekking van de publicatie niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over internationaal maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen

An MP asks how the government screens environmental effects, corruption links and water impacts of Dutch firms receiving subsidies, trade missions, export credit insurance and diplomatic support, and how rejections and evaluations work. The minister answers that firms are checked against OECD-based IMVO criteria, that some applications were refused for environmental reasons, that no applications were refused for bribery concerns, and that a standing evaluation system exists, while withholding firm-specific details for business confidentiality.
For reasons of business confidentiality, no firm-specific information can be provided about withdrawn or rejected applications.
Omwille van bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid kan er geen (bedrijfs-) specifieke informatie worden verstrekt over ingetrokken of afgewezen aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over export van trucks naar Soedan

MP Karabulut asked whether used military trucks exported by Dutch firms to Sudan, possibly still militarily equipped, were used in the armed conflict and whether this breaches the Sudan arms embargo. The government answered that the trucks were demilitarised and exported as civilian vehicles without licence requirement, that it lacks data on their use in the conflict, that the export does not breach the embargo, and that export criteria for ex-military vehicles were already tightened in 2016.
The ministry does not have independent information on the use of trucks in the armed conflict in Sudan.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie over de inzet van trucks in het gewapend conflict in Soedan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het rapport "Are Belgium and the Netherlands in breach of their international obligations under the Basel Convention and customary international law due to their export of hi

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked whether the Netherlands breaches Basel Convention, customary law and ESC rights by exporting high-sulfur fuels to Bamako Convention parties in Africa, and whether it will restrict such exports.
