Minister Ploumen answered that no Basel notifications of such fuels as hazardous waste exist, so no export ban is legally required, and that the government will pursue standards and industry engagement instead, while ILT increases inspection capacity.
Without notification under the Basel Convention, there is no obligation for the Netherlands under the Basel Convention to counter the export.
Zonder notificatie onder het Verdrag van Bazel bestaat er voor Nederland geen verplichting onder het Verdrag van Bazel om de export tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de verscheping van giftige olie vanuit Rotterdam naar Afrika

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the government would respond to a CIEL report claiming illegal export of toxic diesel from Rotterdam to Africa and prosecute Trafigura and Vitol. The Minister rejected the claim of Basel Convention violation, said no legal basis for enforcement exists, promised ILT inspections and dialogue on cleaner fuel standards, but could not guarantee an end to the practice.
The cabinet will continue to call on all parties involved to contribute to a transition to cleaner fuels in African countries.
Het kabinet zal alle betrokken partijen blijven oproepen bij te dragen aan een transitie naar schonere brandstoffen in de Afrikaanse landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van den Hul over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij de voorbereidingen op het WK voetbal in Rusland in 2018

Two MPs asked the government about reports of forced labour and modern slavery among North Korean workers building a World Cup stadium in Russia, whether this breaches sanctions, and what Dutch action is possible. The minister said the reports are serious, that FIFA should investigate and that the Netherlands will press for action in EU and UN settings, while noting the sanctions do not ban such employment.
The cabinet expects FIFA to investigate this matter thoroughly and to take the results of the investigation seriously.
Het kabinet verwacht van de FIFA dat het deze zaak grondig onderzoekt en de resultaten van het onderzoek serieus neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Karabulut over de aandacht die corruptie krijgt in de convenantenaanpak

MPs Hijink and Karabulut asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a reported Shell bribery case in Nigeria, the handling of corruption in the convenant approach, aid and trade policy, and Dutch government support to Shell. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing investigation, described existing anti-corruption policy, OECD guidelines and aid programmes, and said the energy sector convenant had not yet started.
While the Public Prosecution Service investigation is ongoing, no substantive response can be given.
Lopende het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie kan niet inhoudelijk worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over een Amerikaans onderzoek naar staalimporten/staaldumping

An MP asked the trade minister about a US national-security investigation into steel and aluminium imports under section 232, its differences from EU anti-dumping measures, and risks to Dutch steel producers such as Tata Steel IJmuiden. The minister answered that the probe is ongoing, that it is not targeted at one country, that she raised concerns with US Commerce Secretary Ross, and that she would keep the Chamber informed.
Yes. The Netherlands has always pressed for anti-dumping measures to be no more distorting or protectionist than necessary.
Ja. Nederland heeft zich er altijd voor hard gemaakt dat antidumpingmaatregelen niet meer verstorend of protectionistischer zijn dan nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat de EU-steun aan Afrika ten zuiden van de Sahara voor het genereren van inkomsten “nog niet doeltreffend” is.

MPs Taverne and Ten Broeke asked about a European Court of Auditors report finding EU budget support to sub-Saharan Africa not yet effective for domestic revenue mobilisation, and about Dutch positions, EU budget support share, and Zimbabwe tax-training assistance. The minister answered in detail, accepting the report's six recommendations, defending budget support as broadly effective, and noting the Dutch stance and the ended training assistance.
The cabinet welcomes more information and evaluations on the contribution of budget support to domestic revenue mobilisation.
Het kabinet verwelkomt meer informatievoorziening en evaluaties over de bijdrage van begrotingssteun aan de mobilisering van binnenlandse inkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de aanleg van een pijpleiding in de Verenigde Staten

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the government about bank financing for the Dakota Access pipeline, the status of the project, concerns of the Sioux tribes over environment, drinking water, sacred land and treaty rights, and whether ING remains involved. The government answered that the permitting is a US sovereign matter with courts open to objectors, that the Dutch government respects indigenous rights, and that ING has agreed to sell its loan following dialogue with the Standing Rock Sioux.
The decision to grant a permit for the construction of infrastructure projects is a national and sovereign competence of the United States.
De afweging om een vergunning te verlenen voor de aanleg van infrastructurele bouwprojecten is een nationale en soevereine bevoegdheid van de Verenigde Staten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Berlijn zeer terughoudend is geworden met wapenexport naar Turkije

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked whether Germany had become very restrictive on arms export licences to Turkey after the 2016 coup attempt and what the Netherlands was doing in response. The ministers answered that licences are assessed case by case against EU criteria, that four licences were refused in 2016 on internal-situation grounds, and that no EU-wide change or unilateral embargo is planned.
The cabinet publishes a monthly overview of issued arms export licences.
Het kabinet publiceert maandelijks een overzicht van afgegeven vergunningen voor wapenexport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de indirecte bijdrage aan Bridge International Academies

MPs Van Bommel and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch development funds indirectly invested in Bridge International Academies, a low-cost private school operator, and whether this should be reclaimed given school closures and quality concerns. The minister confirmed about USD 1.51 million indirect investment via Novastar, refused to reclaim it, and argued that private education can complement weak public schooling while committing to monitor the Ugandan and Kenyan situations.
The cabinet sees no reason to reclaim this indirect support because the investment is a good complement to the deficient public education in these countries.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om deze indirecte steun terug te vorderen omdat de investering een goede aanvulling vormt op het gebrekkige publieke onderwijs in deze landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes en Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse verzekeraars die nog steeds investeren in wapenfabrikanten

MPs Sjoerdsma, Servaes and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch insurers' investments in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, which may be used in the Yemen conflict, fit export restrictions, the insurance sector's sustainable investment code and international responsible business standards, and what the government has done since 2015. Minister Ploumen answered that no EU sanctions apply to Saudi Arabia, that insurers themselves decide which companies to invest in, that a sector IMVO covenant is being negotiated, and that the insurers named were contacted.
Subject to these conditions, it is up to insurers themselves to decide which companies they invest in; the government in principle does not regulate this.
Met in achtneming van deze voorwaarden is het aan verzekeraars zelf om te bepalen in welke bedrijven zij investeren, de overheid reguleert dit in beginsel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht 'Europa dumpt nog steeds schepen op Aziatische sloopstranden'

An MP asked the ministers whether EU-flagged ships are still dumped on Asian beaches, about Dutch participation, the IMVO covenant with the shipping association, and ratification of the Hong Kong Convention. The government rejects the practice, reports a covenant aimed for this year, and says ratification will follow parliamentary approval of the treaty.
Het kabinet keurt deze praktijk af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht “Textielindustrie ontdekt Myanmar: lage lonen, lange dagen en kinderarbeid”

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports of low wages, long hours and child labour in Myanmar's garment industry, and whether Dutch firms should disclose their activities there and be bound by stricter transparency rules. The minister answered that voluntary supply-chain transparency under the textile convenant suffices for now, that existing due diligence guidance applies without Myanmar-specific indicators, and described development support for labour inspection and unions.
At this moment it is not yet known which factories in Myanmar produce for the Dutch market.
Op dit moment is nog niet bekend welke fabrieken in Myanmar produceren voor de Nederlandse markt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de president van Mali over terugname van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers en illegalen

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the ministers whether Mali's president's statements that Mali would never sign a readmission agreement undermined the EU-Mali migration deal and whether Mali was cooperating enough on returning its nationals, and whether pressure or aid conditionality should be used. The government answered that the joint declaration remains valid, that Mali is bound by international law to cooperate on returns, that only about ten Malians returned voluntarily since 2014 and none forcibly, and that it prefers a broad pragmatic approach over negative incentives such as cutting aid.
The cabinet is of the view that measures to encourage this cooperation are most effective when they are part of a broader package.
Het kabinet is van mening dat maatregelen om deze medewerking te stimuleren het effectiefst zijn als zij onderdeel zijn van een breder pakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over wapenhandel met Turkije

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether the government would suspend arms exports to Turkey given Turkish airstrikes in Syria and Iraq, whether F-35 parts supplied from the Netherlands were acceptable, and whether they would raise the issue in the EU. The government answered that exports are assessed under the EU Common Position, that the F-35 parts are for a multinational production chain, that four Turkish export applications were refused last year, and that it opposes a unilateral embargo and sees no EU support for changing policy on Turkey.
The Netherlands applies the Common Position very strictly and will refuse an export application when it considers the proposed export not in line with the criteria of the Common Position.

Nederland is zeer strikt in de toepassing van het Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt en zal een vergunningaanvraag afwijzen wanneer het de voorgenomen uitvoer niet in overeenstemming acht met de criteria van het Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Merkies en Smaling over de mate waarin Nederlandse verzekeraars zich inzetten voor toegang van mensen in arme landen tot medicijnen

SP MPs asked why Dutch insurers score poorly on health and access to medicines in responsible investment rankings, and what the government will do about it. The minister said several insurers have not signed the Access to Medicine Index investor statement, but that the sector is being engaged through a planned IMVO covenant and that DNB oversees insurers' prudential risk management without setting investment policy.
The investment policy of insurers is primarily the responsibility of those insurers themselves.
Het investeringsbeleid van verzekeraars is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van die verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het handelsverdrag tussen de EU en Japan

An MP asked the trade minister about the stalled EU-Japan trade agreement, including whether it would include investor-state dispute settlement like CETA, data protection, and how the EU and Japan negotiations and CETA might be reset. The minister answered on each point: no agreement yet, the EU seeks the Investment Court System, market access for dairy and cars remains disputed, and the government pushes for more transparency and inclusion, including a new stakeholder council.
The cabinet advocates a reset of the negotiations. Trade agreements must become more sustainable, transparent and inclusive.
Het kabinet pleit voor een reset van de onderhandelingen. Handelsakkoorden moeten duurzamer, transparanter en inclusiever worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dijkgraaf over de oprichting van een internationaal fonds voor abortussen

Two MPs asked why the Dutch government is funding an international abortion fund focused on abortion rather than broader maternal care, and how it will be financed amid budget cuts. Minister Ploumen answered that the initiative promotes women's reproductive rights, that 10 million euro fits within the existing budget, and that the impact of the US Mexico City Policy is still being monitored.
The cabinet makes ten million euro available under the She Decides initiative.
Het kabinet stelt tien miljoen euro beschikbaar in het kader van het initiatief She Decides.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ten Broeke over dreigende antidumpingmaatregelen van Brazilië

MPs Lodders and Ten Broeke asked about Brazil's threatened anti-dumping duties on Dutch chips exports, including whether the Brazilian authorities used improper arguments, whether the measures comply with WTO rules, and what steps the government has taken. The minister answered that the Commission considers the measures insufficiently substantiated, that the Netherlands has lobbied repeatedly through its embassy and the Commission, and that the Commission can challenge the measures at the WTO.
The cabinet shares the European Commission's view that the measures are insufficiently substantiated and motivated.
Het kabinet deelt de lezing van de Europese Commissie dat de maatregelen onvoldoende zijn onderbouwd en gemotiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de positie van vrouwen en meisjes in de watersector

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the disadvantaged position of women and girls in access to and control over water, and about gender analysis, due diligence and protection of women human rights defenders. The minister agreed with the concerns, described existing gender analysis requirements, water strategy commitments, CSR and due diligence efforts, and measures on women human rights defenders.
A condition for approval of all programmes the Netherlands supports, including water, food security and climate, is carrying out a gender analysis.
Voorwaarde voor goedkeuring van alle programma's die Nederland ondersteunt, inclusief water, voedselzekerheid en klimaat, is het uitvoeren van een genderanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het ontslag van 1500 textielwerkers in Bangladesh

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the dismissal of 1,500 garment workers in Bangladesh after a strike for higher minimum wages and the arrest of trade union leaders, and what the government would do on union freedom and living wages. The minister expressed concern, said the embassy raised union rights with Bangladeshi authorities and that the government would discuss the matter with the Bangladesh Accord and Dutch brands, while noting that the Accord focuses on fire and building safety.
The Netherlands emphasised the importance of freedom of association, workers' rights and social dialogue in these discussions.
Nederland heeft het belang van vrijheid van vereniging, de rechten van werknemers en sociale dialoog in deze gesprekken benadrukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over kledingmerken die bijdragen aan lage lonen, lange werktijden, kinderarbeid en schooluitval in Bangladesh

MPs Voordewind and Van Laar asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Branded Childhood report linking clothing brands' low wages and excessive overtime to child labour and school dropout in Bangladesh, and what the government would do about living wages, rising living costs, transparency and wage benchmarks. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to existing actions such as the textile covenant, round tables, a Bangladesh conference and ISEAL benchmark work, and declined to commit to new binding legislation.
Government policy is aimed at voluntarily concluding IMVO covenants.
Het kabinetsbeleid is gericht op het vrijwillig afsluiten van IMVO-convenanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het weren van maatschappelijke organisaties door de Indiase overheid

An MP asked the ministers whether India's freezing of funds and restrictions on NGOs such as Compassion and Navsarjan Trust, and its restrictive Foreign Contributions Regulation Act, were of concern and whether the Netherlands would press India to reverse them. The ministers said they share concern about the Act, have raised it bilaterally and multilaterally, will raise it at the March 2017 consultations and in the EU, and that embassy contact with Compassion is under way.
The Netherlands has made efforts at various levels, in bilateral contacts and multilaterally, to draw attention to this situation and will continue to do so.
Nederland heeft zich op verschillende niveaus in bilaterale contacten en in multilateraal verband ingespannen om aandacht te vragen voor deze situatie en zal dit onverminderd blijven doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de gevolgen van het handelsverdrag tussen de EU en Canada (CETA) en het handelsverdrag voor de handel in diensten (Trade in Services Agreement, TiSA)

Two SP MPs asked the Ministers of Foreign Trade and Finance about financial-sector risks, regulatory room, investor rights, TiSA services liberalisation and ILO standards under CETA and TiSA. The minister answered at length, largely defending the agreements, while committing to continued attention to ILO standards, a Broad Trade Consultation, and quarterly overviews of trade negotiations.
To increase transparency, the cabinet sends the House of Representatives a quarterly overview of all ongoing EU trade agreement negotiations with third countries.
Om de transparantie te vergroten stuurt het kabinet de Tweede Kamer elk kwartaal een overzicht van alle lopende onderhandelingen over handelsakkoorden van de EU met derde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de besteding van belastinggeld aan foute soja

MP Ouwehand asks the minister about public funding for the Round Table on Responsible Soy and the Soy Fast Track Fund, including total spending, reporting on results, and whether funding should end after ten years of limited progress. The minister defends the RTRS standards and the fund, reports Dutch payments of about 6 million euro for phases I and II plus 3 million for phase III, and says the ministry will keep investing in sustainable soy.
This results reporting provides adequate insight into the use of the funds, including in the case of the Soy Fast Track Fund.
Deze resultaatsverantwoording geeft adequaat inzicht in de besteding van de middelen, ook in het geval van het Soy Fast Track Fund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over mensonterende omstandigheden bij de teelt van koffie in Brazilië

MP Thieme asked the minister about reports of slavery-like conditions, child labour, hazardous pesticides and lack of drinking water in Brazilian coffee cultivation, and whether Dutch coffee buyers such as Nestlé and Douwe Egberts were implicated. The minister acknowledged the concerns, relied on due diligence expectations, voluntary IMVO agreements and support for IDH and Solidaridad projects, and said legislation could be considered if voluntary agreements prove insufficient.
In case those agreements lead to insufficient results, other avenues can be considered, including legislation.
In het geval dat die afspraken tot onvoldoende resultaten leiden, kunnen andere wegen worden overwogen, waaronder wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Nederlandse banken die investeren in de aanleg van de omstreden North Dakota oliepijpleiding

An MP asks the government about Dutch banks financing the contested Dakota Access pipeline and whether they should halt the project, respect Sioux rights, stop protest repression, and end fossil fuel lending. The minister answers by citing the OECD guidelines and UN principles, saying banks must use their influence and that the decision on permits and bank relationships is up to the US and the banks themselves, while the government will not take a position against the pipeline.

I expect Dutch banks to use their influence, in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, to prevent and address potential violations.

Ik verwacht van Nederlandse banken dat zij conform de OESO Richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's) hun invloed gebruiken om (potentiële) schendingen te voorkomen en aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Taverne over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over EU-bijstand aan Oekraïne

MPs Ten Broeke and Taverne (VVD) asked about the European Court of Auditors report on EU assistance to Ukraine, including reporting on indicators, repayment options, and measures to strengthen control over EU aid to Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine. The minister welcomed the Court's recommendations, explained the aid framework, conditionality and transparency, and said the EU Association Agreement does not affect member states' decisions on financial aid to Ukraine.
The Netherlands will use the Council discussion of the report to invite the Commission to place greater emphasis on conditionality in programming.
Nederland zal de bespreking in Raadsverband van het rapport aangrijpen om de Commissie uit te nodigen nog meer nadruk te leggen op conditionaliteit in de programmering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar, Voordewind en Dijkgraaf over (kinder)slavernij bij Zuid-Indiase spinnerijen die garens produceren voor westerse kledingmerken

MPs asked the minister about forced and child labour in South Indian spinning mills supplying Western garment brands, referring to a 2016 NGO report, and what the government would do with companies and international bodies. The minister agreed that forced labour is widespread, pointed to OECD due diligence and the Textile Covenant, and described raising the issue with the Indian government and the ILO without committing to a specific new step.
I share the conclusion that forms of slavery occur in many spinning mills.
Ik deel de conclusie dat vormen van slavernij in veel spinnerijen voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de Egyptische ngo-wet en civic space

MP Van Veldhoven asks the government about Egypt's draft NGO law, its restrictions on foreign cooperation and funding, its effect on Dutch NGOs, and the government's response to prosecutions and wider civic space restrictions. The ministers answer that the bill is not yet final, that Dutch concern has been raised bilaterally and in the EU, and that the government views the restrictions as very worrying.
This cannot be confirmed, because the official text of the bill is not yet available.
Dit kan niet worden bevestigd, omdat de officiële tekst van het wetsvoorstel nog niet beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Van Oosten, Kooiman en Van der Staaij over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

Five MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about the documentary on child sex tourism and webcam abuse, including police capacity, investigative powers, Philippine cooperation, liaison staffing and funding. The government answered in detail, describing existing measures, the Plan van Aanpak, the Manila liaison extension and the Down to Zero programme, while declining to commit additional funds or expertise for Philippine police training due to scarce specialised capacity.

Because these efforts require scarce specialised operational police capacity, which would then not be available for investigation in the Netherlands, I am unfortunately forced to be restrained in this regard.

Omdat deze inspanningen de inzet vereisen van schaarse gespecialiseerde operationele capaciteit van de politie, die daardoor niet voor de opsporing in Nederland beschikbaar is, ben ik helaas gedwongen hiermee terughoudend om te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Verhoeven asked the ministers about the documentary 'Grenzeloos misbruikt' on online child sexual abuse, covering police undercover and honeypot powers, use of decoy personas, Philippine cooperation, detection technology like PhotoDNA, and education. The government answered that current law limits deanonymising darknet users, that pending bill Computercriminaliteit III would add powers, that decoy personas are permitted under the Tallon criterion, and described ongoing cooperation and education efforts.
Current legislation offers little to no possibility to de-anonymise users in the relevant environments on the TOR network.
De huidige wetgeving biedt weinig tot geen mogelijkheden om de gebruikers op de bedoelde omgevingen op het TOR-netwerk te de-anonimiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de voorlopige toepassing en ratificatie van het Vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

An MP from the SP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about the provisional application and ratification of the EU-Canada CETA agreement, including which parts are excluded, whether the Council votes by qualified majority, the status of the interpretative declaration, and whether the government will publish texts and meet union demands. The Minister answered that the draft Council decision was published, provisional application excludes specified provisions, the declaration has legal and political value, and all texts will be made public.
Yes. The unrevised treaty text of CETA was already published in September 2014, and the legally-linguistically revised version was published immediately in February 2016.
Ja. De ongereviseerde verdragstekst van CETA is reeds in september 2014 openbaar gemaakt en ook de juridisch-linguïstisch gereviseerde versie is direct openbaar gemaakt in februari 2016.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Laar over de duizenden kinderen die als kindsoldaten worden gebruikt in de Centraal Afrikaanse Republiek

The MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the thousands of child soldiers in the Central African Republic, including estimates, the 2015 peace accord, Dutch support for released children, and funding. The Minister answers that the number is unclear, outlines Dutch financing through EU, VN and humanitarian channels, and states no extra contribution is currently foreseen.
The cabinet currently does not foresee any additional contribution.
Het kabinet voorziet momenteel geen extra bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Jan Vos over het bericht dat waterschappen risicovolle buitenlandse projecten aangaan.

MPs Jacobi and Jan Vos asked about reports that water boards invest in risky foreign projects via the NWB Fund, including coco loans, export credit insurance, OECD guidelines, and the Cali (Colombia) evacuations. The minister answered that water boards do not undertake commercial activities abroad, that the NWB Fund made an AT1 loan to NWB Bank rather than a coco loan, that export credit insurance is unavailable to public bodies, and that the Cali situation is being followed by the embassy.
Under the Decentralised Governments Financing Act (wet FIDO), water boards do not undertake commercial activities abroad.
Conform de Wet Financiering Decentrale Overheden (wet FIDO) ondernemen waterschappen geen commerciële activiteiten in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jan Vos over kinderarbeid en uitbuiting op gecertificeerde palmolieplantages in Indonesië

MPs Van Laar and Jan Vos asked the minister whether certified palm oil plantations in Indonesia using child labour can be called sustainable, how RSPO and due diligence failures should be addressed, and what steps Unilever and Indonesia should take. The minister acknowledged the Amnesty report, said child labour makes palm oil unsustainable, pointed to RSPO complaint mechanisms and OECD contact point options, and committed to talks with Unilever and to working through multi-stakeholder forums and the Indonesian government.
The cabinet is of the view that products made with child labour are not sustainable.
Het kabinet is van mening dat producten die met kinderarbeid tot stand zijn gekomen niet duurzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over vermeende grove schendingen van arbeidsrechten door het Nederlandse bloemenbedrijf Royal Van Zanten in Uganda

Van Laar (PvdA) asked the minister whether the government knew of alleged poisoning, exploitation and sexual harassment of workers at Royal Van Zanten in Uganda, and what it would do. Minister Ploumen answered that Ugandan authorities are investigating, the embassy is facilitating dialogue, the Dutch state is not involved in the company's activities, and consequences depend on the outcome of that investigation.
The cabinet is awaiting the results of this investigation.
Het kabinet wacht de resultaten van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het stoppen van ontwikkelingshulp aan de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government shares concerns that the Palestinian Authority and other Palestinian organisations still receive Dutch and EU funds despite alleged terrorism links, and whether it will stop subsidising antisemitic and anti-Israeli organisations as the UK did. The minister denied any facilitation of terrorism, said the PA should do more to condemn violence and pressed this point, and stated the government will not fund organisations that make antisemitic statements or glorify terror.
There is no question of the Palestinian Authority or other Palestinian organisations supported by the Netherlands or the EU facilitating terrorism.
Er is geen sprake van faciliteren van terrorisme door de Palestijnse Autoriteit of andere door Nederland of de EU gesteunde Palestijnse organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de Verenigde Naties verzaken om de Rohingya in Myanmar te beschermen

An MP asks the Dutch government about leaked UN documents and a documentary suggesting the UN failed to protect the Rohingya in Myanmar, and about reports of intimidation and restricted aid access. The minister answers that the government is concerned, supports UN and NGO work in Rakhine, raised the issues during a visit, and rejects the claim of institutional complicity, while declining to share an internal UN report.
The Netherlands does not have the report. It is an internal report commissioned by the UN.
Nederland beschikt niet over het rapport. Het betreft hier een intern rapport dat in opdracht van de VN is opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat giftige olie vanuit Rotterdam naar Afrika wordt verscheept

Mr. Smaling (SP) asked the state secretary and the minister whether they knew that diesel was being contaminated before export from Rotterdam to Africa, what volumes are involved, whether this is a criminal offence, whether they will raise it at the IMO, and what has been done with the SP's 2013 'Oliezwendel' recommendations. Minister Ploumen replied that the government was unaware of this specific practice, has few details on the trade, sees no current breach of law (the EU fuel quality directive does not cover exports and the waste regulation does not apply), will work through UNEP and regional West African initiatives, deems the IMO inappropriate, and points to earlier letters on fuel adulteration.
Few specific details are available on the import, export and transit (such as origin) of diesel coming from outside Europe.
Er zijn weinig specifieke details beschikbaar over de in-, uit- en doorvoer (zoals de herkomst) van diesel die van buiten Europa afkomstig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het rapport Dirty Diesel

An MP from D66 asked the minister about the Public Eye 'Dirty Diesel' report on high-sulphur diesel exported from Dutch and Belgian ports to West Africa, covering human rights, corporate responsibility, legal instruments, government ties with traders, and aid. The minister answered that no current law blocks such exports, that the Dutch government relies on the OECD guidelines, a NCP investigation and an IMVO covenant effort, and that aid runs mainly through UNEP and the CCAC.
A first scan of existing laws and regulations indicates that there are no legal instruments to prevent the production and/or export of high-sulphur diesel.
Een eerste scan van bestaande wet- en regelgeving wijst erop dat er geen wettelijke instrumenten zijn om de productie en/of export van diesel met een hoog zwavelgehalte tegen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het rapport 'Dirty Diesel – How Swiss Traders Flood Africa with Toxic Fuels'

An MP asked whether the Netherlands should restrict oil blending and trading infrastructure in Rotterdam and Amsterdam that supplies low-quality fuels to West Africa, as reported by Public Eye. The government acknowledged the report, said it would raise the case in the port work programme and ask the NCP to examine OECD guideline implementation, and emphasised a harmonised international approach through UNEP rather than unilateral national rules.

Are you prepared, on the basis of additional research, if necessary, to introduce legislation and regulation that makes it impossible for this infrastructure to still be used to produce and trade fuels

Bent u bereid op basis van aanvullend onderzoek zo nodig met wet- er regelgeving te komen die het onmogelijk maakt dat deze infrastructuur nog gebruikt wordt om brandstoffen te produceren en verhandelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht dat internationale brandstofbedrijven op grote schaal giftige brandstof via Nederlandse havens naar Afrika exporteren

An MP asked the government about reports that international fuel companies export toxic fuel via Dutch ports to Africa, including exported volumes, air pollution, and whether Dutch and international law is violated. The minister answers that no violation of current rules is known, promises an NCP review of the oil and gas sector due in spring 2017, and describes multilateral efforts through UNEP and partnerships on cleaner fuel standards.
At this moment the cabinet has no indications that current legal and regulatory frameworks are being violated.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen aanwijzingen dat in strijd met het huidige kader van wet- en regelgeving wordt gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de tientallen miljoenen die Assad krijgt van de Verenigde Naties

An MP asks why the UN pays tens of millions of dollars in contracts to Assad-regime-linked entities, including a Damascus hotel partly owned by a sanctioned ministry, and whether this undermines UN independence. The ministers answer that cooperation with the regime is a practical necessity for reaching millions in need, that private contracts are separate from aid, that the EU and US sanctions do not cover UN transactions, and that they raise the matter in the ISSG and with the UN.
In the discussion, the Netherlands emphasises the importance of dialogue between humanitarian organisations working in Syria and argues for preserving room to voice criticism.
Nederland benadrukt in de discussie het belang van dialoog tussen humanitaire organisaties werkzaam in Syrië, en pleit voor behoud van ruimte om kritiek te uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over vragen van het lid Van Laar over vermeende invloed van president Assad bij de verstrekking van VN-hulp aan Syriërs

An MP asked the government whether President Assad's influence over UN aid distribution in Syria is acceptable, and whether an exception to the rule of cooperating with host governments should apply. The government answered that the UN must work with the Syrian regime to reach millions in need, acknowledges the dilemmas, supports the UN approach, and will keep parliament informed.
The cabinet will keep you informed of further developments through the usual channels.
Het kabinet zal u via de gebruikelijke wegen op de hoogte houden van verdere ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martin Bosma en Graus over de Clinton Foundation

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands gave over four million euros to the Clinton Foundation's Clinton Development Initiative, what projects were funded, what evaluations exist, whether any funds went to Clinton's campaign, and whether all money was spent. The State Secretary answered at length, listing project results and impact figures, stating the foundation's audited reports show no campaign use, explaining the initiative was taken by the Netherlands within the Alliance for Climate Smart Agriculture, and confirming the funds were spent on the agreed agricultural projects, while sending correspondence and MoUs.
I hereby send you the correspondence leading up to the signing of the MoUs and the MoUs themselves.
Hierbij stuur ik u de correspondentie in de aanloop naar de ondertekening van MoU's en de MoU's zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over misstanden op Indiase theeplantages

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about labour abuses on Rainforest Alliance-certified Indian tea estates supplying Unilever, including demands for a public action plan and a living wage. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to industry initiatives (IDH, TRUSTEA, Team Up India, living wage benchmarks) and to Dutch diplomatic and ILO efforts, without committing to new binding measures.
The cabinet shares the analysis that many improvements have taken place on the tea plantations, but that the work is not yet finished.
Het kabinet deelt de analyse dat er veel verbeteringen hebben plaatsgevonden op de theeplantages, maar dat het werk nog niet af is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over fraude met hulpgoederen voor Syrische vluchtelingen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about suspected fraud with aid goods for Syrian refugees, including how Dutch NGOs responded, whether ministry protocols exist, and whether the Chamber will be informed proactively. The minister said investigations are ongoing, the affected NGOs informed the ministry and tightened procedures, no own investigation is planned, and the Chamber will be informed of conclusions and of fraud involving Dutch funds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de aankondiging door de minister van ‘handelsakkoorden nieuwe stijl’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about 'new style' trade agreements, including how to increase negotiation transparency, address social and sustainability impacts, and apply this to CETA and TTIP, and how product production methods can be treated under WTO rules. The minister replied that the government will publish quarterly overviews of EU trade negotiations, create a Breed Handelsberaad with business, unions and civil society, commission impact studies, and pursue transparency and sustainability provisions, while explaining that WTO non-discrimination rules limit excluding products based on production methods.
To increase transparency in the Netherlands, the cabinet sends the House of Representatives a quarterly overview of all ongoing EU trade agreement negotiations with third countries.
Om de transparantie in Nederland te vergroten stuurt het kabinet de Tweede Kamer elk kwartaal een overzicht van alle lopende onderhandelingen over handelsakkoorden van de EU met derde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Nederlandse bedrijven in India kleding laten produceren onder het minimumloon

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch clothing firms are responsible for sub-contractors in India paying below the legal minimum wage and whether they will be held to account. The minister says firms have due diligence duties under OECD guidelines and a sector covenant, commits to raising the living wage collectively and to the report being put to the firms, but declines to name the factories and leaves enforcement largely to firms and the Indian government.
The cabinet wants to discuss the report 'Uitgekleed-Aangekleed' within the framework of the IMVO covenant for the clothing and textile sector concluded in July.
Het kabinet wil de discussie over het rapport «Uitgekleed-Aangekleed» voeren in het kader van het in juli afgesloten IMVO-convenant voor de kleding- en textielsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het rapport Uitgekleed-Aangekleed

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report documenting exploitation of Indian garment workers supplying Dutch brands, including the companies' responses, complaint options under the textile covenant, the BSCI label, and India's role in living-wage efforts. The Minister acknowledged the situation is unacceptable, pointed to the covenant's due diligence and complaint mechanisms, and said government will raise the matter with companies, BSCI and ILO-linked actors, while stating that factory names were not shared with companies.
The cabinet wants to discuss the report 'Uitgekleed-Aangekleed' within the framework of the IMVO covenant for the clothing and textile sector concluded in July.
Het kabinet wil de discussie over het rapport «Uitgekleed-Aangekleed» voeren in het kader van het in juli afgesloten IMVO-convenant voor de kleding- en textielsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Grashoff over hongerlonen en zeer slechte arbeidsomstandigheden bij Indiase leveranciers aan Nederlandse kledingmerken

MPs Voordewind and Grashoff asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about very low wages and poor working conditions, including gender-based violence, at Indian garment suppliers to Dutch brands, and what the government will do about living wages, pressure on Dutch firms, Indian government engagement and OECD involvement. The minister largely agreed the situation is unacceptable, described Dutch support for living wage action, sectoral agreements, the Fair Wear Foundation programme and planned talks under the textile covenant, and noted that responsibility for enforcement also lies with the Indian government.
The cabinet wants to make agreements with the covenant parties on a roadmap for a living wage in the first quarter of 2017.
Het kabinet wil in het eerste kwartaal van 2017 afspraken maken met de convenantspartijen over de routekaart voor leefbaar loon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over creatie van banen door programma’s voor private sectorontwikkeling

MP Martin Bosma (PVV) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development how the claimed 190,000 jobs created or preserved by private-sector development programmes were achieved, asked for verifiable records and quarterly progress reports, and asked why the government destroys jobs at home while claiming to create them abroad. The Minister confirmed a typo (160,000 target for 2017), said the 190,000 figure is reported in the 2016 results report with direct jobs verified by implementing agencies and FMO, pointed to budget websites and annual reporting, and attributed domestic job growth to fiscal and labour-market measures.

Direct jobs in small and medium enterprises are reported to the ministry by implementing organisations and fund managers and verified by implementing organisations through company visits and/or project evaluation.

Directe banen in het midden- en kleinbedrijf worden door uitvoeringsorganisaties en fondsmanagers aan het ministerie gerapporteerd en geverifieerd door uitvoeringsorganisaties bij bedrijfsbezoek en/of evaluatie van een project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over de gevolgen van de vrijhandelsverdragen met Canada (CETA) en de VS (TTIP) voor asbesthoudende producten

MPs Van Dijk and Smaling asked whether CETA and TTIP could let asbestos-containing products enter the EU market and whether the precautionary principle is weakened. The minister answered that REACH bans asbestos imports, that mutual recognition does not apply to asbestos, that inspection services have adequate powers, and that the precautionary principle is secured in CETA, while Dutch government asked the Commission for a binding declaration.
To clarify matters, the Netherlands has asked the European Commission to also include the precautionary principle for future safety and health measures in a legally binding declaration.

Ter verduidelijking heeft Nederland de Europese Commissie verzocht om het voorzorgsprincipe voor toekomstige veiligheids- en gezondheidsmaatregelen ook op te nemen in een juridisch bindende verklaring
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Gesthuizen over bancaire dienstverlening aan activiteiten van humanitaire organisaties in sanctielanden als Syrië en Rusland

MPs Dijkgraaf and Gesthuizen asked whether Dutch banks are wrongly over-applying sanctions regimes and blocking banking services to humanitarian organisations in Syria and Russia, and whether the government will act. The government replied that banks make their own risk assessments within EU sanctions rules, that humanitarian exemptions can be requested from the Ministry of Finance, that it is in dialogue with banks and will encourage them to facilitate humanitarian organisations, and that a 'white list' idea merits further EU discussion.
The cabinet is in dialogue with the banks on sanctions policy.
Het kabinet is over het sanctiebeleid in dialoog met de banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over vernielingen van de Nederlandse onderneming Esmeralda Farms in Ethiopië

An MP asked whether arson destroyed Esmeralda Farms in Ethiopia, whether other Dutch firms were affected, what drives the unrest and what Ethiopia is doing to protect foreign investors, and whether Dutch firms have a legal basis for compensation. The ministers confirmed major damage, explained the regional grievances and urged reform, said the Ethiopian authorities and investment commission will assess damage and that compensation is primarily a matter for Ethiopian courts or investment insurance, with no basis under the bilateral investment treaty.
The Dutch embassy in Addis Ababa is in close contact with the affected Dutch companies and Ethiopian authorities.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Addis Abeba staat in nauw contact met de Nederlandse getroffen bedrijven en Ethiopische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het binden van handelsconsequenties aan de dolfijnslachtingen en illegale walvisvangst door Japan

The MP Thieme asks whether the government will make an end to Japanese dolphin slaughter in Taiji and illegal whaling a condition in EU trade and partnership negotiations with Japan, and how the minister will act on this during a trade mission. The minister answers that the government opposes dolphin slaughter and all whaling, will state this at the IWC meeting, and supports the Commission's push to address the issue in a sustainability chapter of the trade deal rather than linking it as a formal condition.
The cabinet supports this approach of the European Commission.
Het kabinet steunt deze inzet van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Smaling over het bericht “Nederland faciliteert omstreden bouwproject”

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch-based shell companies facilitate HKND's Nicaragua canal project that allegedly violates human rights and harms the environment, and what the government did about warnings. The government answered that tax authorities cannot assess human rights, that trust offices must screen integrity risks and DNB supervises them but cannot share its findings, that concerns were shared with Nicaragua and Dutch firms, and that Dutch firms should apply due diligence.
Whether TMF Group adequately performed its gatekeeper function in this case is supervisory-confidential information and therefore cannot be shared by DNB.
Of TMF Group in dit geval zijn poortwachterfunctie adequaat heeft uitgevoerd, is toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie en kan derhalve niet door DNB worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over een bezoek van een Turkse minister aan Nederland

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked whether a visiting Turkish minister made inflammatory remarks about Gülen supporters and whether he should be denied entry to the Netherlands. The minister replied that the statements were the Turkish minister's responsibility, that the government had raised concerns with Turkish authorities and that it does not consider entry bans appropriate.
The cabinet does not share that view. We must remain in dialogue with the Turkish authorities.
Het kabinet deelt die opvatting niet. We moeten in gesprek blijven met de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over toegenomen ongelijkheid tussen kinderen in ontwikkelingslanden en roep om stevigere inzet t.b.v. de Werelddoelen over ondervoeding en onderwijs

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about rising inequality among children in developing countries, malnutrition, education gaps and the Sustainable Development Goals. The minister replied that the Netherlands supports nutrition and education programmes and points to results, but gives no new commitments beyond existing initiatives.
Carrying out specific context analyses and setting targets on malnutrition is first and foremost the responsibility of the national governments concerned.
Het uitvoeren van specifieke context analyses en het stellen van doelen op gebied van ondervoeding is op de eerste plaats de verantwoordelijkheid van de betreffende nationale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Agnes Mulder over het achterblijven van de financiering aan maatschappelijke organisaties

MPs Voordewind and Agnes Mulder asked why only about 22% of the 2016 development budget flows through civil society organisations, below the 25% target in their motion, and how the target will be met in 2016 and 2017. Minister Ploumen answered that the percentage is depressed by budget items counted as ODA (such as first-year asylum reception costs), that about 30% would flow via civil society excluding these, that the government aims for 25% without steering the channel mix, and that several programmes will be implemented through civil society organisations.
The cabinet has committed to aim for spending 25% of the ODA budget via civil society.
Het kabinet heeft toegezegd te streven naar besteding van 25% van het ODA-budget via het maatschappelijk middenveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Het gebruik van in Nederland geregistreerde postbusfirma’s voor de ontwijking van internationale sancties door het Assad-regime

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch companies supplied oil to the Assad regime via Panama-registered shell companies, and what action was taken against them and against Staroil B.V. The government answered that a Customs investigation found no breach of the sanctions rules applicable at the time, so no enforcement or prosecution followed, and that it would keep pressing international partners and informing firms about sanctions.
Based on the outcome of the Customs investigation, the Public Prosecution Service decided not to take any further steps regarding enforcement or prosecution.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de Douane heeft het Openbaar Ministerie besloten om verder geen stappen te nemen met betrekking tot handhaving of vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de voorlopige toepassing van het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

An SP MP asked the trade minister about the provisional application of the EU-Canada trade agreement CETA, including whether the government had objected in the trade committee, how it squares with a parliamentary motion, and whether investment court provisions and the whole agreement would be provisionally applied. The minister answered that the government took no position in Brussels until a 14 September debate, that CETA is a mixed agreement so national parliaments can weigh in on all of it, and that the government intends to oppose provisional application of the whole agreement.
Only after the debate with your House on 14 September will the cabinet establish a Dutch position on the provisional application of CETA and advocate it in Brussels.
Pas na het debat met uw Kamer op 14 september zal het kabinet een Nederlands standpunt vaststellen over de voorlopige toepassing van CETA en dit in Brussel uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de negatieve gevolgen van het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP) voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the ministers whether TTIP's tariff cuts on sugar, alcohol and tobacco would harm public health, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that tariff cuts may lower consumer prices, that public health policy space remains under TTIP, and that a full response will follow once Ecorys' final report is published.
Once the final report is published, the cabinet will give a comprehensive response.
Zodra het definitieve rapport is gepubliceerd, zal het kabinet een uitgebreide reactie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP)

MP Teeven asked the Minister for Foreign Trade whether she agreed that TTIP negotiations had effectively failed and how far they had progressed. The minister confirmed the German statement, described the reactions of several member states and the US, and said that conclusion in 2016 is unlikely without major US concessions, while providing a general status update.
On this, the cabinet will send your House a report as usual.
Daarover stuurt het kabinet uw Kamer zoals gebruikelijk een verslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de onderhandelingen over het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP) mislukt zijn

An SP MP asked the trade minister whether TTIP negotiations have effectively failed, whether ISDS/ICS investor protection and European standards are being conceded, and whether the government should abandon the deal. The minister answered that the US must make concessions, that the chapters are interlinked so no agreement exists yet, that European standards are not up for debate, and that the government still supports a balanced deal subject to SER criteria and parliamentary ratification.
The European Council, the European Parliament and the national parliaments will take a final decision, in accordance with the Treaty of Lisbon.
De Europese Raad, het Europees parlement en de nationale parlementen zullen een uiteindelijk besluit nemen, conform het Verdrag van Lissabon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Kenia

MPs Taverne and Ten Broeke asked whether the minister's earlier answers on the Dutch ambassador in Kenya's remarks were complete, and how a 'firm conversation' with the ambassador squares with freedom of expression. The minister answered that the remarks conflicted with aid and trade policy, that a talk with the ambassador took place, and that the matter is closed.
I consider the matter closed with this.
Ik beschouw de kwestie hiermee als afgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het willen weren van seksuele voorlichting op scholen door het Oegandese parlement

Van Laar (PvdA) asked the minister about a reported Ugandan parliamentary resolution to ban sexuality education in schools and publicly burn materials, and about the Dutch response. Minister Ploumen replied that no such resolution was adopted, that Uganda had committed to comprehensive sexuality education, and that quiet diplomacy rather than a public statement is preferred.
The Ugandan parliament did not adopt a resolution calling for sexuality education to be banned from schools and for sexuality education materials to be publicly burned.
Het Oegandese parlement heeft geen resolutie aangenomen waarin wordt opgeroepen seksuele voorlichting op scholen te weren en schoolmateriaal voor seksuele voorlichting publiekelijk te verbranden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over kinderarbeid in de textielsector van Myanmar

An MP asked the minister whether H&M's Myanmar suppliers employing 14-year-olds, working until 22:00, breach ILO norms and Myanmar law, and what the Netherlands is doing about child labour and the 'waterbed effect' in textiles. The minister answered that ILO norms on hours and schooling are breached if structural overtime occurs, that the ILO and EU programmes are the main tools, and that Dutch companies are expected to apply due diligence, though no Dutch textile firms currently operate in Myanmar.
If structural overtime and working hours until 22:00 were actually occurring, that would contradict ILO norms.
Mocht er daadwerkelijk sprake zijn van structureel overwerk en werktijden tot 22.00 uur, dan is dat in tegenspraak met de ILO-normen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over de inzet van Europees ontwikkelingsgeld ten behoeve van buitenlandse krijgsmachten in Afrikaanse landen

MPs asked whether EU development funds would be used to finance foreign armies in African countries, including Sudan's, and whether this is acceptable. The government answered that the Commission proposal would only allow non-ODA funds under the IcSP in exceptional cases, that ODA cannot be used to strengthen foreign armies, that Sudanese army support is not on the table, and that the Netherlands will push to keep development money for development.
Your House will be further informed about this proposal in September via a BNC fiche.
Uw Kamer zal in september nader worden geïnformeerd over dit voorstel via een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het uitblijven van internationale veiligheidsinterventies in Burundi

An MP asked the ministers about the Burundian government's rejection of a UN police force and African Union experts, the options to get them into the country, available UN/AU sanctions, the outcome of an EU visit and the Western position on the stalled dialogue, and measures against food, education and malaria shortages. The ministers answered that the UN force needs Burundi's consent and is for the UN secretariat to negotiate, listed existing sanctions tools while calling suspension of UN membership exceptional, said the EU visit was postponed to September, and described Dutch aid programmes on food, education and malaria.
It is up to the UN secretariat to reach agreement with the Burundian government on a possible solution.
Het is aan het VN-secretariaat om met de Burundese overheid tot overeenstemming te komen over een mogelijke oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat het Transatlantisch Handels- en Investeringspartnerschap (TTIP) mogelijk de klimaatdoelstellingen in gevaar kan brengen

An MP asked the ministers whether the published TTIP negotiating texts could endanger climate targets, including provisions on non-discrimination in energy infrastructure, shale gas imports, Arctic oil and environmental policy space. The government denied that TTIP threatens climate goals, said renewable priority rules remain possible, and pointed to explicit policy-space and climate cooperation provisions.
TTIP creates no obstacle to taking measures to protect the environment.
TTIP creëert geen belemmering voor het nemen van maatregelen ter bescherming van het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het stoppen van kindhuwelijken in Tanzania

An MP asked the minister about the Tanzanian government's appeal against a High Court ruling that child marriage under 18 is unconstitutional, whether the Netherlands had responded, and how it could promote an end to child marriage. The minister said no formal appeal had yet been lodged and the Netherlands would monitor developments with EU partners and consider further support depending on the grounds of appeal.
Formally, there is not yet an appeal.
Formeel is er nog geen sprake van een hoger beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Smaling over de kwetsbare positie van vrouwen bij landregistratieprojecten in onder andere Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Smaling asked whether a Dutch-supported land registration pilot in Ngozi, Burundi, left women with fewer land claims, whether gender analysis should precede such projects, and how gender inequality features in land registration projects. The minister acknowledged Dutch support, said about 95% of registered parcels in Ngozi are in men's names and that some customary women's rights risk erosion, and argued that gender analysis must be integral to such projects and that Nederland continues to support land registration where women's inheritance rights are not legally codified.
It is estimated that before the registration process, about 10% of parcels in the area were subject to such a right exercised by a woman.
Naar schatting werd voorafgaand aan het registratieproces op ongeveer 10% van de percelen in het betreffende gebied een dergelijk recht uitgeoefend door een vrouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Sjoerdsma over de situatie van jonge Syrische vluchtelingen in Libanon

MPs Van Veldhoven and Sjoerdsma asked the minister about the hopelessness and reported suicidal feelings among young Syrian refugees in Lebanon, the funding of UNICEF education centres, and what the Netherlands is doing on psychosocial care. The minister acknowledged the situation, said suicide figures could not be verified, described psychosocial care and education funding commitments, and said the government is in ongoing dialogue with Lebanese authorities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not have its own figures on suicidal tendencies among young Syrian refugees in Lebanon or other countries in the region.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken beschikt niet over eigen cijfers ten aanzien van zelfmoordneigingen onder jonge Syrische vluchtelingen in Libanon of andere landen in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Thieme over het informeren van de Kamer over de ambities inzake TAFTA

MPs Van Dijk and Thieme asked why the government did not inform parliament about its ambitions for TAFTA/TTIP, including full liberalisation and the claim that failure was not an option. The minister replied that parliament was kept informed through regular letters and committee debates on the Dutch position, and that the Commission now proposes CETA as a mixed agreement, which meets the Dutch demand.
The House was informed of the Dutch position through the usual methods.
De Kamer is volgens de gebruikelijke methodes geïnformeerd over de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Kenia

MPs Taverne and Ten Broeke asked the minister whether she would hold a firm talk with the Dutch ambassador to Kenya over remarks in a ViceVersa interview and whether ambassadors should fear such talks when their observations diverge from ministerial policy. The minister confirmed the interview, said ambassadors are the ministry's eyes and ears and may publicly promote policy, and admitted that remarks deviating from Dutch policy prompted a conversation with the ambassador.
In the interview you cite, various remarks were made that deviate from the Dutch position. This was the reason for a conversation with the ambassador concerned.
In het door u aangehaalde interview zijn diverse opmerkingen gemaakt die afwijken van de Nederlandse inzet. Dit is aanleiding geweest voor een gesprek met de betreffende ambassadeur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over de vrijheid van meningsuiting van ambassadeurs

An MP asked whether the Dutch ambassador in Kenya deserves praise for speaking out about wasteful aid, why he faces a 'firm talk', and how much aid went to Kenya. The minister said ambassadors are encouraged to speak publicly, that the ambassador was spoken to because his remarks deviated from Dutch policy, and gave aid figures and programme outcomes while declining to say the money is recoverable and rejecting the praise.
In the interview you cite, various remarks were made that deviate from the Dutch position. This gave cause for a conversation with the ambassador concerned.
In het door u aangehaalde interview zijn diverse opmerkingen gemaakt die afwijken van de Nederlandse inzet. Dit is aanleiding geweest voor een gesprek met de betreffende ambassadeur.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het rapport 'Beauty and a Beast, Child labour in India for sparkling cars and cosmetics’ van SOMO en Terre des Hommes over kinderarbeid in mica-mijnen in India

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the SOMO and Terre des Hommes report on child labour in Indian mica mines, including rising child labour numbers, due diligence by Dutch companies, monitoring and support for local organisations. The minister acknowledged the problem, said Dutch firms must apply OECD due diligence, pointed to IMVO covenant talks and Dutch-supported child labour projects in India, but gave no clear explanation for the rise in child workers and no binding monitoring or sanctions commitment.

The cabinet is of the view that child labour in this kind of sector belongs to the worst forms of child labour and that Dutch companies must carry out due diligence to ensure they do not contribute to it.

Het kabinet is van mening dat kinderarbeid in dit soort sectoren tot de ergste vormen van kinderarbeid behoort en dat Nederlandse bedrijven hun due diligence moeten uitvoeren om te zorgen dat ze hieraan niet bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Grashoff over het terugsturen van vluchtelingen naar Eritrea

MPs Voortman and Grashoff asked the government about the UN Commission of Inquiry on Eritrea, EU and Dutch development aid to Eritrea, reports of Eritreans being returned from Sudan, and Sudan's border assistance under the Khartoum process. The government answered that it supports ICC referral only via the UN Security Council, keeps Eritrea in the DGGF and backs an EU programme with conditions, deems Sudanese returns possible refoulement, and says aid to Eritrean and Sudanese border authorities will be monitored and kept restrained without commitment to new binding limits.
The Netherlands will also oversee this via its involvement in the EUTF and will also work for restrained use of EU ODA funds for border control in this context.
Nederland zal hiertoe via betrokkenheid bij het EUTF ook op toezien en zich eveneens inzetten voor een terughoudend gebruik van EU ODA-middelen voor grensbewaking in dit kader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over de doelstelling van de International Labour Organisation (ILO) om uiterlijk in 2016 de ergste vormen van kinderarbeid uit te bannen

Two MPs (Voordewind and Van Laar) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the ILO goal to eliminate the worst forms of child labour by 2016 and what the Netherlands and the Initiative Sustainable Trade (IDH) have done to achieve it. The minister acknowledged the goal is not yet met, listed new Dutch measures such as a child labour fund and EU Council conclusions, and described IDH programmes and lessons learned.
The figure of 168 million children comes from the ILO report 'Global child labour trends 2008 to 2012'.
Het cijfer van 168 miljoen kinderen stamt uit het ILO-rapport «Global child labour trends 2008 to 2012».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en van Laar over de discrepantie tussen het door banken gestelde beleid met betrekking tot arbeidsrechten en de misstanden in de kleding- en elektronicasector

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a gap between banks' stated policies on labour rights and abuses in the garment and electronics sectors, and what the government will do about it. The minister said the banks' policies are largely adequate but their practice (engagement with clients) needs improvement, and that a responsible-business covenant with the banking sector, which the government supports, is expected to be signed after the summer.
It is expected that the covenant will be signed after the summer.
Het is de verwachting dat het convenant na de zomer ondertekend zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over aan Jordanië verkochte F-16’s

The MP De Roon asked how many F-16s the Netherlands sold to Jordan, whether they are operational, whether external inspections are possible, and whether they were resold to Pakistan. The government answered that 21 were sold (6 delivered), the six delivered are still in use, post-shipment controls are complex but the Dutch ambassador confirmed with Jordan that no resale to Pakistan will occur.
Post-shipment controls are a complex matter, because the Netherlands has no jurisdiction in the country of end use.
Controles na levering ( post shipment controls ) zijn een complexe zaak, omdat Nederland geen jurisdictie in het land van eindgebruik heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een verbod op de anti-Israëlische Boycot, Desinvestering en Sancties (BDS)-beweging

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether publicly funded bodies should be banned from boycotting Israeli products, whether the ANBI status of BDS-linked organisations such as docP should be revoked, and about reported supermarket patrols. The minister answered that consumers may investigate product origins, that ANBI status is granted and revoked only by the Tax Authority under neutral criteria, and that no ban on boycotts is planned.
The cabinet has no power to revoke a granted ANBI status.
Het kabinet heeft geen bevoegdheid om een verleende ANBI-status in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Veldhoven over import en inkoop van steenkool

An MP asked the minister about the coal covenant, the situation of victims of human rights abuses in the Colombian coal sector, Prodeco/Drummond supply relations, European market shares, and an Amsterdam motion on blood coal. The minister answered by describing Bettercoal audits, OECD cooperation, transitional justice efforts in Colombia, DONG's no-longer-current Prodeco purchases, EU import figures, and the government's encouragement of corporate due diligence, while stating substitution effects are unknown.
As laid down in the coal covenant, progress on implementing the covenant will be reported in more detail in the third quarter of each year.
Conform vastgelegd in het steenkoolconvenant zal in het derde kwartaal van ieder jaar nader gerapporteerd worden over de voortgang van de implementatie van het convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Gesthuizen over uitblijven van genoegdoening aan (indirecte) slachtoffers van mijnbouwactiviteiten in Colombia

MPs Jan Vos and Gesthuizen asked whether the government would urge Dutch energy firms to halt coal purchases from Colombian suppliers linked to paramilitary violence until victims receive redress, and how it would address victims' access to remedy in the peace process. The minister answered that the government favours an inclusive transitional justice approach within the FARC peace deal, encourages companies to use supplier leverage and due diligence rather than suspension, and says the Cesar victims exploration will not proceed because the peace agreement is now the vehicle.
The cabinet encourages energy companies to use their trading relationship with mining companies to achieve these improvements, so that the option of temporary suspension does not have to be invoked.

Het kabinet moedigt de energiebedrijven aan om hun handelsrelatie met de mijnbouwbedrijven in te zetten voor deze verbeteringen om te voorkomen dat de optie van een tijdelijke opschorting ingeroepen moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over windmolens in Kenia

An SP MP asks the minister about the Lake Turkana wind park in Kenya: Dutch financing, recognition of nomadic land rights and indigenous status, consultation, jobs, the power purchase price, the World Bank's exit, and possible corruption. The minister answers that FMO and a Dutch ministry subsidy are involved, that the lease is registered and was confirmed by the national land commission, that the World Bank judged the risk too high, and that no signs of corruption were received.
The cabinet has received no signals from the parties involved in the Lake Turkana Wind Project that this is the case.
Het kabinet heeft van betrokken partijen bij het Lake Turkana Wind Project geen signalen ontvangen dat dit het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Dijkgraaf, Jasper van Dijk, Bruins, De Roon en Grashoff over de voorlopige toepassing van het vrijhandelsverdrag met Canada (CETA)

MPs asked whether Netherlands had an effective veto over provisional application of the Ukraine association agreement and would have one over provisional application of CETA, and requested legal advice on provisional application. The minister confirmed unanimity applied for the association agreement, said CETA's voting rule depends on the legal basis not yet determined, and stated the government knows of no written legal advice received on provisional application.
Whether decision-making on signature and provisional application of CETA will be by unanimity or qualified majority depends on the legal basis.
Of besluitvorming over ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van CETA zal geschieden met unanimiteit of gekwalificeerde meerderheid is afhankelijk van de rechtsgrondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over beperkte toegankelijkheid van de websites van Nederlandse ambassades voor het maatschappelijk middenveld in Senegal, Mozambique en Burundi

An MP asked why embassy websites in Senegal, Mozambique and Burundi offer funding information for local organisations only in Dutch, and whether they would add English, French or local-language versions and track application language. The minister replied that Dakar and Bujumbura sites already have French versions and Maputo has English, that embassies do not systematically track applications, that no applications have yet come via the websites, and that no pilot for local languages is planned.
Applications for funds are submitted by email, by post or in person.
Aanvragen voor fondsen worden per email, per post of in persoon ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jasper van Dijk over het geweld rondom het Agua Zarca project in Honduras en de vermeende betrokkenheid van de Nederlandse ontwikkelingsbank FMO

MPs Van Laar and Jasper van Dijk asked about violence around the Agua Zarca project in Honduras, alleged FMO involvement, and the investigation into the murder of activist Berta Cáceres. The minister said the government was shocked, FMO was withdrawing from the project, and it had urged Honduran authorities to accept IACHR involvement, while the fact-finding and broader accountability questions remain under review.
The government considers it crucial to have the facts clearly established and has therefore given relevant stakeholders the opportunity to share their views on the project.
Het kabinet vindt het cruciaal de feiten goed op een rij te hebben en heeft daarom betrokken stakeholders de mogelijkheid gegeven om hun visie op het project te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de investeringsbeschermingsverdragen tussen EU-lidstaten

An SP MP asked whether the Netherlands is seeking EU-wide support for ISDS arbitration so that European investors can bypass national courts, and why the government opposes terminating intra-EU BITs. The minister denied seeking ISDS, said the Netherlands is exploring orderly termination of intra-EU BITs with alternatives such as a permanent investment court, and gave no concrete commitment beyond continued analysis.
No, on the contrary. The article in NRC refers to a discussion on the future of bilateral investment protection agreements between EU member states.
Nee, integendeel. Het bewuste artikel in de NRC verwijst naar een discussie over de toekomst van bilaterale investeringsbeschermingsovereenkomsten tussen EU-lidstaten onderling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over levering van 'dual use' goederen

MPs Hachchi and Sjoerdsma asked whether Imtech/Radio Holland supplied dual-use goods to Iran, Cuba, Syria and South Sudan in breach of sanctions, and what the government would do to prevent it. The minister replied that Customs found the shipments were not dual-use, not subject to Dutch or EU licensing, and not in breach of Dutch or EU law, so no change to export control enforcement is planned.
Based on this case, the cabinet sees no need to adjust the enforcement of export controls.
Op basis van deze casus ziet het kabinet geen noodzaak om de handhaving van de exportcontrole aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over onderzoek naar de export van goederen door RH Marine Group

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked about a customs investigation into possibly illegal exports of goods by RH Marine Group (former Imtech Marine), including whether licences were required and whether defence projects are affected. The minister replied that customs found no breach of Dutch or European law, that the violations concerned US sanctions and were settled with a warning, and that there are no consequences for defence projects.
The customs investigation shows that RH Marine Group (formerly Imtech Marine) did not violate Dutch or European legislation.
Het onderzoek van de Douane wijst uit dat RH Marine Group (voormalig Imtech Marine) geen Nederlandse of Europese wetgeving heeft overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk, Dijkgraaf, Grashoff, De Roon, Jan Vos en Agnes Mulder over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het handelsakkoord tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

Seven MPs asked the trade minister whether the Commission's plan to provisionally apply the EU-Canada CETA would be put to parliament, how the parliamentary reservation demanded by an earlier motion would be implemented, and whether CETA will be a mixed agreement.
