The minister answered that the Commissioner's commitment to consult the European Parliament is noted, that the government will formally register a parliamentary reservation in the Council once a proposal is tabled and inform the Tweede Kamer promptly, and that which parts would apply provisionally is not yet known.

If the Commission has submitted a proposal for a Council decision on signature and provisional application, the cabinet will formally implement the motion by stating in the Council that the Netherlands cannot agree to the proposal before it has been discussed with the House of Representatives.

Als de Commissie een voorstel heeft gedaan voor een Raadsbesluit voor ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing, zal het kabinet formeel uitvoering geven aan de motie door in de Raad kenbaar te maken dat Nederland niet kan instemmen met het voorstel voordat het voorstel is besproken met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het EU-Vietnam vrijhandelsverdrag

MPs Jasper van Dijk asked the minister about the labour, human rights and investment-court (ICS) implications of the EU-Vietnam free trade agreement, including its effects on Vietnamese industries and worker protections. The minister answered that impact studies show mixed economic effects, that existing ILO and EU mechanisms monitor labour rights, and that the ICS model mirrors the EU's TTIP proposal with safeguards for public policy.
The cabinet will soon respond to the SER advice.
Het kabinet zal spoedig een reactie op het SER-advies geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over TTIP Leaks

An SP MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade whether leaked TTIP documents show US business influence over EU decision-making, eroded standards and absent precautionary principle, and what the state of negotiations is on investment protection, regulatory cooperation, financial services and public debate. The minister rejects undue business influence, insists standards and the precautionary principle are preserved and regulatory policy space is protected, notes ongoing negotiations on investment court systems, and declines to share unpublished consolidated texts beyond the reading room.
Publication would harm the EU's negotiating position and therefore also the interests of the Netherlands.
Openbaarmaking schaadt de onderhandelingspositie van de EU en daarmee ook de belangen van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over Burundese vluchtelingen en het voortdurend vermoorden van (vermeende) tegenstanders van president Nkurunziza in en buiten Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about escalating violence in Burundi, refugees being attacked in camps abroad, shortages in refugee camps, and Dutch and EU responses. The ministers answered that Dutch and EU pressure, sanctions, suspended direct budget aid and support for a regional dialogue continue, and that Dutch humanitarian funding and a 1 million euro contribution for the Mahama camp were provided, while the AU observer deployment is delayed.
Because of the violence and the poorly conducted elections, the Netherlands suspended direct aid to Burundi in 2015.
Vanwege het geweld en de slecht verlopen verkiezingen heeft Nederland in 2015 de directe hulp aan Burundi opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over (onder)voeding

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the UN Decade of Action on Nutrition, a new investment framework, the investment needed to end global undernutrition, the balance between people, planet and profit in food security policy, and Dutch representation at the WHA and Nutrition for Growth summit. The minister answered each question, committing to letters to the House on the investment results and policy balance, while noting the Nutrition for Growth summit's date is uncertain and no invitation has been received.
Your House will be informed further about this in the letter promised during the Food Security committee meeting of 27 January.
Uw Kamer zal daarover nader worden geïnformeerd in de brief die is toegezegd tijdens het AO Voedselzekerheid van 27 januari jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Servaes over het Amnesty-rapport 'WK Voetbal Qatar: FIFA negeert uitbuiting arbeidsmigranten'

MPs Van Dekken and Servaes asked the ministers about Amnesty's report on exploitation of migrant workers building Qatar 2022 World Cup venues, FIFA's inaction, and Qatar's sponsorship system. The ministers acknowledged serious abuses remain, pointed to EU-level pressure on FIFA and Qatar, the ILO mission and complaint process, and the EU Presidency's integrity agenda, without committing to new binding steps.
The cabinet will therefore continue to press for improvements in the position of migrant workers in talks with Qatar and business.
Het kabinet zal zich daarom in de gesprekken met Qatar en het bedrijfsleven blijven inzetten voor de verbetering van de positie van arbeidsmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over een mogelijk referendum aangaande TTIP

MP Klein asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a website calling for a referendum on the EU trade deals with the US (TTIP) and Canada (CETA), disputing claims of secret negotiations, lack of democratic control, regulatory cooperation, investor arbitration and the referendum's availability. The Minister answered that negotiations carry normal confidentiality but documents are published and parliamentarians have reading-room access, that parliament is involved through debates and motions, that investment protections preserve state policy space, and that CETA and TTIP would be referendable if handled as mixed agreements, with the timing left open.
In addition, Dutch and European parliamentarians have access to all EU negotiating documents, most of which are now also public, and to all consolidated negotiating texts in the reading rooms.

Daarnaast hebben Nederlandse en Europese parlementariërs toegang tot alle EU-onderhandelingsdocumenten, waarvan de meeste inmiddels ook voor het publiek openbaar zijn, en tot alle geconsolideerde onderhandelingsteksten in de leesruimtes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over subsidiegelden

An MP asks how much the central government paid in 2014, 2015 and 2016 to environmental and nature organisations (Greenpeace, Milieudefensie, Natuur en Milieu, Urgenda, Sea Shepherd, IUCN, Wakker Dier), what they do with it, whether they also receive Postcode Loterij funds, and whether government funding of groups that protest against the government is appropriate. The government answers with detailed subsidy tables per organisation and project, notes that Postcode Loterij grants are not accounted to the state, and states that protest against government conduct is possible within the uniform subsidy framework.
Government subsidy payments are published as open data via Rijksbegroting.nl.
De subsidiebetalingen van de rijksoverheid worden gepubliceerd als open data via Rijksbegroting.nl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het schrijnende gebrek aan goede psychologische zorg in Indonesië

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Indonesia's failure to provide adequate psychological care, the abuses (including chaining) documented by Human Rights Watch, and whether Netherlands should help Indonesia through training, twinning or EU initiatives. The minister said the findings are worrying, that Indonesia has not requested Dutch assistance, and that the Dutch embassy is exploring support for initiatives strengthening people with mental health conditions.
It is the responsibility of the Indonesian government to protect people with a psychological condition and to meet its international obligations.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Indonesische overheid om bescherming te bieden aan mensen met een psychologische aandoening en aan haar internationale verplichtingen te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen over Subsidie voor ontwikkelingsprojecten van Heineken in Afrika

Two MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Dutch subsidies to Heineken development partnerships in Africa, including additionality, job losses, tax avoidance, water use and alcohol promotion. The minister defended the partnerships, said additionality is assessed by market conditions rather than a mathematical test, and rejected repayment, committing to no concrete new action.
Additionality of the government contribution is a condition for a partnership with the business sector.
Additionaliteit van de overheidsbijdrage is een voorwaarde voor een partnerschap met het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar, Jasper van Dijk, Van Veldhoven, Voordewind, Grashoff, Dijkgraaf, Thieme over het gebrek aan bescherming van Syrische kinderen

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about the lack of protection for Syrian children, including the petition and reports by UNICEF, Save the Children, War Child and World Vision, and what the Netherlands does on education, psychosocial aid and school protection. The minister answered that Dutch funding for education and psychosocial support in Syria and neighbouring countries is ongoing, that it supports the call to honour pledges, and that it will raise school protection and MHPSS at the EU and World Humanitarian Summit, but gave few figures on outcomes and no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands is working within international frameworks to ensure that the pledges are also honoured.
Nederland zet zich in internationaal verband in om ervoor te zorgen dat de toezeggingen ook worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse subsidie voor antisemitisme- en terreurverheerlijking

Two Dutch MPs asked whether the government funds the Palestinian NGO RWDS, which held events honouring a terrorist, and whether it will stop indirect subsidies to organisations promoting antisemitism and terrorism. The minister confirmed past funding of RWDS (about 460,000 euro and 104,852 euro via Oxfam Novib), denied any support for the event, and said the government will not fund such organisations and will suspend or end grants if subsidy conditions are breached, though it did not commit to a specific new stop or the requested EU/UN initiative.
If, however, it is established that an organisation has breached the subsidy conditions, measures will be taken, including suspending or ending the contribution.

Indien evenwel geconstateerd wordt dat er sprake is van schending van de subsidievoorwaarden door een organisatie, zullen maatregelen worden getroffen, waarbij het opschorten of beëindigen van de bijdrage tot de mogelijkheden behoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over de nalatigheid van de Europese Commissie bij het uitvoeren van mensenrechtenanalyses bij handelsverdragen

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers about the European Commission's failure to carry out a human rights analysis for trade agreements, including the delayed TiSA impact study and the EU-Vietnam FTA. The ministers answered that the Commission has committed to including human rights in future Sustainability Impact Assessments, that the Netherlands will push this during its EU presidency, and that the EU-Vietnam agreement already contains human rights links.
Following the Ombudsman's call, one of these ambitions concerns including a human rights analysis in the usual Sustainability Impact Assessments.
In navolging van de oproep van de Ombudsman betreft één van deze ambities het opnemen van een mensenrechtenanalyse in de gebruikelijke Sustainability Impact Assessments.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over landrechten

MPs Van Dijk and Smaling asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the murder of land-rights activist Berta Cáceres in Honduras, FMO's financing of the Agua Zarca dam, and Dutch land-rights policy. The Minister responded that the Netherlands has called for prosecution of the perpetrators, FMO has temporarily suspended financing pending investigation, and the government will sharpen land-rights policy and draft an action plan implementing the Smaling motion.
Pending the results of the investigation into local conditions at the Agua Zarca project, FMO has temporarily halted financing.
In afwachting van de resultaten van het onderzoek naar de lokale omstandigheden bij het Agua Zarca project heeft FMO de financiering tijdelijk stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over het bericht dat mensenrechtenactiviste Berta Cáceres is vermoord in Honduras

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers how the government would respond to the murder of Honduran activist Berta Cáceres, how it would monitor Honduras's human rights efforts, what steps it had taken regarding FMO's involvement in a dam project, and how it would address the protection of human rights defenders. The ministers answered that the government condemned the killing, had the ambassador raise investigation demands with Honduran authorities, pressed FMO on land rights and transparency, and outlined existing human rights defender protection programmes.
The government regularly speaks with FMO about its investment policy.
Het kabinet spreekt regelmatig met FMO over haar investeringsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Iraanse luchtvaartmaatschappij Mahan Air

An MP asked the ministers about US sanctions on Iranian airline Mahan Air, whether it operates in the Netherlands and links to Aviareps, and whether EU sanctions exist and why the airline should not be banned from the Netherlands. The minister replied that the US sanctions are a US sovereign matter, Mahan Air is not active in the Netherlands, Aviareps is a service provider, EU sanctions require unanimity and lacked support, and no action is needed since the airline is not active here.
Het instellen van sancties vergt unanimiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over kritische rapporten over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij de verbreding van het Egyptische Suezkanaal

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked ministers about critical reports (SOMO and One World) alleging that Dutch dredging firms and the state-backed export credit insurer Atradius DSB failed to apply due-diligence standards to the Suez Canal widening, and whether commercial interests outweighed human and environmental rights. The government rejects the conclusion that economic interests prevailed, says it gathered sufficient information for an environmental and social assessment, and explains the differing findings of the SOMO report and the Witteveen & Bos study.
The cabinet has taken good note of the SOMO report in question and takes its observations and findings seriously.
Het kabinet heeft goede nota genomen van het betreffende SOMO-rapport en de observaties en bevindingen nemen wij serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de voorlichting aan Nederlandse ondernemers over problemen met kinderarbeid in Oekraïne

The MP Thieme asks why RVO.nl removed a warning to Dutch entrepreneurs about child labour in Ukraine's agriculture and construction sectors shortly before the April 2016 referendum, and whether the government will pressure Ukraine on child labour. The minister answers that the text was outdated (dating from 2009), removed autonomously by RVO during routine updating ahead of a trade mission, with no political pressure, and that the text has since been updated and republished while Ukraine will be engaged on labour standards through the Association Agreement and OECD channels.
In an update round for the CSR texts it was found that the information dates from 2009.
In een actualisatieronde voor de MVO-teksten is geconstateerd dat informatie dateert uit 2009.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de berichten dat Nederland en Europa een grote rol spelen in de illegale dierenhandel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Netherlands and Europe play a major role in illegal wildlife trade, including enforcement capacity, penalties, international cooperation and aid to African countries. The government replied that Dutch enforcement capacity is sufficient, penalties are substantial, and it is pursuing CITES, EU and aid-based measures, while rejecting claims of inadequate capacity.
In my view the Netherlands' efforts in this area are good and I am making sufficient resources available for them.
Naar mijn oordeel is de inzet van Nederland op dit terrein goed en maak ik daar voldoende middelen voor vrij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over hulp aan vrouwelijke en minderjarige slachtoffers van ontvoeringen door Boko Haram

MP Van Laar asked the minister about aid to female and underage victims of Boko Haram abductions in Nigeria, their stigmatisation, and the embassy's role. The minister said the findings are known, listed existing Dutch-funded and multilateral psychosocial programmes, and said the problem is that aid does not always reach the group rather than a lack of aid.
Where possible we draw attention to this problem, for example via the Dutch embassy in Abuja, our contacts with international aid organisations and our input into the policy process in Brussels.

Waar mogelijk vestigen we de aandacht op dit probleem, bijvoorbeeld via de Nederlandse ambassade in Abuja, onze contacten met de internationale hulporganisaties en onze inbreng in het beleidsproces in Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de oplopende tekorten aan voedselhulp in Ethiopië

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about looming food aid shortfalls in Ethiopia, including Dutch steps, EU coordination, donor conferences, refugee migration and lessons from the delayed Ethiopian appeal. The Minister answered in detail, describing Dutch contributions of EUR 5m to the CHF, EUR 8.6m via the DRA, EUR 8m to WFP and FAO, EU and UN funding, and a refugee programme, while declining to convene a donor conference for now.
However, the Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation and calls on other countries to also contribute substantially.
Nederland blijft echter de situatie nauwlettend volgen en roept andere landen op ook substantieel bij te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het voorzorgsbeginsel in de onderhandelingen tussen de EU en de VS over TTIP

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister whether the EU's precautionary principle will be preserved in the TTIP trade negotiations with the US, citing US negotiators' statements that risk assessments could be harmonised and that the EU should rely more on US assessments. The minister replies that the precautionary principle is not up for discussion in TTIP, that regulatory cooperation does not mean adopting each other's standards, and that the Commission publishes reports on each negotiating round.
The precautionary principle is not up for discussion in TTIP.
Het voorzorgsbeginsel staat niet ter discussie in TTIP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Nieuw rapport: ‘Europese boeren kansloos door TTIP’

An SP MP asked the government about a report claiming TTIP would harm European farmers, including unfair competition from US livestock producers and pressure toward GMO feed and higher pesticide residue limits. The minister replied that the study's assumptions are unrealistic, that EU health, environment and animal welfare standards are not up for negotiation, and that the Netherlands is pursuing tariff exclusions for sensitive sectors while noting the EU does not plan to label products from animals fed GMO feed.

This assumption is not realistic given that the cabinet, the European Commission and the Council have repeatedly confirmed that European standards protecting human, plant, animal and environmental health are not up for discussion in TTIP.

Deze aanname is niet realistisch gezien het kabinet, de Europese Commissie en de Raad herhaaldelijk hebben bevestigd dat de Europese standaarden ter bescherming van mens, plant, dier en milieu door TTIP niet ter discussie staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over dreigende hongersnood in Zuidelijk Afrika als gevolg van El Niño en het tekort aan klimaatfinanciering

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked about the food crisis in Southern Africa caused by El Niño, the case for early action and climate finance. Minister Ploumen answered that the government has provided emergency aid through several channels, supports resilience programmes, and will press donors and promote climate finance, without addressing any oversight of the executive.
The cabinet closely follows the situation around El Niño and is aware of the effects of El Niño in Southern Africa.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie rond El Niño nauwlettend en is zich bewust van de effecten van El Niño in Zuidelijk Afrika
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een rapport over import door IS van onderdelen voor de productie van IED’s (Improvised Explosive Devices- geïmproviseerde bommen)

Parliamentary member Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether the government shares concern about a report showing IS imports components for IEDs from many countries including the Netherlands, and what export controls could stop this. The ministers answer that most goods have civilian uses and are not export-controlled, that the Dutch-origin hydrogen peroxide was legally sold, and they point to new EU and national precursor rules and talks with other EU countries.

Therefore, within the National Counterterrorism Strategy and the Integrated Approach to Jihadism Action Programme, measures have been taken to limit the availability of raw materials for explosives and to oblige companies to report suspicious transactions.

Daarom zijn binnen de Nationale Contraterrorisme strategie en het Actieprogramma Integrale Aanpak Jihadisme maatregelen genomen om de beschikbaarheid van grondstoffen voor explosieven te beperken en bedrijven te verplichten om verdachte transacties te melden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over investeringsbescherming (Investor-State Dispute Settlement, ISDS) in het associatieakkoord met Oekraïne

MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether Article 89(2) of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, which mentions investment protection and investor-state dispute settlement, opens the door to ISDS and whether the passage would be dropped after the referendum. Minister Ploumen answered that the agreement contains no investor-state dispute mechanism, that ISDS is ruled out for the Netherlands, and that the cabinet will not anticipate the referendum outcome.
The Association Agreement with Ukraine contains no mechanism for the settlement of disputes between an investor and a state.
Het associatieakkoord met Oekraïne bevat geen mechanisme voor de beslechting van geschillen tussen een investeerder en een staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Europese Commissie voorspelt economische groei voor Oekraïne op basis van gedateerd onderzoek”

An SP MP asked the ministers whether outdated economic studies (Ecorys, German advisory group) still justify the EU-Ukraine association agreement given the conflict since 2013, and about its effects on prices and Ukrainian firms. The government replied that the CGE-based studies remain relevant, a new analysis is informative but not necessary, and the agreement is a sovereign Ukrainian choice with a ten-year phase-in and SME support.
In that sense, the cabinet considers a new analysis informative but not necessary for its assessment of the effects of the association agreement.
In die zin acht het kabinet een nieuwe analyse informatief, maar niet noodzakelijk voor het oordeel over de effecten van het associatieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de omstreden handelsverdragen met Canada (CETA) en de VS (TTIP)

An SP MP asks the trade minister about CETA and TTIP: whether member states are losing control, the German judges' objections, provisional application before parliamentary approval, ISDS/ICS arbitration risks (including the TransCanada Keystone claim), and regulatory chill. The minister rejects most concerns, says the investment court system is being adopted in CETA and TTIP, and commits to no new concrete action beyond continued parliamentary consultation.
The Netherlands does not comment on pending cases.
Nederland laat zich niet uit over lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Belhaj over mensenhandel in Djibouti

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports of human trafficking and prostitution of young girls in Djibouti, including whether Dutch soldiers could contribute, and about Dutch use of the US trafficking classification and its human-rights stance toward Djibouti. The ministers answered that no Dutch soldiers are stationed there, that the Netherlands does not use its own classification system, and that bilateral relations with Djibouti are limited and indirect.
Our country has no classification system of its own.
Ons land heeft geen eigen classificatiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het bericht Syrian refugees in Turkish garment supply chains: An analysis of company action to address serious exploitation

MP Van Laar asked the minister whether companies are doing enough to prevent exploitation of Syrian refugees, including children, in Turkish garment supply chains, and what the government will do about it. The minister said the government expects buyers to investigate their Turkish supply chains, noted new Turkish work-permit rules and planned EU-funded education, and said a sector IMVO covenant and an anti-child-labour fund are being prepared, while declining to launch its own survey of Dutch textile firms.
The government sees little value in conducting such a survey itself.
Het kabinet ziet weinig in het zelf uitvoeren van een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over de belastingvoordelen voor Shell, Total en ENI in Nigeria

SP MPs asked the government to react to an ActionAid report on tax holidays worth 3.3 billion dollars for Shell, Total and ENI in Nigeria, and whether such incentives help poor countries, and asked about Dutch involvement and aid to Nigeria. The minister answered that tax incentives should be used narrowly, that Nigeria is responsible for its own incentive design, that the Netherlands did not actively help Shell obtain its incentive, that tax holidays show weak effects and the OECD and IMF advise restraint, and gave Nigeria aid figures.
The Dutch government does not support individual Dutch companies in obtaining favourable tax treatment in developing countries.
De Nederlandse overheid geeft geen ondersteuning aan individuele Nederlandse bedrijven om een gunstige fiscale behandeling in ontwikkelingslanden te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over kinderen en vrouwen die het slachtoffer zijn van seksueel geweld ten tijde van de ebola-epidemieën

MP Van Laar asks the minister about reports of rising sexual violence against women and girls during the Ebola epidemics, including teenage pregnancies and a Liberian ban on pregnant girls attending school, and what the Netherlands will do. The minister acknowledges the increase, describes NGO-funded prevention work and Dutch agenda-setting on sexual and reproductive rights, and calls the school ban unwise without announcing a concrete new measure.
The absolute figures are not known to the cabinet, but the increase in sexual violence underlying them is very regrettable.
De absolute cijfers zijn bij het kabinet niet bekend, maar de toename van seksueel geweld dat hier aan ten grondslag ligt is zeer te betreuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over duurzame investeringen in de bankensector naar aanleiding van het rapport ‘Undermining our future’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about Dutch banks' greater investment in fossil fuels than in renewables, a coal-reduction recommendation, transparency, and ING's selection as state house bank. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to a bank climate statement and planned transparency talks, and said commitments on coal were a matter for the energy phase-out and sector, giving only partial substantive answers.
Perhaps the researchers themselves can explain this.
Wellicht kunnen de onderzoekers zelf hier duiding aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het subsidiebeleidskader Funding Leadership and Opportunities for Women 2016-2020

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the FLOW II subsidy framework, including the subsidy thresholds, why nine large northern NGOs were selected rather than local women's organisations, and the risk to Southern women's organisations. The minister largely defended the selection as quality-based, outlined local involvement and regranting, and offered a Accountability Fund pathway of at least 5 million euros a year for local women's organisations.
In the selection, quality in light of the FLOW policy framework was the only criterion; the nine best-scoring programmes were funded.
Bij de selectie was kwaliteit in het licht van het FLOW-beleidskader het enige criterium; de negen best scorende programma's zijn gehonoreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Dekken over gebrekkige arbeidsomstandigheden in Qatar bij de voorbereidingen op het WK voetbal van 2022

MPs Servaes and Van Dekken asked the foreign and trade ministers about poor labour conditions for migrant workers in Qatar ahead of the 2022 World Cup, including Amnesty's report of stalled reforms, the concrete steps taken on the Parliament's June motion, and FIFA's transparency. The ministers answered that Qatar has taken some positive steps but reforms are incomplete, that the Netherlands is pressing Qatar bilaterally, in the EU and through the ILO (including a high-level ILO mission), and that FIFA integrity questions await ongoing investigations.
Various (criminal) investigations into the awarding of these World Cups are currently underway. The cabinet is awaiting the outcomes of these investigations before taking a position.

Momenteel worden er diverse (strafrechtelijke) onderzoeken verricht naar de toewijzing van deze Wereldkampioenschappen. Het kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken af alvorens een standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de United Nations Convention on Transparency in Treaty-based Investor-State Arbitration

An MP asked the minister why the Netherlands has not signed the UN Convention on Transparency in Treaty-based Investor-State Arbitration while the US, Canada and some EU states have, and whether it will sign quickly. The minister explains that the EU failed to reach consensus on signing, so the Netherlands has waited for an EU position, and says a Dutch decision on signing will be taken very shortly.
In parallel, the cabinet will take a decision on signing the convention in the very short term, and the approval documents are also in the final stage of preparation.
Parallel daaraan zal het kabinet op zeer korte termijn een besluit nemen over de ondertekening van het verdrag en ook de goedkeuringsstukken zijn in de laatste fase van voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over kinderarbeid achter batterijen voor smartphones en elektrische auto’s

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour behind cobalt used in smartphone and electric car batteries, citing an Amnesty report, and about traceability, due diligence, supply diversification, talks with the Congolese government, and the EU conflict minerals regulation. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to the OECD Due Diligence Guidance, the IMVO covenant route, a PACT traceability project, planned talks with the DRC, and the EU trilogue, but does not commit to new binding measures.
The cabinet intends to discuss with the relevant Congolese government counterparts what our governments and international business could do to combat child labour.

Het kabinet is voornemens met de relevante gesprekspartners binnen de Congolese overheid te bespreken wat onze regeringen en het internationale bedrijfsleven zouden kunnen doen om kinderarbeid tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over kinderarbeid bij de productie van batterijen voor smartphones in Congo

An ChristenUnie MP asked the minister about child labour in Congolese cobalt mines supplying smartphone batteries, and whether she would engage the electronics sector and how the Amnesty report and traceability schemes factor into convenant negotiations. The minister acknowledged the risks, expects companies to apply OECD due diligence, says she is in talks with the electronics sector on a responsible-sourcing covenant, and outlines the iTSCi and PACT traceability projects, which currently do not cover cobalt.
The cabinet expects companies to comply with these guidelines and incorporate them into their business operations.
Het kabinet verwacht dat bedrijven deze richtlijnen naleven en in hun bedrijfsvoering opnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid in de kobaltmijnbouw

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour in cobalt mining in DR Congo, raised by an Amnesty report, including the EU conflict minerals regulation, OECD due diligence alignment, sales of affected devices, and the IMVO covenant for electronics. The minister replied that child labour in cobalt mining is among the worst forms, that companies should follow OECD due diligence, that cobalt is not on the negotiating table since no institution proposed adding it, that the origin of cobalt cannot be traced after smelting so the number of affected devices is unknown, and that cobalt will be placed on the covenant agenda only if the electronics sector takes an initiative.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het bericht ‘Kinderarbeid achter batterijen voor smartphones en elektrische auto’s’

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports of child labour in cobalt mining for smartphone and electric car batteries, asking whether large brands could be held to account and whether cobalt could be added to EU conflict-minerals rules. The minister said the government will engage industry through due diligence guidance and an IMVO covenant, raise the issue with Congo and China, but will not push to add cobalt to the EU regulation since Parliament, Council and Commission did not propose it.
The government is willing to raise this situation with the Chinese government.
Het kabinet is bereid deze situatie aan te kaarten bij de Chinese regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het loslaten van de duurzame doelstelling door de koffiesector

MP Voordewind asks why the coffee sector has abandoned its 75% sustainable coffee target, whether independent certification will be safeguarded, and whether convenants need a legal framework. The minister replies that the sector should set new measurable targets with transparency, that certification alone is insufficient but independent verification remains necessary, and that no legal framework is currently needed for IMVO convenants.
The cabinet is certainly willing to continue talks with the coffee sector and to press it for ambitious targets.
Het kabinet is zeker bereid om met de koffiesector verder in gesprek te gaan en bij de koffiesector aan te dringen op ambitieuze doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de inzet van de Nederlandse regering bij de OESO Development Assistance Committee (DAC) High Level Meeting

An SP MP asked the minister how the Netherlands would approach the OECD-DAC High Level Meeting on modernising ODA, including asylum reception costs, military spending, private sector finance and countering violent extremism. The minister outlined the Dutch position on each point, stated that reporting first-year asylum costs as ODA is an OECD-DAC agreed practice, and answered the questions on substance.
The Netherlands will be represented at the High Level Meeting by the Director-General for International Cooperation and the Ambassador for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation.
Nederland zal bij de High Level Meeting worden vertegenwoordigd door de Directeur-Generaal Internationale Samenwerking en de Ambassadeur Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over export van militair materieel aan Saoedi-Arabië

SP MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Dutch arms export licences to Saudi Arabia breach EU and international law given the Yemen war and blockade, and whether Nederland will restrict such exports. The ministers acknowledge likely violations of international humanitarian law by the coalition, report four licences since March 2015 worth 2.8 million euro, and say they reject most military-related requests and will grant further licences only where no use in Yemen or rights abuses is conceivable.
Only when it is indisputably established that goods cannot be used in the fighting in Yemen or for human rights violations will a licence still be issued.
Alleen wanneer onomstotelijk vaststaat dat goederen niet kunnen worden ingezet in de strijd in Jemen of bij mensenrechtenschendingen zal nog een vergunning worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over het onderzoek naar de export van omstreden goederen door RH Marine Group

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked about a customs investigation into possibly illegal exports of dual-use goods by RH Marine Group (former Imtech Marine), including licensing, the countries involved, and consequences for defence projects. The minister confirmed that customs is investigating after the ministry was alerted and that the remaining questions will be answered once the investigation, expected in about two months, is complete.
Questions 3 through 7 will be answered after the customs investigation has been completed.
De vragen 3 tot en met 7 worden beantwoord na afronding van het onderzoek van de Douane.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de betrokkenheid van bedrijven uit de Nederlandse financiële sector bij de bosbranden in Indonesië

MP Gesthuizen asked the minister whether Dutch financial institutions such as Rabobank, ABN AMRO and ABP should be held responsible for financing palm oil firms linked to deliberate forest fires and land grabbing in Indonesia, and whether banks, insurers and pension funds would be included in covenant negotiations and a ban on such palm oil considered. The minister answered that due diligence under OECD guidelines applies, that banks and other sectors are engaged through IMVO covenants and dialogue, and that a legal ban is currently not internationally feasible in favour of voluntary, certification-based approaches.
I do not have an overview of the companies operating in the Netherlands that purchase palm oil grown in Kalimantan for the Dutch market.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de in Nederland opererende bedrijven die voor de Nederlandse markt palmolie inkopen die op Kalimantan is verbouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jan Vos over over de bosbranden in Indonesië en het streven naar duurzame palmolie

MPs Van Laar and Jan Vos asked the minister about a Friends of the Earth report alleging that palm oil producers Wilmar and Bumitama Agri fail their no-burning commitments and Indonesian law, and about implications for RSPO credibility and the 2020 sustainable palm oil ambition. The minister replied that the companies have reaffirmed no-burning policies, that RSPO has monitoring and sanctions mechanisms though not waterproof, and that Indonesian enforcement is difficult but the government supports capacity building and partnerships.
Possible breaches of the agreements must be taken seriously, but do not undermine the ambitions and concrete actions in this area.
Eventuele schendingen van de afspraken moeten serieus worden genomen, maar ondermijnen niet de ambities en concrete acties op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over Dumpstaal uit China

An MP asked the trade and economic affairs ministers about alleged dumping of Chinese cold-rolled steel, its effects on climate goals and Tata Steel's Hisarna technology, and whether they would press the European Commission on anti-dumping timing and measures. The minister replied that an EU anti-dumping investigation is underway with preliminary findings due by 14 February 2016, that the Netherlands weighs environmental costs of duties case by case, and that the issue has been raised in EU Council meetings.
Yes. This issue was discussed during an extraordinary session of the Competitiveness Council on 9 November 2015 and at the regular Foreign Affairs Council (trade) on 27 November 2015.
Ja. Deze kwestie is besproken tijdens een ingelaste sessie van de Raad van Concurrentievermogen op 9 november 2015 en tijdens de reguliere Raad voor Buitenlandse Zaken handel op 27 november 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat oliebedrijf Total de Oegandese staat aanklaagt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Total's investment-treaty arbitration against Uganda via a Dutch subsidiary, including treaty shopping, the disputed stamp duty, secrecy of production-sharing agreements and the effect on developing-country budgets. The minister said Dutch IBOs are available to firms with Dutch registration, that the use of IBOs by firms without substantial activity is undesirable and will be revised, and that the matter is for an arbitral tribunal, with transparency improvements promised for the IBO modernisation.
Attention deserves in this context the use of these treaties by Dutch investors that carry out no substantial business activities here.
Aandacht verdient in dit kader het gebruik van deze verdragen door Nederlandse investeerders die hier geen substantiële bedrijfsactiviteiten verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het niet bereiken van vrouwen en meisjes in noodsituaties met specifieke hulp

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about UNFPA findings that women and girls in crises and emergencies are not reached with reproductive health aid, and about gaps such as sanitary products in refugee camps. The Minister acknowledged the gaps, described Dutch efforts through EU and World Humanitarian Summit agendas, UN partners and NGOs, and committed to continued advocacy without specifying new funding.
The Netherlands supports the UNFPA call to focus the (humanitarian) agenda more on women and girls, as well as on sexual and reproductive health and rights.
Nederland ondersteunt de oproep van UNFPA om de (humanitaire) agenda meer op vrouwen en meisjes, alsook op seksuele en reproductieve gezondheid en rechten te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie klimaatvoorstellen zou blokkeren die handel en het TTIP hinderen

An SP MP asked the minister about a report that the European Commission was blocking climate proposals that hinder trade and TTIP, including a memo on instructing negotiators to oppose discussing trade in the UNFCCC and patent rights. The minister denied that all climate proposals are blocked, said climate and trade belong in their own fora with overlap handled politically, argued trade can benefit the environment, and said the Commission's stance needs no challenge.
The cabinet does not share the assumption in the report that the EU would block every climate proposal because of the TTIP negotiations.
Het kabinet deelt de veronderstelling in het bericht dat de EU ieder klimaatvoorstel zou blokkeren vanwege de TTIP-onderhandelingen niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jan Vos over de vernieling van drie Nederlandse bedrijven in Ethiopië

MPs Van Laar and Jan Vos asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the destruction of three Dutch companies in Ethiopia, including the causes, land-grab concerns, government response and safety of Dutch entrepreneurs. The minister answered that two Dutch firms were affected, that the embassy is in close contact with them, that the attacks likely stemmed from fears over land rights linked to Addis Ababa's expansion, and that the Ethiopian government will prosecute perpetrators and facilitate compensation talks.
The Dutch embassy is in almost daily contact with the two affected Dutch companies, Solagrow and Grazeland.
De Nederlandse ambassade staat in bijna dagelijks contact met de twee getroffen Nederlandse bedrijven, Solagrow en Grazeland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de situatie in Burundi

MP Taverne (VVD) asked the minister about the newly announced Burundian rebel group FOREBU, its aims, the risk of ethnic conflict, AU troop deployment, Rwandan involvement and whether Dutch and EU aid to the Burundian government should end. The minister answered that FOREBU's size is unclear, the conflict is political rather than ethnic, Nederland has no evidence of Rwandan support, and aid to the Burundian government was already suspended, while keeping the door open to dialogue.
The cabinet has repeatedly conveyed this message and clearly signalled it by suspending aid to the Burundian government.
Het kabinet heeft deze boodschap herhaaldelijk uitgedragen en een duidelijk signaal afgegeven door de hulp aan de Burundese overheid op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over de vergunning verleend aan Urenco voor de export van 1000 ton verarmd uranium naar Rusland

D66 MPs asked how the ANVS issued a transport permit for depleted uranium to Russia despite a text error, what risks, oversight and Russian end-use guarantees apply, and whether the permit should be withdrawn. The government admits the error should not have been issued, says it was corrected by amendment, and defends the export licence as legally permissible with formal Russian guarantees, declining to withdraw it.
I regret the error made. The ANVS has in the meantime taken measures so that a strict application of the justification principle will apply from now on.
Ik betreur de gemaakte fout. Er zijn intussen door de ANVS maatregelen getroffen die er toe leiden dat voortaan sprake zal zijn van een strikte toepassing van het rechtvaardigingsbeginsel.
Antwoord op vraag 3 van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over leveringen van ‘dual use’ goederen

Two D66 MPs asked whether the minister had contacted Imtech about an internal investigation showing at least 51 shipments of dual-use goods to denied entities. The minister answers that the company applied for no export licences, that the ministry did contact RH Marine Group and reviewed the investigation, and that customs has been asked to investigate while licence applications are held.
After inspection, customs was asked to conduct an investigation.
Na inzage is de douane gevraagd een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de vermeende onware claims van Shell aangaande het schoonmaken van de Niger Delta

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that Shell made false or incomplete claims about cleaning up oil pollution in the Niger Delta, whether it will raise this with Shell, and what levers it has to make Shell act responsibly. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the embassy in Abuja is working on strengthening the Nigerian regulator NOSDRA, that the Netherlands has raised the UNEP recommendations with Shell and the Nigerian government, and that it will use mediation (Bodo) and existing CSR instruments.
In this context, the Netherlands among other things urges all parties involved to implement the recommendations of the 2011 UNEP report.
Nederland dringt in dit kader onder meer aan op implementatie van de aanbevelingen uit het UNEP-rapport uit 2011 door alle betrokken partijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat Unicef waarschuwt voor het lot van Nepalese kinderen in de winter

An MP asked the minister whether she knew of UNICEF's warning about Nepalese children facing a harsh winter after the 2015 earthquakes, and what the Netherlands was doing on relief, winterization, funding and international follow-up. The minister answered that the Netherlands provided about 10 million euro via the Red Cross, WFP and the Dutch Relief Alliance, described winter preparation measures, and said unearmarked contributions to UNICEF and others could be used for Nepal's needs.
After the earthquake of 25 April 2015, the Netherlands made ten million euros available for humanitarian aid.
Na de aardbeving van 25 april 2015 heeft Nederland tien miljoen euro beschikbaar gesteld voor humanitaire hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de relatie met Ethiopië

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a newspaper article on drought in Ethiopia, climate-smart solutions, lessons from Kenya, food security funding (EUR 33.7 million), water management projects, the UN food aid request, and structural measures against future famine. The minister answered each question, describing Dutch-funded programmes, the bodies involved, and the reallocation of EUR 9 million to the Productive Safety Net Programme, with a project table provided as an annex.
The Netherlands contributes 5 million euros to OCHA's Common Humanitarian Relief Fund (CHF) in Ethiopia.
Nederland geeft een bijdrage van 5 miljoen euro aan het Common Humanitarian Relief Fund (CHF) van OCHA in Ethiopië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Voordewind over kinderarbeid en lage lonen bij Nederlandse en in Nederland actieve zaadbedrijven die in India actief zijn

MPs Van Laar and Voordewind asked the minister about child labour and underpayment of women in Dutch-linked vegetable seed companies operating in India, citing a 2015 NGO report and asking about industry follow-up, a convenant, complaint mechanisms and raising the issue bilaterally. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to Plantum's engagement with members, a planned IMVO risk analysis, a new child-labour fund, and openness to a sector convenant and bilateral raising of the issue, without committing to a specific sanction or binding measure.
I consider a sector convenant with the seed sector and directly involved parties a suitable means to deal properly with the issues the report draws attention to.
Een sectorconvenant met de zadensector en direct betrokkenen acht ik een geschikt middel om goed om te gaan met kwesties waar het rapport aandacht voor vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over de schrijnende situatie in Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers about Burundi's suspension of ten civil society organisations, its prosecution of them, Dutch links to those groups, conditions for resuming aid, the recall of Burundian EALA members, US sanctions, and support for refugees in neighbouring countries. The government answered that it had raised its concern about the measures with Burundian ministers, that three of the ten organisations receive Dutch funding, that aid resumes only after conditions such as a peaceful climate and media independence are met, and that it added funds for refugee relief.
Naturally, the Netherlands also expects the Burundian government to give civil society sufficient room to function, without fear of persecution.
Uiteraard verwacht Nederland eveneens dat de Burundese regering het maatschappelijk middenveld voldoende ruimte geeft om te kunnen functioneren, zonder angst voor vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken en Jan Vos over het bericht dat Nederlandse banken een megakippenbedrijf in Oekraïne financieren

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Dutch banks financing a huge Ukrainian poultry company, export credit guarantees for intensive livestock systems, and Dutch versus Ukrainian animal welfare standards were acceptable. The minister answered that Ukrainian standards are currently lower but the EU association agreement requires convergence, that export credits are assessed under IFC standards including animal welfare, and that the government sees no reason to refuse credits on the basis of herd size.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over meer dan 1 miljoen kinderen in nood in de Centraal Afrikaanse Republiek

Van Laar (PvdA) asks the minister how the government responds to the UN finding that over one million children in the Central African Republic need urgent aid, why aid is not reaching them, and whether the Bekou Fund and its EUR 64 million capitalisation are adequate. Minister Ploumen answers that insecurity and attacks on aid workers hamper delivery, that the fund now has sufficient financing for 2016, and that further Dutch aid will be assessed after the electoral process in 2016.
In 2016, once the electoral process is completed, it will be examined in which areas additional Dutch aid is needed and possible.
In 2016, wanneer het verkiezingsproces is afgerond, zal worden bezien op welke terreinen extra Nederlandse hulp nodig en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over een aan Urenco verleende vergunning voor de levering van verarmd uranium aan Rusland

MPs from D66 asked whether a November 2015 transport permit for up to 1,000 tonnes of uranium hexafluoride to Russia, and the related export licence, were justified given the sanctions climate, Russian plutonium and weapons risks, storage conditions and Euratom rules. The government answered that the permit wrongly mentions depleted uranium (only natural UF6 is covered, with a textual error to be corrected), that the export is civil and subject to Russian formal guarantees and IAEA safeguards, and that transport risks are low; several questions were answered by restating the regulatory framework.
The textual error will be corrected as soon as possible and the transport permit will be amended.
De tekstuele fout zal zo snel mogelijk worden hersteld en de vervoersvergunning zal worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Laar over de blokkade die goederen van India naar Nepal tegenhoudt

An MP asked the minister about an Indian-imposed blockade on goods to Nepal, its impact on earthquake relief and medicine shortages, and what steps the government would take. The minister confirmed the blockade, described intervention in a stranded aid shipment, said the government would raise the issue in the EU and with like-minded countries, and noted the UN Secretary-General's call to lift the blockade.
The Netherlands will raise this issue where possible, within the EU and in consultation with like-minded countries.
Nederland zal waar mogelijk deze kwestie aan de orde stellen, in EU-verband en in samenspraak met gelijkgezinde landen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over kinderarbeid bij goudwinning voor de elektronicasector

Two MPs (Voordewind and Van Laar) asked the government about child labour in gold mining supplying the electronics sector, including responsibility of electronics firms, EU and OECD action, development programmes in Mali, and due diligence convenants. Minister Ploumen answered that the government will raise the issue with the Conflict Free Smelters Program, pursue a sector IMVO covenant for gold by summer 2016, seek EU Council conclusions during the Dutch presidency, and support child labour programmes in Mali.
In the process towards an IMVO covenant for the gold sector, the ministry is in close consultation with, among others, several companies from the electronics sector.
In het traject om te komen tot een IMVO-convenant voor de goudsector is het ministerie in nauw overleg met onder meer enkele bedrijven uit de elektronicasector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het tekort aan voedsel in Noord-Irak

An MP asked the minister about the imminent end of food aid in northern Iraq due to funding shortfalls, the EU and member state contributions, and whether northern Iraq and Syria receive adequate attention. The minister acknowledged serious concern, listed Dutch and EU humanitarian contributions to Iraq, and denied that northern regions are neglected relative to Turkey, Jordan and Lebanon.
The Netherlands supports both organisations and calls on other donors to also contribute.
Nederland ondersteunt beide organisaties en roept andere donoren op ook bij te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over de door de Europese Commissie voorgestelde nieuwe handelsstrategie voor Europa

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the European Commission's new trade strategy, covering modernisation of existing trade agreements, the link between trade and sustainable development, GSP rules, labour and human rights, regulatory standards, transparency of negotiations, and investor-state arbitration. The minister answered that the strategy aims to strengthen sustainability and transparency, that Dutch standards will be maintained, and that the Dutch model investment treaty will be revised in line with the EU standard.
The cabinet favours maximum transparency in negotiations on trade and investment agreements.
Het kabinet is voorstander van maximale transparantie van onderhandelingen over handels- en investeringsakkoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat meer dan 10.000 vluchtelingen vast komen te zitten in Servië en een tekort aan humanitaire hulp ontstaat in landen op de ‘Balkanroute’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that over 10,000 refugees were stranded in Serbia and that aid shortages were emerging along the Balkan route after border closures, and asked what the EU and the Netherlands were doing. The minister answered that the Netherlands is engaging EU partners, that EU emergency funding and 50,000 extra reception places in Greece and 50,000 along the route were agreed, and that hotspots are key to implementing the relocation agreements, without any institutional change to executive oversight.
In addition, the Netherlands has made 100 camp beds and 10 light towers available to Slovenia, following a Slovenian request for more materials to better organise the reception of the many refugees.

Daarnaast heeft Nederland 100 veldbedden en 10 lichttorens ter beschikking gesteld aan Slovenië, naar aanleiding van een oproep van Slovenië voor meer materialen om de opvang van de vele vluchtelingen beter te kunnen organiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme, Klaver en Voordewind over het rapport van de onafhankelijke klachtencommissie van de Nederlandse financieringsmaatschappij voor ontwikkelingslanden FMO m.b.t. de Barro Blanco dam i

MPs Thieme, Klaver and Voordewind asked the minister about the FMO complaints committee finding that indigenous rights were not fully assessed before approving the Barro Blanco dam loan in Panama, and about human rights impact assessments, parliamentary oversight of FMO, and the state's influence over FMO investment decisions. The minister acknowledged the incomplete information, promised to raise FMO's tightened approval process and transparency with FMO, supported a dialogue process with indigenous authorities, and rejected several proposals such as a public open session of FMO's supervisory board and a construction halt.
At the next consultation with FMO I will explicitly raise this issue.
In het eerstvolgende overleg met FMO zal ik dit nadrukkelijk aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Klein en Sjoerdsma over het EU-Turkije actieplan migratie

MPs Voortman, Klein and Sjoerdsma asked about the sequencing, financing, Turkish commitments, Frontex data exchange, accession talks and migration law reform under the EU-Turkey migration action plan. The minister answered that the plan sets no sequence or fixed amounts, that Dutch funding awaits further talks, and that details will be worked out later with Turkey.
Neither the action plan nor the European Council conclusions contain target amounts or worked-out agreements on financing and spending.
Het actieplan noch de ER-conclusies bevatten streefbedragen of uitgewerkte afspraken over financiering en besteding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapenexport naar Egypte

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about Dutch arms exports to Egypt, Egyptian navy involvement in the Yemen blockade, humanitarian impacts, and whether licences should be maintained. The ministers answered that the Yemen humanitarian situation is grave, that Egyptian ships are enforcing the UN arms embargo, that reports of bombing could not be confirmed, and that they see no reason to change the Egypt licensing policy.
The cabinet sees no reason to change the policy regarding Egypt on this point.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om het beleid ten aanzien van Egypte op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over bosbranden voor palmolie in Indonesië

An MP asked the minister about the Indonesian palm oil forest fires, Dutch policy, Unilever's role and EU and IMVO measures. The minister answered that Indonesia is taking steps but enforcement is needed, that Dutch support runs through IDH, Solidaridad and EU market initiatives, and that Unilever's commitments are positive.

Secondly, I encourage the Indonesian authorities to be open to international market developments and to give companies that commit to sustainability measures and standards, nationally and internationally, room to put them into practice.
Ten tweede moedig ik de Indonesische autoriteiten aan open te staan voor de internationale marktontwikkelingen en bedrijven die zich verplichten aan duurzaamheidsmaatregelen en standaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het opleggen van een anti-dumpingheffing aan ZEP BV Urk

An MP asks whether ZEP BV Urk, forced by minimum order volumes to buy solar roof tiles from Chinese producers, should be subject to anti-dumping duties up to 64%, and whether SMEs should be restricted by such duties. The minister explains that price undertakings with over 120 Chinese producers can avoid the duties, that duties apply regardless of firm size, and that solar roof tiles are supported through net metering and energy innovation policy.
When imposing anti-dumping and countervailing duties, no distinction is made between small and large importers.
Bij het opleggen van antidumping en compenserende rechten wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt tussen kleine en grote importeurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapenexport naar Egypte

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Dutch export licence worth over 34 million euro for military equipment for the Egyptian navy, Egypt's role in the Yemen conflict and blockade, and whether the licence would be reconsidered. The ministers confirmed the licence, said they could not establish that Egyptian ships shelled targets in Yemen, acknowledged humanitarian concerns, and declined to reconsider the licence, citing the need to enforce the arms embargo and Egypt's legitimate security needs.
Based on the information gathered, the cabinet cannot conclude that Egyptian ships shelled targets in or off the coast of Yemen.
Op basis van de hieruit opgedane informatie kan het kabinet niet opmaken dat vanaf Egyptische schepen doelen in of voor de kust van Jemen zijn beschoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over abortus voor verkrachtingsslachtoffers in conflictgebieden

Parliamentarian Van Veldhoven asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the Netherlands will champion EU policy on access to safe abortion for rape survivors in conflict zones, including at the UN Security Council debate. The Minister confirms Dutch leadership, says the Netherlands will raise sexual and reproductive health and rights including abortion in bilateral, multilateral and EU settings, and commits to ensuring implementation and to speaking publicly at the Security Council.
Yes, the Cabinet will oversee that.
Ja, daar zal het Kabinet op toezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Nederlands hulpgeld wordt gebruikt om boetes van Palestijnse boeren te betalen

An SGP MP asked whether Dutch aid money was used to pay fines imposed on Palestinian farmers by Israeli authorities, how often this occurred, and under what criteria. The minister confirmed EUR 11,382 in fines paid since 2013 in three cases to release seized equipment, and said the government will continue aid in Area C despite the risk, without ending the practice.
No. Question 4: Has the Netherlands also paid fines imposed after Palestinian violence? Answer 4: No.
Vraag 4 Heeft Nederland ook boetes betaald die waren opgelegd nadat er sprake was van geweldpleging door Palestijnen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het geschillenbeslechtingsmechanisme in het Vrijhandelsverdrag met Canada (CETA)

An SP MP asked the minister why the Commission will not modernise the ISDS arbitration clause in CETA while reforming it for TTIP, and about US subsidiaries in Canada, timing of legal scrubbing, and national parliamentary involvement. The minister largely referred to earlier answers, said only firms with substantial Canadian activity may use the protection, promised limited technical revisions before signature in the second half of 2016, and committed to parliamentary debate before signature.
As set out in parliamentary letter 31 985, no. 23, there will be a debate with your House on signature and provisional application of the agreement before the cabinet decides.
Zoals uiteen gezet in de Kamerbrief 31 985, nr. 23 zal er met uw Kamer worden gedebatteerd over ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van het akkoord voordat het kabinet hierover beslist.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Roemenië voelt TTIP nu al”

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade about Gabriel Resources' investment-arbitration claim against Romania (up to EUR 4 billion) after a gold-mine project was cancelled, and about treaty shopping, regulatory chill and ISDS in CETA and TTIP. The minister says investors may challenge state decisions via arbitration, denies that such claims cause regulatory chill, says the company's structure is unknown, and points to a proposed investment court and to excluding companies without substantial activity.
The cabinet does not prefer investment arbitration or an investment court over the regular legal route.
Het kabinet verkiest investeringsarbitrage of een investeringshof niet boven de reguliere rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gebrekkige transparantie rond het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP)

An SP MP asked the minister about limited transparency over the TTIP trade negotiations, including access for national parliamentarians to US and consolidated negotiating texts and the Brussels reading room. The minister replied that national parliamentarians should get access to consolidated texts, that transparency has increased, and that she pushes for it with the Commission, while declining to endorse the protest day.
The cabinet is of the view that national parliamentarians must be able to gain access to the consolidated negotiating texts.
Het kabinet is van mening dat nationale parlementariërs inzage moeten kunnen krijgen in de geconsolideerde onderhandelingsteksten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Kerstens over het niet aanpassen van de clausule voor het beslechten van investeringsgeschillen in het handelsverdrag met Canada, genaamd CETA

Two MPs asked why the ISDS investor-state dispute clause in the CETA trade deal with Canada has not been changed, and whether the Commission should reopen the CETA negotiations given work on an alternative for TTIP. The minister says the Commission does not want to reopen CETA but will align the investment chapter with TTIP reforms through technical changes in legal revision, that CETA already contains improvements, and that the text may still be adjusted before European Parliament approval.
Once the legal revision process is concluded, the agreement will be submitted to the Council for approval and signature and will also have to be approved by the European Parliament.

Als het proces van juridische revisie is afgesloten, zal het akkoord ter goedkeuring en ondertekening worden voorgelegd aan de Raad en zal het ook moeten worden goedgekeurd door het Europees parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de misstanden op en rondom Indiase theeplantages

An MP asked the minister about labour abuses (including child labour and poor wages) on Indian tea plantations supplying Unilever, and whether the Dutch government can oversee multinationals' compliance with OECD guidelines. The minister answered that companies and governments have distinct duties, pointed to a food-sector CSR covenant, transparency benchmarks, the EU non-financial reporting directive and the National Contact Point, and said Indian local enforcement is often lacking.
The CSR covenant for the food sector may possibly contribute to this.
Het IMVO-convenant van de voedingsmiddelensector kan daaraan mogelijk bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het doden van wilde dieren door trofeejagers

An SP MP asked the ministers about trophy hunting of protected wildlife such as the lion Cecil, the share of hunting revenue reaching local communities, enforcement against illegal trophy trade and online wildlife sales. The government said hunting can be permitted under conditions, that it lacks data on local benefit shares, promised an exploration of limiting trophy imports in October 2015, and described NVWA/Douane enforcement and ongoing talks with Marktplaats.

The State Secretary for Economic Affairs will send the House in October 2015, as promised in the committee debate on nature policy and biodiversity of 28 May, an exploration of options to further reduce or prohibit the import of hunting trophies.

De Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken zal in oktober 2015, zoals toegezegd in het AO Natuurbeleid en Biodiversiteit van 28 mei jl., een verkenning naar de Kamer sturen van de mogelijkheden om de invoer van jachttrofeeën verder te verminderen of te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme en Voortman over de Europese migratieproblematiek.

MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme and Voortman asked the government about the European migration crisis, including limits of reception capacity, funding for regional refugee aid, safe third country returns, relocation quotas and Dublin rules. The state secretary answered largely on substance, describing the planned approach and noting that many details remain to be negotiated with the EU and third countries.
Once the ideas take more concrete shape at European level, we can further develop the plans together with relevant reception countries, such as Syria's neighbours.
Zodra in Europees verband de ideeën concreter vorm krijgen, kunnen we de plannen verder uitwerken samen met relevante opvanglanden, zoals de buurlanden van Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het farmaceutische bedrijf Mylan

An MP asked ministers whether Dutch pharmaceutical firm Mylan supplies drugs used in US executions and what it will do to prevent this. The minister answered that Mylan refused to give a guarantee, that the government expects further steps, and that EU export controls and the OECD complaint process are being pursued.

Since the answer to the parliamentary questions mentioned in question 1, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has had repeated contact on this matter with Mylan itself, investor APG, the NGO Reprieve, and the lawyer Stapert.
Sinds de beantwoording van de in vraag 1 genoemde Kamervragen heeft het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken over deze kwestie verschillende malen contact gehad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een rapport van Stop Wapenhandel over wapenleveranties van het Nederlandse bedrijf Thales aan Myanmar

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Stop Wapenhandel report alleging Thales radar technology, licensed to Indian firm BEL, ended up in Myanmar's navy, and whether the Netherlands can block such re-export and enforce the Myanmar arms embargo. The government answered that licence and contract clauses require prior Dutch consent for re-sales, that it would refuse future licences to a breaching end-user, that the EU embargo covers listed goods regardless of age, and that it found no evidence of Dutch embargo violations.
It should be clear that the Dutch government will refuse a future licence application for this end-user.
Het mag duidelijk zijn dat de Nederlandse overheid een volgende vergunningaanvraag voor deze eindgebruiker zal weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over burgerslachtoffers, oorlogsmisdaden en dreigende hongersnood in Jemen

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the government about civilian casualties, alleged war crimes by the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen, and famine risk, including whether the Netherlands would raise these at the UN Human Rights Council and General Assembly and support an international inquiry. The ministers answered that the Netherlands will raise violations with all parties, intends to include an inquiry in its Yemen resolution, and has granted 10 million euro in additional humanitarian aid on top of earlier contributions.
The cabinet is very concerned about allegations of violations of international humanitarian law in Yemen and is committed to investigating them.
Het kabinet is zeer bezorgd over beschuldigingen van schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht in Jemen en maakt zich sterk voor onderzoek hiernaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het achterhouden van documenten over het Transatlantic Trade & Investment Partnership (TTIP)

An SP MP asked the trade minister why the Dutch parliament no longer receives TTIP negotiation documents and whether the EU's restricted reading room and US secrecy should be addressed. The minister answered that the Commission restricted the last round report after leaks, that the government opposes this, that parliament is informed via debates and letters, and that the government supports maximum transparency within normal confidentiality.
The government has spoken out against the current restriction on access to the latest negotiation report and, like other member states, has made this known to the Commission in various ways.

Het kabinet heeft zich uitgesproken tegen de huidige beperking in de toegang tot het laatste onderhandelingsverslag en heeft dit, evenals andere lidstaten, op diverse manieren kenbaar gemaakt aan de Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over kinderarbeid in Syrië

An MP asked the minister about child labour and lost schooling among Syrian children, and what the Netherlands is doing internationally on education, livelihoods and child marriage. The minister confirmed the UNICEF/Save the Children findings, listed Dutch funding for education and child protection programmes, and said the Netherlands will pursue these issues in UN and EU fora.
The Netherlands will play an active role in the Champions Group on Education in Emergencies and Protracted Crisis set up by UN Special Envoy for Global Education Gordon Brown.

Antwoord 4 Nederland gaat een actieve rol vervullen in de door de VN Speciaal Gezant voor Wereldwijd Onderwijs, Gordon Brown, in het leven geroepen Champions» Group on Education in Emergencies and Protracted Crisis .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over een half miljoen kinderen die in de katoenzaadproductie werken

An MP asked the minister about a report estimating nearly half a million children work in Indian cottonseed production, and what Dutch firms and government are doing to stop child labour and secure living wages. The minister agreed the estimate is realistic, pointed to voluntary due diligence, sector covenants, Plantum surveys, and dialogue with India, but committed to no binding measures.
Together with colleague Kamp, I aim to conclude IMVO covenants with Dutch business sectors and civil society.
Samen met collega Kamp streef ik naar het afsluiten van IMVO-convenanten met Nederlandse bedrijfssectoren en maatschappelijk middenveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Leijten over gegijzelde patiënten in Kenia

MPs Smaling and Leijten asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports of patient hostage-taking, moonlighting staff and resale of equipment in Kenyan hospitals, and about the scope of Dutch aid and corruption risks. The minister acknowledged corruption as a serious problem, described existing zero-tolerance rules and risk assessments (including for the ORIO hospital project), and promised to check the adequacy of risk analysis and to press partner embassies to stay alert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de douane van Turkije

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked about Turkey's new additional import duties on goods from third countries, which affect Dutch exports, and whether this breaches the EU-Turkey customs union, and what steps the government would take. The minister confirms the customs union rules, lists the additional duties, says the Dutch embassy and the European Commission have raised the issue with Turkey, and that the parties will look at modernising the customs union.
The Dutch embassy in Ankara raised the increasing duties in a conversation on 10 July with the Turkish Ministry of Economic Affairs.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Ankara heeft de toenemende heffingen aangekaart in een gesprek op 10 juli bij het Turkse Ministerie van Economische Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Eijsink over de samenwerking met milities die kindsoldaten inzetten

MPs Van Laar and Eijsink asked the ministers about Dutch cooperation with militias that deploy child soldiers in the fight against IS, including whether Dutch forces work with Iraqi militias and what can be done to end child deployment. The government answered that it does not cooperate with parties using child soldiers, that its Iraq training targets Iraqi Special Operations Forces and Peshmerga rather than militias, and that it will keep raising human rights with Iraqi and Kurdish authorities and support education for children.
