The Netherlands does not cooperate with parties that deploy child soldiers.
Nederland werkt niet samen met partijen die kindsoldaten inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Merkies, Smaling en Van Bommel over het bericht “Afspraken VN-top stellen arme landen teleur”

MPs from the SP asked why no international tax body was created to combat tax avoidance, how much developing countries lose to profit shifting, and what the UN Addis Ababa conference means for aid and Dutch policy. The minister answered that BEPS and a compromise on the UN tax committee are the main routes, that loss estimates are unreliable, and that the outcome supports the SDGs without new pledges.
Owing to the lack of unambiguous data, it is currently impracticable to give a ratio between total development aid and the taxes developing countries lose through tax avoidance by multinationals.

Bij gebrek aan eenduidige gegevens is het thans ondoenlijk om een verhouding aan te geven tussen de totale ontwikkelingshulp en de belastingen die ontwikkelingslanden mislopen als gevolg van belastingontwijking door multinationals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over verwoesting van landbouwgrond nabij Bethlehem door Israël

An SP MP asked the government whether Israel destroyed Palestinian agricultural land near Bethlehem, the financial damage, whether Dutch-funded projects were hit and whether the government would demand compensation. The minister confirmed the destruction of crops and infrastructure at five sites funded by Dutch programmes worth about EUR 40,000, said the Netherlands has no legal basis to claim compensation since funding had ended, and only protested to Israeli authorities.
The Netherlands therefore has no legal basis to demand compensation.
Nederland heeft daarmee geen juridische basis om een schadevergoeding te eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat militaire trucks zijn geleverd aan Sudan zonder exportlicentie en in weerwil van het EU wapenembargo

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether Dutch firm Van Vliet Trucks sold ex-German military trucks to Sudan without an export licence despite the EU arms embargo, and how this fits with the 2008 resale policy. The minister answered that demilitarised trucks fall outside Dutch export licensing, so no licence was needed and the buyer was private, while acknowledging an interpretation difference with Germany and promising to examine aligning Dutch policy with Germany's.
Because there was no licence requirement and the recipient was private, the transactions were not notified to the Dutch export control authorities.
Omdat er geen vergunningsplicht geldt en omdat er sprake was van een private ontvanger, zijn de transacties niet aangemeld bij de Nederlandse exportcontrole-autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht dat via een Nederlands handelsbedrijf afgedankte Duitse legertrucks terecht zijn gekomen bij het Sudanese leger

An MP from the CDA asked the Dutch ministers whether they knew that ex-German army trucks sold via a Dutch trading firm ended up with the Sudanese army, whether export controls failed, and what would prevent recurrence. The ministers answered that the trucks were demilitarised and treated as civilian under Dutch rules so no licence was required, that Germany now requires re-export consent in its contracts, and that the government will examine aligning Dutch policy with Germany and the EU, while also addressing Sudan's human rights abuses, humanitarian access and UN reporting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Grashoff over de voorlichting van de Rijksoverheid over TTIP

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Grashoff asked the ministers whether government information on TTIP was misleading and how food safety, regulatory cooperation, MRLs and investor-state dispute settlement would be protected. The minister answered that regulatory cooperation does not allow lower EU standards, the regulatory cooperation body would be advisory only, and ISDS is being reformed toward a transparent, democratically supervised system.

As explained in a letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 1499), the European Commission confirms that this body may only have an advisory role, that European and national democratic procedures may therefore not be bypassed, and that all stakeholders must be able to contribute equally.

Zoals toegelicht in een Kamerbrief (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 1499 ), bevestigt de Europese Commissie dat deze instantie enkel een adviesrecht mag hebben, dat Europese en nationale democratische procedures daardoor niet doorkruist mogen worden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het ontbreken van afdoende mogelijkheden multinationals aansprakelijk te stellen voor rampen die verderop in de handelsketen plaatsvinden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether multinationals can be held liable for disasters deeper in their supply chains, citing a dissertation on contractual control and liability. The minister agreed responsibility lies with companies under the UN Guiding Principles and OECD guidelines, said a University of Utrecht study on companies' duty of care is pending, and stated that the government will report to parliament on supply-chain agreements if sectors fail to act.
At three-quarters of the process, at the evaluation moment, I will report to the House on this.
Op driekwart van het proces, tijdens het evaluatiemoment, zal ik hierover rapporteren aan de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland een ‘claimwalhalla’ is voor multinationals

An SP MP asked the minister whether the Netherlands is a 'claim paradise' for multinationals, questioning the CPB and UNCTAD studies on investment treaties, the lack of ISDS data, treaty shopping by letterbox firms, and the timeline for renegotiating Dutch BITs and TTIP safeguards. The minister rejected the claim, defended the investment treaty network, acknowledged that Dutch treaties allow letterbox firms without substance requirements and promised to examine substance requirements and treaty-shopping safeguards.
The Netherlands wants to revise this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over twee omstreden wetsvoorstellen in Oeganda

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the government about Ugandan bills restricting NGOs and anti-homosexuality legislation, including Dutch aid resumption. The ministers answered that the NGO bill threatens NGO freedom if adopted unamended, that the anti-homosexuality bill has not been formally submitted, and that the EU is handling the dialogue.
If the law is adopted without substantial changes, its application could significantly restrict the freedom of NGOs.
Wordt de wet zonder substantiële wijzigingen aangenomen, dan zal de toepassing ervan de vrijheid van ngo's flink kunnen inperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de werkwijze van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO)

An MP asked the minister whether the WHO's Ebola response exposed structural weaknesses and what Dutch funding and policy changes would follow. The minister agreed the WHO needs reform, described ongoing hervormingsstappen, and declined to cut Dutch voluntary contributions, while reporting the mandatory and voluntary funding figures.
The Netherlands currently sees no reason to further reduce its voluntary contribution given the WHO's important system function.
Nederland ziet nu geen aanleiding om de vrijwillige bijdrage verder te verminderen gezien de belangrijke systeemfunctie van de WHO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de selectieve aandacht van VN-organisatie UNICEF voor vrouwenbesnijdenis

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether UNICEF's data on female genital mutilation underrepresents the Middle East and Indonesia/Malaysia and whether it is a 'Muslim problem'. The minister answered that UNICEF will update its data, that Indonesia has since been added, that religious leaders are engaged, and that the practice is a human rights violation to be addressed in all countries.
I urge UNICEF and other UN organisations to collect data in all countries where female genital mutilation occurs (possibly) and to report on it.
Ik dring er bij UNICEF en andere VN-organisaties op aan gegevens te verzamelen in alle landen waar vrouwenbesnijdenis (mogelijk) voorkomt en hierover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bosma over noodhulp aan Christelijke vluchtelingen in Noord-Irak en Syrië

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether Christian refugees from ISIS are being left last in line for emergency aid and whether Dutch aid reaches them. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, acknowledged food shortages from funding gaps, and stated that aid is allocated by need without discrimination by religion, while promising to press aid organisations to act if any discrimination is found.
I have no basis to assume that the claim by the CEO of Open Doors is correct, that Christian refugees would be disadvantaged when it comes to receiving humanitarian aid.
Ik heb geen basis om aan te nemen dat de bewering van de CEO van Open Doors juist is dat Christelijke vluchtelingen achtergesteld zouden worden wanneer het gaat om het ontvangen van humanitaire hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over mensenrechtenschendingen in Zuid-Sudan

An MP asked the minister about a UN report on rape and live burning of women and girls in South Sudan by government forces, and whether sanctions and abortion access would follow. The government condemned the abuses, pointed to UN Human Rights Council and Security Council sanctions steps and possible further EU listings, and committed to supporting access to medical care including safe abortion in conflict settings.
The cabinet considers it urgently necessary that these abuses be investigated and that the perpetrators be tracked down and not escape punishment.
Het kabinet acht het dringend noodzakelijk dat deze misstanden worden onderzocht en dat de daders worden opgespoord en hun straf niet ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over kinderarbeid

MP Van Laar asked the minister about child labour in Thai shrimp processing and Ghanaian gold mines, including supply-chain transparency, living wages, and corporate duties. The minister answered that the government is pursuing living-wage initiatives, sector covenants and SDG targets, but that options to ban Thai shrimp from the EU market are very limited.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de zeehondenjacht in Canada

MP Thieme asked whether the government knows that Norwegian sealers stopped after subsidies ended, whether Canada would end its seal hunt if it stopped subsidising, and whether the minister raised the seal hunt during the Canada trade mission as promised. The minister confirmed the Norwegian development, declined to judge Canadian hunters' motives, and said the topic was not raised because no Canadian federal minister could be met, while pledging to keep raising it bilaterally and in Europe.
During this mission it proved not possible for scheduling reasons to meet a member of the Canadian government, so this topic was not raised this time.
Tijdens deze missie bleek het om agendatechnische redenen niet mogelijk om een ontmoeting te hebben met een lid van de Canadese regering, derhalve is dit onderwerp dit keer niet ter sprake gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het verslag van de Raad Buitenlandse Handel van 7 mei 2015

MP Verhoeven asked the trade minister about the list of green goods in the EU-WTO environmental goods negotiations, the Dutch economic stakes, environmental and climate effects, and the EU decision-making process. The minister answered that the list is not yet fixed, gave EU export figures from Commission studies, said impact assessments are ongoing, and committed to keeping Parliament informed.
There is currently no fixed list of green goods.
Er is op dit moment nog geen vastgestelde lijst met «groene goederen».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de impact van certificering op de arbeidsomstandigheden in de landbouwsector in ontwikkelingslanden

MP Voordewind asked the ministers whether they know the SOMO report on certification and labour conditions in developing-country agriculture, and whether they will engage supermarkets, ISEAL and the Sustainability Consortium on stronger certification, due diligence and convenants. The minister answers that the report is noted, that the Alliance and supermarkets are working on sustainability agendas, and that certification is one tool among others, with no binding government commitment beyond ongoing dialogue and subsidy.
The initiative for the agreements lies with the sectors themselves.
Het initiatief voor de convenanten ligt bij de sectoren zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over de berichten dat verzekeraars miljarden investeren en beleggen in controversiële wapenhandel

An MP asked the minister whether insurers investing in arms firms supplying Saudi Arabia (including cluster munitions used in Yemen) conflicts with responsible business conduct, and whether insurers should be pressed to divest and be more transparent. The minister replied that only cluster munition producers are excluded by law, that expectations under UN and OECD guidance apply, and that an IMVO covenant for the insurance sector is being discussed, while stating the government cannot comment on other EU states' export licences.
The cabinet cannot provide substantive comment on a licence issued by another EU member state or on the decision that preceded it.
Het kabinet kan geen inhoudelijke toelichting geven op een door een andere EU-lidstaat afgegeven vergunning of de beslissing die daaraan voorafging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over beleggingen van verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen in de wapenhandel

MPs asked whether insurers and pension funds should stop investing in arms makers supplying controversial states, and about reported billions in such holdings, including APG's. The government answered that only cluster munitions are legally barred, that it promotes IMVO covenants, and that the banking and insurance sectors are pursuing sector-specific covenants.
For investments in cluster munitions there is a statutory ban; beyond that, there are no other binding legal restrictions on insurers and pension funds investing in companies.

Voor investeringen in clustermunitie geldt er een wettelijk verbod, verder zijn er geen andere dwingende wettelijke belemmeringen voor het investeren in bedrijven door verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over inbeslagname van irrigatiepijpen van Palestijnse boeren in de Jordaanvallei

An MP asked whether Israeli authorities seized nearly 1.9 km of irrigation pipes from Palestinian farmers in the Jordan Valley, including a Dutch-funded project, and what the government would do about it and about obstructions to Dutch projects in Area C. The minister confirmed the seizure, said the pipes would be released after talks with Israeli authorities, outlined Dutch aid priorities in Area C and noted that other donors face similar problems.
It has been agreed that the pipes will therefore be released in the short term.
Afgesproken is dat de leidingen daarom op korte termijn zullen worden vrijgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over Conflict chipfabrikant NXP en vakbonden Thailand en Filipijnen

Gesthuizen (SP) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reported NXP intimidation of unions, dismissal of union negotiators and excessive overtime in Thailand and the Philippines, and whether the government would press NXP. The minister called the SOMO findings worrying, said embassies will contact unions and NXP, committed to raising OECD guideline compliance with the company, and noted NXP is involved in the metal and electronics sector covenant via FME.
The Dutch embassies in Bangkok and Manila will contact the local trade unions following the report.
De Nederlandse ambassades in Bangkok en Manilla zullen naar aanleiding van het rapport contact opnemen met de lokale vakbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over het bericht ‘Oxfam: Afrika verliest miljarden door belastingontwijking’

An MP asked whether Dutch aid helping Zimbabwe's government improve its tax system, including a 2014 tax-treaty training, is compatible with not supporting the Mugabe regime, and whether budget support should be ruled out. The minister replied that assistance is limited and technical, involves no financial transfers, that no general budget support is given, and that the EU will consider budget support only after the 2017 mid-term review if public financial management improves.
The cabinet no longer provides bilateral general budget support.
Het kabinet verstrekt geen bilaterale algemene begrotingssteun meer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over meer doden door aardverschuivingen in Nepal

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they knew of further deaths from landslides in Nepal, the risk of dammed rivers and flash floods for the Terai, and whether Dutch integrated water management expertise and preventive disaster risk reduction could be deployed there. The minister answered that Dutch involvement is focused on humanitarian aid, that prevention is mainly Nepal's responsibility with Dutch expertise available on request, and that the government has no plans for a specific programme for mountainous earthquake regions.
Nepal is therefore not among the countries with which cooperation on integrated water management takes place.
Nepal behoort daarom niet tot landen waarmee op het onderwerp integraal waterbeheer wordt samengewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de governance gap op het gebied van bedrijfsgerelateerde mensenrechtenschendingen

SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Foreign Affairs about the global governance gap in preventing business-related human rights abuses, whether a binding Business and Human Rights Treaty would help, why the Netherlands joins TTIP talks but not the treaty talks, and the government's position and EU parameters for the IGWG. The ministers answered that the UN Guiding Principles and the national action plan are the preferred route, that the EU parameters for joining the IGWG have not been met, and that the Netherlands chairs the Council of Europe instrument negotiations.
The cabinet expects companies to respect in other countries the same human rights standards as in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven dat ze in het buitenland dezelfde mensenrechtenstandaarden eerbiedigen als in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over investeren in China’s landjepik in de Zuid-Chinese zee

An MP asked whether investment opportunities offered by Chinese state firm CCCC in South China Sea island-reclamation projects are lawful, what risks investors face, and whether the government will block such investments. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands takes no position on territorial claims and leaves assessment to international law, left investment risk to investors, and offered no measures beyond referring to the earlier answer.
The Netherlands takes no position on the territorial claims in the South China Sea, but advocates peaceful settlement of disputes in accordance with international law.
Nederland neemt geen positie in over de territoriale claims in de Zuid-Chinese zee, maar pleit voor vreedzame beslechting van geschillen in overeenstemming met internationaal recht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de VS vasthouden aan een Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) met investeringsgeschillenbeslechting-sclausule (ISDS)

An SP MP asks the trade minister about reports that the US insists on retaining investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) in TTIP, rejecting the EU's proposed investment court, and about the consequences for negotiations and parliamentary approval. The minister replies that the Netherlands is pushing structural reforms (including a permanent court) with other member states, that the EU position is still being developed, that the Commission's proposals are in line with Dutch aims, and that US Trade Promotion Authority has been approved.
Once there is an EU position, negotiations with the Americans on this matter will be resumed.
Zodra er een EU positie is, zullen de onderhandelingen met de Amerikanen op dit gebied worden hervat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Smaling over het bericht ‘TTIP tast gezondheid EU aan’

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether TTIP would lower import tariffs on unhealthy US products, raising health costs and inequality, and whether the government's red lines on food safety hold. The minister replied that EU food safety standards remain fully in force, that tariffs are not linked to healthiness, that no list of affected products exists, and that the WRR food policy report is answered separately.
Such a list does not exist and is also not necessary.
Een dergelijk lijst is er niet en is ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over de handelsmissie naar India en het verzoek van een aantal NGO’s om te pleiten voor de vrijheid van organisatie en meningsuiting

MPs Servaes and Jan Vos asked the Prime Minister and ministers whether the government would press India during the trade mission to protect freedom of association and expression, given reported restrictions on NGOs such as Greenpeace and visa refusals. The minister answered that the government shares concern about shrinking space for international NGOs in India, raised it with Indian officials and agreed to discuss NGO cooperation in coming months, but left constitutional judgments to Indian courts and only promised reporting in the quarterly letter.

During my meeting with Minister of State Mr Haribhai P. Chaudhary I emphasised that a free, independent, active and critical civil society, through dialogue with businesses and governments, can contribute greatly to inclusive growth and development.

Ik benadrukte tijdens mijn onderhoud met Minister of State, Mr Haribhai P. Chaudhary dat een vrij, onafhankelijk, actief en kritisch maatschappelijk middenveld via een dialoog met bedrijven en overheden veel kan bijdragen aan inclusieve groei en ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Dekken over de voortdurende schending van arbeidsrechten bij de voorbereidingen voor het WK voetbal in Qatar

MPs Servaes and Van Dekken asked the government about continued labour rights abuses of migrant workers in Qatar linked to World Cup preparations, including Amnesty's findings, journalist detentions, union rights, Dutch company monitoring and FIFA corruption. The Minister answered that the government shares concerns, sees early steps by Qatar, pressed for ratification of ILO conventions 87 and 98, and engages bilaterally, through the EU, with business and the NCP, while declining to pre-judge ongoing FIFA investigations.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to anticipate the various investigations currently being conducted by the Swiss and American authorities.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun vooruit te lopen op de verschillende onderzoeken door de Zwitserse en Amerikaanse autoriteiten die momenteel lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over Kindermisbruik door militairen

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the foreign and development ministers about child sexual abuse by French troops in the Central African Republic, the suspension of UN official Anders Kompass for leaking a report, UN protection of whistleblowers, and measures against sexual abuse by UN-mandated soldiers. The minister said the government lacks the facts to judge the Kompass case, supports an independent UN inquiry, and noted the UN Secretary-General announced an external independent investigation.
The cabinet considers it important that an independent investigation be carried out covering all relevant aspects, and will therefore follow this case closely.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat er een onafhankelijk onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd waarin alle relevante aspecten aan de orde komen en zal deze zaak daarom op de voet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over slavernij en kinderarbeid in steengroeves

MPs Voordewind and Van Laar asked about child labour and slavery in South Indian granite quarries, due diligence by Dutch firms, the government's own procurement of granite, and whether municipalities and other public bodies are engaged. Minister Ploumen answers that she will engage sector federations on IMVO agreements, raise the issue during her India visit, pilot and implement evaluation recommendations on international social procurement conditions, and that PIANOo has worked with local authorities on procurement tools.
I am in discussion with the relevant trade organisations about the support the government can offer the sectors to reach IMVO agreements.
Ik ben in gesprek met de desbetreffende brancheorganisaties over de ondersteuning die de overheid kan bieden aan de sectoren om te komen tot IMVO afspraken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Teeven over de berichten “Welzijn scharrelvarken niet beter dan gangbaar” en “Welzijn straalt uit naar buren”

MPs Lodders and Teeven (VVD) asked whether animal welfare standards in the EU and in Denmark and Germany are raising Dutch pig farming costs and weakening competitiveness, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that Dutch production costs are only modestly above EU peers, mostly due to environmental rules, and that the government will push for EU-level welfare standards and innovation without unilateral tightening.
I am in favour of tightening animal welfare requirements at European level because of the consequences for the competitiveness and future prospects of the Dutch pig sector.
Ik ben voorstander van het aanscherpen van dierwelzijnseisen op Europees niveau vanwege de gevolgen voor de concurrentiepositie en het toekomstperspectief van de Nederlandse varkenssector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over bericht Miljoenen mensen ontheemd door projecten Wereldbank

An SP MP asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about press reports that millions were displaced by World Bank-financed projects, including whether rules were broken, compensation, monitoring and the revised safeguards. The minister denies the 3.4 million figure, says land acquisition and resettlement are not in themselves rule violations, admits some monitoring gaps, and promises to raise concerns with the Bank and report after meetings.
The bank's policy is that all affected persons are compensated.
Het beleid van de bank is dat alle betrokkenen worden gecompenseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over de Burundezen die uit vrees voor mogelijk verkiezingsgeweld naar Rwanda vluchten

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers about reports of Burundians fleeing to Rwanda over fear of election-related violence, the role of the Imbonerakure, threats to journalists and activists, police and military involvement, the Cibitoke investigation, a possible third term for President Nkurunziza, and possible suspension of cooperation programmes. The government answers that the questions were already answered in a separate letter to the House (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163), so no new substantive answer is given here.

The written questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes (both PvdA), question number 2015Z07291, have been answered by means of the letter 'Reaction to committee request regarding the situation in Burundi and answer to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary Paper 29 237, no. 163).

Antwoord 1 t/m 7 De schriftelijke vragen van leden Van Laar en Servaes (beiden PvdA), vraagnummer 2015Z07291 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat EU-landen door het vrijhandelsakkoord tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP) nieuwe wetten moeten toetsen op de impact die zij hebben op bedrijven

MP Jasper van Dijk asked whether EU-US TTIP would require new laws to be screened for impact on business, how this squares with his motion for a regulatory cooperation body with only advisory powers, and whether national parliaments keep full legislative freedom and a real say in ratification. Minister Ploumen answered that the regulatory cooperation body would only have an advisory role, that broad consultation including unions and consumer groups is planned, that parliaments keep full lawmaking power, and that the Netherlands treats TTIP as a mixed agreement requiring parliamentary approval before entry into force.
The regulatory body therefore only has an advisory power.
De regulerende instantie beschikt daarmee alleen over een adviesrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat België de politiesamenwerking met Burundi en steun aan verkiezingen opschort

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Belgium's suspension of police cooperation with Burundi, including whether Dutch-trained police had shot civilians, whether the Netherlands would follow suit, and whether other bilateral aid would be suspended. The government answered that these questions had already been answered in a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163), so no new substantive answer was given here.

The written questions from MP Sjoerdsma (D66), question number 2015Z08596, have been answered by the letter 'Response to committee request regarding the situation in Burundi and answers to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary paper 29 237, no. 163).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma (D66), vraagnummer 2015Z08596 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt over de situatie in Burundi en de inzet van Nederland om escalatie (zoals massamoord en mogelijke genocide) te voorkomen

CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Burundi crisis over President Nkurunziza's third term, the court ruling, possible genocide risk, Dutch diplomatic and aid responses, and sanctions. The government answer refers the MPs to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163) answering these questions rather than answering them in this document.

The written questions from MPs Agnes Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt (all CDA), question number 2015Z08595, have been answered by the letter 'Response to committee request on the situation in Burundi and answer to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary paper 29 237, no. 163).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt (allen CDA), vraagnummer 2015Z08595 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Kerstens over het Trans-Atlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) en arbeidsnormen, REACH, REFIT en chemische ontsmetting van kippenvlees

MPs Jan Vos and Kerstens asked the government about TTIP and labour standards (ILO conventions, enforcement), REACH and REFIT, and chemical decontamination of chicken with peracetic acid. The minister answered that ILO core conventions are an essential element of the trade chapter, that REACH and national labour rules are not on the table, that REFIT runs separately from TTIP, and that any peracetic acid approval must follow EU risk assessment and member state voting.
I will ask the Social and Economic Council (SER) for advice on this.
Ik zal de sociaaleconomische Raad (SER) hierover om advies vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over situatie in Jemen

An MP asked the minister about the humanitarian situation in Yemen and about the total Dutch aid spent there, and whether Dutch funding should stop. The minister confirmed the reports, gave the cumulative aid figure of about USD 1 billion and described programme results, and said the development relationship will continue with the programme adjusted to the war, promising to inform the House shortly.
The cabinet will inform the House about this shortly, in line with the commitment in the letter on the temporary closure of the Sana'a post.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer hierover op korte termijn informeren, in lijn met de toezegging in de Kamerbrief over de tijdelijke sluiting van de post Sana’a

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Servaes over het bericht dat Engeland ruim vijf miljard pond heeft uitgegeven aan wapenexport naar landen die op de zwarte lijst staan wegens mensenrechtenschendingen

Two Dutch MPs asked the ministers about a UK parliamentary report criticising British arms exports to countries of human rights concern, and about how EU member states can hold each other to account on arms export policy. The government answered that licensing decisions are national competences, that the UK report lacks end-use data, and that it will consult partners on the D66/PvdA proposals for an EU arms export authority and a right to challenge, which it considers constrained by EU-national competence division.
The cabinet will nevertheless consult European partners on this idea, starting with the most like-minded on further EU harmonisation.
Het kabinet zal de Europese partners evenwel over dit idee consulteren, om te beginnen de meest gelijkgestemden op het gebied van verdere EU-harmonisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de gevolgen van de ISDS-clausules in Nederlandse handelsverdragen voor ontwikkelingslanden

MP Thieme asked the minister whether ISDS clauses let investors claim compensation from developing countries for public-interest regulation, and about the scale of use and treaty shopping. The minister defended ISDS as a needed safeguard, described the EU reform proposals and a renegotiation plan for the 92 Dutch BITs, and agreed to explore substance requirements against treaty shopping.
I am willing to examine the extent to which it is possible to include a provision in BITs under which only companies carrying out substantial economic activities could use the treaty benefits.

Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken in hoeverre het mogelijk is om in IBO's een bepaling op te nemen, waarbij alleen bedrijven die substantiële economische activiteiten ontplooien, gebruik zouden kunnen maken van de verdragsvoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP) en de komst van de "azijnkip"

An SP MP asks the trade minister whether the EU will admit peracetic acid washing of US chicken ('azijnkip') under TTIP, and how this relates to food safety, farmer competition, investor-state arbitration and regulatory cooperation. The minister replies that such applications follow EU procedures with EFSA risk assessment, that food standards will not be conceded, and that EU regulatory autonomy and the rule against lowering standards are preserved.
I have emphasised that no concessions will be made on European food standards.
Ik heb benadrukt dat er aan de Europese voedselstandaarden geen concessies zullen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Jan Vos over het anti-dumping onderzoek naar de import van Transformatorstaal in de EU

MPs Teeven and Jan Vos asked whether EU anti-dumping duties on grain-oriented electrical steel (GOES) are justified and whether they threaten Dutch jobs, and what the government will do. The minister answered that the Commission found dumping and injury, that recent world price rises and quality issues need clarification, that Netherlands asked the Commission for clarity and will take a critical stance in the consultation, but that the government does not compensate firms for anti-dumping measures.
The Netherlands has asked the Commission to provide clarity on the basis for the anti-dumping duties.
Nederland heeft de Commissie verzocht duidelijkheid te verschaffen over de grondslag voor de antidumping heffingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over het artikel “Experts kritisch op wapenexportplan”

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked the ministers about a press report criticising the arms export plan, including CDIU consultation, the timing and validity of export licences, and EU-level distortion of competition through state-owned shipyards. Minister Ploumen answered that licences are issued before delivery with a prior sounding procedure available, that licences usually run one year, and that the EU has long worked to reduce competition distortion in defence procurement.
A licence is issued prior to the actual delivery of the goods.
Een vergunning wordt verstrekt voorafgaand aan de daadwerkelijke levering van de goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over het bericht dat de Nederlandse ambassade in Zuid-Afrika anti-blanke quota’s promoot

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked whether the Dutch embassy in South Africa promoting a helpdesk on Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment amounts to promoting anti-white quotas, and whether embassies should promote such laws. The minister answered that the helpdesk helps Dutch firms navigate an existing legal reality, that she did not know the cited research, and that embassies do not promote racial laws.
The helpdesk was set up to assist Dutch entrepreneurs in dealing with the BBBEE rules in order to increase their opportunities on the South African market.
De helpdesk is opgezet om Nederlandse ondernemers te assisteren bij het omgaan met de regels voor BBBEE om zo hun kansen op de Zuid-Afrikaanse markt te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Laar over moderne slavernij en kinderarbeid in de kledingindustrie in India

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Van Laar asked the government about modern slavery and child labour in the South Indian textile industry, including reported deaths and abuse of girls under the Sumangali scheme, and what Dutch action is planned. The minister answered that the embassy and industry are engaged in multi-stakeholder initiatives, the MVO conference will explore EU-level supply chain measures, and the ILO and OECD frameworks are used to press India on forced and child labour standards.
Once the initiative takes firm shape, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will consider how this initiative can be supported.
Zodra het initiatief vaste vormen aanneemt, zal het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken bezien op welke manier dit initiatief ondersteund kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over het bericht "Remove Paul Kruger statue within 7 days, or else: EFF"

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked about an EFF ultimatum to remove the Paul Kruger statue in South Africa, including whether the Dutch embassy would act to protect it and whether the Culture Minister would seek UNESCO listing. The government answered that the matter is internal to South Africa, that the embassy has taken no action since no Dutch persons or property are involved, and that South African authorities decide on heritage and on responding to the EFF.
This concerns an internal South African matter in which no Dutch persons or property are involved.
Het betreft hier een interne Zuid-Afrikaanse zaak waarbij geen Nederlandse personen of bezittingen betrokken zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Berndsen-Jansen, Van Weyenberg en Koolmees over het bericht dat een farmaceutisch bedrijf dat zich onlangs in Nederland heeft gevestigd, doodstraf-medicatie levert aan de Amerik

MPs from D66 asked whether Dutch-based pharmaceutical company Mylan supplies the muscle relaxant rocuronium bromide for US executions, whether this conflicts with the EU export ban and Dutch policy against the death penalty, whether pension funds should keep investing, whether tax rulings were involved, and whether Mylan will stop. The government neither confirmed nor denied the supply, said the EU export regulation does not cover the drug, pledged to propose adding it to the list and to raise the matter with Mylan, and declined to disclose tax ruling details citing confidentiality law.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not permit disclosing information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer, such as Mylan in this case.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat niet toe informatie bekend te maken over de belastingpositie van een individuele belastingplichtige, zoals in het onderhavige geval Mylan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het bericht "TTIP-akkoord bedreigt de democratie"

An MP asked the trade minister whether the TTIP deal threatens democracy, whether talks at the Riga informal EU meeting exposed obstacles to a 2015 deal, and for a timeline. The minister said TTIP does not override EU laws, that Parliament will be involved in ratification, and that the EU aims to conclude talks by end 2015 while prioritising substance over speed.
As with every RBZ, I send a report of it to the House.
Zoals met elke RBZ stuur ik een verslag daarvan naar de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Servaes en Van Laar over de uitkomst van de VN-commissie over vrouwenrechten van 13 maart 2015

MPs Yücel, Servaes and Van Laar asked about the outcome of the 2015 UN Commission on the Status of Women, including concerns that the political declaration weakened women's rights, that conservative states blocked references to harmful practices and sexual and reproductive rights, and that NGOs were excluded. The minister acknowledges difficult negotiations and the absence of specific references but argues there is no regression from Beijing, describes Dutch efforts and dialogue with conservative actors, and commits to continued advocacy.
However, with this political declaration there is no regression compared with the commitments made in 1995, because all member states reaffirmed the full Beijing agenda.
Echter, met deze politieke verklaring is geen sprake van achteruitgang ten opzichte van de afspraken gemaakt in 1995, omdat alle lidstaten de volledige Beijing agenda hebben herbevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over het rapport van Oxfam Novib over investeringen van de Wereldbank

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Oxfam Novib report alleging misuse of International Finance Corporation (IFC) investment funds and lack of public disclosure. The Minister acknowledged the report, said it contains little new information, promised to raise its recommendations with IFC, and rejected the idea of reconsidering Dutch contributions.
I will closely monitor the results of that dialogue.
Ik zal de resultaten van die dialoog nauwlettend in de gaten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het TTIP vrijhandelsverdrag en het Nederlandse zorgstelsel

Two MPs asked the ministers whether TTIP's health-services reservation protects the Dutch healthcare system, whether UKIP-style investor claims against national health policy are a risk, and whether the government will pursue opt-outs and more individual choice in health insurance. The government replied that the EU reserves the right to regulate publicly funded health services, that investor protection rules apply only to breaches of standards with compensation for expropriation, that the Netherlands seeks maximum policy freedom, and that no opt-outs are needed because healthcare remains a national competence.
As a result, EU Member States can themselves determine how they organise their public services.
Hierdoor kunnen EU Lidstaten zelf bepalen hoe zij hun publieke diensten inrichten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de dreigende toelating van Amerikaanse chloorkippen tot de Europese markt

MP Thieme asks whether the EU will lift its ban on chlorine-washed American chicken before end-2015, linked to TTIP, and whether this erodes EU food and environmental standards, including on cloned-animal products and endocrine disruptors. The minister replies that such chicken is not admitted, that the EU ban on hormone-treated beef is kept under the precautionary principle, that the Commission has committed to keeping EU standards in TTIP talks, and that EFSA found no health differences for clone offspring.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Jasper van Dijk over de resultaten van de economische missie naar Abu Dhabi en wapenhandel met Saoedi-Arabië

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Damen Shipyards naval contract with the UAE, whether it fell under Dutch arms-export criteria, the role of the Defence Minister at the Abu Dhabi fair, and why the Netherlands does not follow Sweden in halting arms trade with Saudi Arabia. The government answered that the contract dated from 2013, that export licences are assessed case by case against the EU Common Position criteria, that no credit guarantees or government-brokered contracts were involved at the fair, and that Sweden's decision concerned a memorandum rather than a trade halt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de slechte positie van cacaoboeren in de productieketen

MP Voordewind asked the minister about the weak position of cocoa farmers in the supply chain, who live far below the poverty line, and whether certification and the sustainability initiatives IDH and Solidaridad address this, including a living-income requirement, market concentration research and dialogue with companies. The minister replied that certification, productivity gains, land access and financing help raise farmer incomes, that IDH subsidy terms now target living incomes, and that dialogue continues within existing consultations, but no new binding measures were committed.
I am in discussion with sustainability initiatives and companies about the challenges in the cocoa sector.
Ik ben in gesprek met verduurzamingsinitiatieven en bedrijven over de uitdagingen in de cacaosector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht 'recordbedrag aan buitenlandse investeringen'.

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the record foreign investment figures were inflated by one wind park investment costing taxpayers billions in subsidy, and whether foreign investment created fewer jobs and more closures in 2014. The government answered that NFIA support cost about 13 million euro, that the Gemini wind park is half the total, that jobs rose on the 2013 figures except for one year, and that net job effects of foreign investors are positive, while it does not know the revenue lost from closures.
It is not known what revenue the Netherlands has missed as a result.
Het is niet bekend welke inkomsten Nederland hiermee is misgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Leegte over de strijd tegen ivoorhandel

MPs Smaling and Leegte asked the government about China's temporary ivory ban, NGO claims of window dressing, poaching trends, and how to combat wildlife crime. The state secretary welcomed China's steps, outlined poaching trends, and described the planned use of funds and CITES follow-up without committing to new oversight mechanisms.
I see the measure, a temporary ban on the ivory trade, as a recognition by China that destination countries also bear a great responsibility for combating wildlife crime.
Ik zie de maatregel, een tijdelijk verbod op de handel in ivoor, als een erkenning van China dat ook destinatielanden een grote verantwoordelijkheid hebben om wildlife crime tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de situatie in Gaza, een half jaar na het staakt-het-vuren

An MP asked the ministers about the humanitarian and reconstruction situation in Gaza six months after the ceasefire, including building-material imports, the Rafah crossing, Palestinian Authority role, donor shortfalls and the Cairo pledges. The government acknowledged serious concern, described the Gaza Reconstruction Mechanism as adequate for housing materials, and said it raises the issues bilaterally and multilaterally, though it gave no comprehensive list of unfulfilled pledges.
The cabinet itself does not have a detailed overview of all pledges.
Het kabinet heeft zelf geen gedetailleerd overzicht van alle toezeggingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over EU-steun voor guerrilla’s in Guatemala

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch and EU funding to Guatemalan NGOs, including a €2.5 million regional human rights fund, may have reached Marxist guerrillas, and asked for lists of funded NGOs. The minister said the government has no knowledge of support to Marxist guerrillas, pointed to a 2013 IOB evaluation, and gave partial overviews of MAP partners and EU funding while noting some amounts are hard to determine.
The cabinet has no knowledge of support to Marxist guerrillas.
Het kabinet heeft geen kennis over steun aan marxistische guerrilla’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de economische missie naar Abu Dhabi

An MP asked the Defence and Trade ministers whether the February 2015 economic mission to Abu Dhabi and the IDEX defence fair aimed at arms exports, and how the government would manage the risk of arms exports fuelling instability and rights abuses in the MENA region. The government answered that the mission supports the defence and security industry under the Defence Industry Strategy, that export licences are assessed against the EU Common Position criteria, and that it will not reconsider attendance.
If this assessment against the EUGS criteria is negative, the export licence is refused.
Indien deze toets aan de EUGS-criteria negatief uitvalt, wordt de exportvergunning afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over het rapport van Human Rights Watch, waarin de organisatie melding maakt van 47 buitengerechtelijke executies in Burundi

MP De Caluwé asked the minister about the HRW report on 47 extrajudicial killings in Burundi and whether Dutch rule-of-law funding reached the implicated units. The minister confirmed the report, said Dutch-funded police and army programmes may have touched individuals involved, and reported requesting an independent Burundian investigation, with conditional threats to suspend aid.
The Netherlands will urge the Burundian government to expand the investigative commission with members of Burundian civil society.
Nederland zal er bij de Burundese overheid op aandringen om de onderzoekscommissie uit te breiden met leden van het Burundese maatschappelijk middenveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over het bericht “EU doneert 234 miljoen aan Zimbabwe”

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the EU is donating 234 million euros to Zimbabwe, including whether it is budget support, what conditions apply, and whether sanctions on the regime should preclude such aid. The minister answered that the programme is not budget support, targets health and rural development via non-state and international partners, and that restoring aid relations is separate from sanctions on President Mugabe, which were extended for one year.
No budget support is provided from the programme.
Vanuit het programma wordt geen begrotingssteun verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over slechte werkomstandigheden en kinderarbeid in textielfabrieken in Bangladesh en Turkse katoenproductie

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour and poor working conditions in Bangladeshi garment factories and in Turkish cotton production, including subcontracting under the Bangladesh Accord and forged identity documents. The Minister acknowledges the problems, says child labour has declined in BGMEA-affiliated factories, and promises to raise the issues with the Bangladeshi government and the Accord management during a June visit.
I will discuss this with the Bangladeshi government during my visit to Bangladesh in June.
Ik zal dit tijdens mijn bezoek aan Bangladesh in juni met de overheid van Bangladesh bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het opnemen van het investeringsgeschillenbeslechtingsmechanisme (ISDS) in het Vrijhandelsakkoord van de EU met Canada (CETA)

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade whether she would take up the EU public consultation's criticism of investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) in CETA and TTIP, including the Franco-German call to revisit CETA. The minister answered that the consultation results feed a broader EU debate on an improved ISDS standard, that Netherlands will join the debate, and that it will consult stakeholders on the Dutch position.
I am of the view that conducting a focused debate to arrive at an EU approach to ISDS will strengthen the EU's negotiating position against the US.
Ik ben van mening dat het voeren van een gefocust debat om tot een EU-benadering van ISDS te komen, de onderhandelingspositie van de EU tegenover de VS zal versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de stop op Duitse wapenexport naar Saoedi-Arabië

De Roon (PVV) asked whether Germany had halted arms exports to Saudi Arabia, on what grounds, whether the Netherlands was informed, and whether the Netherlands would also stop exports. Minister Koenders replied that media reports of a German halt were incorrect, that Dutch and German case-by-case assessments continue, and that the government opposes a unilateral total stop.
The cabinet is not in favour of a全 general stop on arms exports to Saudi Arabia.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van een algehele stop op wapenexport naar Saudi-Arabië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Kerstens over de gevolgen van het Trans-Atlantic Trade and Investment Partnership voor de werkgelegenheid

MPs Jan Vos and Kerstens asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a Tufts working paper claiming TTIP would cause large job losses and a negative trade balance, and about related methodological criticism. The minister rejected the paper's key assumptions, argued the CGE model is the best available tool, cited Commission and Ecorys estimates of positive effects, and agreed to invite its author for a meeting.
I will invite Capaldo for a conversation.
Ik zal Capaldo uitnodigen voor een gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ontwikkelingen rond het vrijhandelsakkoord tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP)

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about TTIP, covering the ratification process, labour rights, the Capaldo study on job losses, the stop-TTIP petition and ISDS arbitration. The minister answered that all parliaments must ratify a mixed agreement, that a labour clause protects social rules, that the Commission's ISDS consultation is being followed up, and that she opposes halting negotiations.
Once the negotiations are concluded, the European Council and the European Parliament will still have to approve the agreement.
Als de onderhandelingen zijn afgerond, zal de Europese Raad, het Europees parlement het akkoord nog moeten goedkeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over Conflict-Free Tin Initiative

An MP asked the minister whether an evaluation of the Conflict-Free Tin Initiative pilot in Congo had been ordered, whether it would assess stability and socio-economic effects, and how the minister responded to expert criticism and the EU conflict minerals regulation. The minister replied that no evaluation was commissioned, but a mid-term evaluation is planned for late 2016, and defended the initiative as compatible with the EU's voluntary certification approach.
No assignment has been given for carrying out an evaluation.
Er is geen opdracht gegeven voor het uitvoeren van een evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse steun aan het Jordaanse Media Instituut in relatie tot uitlatingen over Hamas

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the ministers whether Dutch support to the Jordan Media Institute was acceptable given that an article on its website praised a Hamas-linked figure as a role model, and whether funding should be withdrawn or other donors urged to stop. The minister answered that the funded women's rights project had no link to the article, the institute said the article was written by a student and has been removed, and there is no reason to reclaim funds or urge other donors to act.
There is no connection whatsoever between the article on the JMI website and the project supported by the Netherlands.
Er is geen enkele relatie tussen het artikel op de website van het JMI en het door Nederland gesteunde project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de dolfijnenslachtingen door Japan en de Faeröer en het plan van Japan om de walvisjacht weer te hervatten

An MP asked the government about dolphin hunts in Japan and the Faroe Islands, Danish police role, whether Japan would resume Antarctic whaling despite the ICJ ruling, and the EU-Japan trade and framework agreements. The ministers said Denmark would be pressed on dolphin killings, the ICJ ruling strengthens opposition to whaling, and whaling and dolphin killing would be raised in the EU-Japan framework negotiations, though no EU consensus exists on linking trade to whaling.
The cabinet will again address Denmark and indicate that killing dolphins, as happens in the Faroe Islands, is not acceptable.
Het kabinet zal Denemarken opnieuw aanspreken en aangeven dat het doden van dolfijnen, zoals dit gebeurt op de Faeröer eilanden, niet acceptabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de vulkaanuitbarsting op Fogo, Kaapverdië

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Fogo volcano eruption in Cape Verde, including the situation on the island, EU and member state assistance, and whether the Netherlands would contribute. The minister described evacuations and EU in-kind aid, and said the Netherlands was not for now considering a contribution to the IFRC appeal, while monitoring the situation.
The Cabinet is not currently considering making a contribution.
Het Kabinet overweegt vooralsnog niet een bijdrage te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Sjoerdsma over gaten in de huidige ebola-hulpverlening

MPs Van Laar and Sjoerdsma asked the minister about gaps in Ebola aid in West Africa, including delayed deployment of pledged UK hospital beds and whether a more flexible approach is needed. The minister acknowledges remaining gaps, points to labs, flexible NGO funding and a new NGO financing facility, but rejects the claim that aid is misaligned with needs and says there is no EU biological disaster team.
I do not share that view. WHO and UNMEER continuously analyse needs on the ground.
Ik deel die visie niet. WHO en UNMEER maken een doorlopende analyse van de noden ter plaatse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de effecten van spaargroepen

An MP asked the minister about a randomized evaluation finding only small effects of savings groups in Mali and whether Dutch funding supports such groups. The minister acknowledged the study, said savings groups are not a specific focus of Dutch policy, and pointed to broader financial sector programmes instead.
I do not specifically focus on savings groups, so the findings of this report have no direct effect on my policy.
Ik zet niet specifiek in op spaargroepen, daarom hebben de uitkomsten van dit rapport geen direct effect op mijn beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Smaling over Vluchtelingensituatie in Turkije

MPs Gesthuizen and Smaling asked the government to respond to Amnesty International's report on Syrian refugees in Turkey, including alleged shootings of refugees at the border and forced returns. The government denied structural forced returns, attributed the incidents to a period before the Kobani surge, and pointed to Dutch humanitarian funding of EUR 30 million and EUR 12 million for 2015 with a resettlement quota of 250 Syrians.
The cabinet does not believe there are structural problems regarding forced return of Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat er sprake is van structurele problemen met betrekking tot gedwongen terugkeer van Syrische vluchtelingen uit Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over ‘voluntoerisme’ en internationaal vrijwilligerswerk in weeshuizen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch subsidies under the MillenniumDoen! programme funded volunteering in orphanages abroad, whether those placements were checked, and what role the ministry and embassies should play in warning volunteers. The minister answered that the ministry does not hold a primary controlling role over youth volunteering organisations, that SBOS subsidies were checked on 'do no harm' criteria and are now discontinued, and that awareness-raising and embassy signalling are the main tools.
The cabinet does not see a primary or controlling role for itself in the field of youth travel and international volunteer work.
Het kabinet ziet in het veld van jongerenreizen en internationaal vrijwilligerswerk voor zichzelf geen primaire of controlerende rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over achterblijvende resultaten om meer vrouwen te betrekken bij militaire vredesmissies

MPs Hachchi and Sjoerdsma asked why women remain underrepresented in the Dutch armed forces and UN peacekeeping missions, and whether further research and a revised national action plan on UNSCR 1325 are planned. The ministers answered that quality is the main criterion, that gender is treated as operationally relevant, that further research is not opportune, and that a February 2015 conference and the 2015 UN review will inform the next action plan.
Further research is not considered opportune at this time.
Nader onderzoek achten wij nu niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Schouw over Brandpunt uitzending "De lange arm van Kagame"

MPs Sjoerdsma and Schouw asked the government to respond to a Brandpunt broadcast alleging that a Rwandan whistleblower's asylum-related reports were manipulated and questioning Rwandan fair-trial guarantees. The government rejected the claims, said the matter was handled through the proper channel with the court, declined further investigation, and described Rwanda's judicial standards.
Because his statements concern individual asylum cases, the cabinet is bound by confidentiality and cannot go into concrete details.
Omdat zijn uitspraken individuele asielzaken betreffen is het kabinet gebonden aan vertrouwelijkheid en kan niet ingaan op concrete details.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het wapenembargo tegen Rusland, de Franse Mistraldeal en samenwerking tussen Europese wapenleveranciers en Russische strijdkrachten

Two MPs asked whether the Mistral helicopter carrier deal would be delivered to Russia despite the arms embargo, how Europe's arms makers could cooperate with Russian forces, and about the embargo's status and enforcement. The minister replied that France decides on delivery, that the government shares France's view that conditions are not right for delivery, that the embargo does not cover pre-August 2014 contracts, that it runs until 31 July 2015, and that the Netherlands will raise enforcement issues in Brussels.
The government has no insight into deliveries above 1 million euros from EU member states based on contracts concluded before 1 August 2014.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in leveringen van boven de 1 miljoen euro vanuit EU-lidstaten op basis van voor 1 augustus 2014 gesloten contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mohandis over het verbod voor studenten van de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA) om voor stage of studie af te reizen naar Afrika

MPs Van Laar and Mohandis asked the ministers whether they know of the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences ban on student internships and study trips to Africa, and whether they agree that Africa should not be treated as one region. The minister acknowledged the ban is not absolute, agreed that per-country risk assessment is better, and said institutions set their own policy while the government advises following the Foreign Affairs travel advice without issuing binding national guidelines.
It is up to the institutions themselves to determine their policy in this matter; I will not draw up national guidelines on this.
Het is aan de instellingen zelf om in hierin hun beleid te bepalen, ik zal daarover geen landelijke richtlijnen opstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over de investeringsbescherming (ISDS) in het handelsverdrag tussen de VS en de EU (TTIP)

An SP MP asked the Dutch Minister for Foreign Trade about reports that EU Commissioner Timmermans would have a veto over investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) in TTIP, whether ISDS is effectively dropped, and whether TTIP should go to national parliaments as a mixed agreement. The minister answered that the Commission decides collegially, that the final ISDS position awaits a consultation analysis and EU institutional approval, and that the government supports improving ISDS and treating TTIP as a mixed agreement.
The Netherlands is committed to ensuring these improvements to the ISDS instrument are incorporated into TTIP.
Nederland zet erop in dat die verbeteringen in het ISDS-instrument in TTIP worden verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het beschikbaar stellen van noodhulpfondsen voor kleine NGO's

MP Agnes Mulder asks whether the minister will expand emergency Ebola funding to small NGOs with local networks and relax the Framework Partnership Agreement requirement for them. Minister Ploumen answers that funding goes mainly via the UN and large NGOs for coordination reasons, that small NGOs may submit proposals that fit a coordinated approach, and that the FPA requirement stays to ensure quality and accountability.
To qualify for funding from the emergency aid budget and the Relief Fund, NGOs must from 2015 hold an FPA.
Om in aanmerking te komen voor financiering uit de begroting voor noodhulp en het Relief Fund moeten NGO's met ingang van 2015 beschikken over een FPA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Smaling en Ouwehand over het bericht dat de EU ervan afziet om teerzandolie te labelen

MPs Jasper van Dijk, Smaling and Ouwehand asked whether the EU's dropping of a separate label for tar sands oil, its impact on climate ambitions, CETA and TTIP, and possible import bans or labelling are acceptable. The State Secretary answered that tar sands oil is still legally importable, that no import ban or consumer labelling is feasible given traceability limits, and that EU climate targets are not weakened.
I have no plans to exclude tar sands oil from the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen plannen om teerzandolie te weren uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Van Ojik over Textiel/Bangladesh, Compensatie Rana Plaza slachtoffers

MPs asked the minister what results followed their call for companies to compensate Rana Plaza victims, how to fill the half-empty fund, whether Dutch firms must sign the Bangladesh safety accord, and about supply-chain transparency and safety nets for workers. The minister reported an extra 2 million USD raising the fund to 19.4 million of the needed 40 million, said companies bear responsibility, and noted voluntary contributions and ongoing IMVO covenant talks.
I will continue to raise this issue with my colleagues and the government of Bangladesh.
Ik blijf dit onderwerp bij mijn collega’s en de overheid in Bangladesh agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over moderne slavernij en kinderarbeid in India

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers about the Flawed Fabrics report on modern slavery and child labour in Indian textile supply chains, and whether mandatory supply-chain transparency and due diligence should be introduced. The minister answered that voluntary sector approaches are still early, that she is open to exploring EU-level mandatory due diligence, and that she raised the issue during her India visit and with the ILO, EU and OECD.

I am in favour of creating a more level playing field in terms of regulation. In that context I am willing to explore whether there are possibilities at European level to achieve mandatory supply-chain transparency and due diligence.

Ik ben wel voorstander van het creëren van een meer gelijk speelveld op het gebied van regelgeving. In dat kader ben ik bereid te verkennen of er in Europees verband mogelijkheden zijn om te komen tot verplichte keten transparantie en due diligence.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over eerste ebola-besmetting in Mali

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the first Ebola case in Mali, its risk of a large outbreak, Dutch partner organisations' role and whether Mali lacks funds. The minister confirmed the case, said Mali has prepared since March with contact tracing and quarantine, and that Dutch funding supports the national plan while priority remains in the three worst-affected countries.
To date, no local Ebola infection in Mali has been reported.
Tot op heden is er nog geen melding gemaakt van lokale ebola-besmetting in Mali.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwe over het bericht "geen verzekering voor ebola-arts"

An MP asked whether the government should guarantee medical repatriation and reserve funds so Dutch doctors willing to treat Ebola patients are not left uninsured. The minister answered that repatriation remains primarily the responsibility of employers and insurers, with the government stepping in only if they cannot arrange it, backed by a US aircraft arrangement and an EU guarantee.
The starting point is that responsibility lies in the first instance with the insurer and the employer.
Uitgangspunt is dat de verantwoordelijkheid in eerste instantie bij de verzekeraar en de werkgever ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de dreigende hongersnood in Zuid-Sudan

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Oxfam Novib's report on looming famine in South Sudan, including whether the Netherlands would increase its efforts, provide logistical support, protect women better through UNMISS, and push diplomacy. The Minister confirmed the seriousness, cited suspended direct aid to the central government, humanitarian funding of about 18 million euro plus 3 million for UNHCR, said Defence assets were not requested, and stressed that IGAD-led peace talks are the key channel.
On the deployment of the available humanitarian funds for 2015 I will decide early next year, based on global needs.
Over de inzet van de beschikbare humanitaire fondsen voor 2015 zal ik begin volgend jaar beslissen, op basis van wereldwijde noden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de verlaging van de huwbare leeftijd in Bangladesh

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Bangladesh's proposal to lower the marriage age for girls from 18 to 16, and whether the Netherlands would act on it. The minister fully agreed that child marriage is harmful, called the proposal contrary to international human rights treaties, said embassy and partners would raise concerns with Bangladeshi authorities, and listed existing Dutch-funded NGO projects against child marriage.

The Bengali proposal to lower the marriageable age for girls from 18 to 16 is, among other things, contrary to the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW) and the Convention on the Rights of the Child.

Het Bengaalse voorstel om de huwbare leeftijd voor meisjes te verlagen van 18 jaar naar 16 jaar is onder andere in strijd met de Universele Verklaring voor de Rechten van de Mens, de Conventie voor uitbanning van alle vormen van discriminatie van vrouwen (CEDAW) en het Kinderrechtenverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de ‘trendbreuk van Nederland als voortrekker in het agenderen van taboedoorbrekende onderwerpen’

An MP asks whether the minister's UN ICPD speech signalled a break from the Netherlands' progressive stance on sexual and reproductive rights, and why she did not explicitly endorse the ICPD reports. The minister rejects any break, says Dutch advocacy is consistent, and that dialogue with less progressive partners such as the Vatican is needed.
There is therefore by no means a break in trend, which would also be strange given my years of personal commitment and involvement in the subject.
Er is dus geenszins sprake van een trendbreuk, hetgeen ook vreemd zou zijn gezien mijn jarenlange persoonlijke inzet en betrokkenheid bij het onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het eenzijdig aanpassen van de procedure met betrekking tot het strategisch partnerschap

Labour MP Van Laar asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the ministry unilaterally changed the procedure for strategic partnerships, including a delay in the eligibility assessment, a tight pitch schedule disadvantaging southern applicants, and risks to timely start-up. The minister denied unilateral changes, said the process follows previously communicated rules with a final outcome by 31 October and partner selection by 31 January 2015, and offered flexibility on pitch dates.
That the rules would be changed unilaterally is, incidentally, not correct.
Dat eenzijdig de spelregels zouden worden veranderd klopt overigens niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht ‘Nog even en de olifant is uitgestorven’

An SP MP asked the government about reports of rapid declines in wildlife populations, poaching and illegal ivory trade, and what Dutch development and enforcement efforts are doing about it. The government answered that it funds about one million euro a year for anti-poaching projects, supports international enforcement cooperation, and raises the issue in CITES, UNEP and EU forums, while noting that most measures are still being prepared.

For the next four years, one million euro per year has been set aside within the Ministry of Economic Affairs budget to finance specific programmes and projects combating poaching and illegal wildlife trade.

Voor de komende vier jaar is binnen de begroting van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, één miljoen euro per jaar vrijgemaakt om specifieke programma's en projecten te financieren in de strijd tegen stroperij en de illegale handel in wilde dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over activiteiten van Stichting Kinderpostzegels

An MP asked the minister whether the government will investigate subsidised 'anti-Israeli' support by charities such as Stichting Kinderpostzegels, after Urk boycotted the foundation over a project in the Palestinian territories, and why it receives over a million euro in government subsidy. The minister rejected the characterisation, defended the project and the partnership model, and saw no reason for a broad investigation beyond existing reporting obligations.
I see no reason for an investigation such as the one the questioner refers to.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een onderzoek als waar vragensteller naar verwijst.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Laar over de invloed van de humanitaire crisis op de ontwikkelingssamenwerking van Nederland met Jemen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the humanitarian crisis in Yemen affects Dutch development cooperation there, including the multi-year strategic plan, water, SRGR and rule-of-law programmes, and the NICHE higher-education programme. The Minister answered that no results have been reversed so far, that it is too early to judge effects on the strategic plan, and that monitoring projects has become difficult because travel is restricted.
It is too early to determine whether the current crisis has consequences for the Netherlands' multi-year strategic plan for Yemen.
Het is te vroeg om te kunnen bepalen of de huidige crisis gevolgen heeft voor het strategisch meerjarenplan van Nederland voor Jemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de vordering van het sleep- en bergingsbedrijf Multraship op de Roemeense overheid

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Romania's unpaid debt of around 13 million euro to the Dutch salvage firm Multraship, for clearing a wreck blocking the Danube, is a scandal, why it remains unpaid, and what measures the government will take to secure payment. The minister answered that the Dutch government is in intensive dialogue with Romania, which has acknowledged the debt, that the matter was raised at ministerial level and with the EIB, and that she cannot disclose other company cases for confidentiality reasons.
This concerns commercially confidential information that I do not make public.
Dit betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die ik niet openbaar maak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het interview met Martin Christie (Bettercoal) waarin hij pleit voor een behoedzame kolendialoog met Colombia

An MP asks the minister about Bettercoal's coal-mine audits in Colombia, the independence of the assessments, how audit results feed into the Dutch energy sector coal covenant, and what makes a stakeholder dialogue inclusive. The minister describes the audit process and says the covenant will not be finalised on 1 October because the ACM review is pending, but aims to conclude it before a November trip to Colombia.
I do aim to finalise the covenant before the trip to Colombia.
Ik streef wel naar afronding van het convenant vóór de reis naar Colombia.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over hulp aan Syrische vluchtelingen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Oxfam and UNICEF reports that international aid to Syria is insufficient, including whether Dutch pledges were paid, whether Dutch contributions are fair, and how to protect Syrian children. The Minister confirmed the funding gap, said all Dutch pledges were transferred, argued Dutch contributions exceed a fair share, and announced an extra 30 million euros for humanitarian aid, including 7 million for UNICEF psychosocial work.
For that reason I have decided to contribute an additional 30 million euros to humanitarian aid.
Om die reden heb ik besloten 30 miljoen euro extra bij te dragen aan de humanitaire hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over 130.000 vluchtelingen naar Turkije

An SP MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about reports that Turkey had closed border crossings to Syrian refugees and whether the Netherlands would press Turkey, offer more humanitarian aid, and resettle more refugees. The minister answered that Turkey reduced crossings to two rather than closing all, described Turkish reception and registration, pointed to 30 million euro in extra aid, and said resettlement would continue in 2015 with details to follow.
