To prevent further chaos, two border crossings remain open so that Turkey and UNHCR can register the refugees in a controlled manner.
Om verdere chaos te voorkomen blijven vooralsnog twee grensovergangen open zodat Turkije en UNHCR gecontroleerd de vluchtelingen kunnen registreren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over de Wereldomroep

An MP asked the minister about press reports of disagreement between the director and editor-in-chief of Radio Netherlands Worldwide, its financial viability, and whether an interim evaluation would be held. The minister replied that the ministry does not intervene in staff matters of subsidised organisations, that an external interim evaluation will take place in early 2015, and that consultation with RNW continues.
As is known, organisations subsidised by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs operate at arm's length and thus independently of the Ministry.
Zoals bekend functioneren door het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gesubsidieerde (maatschappelijke) organisaties «op afstand» en daarmee onafhankelijk van het Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Sjoerdsma over de strijd tegen Ebola

MPs Van Laar and Sjoerdsma asked the minister about the international Ebola response, the WHO's budget cuts and alleged poor choices, and what the Netherlands would contribute. The minister rejected the claim that the international community failed, described the logistical challenges, and announced 15 million euros from the emergency fund plus 1 million for practical support.
I do not share the view that the international community, including the WHO, has failed in its handling of the Ebola epidemic.
Ik deel de mening niet dat de internationale gemeenschap, inclusief de WHO, steken heeft laten vallen in de aanpak van de Ebola-epidemie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over onveilige kledingfabrieken in Bangladesh en het gebrek aan openheid van kledingbedrijven

MP Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the continued unsafe state of Bangladeshi garment factories, whether Dutch firms such as Mexx and Hunkemöller have signed the Safety Accord, the refusal of most Dutch signatories of the Bangladesh Accord to disclose suppliers, and whether transparency should be enforced. The answers are a referral to the letter 'Reactie op het bericht dat textielfabrieken in Bangladesh nog onveilig zijn' (Kamerstuk 33 625, nr. 121) without substantive answers in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat kledingfabrieken in Bangladesh nog onveilig zijn

MP Jan Vos (PvdA) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that garment factories in Bangladesh remain unsafe, including whether Dutch brands sourced from factories ordered closed and what steps they and the Bangladesh Accord take. The minister answered by referring to a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 33 625, nr. 121) that responds to these questions, without answering them in the document itself.

The written questions of MP Jan Vos (PvdA), question number 2014Z15028, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to the report that textile factories in Bangladesh are still unsafe and answers to the written questions of MPs Jan Vos and Voordewind'.

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Jan Vos (PvdA), vraagnummer 2014Z15028 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op het bericht dat textielfabrieken in Bangladesh nog onveilig zijn en beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Voordewind»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Merkies, Smaling over Toegang tot Medicijnen

SP MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she would hold Dutch insurers and pharmaceutical firms accountable for poor medicine access in poor countries, and whether insurers should use their investments to push for better access. The minister said investment policy is primarily the companies' own responsibility, pointed to voluntary initiatives and OECD/IMVO standards, and said she would invite the insurers' association to discuss the Access to Medicine Index.
Investment policy is primarily the responsibility of the companies themselves.
Het investeringsbeleid is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over het rapport Dark side of Coal van PAX

A parliamentary member asked the minister about criticism by Glencore and Drummond of the PAX report 'Dark side of Coal', including alleged lack of hoor- en wederhoor, subsidy support for litigation, and NGO codes of conduct. The minister replied that dialogue is important, that no extra subsidy for litigation is foreseen, that the Partos code requires hoor en wederhoor, and that the Istanbul Principles will inform future subsidy instruments.
These principles provide a useful guideline for transparency, mutual accountability and integrity.
Deze principes vormen een nuttige leidraad voor transparantie, wederzijdse verantwoording en integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Leegte over investeringen van Nederlandse bedrijven in de Palestijnse gebieden

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch government pressure discouraged Dutch firms from investing in the Palestinian territories, and whether the government would contact a company that suspended a joint venture. The minister replied that businesses decide their own activities, the government addresses firms involved in settlement activity and provides no services for it, and it will not intervene in the individual company's decision.
However, the cabinet does not interfere in the decisions of individual companies about their economic activities.
Het kabinet treedt echter niet in de beslissingen van individuele bedrijven over hun economische activiteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de gevolgen van het Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) en Trade in Services Agreement (TISA) voor financiële regulering

SP MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked about a leaked EU proposal on regulatory cooperation in financial services under TTIP and about the effects of TISA on financial regulation. Minister Ploumen answered that the EU aims only at institutional cooperation and consultation, not at weakening financial rules, and that TISA's financial provisions largely reaffirm existing GATS and standstill commitments.
Once enough parties have joined the TISA negotiations, I will also work to bring TISA under the WTO framework to safeguard the continuity of the global trading system.

Wanneer zich voldoende partijen bij de TISA-onderhandelingen hebben aangesloten, zal ik mij bovendien inzetten om TISA onder het raamwerk van de WTO te brengen om zo de continuïteit van het mondiale handelssysteem te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de Ebola-ziekte in West-Afrika

An MP asked the ministers about the Ebola epidemic in West Africa, including vaccine availability, international coordination, Dutch funding, travel advice and information for Dutch nationals. The minister answered that no vaccine or licensed treatment exists yet, listed WHO-led coordination and Dutch contributions of about 722,600 euro, and said travel advice was updated to refer to the outbreak.
It is correct that there is still no vaccine or effective treatment for Ebola.
Het klopt dat er nog geen vaccin of effectieve behandeling van Ebola is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht in The Washington Post van 5 juni jl. "Dutch aerospace company Fokker hit with $ 21 million fine in sanctions case."

MP Servaes asked the minister about reports that Fokker faced a $21 million US sanctions fine, whether the Dutch parent company was involved in exports to Iran, Sudan and Burma, whether the company deliberately evaded US restrictions, and whether the government had contacted the parent. The minister confirmed US requests for legal assistance and said the 2005-2010 violations occurred under a predecessor parent, that the subsidiary self-disclosed and cooperated, and that the matter is not part of a broader evasion strategy, while the court has yet to rule on the settlement.
Importantly, Fokker Services BV itself reported the violation of US sanctions to the US authorities through a voluntary self-disclosure and fully cooperated with the subsequent investigation.

Van belang is dat Fokker Services BV de overtreding van de Amerikaanse sancties zelf aanhangig heeft gemaakt bij de Amerikaanse autoriteiten via een «voluntary self disclosure» en volledig heeft meegewerkt bij het daaropvolgende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de rakettenregen van Hamas en Fatah onder toeziend oog van de terroristische Palestijnse “eenheidsregering"

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the Palestinian unity government and Fatah allowed rocket fire on Israel, whether the government condemned it, and whether all Dutch and EU financial and political support to the Palestinian government and Authority should be halted. The minister answered that the government condemns the rocket attacks, holds the technocratic government to its actions under the Quartet principles, and sees no reason to stop cooperation or funding since Hamas controls Gaza, not the new government.
On the basis of the above, the government sees no reason to stop cooperation with the Palestinian technocratic government.
Het kabinet ziet op grond van het bovenstaande geen aanleiding om de samenwerking met de Palestijnse technocratische regering stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het bericht dat in navolging van het IMF nu ook de Wereldbank begrotingsondersteuning aan Mali heeft opgeschort

An MP asked whether the Netherlands will follow the IMF and World Bank in suspending budget support to Mali over unexplained spending such as a presidential aircraft and an army equipment guarantee. The minister answered that the Netherlands gives no general budget support to Mali since the 2012 coup, that the IMF expects a temporary suspension with verification in September 2014, and that the Dutch aid will be reviewed then.
The cabinet will carefully weigh the findings of the IMF mission in September and, if necessary, take appropriate measures.
Het kabinet zal de bevindingen van de IMF-missie in september a.s. zorgvuldig wegen en, indien noodzakelijk, alsnog passende maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen en Van Laar over kinderarbeid en schending van andere arbeidsrechten

MPs Voordewind, Gesthuizen and Van Laar asked the minister about a Fair Labor Association study on child labour and long hours in Turkish hazelnut harvesting, and what the government, ILO, Turkish authorities and Dutch retailers and firms would do about it. The minister acknowledged the findings, said Turkey is primarily responsible, pointed to Dutch support for an ILO project and a 90,000 euro contribution, and said she raised the issue with Turkish officials and FNLI, which committed to a meeting with industry.
I have committed a contribution of 90,000 euros to the above-mentioned follow-up project of the ILO.
Ik heb hier een bijdrage van 90.000 euro toegezegd aan het hierboven genoemde vervolgproject van de ILO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber en Ouwehand over schaliegasboringen Argentinië

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie and PvdD asked the government about Shell's shale gas test drilling in Argentina, including proximity to a protected area, environmental information access, consultation and compensation for local farmers, and OECD guideline compliance. The minister answered that the drilling lies outside the current protected area, that Shell claims legal compliance and denies harm to livestock, that the embassy's 2013 site visit was routine economic diplomacy, and that OECD guideline questions fall to the National Contact Point.
Whether and to what extent the Environment and Information Disclosure chapters apply to Shell's activities in Vaca Muerta, I cannot assess.
Of en in hoeverre de hoofdstukken Milieu en Informatieverstrekking van toepassing zijn op de activiteiten van Shell in Vaca Muerta, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de Global Partnership for Education Replenishment Meeting

MPs Smaling, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the Netherlands was absent from the Global Partnership for Education replenishment meeting, whether it supports investment in education and urges other donors including the EU to contribute, and whether it will push for the Lucens Guidelines protecting schools from military use. The minister answered that the Netherlands was not represented because its basic education support is being phased out, that it has urged other donors to keep funding education, and that it could not raise the Lucens Guidelines at the meeting.
Given the phase-out of basic education policy and therefore also the phase-out of Dutch support to the GPE, the Netherlands is not represented at this meeting.
Gegeven de afbouw van het beleid voor basisonderwijs en hiermee ook de afbouw van de Nederlandse steun aan het GPE is Nederland niet vertegenwoordigd op deze bijeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over het Oxfam-rapport Business Among Friends

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Merkies asked the State Secretary about the Oxfam report on corporate tax avoidance, the arm's length principle, transfer pricing improvements, and the role of developing countries in OECD standard-setting. The State Secretary answered that the arm's length principle works imperfectly but is not itself the cause of avoidance, that BEPS work targets profit shifting, and that developing countries are involved through dialogue and capacity building.
The Netherlands attaches importance to these action points and actively contributes to seeking improvements.
Nederland hecht belang aan deze actiepunten en draagt actief bij aan het zoeken naar verbeteringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Laar over het bericht “Nepdokteren in Kenia wordt beloond met ridderorde in Nederland”

MPs Van Laar and Kuzu asked ministers about a Dutch homeopath whose non-profit distributes the homeopathic remedy Iquilai as a substitute for antiretrovirals in Kenya, and about his knighthood. The minister says such substitution is harmful, will ask the Dutch embassy to inform Kenyan authorities and asks the Inspectorate for Healthcare to examine options, but states she has no power to revoke the honour and no action is possible abroad.
I have therefore asked the Inspectorate for Healthcare to examine what options there are to investigate this matter further.
Ik heb daarom de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg gevraagd om na te gaan wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze zaak nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Smaling over schaliegas in het vrijhandelsverdrag TTIP

Two SP MPs asked the minister about leaked TTIP texts that would deem energy exports automatically compliant with US export licence conditions, and whether this would boost imports of shale gas and tar sands oil, undermine renewable energy and reduce transparency. The minister answered that US export rules remain strict and that more imports are possible but unquantified, denied that EU climate regulation is being weakened, offered confidential briefings to parliament and said TTIP can support global energy governance.
As previously promised to your House, the House can, if desired, be confidentially informed before each new round and given confidential access to the EU negotiating documents.

Zoals eerder aan uw Kamer toegezegd, kan de Kamer – indien gewenst – voor elke nieuwe ronde vertrouwelijk worden geïnformeerd en vertrouwelijk inzage krijgen in de onderhandelingsdocumenten van de EU.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht dat Nederlandse bedrijven indirect betrokken zijn bij schendingen van de arbeidsrechten bij de bouw van faciliteiten voor het WK 2022 in Qa

MPs asked whether Dutch banks, pension funds and companies invest in firms accused of labour rights abuses in building Qatar's 2022 World Cup facilities, and what the government will do about it. The government said it lacks such investment data, will raise labour rights in the ILO and OECD frameworks and with Qatar, and reported on sports-human rights steps.
The government does not have this kind of information and therefore cannot make statements about it.
De regering beschikt niet over dit soort informatie en kan derhalve geen uitspraken hierover doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over vrouwenrechten in “het Nieuwe Zuid-Afrika”

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that a South African public broadcaster executive received a woman as a gift from traditional leaders, and whether this is consistent with women's rights and SABC neutrality, and why Dutch funds went to the ANC. The minister answers that the gifts were part of a customary respect ritual, the woman denied being given as a gift, SABC is bound by neutrality rules under its statute, and the Dutch state did not finance the ANC, with remaining transition funds going to women's position.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over babysterfte ten gevolge van de ANC-rassenwetten

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked whether South African black empowerment rules, which they call apartheid-style 'racial laws', are causing infant deaths through discrimination in water purification, and why the Netherlands funded the ANC via aid. The minister rejected the 'racial laws' label, described the policy as redress of past inequality, and said the Netherlands funded no party and that aid to South Africa is nearly phased out.
The ANC has not introduced 'racial laws'.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het hardhandig neerslaan van vredige protesten in Ethiopië

An MP asks the government about reports of excessive force against peaceful protesters in Ethiopia's Oromia region, arbitrary detention and possible torture, and what Dutch diplomatic and rule-of-law programme action follows. The minister says the security response appears disproportionate and concerning, that concerns were raised with Ethiopian officials and in UN review, and that dialogue continues, but offers no concrete new measures beyond existing programmes.
Although detailed information is not available, there is an impression that the response of the Ethiopian security forces was disproportionate.
Hoewel gedetailleerde informatie niet voorhanden is, bestaat de indruk dat de reactie van de Ethiopische veiligheidstroepen disproportioneel is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over kledingbedrijven die geen inzicht geven in de aanpak van gebonden (kinder)arbeid in India

MPs from four parties asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Dutch garment companies that give little insight into their handling of bonded child labour in South India, and whether the government would press companies, India and the OECD on it. The minister confirmed the problem, pointed to due diligence promotion, a textile sector work group under the Plan van Aanpak with aggregated transparency rather than company-level disclosure, and raised labour rights bilaterally and through the ILO and EU, while stating no garment company named received international-activity support.
Information that could link factories to individual companies, or information on purchasing volumes, is not included here.
Informatie die fabrieken kan linken aan individuele bedrijven of informatie over inkoopvolumes wordt hier niet in opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het bericht dat kledingmerken nog steeds hongerloon betalen aan kledingarbeiders

MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a Schone Kleren Campagne report finding that none of 171 clothing brands pay a living wage in their supply chains, and what the government would do. The minister called the findings disappointing but not new, pointed to the national textile action plan, a planned living-wage conference and a future textile covenant, but offered no binding commitments on companies.
The report indicates that none of the companies examined currently pays a living wage in the supply chain concerned.
Het rapport geeft aan dat geen van de onderzochte bedrijven op dit moment leefbaar loon in de betrokken toeleveringsketen betaalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Hamas die toetreedt tot de Palestijnse regering

An MP asked whether Hamas was joining the Palestinian Fatah-led government and whether Dutch aid to the Palestinian Territories should be cut as a result. The minister denied that Hamas had joined, described the government as technocratic and unaffiliated, and said the cabinet would judge it on its actions without expressing outrage.
No. Hamas has not joined the Palestinian government.
Nee. Hamas is niet toegetreden tot de Palestijnse regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk, Van Laar en Sjoerdsma over het Moederdagrapport

MPs Van Dijk, Van Laar and Sjoerdsma asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Save the Children Mothers Day report on maternal and child mortality in fragile states, education in conflict countries, reproductive health, and the effects of reduced aid to transition countries. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports SRGR and education programmes in conflict settings, backs the Lucens Guidelines, and will shift some public health investment to the private sector in transition countries without a clear picture yet of who will fund it.
In the medium term, Dutch public investments in SRGR in the named countries will decrease.
Op middellange termijn zullen de Nederlandse publieke investeringen in SRGR in genoemde landen afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de misstanden bij steenkoolbedrijf Drummond

An MP asks whether Drummond, a coal company in Colombia accused of human rights abuses, should provide redress to victims, whether Bettercoal is a suitable instrument, and whether it will publish audit results. The minister answers that redress is a matter for the Colombian state and judiciary, that Bettercoal audits are ongoing with results to be discussed further, and that she has urged Drummond toward transparency.
The process for redress for victims of the conflict is a responsibility of the Colombian government.
Het proces voor genoegdoening voor slachtoffers van het conflict is een verantwoordelijkheid van de Colombiaanse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de gevolgen van het sluiten van het consulaat te Atlanta

The MP De Roon asks the Foreign Minister about objections to closing the Atlanta consulate, including the economic damage compared with the savings, and which other US consulates face closure. The minister answers that the honorary consulate will not be closed, but its biometric visa and passport processing will be phased out by 1 January 2016 as part of a wider modernisation and budget cut affecting 37 honorary consulates in 12 countries, and that no US consulates will close.
The honorary consulate in Atlanta will not be closed.
Het honorair consulaat in Atlanta zal niet worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over het bombarderen van een ziekenhuis in het Nuba gebergte in Soedan

Two CDA MPs asked the government about an alleged bombing of the only hospital in the Nuba Mountains in Sudan, the EU/UN response, Dutch private-sector trade promotion in Sudan, and a visit by Sudanese officials to Europe, and whether the government would raise the bombing with them. The government answered by referring to an earlier letter on the political situation in Sudan, without substantive answers to the individual questions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over zeggenschap van lidstaten bij het afsluiten van handelsverdragen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the trade minister whether the EU-Canada free trade agreement CETA and the planned TTIP should be ratified by member states as mixed agreements, and about an arbitration liability regulation adopted as a consent item. The minister answered that CETA should be a mixed agreement requiring national ratification, that the regulation was amended so the Commission cannot force member states' positions or settlements, and that an ISDS study will be completed before consent.
I am working to ensure that CETA becomes a mixed agreement, so that the Dutch parliament also gets the opportunity to consent to the agreement.
Ik zet mij ervoor in dat CETA een gemengd verdrag wordt, zodat ook het Nederlands parlement de mogelijkheid krijgt met het akkoord in te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat over het bericht dat ontwikkelingsbank FMO doorgaat met een omstreden stuwdamproject in Honduras

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister whether FMO should stop financing the contested Agua Zarca dam in Honduras after protests, a fatal incident, and allegations of harassment of local activists, and how FMO's standards and free, prior consent obligations were applied. The minister answered that FMO and DESA had consulted the communities, that DESA adjusted the design to avoid La Tejera, that the violence claims are hard to verify, and that FMO will continue to invest while using the embassy network more.
I have informed FMO that it should make greater use of the network of embassies, including local NGOs and local governments.
Ik heb aan FMO gemeld dat ze meer gebruik dient te maken van het netwerk van ambassades, waaronder lokale NGOs en lokale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een half miljard extra voor ontwikkelingshulp

The MP asks whether the extra 500 million euros for development aid is due to EU accounting rules, whether public support will erode, and whether the money should instead go to tax relief at home. The minister answers that aid is tied to GNP, the ESA2010 revision drives the budget change, 0.6 billion was reserved, and the exact effects will only be known by the Miljoenennota 2015.
The Chamber will be further informed about this no later than the Miljoenennota 2015.
Hierover zal de Kamer uiterlijk bij Miljoenennota 2015 nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de voortgaande subsidiëring van anti-Israël organisaties

An MP asked whether Dutch taxpayer money funds Palestinian NGOs (Badil, Addameer, Al-Haq) via the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat, and whether an investigation or measures to stop such funding are planned. The minister answered that the funding supports rights monitoring, that the Secretariat has strict selection and suspension procedures, and that no investigation or additional measures are considered necessary.
On the basis of the above, the cabinet sees no reason to take additional measures.
Het kabinet ziet op grond van het bovenstaande geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Laar, Thieme en Voordewind over misstanden bij de productie van handgeknoopte tapijten in India

MPs from SP, PvdA, PvdD and ChristenUnie asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour and forced labour in India's hand-knotted carpet industry, and whether Dutch importers are involved. The minister acknowledges the severe abuses, reports that the Dutch import market is small and that voluntary initiatives such as Goodweave and Care & Fair have limited reach, and lists development projects and dialogue with India as follow-up.
Statistics Netherlands publishes only aggregated data and provides no overview of individual companies importing carpets from India.
Het CBS publiceert alleen geaggregeerde data en geeft geen overzicht van individuele bedrijven die tapijten uit India importeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de extra miljoenen voor de EU en ontwikkelingshulp

An MP asked whether the national net contribution to the EU and development aid would rise due to a revised national accounts methodology, and how this affects lastenverlichting. The ministers answered that the effect cannot yet be quantified, that information will follow in the Voorjaarsnota and Miljoenennota 2015, and that they do not share the view that the money should go to tax relief at home.
The cabinet will inform the House in the Voorjaarsnota about changes in this budget year to EU contributions compared with the Miljoenennota 2014.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer in de Voorjaarsnota informeren over wijzigingen die zich dit begrotingsjaar in de EU-afdrachten voordoen ten opzichte van de Miljoenennota 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over door Israël vernielde gebouwen in Palestijns gebied

An SP MP asked the government whether Israel demolished three EU-co-funded buildings in Palestinian territory, whether fifteen more are threatened, and whether Israel should compensate the EU and the government should demand compensation. The government confirmed the facts, said the EU Commission is in talks with Israel and Israel refuses compensation as the demolitions are legal, and that the Netherlands will keep raising demolitions in area C with Israel.
The Netherlands also continues to hold the Israeli government to account for demolishing property in area C.
Ook Nederland blijft de Israëlische regering aanspreken op het slopen van onroerend goed in area C.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over schadeclaims die via Nederland ingediend worden

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about investment treaty claims filed through Dutch shell companies, Indonesia's termination of its treaty with the Netherlands, and the risks of ISDS in TTIP. The minister replied that UNCTAD/CPB studies and an analysis of TTIP investor-state dispute settlement are underway, that Dutch treaties are being aligned with EU standards, and that consultations with partners may follow.
As already promised, your House will be informed of the outcomes of this study.
Zoals reeds toegezegd, wordt uw kamer geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oijk over investeringsverdragen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Indonesia's termination of its bilateral investment treaty with the Netherlands, the risk of investor claims against public-interest legislation, and modernisation of Dutch investment treaties. The minister answered that Indonesia is terminating all such treaties, that Dutch treaties already protect public interests and are being modernised via UNCITRAL transparency rules and OECD guidelines, and that a study of their effects is underway.
A study into the effects of Dutch investment treaties is underway. Its conclusions will be taken into account when revision and modernisation of Dutch investment treaties is on the agenda.

Er loopt een onderzoek naar de effecten van Nederlandse IBO's. Met de conclusies van dit onderzoek zal rekening worden gehouden wanneer herziening en modernisering van Nederlandse IBO's aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over concurrentie tussen verschillende VN-instanties

An MP asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Foreign Trade and Development about overlapping mandates and competition between UN agencies in humanitarian response, prompted by a press article. The minister acknowledged overlapping mandates and coordination difficulties, stated that existing agreements and OCHA coordination are adequate, and described reforms and Dutch funding for the Central African Republic without committing to new concrete measures.
I am of the view that the UN has an adequately organised system for humanitarian aid.
Ik ben van mening dat de VN een adequaat ingericht systeem heeft voor humanitaire hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over commerciële mogelijkheden in Myanmar

A PVV MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she would act, as the US has, to expand commercial opportunities for Dutch firms in Myanmar, and whether Bangkok embassy support is adequate. The minister replied that the Dutch capacity in Bangkok was expanded, an economic mission office was opened in Yangon, and Myanmar was added to the Dutch Good Growth Fund for SMEs.

To give Dutch companies sufficient support to seize these opportunities in a socially responsible way, the cabinet decided in 2013 to expand the Burma/Myanmar capacity of the Dutch embassy in Bangkok.

Om Nederlandse bedrijven voldoende ondersteuning te geven deze kansen op een maatschappelijk verantwoorde manier te benutten, heeft het kabinet in 2013 besloten de Birma/Myanmar-capaciteit van de Nederlandse ambassade in Bangkok uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de Europese investeringsbank geen openheid van zaken geeft

An MP asks whether the European Investment Bank withheld findings of its investigation into alleged tax evasion by Mopani and why member states were not informed. The minister answers that EIB anti-fraud policy keeps investigation material confidential, that member states were last informed in January 2014, and that the Netherlands will encourage the EIB to communicate the general outcome.
The Netherlands will encourage the EIB to communicate in some way about the general outcome of this case, partly because the start of the investigation was also made public.
Nederland zal de EIB aanmoedigen op enigerlei wijze te communiceren over de algemene uitkomst van deze casus, mede gezien het feit dat ook de start van het onderzoek publiekelijk bekendgemaakt werd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over nieuwe voorstellen tot ‘landhervormingen’ in Zuid-Afrika

An MP asks the Dutch minister whether aid to South Africa should stop given proposed land reform that could endanger food supply and mirror Zimbabwe, and whether 90% of redistributed farms fail. The minister says land transfer is slow and mostly unsuccessful due to lack of skills and credit, notes Zimbabwe's negative experience, says aid is winding down to a transition programme and that the government supports flanking measures.
Until the end of 2011, South Africa was a partner country for the Netherlands in development cooperation.
Tot het einde van 2011 was Zuid-Afrika voor Nederland een partnerland in ontwikkelingssamenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de berichten dat multinationals massaal belasting ontwijken in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies (SP) asked whether OECD tax reforms go far enough against profit shifting harming developing countries, and about transfer pricing losses in Africa and the Dutch role. Secretary Wiebes answered that the OECD rules already prevent profit shifting, that technical assistance to developing countries is supported, and that the Tax Authority's transfer pricing capacity has been expanded.
That all countries aim to be able to tax as large a share as reasonably possible of multinationals' profits is obvious.
Dat alle landen ernaar streven binnen het redelijke een zo groot mogelijk deel van de winst van multinationals te mogen belasten ligt voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de bouw van zeven schepen voor Qatar Armed Forces

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch naval shipbuilding know-how is being channelled via Damen and Keppel Verolme into warships for Qatar, thereby undermining Dutch arms export policy, and what can be done about such corporate structures. The minister confirms the links and the Qatar memorandum, states that export licences and brokering will be assessed against EU and UN criteria including diversion risk, and says that decisions on local cooperation are primarily commercial and that Dutch policy offers sufficient safeguards.
Export licence applications are assessed against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position on arms exports and the assessment criteria of the UN Arms Trade Treaty.
Vergunningaanvragen worden getoetst aan de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexport en aan de toetsingscriteria uit het VN-wapenhandelsverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gedwongen verhuizing van de Ngöbe-stam vanwege de bouw van de Barro Blanco dam in Panama

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the minister about forced evictions of Ngöbe families for the Barro Blanco dam in Panama, a project financed partly by FMO, and whether the Ngöbe's free, prior and informed consent should be required before funding continues, plus questions on FMO transparency and human rights due diligence. The minister acknowledges communication failures by ASEP and says FMO has a complaints mechanism, but rejects suspending financing, says the state does not intervene in individual FMO investment decisions, and states FMO applies IFC and OECD standards.
I oversee that FMO complies with all relevant standards and I maintain close contact with the bank on this.
Ik zie er op toe dat FMO alle relevante standaarden naleeft en ik houd hierover nauw contact met de bank.

Vragen van de leden Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) en Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) aan de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over boringen naar onconventioneel gas in Oekraïne (ingezonden 7 maart 2014)

Two MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Shell's unconventional gas drilling in Ukraine, including open waste pits, a Ukrainian contract partner with alleged corruption links, and OECD guideline compliance. The minister answered that the practices comply with Ukrainian and Dutch rules, that Shell's due diligence found no reason to suspect corruption, and that she asked Shell to monitor the company's developments.
I have asked Shell to closely monitor developments surrounding this company.
Ik heb Shell gevraagd de ontwikkelingen rondom dit bedrijf nauwlettend te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren, en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het nieuwe handelsverdrag met de VS het Nederlandse schaliegasverbod bedreigt

MPs Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren and Agnes Mulder asked whether the proposed EU-US trade deal (TTIP) and its investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) clause could undermine a Dutch shale gas fracking ban and expose the state to damages claims, and whether Chevron's support for ISDS poses a risk. Minister Ploumen answered that ISDS would contain an exception for indirect expropriation covering general non-discriminatory public-interest measures, that parliament remains free to ban fracking, that a study on ISDS effects including on environmental regulation is underway with results due before summer, and that she cannot guarantee Chevron will not use ISDS but considers a successful claim unrealistic.
Yes, even after the conclusion of TTIP, the Dutch parliament can still take a decision on a ban on shale gas extraction.
Ja, ook na het sluiten van TTIP, kan het Nederlandse parlement nog steeds een besluit nemen over een verbod op schaliegaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de test van de Consumentenbond, waaruit blijkt dat supermarkten onvoldoende presteren op het gebied van arbeidsomstandigheden in ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked the minister about a Consumentenbond test showing major supermarkets perform poorly on labour conditions in producing countries, and whether the government will monitor supermarkets and inform consumers. The minister answered that a sector risk analysis is underway with possible dialogue with retailers, pointed to the fruit convenant and existing initiatives, and said corporate reporting is primarily the companies' responsibility.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Economic Affairs are currently commissioning a sector risk analysis.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken laten op dit moment een sectorrisicoanalyse uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de rapportage van Brandpunt over de weeshuis-industrie in Cambodja

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a Brandpunt report on the orphanage industry in Cambodia, including what the government knew, how it informs tourists and volunteers, whether it funds anti-orphanage-tourism actors, and oversight of online volunteer intermediaries. The Minister answered that the problem was known, that Dutch support went to Unicef's alternative-care framework, that travel advice and the Better Care Network guidelines are the main information tools, and that the government has no primary controlling role over private volunteer intermediaries.
The network, with organisations such as Unicef and Cordaid, works to improve international volunteer work with children, including through guidelines.
Het netwerk, met organisaties als Unicef en Cordaid, zet zich in om het internationale vrijwilligerswerk met kinderen te verbeteren, onder meer met richtlijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de Humanitarian Action for Children van UNICEF

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about UNICEF's Humanitarian Action for Children appeal, the Dutch contributions to UNICEF and Syrian refugee children, and related policy. The minister answered in detail on funding amounts and programmes but gave no commitment to change the budget or launch new scrutiny-related steps.
No, the allocation of financial resources has been arrived at in a balanced way.
Nee, de verdeling van financiële middelen is op een evenwichtige wijze tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Jan Vos over het bericht “Alleen nog duurzame soja is stap te ver voor vleesindustrie”

Two MPs (Dikkers and Jan Vos, PvdA) asked the government whether the meat sector will meet its 2015 pledge to buy only certified sustainable soy, and what the state can do to help. Minister Ploumen answers that the 2013 target was missed, that the sector's ambition for 2015 remains, that RTRS supply exceeded Dutch needs, and that the government will keep urging industry to meet its commitments without taking binding measures.
The target for 2013 was therefore indeed not met.
De doelstelling voor 2013 is dus inderdaad niet gehaald
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat €15 miljoen Nederlands belastinggeld voor een vliegveld in Tanzania

An MP asked the minister why the Netherlands co-finances a Tanzanian airport upgrade (EUR 15 million) while Dutch services are cut, and why aid flows to a country seen as corrupt. The minister defended the ORIO infrastructure project, said anti-corruption clauses apply and payments go to the contractor, and rejected reversing the decision.
Preventing and combating corruption is a priority for the Netherlands and the EU.
Het voorkomen en tegengaan van corruptie is voor Nederland en de EU een prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, De Caluwé, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Servaes over het bericht dat President Museveni de omstreden anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

MPs from several parties asked the government how it would respond to President Museveni signing Uganda's anti-homosexuality law and what measures it would take. The minister answered that the Netherlands suspended justice-sector aid and human-rights-conditioned support, pressed Uganda diplomatically, and would push the EU to condemn the law and withhold budget support, while promising to review support for LGBT groups.
Immediately after the law was signed, the cabinet suspended aid to the Ugandan government in the justice sector.
Meteen na het ondertekenen van de wet heeft het kabinet de hulp aan de Ugandese overheid in de justitiële sector opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het rapport ‘Working on the Right Shoes’

An MP asked the minister about the 'Working on the Right Shoes' report scoring 28 shoe companies on child labour and about engaging shoe importers, retailers and trade bodies. The minister answered that talks with firms, the trade association and embassies are underway, a sector risk analysis will guide which sectors are approached, and that public procurement already requires suppliers to prevent child labour.
There is no overview, for example at customs, of shoe retailers that import shoes produced in Turkey.
Er bestaat geen overzicht, bijvoorbeeld bij de douane, van schoenenretailers die in Turkije geproduceerde schoenen importeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de inzet van kledingbedrijf CoolCat om te komen tot verduurzaming van de textiel- en kledingsector

The SP MP Gesthuizen asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about CoolCat's director's statements on the Bangladesh fire and building safety accord, its claimed controllability, its use of own inspectors, and its BSCI membership. The Minister answers that CoolCat's long-term supplier relations aid controllability, that own inspections help but do not guarantee safety, that BSCI is not a certification scheme, and that she revises her earlier view because CoolCat signed the accord.
BSCI is not a certification process, but focuses on helping companies improve working conditions.
BSCI is geen certificatieproces, maar richt zich op het helpen van bedrijven om de arbeidsomstandigheden te verbeteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Ark over het bericht dat in Uganda een Belg vastzit vanwege homoseksualiteit (definitief)

MPs De Caluwé and Van Ark asked the government about reports that a Belgian man was detained in Uganda over alleged homosexual conduct, whether other Europeans were held, the status of Uganda's anti-homosexuality bill, what aid had done for LHBT people, and whether aid would be suspended. The minister answered that the Belgian was released on bail and has left Uganda, that no other Europeans are known to be held, that the President signalled he would not sign the bill in its current form but later indicated he would, and that the Netherlands will await formal presidential signature before reacting while consulting LHBT organisations on aid measures.
Depending on those discussions, we want to consider whether and which measures we take.
Afhankelijk van die gesprekken willen we bezien of en welke maatregelen we nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over het bericht dat onder dreiging van een rechtszaak de minister en Coolcat een gezamenlijke verklaring hebben opgesteld over de inspanningen van Coolcat in textie

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked whether the minister knew of CoolCat's threatened lawsuit over her remarks on Bangladesh textile factories, whether the joint press release was a settlement, and why she named CoolCat in an interview. The minister confirmed the lawsuit was withdrawn after a joint statement, denied speaking of a blacklist or linking CoolCat to child labour, and said her remarks concerned signing the safety accord.
In the future too I will continue this dialogue, about the need to improve working conditions in the textile sector.
Ook in de toekomst zal ik deze dialoog, over de noodzaak om arbeidsomstandigheden in de textielsector te verbeteren, blijven voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de gemaakte afspraken om het werk in kledingfabrieken in Bangladesh veiliger te maken nog te weinig effect hebben

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked why Bangladesh had not yet hired the promised 200 extra labour inspectors after the Rana Plaza collapse, which projects the EUR 1 million Dutch contribution funded, how oversight of subcontractors would work, and when the agreements would take effect. Minister Ploumen answered that the inspector hiring was delayed by elections but other steps had been taken (42 vacancies filled, 200 factories inspected on building safety, ILO programme with EUR 6 million from the Netherlands, five-year timeline), and that the Accord inspections were not delayed.
It is important that the Bangladeshi government keeps the agreements made and promptly appoints the 200 extra inspectors.
Het is belangrijk dat de Bengaalse overheid de gemaakte afspraken nakomt en spoedig de 200 extra inspecteurs aanstelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Roon over subsidies voor anti-Israëlische hulpclubs

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and De Roon asked whether Dutch government subsidies to Oxfam Novib, which funds the Coalition of Women for Peace (said to back an Israel boycott), should stop, and how much money flowed to such groups. The minister confirmed Oxfam Novib funds a project from its own resources rather than government money, declined to comment on a Canadian minister's remarks, and refused to end subsidies.
Since 2013 Oxfam Novib provides funds from its own resources to the Coalition of Women for Peace.
Oxfam Novib verstrekt sinds 2013 fondsen uit eigen middelen aan de organisatie Coalition of Women for Peace .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de groeiende mondiale ongelijkheid

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Oxfam's report on growing global inequality, the WEF's view of inequality as a threat, and whether inequality should be a standalone post-2015 goal, plus measures against tax avoidance and resource revenue capture. The minister acknowledged inequality as a serious problem, described Dutch efforts on jobs, business climate and post-2015 targets, and said tax policy and resource revenue use are sovereign decisions of countries, with the Netherlands offering knowledge and advocacy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leegte en Van Oosten over het artikel waarin de International Chamber of Commerce, ICC, wijst op de risico’s van corruptie voor bedrijven

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Justice about an ICC warning that corruption risks for companies are underestimated, including the effects of US and UK anti-bribery law on Dutch SMEs and support for firms acting in good faith. The government rejected the ICC's picture, pointed to outreach measures, the 2012 OECD evaluation and planned integrated policy response, but gave no new commitments beyond ongoing talks with the ICC.
The cabinet does not recognise the picture that the ICC paints.
Het kabinet herkent zich niet in het beeld dat de ICC schetst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Ark over het bericht dat het parlement in Oeganda een anti-homowet heeft aangenomen

MPs De Caluwé and Van Ark asked whether the government would condemn Uganda's anti-homosexuality law, whether budget for Uganda would be cut or redirected to LGBT groups, and whether it would coordinate action with donors. The government answered that the law is not yet in force, that Nederland has urged joint EU pressure and raised concerns with Uganda's prime minister, that existing funds already support LGBT-related organisations, and that it will examine options for extra support without committing to budget cuts yet.
It is too early to decide on consequences once the law is introduced.
Het is te vroeg om te besluiten over consequenties bij de invoering van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over levenslange gevangenisstraf voor homo's in Oeganda

An MP asked whether the government condemns Uganda's bill imposing life imprisonment for homosexuality and whether all development aid to Uganda should stop. The minister called the bill a violation of fundamental human rights, said it is too early to assess consequences since the president had not signed it, and argued that keeping aid lets the Netherlands keep pressing for non-discrimination.
Stopping development aid makes it harder to exert pressure and keep attention locally on the principle of non-discrimination.
Het stopzetten van ontwikkelingshulp maakt het moeilijker om druk uit te oefenen en de aandacht lokaal op het principe van non-discriminatie te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Madlener over belastinggeld voor Palestijnse ambtenaren

PVV MPs asked how many Palestinian officials and pensioners funded by EU and Dutch money are former prisoners convicted of terrorism, asked why aid to the Palestinian Authority is rising, and whether it should be halted and reclaimed. The minister said Pegase salary payments exclude sanctioned persons, could not confirm the $50,000 figure, and that the government sees no reason to change the policy.
The cabinet sees no reason to change this policy, as also stated in the Coalition Agreement.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om dit beleid, zoals tevens verwoord in het Regeerakkoord, te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Wilders over Nederlands belastinggeld voor anti-Israëlische propaganda

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch aid money funded a youth NGO's broadcast calling Israelis 'crows and rats' and whether aid to the NDC and Palestinian Authority should stop. The minister condemned the rhetoric, denied NDC funds went to the producer PYALARA, and declined to halt aid.
The cabinet condemns this kind of incitement.
Het kabinet veroordeelt dergelijk opruiend taalgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de verklaring van het bedrijf Vitens over de beëindiging van zijn samenwerking met het Israëlische waterbedrijf Mekorot

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked the minister why she cancelled a visit to Mekorot, whether government policy discouraging trade with Israeli settlements played a role, and whether she consulted colleagues before cancelling. The minister answered that she refers to a letter of 16 January 2014, said the government sees no reason to apologise, and rejected the characterisation of chaos and diplomatic damage.
I would refer you to the letter to your House of 16 January 2014, reference 2014.35843, which addresses this matter.
Graag verwijs ik u naar de brief aan uw Kamer van 16 januari 2014, met kenmerk 2014.35843, waarin op deze kwestie wordt ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over geweld tegen Australisch exportvee in Gaza

An MP asked the Dutch government whether it knows of videos showing extreme violence against Australian export cattle in Gaza, whether Dutch live animals are exported there, and whether it will press Gaza and Australian counterparts to act. The government confirmed the videos, stated that no live cattle are exported directly from the Netherlands to Gaza because no veterinary certificate exists, declined official contact with Gaza under its no-contact policy, and said Australia must make its own decision.
No live cattle are exported directly from the Netherlands to Gaza, because the Netherlands has not agreed a veterinary export certificate with Gaza.
Er worden vanuit Nederland in directe zin geen levende runderen naar Gaza geëxporteerd omdat Nederland geen veterinair exportcertificaat is overeengekomen met Gaza.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Ark over de doodslag van twee mannen vanwege seksuele gerichtheid

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a reported video of two gay men beaten to death in Kenya, and whether the government would press for prosecution and cut aid if not prosecuted. The minister answered that the event apparently did not take place in Kenya, so no Kenyan investigation exists, and declined to take further action on that basis.
On the basis of environmental details it is clear that it did not take place in Kenya.
Op basis van omgevingsdetails is wel duidelijk dat het niet in Kenia heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jan Vos, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder, Thieme, Baay-Timmerman en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de katoenproductie in Turkije

Seven MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour in Turkish cotton production, the follow-up to a Dutch-funded study, pressure on Turkish authorities and the ILO, the textile sector's responsibility, traceability of Turkish cotton, the MVO risk analysis, ILO child labour figures and child labour raised on trade missions. The minister answered that projects, workshops and a sector action plan are underway, that no EU action plan is needed given ILO efforts, that traceability is not feasible, and that the sector selection will be presented in summer 2014.
The Turkish government is primarily responsible for eliminating child labour.
De Turkse overheid is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitbanning van kinderarbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Caluwe en Ten Broeke over steniging in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about a reported proposal in Afghanistan's law reform working group to reintroduce stoning, and whether Dutch funding to the Afghan bar association should be stopped. The ministers answered that no such proposal was made by the sub-working group or the bar association chair, that Dutch funding is for lawyer training via local partners, and that Nederland will monitor the reform and raise concerns if needed.
The Netherlands will monitor the criminal law reform process with its partners and, if necessary, raise this point again.
Nederland zal met de partners het proces van de herziening van de strafwet monitoren en indien nodig, dit punt opnieuw onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, van Bommel en van Ojik over Nederlandse steun voor bedrijven in nederzettingen

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP and GroenLinks asked whether Dutch support for Israeli companies in settlements, including a planned Dutch-Israeli business forum, conflicts with the Netherlands' discouragement policy and whether the forum's reach would extend to occupied territories. The government answered that the discouragement policy applies to the forum, that Israeli settlement firms are not invited and are monitored, that the Palestinian Authority and Israel were informed of the policy, and that a fully watertight system is not possible.
It is technically not feasible to set up a filter that excludes Israeli companies located in settlements.
Het is technisch niet haalbaar een filter in te stellen die Israëlische bedrijven gevestigd in nederzettingen uitsluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat in Azerbeidzjan en Armenië duizenden meisjes worden geaborteerd vanwege hun geslacht

An SGP MP asked the government about reports that thousands of girls are aborted for their sex in Azerbaijan and Armenia, and whether those governments act and whether the international community raises it. The minister called the reports worrying, described limited government attention in both countries, noted Council of Europe and UNFPA engagement, and committed to supporting efforts to reduce sex-selective abortion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Dijk over investeringsverdragen

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about investment treaties, including ISDS, regulatory chill, South Africa's termination of its bilateral investment treaty with the Netherlands, and the Ping An claim. The Minister replied that the Netherlands seeks a balance between investor protection and policy space, supports the right to regulate and OECD guidelines in EU treaties, sees little financial risk, and promised a study on ISDS risks.
I will inform the House of the results of this study.
Ik zal de Kamer over de resultaten van dit onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat Brazilië weigert Van Oord te betalen

An MP asked whether Brazil's refusal to pay Van Oord for a dredging job in Suape port is a trade dispute, what the government is doing, and whether an environmental fine is linked to the non-payment. The Staatssecretaris answered that the payment arrears are an insurance matter under the state export credit guarantee rather than a trade dispute, that diplomatic talks are ongoing, that no link to the fine is known, and that the arrears may be raised in the Paris Club within months.
I can confirm that payment arrears have arisen regarding work carried out by Van Oord in Brazil.
Ik kan bevestigen dat er betalingsachterstanden zijn ontstaan ten aanzien van door Van Oord uitgevoerde werkzaamheden in Brazilië.

Vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver (beiden GroenLinks) aan de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over het artikel «Alleen losers betalen belasting» (ingezonden 5 juni 2013).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether lack of public information on letterbox companies hinders citizens from filing complaints with the National Contact Point (NCP) under the OECD guidelines, and whether she would investigate and propose remedies. The minister replied that no such obstacle exists, since mandatory filing of annual accounts provides sufficient information to lodge an NCP complaint.
In my view there are no obstacles, see the answer to question 5.
Mijns inziens zijn er geen obstakels, zie het antwoord op vraag 5.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over Conflict Vrij Tin Initiatief

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Conflict-Free Tin Initiative, concerns over its progress, whether controls will be intensified, and whether EU legislation with supply chain due diligence is supported. The minister defended the pilot's internal controls, said the government is pushing the issue in EU and OECD fora while preferring context-specific measures over generic EU legislation for now.
When it comes up, I will test such a proposal for proportionality and effectiveness.
Ik zal -wanneer aan de orde- zo’n voorstel toetsen op proportionaliteit en op effectiviteit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het rapport van Amnesty International over het verspreiden van valse informatie over olielekkages in de Nigerdelta door Shell

An MP asked the minister about an Amnesty International and CEHRD report alleging that Shell manipulated oil spill investigations in the Niger Delta and spread false information, and asked whether Shell should pay compensation, whether the Netherlands would push for independent oversight, and whether the minister would talk to Shell. The minister acknowledged the report, said the spill-cause investigations are run by a Nigerian joint team, offered technical assistance on oversight, and committed to a meeting with Shell and a Nigeria visit with a report to parliament.
I will report on this to your House.
Ik zal hierover verslag uitbrengen aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over tientallen miljoenen extra voor ontwikkelingshulp

An MP from the PVV asked the minister why 50 million euros in development aid, allegedly earmarked for trade, would be added and whether lowering aid to cut taxes at home would be wiser. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, described a parliamentary amendment to shift 50 million euros from the Dutch Good Growth Fund to Syria relief and child welfare, and defended aid as contributing to stability and development in the Netherlands.
The Dutch commitment is aimed at eradicating extreme poverty within one generation and promoting sustainable and inclusive growth in the Netherlands and in low and middle-income countries.
De Nederlandse inzet is gericht op het uitbannen van extreme armoede in één generatie en het bevorderen van duurzame en inclusieve groei in Nederland en in lage en midden-inkomenslanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de knikkebolziekte in Afrika

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the nodding syndrome in East Africa, including death and case numbers, affected countries, causes and treatment, Ugandan and South Sudanese government responses, and possible Dutch contributions. The minister answered that about ten thousand children are affected, that causes are unknown with no cure, and that the Netherlands will make EUR 1 million available for research.
The Netherlands is willing to make EUR 1 million available for the fight against nodding syndrome.
Nederland is bereid tot EUR 1 miljoen beschikbaar te stellen voor de strijd tegen de knikkebolziekte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Europese steun aan Wit-Rusland

An MP asked whether EU aid flowing to Belarus under President Lukashenko, including a border-management project, is absurd and how much Dutch contributions went there. The minister answered that EU support is limited, targets the population and democratisation, and that the border project (EUR 2 million spent in Belarus in 2012 from a EUR 44 million regional programme) serves European security interests; he gave no commitment to stop funding.
The EU provides limited support to Belarus: a full partnership with the regime of President Lukashenko is ruled out.
De EU verleent beperkt steun aan Wit-Rusland: een volwaardig partnerschap met het regime van president Loekasjenko is uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Van Laar over Wit-Rusland

MPs Maij and Van Laar asked whether EU development funds, via an integrated border management programme, trained and equipped Belarusian police and border forces who detain opposition activists, and whether the Minister would press the Commission to prevent such misuse. The Minister replied that the aid went to patrol boats, vehicles, night-vision equipment and customs/border training, not the police, that the practices against activists are worrying but not attributable to EU support, and that the Dutch embassy shared the report with the EU delegation, which said the aid cannot be linked to how authorities treat opponents.
The money the EU has spent in Belarus under integrated border management went to patrol boats, jeeps and night-vision equipment.
Het geld dat de EU in Wit-Rusland heeft besteed in het kader van geïntegreerd grensbeheer is ten goede gekomen aan patrouilleboten, jeeps en nachtkijkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over misbruik van Syrische minderjarige vluchtelingen

Two MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about reports of child abuse and child marriage among Syrian refugee girls, whether the trend is confirmed, what international measures exist, and whether Dutch funding addresses it. The ministers confirmed that child marriage is a known and possibly rising problem but lacks reliable figures, described Dutch-backed UN initiatives and funding for UNHCR and UNICEF, and did not commit to new concrete action beyond existing policy.
The trend of child abuse, and in particular child marriage, is known.
De trend van kindermisbruik en met name kindhuwelijken is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de belofte van de minister aan de Van Drie Group

MP Thieme asked the minister about her reported promise to help the Van Drie Group export, given inspection failures and the food-safety investigation into slaughterhouses and meat handling. The minister defended export support for the meat sector, pointed to NVWA reforms, a Taskforce Voedselvertrouwen and a pending Safety Board investigation, and refused to retract her earlier statements.
I cannot anticipate the conclusions of this.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op conclusies hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Verheijen over het bericht 'EU aid lost in Palestine'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether she knew of a report claiming over a billion euros of EU aid was lost in Palestinian territories through corruption and mismanagement, and whether aid should be halted and a programme-wide audit requested. The minister confirmed awareness of the press report, said she had not yet seen the unpublished European Court of Auditors report, and declined to prejudge its findings while promising to inform parliament by letter once it is published.
I am not aware of the content of the report since it has not yet been released.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de inhoud van het rapport aangezien het nog niet is vrijgegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de dreigende vernietiging van de collectie van het Tropeninstituut

An MP asks the ministers whether the KIT library collection, with nearly 70% of its post-1950 holdings at risk of destruction, is adequately protected, and questions their earlier pledge to keep the collection available to the public. The minister says the pre-1950 part, treated as heritage, will move to Leiden University Library, while for the post-1950 part insufficient interest exists to maintain a library function and KIT remains responsible for negotiating transfers.
That is why I am very pleased that the pre-1950 collection is coming under the management of Leiden University Library and will therefore remain accessible.
Daarom ben ik zeer verheugd dat de pre-1950 collectie in beheer komt bij de universiteitsbibliotheek Leiden en daardoor toegankelijk blijft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Verheijen over verdwenen EU-gelden in Congo

Two MPs from the VVD asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that EU aid to Congo was largely wasted and whether the EU overlooked corruption. The minister agreed the European Court of Auditors found serious shortcomings, said the government will press the Commission to follow the recommendations, and answered the remaining questions on Congo's fragility, Dutch funding shares, Mali and aid levels.

The cabinet agrees with the Court's recommendations to increase aid effectiveness and will, now that programming of the Eleventh EDF begins, press Commissioner Piebalgs to have the EU follow up on these recommendations.

Het kabinet is het eens met de aanbevelingen die de Rekenkamer doet om de effectiviteit van steun te vergroten en zal er, nu de programmering van het Elfde Europees Ontwikkelingsfonds (EOF11) van start gaat, bij Commissaris Piebalgs op aandringen dat de EU gevolg geeft aan deze aanbevelingen.
Vragen van het lid Maij (PvdA) aan de minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over belastingontwijking door microkredietfondsen (ingezonden 25 maart 2013).

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that microfinance funds use Dutch structures to avoid taxes in developing countries, and asked whether the government would act. The minister replied that the NPM sector platform's review found only limited use of third-country structures and no systematic tax avoidance, and that members committed to paying their fair share of tax and to prefer direct investment.
The NPM research showed that investments through third countries are made only to a limited extent and that there is no systematic tax avoidance.
Uit het NPM onderzoek is gebleken dat slechts in beperkte mate investeringen via derde landen worden gedaan en dat er geen sprake is van systematische belastingontwijking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over het EU-besluit het embargo tegen diamanten uit Zimbabwe op te heffen

MPs Servaes and Jan Vos asked the ministers whether the EU lifting the Zimbabwe diamond embargo was justified, given conditions at the Marange mine and possible ZMDC financing of ZANU-PF, and whether the Kimberley Process should be strengthened. Minister Timmermans answered that the Marange mine met Kimberley Process requirements since late 2012, that ZMDC was delisted for lack of evidence of financing violence, and that broadening the Kimberley Process to human rights had no consensus.

On 25 September 2013 ZMDC was removed from the EU list of restrictive measures, because there are no indications that the company was involved in financing the (limited) violence during the July 2013 elections.

Op 25 september 2013 is ZMDC van de EU-lijst van beperkende maatregelen verwijderd, omdat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat het bedrijf betrokken is geweest bij het financieren van het (beperkte) geweld tijdens de verkiezingen van juli 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bereiken van de millenniumdoelen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she agrees that meeting the Millennium Development Goals requires spending 0.7% of GNI on ODA, whether she will press this at the UN, what Dutch ODA shares were for 2013-2015, and whether she will return to the 0.7% target. The minister answered that ODA is an important but modest contribution, that she supports modernising the ODA definition, that 2013 ODA was 0.67% with provisional 2014 and 2015 figures of 0.59% and 0.60%, and that she will report her view on ODA in the government response to the IBO report.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over grondstoffenvoorzieningszekerheid

An MP from D66 asked the government why it lacks a clear vision on raw materials and whether supply shortages and conflict-sourced inputs threaten Dutch agriculture, chemicals and textiles. Minister Kamp answered that raw-material security is primarily the responsibility of business, cited existing initiatives such as conflict-free tin and the planned monitoring and research, but declined to commit to a new overarching strategy or to a partnership with the TNO/HCSS expertise centre.
Raw-material supply security and procurement policy are in the first instance the responsibility of the companies themselves.
Grondstoffenvoorzieningszekerheid en inkoopbeleid zijn in eerste aanleg de verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over hulpgelden voor de Syrië crisis

MP De Caluwé asked whether the 7.5 million euro of Syria aid announced for the Syrian Red Crescent would reach refugees in rebel-held areas, and how spending would be controlled. Minister Ploumen replied that the funds now go to UNHCR as unearmarked aid for the most vulnerable displaced people, that UNHCR is responsible for reaching them and monitoring its programmes, and that there is no reason to doubt its efforts.
The money therefore does not go to the Syrian Red Crescent (SARC). With this unearmarked contribution UNHCR can decide on the ground where aid is most needed.
Het geld gaat dus niet naar de Syrische Rode Halve Maan (SARC). UNHCR kan met deze ongeoormerkte bijdrage ter plaatse bepalen waar de hulp het meest nodig is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het artikel ‘Alleen losers betalen belasting’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about tax avoidance by multinationals using Dutch letterbox companies, and whether such companies comply with the OECD Guidelines and can be subject to NCP complaints. The minister acknowledges the problem, says compliance is for the National Contact Points to judge, notes no complaint has ever been filed against a Dutch letterbox company, and promises to ask the OECD for clarification while deferring the answer on access to information.

To support the NCPs in forming their judgment, I will ask the OECD whether the Working Party for Responsible Business Conduct, in consultation with the Committee on Fiscal Affairs, can clarify the OECD Guidelines in cases of tax optimisation by multinationals.

Teneinde de oordeelsvorming door de Nationale Contact Punten te ondersteunen zal ik aan de OESO vragen of de Working Party for Responsible Business Conduct in overleg met het Committee on Fiscal Affairs een nadere duiding kan geven van de OESO-richtlijnen in het geval van fiscale optimalisatie door multinationale ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Bommel over handel in zand uit West-Sahara

MP Van Bommel asked whether a Groningen-linked shipping company's transport of sand from Western Sahara breached international law, whether proceeds benefit the local population, and whether the government would act against Dutch firms. The minister confirmed the shipment, said economic activity there is not per se unlawful if proceeds benefit the inhabitants, noted no embargo applies, and declined to take action against the shipping company.
Economic activities in Western Sahara are not per se in violation of international law.
Economische activiteiten in de Westelijke Sahara zijn niet per definitie in strijd met het internationaal recht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Homorechten in de Verenigde Republiek Tanzania

MP Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether they were aware of the Human Rights Watch report on discrimination against sexual minorities in Tanzania and of Zanzibar's president rejecting LGBT rights linked to aid, and what the government would do about criminalisation and abuse of LGBT people, including raising it with President Shein and coordinating EU action. The government said it shares the concerns, will monitor enforcement through the embassy, raised rule of law and human rights in talks with Zanzibar's leaders, and will answer for the upcoming Human Rights policy debate.
As usual, no statements are made about the conversation with the King.
Over het gesprek met de Koning worden zoals gebruikelijk geen mededelingen gedaan.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over de slechte arbeidsomstandigheden van garnalenpelsters in Marokko (ingezonden 27 juni 2013).

The MP asks about relocation of Moroccan shrimp-peeling factories from the Tangier free zone, alleged poor working conditions, dismissal and loss of rights, and whether Dutch firms should take responsibility. The minister replies that VEBEGA and the firms say they promote decent employment and will talk with NGO TIE Netherlands, that primary enforcement lies with Moroccan authorities, that relocation effects vary, and that firms will meet the ministry and NGO.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over glycol

An MP (Sjoerdsma, D66) asked the minister whether the earlier promise to investigate what happened to glycol exported from the Netherlands to Syria could be carried out. The minister answered that such an investigation is not currently feasible because of the security situation and the closed embassy, while navigating existing inquiries with the exporter, intelligence services and customs yielded no new information.
Due to the current crisis situation in Syria, further Dutch investigation into the end use in Syria is currently not possible.
Vanwege de huidige crisissituatie in Syrië is nader Nederlands onderzoek naar het eindgebruik in Syrië op dit moment niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Visser en De Caluwé over de organisatie ‘Dutch International Guarantees for Housing’ (DIGH)

MPs Visser and De Caluwé asked whether Dutch housing corporations guaranteeing DIGH loans for social housing in developing countries amounts to an implicit state guarantee, whether these fall under ODA rules, whether guarantees are reviewed for necessity and fee cover, and whether such activity belongs to corporations' core tasks. The minister answered that corporations guarantee loans with their own capital, the state is not directly liable, no new guarantees have been issued since mid-2012, and the Herzieningswet novelle will address corporations' activities abroad.

In my proposals within the novelle to the Herzieningswet, in light of this cabinet's aim that corporations serve the public interest in their area, I will further address the limits arising from this for corporations' activities abroad.
