Ik zal bij mijn voorstellen in het kader van de novelle bij de Herzieningswet, mede in het licht van de doelstelling van dit kabinet dat corporaties dienstbaar zijn aan het publieke belang in hun werkgebied, nader ingaan op de beperkingen die hieruit voortvloeien voor activiteiten van woningcorporaties ten behoeve van het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Maij over het besluit van Artsen zonder Grenzen om Somalië te verlaten

Two MPs (Van Laar and Maij, PvdA) asked the ministers how the government views Artsen zonder Grenzen' withdrawal from Somalia over security concerns, its consequences for humanitarian aid, attacks on aid workers and how the Somali authorities respond, and whether the Netherlands will raise the issue internationally. The minister answered that the government regrets the decision, that other organisations continue aid, that the Somali government has pledged to protect aid workers and that the security situation remains fragile without changing asylum policy.
The Netherlands will continue to press for a robust dialogue by the international community with the SFG on this subject.
Nederland zal blijven aandringen op een stevige dialoog van de internationale gemeenschap met de SFG over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het bericht dat met subsidie Sapph-lingerie in Afrika zal worden verkocht

An MP asked whether a subsidy had been granted for selling Sapph lingerie in African countries and why such trade would be subsidised. The minister answered that no subsidy was granted to Mr Heilbron and no application was submitted, and that the 'subsidy-sensitive' remark was misquoted.
No subsidy was granted to Mr Heilbron, nor did he submit an application.
Er is aan Dhr. Heilbron geen subsidie verstrekt, noch heeft hij een aanvraag ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de miljoenen voor narcostaat Bolivia

An MP from the PVV asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development why Dutch taxpayers' money, including indirect funding via NGOs, goes to Bolivia, and whether all aid should stop. The minister says Bolivia's bilateral aid ends in 2014, that NGOs allocate their own funds without reporting per country, and that she does not intend to halt development aid.
These organisations are themselves responsible for allocating government funds by country and report by development objective, and therefore not by country.
Deze organisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de verdeling van de overheidsmiddelen naar landen en rapporteren per ontwikkelingsdoelstelling, en dus niet per land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Erdogan’s heksenjacht op dissidenten en uitsluiting van niet-moslims

An MP from the PVV asks the government about Erdogan's crackdown on dissidents, arrests of protesters and journalists, exclusion of non-Muslims, and whether a planned Dutch economic mission to Turkey should be cancelled. The minister confirms about 3,600 detentions (most released within 48 hours), says the government will keep a critical rule-of-law dialogue within accession talks, and does not cancel the economic relationship.
In response to recent events, the cabinet, as set out in my letter of 25 June, chooses a credible accession process that adheres to strict accession conditions.
In reactie op de recente gebeurtenissen kiest het kabinet, zoals uiteengezet in mijn brief van 25 juni, voor een geloofwaardig toetredingsproces dat vasthoudt aan strenge toetredingsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over miljoenen belastinggeld voor Afrika

MP Van Klaveren (PVV) asked whether Dutch aid money for Africa should be cut and questioned the grounds for continuing it, including OIC membership and corruption of recipient states. Minister Ploumen defended the aid as contributing to stability and development, declined to characterise the OIC, and refused to withdraw the plan.
No. This contribution to structural solutions fits within the policy as formulated in my memorandum 'What the World Deserves'.
Neen. Deze bijdrage aan structurele oplossingen past binnen het beleid zoals geformuleerd in mijn nota «Wat de wereld verdient».
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Thieme, Krol en Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid en lage lonen bij Nederlandse zaadbedrijven in India

Four MPs asked the minister about child labour and low wages at Dutch seed companies Bejo Zaden and Nunhems in India, and about the sector's due diligence and CSR commitments. The minister responded that the government wants child labour eliminated, that Bejo Sheetal did not join the FLA, that Plantum will evaluate members' policies, and that Bejo and Nunhems will introduce new measures including monitoring and minimum wage commitments.
In the meeting with Plantum, the implementation of the Plantum statement on the prevention of child labour was discussed.
In het gesprek met Plantum is de uitvoering van de « Plantum statement on the prevention of child labour» aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de betrokkenheid van Shell bij een grote brand in Bodo, Nigeria

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether an independent investigation into the Shell-linked fire in Bodo, Nigeria was needed, after Shell contractors were arrested, and what steps had been taken on UNEP recommendations and an offer of technical assistance to Nigerian oil oversight. The minister replied that Shell's internal inquiry includes an NGO representative who considers it independent, that any further investigation is for the Nigerian government (with a possible Dutch legal-assistance request), that the embassy is pursuing UNEP follow-up and a mediation process, and that Nigeria has not responded to the technical assistance offer.
It is up to the Nigerian government whether or not to order an additional investigation into this incident.
Het is aan de Nigeriaanse overheid al dan niet een aanvullend onderzoek naar dit incident in te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over onderwijs in conflictlanden

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the lack of schooling for children in conflict countries, the low share of emergency aid going to education, and Dutch contributions to education in conflict settings. Minister Ploumen answered that education is part of broader aid, outlined Dutch programmes (PBEA, Balochistan, GPE, NICHE) and said the BIV budget does not target education as such.
As a result, it is not possible to determine precisely what percentage of Dutch humanitarian aid goes to education.
Daardoor is echter niet goed te bepalen welk percentage van de Nederlandse humanitaire hulp naar onderwijs gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over De noodsituatie in de Centraal-Afrikaanse Republiek (CAR)

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the humanitarian and security crisis in the Central African Republic after the Seleka coup, including pressure on the UN and African Union, extra Dutch emergency aid, the treatment of local human rights organisations, and a malaria crisis. The minister answered that Nizerlands is pushing through the EU and UN for an active role, that existing contributions via CERF, EU and UN agencies are maintained without an extra contribution for now, and that the Netherlands cannot directly support local human rights groups.
For the time being I am not considering an extra contribution for emergency aid in the CAR.
Vooralsnog overweeg ik geen extra bijdrage voor noodhulp in de CAR.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de besteding van hulpgelden voor Srebrenica

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about refugees still waiting in Tuzla for housing in Srebrenica, reconstruction output, the use of about 120 million euros in aid, corruption signals and the effectiveness of spending. The minister answered at length, reporting that funds were spent on the stated goals, that the embassy monitors projects and has received no specific fraud reports, and that aid was overall effective though not for all assistance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ojik en Klaver over Investeringen vanuit Nederland in Afrika

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked why around 62 percent of Dutch-channelled investment in Africa comes from foreign multinationals using Dutch holdings, and whether treaty shopping under Dutch tax treaties with African countries costs developing countries revenue and will be curbed. The minister answers that Dutch treaties reduce withholding taxes, that the tax law does not distinguish 'real Dutch' companies from foreign multinationals, that revenue losses are hard to estimate, and that anti-abuse clauses and OECD BEPS work will be used.
Where desired, the Netherlands includes anti-abuse clauses in new treaties and is also willing to extend existing treaties with anti-abuse clauses where unintended use of the treaty is found.

Nederland neemt in nieuwe verdragen desgewenst anti-misbruik clausules op en is ook bereid bestaande verdragen bij gebleken onbedoeld gebruik van het verdrag uit te breiden met anti-misbruik clausules.
Antwoord vragen Venrooy-van Ark over het reddingsplan voor het Tropenmuseum

An MP asked the education and foreign trade ministers about the rescue plan for the Tropenmuseum, including its merger conditions, budgets, funding sources and whether it amounts to a cut for culture and development aid. The minister confirmed the merger and collection-transfer conditions, gave budget figures and funding splits, but declined to commit to post-2016 funding and said the rescue is a cut for development cooperation.
I cannot make any commitment for after the current subsidy period, for any institution whatsoever.
Ik kan geen toezegging doen voor na de huidige subsidieperiode, voor welke instelling dan ook.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over bevorderen van voedselzekerheid

An MP asked the trade and development minister whether reducing meat consumption should guide Dutch policy and whether export promotion of livestock and animal protein should be abandoned. The minister answered that Dutch livestock exports will not be discouraged, that sustainable production and export of housing systems is supported, and that vegetarian options are offered at official dinners.
I therefore do not want to discourage the export of these high-quality housing systems.
Export van deze hoogwaardige houderijsystemen wil ik dan ook niet ontmoedigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over geweld in Sudan en in Zuid-Sudan en de precaire situatie tussen beide landen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government about violence in Sudan and South Sudan, human rights abuses, humanitarian access, the Abyei dispute, the suspension of oil transport, civil society space and the future of EU and AU mediation roles. The government answered at length, noting concern, backing AU-led mediation and cross-line humanitarian access, but declined to commit to new fact-finding missions and said the EU Special Representative's mandate would be transferred.
To verify the data in these reports, humanitarian access to these areas is needed, as well as an independent investigation into the human rights situation in South Kordofan and Blue Nile.

Om de gegevens in genoemde rapporten te kunnen verifiëren is humanitaire toegang tot deze gebieden nodig, alsmede een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de mensenrechtensituatie in South Kordofan en Blue Nile.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over wapenleveranties aan Indonesië

Two SP MPs asked whether Vulcano 76mm naval gun ammunition, possibly used on frigates being supplied to Indonesia, is designed for ground targets and whether the Netherlands co-funds it, and whether this conflicts with the government's view on internal tensions. The minister answered that the Netherlands is not involved in developing that ammunition, that it contributed about EUR 6.2 million to a different Vulcano 127mm program, that the frigate supply was assessed against the eight export criteria, and that no known involvement of Indonesian navy equipment in repression has occurred since 1998.
These questions will be answered as soon as possible.
Deze vragen worden op de kortst mogelijke termijn beantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Maij, Servaes en Bonis over voorgestelde wetgeving in Litouwen en Macedonië die de toegang tot abortus zal beperken

Three PvdA MPs asked the Dutch government whether it is aware of proposed abortion restrictions in Lithuania and North Macedonia, whether it considers this worrying for women's health and rights, and whether it will raise concerns with those governments. The minister replied that reproductive rights are fundamental human rights and that Dutch concern is noted, that a Lithuanian bill is pending in committee and a Macedonian law is said by its government not to be more restrictive, and that the Netherlands will raise reproductive health policy in human rights reporting forums.

The Netherlands will raise the policy on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights, including abortion legislation and its implementation, in the appropriate forums during the review of human rights reports.

Nederland zal bij de behandeling van mensenrechtenrapportages het beleid omrent Seksuele en Reproductieve Gezondheid en Rechten, inclusief abortuswetgeving en de uitvoering daarvan aan de orde stellen in de daarvoor geëigende gremia.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Jasper van Dijk over de toekomst van de Tropenmuseum

MPs Monasch and Jasper van Dijk asked ministers whether the future of the Tropenmuseum is at risk, how the KIT budget cuts and 90 job losses affect it, and which ministry should fund it after 2013. The ministers answered that the KIT subsidy ended under earlier decisions, a transition grant of 15.3 million was given for 2013 with 7.5 million earmarked for the museum, the KIT is responsible for its own plans and cut allocation, and post-2013 funding talks with Amsterdam and the ministries are ongoing.
Responsibility for distributing the cuts across the different departments lies with the KIT.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de verdeling van de bezuinigingen over de verschillende afdelingen ligt bij het KIT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Madlener over de absurde verhoging van de EU-uitgaven aan ontwikkelingshulp

Two PVV MPs asked why EU development spending is rising, including the planned EDF amount for 2014-2020 and Dutch contributions, and whether the government will stop the flow of Dutch money to development aid. The minister confirmed Dutch EU development contributions of about 507 million euro for 2013, explained that the final EDF 2014-2020 envelope was lowered to 30.5 billion euro, and said the Regeerakkoord cuts the ODA budget by 750 million euro per year in 2014-2016 and 1 billion euro from 2017.
The coalition agreement includes a substantial cut target for the development cooperation budget.
In het Regeerakkoord is een forse taakstelling opgenomen met betrekking tot het budget voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Omtzigt over het gezag van het Internationaal Strafhof in Afrika

MPs Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked the government how it responds to African Union accusations that the ICC targets Africans, to the AU call to refer the Kenyatta and Ruto cases to Kenyan courts, and to the effects on the ICC's standing, and what the Netherlands did at the AU summit. The minister rejects the AU claims, notes the ICC acts independently and that half of African situations were referred by states or the UN Security Council, says the Kenyan admissibility challenge was rejected, and describes bilateral and EU efforts to support the ICC in Africa without committing to a new report on the summit.
The cabinet disagrees with the statements of the African Union chairperson, Hailemariam Desalegn, which imply that the ICC is biased.
Het kabinet is het oneens met de uitspraken van de voorzitter van de Afrikaanse Unie, Hailemariam Desalegn, waarin wordt geïmpliceerd dat het ICC vooringenomen zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over de petitie "Burundi: Stop Silencing the Media!"

An MP asked the minister for a response to a petition against Burundi's new press law and whether the government condemns it as an attack on free expression. The minister agreed the law restricts press freedom, said the Netherlands and the EU have raised objections with Burundian authorities, and described ongoing diplomatic and legal support efforts.
The Netherlands is not leaving it at that.
Nederland laat het hier niet bij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

An MP asked the government about sexual violence against women in India, the restrictions on human rights NGOs under India's FCRA rules, the treatment of the Dutch Human Rights Tulip winner, and visa problems for Dutch aid workers and journalists. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises civil society freedom in EU and UN forums, that India decides its own conditions for enforcing its law, and that no Dutch-funded organisation has been prevented from working by Indian restrictions.
The Netherlands is committed to keeping the issue of freedom for human rights organisations on the EU and UN agendas and will also do so at the EU Human Rights Dialogue.
Nederland spant zich ervoor in dat het onderwerp «vrijheid voor mensenrechtenorganisaties» op de agenda van de EU en VN aandacht blijft krijgen en zal dat ook doen bij de EU Mensenrechtendialoog.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de absurde steun voor het islamitische boevennest Mali

An MP asked why tens of millions of Dutch taxpayer euros go to Mali rather than tax relief, how much more will be spent, and why aid to Mali should not stop. The minister answered that aid supports stability in the Sahel, plans about EUR 52 million for 2013 with strict conditions on transparency, and that budget beyond 2013 will be detailed in the 2014 budget proposal.
You will be informed about the intended budget for 2014 and beyond in the draft 2014 budget.
Over het beoogde budget voor 2014 en verder zult u worden geïnformeerd in de ontwerpbegroting 2014.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leegte over de drama's in de textielindustrie in Bangladesh

An MP from the VVD asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Bangladesh garment factory collapses, including whether Dutch firms were involved, whether extra national rules are needed, and the Dutch government's role in pressing Bangladesh to enforce fire and building safety. The minister answered that Bangladesh's government bears primary responsibility, outlined EU and donor coordination, a 9 million euro contribution, and a textile-sector action plan, while committing to raise corporate social responsibility at EU level.
I am of the opinion that additional Dutch regulation is not a solution to the problems related to working conditions in Bangladesh.
Ik ben van mening dat extra Nederlandse regelgeving geen oplossing is voor de problematiek verbonden aan de arbeidsomstandigheden in Bangladesh.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind Bonis en Thieme over financiering van bouwprojecten in India waar schending van arbeids- en kinderrechten plaatsvindt

MPs Voordewind, Bonis and Thieme asked whether Dutch-funded Asian Development Bank projects in India involve child labour and labour rights abuses, and what the Netherlands will do about oversight and sanctions. Minister Ploumen answered that the ADB has labour standards in its contracts and monitoring mechanisms, that the Netherlands has pressed the bank to strengthen complaint and sanction mechanisms, and that she will ask Dutch-represented constituencies at other development banks to scrutinise labour standards.
In talks with the ADB, the Netherlands has pointed out that complaint handling, a sanctions mechanism and monitoring are important.
Nederland heeft in gesprek met de ADB erop gewezen klachtenbehandeling, een sanctiemechanisme en monitoring belangrijk te vinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over over de politieke participatie van vrouwen in de MENA-regio (Midden-Oosten en Noord-Afrika)

An MP asked the minister about the Women on the Frontline fund for women's political participation in the MENA region, including its aims, country choice, evaluation, FLOW budget use and the Know Me Initiative. The minister answered that the fund strengthens women's organisations in seven countries through tailor-made support, with annual and final reporting, and pledged to raise women's participation in EU and bilateral talks.
Yes, Hivos provides the ministry with an annual financial and substantive report on expenditure and results achieved.
Ja, Hivos levert jaarlijks een financiële en inhoudelijke rapportage (over de bestedingen en behaalde resultaten) aan het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen Jasper Van Dijk over mensenrechtenschendingen in Ethiopië

An SP MP asked the government about human rights violations in Ethiopia, including restrictions on civil society, forced resettlement of indigenous groups linked to donor-funded programmes, humanitarian access in the Ogaden, and land grabbing. The minister answered that the Netherlands monitors the situation, raises concerns bilaterally and in the EU, finds no convincing evidence of systematic forced displacement, and continues dialogue with Ethiopian authorities.
The Netherlands closely follows the human rights situation in Ethiopia, and the observations as stated in HRW's World Report 2013 are known to us.
Nederland volgt de mensenrechtensituatie in Ethiopië nauwlettend, en de observaties zoals die in het World Report 2013 van HRW zijn verwoord, zijn ons bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bonis over mensenrechtensitutatie in Colombia

MPs Maij and Bonis asked the government about the deteriorating situation of human rights defenders in Colombia, land restitution in Curvaradó, threats and killings, impunity, and implementation of court rulings. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these concerns in dialogue with Colombian authorities, will press for investigation and prosecution at the Universal Periodic Review and in political dialogue, and will urge implementation of court rulings.
I will press the Colombian authorities for investigation, prosecution and punishment to prevent repetition.
Ik zal bij de Colombiaanse autoriteiten aandringen op onderzoek, berechting en bestraffing om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over Aanbesteding Nederlands waterproject in Benin aan een Deens bedrijf

MP Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development why a Dutch-financed water project in Benin was tendered to a Danish consortium despite government ambitions to favour Dutch firms, and how embassies and procurement rules affect such choices. The minister answered that the Dutch bid scored lower, the contract followed EU procurement rules and quality criteria, and the government will keep encouraging Dutch firms within those rules.
Given the financial size of the project in Benin, a European tender procedure was required.
Gezien de financiële omvang van het project in Benin, was een Europese aanbestedingsprocedure vereist.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het subsidieplafond van de Subsidiefaciliteit Burgerschap en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (SBOS) voor het jaar 2013 is vastgesteld op nul

An MP asked why the 2013 SBOS subsidy ceiling was set at zero and why parliament was not informed during the budget debate. The minister answered that budget cuts led to suspending SBOS tenders, that no new project funding is available for 2013, and that the decision is unrelated to the donation-incentive study.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Caluwé over verdeling van de gelden van de Samenwerkende Hulporganisaties (SHO) voor Syrië

An MP from the VVD asked the minister whether Dutch NGO fundraising for Syria (Giro 555 by SHO) is fairly distributed, given reports that two member organisations, CARE and World Vision, are not focused on Syrian refugees. The minister answered that both organisations are active in the Syria regional response, that the NGOs themselves set the allocation key, and that the government's own 4 million euro contribution goes to UNICEF and the Lebanese Red Cross.
As with previous SHO actions, it is up to the participating NGOs to determine the allocation key.
Het is, gelijk eerdere acties van SHO, aan de deelnemende NGO's om de verdeelsleutel te bepalen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over belastingontwijking door microkredietfondsen

An MP asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that microfinance funds, with the Netherlands as an intermediary, avoid tax in developing countries, and asks whether the government will prevent this and quantify lost revenue. The minister answers that the MFIs pay local tax, that no data exist on Dutch intermediary use or lost revenue, that she will consult the sector and NPM and agree to tighten tax treaties and self-regulation, and that subsidy conditions do not include tax avoidance but OECD guidelines apply to companies.
In the short term I will consult representatives of the sector and the Platform for Inclusive Finance (NPM) to gain more insight into current practices.
Op korte termijn zal ik in overleg treden met vertegenwoordigers van de sector en het Platform for Inclusive Finance (NPM), om meer inzicht te krijgen in de huidige praktijken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het recht op veilige abortus voor verkrachte vrouwen in oorlogsgebieden

An MP asked the government whether raped women and girls in war zones have a right to safe abortion under humanitarian law, whether they should be a public champion of this (including in National Action Plan 1325), and whether the US 'no abortion' clause should be challenged. The minister answers that humanitarian law requires necessary medical care that may include abortion, that the Netherlands will press this in the EU and UN, and will urge the US to interpret the Helms amendment to allow funding for safe abortion for rape survivors.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Oosten over interlandelijke adopties uit Ethiopië

Two VVD MPs asked whether Wereldkinderen, which receives MFS-II development funds, financed intercountry adoptions in Ethiopia exposed by Brandpunt, and what the government will do about adoption procedures and the legal status of adoptions obtained irregularly. The state secretary answered that the adoptions predate MFS-II funding, that adoption agencies receive no government money, and that existing safeguards suffice, with no new action planned.
In view of these measures, it is not necessary to take action now.
Gelet op deze maatregelen is het niet noodzakelijk om nu actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over belastingontwijking in Zambia

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked the ministers whether a Dutch treaty with Zambia enables tax avoidance by a British sugar company, whether Zambia loses more to avoidance than it gains in aid, and whether the treaty should be renegotiated. The government said it lacks data on specific amounts, acknowledged the 5% dividend withholding rate under the 1977 treaty, and promised a review of treaties with developing countries with results expected in summer 2013.
We have no information on the amount of tax that may have been avoided in Zambia.
Over de omvang van de eventueel in Zambia ontweken belasting hebben wij geen informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over bestrijding van verborgen honger in ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about hidden hunger in developing countries, the post-2015 hunger goal, and Dutch programmes and partnerships (including DSM) against micronutrient deficiency. The minister answered that hunger is a priority in the post-2015 agenda, listed Dutch-supported programmes, and described existing cooperation with private partners.
Hunger, food security and nutrition is one of eleven themes on which a vision and roadmap are being formulated for the High Level Panel advice.
Honger, voedselzekerheid en voeding is een van de elf thema’s waarop een visie en routekaart worden geformuleerd ten behoeve van het High Level Panel advies.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Agnes Mulder over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

Seven MPs asked the foreign minister about sexual violence against women and Dalit women in India and Indian restrictions on NGOs, including a Dutch human rights prize winner's trial and blacklisting of NGOs and donors. The minister said the Netherlands supports the European Parliament resolution, funds Indian women's NGOs, respects the Indian legal process while staying in contact with the prize winner, and that the Indian NGO rules are being monitored through EU channels.
I will keep you informed of relevant developments.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Maij en Jan Vos over de Nederlandse inzet aangaande financiële transparantie in de grondstoffensector

MPs Van Ojik, Maij and Jan Vos asked the minister whether Dutch policy supports EU rules on financial transparency in the extractive sector, including whether a carve-out for countries with secrecy laws should be allowed. The minister answered that the Dutch government supports the EU transparency directive, opposes any carve-out, and notes that no such exception exists in US Dodd-Frank rules.
The cabinet considers an exception clause undesirable, partly because regimes could otherwise use a reporting ban or confidentiality obligations to evade European transparency provisions.

Het kabinet acht een uitzonderingsclausule niet wenselijk, mede met het oog op de mogelijkheid voor regimes om met een verbod op rapportage of met geheimhoudingsverplichtingen te ontkomen aan Europese transparantiebepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de voorwaarden voor onderhandelingen over een vrijhandelsakkoord met Japan

MP Ouwehand asked whether reopening the Japanese market to Dutch veal, and respect for human rights and the whaling moratorium, were conditions for launching FTA talks with Japan, and whether the government would make these binding preconditions. The minister answered that veal access was a litmus test for Japan's non-tariff barriers, that human rights will feature in a framework agreement with a possible suspension clause (whaling excluded), and refused to make whaling a precondition while promising to raise it through IWC and bilateral channels.
No. The negotiations with Japan will be used to raise these themes further.
Nee. De onderhandelingen met Japan zullen worden aangegrepen om deze thema's verder aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Jan Vos en het lid Klaver over mogelijke bijdrage van voedselproducenten aan mensenrechtenschendingen in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Maij, Jan Vos and Klaver asked whether Dutch food and drink producers contribute to human rights abuses such as land grabbing, exploitation of women and farmers, and labour violations in developing countries, following an Oxfam report. The minister responded that she shares concerns, relies mainly on voluntary OECD guidelines, IFC standards and sector cooperation, will engage the industry federation, and will encourage companies to map gender and labour conditions in their supply chains.
From Dutch companies I ask that they comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises, which include the responsibility to prevent human rights abuses.
Van Nederlandse bedrijven vraag ik dat zij de OESO richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen naleven, waarin de verantwoordelijkheid tot het voorkomen van mensenrechtenschendingen is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat geen van de tien grootste levensmiddelenconcerns uitblinkt in milieu en mensvriendelijkheid

Two SP MPs asked the minister whether it is unacceptable that major food companies sell products linked to serious social and environmental harm, whether consumers are misled by CSR claims, and how transparency on land deals will be promoted. The minister answered that companies should improve along OECD guidelines, that CSR claims must be verifiable, and that the Netherlands supports transparency initiatives such as the Land Matrix and an EU working group, without committing to new binding measures.
The cabinet is of the view that we may ask companies to commit to realising that improvement.
Het kabinet is van mening dat we van bedrijven mogen vragen dat zij zich inzetten om die verbetering te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over bloedkolen uit Colombia

An MP asks whether Dutch power plants import coal from Colombia linked to labour, environmental and security abuses, and asks about the coal dialogue, supplier transparency and the role of trade and development policy. The minister says Colombia bears primary responsibility, companies should follow due diligence, the coal dialogue and Better Coal are the preferred route, and full supplier disclosure is not yet required.
Self-regulation based on dialogue, as described in the answers to questions 6, 8 and 7, is my preference.
Zelfregulering op basis van dialoog zoals beschreven in de antwoorden op de vragen 6,8 en 7 heeft mijn voorkeur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘EU: China dupeert Europese staalmarkt’

MP Agnes Mulder asked whether the government agrees with the European Commission's findings that China subsidises its steel industry and its proposal to impose duties of up to 50 percent on Chinese coated steel. Minister Ploumen answered that the Commission analysis is confidential within an ongoing anti-subsidy procedure, that the government supports countervailing duties where subsidies and injury are established, and that it is following the sector and participating in the High Level Roundtable.
The European Commission's analysis is a confidential document within an ongoing anti-subsidy investigation.
De analyse van de Europese Commissie betreft een vertrouwelijk document in het kader van een lopend antisubsidie onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over investeringen in bedrijven die communicatieapparatuur aan Syrië leverden

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked whether Dutch banks and pension funds investing in firms that supplied communications equipment to Syria could pressure those firms to stop such exports, and about EU-level export controls on repressive technology. The minister answered that corporate responsibility rests with the financial sector under OECD guidelines, outlined Dutch proposals for an EU human-rights export clause and existing sanctions on monitoring equipment for Syria, and said Nederland supports the European Parliament's Digital Freedom resolution.

The Netherlands has proposed at EU level adding a provision to the dual-use regulation that would allow banning the export of goods and technology where there is suspicion they will be used for human rights violations.

Nederland heeft in Europees verband voorgesteld om een bepaling toe te voegen aan de dual-useverordening die het mogelijk maakt om de export van goederen en technologie te verbieden indien het vermoeden bestaat dat deze zullen worden ingezet voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over het bericht «European Commission defends privileged access for “big business”»

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the European Commission's sharing of information with big business but not other stakeholders in trade negotiations is undesirable, and whether transparency on EU trade agreements should be improved. The minister rejected the premise of disproportionate business influence, defended confidential stakeholder exchanges to protect negotiating positions, and said she will keep parliament informed in general terms without committing to concrete new steps.

It is therefore in the interest of the European Union to handle the specific interests of specific players (companies, civil society organisations or other stakeholders) as confidentially as possible.

Het is daarom in het belang van de Europese Unie om specifieke belangen van specifieke spelers (bedrijven, maatschappelijke organisaties of andere betrokkenen) zoveel mogelijk in vertrouwelijkheid te behartigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het afbrokkelde draagvlak voor de miljarden uitgaven aan ontwikkelingshulp

An MP from the PVV asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about eroding public support for aid spending, questioning EU aid to China, aid to Egypt, Tunisia and Libya, and whether the more than 4 billion euro spent should go to elderly care, tax relief and security instead. The minister answered that middle-income countries like China should no longer receive bilateral EU aid, that stability in Arab transition countries makes continued support crucial, and that development spending contributes to stability and security in the Netherlands.
I believe that countries that, based on their income, should be considered able to finance their own development should no longer be eligible for bilateral aid from the European Union.

Ik vind dat landen die op grond van hun inkomen in staat moeten worden geacht hun eigen ontwikkeling te financieren, niet meer in aanmerking zouden moeten komen voor bilaterale steun van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over een toespraak van de leider van de Palestijnse Autoriteit, Mahmoud Abbas

An MP from the PVV asked the foreign ministers whether a speech by Mahmoud Abbas glorifying early Fatah terror attacks, broadcast on the Palestinian Authority's official TV, is incitement, and whether the government will stop funding the PA under a parliamentary motion. Minister Timmermans said he is aware of the speech, that the background of the persons praised is insufficiently known, that he will continue efforts against incitement via the trilateral commission, and that PA support aims at a viable Palestinian state.
In line with the letter to parliament of 12 December 2012, I will continue to work to end incitement and calls for violence.
Conform de Kamerbrief (d.d. 12 december 2012) zal ik mij blijven inspannen voor een einde aan opruiing en aan oproepen tot geweld
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Visserij voor de kust van West Sahara

An SP MP asked the foreign and trade ministers about a Curaçao-flagged refrigerated ship (Nova Florida, Seatrade) reportedly active off Western Sahara, the state of the EU-Morocco fisheries deal, and whether Western Sahara waters should be excluded. The ministers replied that the ship is outside Dutch jurisdiction, that renegotiation of the protocol is ongoing with Dutch conditions, and that a deal covering those waters need not violate international law if conditions are met.
If there is a violation of Dutch or European regulations, the government will hold Dutch companies to account for it.
Indien er sprake is van overtreding van Nederlandse of Europese regelgeving, zal de overheid Nederlandse bedrijven daarop aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Bonis, Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over sluiting van maatschappelijke organisaties door de regering van Sudan

MPs from PvdA, CDA and D66 asked the Dutch government whether it shares EU concerns about Sudan's closure of civil society organisations, whether it will press Khartoum to reverse this, and how it supports the closed groups and threatened rights defenders. The government answered yes to each point, said the EU and member states will raise the closures with Sudanese authorities, and described ongoing contact and programme support for civil society and rights defenders.
The closure of the civil society organisation will be raised with the Sudanese authorities shortly, jointly by the EU and a number of EU member states present in Sudan, including the Netherlands.

De sluiting van de maatschappelijke organisatie zal op korte termijn gezamenlijk door de EU en een aantal in Sudan aanwezige EU-lidstaten, waaronder Nederland, bij de Sudanese autoriteiten worden aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, de Roon en Wilders over Malinese jihadisten die profiteren van Nederlands belastinggeld

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch aid to Mali, including via subsidised NGOs, benefits jihadists and should be stopped or recovered. The minister confirmed aid to the Malian government was suspended after the 2012 coup, said stopping other aid is not at issue and no grounds exist to reclaim funds, and rejected the personal accusation in question 4.
Following the coup in Mali of 22 March 2012, the Netherlands decided in April 2012 to stop aid to the Malian government.
Naar aanleiding van de staatsgreep in Mali van 22 maart 2012 besloot Nederland in april 2012 tot stopzetten van de hulp aan de Malinese overheid.
Antwoord vragen Fokke en Jan Vos over het bericht 'niet ondertekenen verdrag export onbegrijpelijk'

Two PvdA MPs asked why the Netherlands is not ratifying ILO Convention 170 on chemical safety, and whether this endangers workers abroad and imposes low administrative costs on firms. The minister answered that the government will consult the social partners and the SER on ratification, pointed to alternative chemical information sources, and noted that five of 27 EU states have ratified.
Following the consultation between the Cabinet and the Labour Foundation on 19 December, I informed the House by letter.
Naar aanleiding van het overleg tussen Kabinet en de Stichting van de Arbeid op 19 december heb ik de Kamer per brief geïnformeerd
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Ojik en Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid in de katoensector in Turkije

MPs Voordewind, Van Ojik and Gesthuizen asked the ministers about child labour in Turkey's cotton sector, including unconditioned state price-support subsidies and Dutch clothing retailers selling products made with child labour. Minister Ploumen answered that Turkey is primarily responsible, that she raised ILO cooperation with Turkish authorities, and that she will support a textile-sector action plan on supply-chain transparency and ending child labour, expected mid-2013.
I am willing to play an active role in supporting the textile sector in fulfilling its supply-chain responsibility.
Ik ben bereid een actieve rol te spelen om de textielsector te ondersteunen bij het invullen van hun ketenverantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over hulp aan Uganda

MP Maij asked whether the Netherlands would freeze aid to the Ugandan government after a corruption scandal over funds for northern Uganda, and how the EU decision was reached. Minister Ploumen answered that no Dutch funds were involved, that the Netherlands already stopped budget support in 2011 and aligns with donor conditions for resuming it, and that European donors coordinated their suspension.

The Netherlands aligns itself with the conditions set by these donors for Uganda, namely repayment of the missing money, legal action against suspects, and strengthening of the government's financial management.

Nederland sluit zich aan bij de door deze donoren aan Uganda gestelde voorwaarden, te weten – terugbetaling van het verdwenen geld; – gerechtelijke stappen tegen verdachten; – versterking van het financiële management van de overheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij en Jan Vos over bevorderen van duurzame biobrandstoffen

MPs Maij and Jan Vos asked about imports of biofuel feedstock, land grabbing in developing countries and the case for second and third generation biofuels. Minister Ploumen answered that the EU proposal limits food-crop biofuels and promotes advanced ones, that the government will press for responsible land governance, and that a national impact assessment and a Commission report are forthcoming.
The cabinet will also examine, together with industry and research institutions, how the innovation and production of advanced biofuels can be stimulated.
Het kabinet zal voorts samen met het bedrijfsleven en onderzoeksinstellingen bekijken op welke manieren de innovatie en productie van geavanceerde biobrandstoffen gestimuleerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Madlener over de gevolgen van de forse verhoging van de Franse bieraccijns

PVV MPs asked whether France's proposed sharp increase in the beer excise, which leaves wine excise largely unchanged, would harm Dutch beer exports and whether the government would respond with countermeasures. The minister answered that Dutch beer exports to France are about 5% of total exports, that the measure does not discriminate against foreign brewers, that it is in line with EU law, and that the government sees no reason for countermeasures.
If the measure were to turn out to have a discriminatory effect indirectly, in its implementation, we will consider that.
Indien de maatregel indirect, in de uitwerking, een discriminatoir effect zou blijken te hebben, zullen wij ons daarover beraden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ‘De miljoenen voor leuke seks in ontwikkelingslanden’

An MP from the PVV asked whether the minister should cancel a development project on 'fun sex' in developing countries, which he considered a waste of taxpayer money. The minister replied that the project implements approved sexual and reproductive health and gender policy, aimed at reducing maternal and child mortality, teenage pregnancy and domestic violence, and refused to cancel it.
I support this project, because it contributes to implementing the current SRGR and gender policy.
Ik ondersteun dit project, omdat het bijdraagt aan de uitvoering van het vigerende SRGR- en genderbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Maij over het slopen van schepen op stranden in Azië

Two MPs asked the government about deaths during ship breaking on Asian beaches after a Nieuwsuur broadcast, and whether it would set minimum safety, environmental and labour conditions and engage shipowners and financiers. The minister said the Netherlands supports the Hong Kong Convention and an EU ship recycling regulation, notes voluntary industry initiatives, and sees no need to convene shipowners and financiers.
The Netherlands actively contributes to the adoption of this European regulation so that ship dismantling takes place in a safe and environmentally responsible manner.
Nederland draagt actief bij aan de totstandkoming van deze Europese verordening om het slopen van schepen op een veilige en milieuverantwoorde manier te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over criteria voor het verstrekken van microfinanciering

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about concrete measures and criteria for supporting microfinance institutions, including after excesses at LAPO Microfinance Bank. The minister described instruments such as the Social Performance Assessment tool, MicroScore and the Interest Rate Traffic Light, said no absolute interest rate or profit ceiling is set, and indicated a planned EUR 10 million per year for rural microfinance in 2012–2015.
There is no deliberate steering towards reducing the budget.
Er is geen bewuste sturing op verlaging van het budget.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over Nederlands geld voor een onderzoek naar kinderarbeid in de hazelnootpluk in Turkije

The MP De Roon asks why the Netherlands funds research into child labour in Turkish hazelnut picking, given Turkey's economic strength, and whether Turkey could pay itself. Minister Ploumen answers that the Turkish government is primarily responsible, that the Dutch-funded ILO project supports it, and that combating child labour also serves a level playing field for Dutch firms.
The Turkish government is primarily responsible for combating child labour in Turkey and is therefore the primary point of contact for policy.
De Turkse overheid is primair verantwoordelijk voor het tegengaan van kinderarbeid in Turkije en dus primair aanspreekpunt voor beleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het meningsverschil aangaande de besteding van het nog op te richten revolverende fonds

An MP asked the minister whether there is now a unified government view on how a planned revolving development fund, financed from the aid budget, will be spent, and asked for conditions and more information. The minister answered that a unified cabinet view exists, the fund will link Dutch expertise to developing-country needs and be operational in 2014, but details of programmes will only be given in spring 2013.
As soon as the main lines of the new fund are known, I will inform the House about this in more detail.
Zodra de hoofdlijnen van het nieuwe fonds bekend zijn, zal ik de Kamer hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over invoering van de doodstraf op homoseksualiteit in Oeganda

An MP asked whether the government shares outrage at Uganda's planned death penalty for homosexuality and whether it will halt all development aid except emergency aid. The government says the bill is a concerning private member's bill that conflicts with Uganda's international obligations, and that suspending aid is not on the table.
Ending development cooperation with Uganda is not on the agenda.
De ontwikkelingssamenwerking met Oeganda opzeggen is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de inperking van internetvrijheid in Rusland

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the government is aware of Russia's November 2012 law enabling DPI-based internet surveillance, what its impact on human rights and Dutch firms will be, whether EU technology exports could be barred from use in rights violations, and what the government will do to support digital freedom in Russia. The minister acknowledges concern about misuse of the law, says Dutch dual-use export controls cannot exclude such use, and states the government will raise digital freedom in EU and bilateral channels and push for an expanded dual-use regulation.

The Netherlands has for some time been working to expand the EU dual-use regulation so that companies can be subject to an ad hoc licensing requirement if there are indications that technology could (partly) be used for human rights violations.

Nederland zet zich reeds geruime tijd in om de EU- dual use verordening uit te breiden, zodat bedrijven een ad-hoc vergunningplicht kan worden opgelegd indien er aanwijzingen zijn dat technologie (gedeeltelijk) kan worden gebruikt voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over de 3 miljoen euro steun voor Gaza

An MP from the PVV asked whether the Netherlands should withhold all development aid to Gaza while it is governed by Hamas, and whether it would reconsider its 3 million euro pledge. The minister answered that the government condemns Hamas rocket fire but will not hold the Palestinian civilian population collectively responsible, so it sees no reason to deny them aid.
The cabinet does not hold the Palestinian civilian population collectively responsible for the actions of Hamas.
Het kabinet houdt de Palestijnse burgerbevolking niet collectief verantwoordelijk voor het handelen van Hamas.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 33 over de doorzettingsmacht en de beleidsvrijheid van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen

Amendment making the minister the contact point and decision-maker for Groningen reinforcement, with the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen given a mandate and wider discretion to decide reasonableness and cost allocation, and letting the minister set cost-sharing for owners.
to write into the law and explain the enforcement power and policy discretion that the National Coordinator Groningen has in carrying out the reinforcement operation
om de doorzettingsmacht en de beleidsvrijheid die de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) heeft in de uitvoering van de versterkingsoperatie in de wet op te nemen en toe te lichten
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en Smeulders over een energieloket in elke gemeente
Asks the government to give every municipality an energy desk for insulation questions and to implement the earlier Segers/Klaver insulation programme with funding.
requests the government to ensure every municipality gets an energy desk
verzoekt de regering, om ervoor zorg te dragen dat elke gemeente een energieloket krijgt
Motie van de leden Koerhuis en Dik-Faber over het verlagen van de minimuminvestering en het minimumaantal woningen in de regeling voor het Volkshuisvestingsfonds
Asks the government to lower the minimum investment and minimum number of homes in the final Volkshuisvestingsfonds scheme for small municipalities in border and shrinking regions.
requests the government, in the final scheme, to lower the minimum investment of 10 million euros and the minimum number of 250 homes
verzoekt de regering, in de definitieve regeling de minimuminvestering van 10 miljoen euro en het minimumaantal woningen van 250 te verlagen
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en Terpstra over fiscaal gunstig bouwsparen voor starters
Asks the government to map the costs and effects of tax-favoured home savings for first-time buyers and inform the House quickly.
requests the government to map the costs and effects of tax-favoured home savings for starters
verzoekt de regering, om de kosten en effecten van fiscaal gunstig bouwsparen voor starters in kaart te brengen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 28 over opkoopbescherming
Lets municipalities require a permit before owner-occupied affordable homes are rented out, with the mayor and aldermen able to grant exemptions.
The municipal council may, in the housing ordinance, give the mayor and aldermen the power to grant exemption from that prohibition.
De gemeenteraad kan in de huisvestingsverordening aan burgemeester en wethouders de bevoegdheid geven om ontheffing van dat verbod te verlenen.
Amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over het verkorten van de termijnen voor het versterkingsbesluit

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Runderen langs Waal zitten vol gif, verkoop van ‘oervlees’ stilgelegd’

MPs Kröger and Dik-Faber asked about reports of high dioxin levels in cattle grazing along the Waal and whether the sale of their meat, and swimming in contaminated rivers, poses health risks. The State Secretary answered that dioxin in riverbed sediment was not routinely tested, that NVWA-initiated research into grazing cattle is pending (expected mid-2021), that swimming exposure is below health limits, and that no general sales stop or new disposal measures are currently warranted.

After the NVWA-initiated research is completed, the departments involved will assess whether further research into dioxins in the riverbed near the floodplains is needed at locations that are frequently flooded.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Dik-Faber over een werkbezoek aan de prefab-woningen in De Driesprong te Ermelo d.d. 6 maart 2021

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about defects, resident safety, the provincial subsidy rush, and oversight of the Slokker prefab homes in De Driesprong, Ermelo. The Minister answered that repairs are ongoing with the housing corporation, that residents have adequate legal protection, and that the Wkb quality-assurance reform will strengthen construction oversight.
I do not consider extending or amending legislation on this point necessary.
Ik acht uitbreiding of aanpassing van wet- en regelgeving op dit punt dan ook niet noodzakelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Von Martels, De Groot en Dik Faber over het signaal dat de NVWA niet overgaat tot het aanwijzen van verschillende havens als ‘dedicated landing port third countrie

MPs asked why the NVWA has not designated additional Dutch ports, such as Den Helder, as dedicated landing ports for third-country fishing vessels, which hurts shipyards once British vessels lose access after Brexit. The minister explains the EU IUU-regulation limits such designations, reports lost turnover and an intention to allow maintenance-only calls by UK vessels in specified ports, and declines to reconsider the broader landing-port designations.
I have received a confidential overview from the sector of the estimated turnover losses per shipyard.
Ik heb van de sector vertrouwelijk een overzicht gekregen van de geschatte omzetverliezen per werf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over verharding Bospaden

MPs asked whether forest paths paved with recycled construction granulate containing plastic breach the 1% contamination limit and whether Staatsbosbeheer chose it for cost reasons. The government confirmed the cost motive, said it will study regulating recycled granulate more strictly by year-end, and will talk with managers and producers about alternatives and lower contamination for path use.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Vader van honderden’ en massadoneren van sperma

An MP asks the health minister about a serial sperm donor who fathered hundreds of children, the loophole allowing donors to exceed the Dutch limit via foreign banks and private arrangements, and the delayed amendment of the Wdkb donor-data law. The minister acknowledges the problems, says the amendment to the Wdkb will be sent to parliament soon, but states he cannot control private donations or foreign banks and declines new investigations.
With the amendment of the Wdkb, it will be legally ensured that a donor's sperma may be used by Dutch clinics for a maximum of 12 women and this will be centrally monitored by the Sdkb.

Met de wijziging van de Wdkb wordt wettelijk geborgd dat het sperma van een donor maar bij maximaal 12 vrouwen door Nederlandse klinieken mag worden gebruikt en wordt dit centraal door de Sdkb gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over alternatieve zorg tijdens de lockdown

MP Dik-Faber asked the health minister about the closure of alternative care (complementary therapies and lactation care) during the lockdown, citing a petition, CBS usage figures and health harms. The minister answered that the ban on contact professions, which covered alternative care, was a necessary emergency measure, has since been lifted, and that lactation care is again available, while declining to seek new OMT advice.
The temporary ban on contact professions also included a ban on providing alternative care.
Het tijdelijke verbod op het uitoefenen van contactberoepen hield ook een verbod op het verlenen van alternatieve zorg in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Dik-Faber over de tegemoetkoming aan de leveranciers van schoolfruit

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture about compensation for school fruit suppliers who lost income during the first COVID-19 school closures, and about longer supplier recognition periods. The minister said only about 148,000 euro had been paid for documented costs against roughly 600,000 euro claimed, pointed to national support schemes, and said the recognition duration will be reconsidered when the scheme is revised, without committing to compensation.
I am awaiting the results of this study.
Ik wacht de resultaten van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Stop met zonneparken en leg zonnepanelen op daken'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about expanding rooftop solar instead of solar parks on farmland, citing the zonneladder motion and an advisory report. The minister answered that the zonneladder is a regional weighing framework rather than a strict order, that subsidy rules already favour rooftop systems, and that building rules and municipal powers will be strengthened, with several follow-up analyses promised.
I agree with the National Adviser that it is desirable to strongly invest in rooftop solar, and that is what I am doing.
Ik ben het eens met de Rijksadviseur dat het wenselijk is om stevig in te zetten op zon op dak en dat doe ik ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Wonen op een vakantiepark? Meeste Veluwse gemeenten willen daar niets van weten’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about permanent residence on holiday parks, including enforcement, criminality, housing supply and capturing land-value gains. The Minister answered that decisions belong at local level, pointed to an action agenda on undermining crime, admitted unknown effects on housing supply, and said land-value gains cannot in principle be taxed although cost recovery is under study.
In principle it is not possible to claw back land-value gains.
Het is in principe niet mogelijk om bestemmingswinsten af te romen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het antwoord op eerdere schriftelijke vragen en de uitzending van Argos ‘Spraakverwarring in de spreekkamer’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the availability of professional interpreters for non-Dutch speakers in healthcare, the funding of interpreter costs, and the standard on interpreter use, following a broadcast on language barriers in consulting rooms. The Minister said the inspectorate sees interpreter use well established in asylum centres but less so in primary care, that the Zorginstituut has no planning yet for a quality standard, that NZa tariffs cover interpreter costs in principle, and that the Minister will talk with the Zorginstituut and NZa about funding and regulatory bottlenecks.

Yes, I will talk with the Zorginstituut and the NZa about the use and funding of interpreters in healthcare to inventory whether bottlenecks exist in current regulations that hinder funding of necessary interpreter use.

Ja, ik ga met het Zorginstituut en de NZa in gesprek over de inzet en financiering van tolken in de zorg om te inventariseren of in de huidige regelgeving knelpunten bestaan die het financieren van noodzakelijke tolkeninzet bemoeilijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber inzake worteldoeken in Nederlandse rivieren,

An MP asked the minister about geotextile root cloth in Dutch rivers, its fragmentation into microplastics, unregistered non-functional material, and alternatives. The minister acknowledged the concern, said geotextile is needed for durable bank protection, that biobased alternatives are unsuitable, that loose material is removed under existing contracts, and declined a dedicated cleanup project or new register.
Rijkswaterstaat's contractors inspect the banks in accordance with the agreements made.
Opdrachtnemers van Rijkswaterstaat inspecteren de oevers, conform de gemaakte afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over mensen die hun woning moeten verlaten respectievelijk kwijtraken als ze hun zorgindicatie verliezen of worden opgenomen in een GGZ-instelling

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the government about people losing their homes when care indications end or when they are admitted to mental health institutions, and about the gaps in housing and support, the reduction of support hours, the household-sharing norm, and municipal responsibilities. The state secretary answered that no central figures exist on homelessness caused by expiring care indications, pointed to municipal responsibility, planned expert support and the Wvggz/Participatiewet frameworks, and said action is being taken through working agreements and a new plan.
At central level there is no insight into the amount of support that municipalities provide under the Wmo 2015.
Op centraal niveau bestaat geen inzicht in de omvang van de begeleiding die gemeenten op basis van de Wmo 2015 verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bergkamp over pgb-houders en hun zorgverleners en de vaccinatiestrategie

MPs Dik-Faber and Bergkamp asked the health minister why paid-care (pgb) caregivers in small-scale living initiatives were deprioritised in the COVID vaccination strategy, asked for clarity on target groups and timing, and asked for consistent information across government, RIVM and GP websites. The minister explained vaccine supply constraints, gave timelines for each group, and committed to aligning communication with RIVM and to answering at the next debate.
I understand the importance of a consistent message about COVID vaccination and therefore align communication, and thus also the content of the respective websites, with the RIVM.
Ik begrijp het belang van eenduidige boodschap over coronavaccinatie en stem daarom de communicatie, en dus ook de inhoud van de respectievelijke websites, af met het RIVM.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over keuzevrijheid in het vaccin voor een specifieke groep gewetensbezwaarden

Two MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked the health minister whether people with conscientious objections to vaccines developed or tested using fetal-derived cell lines (HEK293, PER.C6) should be given freedom of choice among COVID-19 vaccines. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the vaccines are lawful under current rules, but refused individual choice of vaccine type because of limited supply and a need for rapid mass vaccination, while pointing to information and dialogue efforts.
It is not possible for an individual to choose a specific type of vaccine.
Het is niet mogelijk om als individu de keuze te maken voor een specifiek type vaccin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de berichten dat steeds minder boeren de overstap naar biologische landbouw maken

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports that fewer farmers are converting to organic farming, whether this is worrying, and how the government can support conversion (support via CAP, financing, market promotion, public procurement and land access). The minister acknowledges the decline, says causes are unclear, and points to existing and planned measures such as the conversion programme, a conversion credit guarantee, and a study on local land cooperatives, while leaving some decisions to a later cabinet.
It is true that fewer farmers are making the switch to organic farming.
Het klopt dat minder boeren de overstap maken naar biologische landbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over microplastics in placenta’s van ongeboren baby’s

An MP asked several ministers about reports that microplastics were found in unborn babies' placentas, and about the health risks, product bans and parental information. The government acknowledges the concern, says there is insufficient evidence on health effects, and points to ZonMw research, a knowledge agenda, and planned EU-level and environmental measures without committing to bans or consumer warnings.
There is currently insufficient knowledge to conclude whether microplastic particles pose a danger to the development of unborn babies.
Er is op dit moment onvoldoende kennis om de conclusie te kunnen trekken of microplasticdeeltjes een gevaar vormen voor de ontwikkeling van ongeboren baby's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over regionale verschillen in de euthanasiepraktijk

An ChristenUnie MP asked the health minister to explain unexplained regional differences in euthanasia rates across municipalities, which the research attributes partly to supply-side factors such as physicians initiating end-of-life talks, and to propose further study, a regional evaluation and expanded registration. The minister acknowledged the research, stated that the practice is highly careful everywhere and that regional differences in care quality do not exist, saw no need for further research now, and promised to examine patient characteristics and provincial differences in the fourth law evaluation expected around 2022.
As long as care diligence is high, I am therefore neutral about regional differences.
Zolang de zorgvuldigheid hoog is, sta ik dan ook neutraal tegenover regionale verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen het bezoek van predikanten beperken

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether hospitals restricting visits by chaplains conflicts with agreements and legal rights, and whether patients may receive pastoral visits outside visiting hours. The minister replied that hospitals may limit visits for infection control, that no distinction is made between visitor types, that he disagrees with the claim of non-compliance, and that he will only alert hospital associations to a guidance document; he declined to answer question 8 and could not answer in time.
It is up to the care institution to weigh this, in which the safety of all patients and staff counts alongside the interest of the individual patient.
Het is aan de zorginstelling om een afweging te maken, waarbij naast het belang van de individuele patiënt de veiligheid van alle patiënten en personeel meetelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Agnes Mulder, Sienot, Bromet, Nijboer en Dik-Faber over het rekenmodel waardedalingsregeling dat gedupeerden benadeelt

MPs asked whether the IMG's depreciation model disadvantages the hardest-hit Groningen homes and whether the minister would intervene to apply an individual-level alternative proposed by De Kam and Blanken. The minister replied that the IMG independently sets its own method under the Tijdelijke wet Groningen, that it chose the variant giving the highest average outcomes, and that intervening would undermine its independence, though objections and appeals remain available.
It is not for me but for the IMG to determine, within the legal framework, which method it uses to handle all types of damage, including depreciation damage.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan het IMG om binnen de wettelijke kaders te bepalen welke werkwijze zij hanteert voor de afhandeling van alle schadevormen, waaronder schade door waardedaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gevolgen van de Brexit voor de levering van Nederlandse medicijnen aan het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP asked the health minister about Brexit blocking supply of Dutch-produced cannabis oil to 42 British child epilepsy patients, whether alternatives are adequate, what talks with the UK are underway, and about other affected medicines. The minister confirmed the Brexit cause, said a temporary arrangement continues supply until 1 July 2021 pending a UK-produced solution, and reported no other medicine problems besides cannabis oil.
Until 1 July 2021, the handover of cannabis oil to existing patients from the Netherlands will continue on the same basis as before Brexit.
Tot 1 juli 2021 wordt de terhandstelling van cannabisolie voor bestaande patiënten vanuit Nederland voortgezet op dezelfde voet als vóór de Brexit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het belang van professionele tolken in de zorg

An MP asked the health minister whether professional interpreters in care should be made standard, citing a Kassa report on savings, the use of informal interpreters, the status of the Zorginstituut's quality norm, and funding. The minister answered that good communication is required, that the cost savings are hard to quantify, that the quality norm and existing NZa tariffs already cover interpreter costs, and that a broader standard is for professional groups to develop.
It is primarily up to professional groups to deliver this norm, and they may involve patient organisations and health insurers.
Het is primair aan beroepsgroepen om deze norm op te leveren, waarbij zij ook patiëntenorganisaties en zorgverzekeraars kunnen betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over de Gasopslag in Norg

MPs Dik-Faber and Mulder asked about seismic risk, ground movement and damage compensation linked to the Norg gas storage, including the IMG's suspension of damage claim decisions in Drenthe. The minister answers that risks are low, that monitoring and the IMG's compensation process are adequate, and that the IMG is independent and is awaiting TU Delft and TNO advice.
The IMG is independent in its working method as a zbo. I attach great value to this independence; the IMG itself decides how it handles the aforementioned damage claims.
Het IMG is als zbo onafhankelijk in haar werkwijze. Ik hecht grote waarde aan deze onafhankelijkheid, het IMG bepaalt zelf hoe het omgaat met bovengenoemde schade-afhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Dik-Faber over de plaatsing van windmolens binnen een gebied in de gemeente Haarlem dat gereguleerd is door het Luchthavenindelingsbesluit

MPs Bruins and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why wind turbines near Schiphol in Haarlem are restricted under the airport zoning decree, while a taller KPN mast stands nearby, and urged a waiver. The minister answered that aviation safety rules (ICAO, LIB Schiphol) limit turbine heights, the ILT gave a negative advice, and the height restrictions will be maintained.
No, the current height restriction rules in the LIB Schiphol will be maintained.
Nee, de huidige regels voor hoogtebeperkingen in het LIB Schiphol worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Van Raan over het artikel 'Stukken bos kaalgekapt in Estland voor Nederlandse biomassacentrales'

MPs Sienot, Dik-Faber and Van Raan asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports that whole forests in Estonia were clear-cut to supply Dutch biomass plants, and about controls and sustainability. The minister disputed that this reflects the picture, pointed to strict Dutch sustainability criteria, certification and verification by conformity bodies, and promised to investigate the signal further and discuss it with Estonia.
I want to investigate this signal further and enter into discussion with the authors of the report 'The dark side of the wood pellet'.
Ik wil dit signaal verder onderzoeken en in gesprek gaan met de opstellers van het rapport «De duistere kant van de houtpellet».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de restauratie van het Schnitgerorgel in de Grote of St. Michaëlskerk te Zwolle

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about funding for restoring the Schnitgerorgel in Zwolle, including whether the state would cover up to 100% of eligible costs and the status of a 2.5 million euro subsidy scheme for sounding heritage. The minister confirmed the organ's value, denied any commitment to 100% funding, and said the scheme would be published in spring 2021, with the organ potentially eligible.
No commitment has been made to the Grote Kerk in Zwolle to reach 100% subsidy of the eligible costs.
Er is aan de Grote Kerk te Zwolle geen toezegging gedaan om tot 100% subsidiering van de subsidiabele kosten te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de compensatieregeling voor het ziekenhuis St Jansdal

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the generic COVID compensation scheme between hospitals and insurers, which uses 2019 as base year and disadvantages St Jansdal, and whether tailored compensation and contact with the insurers Zilveren Kruis and VGZ would follow. The minister acknowledged the disadvantage, said insurers and the hospital are negotiating on the hardship clause, and committed to contacting the hospital and insurers.
The health insurers and the hospital are still in discussion with each other about the application of the hardship clause.
De zorgverzekeraars en het ziekenhuis zijn nog in gesprek met elkaar over de toepassing van de hardheidsclausule.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zingen in groepsverband

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health why group singing was banned for people over thirteen, on what evidence the exceptions rest, and how choirs and conductors were informed and compensated. The Minister cites OMT advice that singing cannot be ruled out as a transmission risk, notes the ban has since become a strong recommendation, and offers talks with choir representatives and the financial support available to conductors.

I am willing to enter into discussion with representatives of choirs and conductors and would also gladly involve my colleagues from Justice and Security and Education, Culture and Science, with whom the measures are coordinated.
Ik ben bereid om het gesprek aan te gaan met vertegenwoordigers van koren en dirigenten en betrek ook graag mijn collega's van JenV en OCW, met wie de maatregelen worden afgestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het Dik-Faber over de toegang tot mondzorg voor mensen in de schuldsanering

An MP asked the minister whether people entering debt rescheduling are forced to cancel supplementary health insurance, including dental cover, and what this means for access to care and recovery. The minister said he knows of no signals of forced cancellation, that insurers suspend supplementary cover for premium arrears, and pointed to municipal tools and a planned conference, without committing to new rules.
I am not aware of signals that people in a debt assistance process are forced to cancel their supplementary health insurance.
Ik ben niet bekend met signalen dat mensen in een schuldhulpverleningstraject zitten gedwongen worden om hun aanvullende zorgverzekering op te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over voedselverspilling

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Agriculture about food waste linked to cosmetic standards for fruit and vegetables, the status of a motion, EU-level action, and inclusion of class II produce in the school fruit scheme. The minister answered that retailers have committed to relaxing cosmetic demands, that the EU-level recommendation is pending in UNECE discussions, and that the school fruit scheme rules will be amended to allow class II produce by spring 2021.
Yes, at the upcoming revision of the School Fruit, Vegetables and Milk Scheme 2019 it will be amended so that class II products can also be supplied to schools.
Ja, bij de komende herziening van de Regeling schoolfruit,-groente en -melk 2019 zal deze zo worden aangepast dat ook klasse II producten geleverd kunnen worden aan scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over een isotopenfabriek in Groningen

An MP asked the health minister about a proposed SHINE Medical isotope plant in Groningen, SHINE's concern about state aid to competitor Pallas, the repayment deferral of loans to Pallas, and the Lighthouse technology moving to Belgium. The minister welcomed SHINE's interest, said the Pallas loans are to be repaid, promised a confidential letter on Pallas before year end, and said the decision on Pallas would weigh innovation and supply security.
I will inform your House further before the end of the year in a separate confidential letter (due to the ongoing negotiations)
Ik zal uw Kamer nog voor het einde van het jaar in een aparte vertrouwelijke (vanwege de lopende onderhandelingen) brief hier nader informeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Dik-Faber en Bruins over het bericht ‘Verbreden snelwegen kan ondanks stikstofverbindingen doorgaan dankzij ‘rekentruc’ kabinet’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked whether the 2019 national speed reduction to 100 km/h was modelled without a 5 km cut-off while the 2011 speed increase to 130 km/h used a 3 km cut-off, calling this an accounting trick.
