The minister answered that the models differ for justified reasons, that the freed nitrogen space is not a saving, and that backdating speed changes to manufacture headroom is neither legally nor ecologically an option.
Raising speed on sections where 130 km/h did not yet apply, but was eventually foreseen, was treated under the PAS as an autonomous development.

Het verhogen van de snelheid op trajecten waar destijds nog geen 130 km/uur gold als maximumsnelheid, maar waar dit (uiteindelijk) wel was voorzien, werd in het PAS beschouwd als een autonome ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Dik-Faber en Bruins over het bericht ‘Verbreden snelwegen kan ondanks stikstofverbindingen doorgaan dankzij ‘rekentruc’ kabinet’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management when decisions on seven MIRT road projects would be taken, how much nitrogen space they need under the Hordijk commission's advice, and whether decisions can be postponed until parliament debates that advice. The minister gave the planning status of the seven projects, said AERIUS remains the basis for permitting, and committed to informing parliament on AERIUS development by next summer, while stating the government aims to realise the projects quickly under a motion.
On the further development of AERIUS, the House will be informed before next summer.
Over de doorontwikkeling van AERIUS wordt de Kamer voor de zomer van volgend jaar geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp Van Eijs, Beckerman, Laan-Geselschap, Dik-Faber, Nijboer Geluk-Poortvliet en Terpstra over de noodzaak tot investeren in wonen voor senioren

MPs from several parties asked whether a 80,000-unit shortage of senior housing exists, what the government is doing with the taskforce on housing and care, and whether municipalities should be obliged to build senior homes. The minister answered that the shortage figure's source is unclear, that a senior housing monitor will be sent by year-end, that no binding national targets will be imposed, and that the government is supporting local action through taskforces, agreements and subsidy schemes.
Even after inquiry, it is not clear to us what the source of this figure is.
Het is ons, ook na navraag, niet duidelijk wat de bron is van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Hotel biedt longstay aan: 799 euro voor 6 vierkante meter’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a hotel marketing 6 m2 'longstay' rooms for 799 euro should be treated as housing, which rules apply, and whether tenant protection should be extended to such offers. The Minister answered that these are hotel rooms for short stays outside rental law, that Amsterdam regards such arrangements as not the norm, and promised a transparency convenant on rent setting, possibly to be made binding by legislation.
In this case it does not concern rental of a dwelling but of a hotel room for short-term use.
In deze casus betreft het geen verhuur van een woning maar van een hotelkamer voor kortstondig gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over het besluit Nr. 1/2020 van het Associatiecomité EU-Marokko van 16 maart 2020

ChristenUnie MPs asked whether the EU-Morocco association committee decision on annual information exchange, and the trade preferences extended to products from Western Sahara, has led to exports to the EU and the Netherlands, whether such products are correctly labelled, and whether a list of exported products will be requested and enforced by the NVWA. The government confirmed the exports and the operational information mechanism, said food labelling rules apply regardless of origin and enforcement lies with the NVWA on a risk basis, but did not commit to a new list or specific enforcement.
Part of the agreed information exchange between the EU and Morocco is that Morocco shares with the EU data on exports of products originating in Western Sahara to the EU.

Onderdeel van de overeengekomen informatie-uitwisseling tussen de EU en Marokko is dat Marokko gegevens over de uitvoer van producten van oorsprong uit de Westelijke Sahara naar de EU deelt met de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de dreiging van een boete voor het Israël Producten Centrum

MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP asked the minister why the NVWA is enforcing the 2015 EU interpretive notice on labelling of settlement goods against the Israel Producten Centrum, and why this is not applied equally to other occupied territories, and about consistency with UN and BDS positions. The government answered that EU origin-labelling rules apply uniformly, that the NVWA acted after a complaint, inspection and re-inspection under its intervention policy, and that the 2019 CJEU ruling confirms settlement products must be labelled as such.
There is no exception for Israel or the Israeli-occupied territories or any other country or territory.
Er is geen uitzondering voor Israël of de door Israël bezette gebieden of een ander land of gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘AED-netwerk is uitgebreid, maar nog niet dekkend’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about AED coverage, noting that only about 22,000 AEDs are registered with the HartslagNU call system despite many more existing in the Netherlands, and asked what actions would expand registration and training of civilian responders. The minister replied that many AEDs are indoors or poorly accessible, that coverage improved in 2020, that municipalities are responsible for AED policy, and that HartslagNU aims to grow its responder network, without committing to new concrete government measures.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for AED policy.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het beleid rond AED’s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over de berichten 'Nederland moet haast maken met groen economisch herstel na de coronacrisis' en 'We staan op een kantelpunt voor het klimaatbeleid'

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the government about green economic recovery after the COVID-19 crisis, including investment advice from the PBL, IEA, DNB and SER, hydrogen competitiveness, the CO2 levy, KLM sustainability conditions, and workforce retraining for the energy transition. The minister responded that the Klimaatakkoord forms the basis for green recovery, that additional investments via the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility and accelerated projects (about EUR 2 billion) are being prepared, and that the CO2 levy for industry proceeds from 1 January 2021 without delay.
The cabinet wants to make room for additional investments via the European Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF).
Het kabinet wil ruimte maken voor aanvullende investeringen via de Europese Recovery and Resilience Facility (RFF).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de ziekte van Parkinson en het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen

An MP asks the government about a publication linking certain pesticides to Parkinson's disease, the adequacy of EU approval testing for neurotoxic effects, and monitoring of residues. The minister says the EU procedure will be tightened, commits to asking the Commission to revise data requirements, and points to ongoing Gezondheidsraad and monitoring work.
I have in the meantime asked the European Commission by letter to start a process to revise the data requirements on neurological disorders.
heb de Europese Commissie inmiddels per brief verzocht een traject te starten om de datavereisten op het gebied van neurologische aandoeningen te herzien
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over het ontwerpinstemmingsbesluit Winningsplan Nedmag en de zoutwinningsactiviteiten in Zuidwending

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the draft Nedmag salt-mining permit in Zuidwending, covering water board and local advice, subsidence and cumulative risks, damage claims and reversal of the burden of proof, diesel and well sealing, permit duration, financial guarantees, and reuse of caverns. The Minister answered that advice was weighed and reflected in conditions (no further extraction from VE-3, limited TR-9, financial guarantee before extraction starts), that a Mining Damage Committee handles claims without a statutory burden-of-proof reversal, and that the permit length and diesel risks are considered adequate under SodM oversight.

Partly on the basis of the advice, I do not consent to further salt extraction from cavern VE-3, and I limit extraction from cavern TR-9 to prevent it from becoming too large and merging with the cluster.

Ik stem mede op basis van de adviezen niet in met verdere zoutwinning uit caverne VE-3 en ik beperk de zoutwinning uit de caverne TR-9 om te voorkomen dat deze caverne te groot wordt en aan het cluster groeit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over ‘het verlengen van opsporingsvergunningen voor olie en gas aan Vermilion zonder aan wettelijke criteria te voldoen’

An MP asked the minister why an expired Vermilion oil and gas exploration licence still appears as extended, whether an eight-year extension is being pursued without meeting legal criteria, and how municipal objections will be addressed. The minister confirmed the pending extension request, said the licence registration does not confer rights, denied a practice of halving requested terms, and committed to no new onshore exploration licences and enforcement by the State Supervision of Mines.
I have not yet made a decision on extending the validity period of the licence or on the exact term of this extension.
Ik heb nog geen besluit genomen over het verlengen van de geldigheidsduur van de vergunning of over de exacte termijn van deze verlenging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over de oproep van de Burgemeester van Loppersum voor een andere aanpak voor de versterkingsoperatie in Groningen

MPs asked whether the government will act on the Loppersum mayor's call for a crisis team and an emergency law to speed up the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation. The minister says the government is pursuing faster implementation, is in talks with the mayor and regional administrators, and will inform parliament on outcomes, while the reinforcement bill is still being revised after the Council of State's advice.
In line with our commitment in the General Consultation on Mining/Groningen of 24 June, we will inform the House of the outcomes as soon as possible.
Conform onze toezegging in het Algemeen Overleg Mijnbouw/Groningen van 24 juni jl. informeren wij uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het advies van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie om de abortuspil na 24 weken te gebruiken

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the minister about WHO guidance permitting medical abortion pills after 12 and even 24 weeks, questioning its compatibility with Dutch practice and whether development aid funds such procedures. The minister replied that Dutch clinics limit the pill to 9 weeks while hospitals follow NVOG guidance up to 24 weeks, saw no reason to contact the WHO, and said aid supports safe abortion care within recipient countries' legal frameworks.
I see no reason to contact the WHO about the 2014 Clinical practice handbook for safe abortion.
Ik heb geen aanleiding om in contact te treden met de WHO over het in 2014 uitgebrachte «Clinical practice handbook for safe abortion».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over agrobosbouw

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about agroforestry (agrobosbouw): its potential for climate, biodiversity and soil goals, support instruments, the Wet natuurbescherming, verdienmodellen, agricultural education and the 25,000 ha target in the Klimaatakkoord. The Minister answered that agroforestry is a promising form of farming still in its infancy, that advice is being studied, and that she will work on a subsidy scheme, GLB pilots and the Bossenstrategie, while many questions were answered only with planned analyses.
I am willing to discuss this with the provinces in the context of the forest strategy.
Ik ben bereid hier over in gesprek te gaan met provincies in het kader van de bossenstrategie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schonis over het bericht: ‘Corona jaagt ov-reizigers de deelauto in’

MPs Schonis and Dik-Faber asked the state secretary about reports that COVID-19 pushed public transport users into car sharing, and about how to encourage safe and electric car sharing, its effect on congestion and CO2, and subsidy eligibility for cooperatives. The state secretary answered that car sharing is promoted via the Green Deal Autodelen II and a sector hygiene protocol, that the shift is small and its traffic and CO2 effects limited, and that the electric car subsidy is restricted to individuals for administrative reasons.
I am willing to enter into discussion with the sector about this.
Ik ben bereid om met de sector het gesprek hierover aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over De (woning)bouw ten tijde van de Coronacrisis

An MP asked the minister how COVID-19 affects housing construction order intake, the housing shortage, anti-cyclical building measures, and related permitting, tax and mortgage issues. The minister answered that the government is taking a range of measures (a 'keep building' package, reprioritised funds, flexible municipal staffing pools) and promised to monitor the situation and report back to parliament if further measures are needed.
I am therefore in close consultation with the sector to monitor the extent to which home purchases decline and which measures may need to be taken to ensure building continues.

Ik ben daarom nauw met de sector in overleg om te monitoren in hoeverre de aankoop van woningen terugloopt en welke maatregelen eventueel genomen moeten worden om ervoor te zorgen dat er doorgebouwd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de Ecodesign-richtlijn en de reparatie-infrastructuur in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary whether EU Ecodesign rules oblige manufacturers to support repair of household appliances, and whether repair cafés, a national repair registry, and stronger repair-sector policy should be pursued. The State Secretary confirmed Ecodesign requirements on spare parts and repair information from March 2021, said a broader study on professionalising the repair sector will be commissioned, and committed to report back on a registry.
I will inform the House about the results of the study and my consideration regarding the registration platform.
Over de resultaten van het onderzoek en mijn afweging over het registratieplatform zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het weer opschalen van de reguliere ziekenhuiszorg

MP Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the slow restart of regular hospital care after COVID-19, including waiting lists, digital care, staff involvement, hospital finances and early warning of financial risk. The minister answered that hospitals bear primary responsibility, the NZa coordinates regionally, digitalisation and finance arrangements are being developed, and a plan for IC capacity is forthcoming.
It is primarily the responsibility of healthcare providers themselves to restart care and to use the possibilities for their own organisation.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders zelf om de zorg weer op te starten en de mogelijkheden daartoe voor de eigen organisatie te benutten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind over het rapport 'The burning question' van Tearfund en overige berichtgeving over het verbranden van plastic afval in ontwikkelingslanden en de verantwoordelijkhei

MPs Dik-Faber and Voordewind asked the government about the Tearfund report on plastic waste burning in developing countries, corporate responsibility of major beverage and food companies, export of plastic waste, and whether Dutch plastic waste is incinerated instead of recycled. The State Secretary answered that companies should map and address risks in line with OECD guidelines, outlined existing pacts, export rules and pilot projects, and said a study on banning incineration of recyclable waste is underway, promising to inform parliament later.
I am conducting an exploration into a ban on incinerating recyclable waste.
Ik voer een verkenning uit naar een verbod op het verbranden van recyclebaar afval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zonnepanelen op water

MP Dik-Faber asks how many locations are considering floating solar on water, what is known about ecological effects, whether natural areas like the IJsselmeer should be considered, and how the solar ladder (preferring roofs and facades) applies. The minister says roughly a dozen floating projects have been permitted, ecological research is ongoing, natural areas are not excluded in principle, and the solar ladder will be monitored within the RES process.
The competent authority also takes the ecological impact into account in the permit assessment.
Het bevoegd gezag neemt bij de vergunningverlening ook de ecologische impact mee in de afweging.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over de registratie van kinderen die kort na geboorte zijn overleden maar waarvan geen akte van overlijden is opgemaakt

Two Christian Union MPs asked how parents whose infant died shortly after birth, without any death certificate having been issued, can have this registered, and whether they must hire a lawyer to go to court. The minister confirmed a court procedure exists, that a lawyer is generally needed, and promised to map the problem with civil registrars and report in the second half of the year, and a bill is being prepared to allow registration of such children in the BRP.

I will, in consultation with the professional association of civil registrars, map the scale of the problem and on that basis examine whether there is reason to further assist parents, in addition to the existing options.

Ik zal in overleg met de beroepsvereniging van ambtenaren van de burgerlijke stand, de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Burgerzaken (NVVB), in kaart brengen wat de omvang van de problematiek is en op basis daarvan nagaan of er aanleiding is om -aanvullend op de bestaande mogelijkheden- ouders nader tegemoet te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Trillende handen, dementie, depressie: landbouwgif is zo onschuldig niet'

MPs De Groot and Dik-Faber asked about reported links between pesticides and Parkinson's and other neurological conditions, the Gezondheidsraad advice, EU action on mancozeb, and timing of the advice. The minister said she takes the concerns seriously, asked the Gezondheidsraad to examine health risks, requested the European Commission to revise neurological data requirements, and pressed the Commission to finalise the mancozeb decision, with the Gezondheidsraad advice expected in summer.

I expect the Gezondheidsraad advice on the health risks of exposure to crop protection products in the summer and will share it with your House, together with the Minister for Medical Care and Sport and the Minister for Environment and Housing.

Ik verwacht het advies van de Gezondheidsraad over de gezondheidsrisico's van blootstelling aan gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in de zomer en zal dit, samen met de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport en de Minister voor Milieu en Wonen, met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Dik-Faber over opkoop van diverse veehouderijen in andere provincies door de provincie Noord-Brabant

MPs Geurts and Dik-Faber asked the minister about Noord-Brabant buying out livestock farms in other provinces to use external nitrogen offsetting for Logistiek Park Moerdijk, and about scattered nitrogen effects from shipping and offsetting rules. The minister replied that the province acted within its policy rules but acknowledged poor coordination with other provinces, and promised agreements with provinces on notification, monitoring and management measures.
Given the limited coordination with other provinces over this buyout, this did not go well and caused much unrest, for which the province has offered apologies.
Gezien de beperkte afstemming met de andere provincies over deze opkoop, is dit hier niet goed verlopen en heeft dit veel onrust veroorzaakt waarvoor de provincie excuses heeft aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Bijna helft oudere huizen steenkoud zonder gas’

An MP asked the government whether older homes will still need a gas connection because heating demand on cold winter days cannot be met by insulation and alternatives, and how network operators' warnings fit with the Climate Agreement. The minister rejects that claim as a firm conclusion, stating that heating options (heat pumps, heat networks, hybrid solutions) will be assessed per neighbourhood and that municipalities lead the transition with residents' interests protected.
I therefore do not endorse the stated claim.
Ik onderschrijf de genoemde stelling daarom niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over een werkbezoek aan Groningen op maandag 2 maart 2020

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked the ministers about differing reinforcement regimes in Overschild, slow reinforcement advice, cost recovery from NAM, small-field gas damage claims, vacant housing, and Delfzijl evacuations. Minister Ollongren answered that regime differences are unavoidable given evolving policy, that the new law gives residents a choice of control, and that the damage protocol and Commission should be operational by 1 July 2020, while largely deferring details to other bodies.
The bill does not change agreements made within the implementation of the various batches.
Het wetsvoorstel brengt geen wijzigingen aan in afspraken die in het kader van uitvoering van de verschillende batches zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de e-laadinfrastructuur voor vrachtwagens

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether the lack of public charging infrastructure for electric trucks along motorways would delay the transition to electric freight, and whether subsidies or a sound business case could speed up roll-out. The state secretary acknowledged the gap, pointed to existing logistics charging provisions in the Klimaatakkoord and national agenda, and to the DKTI and MIA/VAMIL schemes, while stating that the business case and RED2 implications will be reviewed.
With the implementation of RED2, the impact on the business case for charging infrastructure will be reviewed again.
Bij de implementatie van de RED2 wordt opnieuw gekeken naar de impact op de business case van laadinfrastructuur
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over woonruimte voor (economisch) daklozen

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Housing about homelessness among economically displaced people, including its link to housing shortages, the Ombudsman's recommendations, the kostendelersnorm exception, and housing solutions. The minister answered at length, describing existing measures (Flexwonen, Crisis- en herstelwet changes, CBS data), noting no categorical exception to the kostendelersnorm, and promising a broader national plan later.
To gain more insight into the regional task of reducing the number of homeless people, the cabinet has asked the centre municipalities to map it.
Om meer zicht te krijgen op de regionale opgave om specifiek het aantal dak- en thuislozen terug te dringen heeft het kabinet de centrumgemeenten gevraagd deze in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Dik-Faber en Harbers over de organisatie van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen

Four MPs asked the Minister about reported internal chaos at the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG), its absorption of the CVW, staff turnover and whether this threatens reinforcement work. The Minister denied chaos, called reorganisation necessary, said public execution is now with the NCG and the TCMG/IMG handles compensation, and promised further attention to staff retention and continued contact.
The image that there would be chaos, as the headline above the cited report suggests, I do not recognise.
Het beeld dat er sprake zou zijn van chaos, zoals de kop boven het aangehaalde bericht suggereert, herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schonis over het bericht ‘Kosten verlaging maximumsnelheid twee keer hoger dan verwacht’

MPs Dik-Faber and Schonis asked whether the costs of lowering the motorway speed limit were twice the expected amount and why Rijkswaterstaat would place extra 130 km/h signs and why EV charging-point signs were not added. The minister confirmed the extra signs, said budget and time were allocated for the urgent nitrogen-driven speed reduction, and committed to combining charging-point signage with the work where cost-efficient.
Rijkswaterstaat has indicated that it will prepare a schedule including a cost estimate for this after completing the placement of the current signs.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft aangegeven hiervoor een planning inclusief een kostenraming te maken na afronding van het plaatsen van de huidige borden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het WUR rapport ‘Cosmetische aspecten in specifieke handelsnormen voor groenten en fruit’

MP Dik-Faber asked the minister about a WUR report on cosmetic standards for fruit and vegetables, the lack of data on waste, consumer acceptance, and supermarket cosmetic requirements, and whether the minister would act on them. The minister answered that the report gives enough basis to raise EU trade standards, committed to further research via a waste working group, reported talks with supermarkets who agreed to relax requirements when needed, and said structural solutions would be explored with the working group.
I presented this recommendation in November 2019 to the UNECE working group on agricultural product standards.
Tevens heb ik deze aanbeveling in november 2019 voorgelegd aan de «UNECE-werkgroep standaarden agrarische producten».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat bewoners van vakantiepark De Ossenberg eruit worden gezet

MP Dik-Faber asks the minister about residents of holiday parks being evicted, including a family in Hensbroek facing a dwangsom, and whether alternative housing and individual solutions are secured for vulnerable residents. The minister says no national data exist on evictions, that municipalities vary in offering tailored support, and promises a quality and assessment framework for municipalities by year end.
There is no national overview of how many residents had to leave their recreational property as a result of an enforcement procedure.
Er is geen landelijk overzicht van hoeveel bewoners als gevolg van een handhavingstraject hun recreatieobject hebben moeten verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Van der Lee en Van Raan over de Gedragscode Zon op Land

Five MPs from different parties asked ministers about the industry-drafted Gedragscode Zon op Land (code of conduct for ground-mounted solar), its alignment with the solar-ladder motions, protection of Natura 2000 and national park areas, guidance to local authorities and RES regions, use in rijksgronden tenders, and PBL's landscape report. The government welcomed the code as consistent with the voorkeursvolgorde zon, said it will be promoted via the Nationaal Programma RES and monitored, and deferred the landscape-policy questions to a forthcoming NOVI letter.
Through the National Programme RES we will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the RES regions.
Via het Nationaal Programma RES (NP RES) brengen we deze gedragscode onder de aandacht van de RES’en.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Omdat duizenden bedrijven geen natuurvergunning hebben weten we niet hoeveel stikstof de industrie uitstoot’

An MP asked the ministers whether it is known how many companies lack a nature permit under the Nature Conservation Act, and why emissions reporting thresholds limit visibility of industrial nitrogen emissions. The government answered that the number of companies without permits is not known, that provinces are responsible for permitting and enforcement, and that industrial emissions are well covered by the Emissieregistratie, while declining to lower the reporting threshold.
It is not known how many companies wrongly lack a permit under the Nature Conservation Act.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel bedrijven er ten onrechte geen vergunning hebben in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Dik –Faber over het standpunt van het Zorginstituut Nederland over de hooggebergtebehandeling voor patiënten met ernstig astma

MPs Van Gerven and Dik-Faber asked the Minister for Medical Care about the Zorginstituut's decision to drop reimbursement of high-altitude treatment for severe asthma, including its handling of the REFRAST study, insurer authorisation delays, and whether a follow-up study and stakeholder talks will be held. The Minister defers to the Zorginstituut procedure, says it will evaluate how suited its methods are to small patient groups, notes insurers have contracted the Davos clinic for 2020, and will inform the House after talks with stakeholders.
I stand behind this procedure as I also indicated during the committee debate.
Ik sta achter deze procedure zoals ik dat ook tijdens het AO heb aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Sienot over de gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Dik-Faber and Sienot asked the minister about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, including whether the NAM study on long-term subsidence is independent, the timing of results, the Auditcommissie's role, sea-level rise, Natura 2000 nitrogen effects, the permit procedure, and whether decisions should wait for a debate. The minister answered that the NAM study was commissioned by him, results go to the Auditcommissie with advice expected late 2019 or early 2020, the NAM has commercial interests, and gas extraction may continue within existing permits and the Mijnbouwwet/Wet natuurbescherming framework.
I expect the advice of the Auditcommissie at the end of 2019 or the beginning of 2020. I aim to send this advice and my response to your House in the first months of 2020.
Het advies van de Auditcommissie verwacht ik eind 2019 of begin 2020. Ik streef er naar dit advies van de Auditcommissie en mijn reactie daarop in de eerste maanden van 2020 aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Dik-Faber en Van den Berg over het werkbezoek aan het Emma Kinderziekenhuis

MPs asked the minister about problems chronically ill young people face when transitioning to adult care, including loss of parental involvement, financial burdens and DBC billing limits, and about a transition unit and AVG care billing. The minister acknowledged transition challenges, said care providers and insurers should make tailored agreements and that NZa is handling AVG billing, but did not commit to a new transition unit pilot or funding.
I will make inquiries about this in the relevant consultations, such as the regular consultation with the Dutch Federation of University Medical Centres (NFU).
Ik zal hiernaar in de daarvoor in aanmerking komende overleggen, zoals in het reguliere overleg met de de Nederlandse Federatie van Universitair Medische Centra (NFU), navraag doen.
Antwoord op de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over het gebruik van biomassa als energiebron

MPs Dik-Faber, Sienot and Agnes Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the DNV-GL report on biomass emissions, subsidy amounts, sustainability criteria, planned plants and the RES regional energy strategies. The minister responded that a TNO study on tighter emission limits for small and medium biomass plants is underway, that a sustainability framework is being prepared with an SER advisory report expected in early 2020, and that subsidies for biomass plants continue for now.
I cannot disclose the origin of the wood pellets of a specific company, because this information is commercially confidential.
De herkomst van de houtpellets van een specifiek bedrijf kan ik – in verband met bedrijfsvertrouwelijke aard van deze informatie – niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over vismigratie barrières

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about fish migration barriers, including whether only 35% of fish passage facilities work, whether maintenance is secured, and whether KRW targets for 2027 can be met. The Minister disputed the 35% figure, reported that 66% of evaluated facilities function well, said water managers handle testing and maintenance, and stated that not all barriers need removing for a healthy fish stock.
I do not recognise the figure of only 35% of fish migration facilities working.
Het getal van slechts 35% werkende vismigratievoorzieningen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Dik-Faber over sanering van ernstig vervuilde bodems in gemeente de Ronde Venen

MPs Stoffer and Dik-Faber asked about lead-contaminated soil in De Ronde Venen, the urgency of remediation above 800 mg/kg, the division of responsibilities between state, province and municipality, and financing. The minister answered that the intervention threshold signals possible need for measures, that the Soil Convenant leaves it to competent authorities to decide, that responsibilities shift to municipalities under the Environment and Planning Act, that funding runs to end-2020, and that a joint taskforce is working on scenarios.
It concerns a signal value, which indicates that measures may possibly be necessary.
Het betreft een signaalwaarde, die aangeeft dat mogelijkerwijze maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het ontbreken van informatie op verpakkingen t.b.v. recycling

An MP asked the state secretary about Natuur & Milieu findings that packaging is overly complex, poorly labelled for sorting and often not recyclable, and about the effectiveness of the Plastic Pact and industry plans. The secretary largely acknowledged the problems, pointed to tariff differentiation, EU-level tightening of essential requirements and planned higher recycling targets, but declined to make the industry plans binding and gave no firm new national rules.
I have no possibility to declare them generally binding, because a sector is not a recognised entity in the Packaging Management Decree.
Ik heb geen mogelijkheid ze algemeen verbindend te verklaren, omdat een branche niet een erkende entiteit is in het Besluit beheer verpakkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over de registratie van levend geboren kinderen die voor het doen van geboorteaangifte reeds waren overleden

MPs Van der Graaf and Dik-Faber asked whether children born alive but dead before birth registration could only be recorded as stillborn in the population register, and whether ouders could have them registered as born alive and later deceased. The State Secretary explained the civil-status and population-register procedures, said a pre-1994 child cannot get its own record with a death date, but that the birth date appears on the parent's record, and declined new instructions or legislation.
Because the BRP already shows in the current situation that the child lived, I do not consider additional instructions and legislation necessary.
Omdat in de huidige situatie al uit de BRP blijkt dat het kind heeft geleefd, acht ik aanvullende instructies en wetgeving niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de bereikbaarheid van 113 Zelfmoordpreventie

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the 113 suicide prevention line could be made directly reachable via the 113 number, since the 0900 number is less known and costly, after a family tragedy where a caller dialled a non-existent 113 number. The State Secretary answered that a 0800 number now removes cost barriers, that the 1-1-3 number could potentially be made available subject to a number-plan change by the ACM, a process of at least three months with conditions and misdialling risks still being studied, and committed to further investigation with the Minister of Justice.
Together with the Minister of Justice we will investigate the possibilities, risks and appropriate conditions for making this number available.
Samen met de Minister van JenV zullen wij onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden, de risico’s en passende voorwaarden zijn bij het beschikbaar maken van dit nummer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Dik-Faber over het bericht ’Plastic theezakjes blijkt bron van microplastic’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that plastic tea bags release microplastics, including how many are used, whether plastic should be banned, legal options, other sources, and whether they fall under EU single-use plastics rules. The State Secretary answered that data are lacking, health effects are still under study, existing EU rules on migration limits apply, no new ban is currently considered necessary, and tea bags are not covered by the single-use plastics directive.
The cabinet currently sees no need for that.
Daar ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen noodzaak toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht het bericht ‘Chemische bedrijven overtreden massaal de regels: 'Veiligheidscultuur moet anders'

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about research showing that about 90% of Brzo chemical companies committed a safety violation over 2006–2017, with 7% responsible for a quarter of violations, and about risk-based inspection and safety culture. The state secretary answered that the data show a stable share of compliant firms, that the 'repeat offender' definition needs clarification with the researchers, that existing enforcement tools are considered sufficient, and that a range of safety-culture and cooperation initiatives are underway.
I would like to engage with the researchers to properly interpret the results and see how the follow-up research can offer points of departure for policy.
Ik wil graag in gesprek met de onderzoekers om de resultaten goed te kunnen duiden en te kijken hoe het vervolgonderzoek aangrijpingspunten voor beleid kan bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het recht op huurtoeslag van cliënten in een beschermde woonvorm

An MP asked whether residents of supported housing cannot claim rent allowance when their building is owned by a commercial landlord, and whether this worsens the shortage of housing from non-profit landlords. The minister confirmed the rule, said local authorities and housing corporations are responsible for housing supply, and pointed to recent government plans without committing to amend the rule.
I share your concern about realising sufficiently affordable housing with appropriate support for this group of vulnerable citizens.
Ik deel uw zorg om voldoende betaalbare huisvesting met passende ondersteuning te realiseren voor deze groep kwetsbare burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de aanbeveling van het VN-Mensenrechtencomité 2019 om de waarborgen voor de euthanasiepraktijk te versterken door toetsing vooraf

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked whether the government will respond to the 2019 UN Human Rights Committee recommendation to strengthen ex ante review of euthanasia, including an independent ethics commission. Minister De Jonge replied that he sees no reason to change the Wtl, citing broad public support, six careful-practice criteria and post-hoc review by regional committees, and that this answer serves as an early response.
I see no reason to amend the current euthanasia legislation, for the following reasons.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de huidige euthanasiewetgeving aan te passen, om de volgende redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Drost over de registratie van een levenloos geboren kind na een abortus

MPs Dik-Faber and Drost asked why a stillborn child after abortion could be registered in the Basisregistratie Personen, whether this was foreseen, and how it fits with the law on abortion and the legal status of unborn life. The State Secretary answered that registration follows parents' wishes without conditions, that no legal consequences attach, that the Waz framework is unchanged, and declined to launch a broader societal debate.
I have received similar questions from municipalities and will shortly look into what can be done about this.
Ik heb overigens vergelijkbare vragen ontvangen vanuit gemeenten en zal op korte termijn bekijken wat hieraan gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het aanbieden van scholing over euthanasie bij psychiatrie door het Expertisecentrum Euthanasie van de Levenseindekliniek

An MP asked the Minister of Health about euthanasia training for psychiatrists offered by the Levenseindekliniek, the NVvP guideline on euthanasia in psychiatry, and whether psychiatrists should engage more with such requests. The Minister answered that the profession is responsible for training and guidelines, pointed to existing NVvP training and dissemination, said it is too early to measure referral effects, and promised a study of psychiatric euthanasia requests reported in early 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over de uitzending van Radar over drugsdumpingen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about drug waste dumpings on private land, including whether owners should be expected to take preventive measures, whether full compensation for clean-up costs is warranted, and whether convicted dumpers could fund a victims' fund. The government answered that owners need not take preventive measures, that full compensation for direct clean-up costs for private owners will be provided through provincial schemes and structural funding, and that a victims' fund and separate co-financing arrangements are still being explored by the intergovernmental working group.
In connection with drug dumpings, citizens who have committed no offence are not obliged to take measures to prevent the dumping of drug waste, nor to clean up dumped drug waste.

In samenhang met drugsdumpingen zijn burgers die geen overtreding hebben begaan, niet verplicht om maatregelen te nemen om dumping van drugsafval tegen te gaan en ook niet om gedumpt drugsafval op te ruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind over het tegengaan van het gebruik van lachgas

MPs Dik-Faber and Voordewind asked the state secretary about municipalities and festivals banning recreational nitrous oxide, its health and environmental harm, and whether national measures are needed after voluntary retailer agreements. The state secretary said he will consult VNG and municipalities, commissioned a new CAM risk assessment due late November, and will report on it, while stating he lacks data on how many municipalities have banned use.
I do not have such data.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, en Dik-Faber over het artikel ‘Gedupeerden gaswinning moeten twee keer zo lang wachten op afhandeling schade’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that Groningen gas-damage claimants face a total wait of about 30 months, as the TCMG postponed its decision deadline by fifteen months. The Minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to a backlog inherited by the TCMG, and announced a one-off stuwmeer scheme offering a fixed compensation of 5,000 euro to all claims received up to 12 June 2019, with variable compensation up to 11,000 euro for claims from 1 January 2019.
I have decided to enable the TCMG to apply the fixed compensation of 5,000 euro from the stuwmeer scheme to all applications received by the TCMG up to and including 12 June 2019.
Ik heb besloten het de TCMG mogelijk te maken de vaste vergoeding van € 5.000,– uit de stuwmeerregeling te laten gelden voor alle aanvragen die door de TCMG zijn ontvangen tot en met 12 juni 2019
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Dik-Faber over de berichten ‘NBA bezorgd over daling aantal oob-kantoren’ en ‘Woningcorporaties worden al streng genoeg gecontroleerd’

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Finance and Interior ministers about NBA concerns that the number of accountancy firms licensed to audit public-interest entities (oob) is falling, and about extending that status to large housing corporations. The minister answers that the decline is regrettable but not yet a shortage, rejects tailored rules for small oob firms, and says the oob status for housing corporations above 5,000 units will go ahead, while promising to await the CTA recommendations on the audit market.
Applying tailored treatment for smaller oob accountancy organisations does not seem desirable to me from that point of view.
Het toepassen van maatwerk voor kleinere oob-accountantsorganisaties lijkt mij vanuit dat oogpunt niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de rietteelt en rietsnijders in Nederland, in het bijzonder nationaal park de Weerribben-Wieden

An MP asked about unrest among reed cutters in the Weerribben-Wieden after SNL subsidy rates were lowered, the tenancy and import problems, and the sector's future. The minister acknowledged the concerns, explained that subsidy rates are set by an independent IPO commission, and said the province is reviewing effects and that she is willing to talk with the sector and IPO.
I am happy to be willing to enter into discussion with the IPO, the Province of Overijssel and the sector about reed cultivation in the Weerribben-Wieden.
Ik ben graag bereid om met het IPO, de Provincie Overijssel en de sector in gesprek te gaan over de rietteelt in de Weerribben-Wieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Die gevaarlijke pijnstiller uitbannen lukt maar niet’

MPs De Groot and Dik-Faber asked about a study and news report on pharmaceutical residues (diclofenac) in water, including EU priority substance listing, waterboard monitoring, province and Rijkswaterstaat action, hospital wastewater treatment and the Green Deal Duurzame Zorg. The minister agrees on the urgency, notes the EU has postponed revising the priority list, points to the chain approach and biomonitoring experiments, says hospital treatment depends on local circumstances, and promises to keep the Chamber informed on the Green Deal follow-up.
I will gladly keep you informed of the progress on both topics.
Ik zal u graag op de hoogte houden van de stand van zaken op beide onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de situatie van donorkinderen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health about the implementation of the 2017 action plan for donor-conceived children, the evaluation of the Donor Data Act, consanguinity limits on donors, and access to donor information. The Minister reported on the status of the seven action points, said the evaluation is nearly complete, defended the 25-children limit as revised, and said the age-16 disclosure threshold follows other legislation.
As usual, the Minister of VWS accounts to the House of Representatives for the policy pursued and thus also for the status of the action plan supporting donor children.

Zoals gebruikelijk legt de Minister van VWS verantwoording af over het gevoerde beleid aan de Tweede Kamer en daarmee ook over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot het Actieplan ondersteuning donorkinderen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het rapport 'Circulaire economie in kaart' van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the PBL report on the circular economy, including whether policy should shift toward higher R-strategies, design for repair, support for repair businesses and Repair Cafés. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, pointed to the Uitvoeringsprogramma circulaire economie, the CIRCO programme, the Versnellingshuis and the RepairMonitor, but gave mostly general commitments without new concrete measures.
By summer 2020, an update of this implementation programme will be sent to the House, incorporating new insights from the forthcoming PBL progress report.

Voor de zomer van 2020 zal er, ook naar aanleiding van de in de tussentijd te verschijnen voortgangsrapportage van PBL, een actualisering van dit Uitvoeringsprogramma aan de Kamer worden aangeboden waarin nieuwe inzichten meegenomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber, Agnes Mulder, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Stress door gasellende in bevingsgebied neemt toe’

MPs asked the minister about reports that gas-extraction stress in the Groningen earthquake area is rising, the need for psychological care funding, and NAM liability for immaterial damage. The minister acknowledged the mental health problem, pointed to ending gas extraction, independent damage and reinforcement processes, regional support programmes, and said he will await the outcome of pending court proceedings on immaterial damage.
I am awaiting the outcome of the court proceedings.
Ik wacht de uitkomst van de gerechtelijke procedures af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Dik-Faber, Sienot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de metingen van het KNMI in de Groninger bodem niet kloppen

Four MPs asked the minister about reports that KNMI seismic acceleration measurements in Groningen were miscalibrated, covering the cause, when officials and SodM were informed, effects on hazard maps and damage assessment, and whether trust and oversight are affected. The minister answered in detail on the timeline and the KNMI error, said data are usable after correction, and committed to an SodM audit and an evaluation of KNMI's internal processes.
SodM is having an independent audit carried out on the quality of the KNMI's measured ground accelerations.
SodM laat een onafhankelijke audit uitvoeren op de kwaliteit van de gemeten grondversnellingen van het KNMI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Dik-Faber, Sienot en Von Martels over het bericht dat de metingen in de Groninger bodem niet kloppen

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management how KNMI measurement errors in Groningen went unreported from August 2018 until February 2019, and what will prevent recurrence. The government answered that the KNMI delayed reporting, announced an evaluation, a working group, and an additional SodM audit, while stating the hazard models and damage decisions are not affected.
We regret that the KNMI did not report the identified deviations in a timely manner.
Wij betreuren het dat het KNMI niet tijdig een melding heeft gemaakt van de geconstateerde afwijkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Dik-Faber en Remco Dijkstra over de doorlooptijden bij het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

MPs asked why driving licence renewals at the CBR take so long, leaving people without valid licences and at risk of losing their jobs, and about poor communication and the four-week response standard. The minister acknowledged the delays, described CBR capacity expansion, priority handling for expiring licences and professional drivers, and extra information measures, but did not discuss specific cases.
The CBR must provide clarity on the renewal of the driving licence within four months. Unfortunately, this is currently not achieved in all cases by the CBR.
Het CBR dient binnen vier maanden duidelijkheid te geven over de vernieuwing van het rijbewijs. Dit wordt op dit moment helaas niet in alle gevallen gehaald door het CBR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Ministerie erkent blunder met energierekening: Tweede Kamer boos’

MPs from VVD, D66, ChristenUnie and CDA asked why the government had used outdated 2017 PBL projections of household energy bills, which underestimated rising prices, and what the consequences are for the 2019 budget, koopkracht and the Klimaatakkoord analysis. Minister Wiebes acknowledges the government should have been less categorical and that the PBL did not update its outlook in 2018, attributes the price rise to market developments and existing policy, and promises a new PBL estimate within weeks.
The cabinet should have been less categorical at the end of last year and should have stressed more that this was a 2017 estimate.
Het kabinet had zich eind vorig jaar minder stellig moeten uitlaten en meer moeten benadrukken dat het hier ging om een raming uit 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het eigen voedselkeuzelogo van Coca-Cola

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health why Coca-Cola is introducing its own food-choice logo on Dutch products and how this fits the planned government-backed, independently researched logo. The State Secretary regrets the company-specific logo, says a single shared logo under the Prevention Accord is needed, and promises a meeting with Coca-Cola.
I will shortly meet with Coca-Cola to share my position, as set out in this reply, with them.
Ik ga binnenkort in gesprek met Coca-Cola om mijn standpunt zoals ook in deze beantwoording verwoord met hen te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de ‘Rapportage aan het Comité voor de rechten van personen met een handicap, inzake de eerste rapportage van Nederland’

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how the government responds to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report on implementing the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, covering accessibility, local inclusion plans, guardianship, education, transport and development aid. The Minister answered that the Onbeperkt Meedoen! programme and existing measures address these concerns, while acknowledging that implementation takes time and promising follow-up letters and an evaluation meeting.
I share the College's call to make the necessary adjustments as quickly as possible so that persons with disabilities can participate as fully as possible in society.

Ik deel de oproep van het College om zo snel als mogelijk noodzakelijke aanpassingen te treffen om te zorgen dat personen met een beperking zo volwaardig mogelijk kunnen deelnemen aan de maatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het stimuleren van kleinschalige windprojecten

MPs from GroenLinks, CDA, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about decommissioning of small wind turbines, municipal refusals to allow replacement of solitary mills, subsidy levels for medium-sized turbines and uncertainty around the postcode rose scheme. The Minister responded that some decommissioning is planned and monitored, that location decisions rest with provinces and municipalities, that he does not favour a separate SDE+ tariff for medium turbines, and that the successor to the net-metering scheme is still being worked out.
I note that in its report ECN calculated base amounts for hub heights of 40 to 50 metres and 50 to 60 metres respectively.
Ik teken hierbij aan dat ECN in haar rapport basisbedragen heeft berekend voor ashoogten van respectievelijk 40 tot 50 meter en 50 tot 60 meter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de moeizame recycling van textiel vanwege de slechte kwaliteit

An ChristenUnie MP asks the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about poor textile recycling due to low-quality clothing, unreliable fibre labels, and the case for mandatory warning labels on synthetic clothing. The state secretary agrees textile recycling must scale up, promises talks with the sector, an Extended Producer Responsibility scheme, a RIVM discussion paper on microfibres, and further exploration of recycled-content minimums, without committing to a labelling mandate.
I will enter into discussion with the clothing industry, after which I will consider whether and how further research should be initiated.
Ik ga in gesprek met de kledingbranche, waarna bezien of en zo ja hoe nader onderzoek dient te worden geïnitieerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de registratie van AED’s

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister for Medical Care about the low registration of automated external defibrillators (AEDs), regional gaps in the 6-minute zones, actions to raise registrations, awareness among civilian responders, merging of alarm networks, and talks on registering AEDs at (semi-)government buildings. The minister answered that roughly 16,000 AEDs are registered against at least 30,000 needed, outlined a range of campaigns and the completed merger into HartslagNu, and said the talks with other ministries and bodies would conclude early next year.
I consider it important that as many available AEDs as possible are registered.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat zoveel mogelijk beschikbare AED’s worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de vergoeding van het medicijn Translarna

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the drug Translarna for Duchenne patients is not reimbursed, why the manufacturer stopped free supply, and whether the government will negotiate or create a faster access scheme. The minister answered that the drug was rejected for reimbursement for insufficient evidence of clinical benefit, that a new access scheme for orphan drugs is being developed with an update promised before year end, and that the government will not urge the manufacturer to continue free supply.
I will therefore not urge the manufacturer to continue providing the rejected drug free of charge.
Ik zal de fabrikant daarom ook niet aansporen om door te gaan met het gratis verstrekken van het afgewezen medicijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van der Staaij, Ellemeet en Dik-Faber over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs from SGP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why the disability equality law and public transport rules exclude small buurtbussen from wheelchair accessibility requirements, and whether the government would act. The State Secretary answered that accessibility rules were written for larger scheduled buses, that provinces and municipalities are responsible for buurtbus requirements, and that accessibility of buurtbussen is an item on an action programme with stakeholders, without committing to a legal change.
The responsibility for this lies with the provinces and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt bij provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Jetten over het terugdringen van de klimaatimpact van de financiële sector

MPs Dik-Faber and Jetten asked whether other Dutch banks, insurers and pension funds have published commitments to measure and reduce the climate impact of their full balance sheets, and whether the minister will make concrete agreements with the financial sector in the Klimaatberaad as required by an outstanding motion. The minister replied that about fifteen financial firms pledged to measure climate impact by 2020 and that a financial task group within the Klimaatakkoord talks will develop plans, without committing to specific agreements.
Soon I will inform your House about progress towards a Climate Agreement.
Binnenkort informeer ik uw Kamer over de voortgang om te komen tot een Klimaatakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het testen van erfelijke ziekten via de huisarts

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the health minister about GP-offered carrier screening for hereditary diseases for couples planning a child, including licensing, ethical counselling, coverage and transparency of the UMCG study. The minister answered that GP offers operate under university genetic centre licences, that counselling is adequate, that the test is not reimbursed without medical indication, and that quality guidelines are being drafted.
I will consult with the relevant professional associations so that these guidelines come as quickly as possible.
Ik zal in overleg treden met de betreffende beroepsverenigingen opdat deze richtlijnen er zo snel mogelijk komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de met vervuild slib versterkte Westdijk bij Bunschoten

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the minister about the Westdijk at Bunschoten, reinforced with thermally cleaned soil (TGG) found contaminated with heavy metals, including who supplied it, how certification and oversight worked, and who bears the costs. The state secretary answered that the cause is not yet known, that the waterschap is pursuing the contractor and supplier for costs, that TGG use in primary dikes is now suspended, and that a review of TGG quality is underway.
Rijkswaterstaat and the Flood Protection Programme (including the water boards) will for now no longer permit the use of TGG.
Rijkswaterstaat en het Hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma (met daarin de waterschappen) staan het toepassen van TGG voorlopig niet meer toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik- Faber over de museumtramlijn te Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the future of Amsterdam's heritage museum tram line, which depends on volunteers and may be displaced by housing development, and whether the municipality and transport operators bear responsibility and should support it. The minister said the loss would be regrettable, that the municipality should support the foundation without excessive demands, and that she would facilitate expert support and funding options while noting the municipality awaits the Raad van State appeal outcome.
The municipality can indeed be expected to support the EMA in this and not to impose unnecessarily heavy requirements.
Van de gemeente mag wel verwacht worden dat zij de EMA daarbij ondersteunt en geen onnodig zware eisen stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het registreren van AED’s in overheidsgebouwen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the low registration rate of AEDs, including those in government buildings, and whether government would coordinate with ministries and municipalities to register them. The minister acknowledged low registration, cited reasons such as non-public placement, and agreed to consult the Interior Minister, VNG and others.
Are you willing to consult with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations so that all AEDs in or on (semi-)government buildings are registered?
Bent u bereid met de Minister van Binnenlands Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties in overleg te treden zodat alle AED’s in/aan (semi-)overheidsgebouwen geregistreerd worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz, Dik-Faber, Jetten en Agnes Mulder over het vertrek van de NCG

MPs asked about the role of the National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) after its director Alders resigned, covering its remit, houses inspected and reinforced, the shift of damage handling to an independent commission, funding, timelines for reinforcing 2,500 homes, and continuity of the programme. The minister answered in detail, stating the NCG no longer handles damage claims, that reinforcement decisions should be made independently of NAM with advice from the Mijnraad, and that continuity is being secured.
Because of these developments, the NCG no longer has a role in damage handling.
Vanwege deze ontwikkelingen heeft de NCG geen rol meer in de schadeafhandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over het kappen van oude bomenlanen langs provinciale wegen

MPs Van der Graaf and Dik-Faber asked the minister whether safety works on provincial roads would lead to mass felling of old tree-lined avenues, and whether maatwerk and cultural-historical value would be respected. The minister denied any expected mass felling, said only trees very close to the road might be removed case by case, and said provinces are expected to follow the same tailored approach used on national roads.
Given experience so far with verge improvements on national and provincial roads, there is no reason at all to expect mass tree felling.
Gezien de ervaringen tot nu toe met bermverbeteringen bij rijkswegen en provinciale wegen is er geen enkele aanleiding om «massale bomenkap» te verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over het sluiten van kinderafdelingen in de ziekenhuizen in Hoogeveen en Stadskanaal

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked the Minister of Medical Care about Treant's plan to close children's wards and acute obstetrics at Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal, and its consequences for care, travel times, finances and the regional decision process. The minister answered that the impact on care quality and safety is being examined by the IGJ, that 45-minute access for acute obstetrics is ensured, and that the regional body ROAZ is involved, but gave no details on financial consequences and deferred several points to a separate letter to parliament.
Together with my answers to these parliamentary questions I am also sending a letter to the House of Representatives regarding this proposed Treant decision.
Tegelijk met mijn antwoorden op deze Kamervragen stuur ik ook een brief aan de Tweede Kamer met betrekking tot dit voorgenomen besluit van Treant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over wooninitiatieven voor kinderen met een beperking

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked the health minister about the SCP finding that parent-initiated small-scale housing for children with disabilities is under pressure, covering funding, regulation, support, short indication periods, the housing allowance and PGB rules. The minister answered that he will consult VNG, ZN and Per Saldo on bottlenecks and clearer information, and promised further steps on client support and the housing allowance, without committing to a formal change.
I am going to consult with VNG, ZN and Per Saldo about these bottlenecks, including governance and financing, to discuss which improvements are possible in practice.
Ik ga met VNG, ZN en Per Saldo in overleg over deze knelpunten, waaronder regie en financiering, om te bespreken welke verbeteringen in de praktijk mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de onvindbaarheid van donorvaders

An MP asked the health minister why sperm donors from before 2004 are hard to find for donor-conceived children, and whether clinics and donors should be obliged or encouraged to make themselves traceable. The minister acknowledged the difficulty, pointed to new agreements between the foundation Sdkb, clinics and the profession to approach anonymous donors, and declined to fund registration for donor children in the KID-DNA databank.
I have decided not to reimburse registration in the FIOM KID-DNA databank for donor children conceived before 2004.
Ik heb besloten de inschrijving in de FIOM KID-DNA databank voor donorkinderen, verwekt voor 2004, niet te vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de komst van een zelfmoordmachine naar de uitvaartbeurs in Amsterdam

Three MPs asked whether it is acceptable that a suicide machine (euthanasia demonstration) was shown at an open funeral fair in Amsterdam, and what the government would do about it and about suicide prevention investment. The Staatssecretaris called such a demonstration highly undesirable, said the government has no legal power to ban it, and promised to inform the House this spring on suicide prevention funding.
I have no legal powers to prohibit such demonstrations, the aim of which is to stimulate discussion.
Ik heb geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om te verbieden dat dergelijke demonstraties plaatsvinden, waarvan het doel is de discussie aan te jagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het dumpen van vervuild slib uit het buitenland in een Nederlandse recreatieplas

MP Dik-Faber asked the minister whether foreign contaminated sludge dumped in a Dutch recreational lake meets Dutch standards, how it is monitored, and whether Rijkswaterstaat can enforce it. The State Secretary replied that foreign material must meet the same Besluit bodemkwaliteit standards, that Rijkswaterstaat and water boards supervise and inspect via notification and sampling, and that the framework will be carried into the Omgevingswet.
I intend to incorporate this assessment framework into the Environment and Planning Act through general rules.
Ik heb het voornemen om dit toetsingskader in de Omgevingswet op te nemen door middel van algemene regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de stormloop op grond voor zonneparken

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Agriculture about a rush of investors onto farmland for solar parks, its effects on land prices, young farmers, biodiversity, and whether rooftops and other land should be prioritised. The minister answered that municipalities and provinces are primarily responsible, that the government will consider rooftops and its own property, will include the issue in the Climate Agreement, and will inform parliament before summer 2018, but gave no binding national restriction.
The responsibility for this lies primarily with municipalities and provinces.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt primair bij gemeenten en provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over het objectieve verdeelmodel Wmo en Jeugd in relatie tot doelmatig medicijngebruik

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked whether the medicine-use distribution criterion in the Wmo and Youth social domain fund penalises municipalities like Asten that prescribe medicines efficiently, and what will be done about it, including timing of the evaluation and compensation. The minister answered that the criterion fits average municipal costs, that individual compensation does not fit the integrated approach, that a qualitative evaluation is complete with a quantitative follow-up to be decided, and that best-practice sharing is encouraged.
Once this research is completed, I will present the research report to your House.
Zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond, zal ik het onderzoeksrapport aan uw Kamer aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat de burgemeesters van de grote steden een verbod willen op knalvuurwerk en vuurpijlen

An MP asked the government whether it would act on the OVV report on New Year's fireworks and on the mayors' call for a national ban on rockets and banger fireworks, and whether it would tighten protection of emergency workers. The state secretary answered that a national approach is being prepared with partners, that the mayors' call will be considered, that a ban requires time and consultation, and that a letter on the approach is expected by end of March.
Currently I am working together with the Minister of Justice and Security and our partners on a national approach to the New Year's problem.
Momenteel werk ik samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid en onze partners aan een landelijke aanpak van de jaarwisselingsproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bergkamp over het behoud van het religieus erfgoed

MPs Dik-Faber and Bergkamp asked the minister about preserving religious heritage, including church vacancy, restoration priorities, long-term funding for large monuments and sustainability measures. The minister agreed that local church visions are important, earmarked 13.5 million euro for them, promised a new multi-year instrument for large monuments to be presented this autumn, and described existing sustainability initiatives.
I therefore endorse the Ecorys recommendation on large monuments and will work with the sector to develop a new instrument, which I will present to your House this autumn.
Ik onderschrijf dus de aanbeveling van Ecorys over grote monumenten en zal met het veld een nieuw instrument uitwerken en dit najaar aan uw Kamer presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ellemeet, Dik-Faber en Von Martels over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in de dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs asked whether wheelchair users can be refused when transferring from a regular bus to a community bus, and whether the Wet personenvervoer 2000 should be amended to close a gap. The government answers there is no legal omission: the Wgbh/cz applies, community buses are deliberately outside its scope as small vehicles, the province chose not to impose further demands on volunteer-run services, and gemeenten must provide small-scale wheelchair transport instead.
There is no omission in the Wet personenvervoer 2000 that would need to be repaired.
Er is geen sprake van een omissie in de Wet personenvervoer 2000 die gerepareerd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Dik-Faber over de fipronilschade van pluimveehouders

MPs Geurts and Dik-Faber asked the minister about the European Commission's approval of Belgian compensation for fipronil-contaminated poultry farmers, whether this creates an unequal playing field, and what support is available. The minister answered that the Commission deems the crisis to fall under compensable exceptional events for Belgium only, that compensation is not due for damage caused by private parties and that the Dutch position is unchanged, while listing Dutch support measures and noting the Commission found no distortion of competition.
Government compensation is not at issue if damage was caused by the actions of private parties.
Compensatie door de overheid is niet aan de orde als schade is veroorzaakt door het handelen van private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over de magnesiumzoutwinning door Nedmag onder Kiel-Windeweer

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked whether Nedmag's planned magnesium salt mining under Kiel-Windeweer falls within the existing concession, whether SodM's critical advice on the Groningen geothermal project affects the mining vision, and whether mining permits should be published more widely across municipal borders. Minister Wiebes answered that the expansion fits the existing concession and 2013 mining plan (with a revised plan required if subsidence or method changes), that the geothermal concerns have no bearing on salt mining, and that the surface permit is published only in the municipality where the installation stands, as legally prescribed, while a mining plan is published across the whole affected area.
The draft approval decision (with all underlying documents) will be made available for inspection in the area covered by the mining plan.
Het ontwerpinstemmingsbesluit (met alle achterliggende documenten) zal in het gebied waarop het winningsplan betrekking heeft, ter inzage worden gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘De tropenarts dreigt te verdwijnen’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the risk of the tropical medicine specialist (arts IGT) training disappearing as five of 24 hospitals have stopped offering it, and whether talks with stakeholders would be held. The minister answered that these doctors serve abroad, that Dutch care does not depend on them, and saw no reason for consultation on training places.
From my responsibility for care in the Netherlands I see no reason to consult on maintaining the number of training places.
Ik zie vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid voor de zorg in Nederland geen aanleiding voor overleg over behoud van het aantal opleidingsplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de CASA-klinieken

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the Minister about signals that care quality at CASA clinics was not guaranteed, including workload, use of temporary nurses, and the protection of counselling and information rights for women seeking abortion. The Minister answered that the inspectorate placed CASA Klinieken under intensified supervision, that responsibility for care quality lies with the board, and that a licence procedure will apply to any takeover.
After completion of the intensified supervision process, the inspectorate will prepare a report and publish it as usual.
Na afronding van het traject van verscherpt toezicht zal de inspectie een rapportage opstellen en zoals gebruikelijk openbaarmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over euthanasie in de Levenseindekliniek bij psychiatrisch patiënten

Two MPs asked the Health Minister whether euthanasia by the Levenseindekliniek for psychiatric patients who were not fully treated, or not in unbearable hopeless suffering, was in line with the Chabot ruling and why the RTE judged such cases careful. The Minister declined to judge individual cases, explained the distinction between hopeless suffering and absence of a reasonable alternative, said he would discuss concerns with the profession in the evaluation of the euthanasia law, but saw no reason to doubt current practice.
It is not for me as Minister to judge individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om te oordelen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de oproep van het Leger des Heils om hergebruik van textiel van de grond te krijgen

An MP asked the state secretary about the Salvation Army's call for better recycling of low-quality textiles, including demand for recycled textile, labelling accuracy, public procurement and inclusion in the National Raw Materials Agreement. The government acknowledges the problem, points to the Roadmap Circular Textiles, the IMVO convenant, pilots and the upcoming Transitieagenda Consumptiegoederen, and promises further talks with the sector.
I will consult with the clothing industry, Milieu Centraal and the Stichting Milieukeur and with the European Commission to see what we can do about this.
Ik ga in overleg met de kledingbranche, Milieu Centraal en de Stichting Milieukeur en met de Europese Commissie om te bezien wat wij hieraan kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het advies van de Coöperatie Laatste Wil omtrent een zelfdodingsmiddel

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij ask whether a lethal substance advised by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil for suicide is legal, traceable, safe, and whether the cooperative's advice constitutes criminal assistance in suicide, and whether it should be banned. The ministers answer that they do not know the substance, that criminal liability is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that a ban under article 2:20 BW faces high legal thresholds, and that the government opposes spreading such information and will rely on suicide prevention policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, De Groot, Geurts en Lodders over gegevensverstrekking aan Brancheorganisatie Akkerbouw voor het programma Onderzoek en Innovatie
