MPs asked whether the minister should give the agricultural sector body BO Akkerbouw the names, addresses and acreage data of non-member farms, given data-protection limits and administrative burden, for a mandatory research levy. The minister declined direct transfer of the data, offering instead KvK data transfers and an opt-in consent route via RVO.nl, arguing this is proportionate and workable under the Wbp.
This means that providing the acreage data, without the farms having given consent, does not meet the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity.
Dit maakt dat het verstrekken van de areaalgegevens, zonder dat de akkerbouwbedrijven daar toestemming voor gegeven hebben, niet voldoet aan de eisen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Rijksdienst: 'Maak van niet te redden monumenten ruïnes'

MPs Van Tongeren and Dik-Faber asked whether the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed was effectively giving up on monuments in the Groningen earthquake area by recommending ruins, and how the government would protect heritage. The ministers replied that the RCE's framework aims to preserve monuments, that some monuments may be irreparable with owners and municipalities deciding, that data on their number is lacking, and that a heritage programme will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
At this moment we do not yet have sufficient data available to make a reliable statement about this.
Op dit moment hebben wij nog niet voldoende gegevens beschikbaar om hier een betrouwbare uitspraak over te kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber en De Groot over fipronil in eieren

MPs Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber and De Groot asked the ministers about the fipronil egg crisis, including a toxicologist's claim that the Dutch limit is too strict, the RASFF notification process, when the Netherlands knew of contamination, and differing risk approaches across member states. The government defended the EU residue limit, explained the RASFF process and the ARfD and ADI tests used, admitted a date error, and said it would examine the differences in approach.
For the answer to this question I refer you to our letter of 10 August.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar onze brief van 10 augustus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het onterecht afwijzen van bevingsschades rond Emmen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why earlier quake-damage claims around Emmen were rejected by Witteveen+Bos, despite criticism from the technical commission Tcbb, and whether affected residents can get counter-expertise. The minister said the Tcbb review is attached, that the protocol will be improved with the Tcbb, that residents can request a second opinion from the Tcbb under the Mijnbouwwet, and that the NAM voucher concerned Groningen rather than Emmen.
I take its conclusions very seriously and will, together with the Tcbb, examine how an improved protocol for damage handling can be shaped.
Ik neem haar conclusies zeer serieus en zal zoals hierboven al aangegeven samen met de Tcbb bekijken hoe vorm gegeven kan worden aan een verbeterd protocol voor schadeafhandeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over klachten inzake de uitvoering van de zogenoemde Backpay-regeling

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the implementation of the Backpay scheme for former Dutch East Indies civil servants and KNIL soldiers, including delays, rejections, the 15 August 2015 cut-off date and calls for re-assessment. The state secretary answered that 574 payments of 25,000 euros had been made, that decisions took on average 26 to 42 days, that rejections followed from the scheme's criteria, that appeals are possible under the General Administrative Law Act, and that the scheme is considered successful.
When new information comes to light, the SVB is generously willing to reconsider the judgement.
Wanneer er nieuwe informatie bovenkomt, is SVB ruimhartig bereid om opnieuw het oordeel te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Kooiman over de schadelijke gevolgen van de HeatStick voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Dik-Faber and Kooiman asked the State Secretary about claims that the IQOS HeatStick is less harmful, its cancer-causing substances, its missing graphic warnings and its regulatory status abroad. The State Secretary said the product is still discouraged, that independent studies were short-term and did not assess long-term harm, and that RIVM research on the product is expected in autumn 2017 before deciding on notification to the European Commission.
I have asked the RIVM to conduct research into the IQOS and the HeatStick.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd onderzoek te doen naar de IQOS en de HeatStick.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van den Berg, Omtzigt, Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over lekkages bij AKZO-Nobel in Twente

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new well leaks at AkzoNobel in Twente, the number and effects of leaks, SodM's enforcement and projects, and liability for leak damage. The minister answered that lists of leaks are published and checked by SodM, that the effects appear limited to the immediate vicinity of leaking wells, that enhanced supervision continues with a research programme due by end 2017, and that liability stays with the party responsible at the time of the leak.
SodM urged AkzoNobel to give appropriate urgency to the investigation and remediation of leaks and possible contamination in Twente.
SodM heeft bij AkzoNobel aangedrongen op gepaste urgentie bij het onderzoek en de sanering van lekkages en mogelijke verontreinigingen in Twente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over vertraging en gebrek aan kennis bij herstel van schade en versterking van monumentaal erfgoed in de provincie Groningen

An MP from ChristenUnie asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about delays and lack of heritage expertise in repairing and reinforcing listed buildings in Groningen, including criticism of the Centrum Veilig Wonen and the reported scrapping of a heritage help desk, and asks about progress on a motion for a coherent heritage policy. The minister replies that expertise requirements, a pilot and a joint heritage programme under the National Coordinator Groningen are underway, that the programme will be sent to parliament after summer, and that talks with owners' organisations are in place, while giving no firm commitment on reinstating the help desk.
I aim to send the heritage programme to your House after the summer.
Ik streef ernaar het erfgoedprogramma na de zomer aan te bieden aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de plannen voor olie- en aardgaswinning bij Woerden

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers about plans to extract gas at the Papekop field near Woerden, covering Vermilion's financial guarantees, the cumulative risk and reservation of funds, and the weight given to local objections. The minister answered that Vermilion has not yet applied for an environmental permit or submitted an updated extraction plan, that creditworthiness is assessed through several means, and that regional authorities will be consulted under the new Mining Act procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de kosten voor koosjere maaltijden in zorgcentra

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether kosher meal provision at care centres such as Etrog in Amersfoort is under financial pressure because costs are not covered in the tariffs, and whether the government will ensure such religious meal provision remains possible. The State Secretary replied that meals are part of the integrated Wlz tariff for accommodation, that there are no specific funding rules for religious meals, and that providers have freedom to allocate funds, while agreeing that food can be part of a care centre's identity.
There are no specific funding rules for the reimbursement of meal provision according to religious practices.
Er zijn geen specifieke bekostigingsregels voor de vergoeding van maaltijdverstrekking volgens religieuze gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het essay ‘De apotheek is geen euthanasie-automaat’

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the minister about pharmacists' concerns over supplying euthanasia drugs, including unclear professional norms, conscientious objection, time pressure from doctors, and the absence of this issue from the third evaluation of the Euthanasia Act. The state secretary replied that the 2012 KNMP/KNMG guideline is the applicable norm, that pharmacists may refuse on principled grounds, and that doctors bear final responsibility, but declined further research on the pharmacist's role.
It is therefore sensible for the professional associations to keep their members continuously informed about the existence and content of the guideline, including during pharmacist training.
Het is daarom zinvol als de beroepsverenigingen hun achterban blijvend informeren over het bestaan en de inhoud van de richtlijn, ook gedurende de opleiding tot apotheker.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het rapport "Are Belgium and the Netherlands in breach of their international obligations under the Basel Convention and customary international law due to their export of hi

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked whether the Netherlands breaches Basel Convention, customary law and ESC rights by exporting high-sulfur fuels to Bamako Convention parties in Africa, and whether it will restrict such exports. Minister Ploumen answered that no Basel notifications of such fuels as hazardous waste exist, so no export ban is legally required, and that the government will pursue standards and industry engagement instead, while ILT increases inspection capacity.
Without notification under the Basel Convention, there is no obligation for the Netherlands under the Basel Convention to counter the export.
Zonder notificatie onder het Verdrag van Bazel bestaat er voor Nederland geen verplichting onder het Verdrag van Bazel om de export tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verliezen van de SKAL-licentie door het innovatieve stalconcept de 'Koeientuin' op een biologisch melkveebedrijf in Groenlo

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about a Groenlo organic dairy farm losing its SKAL licence because its innovative 'Koeientuin' barn omits straw bedding, and whether rules can be relaxed. The state secretary confirmed EU organic production rules block the concept, that Nederland's request for an individual exemption was rejected by the European Commission, and referred to an earlier answer for further action.
The European organic production rule on the mandatory presence of bedding of straw or other suitable natural materials is an obstacle to producing organically with this barn concept.

De Europese biologische productieregel inzake de verplichte aanwezigheid van strooisel bestaande uit stro of andere geschikte natuurlijke materialen vormt een belemmering om met dit stalconcept biologisch te produceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over de risico’s van een curettage na een miskraam of tijdens een abortus provocatus

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked about risks of curettage after miscarriage or abortion, including a possible shift toward expectant management and whether all women are fully informed of risks beforehand. The Secretary of State replied that curettage is considered safe, that alternatives exist and are used when medically indicated, that professional guidelines are updated with new evidence, and that the WGBO already requires risk information, with a planned WGBO amendment pending at the Raad van State.
Furthermore, together with the Minister of Security and Justice, I am preparing an amendment to the WGBO.
Verder bereid ik samen met de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie een wijziging voor van de WGBO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gaswinning onder een woonwijk en bedrijventerrein in Heerenveen

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the municipality of Heerenveen was not informed about gas extraction by Vermilion under its territory, whether the extraction expansion required a revised winning plan first, and what communication and baseline measurements are planned. The Minister answered that Heerenveen was consulted in 2012, that the amended plan is now in a formal procedure with advice requested, that production continues under the 2012 plan pending review, and that a list of pending plans will be provided.
By letter dated 29 June 2016 I informed Vermilion that production could continue under the existing 2012 winning plan pending treatment of the amended winning plan.

Met een brief d.d. 29 juni 2016 heb ik Vermilion laten weten dat de productie kon doorgaan op basis van het vigerende winningsplan uit 2012 in afwachting van de behandeling van het gewijzigde winningsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Remco Dijkstra, Ouwehand, Cegerek, Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Geurts over het bericht dat chemiebedrijven de veiligheidsregels schenden

MPs asked the state secretary how to respond to reports that more than half of Dutch major-risk chemical firms repeatedly violated safety rules, including risks to workers and residents in Zaltbommel and how inspections and enforcement work. The state secretary replied that violations fell from 850 to 615 in 2015, that most are light offences, that inspectors act immediately on serious ones, that Zaltbommel is being handled through a planning and permit process, and that repeat offenders face escalated sanctions.
As previously promised, I will send the State of Safety of Major Risk Companies report for 2016 to your House before the summer, including an analysis of regional differences in compliance rates.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik de Staat van de Veiligheid Majeure Risicobedrijven over 2016 voor de zomer naar uw Kamer sturen inclusief een analyse van regionale verschillen in naleefpercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over niet heimelijk euthanasie plegen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Health whether euthanasia in advanced dementia, based on written declarations and without the patient's current consent, is legally and ethically sound after specialists criticised such cases. The Minister defended the Wtl framework, said one of three reviewed cases was judged not careful by the Rte and referred to IGZ and OM, and declined to tighten the rules or the handreiking.
In view of this, I refrain from giving a judgment.
Gelet hierop onthoud ik mij van een oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over blootstelling aan schadelijke minerale oliën via verpakkingen van voedsel

An MP asked the Minister of Health about consumer exposure to mineral oils from food packaging, asking whether monitoring delays justify interim measures, how monitoring and toxicological research are coordinated in Europe, and whether results will be published. The minister answered that monitoring will take time and binding norms are not expected soon, that industry measures are underway, that there is insufficient insight into interim measures, and that publication of results depends on factors including monitoring coverage.
Regarding publication of the monitoring data, the NVWA aims to make the results public.
Wat de openbaarmaking van de monitoringgegevens betreft, is het streven van de NVWA om resultaten openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bouwmeester over een uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over medezeggenschap in zorginstellingen

MPs Dik-Faber and Bouwmeester asked the minister how a Supreme Court ruling on client councils in care institutions affects participation, including plans for local councils, budgets and timing of the new law. The minister answered that she will clarify the level of participation in the new bill, requiring per-location councils on request, guarantee facilities and funding, but declined to take immediate measures and gave a timeline of submission after Council of State advice.
I will make the desired clarification in the bill for a new Client Participation in Care Institutions Act.
Ik zal de gewenste verduidelijking aanbrengen in het wetsvoorstel voor een nieuwe Wet medezeggenschap cliënten zorginstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de brandbrief van LTO Nederland, Greenport Holland en de Branche Organisatie Akkerbouw over knelpunten in gewasbescherming

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how the government would respond to a joint letter from farm and horticulture organisations about eleven crop-protection bottlenecks, including minor-use approvals, emergency exemptions, biocides and EU harmonisation. The state secretary answered that work on these issues is ongoing, listed the measures and timelines under way, and agreed to consult the signatories at official level.
Yes, to start at official level. The organisations concerned will be invited for this shortly.
Ja, om te beginnen op ambtelijk niveau. De betrokken organisaties zullen hiertoe binnenkort uitgenodigd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de vernietiging van in beslag genomen nep-kleding

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the ministers whether seized counterfeit clothing is destroyed, who decides, and whether a central record exists and destruction can favour circular recycling. The minister answered that counterfeit goods are destroyed under the Criminal Procedure Code, that a central seizure portal exists but has gaps with implementation planned for 2018, and that destroyed materials can be recycled where possible.
This cross-chain central ICT system still has shortcomings.
Dit ketenoverstijgende centraal ICT-systeem kent nog onvolkomenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over jong ouderschap

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary how municipalities can better use decentralisation to support young parents, avoid new silos, handle the region-binding rule for shelters, address housing access, administrative burdens, preventive funding, education support and consultations with FIOM and Siriz. The state secretary answered that municipalities are implementing the transition locally and are supported via guidance and monitoring, that no national data exists on homeless teen mothers and a study is planned, and promised to report back in May and after the Voorjaarsnota.
These figures are not registered in a way that allows a national overview to be generated.
Deze cijfers worden niet geregistreerd op een wijze waarmee landelijk overzicht kan worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de koppeling van warmtenetten aan kolencentrales

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs what 'technology-neutral' public financing of heat infrastructure means, whether heat-grid costs will be socialised through network tariffs, how this fits a motion against coal-linked heat, and whether Gasunie should be asked to avoid favouring fossil sources. The minister answered that technology-neutral means infrastructure open to any heat source, that tariff socialisation is undetermined pending a regulatory study, that public financing may apply if it facilitates the energy transition, and that as shareholder he cannot interfere with Gasunie's investments due to independence rules.
I see no reasons to do so.
Ik zie hier geen redenen toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de plannen van NAM om de put Vries-10 in Assen op te starten

MP Dik-Faber asks the minister why NAM may start gas production from the new well Vries-10 in Assen before the updated Westerveld winning plan is approved, given residents' fears of quakes and damage and the earlier local requests to halt production. The minister answers that SodM found production within the existing winning plan allowed, that production has already started, that a seismic risk analysis places the field in the lowest risk category, and that he will not order a halt pending the new plan.
SodM found that the limits of the current winning plan are not expected to be exceeded over the next two years by bringing Vries-10 into use, so production may start under that plan.
SodM heeft geconstateerd dat de grenzen van het vigerende winningsplan met het in gebruik nemen van put Vries-10 de komende twee jaar naar verwachting niet zullen worden overschreden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van Tongeren over de uitspraak van de bestuursrechter betreffende vergunning voor het opsporen van schaliegas door Cuadrilla

MPs Dik-Faber and Van Tongeren asked whether a court ruling that the refusal to extend Cuadrilla's shale gas exploration permits was unfounded affects the ban on commercial shale gas drilling, and what options the minister has. The minister replied that the ruling does not affect the moratorium, that he chose to appeal rather than extend or revoke the permits, and that the new Mining Act allows permits to be revoked or restricted in light of changed societal views.
I have therefore lodged an appeal against the court's ruling on 11 January 2017.
Ik heb daarom 11 januari 2017 hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Dik-Faber over vastgoed in de zorg

MPs Keijzer and Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary about vacant care property, waiting lists and the ending of the care infrastructure subsidy. The State Secretary answered that the NZa sees no continuity risk for elderly care, that property decisions lie with providers, and that a successor regulation will be developed.
I want to work towards a national regulation with regional involvement that will replace the care infrastructure subsidy scheme.
Ik wil toewerken naar een landelijke regeling met regionale betrokkenheid, die de subsidieregeling zorginfrastructuur zal vervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Dik-Faber, Ouwehand, Smaling en Jan Vos over het WOB-verzoek van Milieudefensie over gaswinningsbesluit 2016

Five MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's influence on the 2016 Groningen gas extraction decision, including a pre-sent expectations letter, consultations with NAM and Shell, and the withholding of an SodM advice from parliament. The minister answered that a draft expectations letter was shared with NAM only to test interpretation and feasibility, that the SodM advice was not actively sent but was later provided and published, and that the extraction ceiling was set on safety grounds at 24 billion m3 per year.
Since the SodM advice only confirmed that the process communicated to your House could proceed, I did not find it necessary to actively inform your House about it.
Aangezien het advies van SodM slechts bevestigde dat het met uw Kamer gecommuniceerde proces doorgang kon vinden, heb ik het niet nodig gevonden uw Kamer hier actief over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de koppeling van kolencentrales aan warmtenetten

MP Dik-Faber asks whether the minister will reconsider public financing of heat networks and the Gasunie Leiding over West, given that several potential heat customers refuse coal-plant heat. The minister answers that he foresees no public funds specifically for coal-plant waste-heat projects, that any public infrastructure financing will be technology-neutral, and that Gasunie is involved on its own grounds; he promises to inform parliament soon on coal-plant scenarios.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Geurts over het mislopen van miljoenen euro’s aan GMO-subsidie voor telersverenigingen vanwege onduidelijkheid en te late bekendmaking door de Nederlandse overheid

MPs Dik-Faber and Geurts asked why only one Dutch grower association submitted an operational plan for EU fruit and vegetable GMO subsidies, and why the national strategy was published late. The Secretary of State acknowledged the shortfall, explained the strategy was agreed with the sector in April and the rules published in July, and pointed to a new expertise centre and ongoing consultation as remedies.
I agree that it is regrettable that more producer organisations have not submitted operational programmes for 2017.
Ik ben het met u eens dat het spijtig is dat niet meer producentenorganisaties operationele programma's voor 2017 hebben ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat Gendia medische gegevens misbruikt bij de Niet Invasieve Prenatale Test (NIPT)

An MP asked the minister about reports that Gendia misuses women's medical data collected for the NIPT prenatal test, including consent, privacy, and whether hospitals should stop cooperating. The minister said privacy rules apply, the Dutch and Belgian privacy authorities are acting on the case, and the NIPT will become available in the Netherlands from April 2017 with quality safeguards.
On request, the Belgian Privacy Commission indicates that, in consultation with the Dutch Data Protection Authority, it is taking action on the possible privacy violation by Gendia.
Desgevraagd geeft de Belgische Privacycommissie aan dat zij, in overleg met de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, actie onderneemt op de eventuele privacyschending door Gendia.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de situatie van een dakloze Belg die al een half jaar in een ziekenhuis in Harderwijk 'woont'

An MP asked the health minister about a homeless uninsured Belgian patient who has stayed for six months in a Harderwijk hospital because no alternative placement was found, with the hospital bearing the costs. The minister answered that such costs are part of the hospital's ordinary business risk, that contact with Belgian authorities showed the patient was uninsured in Belgium, and that she will raise the case again with Belgian authorities.
Given the Belgian status of the patient, I will again bring this case to the attention of the Belgian authorities concerned.
Gezien de Belgische status van de patiënt zal ik deze casus nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen van de betrokken Belgische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de benchmark duurzaam inkopen van vervoer

An MP asked the state secretary about a benchmark showing 82% of municipalities fail their own 100% sustainable procurement targets for transport, and about updating outdated criteria, knowledge gaps and the Klimaatakkoord. The state secretary acknowledged the need for progress, pointed to a Plan van Aanpak, a manifesto with municipalities, a revised criteria document due February 2017, a new expert pool, and a benchmark under development.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de evaluatie van de Jonge Landbouwersregeling door het NAJK

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the NAJK evaluation of the Young Farmers Scheme (JOLA), including its findings on the EUR 20,000 minimum investment and the limited choice of investments, and whether the scheme will be adjusted for smaller farms. The State Secretary answers that the provinces are primarily responsible for JOLA, that the evaluation is conducted by an external party with results expected in December, and that he is willing to help think about adjustments at the provinces' request.
The provinces are primarily responsible for the implementation of the JOLA.
De provincies zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de JOLA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de voortgang van de motie 31793, nr. 143 in relatie tot berichtgeving over investeringen in fossiele energie.

The MP asks whether the financial sector should keep investing in fossil energy given climate targets, whether science-based targets for finance exist and whether PBL should study them, and what action followed motion 31793 nr. 143. The Staatssecretaris answers that finance firms are expected to contribute, that a sector initiative on science-based targets is welcome without a PBL study, and that the ministry joins the DNB-led Platform voor Duurzame Financiering and the PCAF.
I wholeheartedly welcome this sector initiative and currently see no reason to additionally ask PBL to conduct research on science-based targets for the financial sector.

Ik juich dit initiatief van de sector van harte toe en zie op dit moment dan ook geen aanleiding om in aanvulling daarop PBL te verzoeken onderzoek te verrichten naar wetenschappelijk onderbouwde doelstellingen voor de financiële sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het rapport 'Dirty Diesel – How Swiss Traders Flood Africa with Toxic Fuels'

An MP asked whether the Netherlands should restrict oil blending and trading infrastructure in Rotterdam and Amsterdam that supplies low-quality fuels to West Africa, as reported by Public Eye. The government acknowledged the report, said it would raise the case in the port work programme and ask the NCP to examine OECD guideline implementation, and emphasised a harmonised international approach through UNEP rather than unilateral national rules.

Are you prepared, on the basis of additional research, if necessary, to introduce legislation and regulation that makes it impossible for this infrastructure to still be used to produce and trade fuels

Bent u bereid op basis van aanvullend onderzoek zo nodig met wet- er regelgeving te komen die het onmogelijk maakt dat deze infrastructuur nog gebruikt wordt om brandstoffen te produceren en verhandelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de inzameling van medicijnafval

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the ministers whether municipalities are living up to their responsibility for collecting unused medicines, whether pharmacies are being charged for it, and how waste costs are divided. The State Secretary answers that cooperation between municipalities and pharmacies is needed, that municipalities should make agreements to collect medicines without pharmacies bearing the costs, and that information will be provided to municipalities and pharmacies.
I therefore ask municipalities to reach agreements with pharmacists on the collection of unused medicines.
Ik vraag gemeenten daarom om samen met apothekers tot afspraken te komen voor de inzameling van ongebruikte geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dik Faber en Van Tongeren over schade aan huurwoningen in Middelstum

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about damage to rental homes in Middelstum caused during reinforcement works, including months of drainage problems and loose structural bolts, and whether the Centrum Veilig Wonen and the NCG could intervene. The minister confirmed it concerns one dwelling, declined to detail an individual damage case, said a repair plan exists, and agreed that the corporation will check bolts in all Middelstum homes soon.
It does not befit me as Minister to go into the details of an individual damage case at length.
Het past mij als Minister niet om uitgebreid in te gaan op de details van een individueel schadegeval.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over de nieuwe veerboot Texelstroom van TESO

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport has not yet decided TESO's over one-year-old request to bunker CNG for the new Texel ferry, and when a decision will come. The minister replied that the assessment is ongoing because technical information is still missing from the company, that the Amsterdam sightseeing boats are not comparable, and that a decision will follow as soon as the information is supplied.
The assessment of the application is still ongoing because the ILT has not yet received all the necessary technical information to assess the application fully.
De beoordeling van de aanvraag loopt nog doordat de ILT nog niet alle benodigde technische informatie heeft ontvangen om de aanvraag volledig te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gevolgen van de fusie tussen Bayer en Monsanto voor de voedselproductie

The MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the effects of the Bayer-Monsanto merger on food production, market dominance, the Dutch seed sector, patents and farmers' protection. The State Secretary shares concerns, says the European Commission will assess the merger's competition effects, notes the Dutch seed sector is strong, and says the patent-breeder's rights imbalance must be fixed, while the Commission's decision is awaited.
I will therefore continue to follow developments closely.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen daarom met zorg blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Criminelen wijken uit naar Gelderland voor dumpen drugsafval’

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked about reports that drug waste dumping is shifting to Gelderland and why few people claim from the co-financing fund for cleanup costs, and whether the fund could pay faster or a higher share. The minister acknowledges a slight rise, explains low claim numbers (unawareness, missing documents, small amounts), refuses faster payment to keep the pro-rata system, and says talks with provinces on a higher share and a possible offender levy are ongoing.
I am in discussion with the provinces to explore the possibilities for better use of the compensation scheme.
Ik ben met de provincies in gesprek om de mogelijkheden voor betere benutting van de vergoedingsregeling te verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over verwijzingen naar abortusklinieken in AZC’s

MPs asked how pregnant asylum seekers in reception centres are cared for, whether COA policy on unplanned pregnancies includes independent counselling on alternatives to abortion, and whether they are being referred to abortion clinics with standard referral letters, with calls for independent investigation. The government answered that asylum seekers have the same maternity care rights as Dutch citizens, that GC A follows NHG standards with referral to clinics or counselling bodies possible, that it finds such steering unacceptable, has received no such signals, and sees no reason for an investigation at present.
At this moment there is no reason for me to conduct an investigation.
Op dit moment is er voor mij geen aanleiding voor een onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de situatie van de locatie Den Helder van de Noordwest Ziekenhuisgroep

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the Den Helder hospital location can remain a basic hospital under its 2014 profile, given plans to concentrate complex multi-day cardiology care in Alkmaar, and what the government will do about local unrest. The Minister answered that the concentration concerns only complex multi-day cardiology, that the Den Helder emergency department must have a cardiologist available within a set time, that the organisation is primarily a matter for providers and insurers supervised by the IGJ and NZa, and that the hospital has commissioned an independent review due in autumn.
It is up to the hospital to discuss intended changes to the profile with the region and to take the region into account in the deliberations on the matter.
Het is aan het ziekenhuis om voornemens tot wijziging van het profiel met de regio te bespreken en de regio mee te nemen in de afwegingen terzake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over rookruimtes in de horeca

An ChristenUnie MP asks the state secretary for health about smoking rooms in hospitality venues, whether they undermine the smoking ban and unfair competition, whether municipalities can help enforce the Tobacco Act, and whether smoke-free playgrounds will be promoted. The state secretary answers that smoking rooms are incompatible with a smoke-free society, that rising numbers are not necessarily a sign of failed policy, that NVWA enforces the ban in cooperation with municipalities while deferring a decision on municipal enforcement until the Drank- en Horecawet evaluation, and that he supports smoke-free playgrounds and local tobacco control.
I am monitoring the consequences of my policy, and that includes the presence of smoking rooms.
Ik houd de gevolgen van mijn beleid in de gaten en zo ook de aanwezigheid van rookruimtes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over de verspreiding van abortuspillen door Women on Waves naar Noord-Ierland

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether the Women on Waves abortion-pill action toward Northern Ireland was lawful, whether the Dutch permit was affected, and whether there was contact with Ireland. The Minister answered that Northern Ireland's authorities are responsible for enforcement, no temporary permit was required since the action took place abroad, and there was no contact with Ireland or Northern Ireland.
Since Women on Waves' conduct did not take place on Dutch territory, no permit is required under Article 296(5) of the Criminal Code.
Aangezien het handelen van Women on Waves niet op Nederlands grondgebied plaatsvond, is er geen vergunning vereist
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat er sprake is van een ophoping van kernafval in Petten door falende apparatuur

MPs from D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the minister about reports of a build-up of nuclear waste at Petten caused by failing equipment, including how often the COVRA transfer deadline has been postponed, the VINISH problems, cost estimates and financial risks for ECN/NRG. The minister answered that the deadline was extended three times to 2022, that current VINISH problems are software-related and expected to be resolved, that cost estimates from 2015 remain valid, and agreed to publish the Turkenburg and Holtkamp reports with some passages redacted.
In accordance with articles 10 and 11 of the Open Government Act, a number of passages in the letter and the reports have been redacted.
Overeenkomstig de artikelen 10 en 11 van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur is een aantal passages in de brief en de rapporten weggelakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Lodders, Graus, Dik-Faber, Dijkgraaf,  Van Klaveren en Houwers over het bericht van Cumela om voor 24 augustus 2016 duidelijkheid te geven over het verzoek van Cumela voor uitstel

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs to clarify before 24 August 2016 whether he would postpone the manure spreading ban, as requested by the trade association Cumela. The State Secretary answered that he had asked the Technical Committee Soil for advice on a possible exemption under the Soil Protection Act, expected to decide within the week and communicate it promptly.
I expect this advice to be received shortly and will then decide on an exemption.
Ik verwacht dit advies op korte termijn te ontvangen en zal daarna besluiten over een vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over jong ouderschap naar aanleiding van het congres Jong en Ouder

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the state secretary about support, housing, funding fragmentation and care for young parents, including teen pregnancies in closed youth care. The state secretary largely pointed to municipal responsibility, existing initiatives and the taskforce, promising follow-up letters on national procurement and a study on the demand side.
Municipalities precisely have the opportunity to look, using funds from different sources, at how integrated tailored support can best be delivered.
Gemeenten hebben juist de mogelijkheid om met middelen die uit verschillende bronnen komen te kijken op welke wijze integraal het beste maatwerk kan worden geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de controle van biologische bedrijven met het Skal-keurmerk

An MP asked the State Secretary whether Skal relies mainly on one private firm, Control Union, for organic inspections, and whether this concentration is acceptable under EU rules on impartiality. The government answered that Skal keeps responsibility for and control over Control Union, that the single-authority structure is deliberate and efficient, and it declined to open talks with Skal to allow multiple inspection bodies.
Skal is at all times responsible for the work and direction of CU, including the impartiality of the contracted inspectors and the absence of conflicts of interest.
Skal is te allen tijde verantwoordelijk voor de werkzaamheden en aansturing van CU, ook voor wat betreft de onpartijdigheid van de ingehuurde inspecteurs en het ontbreken van belangenconflicten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over restwarmte uit de Uniper-kolencentrale

The MP asked whether the minister requested Gasunie to study a heat pipeline carrying residual heat from the Uniper coal plant to the Westland, whether this fits Gasunie's legal role, and whether public funds or regulated tariffs would be used. The minister denied asking Gasunie to study it, said Gasunie New Energy joined the feasibility study voluntarily, and stated that GTS's regulated transport tasks do not permit investments in heat infrastructure.
It is therefore not permitted for Gasunie to make investments in heat infrastructure from the regulated tariffs, or to recover such investments through the regulated tariffs for gas transport.

Het is dan ook niet toegestaan dat Gasunie vanuit de gereguleerde tarieven investeringen doet in warmte-infrastructuur, danwel deze investeringen terugverdient via de gereguleerde tarieven voor het transport van gas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over vertraging in het onderzoek over schade aan woningen in Steenbergen en de gasopslag van de NAM bij Langelo

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why the NAM's follow-up investigation into damage to homes near Steenbergen and Norg has not started, why residents are poorly informed, and whether expanding the Norg gas storage is responsible given unresolved damage reports. The minister answers that the National Coordinator Groningen visited Norg and that NAM is preparing follow-up and validation studies independent of the minister, and that conditions including a seismic network and a risk update by 1 November 2016 are imposed before the storage plan is reviewed.

In addition, I have required NAM to provide, by 1 November 2016 and to the satisfaction of the Inspector-General of Mines, a written update of the seismic risk analysis for the Norg underground gas storage.

Daarnaast heb ik NAM opgelegd om voor 1 november 2016, ten genoegen van de Inspecteur-Generaal der Mijnen een schriftelijke update aan te leveren van de seismische risicoanalyse voor de ondergrondse gasopslag Norg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de aanbesteding van dienstauto’s voor de brandweer

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked about the tender for fleet cars for the fire service, including the diesel requirement, sustainability criteria and tax treatment. The State Secretary replied that the diesel requirement is being dropped, that the fire service's procuring body (IFV) has been asked to pay attention to environmental aspects, and that the choice of diesel versus alternatives has cost implications.
As indicated in the reply of 13 April 2016, the diesel requirement is being dropped.
Zoals aangegeven in de beantwoording van 13 april 2016 1 wordt de dieseleis geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over Driezorg in Zwolle en de Wet normering topinkomens

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked about a 426,113 euro severance payment to the former director of Driezorg in Zwolle and whether it complies with the WNT pay cap. The state secretary answered that the amount exceeds the WNT limit but that pre-WNT agreements apply until four years after 2013, that the accountant found no violations, and that the CIBG will nonetheless investigate.
Nevertheless, the CIBG will carry out an investigation to ensure there is no question of violations.
Desondanks zal het CIBG een onderzoek uitvoeren om zeker te stellen dat er geen sprake is van overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de handreiking schriftelijk euthanasieverzoek

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP ask the health and justice ministers whether the government's answer on the written euthanasia request guidance was adequate and whether its wording on dementia patients, which they say confuses doctors and the public, should be changed. The minister replies that the sentence should be read in the context of dementia cases, that it is clear, and that the working group decided not to amend it.
In consultation, the members of the working group on the written euthanasia declaration have therefore decided not to amend the passage.
In overleg hebben de leden van de werkgroep «Schriftelijke wilsverklaring euthanasie» dan ook besloten de passage niet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat er sprake is van een ophoping van kernafval

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks asked the minister about reports that faulty measuring equipment at Petten leaves stored nuclear waste drums uncertain in content, and about delays in transferring the waste to COVRA. The minister confirmed the ANVS knew of the equipment shortcomings since spring 2015, said the waste remains safely stored, and gave partial answers on costs, delays and the NRG safety culture while referring some points to the regulator and the parliamentary debate.
The ANVS has been aware since spring 2015 that the accuracy of the VINISH installation at that time was not sufficient to achieve the characterisation agreed with COVRA.

De ANVS is sinds het voorjaar 2015 op de hoogte van het feit dat de nauwkeurigheid van de VINISH-installatie op dat moment niet voldoende was om de met COVRA afgesproken karakterisering te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gevolgen van extreme weersomstandigheden

An MP asked the ministers about the consequences of extreme weather, climate scenarios, municipal climate risk preparedness, funding for adaptation, and event planning. The government answered that existing Delta Programme decisions remain valid, gave an overview of current programmes and an evaluation due end 2016, and said municipal capacity is the responsibility of local authorities.
The ambition is that by 2020 climate-resilient action and water-robust planning will be an integral part of their policy and conduct.
De ambitie hierbij is dat in 2020 klimaatbestendig handelen en waterrobuust inrichten een integraal onderdeel van hun beleid en handelen is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het hoge aantal abortussen

Two MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked the health minister about the rising global abortion count, the apparently high rate among some immigrant groups, and whether abortion may encourage risky sexual behaviour. The minister answered that the Netherlands has one of the lowest abortion rates internationally, that origin is not registered so no evidence of higher rates among specific immigrant groups exists, and that no additional research or targeted policy is planned.

I do not intend to commission additional research into the effect of abortion legislation on sexual risk-taking, since the Netherlands is internationally among the countries with the lowest abortion rate.

Ik ben niet voornemens om extra onderzoek te laten doen naar het gevolg van de abortuswetgeving op seksueel risicogedrag, aangezien Nederland internationaal tot de landen behoort met het laagste abortuscijfer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het artikel ‘Minister aanklagen vanwege miskramen’ en het uitsluiten van belangenverstrengeling

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the NIPT consortium and Gendia have conflicts of interest with the Health Council's advice on the NIPT test, after a Gendia director accused her of medical malpractice. The Minister rejected the accusations, said Gendia is not involved in the Health Council advice, described the consortium's links and its conflict-of-interest rules, and explained the Council's procedures for excluding conflicted experts.
Gendia is not involved in any way in the Health Council's advice on the NIPT.
Gendia wordt op geen enkele manier betrokken bij het advies van de Gezondheidsraad over de NIPT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over mogelijk kankerverwekkende stoffen in voeding

An ChristenUnie MP asked the health minister about mineral oil contamination (MOSH and MOAH) in food and packaging, including company responsibility, recycled packaging barriers, ink de-inking, and whether national standards should be set. The minister replied that monitoring with validated methods is needed first, that the food industry must take responsibility, and that national standards and NVWA enforcement will follow only once EU monitoring results are available.
As soon as exposure to such substances reaches (near) harmful levels, everything must be done to reduce it.
Zodra de blootstelling van dergelijke stoffen op (nagenoeg) schadelijke niveaus ligt moet alles in het werk worden gesteld om dit terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht “Grond bij Oppenhuizen zakt veel meer bij gaswinning”

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the Economic Affairs minister whether a second-opinion study predicting much larger subsidence and a 19% earthquake chance at the Oppenhuizen gas field requires rejecting the drilling plan, and whether reversed burden of proof and a baseline survey of buildings should apply. Minister Kamp replied that SodM and TNO found the predictions plausible, the maximum subsidence is under two centimetres and legally binding, reversed burden of proof does not apply because no building damage is expected, a baseline survey has been agreed, and a single damage desk study will be reported by 1 July 2016.
I asked the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) and TNO to respond to the study by Mr Houtenbos.
Ik heb Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) en TNO gevraagd om een reactie op het onderzoek van de heer Houtenbos.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over rookruimtes in de horeca

An MP asked the State Secretary about the rise of smoking rooms in cafés and discotheques and whether to restrict them. The State Secretary answered that smoking rooms are an accepted instrument within the smoke-free hospitality rule, that their enforcement norm is sufficient, and that new rules will await the effects of other measures.

Now that the smoking ban applies across the full hospitality sector and I am taking many other measures to discourage smoking, I first want to await their effects before setting new rules for smoking rooms.

Nu in de volledige horeca het rookverbod is ingevoerd en ik tal van andere maatregelen neem om het roken te ontmoedigen, wil ik eerst de effecten daarvan afwachten alvorens nieuwe regels voor rookruimtes vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de handreiking schriftelijk euthanasieverzoek

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked about the handreiking on written euthanasia requests, including how the brochure was drafted, uptake among doctors, and wording on dementia suffering. The ministers answered that the handreiking was developed by a working group with consultation of stakeholders to clarify the Wtl, that uptake is unknown, and that doctors must still assess unbearable suffering case by case.
We have no insight into the extent to which doctors use the handreiking.
Antwoord 3 We hebben geen inzicht in de schaal waarop artsen gebruikmaken van de handreiking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over dumping van drugsafval in Gelderland

ChristenUnie MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about the rise in illegal drug-waste dumping in Gelderland, including the cost-sharing fund, dumping figures, offender liability and cooperation with provinces. The government answered that it had not contacted Gelderland, that dumping appears to shift from Brabant toward neighbouring provinces, that a 1 million euro cofinancing fund covers all provinces with a review due by 1 September, and that it will not change its drug enforcement approach.
The total subsidy requested remains well below the available amount of 1 million euros, and the number of applications is also smaller than expected.
Het totaal aan gevraagde subsidie blijft ruim onder het beschikbare bedrag van € 1 miljoen en ook het aantal aanvragen is kleiner dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de uitvoerbaarheid van het asbestdakenverbod

An MP asked the State Secretary about the feasibility of the 2024 asbestos roof ban, covering costs, subsidies, contractor capacity, information provision and a possible notification duty. The State Secretary answered that the government will support the ban with subsidies and the Versnellingsaanpak programme, that the 35 m2 self-removal limit will be kept, and that a national notification duty is hard to enforce, while promising progress reports.
I currently see no reason to reduce the 35 m2 limit.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de grens van 35 m 2 te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Aardbevingsschade maakt Groningers machteloos'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Groningen residents feel powerless over earthquake damage handling by NAM and CVW, and about NAM's treatment of damage outside the theoretical contour. The minister promised to send the Onafhankelijke Raadsman report with his response shortly, and said NAM is legally obliged to compensate all damage, with validation of its outside-contour research expected around summer.
I will shortly send your House the report, accompanied by my response to the findings and recommendations.
Ik zal uw Kamer op korte termijn het rapport aanbieden, vergezeld van mijn reactie op de constateringen en aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Geurts en Koser Kaya over het rapport van de Raad voor Regionaal Veevoer over de kansen en knelpunten voor eiwitrijke veevoergrondstoffen

MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Raad voor Regionaal Veevoer report on increasing regionally grown protein feed and whether he would adopt its recommendations and a protein vision. The State Secretary agreed that regional protein production has potential, committed to exploring public-private initiatives, topsector focus and raising EU-level barriers, but said direct state steering of cultivation is not the preferred route and the transition will proceed more slowly than the report envisages.
I agree that regional cultivation and sale of protein crops can contribute more to improving the regional cycle.
Ik onderschrijf dat met de productie van regionale teelt en afzet van eiwitgewassen meer kan worden bijgedragen aan het verbeteren van de regionale kringloop
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de aanbesteding voor nieuwe politieauto’s

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked whether the police tender for new patrol cars requiring diesel engines and a 140 g/km CO2 limit, and lacking further climate criteria, is consistent with air quality and sustainable procurement goals. The government answered that the diesel requirement will be dropped from the final programme of requirements, that the police are considering sustainability criteria, and that fiscal incentives (BPM and MRB exemptions) make diesel economically attractive for high-mileage vehicles.
However, this requirement will be dropped and will therefore not form part of the final programme of requirements.
Deze eis zal echter worden geschrapt en zal dus geen onderdeel uitmaken van het definitief programma van eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Toorenburg, Leijten en Dik-Faber over de tariefverhoging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag en de gevolgen hiervan voor vrijwilligerswerk

MPs from CDA, SP and ChristenUnie asked the government to explain the 38% fee increase for the Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) and its impact on volunteer organisations, and to reconcile it with earlier statements. The state secretary attributed the increase mainly to cost-recovery of Justis integrity products, said 7.5% covers the free VOG scheme, declined to commission an impact study on volunteer organisations, and said no consultation with VWS took place.
I am not willing to conduct research into the consequences of the fee increase for volunteers and their organisations.
Ik ben niet bereid onderzoek te verrichten naar de gevolgen van de tariefverhoging op het effect voor vrijwilligers en hun organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Bruins Slot, Bergkamp, Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over een verzekeraar die wijkverpleegkundigen passeert met nieuw pgb-beleid

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about insurer CZ's new policy limiting which home-care nurses may assess persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) eligibility, designating preferred organisations per region, and whether this restricts budget-holders' choice. The State Secretary answered that CZ's approach is within the agreed rules, budget-holders remain free to choose other providers with reduced reimbursement, the insurer has at least two providers per region, and an AMvB will be sent to parliament with a letter on the motion.
Control lies in all cases with the PGB holder.
De regie ligt in alle gevallen bij de pgb-houder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Marketing kunstvoeding bedreigt borstvoeding’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Health Minister about reports that marketing of infant formula threatens breastfeeding, and about the regulation, monitoring, professional training and support for breastfeeding mothers. The minister answered that formula rules are strict under EU and Dutch law, that breastfeeding rates have risen, and pointed to existing platforms, certification and planned e-learning, without new binding measures.
In the Netherlands the government does not conduct research into the influence of infant formula marketing on breastfeeding.
In Nederland wordt door de overheid geen onderzoek gedaan naar de invloed van marketing van kunstvoeding op het geven van borstvoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de onderzoeken naar de kosten en baten van het statiegeldsysteem

An MP asks whether the ministry's involvement in a Wageningen University study on the costs of the deposit system, commissioned by industry stakeholders and later revised with ministry input, breached integrity rules and whether the study remains reliable. The State Secretary answers that the ministry did give informal input, that no explicit rules govern such involvement, that additional agreements are needed, and that a TNO comparison and the 2017 framework-agreement evaluation will address costs.
Moreover, I believe that additional agreements are needed on this last point.
Overigens meen ik dat er op dit laatste punt aanvullende afspraken nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Wolbert over voeding in de zorg

MPs Dik-Faber and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about nutrition in care: medical training, malnutrition screening, transmural guidelines, cancer screening advice, prevention funding and food concepts in hospitals. The Minister answered that professional bodies and guideline makers should lead on curriculum and guidelines, pointed to existing initiatives, and promised letters on prevention and a Kwaliteitsinstituut request.
I will ask the Kwaliteitsinstituut to promote attention to nutrition in the relevant guidelines.
Daarnaast zal ik het Kwaliteitsinstituut vragen om te bevorderen dat in de relevante richtlijnen aandacht is voor voeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over dreigende hongersnood in Zuidelijk Afrika als gevolg van El Niño en het tekort aan klimaatfinanciering

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked about the food crisis in Southern Africa caused by El Niño, the case for early action and climate finance. Minister Ploumen answered that the government has provided emergency aid through several channels, supports resilience programmes, and will press donors and promote climate finance, without addressing any oversight of the executive.
The cabinet closely follows the situation around El Niño and is aware of the effects of El Niño in Southern Africa.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie rond El Niño nauwlettend en is zich bewust van de effecten van El Niño in Zuidelijk Afrika
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Wolbert over sluipsuikers in drinkpakjes voor kinderen

MPs Dik-Faber and Wolbert asked the Health Minister about sugar levels in children's drink cartons, the Akkoord Verbetering Productsamenstelling, daily sugar limits and EU action. The minister described existing prevention programmes, the staged sugar-reduction agreements (with results not yet available), and plans to raise product reformulation at the EU level during the Dutch presidency.
How much of these drinks from drink cartons is consumed is not known.
Hoeveel van deze dranken uit drinkpakjes worden genuttigd is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de website ‘woman on web’

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether Women on Web, a Dutch-hosted online abortion-information and medication service, offering free abortions to women with Zika may be unlawful and harmful, and when more will be known about Zika's link to microcephaly and Guillain-Barré. The minister answered that Dutch law only permits abortion in licensed facilities and bars internet prescribing without a doctor-patient relationship, that the IGZ has asked follow-up questions, and that scientific conclusions on Zika will take weeks to months.
The IGZ has asked Women on Web additional questions about the working method of this online community following the reports.
De IGZ heeft naar aanleiding van de berichtgevingen Women on Web aanvullende vragen gesteld over de werkwijze van deze online gemeenschap
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de Levenseindekliniek

An MP asks the Health Minister about the Levenseindekliniek (end-of-life clinic) shown in a documentary: whether 'treatment' language fits euthanasia, whether expertise on dementia and psychiatry is secured in the regional review committees, how cases where doctors refused are handled, and whether an independent investigation is needed. The minister replies that the review committees adequately assess cases, the clinic's procedures meet the law, and no independent study is needed, while promising a policy response on Voltooid leven later.
I see no reason to change the procedure of the regional review committees.
Ik zie geen reden om de procedure van de RTE's te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over drugsafval in landbouwakkers

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about drug waste dumped in farmland and gierkelders, including health risks, soil contamination, cost of cleanup, and enforcement capacity. The minister answered that detected amphetamine/MDMA levels pose no health danger, that no evidence yet shows dumping at other farms, that cleanup costs fall on polluters or landowners with a €1 million annual national fund for provinces, and that Intensivering Zuid strengthens anti-drug enforcement in Brabant.
Strong efforts are therefore being made to combat drug crime and the dumping of drug waste.
Er wordt dan ook stevig ingezet op het bestrijden van drugscriminaliteit en dumping van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de benoeming van de voorzitter van Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthanasie

MP Dik-Faber asked whether former NVVE chair Jacob Kohnstamm's appointment as coordinating chair of the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees was procedurally sound and whether his past role at a pro-euthanasia advocacy group compromised impartiality, and whether doctors' pressure linked to NVVE activities should be addressed. The ministers answered that the procedure followed a joint nomination by the committee chairs with published profile and selection steps, that Kohnstamm's past NVVE chairmanship is not an obstacle given the committee's role, and that they will not require him to resign from NVVE membership.
The chairs of the RTEs stated in their nomination that Mr Kohnstamm shows a keen awareness of the impartial position and role of the coordinating chair and the RTEs.
De voorzitters van de RTE's hebben in hun voordracht aangegeven dat de heer Kohnstamm blijk geeft van een scherp zicht op de onpartijdige positie en rol van de coördinerend voorzitter en de RTE's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het onderzoek naar tienerzwangerschappen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the ministers about a Rutgers study on teenage pregnancies, including whether abortion is rejected by many pregnant teenagers, whether support for young mothers is adequate, and whether prevention and counselling should stress abortion's negative consequences. The State Secretary answered that girls' choices are respected, that doctors judge whether decisions are free and informed, that existing funding for support organisations is sufficient, and that counselling covers all options and consequences of abortion.
It is up to the doctor to determine whether a woman who comes to him for an abortus has made this choice freely and well informed.
Het is aan de arts om te bepalen of een vrouw die bij hem komt voor een abortus deze keuze in vrijheid en goed geïnformeerd heeft gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Zilveren kruis smeert verstandelijk beperkten wurgcontract aan"

MPs from nine parties asked the State Secretary about a Zilveren Kruis settlement agreement offered to persoonsgebonden budget holders, and whether it should be withdrawn and whether the motion to halt recovery was being implemented. The State Secretary answered that the zorgkantoren act on agreements made with them, that the settlement need no longer be signed pending a good-faith assessment, that recovery of alleged improperly paid budgets is suspended until good faith is assessed by 1 May 2016, and that other zorgkantoren operate under the same agreements.
By 1 May 2016 or as soon as possible, zorgkantoren will have assessed in all currently open individual cases whether the budget holder acted in good faith.
Uiterlijk 1 mei 2016 of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, hebben zorgkantoren in alle op dit moment openstaande individuele casuïstiek beoordeeld of de budgethouder te goeder trouw heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Dik-Faber over aanhoudende incidenten bij Belgische kerncentrales

MPs Van Tongeren and Dik-Faber asked the minister about Belgian nuclear plants Doel and Tihange: life extension without a full environmental impact assessment, alleged illegal state aid, joint inspections, municipal involvement, and reliability ratings. The minister said the Belgian authorities judged an EIA unnecessary, that the Dutch and Belgian regulators held a first joint inspection and will do more, that Dutch municipalities are informed but lack formal involvement in Belgian decisions, and that state aid is for the European Commission to assess.

The Belgian authorities, on the basis of the relevant law and regulations and licence, judged that drawing up an EIA is not necessary for extending the operating life of Doel 1 and Doel 2 nuclear plants.

De Belgische autoriteiten hebben op basis van de relevante wet en regelgeving en vergunning geoordeeld dat het opstellen van een MER niet noodzakelijk is voor de bedrijfsduurverlenging van de kerncentrales Doel 1 en Doel 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de vermeende angstcultuur bij Zorggroep Charim

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about an alleged culture of fear at care group Charim, including whether earlier improvement points had been implemented and what independent research and external support would follow. The State Secretary condemned any culture of fear, said Charim is primarily responsible for its own improvement, described the prior report's themes and an independent study expected in April 2016, and pointed to available support programmes.
Yes. I am of the view that no organisation may have a culture of fear.
Ja. Ik ben van mening dat in geen enkele organisatie sprake mag zijn van een angstcultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind over de Special Olympic World Games

MPs Dik-Faber and Voordewind asked the Health Minister about the Dutch team's medal results at the Special Olympics in Los Angeles and whether the government would encourage athletes at the 2017 Winter Games in Austria. The minister expressed pride in the athletes and said she would try to attend and cheer them on in Austria, depending on her agenda.
I will work to give the athletes encouragement, just as during the preparation for the World Summer Games in Los Angeles.
Ik zal mij inzetten om net zoals tijdens de voorbereiding van de World Summer Games in Los Angeles de sporters een hart onder de riem te steken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Minder ziekenhuisopnames door casemanager palliatieve zorg'

MPs asked the state secretary for Health about a study finding that palliative case managers reduce hospital admissions, and about funding, reach beyond cancer patients and follow-up on a motion. The state secretary said the model adds value, that the Health Insurance Act allows such roles to be funded through nursing care, and that palliative care is being broadened beyond cancer, though no new obligation is created.
I am currently examining how I can implement the adopted motion submitted by member Bruins Slot et al.
Ik ben momenteel aan het onderzoeken hoe ik uitvoering kan geven aan de aangenomen motie van het lid Bruins Slot c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Geurts over de heffing van btw op subsidies voor rietlandbeheerders in de Weerribben en Wieden

Two MPs asked whether the government will help secure a VAT-free subsidy arrangement for reed-land managers in the Weerribben and Wieden after a tax inspector ruled them VAT-liable. The Secretary of State confirmed the ruling, said the arrangement cannot avoid VAT under EU rules as proposed, and pointed to alternative structures (a collective or a combined entity) and possible amendment of the provincial subsidy scheme while giving no firm commitment to a specific fix.

Within the framework of laws and regulations there is willingness to look, on a proposal from the parties involved, at a sector proposal for reed-land management under which no VAT is levied on the reed-land managers.

Binnen het kader van wet- en regelgeving bestaat de bereidheid om op voorstel van betrokken partijen te kijken naar een voorstel van de sector om te komen tot rietlandbeheer waarbij geen heffing van btw plaatsvindt bij de rietlandbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over mogelijke aardbevingen bij Langelo door uitbreiding van de gasopslag in gasveld Norg

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why residents near Langelo were not informed or involved about the expansion of the Norg gas storage, the earthquake risk, and 80 damage reports, and whether NAM would be pressed on communication and a damage covenant. The minister replied that residents were kept informed during construction, that the Arcadis damage study was published and presented, that the risk is considered very small, and that no additional damage-compensation rules are planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de Niet Invasieve Prenatale Test (NIPT) via Prenacheck

An MP asked the minister whether the Prenacheck website, which offered NIPT tests ordered from Germany outside the TRIDENT study, gave incomplete counselling and information, and what oversight applied under the Population Screening Act. The minister said the site was offline, that limited website information does not meet quality standards for counselling, and that the IGZ is investigating the linked laboratory and monitoring the site.
The IGZ is currently conducting further investigation at this organisation in connection with the report about the website bloedwaardentest.nl (possible violation of the WBO).
De IGZ verricht momenteel nader onderzoek bij deze organisatie in het kader van de melding over de website bloedwaardentest.nl (mogelijke overtreding van de WBO).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bergkamp over het maatwerkprofiel en de meerzorgregeling

MPs Dik-Faber and Bergkamp asked why the progress report on long-term care discusses the meerzorgregeling but not the development of a maatwerkprofiel, what the difference is between the two, and how care for children with severe multiple disabilities can support their development. The Staatssecretaris answered that maatwerk is being examined through an advisory request to ZIN and NZa with results expected in 2016, that existing profiles already allow development-oriented care, and that children with multiple disabilities can receive developmental care within their zorgplan, with supplementary care where profiles are insufficient.
It is my intention that at a later stage the joint advice of the NZa and ZIN will also contribute to this discussion.
Het is mijn bedoeling dat op een later moment ook het gezamenlijke advies van de NZa en ZIN een bijdrage levert aan deze discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het pleidooi van NOV om de prijsverhoging van de VOG niet voor vrijwilligers te laten gelden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the planned VOG fee increase should exempt volunteers, given the NOV's appeal, and whether a quick scan of its financial effects would be done. The State Secretary acknowledged the increase may be a setback but refused to widen the free VOG scheme or conduct a quick scan, citing budget limits and that the effects cannot yet be known.
I see no room in my ministry's budget to make the free VOG available to millions of volunteers.
Ik zie geen ruimte op de begroting van mijn ministerie om voor miljoenen vrijwilligers de gratis VOG ter beschikking te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het maatschappelijk verantwoord inkopen (MVI) van mobiliteit door overheden

An MP asked why most public mobility tenders in 2015 failed the minimum sustainability criteria, and whether the criteria and monitoring should be tightened. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said criteria are being updated annually and a benchmark is being set up, but made no firm binding commitment to 100% sustainable procurement by 2016 and withheld the budget overview pending interdepartmental consultation.
I have made efforts to answer on time. Due to the necessary interdepartmental coordination, this unfortunately did not succeed.
Ik heb mij ingespannen voor een tijdige beantwoording. Als gevolg van de noodzakelijke interdepartementale afstemming is dit helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat één op de drie patiënten vorig jaar het voorgeschreven geneesmiddel niet heeft opgehaald

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether one in three patients not collecting prescribed medicine is a problem, how much money is wasted by uncollected medicines and missed specialist appointments, and whether pharmacists should charge a symbolic fee for uncollected prescriptions. The Minister referred to earlier letters on care avoidance, said waste cannot be precisely quantified, and rejected the fee idea as adding administrative burden without being an effective tool.
It is not possible to state how much money is wasted because patients do not show up for appointments with a medical specialist.
Daarom is het niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel geld verspild wordt doordat patiënten niet komen opdagen bij een afspraak met een medisch specialist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dik-Faber inzake het Wob-verzoek over zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Jacobi and Dik-Faber asked why the Minister had not yet answered a Wob (freedom of information) request on salt extraction under the Wadden Sea, which was more than five months old. The Minister replied that the information was provided on 18 November 2015, after an inventory of 558 documents required considerable review and coordination.
The Wob request submitted on 29 May 2015 was picked up immediately at the time.
Het op 29 mei 2015 ingediende Wob-verzoek is indertijd direct opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en De Boer over de intercitystatus van station Schiedam Centrum en de mogelijkheden voor realisatie van station Schiedam Kethel

Two MPs asked the state secretary about keeping Intercity stops at Schiedam Centrum under the PHS timetable and about options for a new Schiedam Kethel station. The state secretary said no formal Intercity status exists, that Schiedam Centrum loses Intercity stops without extra measures, and that a variant D upgrade is being studied but no extra funding is currently available, while declining to study the Kethel station options further.
The region is free to expand the research assignment with this question, if desired.
Het staat de regio overigens vrij om, indien gewenst, de onderzoeksopdracht met deze vraagstelling te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bruins Slot en Dik-Faber over de financiering van geestelijke begeleiding bij palliatieve zorg in de thuissituatie

MPs Van der Staaij, Bruins-Slot and Dik-Faber asked why spiritual care for terminally ill patients at home is not reimbursed under the Zvw and whether insurers are meeting their duty of care. The Secretary of State answered that spiritual guidance on religion and spirituality is not insured care, that palliative care by nurses and GPs is covered, and that Agora will be asked to inventory improvements with stakeholders.

I am not aware of any signals that health insurers are not purchasing and reimbursing the support for coping with illness and treatment, as described by the professional groups themselves within the limits of care that GPs and nurses normally provide, and are therefore failing their duty of care.

Mij zijn geen signalen bekend dat zorgverzekeraars de begeleiding bij de verwerking en het omgaan met ziekte en behandeling, zoals door de beroepsgroepen zelf beschreven binnen de grenzen van zorg zoals huisartsen en verpleegkundigen die plegen te bieden, niet inkopen en vergoeden en dus hun zorgplicht niet nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de mogelijke aanwezigheid van schadelijke stoffen in gerecyclede verpakkingen

MP Dik-Faber asked the health minister about mineral oil hydrocarbons found in recycled food packaging after a Foodwatch study, including health risks, regulation, NVWA oversight and industry engagement. The minister confirmed the findings are not surprising, said risk assessment and a possible norm are under study, noted no legal limits exist yet, and committed to talks with industry and RIVM and to raising the issue at EU level.
I will engage in discussion with industry to talk about which initiatives have been taken and which additional actions are possible.
