Ik ga het gesprek met de industrie aan om te bespreken welke initiatieven er genomen zijn en welke aanvullende acties mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Euthanasie is geen consumptieartikel’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about an article arguing that euthanasia requests often mask fear and loss of control, and that physicians cannot judge whether a life is meaningful, so the 'unbearable and hopeless suffering' criterion should be narrowed. The Minister answered that existential suffering can already qualify, that palliative care awareness is being raised, that physicians assess unbearable suffering from the patient's perspective rather than meaningfulness of life, and that the current definition will be kept.
I therefore see no reason to depart from the current definition.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om af te stappen de huidige definitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de internetverkoop van de NIPT

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the online sale of the NIPT prenatal test via bloedwaardentest.nl, including counselling quality, possible Wbo violations, links to U-Diagnostics and UMCU, and whether sales should stop. The Minister said the IGZ is examining the reported possible Wbo violation and will await its outcome, while declining to provide sales figures or other data.
The website bloedwaardentest.nl has been reported to the IGZ as a possible violation of the Wbo.
De website bloedwaardentest.nl is bij de IGZ gemeld als mogelijke overtreding van de WBO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de aanpak van luchtvervuiling door scooters

MP Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary about scooter air pollution, Euro 4/5 timing, local emission zones, registration of vehicle data, and a motion on ultrafine particles and type-approval controls. The State Secretary answered that Euro 4 applies from 2017, two-stroke scooters will be phased out by 2018, Euro 5 is delayed to 2020 after failed Dutch lobbying, and enforcement is largely a matter for manufacturers and type-approval authorities, with a letter promised on the Hoogland/Van Veldhoven motion.
It is up to the decentralised authorities to tackle the existing fleet where and how they consider it desirable.
Het is aan de decentrale overheden om de bestaande vloot aan te pakken waar en hoe zij dat wenselijk achten.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Keijzer over zorg na coma

MPs Dik-Faber and Keijzer asked the health minister about care after coma, including the Zorginstituut's review of early intensive neurorehabilitation for adults over 25, misdiagnosis and poor diagnostics in prolonged disorders of consciousness, and a national expertise network. The minister said the Zorginstituut expects to publish its review in spring 2016, and that diagnosis, treatment and knowledge development are the responsibility of professional bodies rather than the government.
It is up to the representative professional groups to interpret the knowledge development on this and, where necessary, incorporate it into the (new) guidelines for responsible care.
Het is aan de representatieve beroepgroepen om de kennisontwikkeling terzake te duiden en zo nodig te verdisconteren in de (nieuwe) richtlijnen voor verantwoorde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verdwijnen van ligplaatsen in de eerste Rijksbinnenhaven in IJmuiden en het ligplaatsenbeleid voor de binnenvaart

An MP asked the minister about the closure of berths in the first Rijksbinnenhaven in IJmuiden, the berth policy for inland shipping, and the ASV's proposal for longer berthing. The minister answered that the number of official berths is unchanged, that the eviction concerns vessels occupying the area unlawfully, and that longer stays should be sought at municipal berths, rejecting the ASV's proposal.
I am willing to examine this further.
Ik ben bereid om dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het plaatsen van particuliere speeltoestellen in de openbare ruimte

An MP asked the health minister about privately placed play equipment in public space, following reports that Zwolle allows residents to install it despite national safety rules that are stricter for public than private equipment. The minister confirmed safety must be ensured, said she will examine whether municipalities could supervise these rules in certain cases, and agreed to explore giving municipalities room, with a first meeting with Zwolle held.
I want to examine whether supervision by municipalities of the national safety requirements for play equipment is possible in certain cases.
Ik wil onderzoeken of toezicht door gemeenten op de landelijke veiligheidseisen voor speeltoestellen in bepaalde gevallen mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over inspraak en betrokkenheid van burgers, provincies en gemeenten bij plannen voor gasboringen in Assen, Blijham en Saaksum

MP Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about public participation and consultation rights for residents, provinces and municipalities over gas drilling and fracking plans in Assen, Blijham and Saaksum, including whether new procedures and risk analyses apply. The Minister answered that a changed winning plan with a risk analysis and public objection procedure will be required before gas production, that the Blijham test drilling is finished without useful results, and that Saaksum fracking falls under the existing winning plan with a notification.
This amended winning plan will, in line with my response to the Safety Board's recommendations, follow the extended preparation procedure with the possibility of submitting objections.

Dit gewijzigd winningsplan zal conform mijn reactie op de aanbevelingen van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) de uitgebreide voorbereidingsprocedure met mogelijkheid tot het indienen van zienswijzen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het opnieuw uitstellen van het Nationaal Programma voor eindberging van kernafval

An MP asked why the government missed the 23 August 2015 deadline for a National Programme on final disposal of radioactive waste, when it will be available, whether public consultation is adequate, and how long-term funding for disposal is guaranteed. The minister answered that studies took longer than planned, the draft programme goes out for consultation in autumn with a final decision later, and the disposal fund is invested via COVRA with returns lagging targets, to be reviewed.
The European Commission has been informed of the delay so that sufficient time can also be taken for public consultation.
De Europese Commissie is op de hoogte gesteld van de vertraging zodat ook voldoende tijd kan worden genomen voor de inspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber inzake verkoop van krasloten en gokverslaving

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary about scratch-card sales, gambling addiction prevalence, and whether a daily purchase limit or registration card should be introduced. The State Secretary answered that the WODC estimates show a declining trend, that the Kansspelautoriteit sees no signals requiring a change, and that no new consultation with Belgium or the regulator is deemed necessary.
The Kansspelautoriteit has no signals that gambling addiction is increasing in scope as a result of scratch-card sales.
Er zijn bij de Kansspelautoriteit geen signalen bekend dat gokverslaving in omvang toeneemt als gevolg van verkoop van krasloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de vertraging bij het spoorproject Assen

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about a one-year delay to the Assen rail project caused by ProRail withdrawing a 2016 possession window due to a shortage of overhead-line technicians, and whether ProRail should have consulted first. The state secretary confirmed the delay, said ProRail informed the municipality promptly and is working jointly to limit consequences, and committed to seeking a completion before summer 2017 while declining to guarantee dates.
ProRail indicates that it will do everything it can to ensure the project is carried out before summer 2017.
ProRail heeft aangegeven dat het er alles aan zal doen om te zorgen dat het project wel vóór de zomer van 2017 wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de BTW-plicht voor agrarisch natuur- en landschapsbeheer

An MP asked whether VAT should not be charged on payments for agricultural nature and landscape management, whether the payments remain cost-covering, and whether farmers would be compensated if VAT applied. The government replied that payments are based on income loss and labour, that VAT would make them non-cost-covering, but that the tax authority has ruled no VAT is due on the subsidies received via collectives, and it gave no commitment to compensation.
The position is that there is no VAT liability for the subsidy received from the province for implementing the management packages by the farmers who together form the collective.

Het standpunt luidt dat er geen BTW-plicht is voor de subsidie die van de provincie wordt ontvangen in het kader van de uitvoering van de beheerpakketten door de betrokken agrariërs die samen het collectief vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek naar de 20 wekenecho door Siriz en de NPV

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about a survey finding that a quarter of women were not fully satisfied with information after an abnormality was detected at the 20-week scan, and about related questions on information quality, the rising share choosing the scan, and new prenatal screening. The Minister said information will be reviewed for neutrality and that the Health Council will advise on the wider screening chain by 2016, but declined further study of the information itself.
I will review the information in light of this so that it is as neutral and complete as possible.
Ik zal naar aanleiding daarvan de informatie tegen het licht houden opdat de informatie neutraal en zo volledig mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over een borderline patiënte die hulp nodig heeft

An MP asked the Health Minister about a borderline patient who reportedly needed help but was referred toward euthanasia services, and about treatment access and youth-to-adult care transitions. The minister said care follows professional guidelines, described transition arrangements, and explained that the NVVE does not refer those wishing to live to euthanasia clinics.
When asked, the NVVE indicated that if someone states they do not wish to end their life but wants to be considered for further treatment, the help-seeker cannot be referred to an end-of-life clinic.

Desgevraagd heeft de NVVE laten weten dat wanneer iemand te kennen geeft geen wens tot beëindiging van het leven te hebben, maar voor verdere behandeling in aanmerking wil komen, de hulpvrager niet kan worden doorverwezen naar een levenseinde kliniek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over toenemende agressie ten aanzien van apothekersassistenten

MPs Voortman and Dik-Faber asked the minister about rising aggression toward pharmacy assistants, linked to the 2014 split of the first dispensing conversation from the standard dispensing fee, and about falling job satisfaction, the trust relationship with patients, and whether the financing should be reversed. The minister acknowledged the preliminary survey results, said the NZa is negotiating with sector parties on a solution, and promised further talks with Optima Farma while defending the new payment as necessary for care content.
I hope that any solution will quickly bring clarity to all those involved and contribute to reducing aggression at the counter.
Ik hoop dat een eventuele oplossing snel tot duidelijkheid leidt voor alle betrokkenen en zal bijdragen aan de vermindering van agressie aan de balie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de erkenning van MTCS als een duurzaam certificeringssysteem voor hout in het Nederlands beleid voor duurzaam inkopen en de reactie hierop van inheemse volken

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the government's account of consultations with Malaysian indigenous peoples on the MTCS timber certification scheme is accurate, given objections from JOAS, and questioned the independence of the planned TPAC check. The government largely defended its findings, declined to verify its report with JOAS, said it cannot explain the discrepancies, and stated that the TPAC check will be limited to information from the last visit while its scope is still being considered.
For the TPAC check, independence, due care and speed must be ensured, also in light of the relevant European framework.
Voor de check door TPAC moeten de onafhankelijkheid, zorgvuldigheid en snelheid geborgd zijn, mede in het licht van het Europese kader terzake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over vrijwilligersnetwerken die zingevingsvragen van ouderen oppakken

An MP asked the state secretary about volunteer networks offering meaning-of-life support to older people, the link between loneliness and a 'completed life', and the cost-saving findings of a Verwey-Jonker study. The state secretary said the government values such initiatives, is funding loneliness programmes and extra support for volunteers, and will bring the study to the attention of partners.
As part of implementing the loneliness programme, I will again bring the report to the attention of Coalitie Erbij and the VNG.
In het kader van de uitvoering van het programma aanpak eenzaamheid zal ik het rapport bij Coalitie Erbij en de VNG nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over eigen kracht-conferenties bij verplichte ggz (geestelijke gezondheidszorg)

An MP asks the Minister of Health about preliminary VUmc findings that family group conferences (Eigen Kracht-conferenties) can reduce coercive mental health care, and whether the Wvggz should be amended and the conferences funded structurally. The minister finds the early results positive, says the conferences can help find alternatives to coercion and that artikel 5:7 already allows a family-drawn plan, and promises to include the findings in a nota van wijziging and to consult the researchers.
The research results on the use of Eigen Kracht Conferences will be taken into account in the nota van wijziging of the Wet verplichte ggz.
De onderzoeksresultaten naar de inzet van de Eigen Kracht Conferenties worden mee genomen in de nota van wijziging van de Wet verplichte ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over levensbeëindiging bij pasgeborenen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether the minister sees too little attention to oversight of end-of-life decisions for newborns, the reporting of such cases to the expert committee, and the legal (fundamental-rights) dimensions. Minister Schippers answered that reporting is important but incomplete, that the regulation is being revised, that legal safeguards are clear, and that the revised regulation is expected in autumn 2015.
That is why I also announced that I would amend the Regulation.
Daarom heb ik ook aangekondigd de Regeling te zullen aanpassen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verdwijnen van de ov-jaarkaart en de gevolgen hiervan voor grote gezinnen met kinderen die de vooropleiding volgen van ballet- en dansopleidingen en conservatoria

MP Dik-Faber asks whether the replacement of the OV Jaarkaart by OV Vrij raises costs sharply for large families with children in dance and music pre-training, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary answers that most families benefit, that NS will contact the roughly 405 multi-sibling-pass holders to advise them, that the concession was not breached, and that no evidence shows families abandoning training for cost reasons.
Reasonably, NS as an independent company cannot be expected to fully grant all wishes.
Redelijkerwijs kan niet van NS als zelfstandig bedrijf verwacht worden dat alle wensen onverkort gehonoreerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Dik-Faber over maatwerkprofielen en herindicering in de Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz) voor ernstig meervoudig gehandicapte kinderen

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Dik-Faber asked about CIZ requests for extensive, short-deadline information from families of severely multiple-disabled children being reassessed for the Wlz, and about timing of tailored care profiles and the extra-care scheme. The state secretary said CIZ will ask only targeted questions, plans to extend the transitional period by one year and consider a four-week deadline, but gave no firm date for tailored profiles and did not answer the last question in time.
I am consulting with the CIZ and the parties involved about this. A period of four weeks seems reasonable.
Ik ben hierover in overleg met het CIZ en betrokken partijen. Een periode van vier weken lijkt redelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over nieuwe onderzoeken over de effectiviteit van statiegeld en het niet nakomen van afspraken uit de Raamovereenkomst verpakkingen

An MP asks the State Secretary about recent studies on the effectiveness of deposit schemes, supermarkets' failure to stop selling PVC packaging, the inspectorate's record on recycling norms, and the scope of the environmental analysis of abolishing deposits. The State Secretary answers that the inspectorate found recycling-norm breaches in some years, that the chain-closing approach and environmental analysis are underway or delivered, and declines to provide an uncertainty margin for reported recycling rates.
The ILT does not have information on the basis of which the uncertainty margin can be stated.
De ILT beschikt niet over informatie op basis waarvan de onzekerheidsmarge aangegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de voortgang van realisatie van open data in het openbaar vervoer

An MP asks the government about the slow progress in opening public transport data, including ridership figures, performance data, OV-chipkaart data and the NDOV rollout. The state secretary responds that open-data licences are being prepared, that NS withholds route-level data as confidential until all operators face the same obligation, and that OV-chipkaart data sharing awaits a CBP privacy opinion.
Figures on underlying sub-routes are provided by NS confidentially on request, to the extent a societal purpose is served.
Cijfers over onderliggende deeltrajecten verstrekt NS op verzoek vertrouwelijk voor zover hier een maatschappelijk doel mee gediend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber naar aanleiding van het bericht dat regionale voedselbanken in het nauw komen

An MP asked the state secretaries whether regional food banks in the Rijnmond area are receiving too little food and what the government is doing about it, including progress on the Alliance and Voedselbanken cooperation and support for donation projects. The government attributes the shortfall mainly to a seasonal pattern, describes ongoing cooperation and some supportive measures, and says it is unaware of other obstacles.
It is regrettable that a number of food banks in the Rijnmond region are temporarily receiving too little food.
Het is te betreuren dat een aantal voedselbanken in de regio Rijnmond – tijdelijk – te weinig voedsel aangeleverd krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de fiscale vrijstelling voor SNL-subsidies

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretaries whether the tax exemption for SNL nature and landscape management subsidies, which applied until 2013, has been approved by the European Commission for 2014 onward, and what the consequences are for tax returns and the timeline. The government answered that the exemption falls under a state aid notification covering provincial schemes, that the Commission began questioning the notification on 13 May 2015, and that approval is not expected before the last quarter of 2015, while taxpayers may rely on national law but face recovery with interest if approval is refused.
Where possible, the Dutch authorities involved are making efforts to obtain a prompt response from the Commission.
Waar mogelijk spannen de betrokken Nederlandse autoriteiten zich in om spoedig een reactie te krijgen van de Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de hoge premie voor de waddenheli

The MP Dik-Faber asks why the Friesland helicopter ambulance cost may raise premiums and whether insurers could exclude Frisians, and asks about the RAV Fryslân takeover of patient transport. Minister Schippers answers that the NZa will be instructed to use an availability contribution (beschikbaarheidbijdrage), that the required regulation change may not be ready by 1 July, and that retroactive effect will be considered.
To guarantee the availability of emergency ambulance transport for patients from the Frisian Wadden islands, I will ask the NZa to set an availability contribution.
Om de beschikbaarheid van spoedeisend ambulancevervoer voor patiënten van de Friese Waddeneilanden te garanderen zal ik de NZa vragen een beschikbaarheidbijdrage vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de uitspraak van de rechter over de overweg Laantje van Alverna

An MP asked the State Secretary about a court ruling that the Laantje van Alverna level crossing has become public through prescription, and whether ProRail will reopen it, appeal, and inventory similar crossings. The State Secretary answered that Heemstede has issued an enforcement decision requiring reopening by 1 July 2015, that the ministry has no role in that request, that ProRail is appealing, and that a plan on unsecured recreational crossings will be sent to the House by 17 June.
Given the non-final nature of the court ruling, I am not yet drawing conclusions from it.
Gelet op het niet-onherroepelijk karakter van de rechterlijke uitspraak trek ik hier nog geen conclusies uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren en Van Veldhoven over subsidiering van biomassa bijstook

Four MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether subsidising biomass co-firing (including 15% cheaper residual streams such as animal meal) risks over-subsidisation, and questioned the basis of the SDE+ base amounts and the withheld ECN/DNV GL reports. The minister answered that the NGO agreement does not fix the SDE+ rate, that the price effect is within calculation margins, and that the preliminary ECN note will not be published though the final version was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de NIP-test (ingezonden 10 april 2015)

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the health minister about the societal effects of NIPT prenatal screening, its proportionality, counselling safeguards and abortion rates after Down syndrome diagnoses. The minister answered that an implementation study runs until April 2016, a Health Council advice on prenatal screening is expected in 2016, counselling and voluntary choice safeguards exist, and that the 2013 abortion data does not record diagnoses.
Furthermore, I have asked the Health Council for advice on the entire prenatal screening chain and the role and place of new developments therein.
Verder heb ik de Gezondheidsraad om advies gevraagd over de gehele prenatale screeningsketen en de rol en plaats van nieuwe ontwikkelingen daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, De Boer en Dik-Faber over mobiliteitskaarten

MPs asked whether NS unilaterally terminated contracts with alternative mobility-card providers, whether this threatens an NS monopoly, and whether ACM is investigating. The state secretary answered that NS did not renew contracts on the same terms, agreed in principle with some providers, and that ACM has found no apparent infringement and is not starting an investigation.
ACM is currently not starting an investigation and for the time being is halting its official interventions.
ACM start op dit moment geen onderzoek en staakt vooralsnog de ambtelijke interventies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Dik-Faber over reizen met de trein door blinden en slechtzienden

Two MPs (De Boer, VVD, and Dik-Faber, ChristenUnie) asked the state secretary about blind and partially sighted train passengers not being clearly told which side of the train to alight on, and about the quality of on-board announcements. The secretary acknowledged the issue, said NS is examining the safety impact and passenger perception before deciding, and reported improvements to announcement equipment and a planned revision of the VIRM intercity announcement systems.
NS wants to first investigate the impact on safety of implementing this measure and how other travellers experience information about the exit side.
NS wil de impact op de veiligheid bij uitvoering van deze maatregel en de hoe andere reizigers informatie over de uitstapzijde ervaren eerst onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de progressieve spierziekte ALS

An MP asked the government about municipal knowledge of ALS, support and equipment for patients, Wmo procedure delays, carer support and leave, and podiatry coverage. The minister answered that municipalities bear responsibility under the Wmo 2015 for tailored support, that patient organisations and the VNG should disseminate ALS knowledge and parties will consult on guidance, and that carer leave rules are being extended from 1 July.
Under the Wmo 2015, municipalities have the responsibility to provide appropriate support to people who are dependent on it.
Gemeenten hebben op grond van de Wmo 2015 de verantwoordelijkheid mensen, die hier op aangewezen zijn, passende ondersteuning te bieden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over late abortussen in België

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the health minister about reports that more Dutch couples travel to Belgium for late abortions and whether Dutch guidance and support are adequate. The minister said such travel is undesirable, gave the available case figures, and said the national late-termination regulation will be revised to address the gaps.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over een toenemend aantal schrijnende verhalen door wachtlijsten in de GGZ

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health about reports that GGZ (mental health) patients face long waiting lists and are left without timely care, and about the role of the helpline Sensoor. The Minister acknowledged the signals, promised a response on acute care and a chain-wide review with the Justice Minister, but said the signals were contradictory, lacked waiting-list figures from the patient federation, and that the Nza analysis would follow in June.
Regarding acute GGZ care, I will shortly send you my response in order to realise improvements here.
Met betrekking tot de zorg in de acute GGZ zend ik u binnenkort mijn reactie om hier verbeteringen te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Rebel en Van der Staaij over de rokende gokker

MPs asked why Holland Casino expanded and made attractive smoking rooms with gambling machines, whether this is lawful and consistent with anti-smoking policy, and whether the government will change it. The government answered that such rooms are lawful under the Tabakswet provided the NVWA's criteria are met, that the offer should not be more attractive than outside the room, and agreed to talk with Holland Casino about a prevention pledge.
Smoking rooms, however, are exempt from the smoking ban, and the way Holland Casino has set up its smoking rooms does not conflict with the rules on this.
Rookruimten zijn echter uitgezonderd van het rookverbod en de manier waarop Holland Casino haar rookruimten heeft ingericht is niet strijdig met de regels daaromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de uitspraken van de secretaris van de Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthanasie (RTE)

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the RTE euthanasia review committees' secretary was right to say the term 'onzorgvuldig' (not careful) gives a wrong impression, and whether her remarks undermine the committees' statutory role and the euthanasia care standards. The Minister refers to earlier answers, says the RTE use 'zorgvuldig/onzorgvuldig' only in summaries and annual reports for readability, that this may give a nuanced picture misleadingly in the media, that the Levenseindekliniek has no influence on the independent RTE, and that she will discuss the terminology with the RTE in periodic consultation.
I will therefore discuss the use of this terminology with the RTE in a periodic consultation with them.
Ik zal daarom in een periodiek overleg met de Rte met hen het gebruik van deze terminologie bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gaswinningsplannen op Terschelling, Schiermonnikoog en bij Oppenhuizen

An MP asked the ministers about planned gas extraction near Terschelling, Schiermonnikoog and Oppenhuizen, including protection of the Wadden Sea, the powers of provinces and municipalities, and the energy transition. The ministers answered that permits are still in procedure, that no moratorium is needed, that local authorities have formal consultation rights, and that the Structuurvisie Ondergrond and Energierapport 2015 are in preparation.
The Provincial Executive of the province of Friesland advises me on the mining permit application submitted by Tulip Oil under the Mining Act.
Het College van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Friesland adviseert mij inzake de door Tulip Oil ingediende winningsvergunningaanvraag op basis van de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Slob over de financiële situatie van kleine ziekenhuizen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the health minister about the financial position of small hospitals, the BDO benchmark finding many in financial danger, their share in shrink regions, the 10-point plan, a availability subsidy, administrative burden, uniform indicators and mergers. The minister acknowledged the report, said hospital boards bear responsibility for their finances, promised to consider regional care and administrative burden measures, and declined to commit to a funding subsidy or hard agreements on indicators.
I consider it important that basic care remains available nearby.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat basiszorg dichtbij beschikbaar blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de bereikbaarheid van reisinformatiediensten

An MP asked the government whether the national cyber security centre should actively help public transport travel-information provider 9292 against DDoS attacks, whether it has designated a travel-information operator, and how to make vehicle data resilient and open. The minister answered that travel-information providers are not a vital sector so NCSC gives only online guidance, that no designation under the Passenger Transport Act is needed, and that data delivery and open-data work will be discussed in the national public transport consultation without firm dates.
Providers of travel information are not part of the established list of vital sectors.
Aanbieders van reisinformatie zijn geen onderdeel van de vastgestelde lijst van vitale sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de Levenseindekliniek

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Health whether she shares concern that the Levenseindekliniek is again under scrutiny after a third notification was judged careless, whether she will talk with the clinic, and whether an independent investigation into its functioning will follow. The minister answered that the Inspectie and the Openbaar Ministerie are responsible for assessing the case, that she sees no reason to talk with the clinic, and that she already explained in an earlier reply why no additional investigation is needed.
I do not consider it opportune to discuss this case with the Levenseindekliniek.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om over deze casus in gesprek te gaan met de Levenseindekliniek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over betere benutting van restwarmte

An MP asked the ministers whether residual heat should be used more widely to reduce gas dependence, what barriers heat suppliers face, and whether the findings of a dissertation would be incorporated. The minister agreed that residual heat can help, said the best option depends on local conditions, acknowledged remaining barriers, and promised to address the topic in a forthcoming heat vision.
In my heat vision, which I will send to your House before 1 April, I will address the possibilities for better utilising the heat potential.
In mijn warmtevisie, die ik voor 1 april a.s. naar uw Kamer zal sturen, ga ik in op de mogelijkheden om het potentieel aan warmte nog beter te benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over overmacht bij het niet tijdig melden van het uitrijden van ruige mest

An MP asked the State Secretary whether force majeure can be invoked in an agricultural nature-management subsidy case where a manure-spreading notification was late, and whether provinces should be asked to include such a clause in their rules. The State Secretary confirmed the case and the legal basis for force majeure, and said she will alert provinces to the option of including a force majeure clause in new rules, while noting provinces are autonomous.
However, I consider it important that in distressing situations an appeal to force majeure can be made.
Ik vind het echter belangrijk dat in schrijnende situaties een beroep op overmacht gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob en Dik-Faber over de verkeersveiligheid en de doorstroming op de N36

MPs Slob and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about road safety and traffic flow on the N36, including whether the Beerzerveld junction meets the three-star RPS target and whether a grade-separated junction should replace the planned traffic-light solution. The minister confirmed the target and that Beerzerveld has three stars, said traffic flow is not a bottleneck, and stated the traffic-light redesign remains the agreed solution while the regional partners may propose alternatives and preparatory work continues.

In administrative consultation with the region it was agreed that for safety at the Mariënberg (Beerzerweg) junction, redesign with traffic-light installations is the best solution within the existing constraints of time and money.

In het bestuurlijk overleg met de regio is overeengekomen dat voor de veiligheid op de aansluiting bij de Mariënberg (Beerzerweg) de herinrichting met verkeersregelinstallaties de beste oplossing is binnen de bestaande randvoorwaarden, tijd en geld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de kwaliteit van het middelbaar agrarisch onderwijs in Noord Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary and Education Minister about complaints from farmers and parents over the quality of agricultural vocational education in Northern Netherlands, including basic skills and contact hours. The government answered that quality is the institution's primary responsibility, pointed to improvement plans and inspection follow-up at AOC Terra, and declined further inspection research.
Determining the educational content and methodology of vocational training is the primary responsibility of the institution.
De bepaling van de onderwijsinhoud en -methodiek van beroepsopleidingen is de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van de instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de grote treinstoring rond Utrecht op 2 februari 2015

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the large train outage around Utrecht on 2 February 2015, including outdated systems, the lack of backup and rerouting options, and the handling of the failure. The state secretary answered that ProRail is investigating the causes, that systems are redundant and partly upgraded, and that rerouting to the new control centre takes about four hours, while committing to close monitoring of progress.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment will closely monitor progress.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu zal strak op de voortgang sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de NS-dienstregeling Amsterdam-Haarlem-Zandvoort

An MP asked the state secretary about a 10-minute wait at Haarlem that slows the Amsterdam-Zandvoort sprinter, whether freight paths cause it, and whether priority rules should allow ProRail to apply passenger priority without declaring the infrastructure overloaded. The government attributes the delay to a late NS timetable change, says the rules already allow ProRail to resolve conflicts, sees no need to amend the decree, and promises to press ProRail and NS to look for improvements before summer.
I have asked ProRail and NS, partly in response to this set of questions, to take another thorough look at the situation.
Ik heb ProRail en NS mede naar aanleiding van deze set vragen verzocht nog eens grondig naar de situatie te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over financiering van de nieuwe tropenopleiding

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Health why the Internationale Gezondheidszorg en Tropische Geneeskunde (IGT) training, recognised by the KNMG, lacks structural public funding and is paid for by students, and whether the Minister would meet the training institute to find a structural solution. Minister Schippers answered that the training is privately funded by design, that it is not eligible for public funding as it prepares doctors for care abroad, and that she sees no reason to fund it, while noting that development-aid funds are not used for training in the Netherlands.
As I indicated at the infectious disease control committee debate of 26 November 2014, I see no reason to fund the training.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven bij het AO infectieziektebestrijding van 26 november 2014 zie ik geen aanleiding om de opleiding te financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Bruins Slot en Van der Staaij over de toekomst van het landelijk centrum De Riethorst voor geestelijke gezondheidszorg voor doven en slechthorenden

MPs asked the minister when she would talk with De Riethorst, why doven-ggz is funded differently from general institutions, whether max-max tariffs suffice, and whether an emergency fix like GGMD's can keep the unit open. The minister replied that insurers bear responsibility for access, that she will talk with insurers and commission an NZa study on funding, and that she sees no reason for extra transition measures.
It is not for me to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij om daarin te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de uitkomsten van het belevingsonderzoek euthanasie

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Health about a KNMG survey showing doctors feel emotional strain and pressure from patients to perform euthanasia, and whether patients wrongly see euthanasia as a right. Minister Schippers said the survey is clear, that euthanasia is not a right and doctors must be free of undue pressure, and pointed to existing information materials, promising only consultation with the KNMG.
The law provides that doctors are not obliged to grant a request and that the doctor must be convinced the request meets the statutory due-care criteria.
De wet stelt dat artsen niet verplicht zijn om een verzoek in te willigen en dat de arts overtuigd moet zijn dat het verzoek voldoet aan de wettelijke zorgvuldigheidscriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik- Faber over het bericht dat therapie de kans op zelfdoding verkleint

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Health about a Danish study showing outpatient talking therapy after suicide attempts reduces repetition, and whether the Netherlands should study this model. The minister said Dutch practice already offers similar therapy under existing guidelines and the national suicide prevention agenda, and sent the Lancet article.
I hereby send you the relevant article from The Lancet of 24 November 2014 explaining the findings of this study.
Ik doe u hierbij het betrokken artikel uit the Lancet van 24 november 2014 toekomen waarin de uitkomsten van deze studie toegelicht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het aanbieden van de NIPT in België

Dik-Faber asks the health minister about women travelling to Belgium for the NIPT prenatal test, referral practices by doctors, counselling adequacy, and a remark by a Grendia director about costs of Down syndrome. The minister says the 1.3% share is not alarming, that no official figures exist on doctors' referrals or terminations after Belgian positive results, that the Inspectorate for Health Care oversees compliance with the Wbo, and that she rejects the cost framing.
On this I am in contact with the Inspectorate for Health Care, which has the statutory task of supervising compliance with the Wbo.
Hierover heb ik contact met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg die de wettelijke taak heeft toe te zien op de naleving van de Wbo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de toekomst van het landelijk centrum De Riethorst voor geestelijke gezondheidszorg voor doven en slechthorenden

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the DBC tariffs for 2015 are sufficient to keep the specialist mental health centre De Riethorst for deaf and hard-of-hearing patients open, and whether a solution can be found before the NZa cost study concludes. The Minister says the tariffs and max-max rates leave room, that the provider and insurers have responsibility, that she will talk to insurers and ask the NZa to examine funding, and that she will inform the House after early-2015 talks.
After the talks with the health insurers in early 2015, I will inform the House of the outcomes and the further course.
Na het gesprek met de zorgverzekeraars begin 2015 zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten en over het verdere traject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de dreigende sluiting van de beademingsafdeling in Zuidhorn

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Health Minister and State Secretary whether the threatened closure of the chronic ventilation ward in Zuidhorn, which serves patients with conditions such as muscle diseases, is acceptable given unclear financing, and how structural funding will be secured. The State Secretary denied any closure is threatened, said the NZa and the care office are seeking adequate financing with Zuidhorn, and declined to convene the parties for now.
There is no question of an imminent closure.
Er is geen sprake van een dreigende sluiting.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over wildparkerende vrachtwagenchauffeurs langs de A20 en het verdwijnen van parkeercapaciteit door de realisatie van de Blankenburgtunnel en de doortrekking van de A15

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about truck drivers overnighting informally along the A20 near Rotterdam, the lack of paid or free parking, and parking capacity lost to the Blankenburg tunnel and A15 extension. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is working with the region on a parking and enforcement plan, rejected responsibility for providing free long-stay parking on the main road network, and said she would expand short-rest capacity and develop private truck parkings.
I do not intend to reduce the current parking capacity.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de huidige parkeercapaciteit te reduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de toekomst van het Dokkumer ziekenhuis De Sionsberg

The MP asks about the future of Dokkum hospital De Sionsberg, its financial collapse, and hospital care access in Noordoost Friesland. The minister says the hospital's finances have long been weak, a bankruptcy filing is underway, care continuity is not currently at risk, insurers and the NZa are responsible, and she sees no role for herself unless emergency access exceeds 45 minutes.
I see no role for myself, unless the accessibility of emergency care and acute obstetrics within 45 minutes is at stake.
Ik zie geen rol voor mijzelf weggelegd, tenzij de bereikbaarheid van de spoedeisende hulp en de acute verloskunde binnen 45 minuten in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de vuurwerkopslag in Heerde

Three MPs (Oskam, Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij) asked whether a fireworks storage facility in Heerde close to a care centre and supermarket is safe, and whether other veiligheidsregio's should inventory similar risks. The state secretary replied that the Vuurwerkbesluit's construction requirements, sprinklers and fire resistance keep the effects of any calamity within the storage facility, declined to order a nationwide inventory, and described the uniform incident-response approach.
As I indicated in the answer to question 1, the consequences of any calamity are limited to the storage facility itself.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 1 heb aangegeven, beperken de gevolgen van een eventuele calamiteit zich tot de bewaarplaats zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de toezegging uit het debat over de Wet langdurige zorg, waarin hij aangeeft dat het aantal dagdelen KDC geen norm kan zijn voor een Wlz indicatie

The MP asks whether CIZ bodies know that the number of KDC day-part treatment hours cannot be the norm for a Wlz indication, and how children below eight hours are treated. The State Secretary confirms the position, says children with lower hours but Wlz-level care needs are covered by additional transitional rules, and confirms that permanent supervision or 24-hour nearby care suffices for new clients.
Children who currently have fewer than 8 day-parts of group treatment but may be eligible for the Wlz given their care needs will still be included under the additional transitional arrangement.
Kinderen die nu minder dan 8 dagdelen behandeling-groep hebben maar gezien hun zorgzwaarte toegang kunnen hebben tot de Wlz worden alsnog meegenomen onder het extra overgangsrecht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Arib over één neutrale, landelijke niet-reanimeerpenning

MPs Dik-Faber and Arib asked whether a single neutral national do-not-resuscitate pendant should replace privately distributed ones, and whether registration and distribution should be arranged publicly. The minister supports a neutral, uniform pendant, will examine how VWS can facilitate one, and agrees to consult patient organisations on information.
I will explore the possibilities of issuing, or having issued, a uniform, neutral NR pendant not linked to any particular foundation or association.
Ik zal de mogelijkheden onderzoeken een uniforme, neutrale (niet aan een bepaalde stichting of vereniging gelieerde) NR-penning uit te (laten) geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over het bestraffen van chauffeurs met te hoog beladen vrachtwagens

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked why drivers of overheight trucks at the Velsertunnel are rarely fined, how often fines are issued nationally, and whether road inspectors could be given enforcement powers. The minister explained the notification procedure, reported low fine counts due to police attendance and the planned 2016 renovation, and said talks on a Rotterdam inspector pilot are ongoing.
I refer further to my answer to question 2 for an explanation of the number of height signals compared to the number of fines.
Ik verwijs verder naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 voor een toelichting op het aantal hoogtesignaleringen ten opzichte van het aantal boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zorgen om het voortbestaan van GGz voor mensen met gehoorproblemen

An MP asks the Health Minister about worries that specialist mental health care for deaf and hard-of-hearing people may not survive, and whether a transitional funding arrangement will be continued. The minister acknowledges past contributions, says care providers and insurers have responsibility, and intends to continue the transitional arrangement for 2015 while exploring a sustainable funding solution.
I will explore with the NZa, the Zorginstituut and the VNG what a sustainable solution for the funding is.
Ik zal met de NZa, het Zorginstituut en de VNG verkennen wat een toekomstbestendige oplossing voor de bekostiging is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de tarieven van NS op korte afstanden

An MP asked the state secretary about NS fare rules on short-distance trips, including the minimum fare, the double boarding fare on transfers, and the price gap between outward and return journeys. The state secretary defended the minimum fare as covering costs, said changing the fare system would have financial trade-offs for travellers, and committed only to raising the single-boarding-fare idea within the national public transport consultative body.
I think it is a good idea that the rail operators look at this together.
Ik vind het een goed idee dat de spoorvervoerders hier samen naar kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over snelheidsbeperkingen in de Drontermeertunnel en de spoortunnel Best

An MP asked the State Secretary about speed restrictions in the Drontermeer tunnel and the Best rail tunnel, including whether the design was flawed and whether damages should be recovered from the builder. The State Secretary answered that there is no design defect, the tunnel meets applicable norms, the issue arises from interaction between infrastructure and rolling stock, and no immediate action is needed beyond asking the sector to coordinate on comfort norms for future tunnels.
Although the observed nuisance gives no cause for immediate action, it is for me a reason to ask the rail sector to coordinate among themselves when building new tunnels.
Hoewel de geconstateerde hinder geen aanleiding geeft tot onmiddellijke actie, is het voor mij wel aanleiding om de spoorsector te verzoeken om bij aanleg van nieuwe tunnels onderling af te stemmen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de berichten ‘Hulpdiensten mochten niet in vluchtgebouw’ en ‘Van der Laan wil opvang voor vluchtelingen’

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked about reports that ambulance staff were not allowed into an Amsterdam asylum shelter due to asbestos, causing delay in treating an injured asylum seeker, and about the mayor's call for a national bed-bath-bread scheme. The minister answered that protocol requires a safety clearance before entering asbestos-risk buildings, that the delay was 5-7 minutes for the patient and 10-15 minutes wait in the garage case, and referred the bed-bath-bread question to a separate answer.
The ambulance team was told when dispatched that rescue workers could not simply enter the building because of the presence of asbestos.
Het ambulanceteam kreeg bij de ritopdracht de vermelding mee dat hulpverleners het gebouw niet zomaar mochten betreden vanwege de aanwezigheid van asbest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Forse kritiek van gemeenten en provincie op NAM’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about criticism from municipalities and the province of the NAM's handling of the Groningen gas extraction accord, including the pace of reinforcing homes, the budget for new construction, consultation with the regional dialogue table, and individual information. The minister answered that the pace will be scaled up with a plan due January 2015, the budget is currently sufficient, NAM will report progress to the dialogue table, and information channels are being improved.
Thereupon I myself went to Groningen to discuss this with the Dialogue Table.
Daarop ben ik zelf naar Groningen gegaan om dit met de Dialoogtafel te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over belemmeringen voor het gebruik van alternatieven voor metam-natrium

An MP asked the state secretary about obstacles to alternatives to metam-sodium, the soil disinfectant, and about hectares treated, nematode control, grassland ploughing rules and funding. The state secretary reported consultations with the sector, pointed to Common Agricultural Policy catch-crop rules, a 150,000 euro funding commitment for 2014, and a promise to seek advice on extending the grassland ploughing deadline by 1 December, while referring back to earlier answers on several questions.
I am willing to examine whether there are possibilities within manure policy to extend the deadline for ploughing grassland.
Ik ben bereid na te gaan of er in het kader van het mestbeleid mogelijkheden zijn de termijn voor het scheuren van grasland te verlengen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de IKON-uitzending de Wachtkamer ‘Vechten voor hoop’

MPs Keijzer, Dik-Faber and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a broadcast on coma patients and whether care depends on age and insurer. The minister said no current figures exist for all coma patients, that care follows scientific insight, that the Zorginstituut judged early intensive neurorehabilitation not insured for adults in 2009, and that the institute will re-examine it and may talk to the Zorgen na Coma foundation.
No figures are available on the total number of coma patients, only on the group eligible for early intensive neurorehabilitation.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het totale aantal comapatiënten, wel over de groep patiënten die in aanmerking komt voor vroege intensieve neurorevalidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het grote aantal abortussen waarbij sprake is van financiële redenen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the health minister about the large share of abortions with financial motives and whether the government would act on it. The minister answered that no extra measures are planned, that the woman decides on the emergency, and that a ZonMW study on abortion motives is expected in mid-2016.
It is not mandatory for the treating physician to register and report the nature of the emergency situation.
Het is niet verplicht voor de behandelend arts om de aard van de noodsituatie te registreren en te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over mogelijke opslag van kernafval in zoutkoepels in Friesland en Groningen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Economic Affairs Minister about risks of storing nuclear waste in salt caverns in Friesland and Groningen, and whether such sites are excluded. The minister replied that site-specific research and site selection are not on the agenda for decades, that geological disposal is the preferred option, and that the OPERA research programme finishes in 2016.
As I indicated earlier, site-specific research or a site selection in the research and policy is not on the agenda for the coming decades.
Zoals ik eerder al aangaf is locatiespecifiek onderzoek of een locatiekeuze in het onderzoek en het beleid de komende tientallen jaren niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verband tussen maagzuurremmers en voedselinfecties

An MP asks the health minister about the RIVM finding linking proton-pump inhibitors to Campylobacter infections and about prescribing, information and possible further research. The minister answers that the CBG still judges the benefit-risk balance positively, that prescribers and patients bear responsibility, and that no new research or public campaign is planned.
How many people have died from infections as a result of using acid-suppressing drugs is not known to me.
Hoeveel mensen zijn overleden aan de infecties als gevolg van het gebruik van maagzuurremmers is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat recyclebaar afval wordt verbrand als gevolg van extra overheidssteun voor biomassa

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked whether SDE+ subsidies for bioenergy divert recyclable biomass and waste (A-wood, pallets, pruning wood, potato peels) away from material reuse, contrary to the circular economy goal. The minister replied that bioenergy is needed for renewable targets and cascading will be monitored, that the SDE+ uses market prices for biomass, and that the Landelijk Afvalbeheerplan and VANG programme will be evaluated or explored without committing to binding restrictions.
In my letter to the House of Representatives on cascading I indicated that a condition of government steering is that no structural displacement effects arise that obstruct high-value applications.

In mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer over cascadering heb ik aangegeven dat een randvoorwaarde bij overheidssturing is dat er geen structurele verdringingseffecten ontstaan die hoogwaardige toepassingen belemmeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de aanpak van drugsafval

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked whether a fund could be created, financed from Plukze proceeds, to compensate landowners for clearing dumped drug waste, and what clean-up costs were in 2012 and 2013. The minister answered that no legal barriers exist but the cabinet is reluctant to create budget funds, that costs should fall on the perpetrator, and estimated Noord-Brabant clean-up costs at about 1.5 million euro in 2012 and 3 million euro in 2013.
The costs that landowners face for clearing dumped drug waste should primarily be borne by the perpetrator.
De kosten waarmee grondeigenaren worden geconfronteerd om gedumpt drugsafval op te ruimen dienen primair ten laste te komen van de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over statiegeld op bierflesjes

An MP asked the state secretary whether beer bottles without deposit (statiegeld) undermine the deposit system, whether that increases litter, and whether producers should compensate landowners and be forced to introduce deposits on small bottles. The state secretary answered that deposit is a producer's free choice, that reusable bottles still carry deposit, that the effect on litter is still being studied, and that she will not mandate deposit on beer bottles in the 2014 decree.
As previously stated in parliamentary debates, I steer on goals and means such as deposit are subordinate to them.
Zoals eerder in Kamerdebatten aangegeven, stuur ik op doelen en zijn de middelen, zoals statiegeld, daaraan ondergeschikt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zorgverzekeraars die hun verzekerden geen inzicht willen (helpen) bieden in de opbouw van hun zorgnota en de onduidelijkheid bij verzekerden over het juiste loket voor klacht

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether insured persons can check their care bills, since insurers and providers often withhold the underlying treatment records and diagnosis, and where to complain. The minister replied that a more detailed care bill from 1 June 2014 is on schedule, that insurers are the first point of contact with the SKGZ as fallback, and that agreements on complaint handling are being finalised.
Until 1 June 2014, when the more transparent care bill takes effect, insurers and providers are formally not obliged to supply patients with information at the level of care activities delivered.

Verzekeraars en zorgaanbieders zijn tot 1 juni 2014, wanneer de beter inzichtelijke zorgnota in werking treedt, formeel niet verplicht informatie uit te leveren aan patiënten op het niveau van geleverde zorgactiviteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het stilleggen van de dienstregeling op het spoor rond Alkmaar, Haarlem en Den Haag

An MP asked why train services around Alkmaar, Haarlem and The Hague were fully halted in May 2014 due to GSM-R and telephone exchange failures, whether the back-up systems worked, and how passengers were informed. The State Secretary answered that the GSM-R network itself functioned, the failures were in local exchanges, the back-up partly failed, and he will require ProRail and NS to improve reliability, disaster tolerance by end-2015, and passenger information in new concessions.
I believe passenger information and service must improve.
Ik vind dat de informatievoorziening en dienstverlening aan de reiziger beter moet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber en Ouwehand over schaliegasboringen Argentinië

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie and PvdD asked the government about Shell's shale gas test drilling in Argentina, including proximity to a protected area, environmental information access, consultation and compensation for local farmers, and OECD guideline compliance. The minister answered that the drilling lies outside the current protected area, that Shell claims legal compliance and denies harm to livestock, that the embassy's 2013 site visit was routine economic diplomacy, and that OECD guideline questions fall to the National Contact Point.
Whether and to what extent the Environment and Information Disclosure chapters apply to Shell's activities in Vaca Muerta, I cannot assess.
Of en in hoeverre de hoofdstukken Milieu en Informatieverstrekking van toepassing zijn op de activiteiten van Shell in Vaca Muerta, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat de NVWA steeds meer strafrechtelijke onderzoeken naar voedselfraude verricht en afrondt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the rising number of criminal food fraud investigations by the NVWA and related questions on capacity, outcomes, and reporting. The government answered that the increase stems from the NVWA merger, extra capacity and wider attention after the horsemeat scandal, reported convictions and sentences, and committed to continued work on public reporting channels.
The Functional Prosecution Service was able to trace the 56 cases to 146 suspects registered with it, of whom 52 were convicted at first instance.

Het Functioneel Parket heeft de 56 zaken kunnen herleiden naar 146 bij het Functioneel Parket geregistreerde verdachten, waarvan er in eerste aanleg ten aanzien van 52 verdachten een veroordeling is uitgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat het eten van voedselbanken vaak onvoldoende is

An MP asked the State Secretaries about a report that food bank recipients often lack enough healthy food, the food insecurity comparison with the UK, and how to get surplus food from companies to food banks. The government answered that municipalities hold primary responsibility for poverty policy, that cooperation with the food alliance is progressing, and that a tax-clarification meeting is planned.

As indicated in the answers to the questions of MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten of 25 March 2014, it is important that people who rely on food banks are helped and that the underlying problems are addressed.

Zoals in de antwoorden op de vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten (ChristenUnie) van 25 maart 2014 (TK Aanhangsel van de Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2013–2014, nr. 1852 ) is aangegeven, is het van belang dat mensen die een beroep doen op de voedselbank geholpen worden en dat de achterliggende problematiek wordt aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat het eerste schip met teerzandolie volgende week in Europa aankomt

MPs Van Veldhoven and Dik-Faber asked whether the first shipment of Canadian tar sands oil reaching Europe would reach the Netherlands, whether consumers could choose non-tar-sands fuel, and how this fits EU climate policy. The minister replied that the government has no insight into individual oil transactions or origin data, that mandatory origin labelling is not required internationally, and that the Fuel Quality Directive rules on crude sourcing will be discussed once the Commission proposal is out.
The Dutch government also does not hold data on the place of purchase and origin of oil.
De Nederlandse overheid beschikt ook niet over gegevens over plaats van aankoop en herkomst van olie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over het onderzoek van KWR Watercycle Research Institute naar drugsresten in rioolwater

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the government about a KWR study measuring drug residues in sewage, including whether it reliably reflects Dutch drug use and whether more monitoring is needed. The State Secretary answered that sewage measurements give only a limited indication, cannot distinguish dumped from consumed drugs for most substances, and that no new study will be commissioned.
Given the very limited added value of this type of research for prevention and enforcement, I see no reason to commission research into drug residues in sewage water.
Gezien de heel beperkte toegevoegde waarde van dit type onderzoek voor voorlichting, preventie en bestrijding zie ik geen reden opdracht te geven tot onderzoek naar drugsresten in rioolwater.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Dik Faber over fraude met het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb)

MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service's decision not to investigate suspected PGB fraud in Houten (about 1.6 million euros not spent on care), and reportedly about 200 unprocessed fraud complaints at the national office, was acceptable given the stated lack of priority and capacity. The government replied that fraud is a high priority, that the prosecution service selects cases by modus operandi and motivated its decision, that it could not confirm the 200 figure and referred to earlier letters, and that a package of measures to tighten PGB access is being implemented.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it cannot confirm the stated number of 200 PGB fraud complaints.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld het genoemde aantal van 200 aangiften van pgb-fraude niet te kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de openbaarheid van punctualiteitsgegevens van ProRail

An MP asked the State Secretary why RTL could not obtain detailed punctuality data for trains, and whether ProRail should publish route-level and real-time data as open data. The State Secretary answered that the detailed data belong to the operators and are confidential under access agreements, that ProRail is not subject to the Dutch Open Government Act, and that new concessions will require more transparency on punctuality by line and by time and location.
ProRail does not fall under the Open Government Act (Wet openbaarheid van bestuur), as recently confirmed by the Council of State.
ProRail valt, zoals recentelijk is bevestigd door de Raad van State, niet onder de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over vervuilende tweetakt scooters

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about a Swiss study finding two-stroke scooters a major air polluter, and whether bans, stricter EU emission norms, local low-emission zones and stronger inspection could be pursued. The state secretary rejected a short-term sales ban as incompatible with EU type-approval rules, pointed to 2017 EU emission limits and an evaluation, said local restrictions are problematic, and promised a letter on enforcement.
A sales ban in the Netherlands in the short term is not on the agenda.
Een verkoopverbod in Nederland op korte termijn is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over sturend gedrag van zorgverzekeraars

An MP asks the health minister how she views the NZa report on insurers steering the insured through acceptance practices, whether additional legal tightening is needed, whether the NZa should investigate supplementary insurance as a steering tool, and whether a uniform enrolment method can be enforced. The minister responds that she backs the NZa actions, will ask the NZa to address indirect risk selection, sees no need yet for legal tightening, and will await the NZa's findings on enrolment before considering further steps.
As I wrote in my letter to your House, I support the actions the NZa is taking following the findings in the report.
Zoals ik in mijn brief aan uw Kamer heb geschreven, sta ik achter de acties die de NZa inzet naar aanleiding van de bevindingen in het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het gebruiken van foetussen als energiebron

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the Minister whether Dutch rules allow using foetuses from miscarriages and abortions as an energy source, and how compliance and parental information are ensured. The Minister answered that the Wlb and Wfw do not permit energy use, that the IGZ found no compliance problems, and that hospitals and clinics follow NVOG guidance, with individual wishes considered.
For the avoidance of doubt, I note that using a foetus explicitly for generating energy cannot be considered one of the permitted purposes.
Voor alle duidelijkheid merk ik op dat gebruik van een foetus dat expliciet is gericht op het opwekken van energie, dan niet geacht kan worden onder die toegestane doeleinden te vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het belastingregime voor lokale energiecoöperaties

An MP asked whether the tax regime for local energy cooperatives creates VAT, energy-tax and network-cost obstacles for member participation and business cases. The minister answered that the reduced energy-tax rate is a stimulus, that VAT liability depends on facts and circumstances, and that the 10-year investment guarantee will not be extended.
I am not willing to extend the 10-year period.
Ik ben niet bereid de periode van 10 jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over het bericht dat de Voedselbank EU-geld voor armoedebestrijding opeist

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked why the government is using EU food-aid fund FEAD for 2014-2020, whether consultation occurred, and how food surpluses could better reach food banks. The state secretary answered that the funds are reallocated from ESF/EFRO rather than additional, that the fund targets social inclusion, and that gemeenten and the AVV-Voedselbanken cooperation are being engaged, with promises of further talks and support.
It is correct that for the 2014-2020 programme period the Netherlands will deploy 3.5 million euros for the EU Fund for European Aid to the Most Deprived (FEAD).
Het klopt dat Nederland voor de programmaperiode 2014–2020 3,5 miljoen euro zal inzetten voor het Fonds voor Europese hulp aan de meestbehoeftigen (FEAD).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van Tongeren over het opnemen van de Structuurvisie Schaliegas in de Structuurvisie Ondergrond

Two MPs asked whether the Structuurvisie Schaliegas will be integrated into the Structuurvisie Ondergrond, whether test drilling should wait for that integrated assessment, whether the role of shale gas and need-and-necessity questions will be addressed before legal changes, and whether drinking water and geothermal energy will get priority over shale gas drilling. The minister answered that the shale gas vision will be fully integrated, that mining companies agreed to undertake no activities until it is adopted, that CE Delft is studying costs and benefits with the planMER, and that functions get no absolute priority, with scarcity-linked functions possibly favoured.
As you know, I have agreed with the mining companies that no activities will be undertaken until the Structuurvisie Schaliegas has been adopted.
Zoals u weet heb ik met de mijnbouwondernemingen afgesproken dat totdat de Structuurvisie Schaliegas is vastgesteld er geen activiteiten worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de voortgang van het convenant ‘Asbestdak eraf, zonnepanelen erop’

An MP asked the state secretary about progress on the covenant 'Asbestos roof off, solar panels on' for agricultural buildings, including how much asbestos has been removed, whether the 2024 full-removal target will be met, and the low uptake of the subsidy. The government answered that about 430,000 m2 has been subsidised (around 1 million m2 including pipeline), that current pace is too slow but it expects to reach the target with the planned 2024 ban and extra measures, and that it is consulting with the provinces on adjusting the covenant.
The current pace of roughly 4 million m2 of asbestos roof removed per year is too low to reach the goal of full removal.
Het huidige tempo van ongeveer 4 miljoen m 2 gesaneerd asbestdak per jaar ligt te laag om het doel van volledige sanering te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de realisatie van Randstadspoor Utrecht-Harderwijk en de ontwikkeling van de spoorcorridor Utrecht-Zwolle

An ChristenUnie MP asks the state secretary about the stalled Randstadspoor Utrecht-Harderwijk project, the stopped planning study, the cause of longer stopping times, and the lack of an integrated plan for the Utrecht-Zwolle corridor. The state secretary answers that the planning study was converted into a broader MIRT study due for results in 2015, explains the stopping-time and norm issues, and says no rail-siding reservation at Bilthoven was needed.

The planning study was, in consultation between the parties involved, converted into a MIRT study that will be more in-depth and integral in character. I will inform you once further decisions are taken based on the outcomes in 2015.

De planstudie is in overleg tussen de betrokken partijen omgezet in een MIRT-onderzoek dat diepgaander en integraler van karakter zal zijn. Ik informeer u hierover zodra op basis van de uitkomsten in 2015 nadere besluiten worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de reductie van zwerfafval en statiegeld op kleine plastic flessen en bierflesjes

An MP asked the State Secretary about the rise in small plastic bottles, the reduction targets for litter of bottles and cans, the cost of litter clean-up, and deposit (statiegeld) on small plastic bottles and beer bottles after the abolition of the product boards. The government answered that no verifiable figures on bottle numbers or litter quantities exist, that current monitoring measures cleanliness scores rather than item counts, and that deposit on beer bottles will continue through private sector arrangements.
There are no verifiable figures known to us on the development of the number of plastic bottles in the Netherlands.
Er zijn bij ons geen controleerbare cijfers bekend omtrent de ontwikkeling van de hoeveelheid plastic flesjes in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Albert de Vries over de extra sluiskolk bij Eefde

MPs Dik-Faber and Albert de Vries asked the minister why the Midden-Noord variant for the second lock at Eefde was not chosen despite the Commission for EIA's advice, and about costs, safety, timing and the capacity outlook. The minister defended the Noord location on cost (about 20 million euro cheaper, with regional support), said the planning cannot be accelerated, and stated that no revision of the preference decision is warranted.
All things considered, I see no reason in this finding of the commission to revise my preference decision.
Alles overziend, zie ik in deze constatering van de commissie geen aanleiding mijn Voorkeursbeslissing te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat de WHO heeft geadviseerd de dagelijkse hoeveelheid suiker te halveren

MP Dik-Faber asks the health minister about a proposed WHO halving of the recommended daily sugar intake and how the Dutch prevention programme, the industry agreement, labelling and EU action should respond. The minister answers that current Dutch guidance sets no sugar maximum, that she will not anticipate the WHO draft, will ask the Gezondheidsraad to consider the final WHO guideline if timely, sees no reason yet to tighten the industry agreement, and will raise sugar reduction at EU level with a progress report by year end.
I do not want to anticipate a draft WHO guideline for which consultation and expert peer review are still ongoing.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op een conceptrichtlijn van de WHO waarvoor momenteel nog een consultatie en peer-review door experts plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik Faber over het terugroepen van vlees bij Van Hattem

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether the Van Hattem meat recall could have been partial, whether the NVWA ignored a court opening, and how the sector's losses and traceability oversight stand. The government denied any court offer for partial recall, said the burden of proof for traceability lies with the business, and gave no estimate of economic damage.

At present it cannot yet be said with certainty how many of the companies involved in the recall can demonstrate the legally required safety and traceability of their products, and how much meat must be removed from the market.

Op dit moment is nog niet met zekerheid te zeggen hoeveel van de bij de terugroepactie betrokken bedrijven de wettelijk vereiste veiligheid en traceerbaarheid van hun producten kunnen aantonen en hoeveel vlees van de markt moet worden gehaald.

Vragen van de leden Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) en Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) aan de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over boringen naar onconventioneel gas in Oekraïne (ingezonden 7 maart 2014)

Two MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Shell's unconventional gas drilling in Ukraine, including open waste pits, a Ukrainian contract partner with alleged corruption links, and OECD guideline compliance. The minister answered that the practices comply with Ukrainian and Dutch rules, that Shell's due diligence found no reason to suspect corruption, and that she asked Shell to monitor the company's developments.
I have asked Shell to closely monitor developments surrounding this company.
Ik heb Shell gevraagd de ontwikkelingen rondom dit bedrijf nauwlettend te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat hoogbejaarden zorginstelling De Riederborgh in Ridderkerk moeten verlaten

An MP asked whether 11 very elderly residents of De Riederborgh in Ridderkerk, with light care-package indications, had to leave the facility because the care office CZ would no longer reimburse them, and where they would go. The State Secretary replied that a misunderstanding between provider and care office had been resolved, residents can stay, and the care office respects residents' rights in line with national policy.
It has now become clear that residents with a light care package can remain in De Riederborgh and that the care office respects their rights.

Inmiddels is duidelijk geworden dat de bewoners met een licht zorgzwaartepakket in De Riederborgh kunnen blijven wonen en dat de rechten van de bewoners met een licht ZZP door het zorgkantoor worden gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren, en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het nieuwe handelsverdrag met de VS het Nederlandse schaliegasverbod bedreigt

MPs Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren and Agnes Mulder asked whether the proposed EU-US trade deal (TTIP) and its investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) clause could undermine a Dutch shale gas fracking ban and expose the state to damages claims, and whether Chevron's support for ISDS poses a risk.
