Minister Ploumen answered that ISDS would contain an exception for indirect expropriation covering general non-discriminatory public-interest measures, that parliament remains free to ban fracking, that a study on ISDS effects including on environmental regulation is underway with results due before summer, and that she cannot guarantee Chevron will not use ISDS but considers a successful claim unrealistic.
Yes, even after the conclusion of TTIP, the Dutch parliament can still take a decision on a ban on shale gas extraction.
Ja, ook na het sluiten van TTIP, kan het Nederlandse parlement nog steeds een besluit nemen over een verbod op schaliegaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de carnavalscampagne drinken als een prins

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary for Health about Bavaria's carnival campaign showing the outdated age-16 limit and the alcohol industry's refusal to join the NIX18 campaign. The State Secretary acknowledged the error, said Bavaria regrets it and has corrected online material and posters, and defended the self-regulatory approach while reporting early positive campaign results.
I regret this conduct by Bavaria because it may have created confusion about the minimum age for selling and serving alcohol to young people.
Ik betreur deze handelswijze van Bavaria omdat hierdoor onduidelijkheid heeft kunnen ontstaan over de minimumleeftijd voor het verkopen en schenken van alcohol aan jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Otwin Van Dijk over moeizame samenwerking tussen 26 Utrechtse gemeenten en Achmea

MPs Dik-Faber and Van Dijk asked whether cooperation between 26 Utrecht municipalities and insurer Achmea is difficult and what the government will do to improve it. The State Secretary acknowledged mixed experiences, described Achmea's cooperation strategy and regional talks, and committed to actively supporting the agreements between municipalities and insurers, including in Utrecht.
I will actively support the establishment of these agreements in the regions, including in the Utrecht region where necessary, and closely monitor progress together with ZN and the VNG.
Ik zal de totstandkoming van deze afspraken in de regio, waaronder in de regio Utrecht, waar dat nodig is actief ondersteunen en de voortgang samen met ZN en de VNG nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dik-Faber over opwaardering van de N57 en N59

MPs Bisschop and Dik-Faber asked the minister about road safety and accessibility on the N57 and N59 in Zeeland and Zuid-Holland, including whether fatality rates are five times the national average and what funding the Rijk could provide. The minister denied the fatality claim, stated that €18 million is reserved for bringing these roads to three-star EuroRAP level, and said no extra funding or accessibility problem exists, while noting the projects already count as MIRT projects.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over mobiliteitskaarten en OV-chipkaart 2.0

An MP asked the state secretary about business transit cards (such as Mobility Mixx) failing on regional rail lines, the delayed availability of pay-on-account travel, NS's refusal to let rivals put NS subscriptions on their cards, exclusion of card issuers from NOVB and TLS governance, and whether roaming should be included in the OV-chip law. The secretary answered that the problems stem from private contracts and vendor technology, that responsibility is for the parties to settle, that a TLS platform for pay-on-account is due at the earliest in Q4 2014, and that the Wet personenvervoer 2000 will be amended to increase market-access supervision, while declining to commit to roaming in the law.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de verduurzaming van regionale OV-aanbestedingen

An MP asks whether the government will follow up on reports that CO2-reduction sustainability criteria are ignored in regional public transport tenders and will engage regional authorities on enforcement and measurable CO2 targets. The State Secretary answers that responsibility lies primarily with regional authorities, points to existing criteria and a Green Deal on zero-emission buses, and promises to raise the criteria again at the Bestuurlijk Koepeloverleg.
I note that responsibility for regional concessions lies primarily with the decentralised authorities.
Ik merk op dat de verantwoordelijkheid voor de regionale concessies primair ligt bij de decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de beoordeling van euthanasie door de Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthanasie

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether euthanasia review committees should follow professional guidelines, whether there should be an independent dispute body for KNMG's complaints, and whether a meeting with KNMG had taken place. Minister Schippers answered that committees are not bound by guidelines but use them as a reference, that transparency will be improved via the website, that a separate dispute body is not desirable, and that a meeting with KNMG has been arranged.
We do not consider it desirable that in other situations objection to an Rte judgement be possible.
Wij achten het niet wenselijk dat in andere situaties bezwaar tegen een Rte-oordeel openstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de voortgang van de capaciteitsverhoging op de Valleilijn

An MP asked the State Secretary about the delays and financing of capacity and robustness measures on the Valleilijn rail line, including the Barneveld Zuid station, the Hoevelaken station, the overbelasting declaration, and extending a quarter-hourly service to Ede-Wageningen or Arnhem. The State Secretary answered that Barneveld Zuid does not depend on the capacity measures, that the four robustness measures are expected by end 2016, and that extending the line to Arnhem is not part of ProRail's study and will not receive additional funding for now.
I regret, like the questioner, that the realisation of the robustness-enhancing measures is taking longer than foreseen in 2009.
Ik betreur net als de vragensteller dat de realisatie van de robuustheid verhogende maatregelen langer op zich laat wachten dan in 2009 werd voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind, Van der Steur en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van xtc onder jongeren

MPs asked the government about the high ecstasy use among young party-goers, rising XTC-related hospital and first-aid incidents, how easily XTC is obtained, controls at events, and the role of parents and municipalities in prevention. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to the new Trimbos VGHE prevention programme, noted increased incidents and drug strength, and said event organisers bear primary responsibility for security while enforcement focuses on production and trade.
For this reason I have instructed the Trimbos Institute to start the Safe and Healthy Hospitality and Events (VGHE) programme in 2014, as announced in the National Prevention Programme (NPP).

Mede om die reden heb ik het Trimbos-instituut opdracht gegeven om, zoals ook is aangekondigd in het Nationaal Programma Preventie (NPP), in 2014 te starten met het programma Veilige en Gezonde Horeca en Evenementen (VGHE).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gaswinning in Groningen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Groningen gas production of about 54-55 billion m3 in 2013, above the 42.5 bcm per year ceiling, and the advice to reduce output because of stronger earthquakes, are acceptable, and why export figures are secret. The minister replied that the ceiling is a small-fields policy instrument that does not govern Groningen output, that export figures are published in GasTerra's annual report, and that exports of Groningen gas as such cannot be separated.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de negatieve verevening voor gemeenten waar windmolens worden gebouwd

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked whether municipalities hosting wind turbines lose much of the extra OZB revenue to negative equalisation in the Gemeentefonds, and whether this undermines local support and benefit-sharing. The ministers answered that wind turbines are equalised only at 70% of the notional OZB base, that 58% of turbine value falls under the machinery exemption and is excluded from the WOZ base, and that OZB is not an instrument for building local support, which rests on participation and financial participation schemes.
I do not recognise the problem you describe, because equalisation only concerns OZB revenues insofar as the windmill does not fall under the machinery exemption.
Het door u geschetste probleem herken ik niet omdat de verevening alleen ziet op de OZB-opbrengsten voor zover de windmolen niet onder de werktuigenvrijstelling valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de fiscale vrijstelling voor (agrarisch) natuurbeheer

An MP asked whether subsidies under the SNL and SKNL nature schemes are exempt from income and corporation tax, whether agrarian nature management is covered, and whether farmers and reed cultivators face tax or VAT liabilities. The State Secretary confirmed a tax exemption limited to landscape management, said the government intends to continue it if the European Commission approves, refused a dedicated exemption for other agrarian nature management, and declined to confirm VAT exemption in all cases.
I cannot provide that at present. I undertake to inform your House further before the new agrarian nature management system is introduced.
Dat kan ik momenteel niet geven. Ik zeg toe dat ik uw Kamer voor het invoeren van het nieuwe stelsel van agrarisch natuurbeheer nader zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de bouw van een vuurwerkopslagplaats in Heerde

An MP asked the state secretary whether a fireworks storage bunker near a care home and supermarket in Heerde could be stopped, citing explosion risk and conflict with fire brigade guidance. The state secretary replied that the municipality is responsible, safety rules in the Fireworks Decree were met, the building permit is irrevocable, and no further options to stop it exist.

No, there are none. The environmental permit is irrevocable and the related notification under the Activities Decree and the Fireworks Decree was reviewed by the Noord Veluwe Environmental Service and the Noord-Oost Gelderland Safety Region.

Nee, die zijn er niet. De omgevingsvergunning is onherroepelijk en de bijbehorende melding op grond van het Activiteitenbesluit en het Vuurwerkbesluit zijn getoetst door de Omgevingsdienst Noord Veluwe en de Veiligheidsregio Noord-Oost Gelderland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Slob over vergelijkingssites zorgverzekeringen

MPs Dik-Faber and Slob asked the health minister about health insurance comparison websites, including conflicting rankings, whether sites show only policies sold through them, and commissions paid by insurers. The minister answered that transparency about comparison methods and business models is important, pointed to AFM rules and planned deeper AFM review in 2014, and said government no longer provides insurance comparison information via KiesBeter.
The AFM is considering conducting more in-depth research in 2014 into how the comparison is produced.
De AFM overweegt om in 2014 diepgaander onderzoek te doen naar de wijze waarop de vergelijking tot stand komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer, Dik-Faber en Krol over de publicatie ‘Over(-)behandelen. Ethiek van de zorg voor kwetsbare ouderen’

Members of parliament asked the health minister about a publication on over-treatment of frail elderly patients, including whether over-treatment should be curbed, adopting decision-making methods and ethical frameworks, and cost limits. The minister answered that shared decision-making, professional standards set by stakeholders, and a new 'intensive consultation at end of life' activity code are the preferred routes, with no binding new rules or cost ceilings.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over de effectiviteit van de Bob-campagne

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP and CDA asked the ministers whether independent research shows the Bob campaign works, especially for young drivers, and whether a new, harder campaign concept is needed. The minister answered that annual effect measurements show a decline in drink-driving offenders, particularly among 18–24 year old men, and rejected a new youth concept and harder confrontational messaging as unsupported by evidence.
I do not agree with that finding.
Ik ben het niet eens met die constatering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over genetisch gemodificeerd voedsel

An ChristenUnie MP asked, after a report that many consumers are unaware whether they buy genetically modified food, about the share of unaware consumers, the number of GM-labelled products on the Dutch market, and whether labelling should be improved. The minister answered that labelling already guarantees consumer choice, that surveys are not reliable indicators of purchasing, and that the government sees no need for changes beyond existing rules and Voedingscentrum information.
The mandatory labelling of foodstuffs containing GMOs, consisting wholly or partly of GMOs or produced with GMOs guarantees consumers' freedom of choice.
De verplichte etikettering van voedingsmiddelen die GGO’s bevatten, geheel of gedeeltelijk uit GGO’s bestaan of met GGO’s zijn geproduceerd, waarborgt de keuzevrijheid van consumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber, De Rouwe en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat NS stations overslaat bij vertraging

Four MPs asked the state secretary about reports that NS skips stations when trains are delayed, asking for figures, justification, passenger information, and whether the practice should be restricted. The state secretary said skipping is in principle unacceptable but may be a last-resort measure to prevent wider delays, provided passengers are informed; NS will report annually on the practice and no new restrictions or overload declaration are planned.

I have therefore agreed with NS that the company will provide me annually with an overview of figures, as NS has now compiled for the years 2010 through 2013, with an explanation of the routes where the measure is most often applied.

Ik heb daarom met NS de afspraak gemaakt dat het bedrijf mij jaarlijks een overzicht met cijfers levert zoals NS dat nu voor de jaren 2010 t/m 2013 heeft opgesteld en daarbij een toelichting geeft op de trajecten waar de maatregel het meest wordt getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zorgcentrum Geerestein

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary for Health about the closure of care centre Geerestein, the selection of centres, the pace of closure, the possibility of separating housing and care, and transition support for care providers. The state secretary answered that the regional provider consulted the municipality and staff, that three alternative centres are within ten kilometres, that a feasibility study on converting the building is ongoing, and that the sector is supported through transition funding, but did not answer the question on timing for the 2014 budget.
Because of gathering information and consultation with third parties, it was unfortunately not possible for me to answer your questions before the budget debate.
Vanwege het verzamelen van informatie en overleg met derden was het voor mij helaas niet mogelijk om uw vragen voor de begrotingsbehandeling te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Paulus Jansen over de voorgenomen sluiting van spoorwegovergangen tussen station Heemstede-Aerdenhout en Hillegom met een aanmerkelijk recreatief belang

MPs Dik-Faber and Paulus Jansen asked whether the level crossings at Laantje van Alverna and Laantje van Leyduin, which have recreational value, may be closed, and why ProRail's procedure and risk analysis were not followed. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the crossings are public and recreational, stated that a closure agreement with the right-holders for Laantje van Alverna has been reached, and said no decision has yet been taken on Laantje van Leyduin.
However, the policy is equally aimed at preventing that a change in the traffic function of existing crossings worsens crossing safety.
Het beleid is er echter evenzeer op gericht om te voorkomen dat door een wijziging van de verkeersfunctie van bestaande overwegen de overwegveiligheid verslechtert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de aanpak van de productie van GHB en de verkoop van grondstoffen hiervoor

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers how to tackle GHB production and the sale of its precursor GBL, including scheduling GBL, a ban on high-purity GBL, a licensing system, and denaturation. The government answered that the CAM quick scan is not yet finished, that a ban would likely be ineffective, that voluntary reporting and warnings to online sellers are in place, and that EU-level measures lacked support.
We expect such a ban would not or hardly be effective, because GBL with less than 80% purity can also be used in producing GHB.
Wij verwachten dat een dergelijk verbod niet of nauwelijks effectief zal zijn, omdat ook GBL met minder dan 80% zuiverheid kan worden toegepast bij de productie van GHB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over experimenten met cannabisverstrekking

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the ministers about a proposed Utrecht experiment supplying cannabis to psychosis-vulnerable patients, including whether the Bureau Medicinale Cannabis should supply it and whether it is approved and tested against treaties. The State Secretary answered that no exemption request has been filed yet so questions on that experiment cannot be answered, that any request will be assessed against criteria consistent with international treaties, and that the Social Cannabis Club Domstad request is under review.

No application for an Opium Act exemption has yet been submitted for an experiment (of a treatment) supplying cannabis to patients with vulnerability to psychotic disorders and severe cannabis addiction.

Er is nog geen aanvraag voor een Opiumwetontheffing ingediend voor een experiment (van een behandeling) waarbij cannabis wordt verstrekt aan patiënten met een kwetsbaarheid voor psychotische stoornissen en een ernstige cannabisverslaving.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de Blankenburgtunnel

An MP asked the minister about the Blankenburg tunnel, including why environmental groups did not take part in the consultation on the integration vision and whether residents and public-private financing would be involved. The minister replied that the environmental groups declined to participate, that residents will be involved in the detailed design, and that the integration vision is a regional responsibility, while stating that the financing will be mainly public with some toll revenue.
The integration vision, as drawn up by the regional parties, I will send to you shortly, together with the Preferred Decision and the Structure Vision.
De inpassingsvisie, zoals opgesteld door de regiopartijen, zal ik u binnenkort toezenden, tezamen met de Voorkeursbeslissing en de Structuurvisie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de prijzenoorlog in de supermarkten en de brief van Plus Supermarkten aan haar leveranciers

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about supermarket price wars, Plus Supermarkets passing lost margins on to suppliers, and whether the voluntary fair trading code and government oversight are adequate. The minister answered that the code is a self-regulatory pilot supplemented by existing law, with the ministry facilitating and monitoring it, and that ACM's competition role does not cover margin distribution.
It was agreed that the FNLI will collect a number of anonymised supplier complaints with the associated anonymised contractual frameworks between those suppliers and their buyers.
Afgesproken is dat de FNLI een aantal geanonimiseerde klachten van leveranciers met bijbehorende geanonimiseerde contractuele kaders tussen die leveranciers en hun afnemers zal verzamelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de opbrengsten van gemeenten voor textielinzameling en de fijnsortering van het ingezamelde textie

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about municipal fees charged to charitable textile collectors, whether textile collection is at risk from falling market prices, and the role of retail chains and permits. The state secretary replied that municipalities have autonomous responsibility for textile collection and lack data on fees, said it is not appropriate to charge fees that cover other municipal costs, noted a Green Deal study due in 2014, and reported that inspections found export textiles correctly sorted.
I therefore cannot assess whether the fees have doubled, nor whether they are as high as the amount left for the charitable purpose.
Ik kan dus niet beoordelen of de vergoedingen zijn verdubbeld en ook niet of deze net zo hoog zijn als het bedrag dat overblijft voor het goede doel.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Dik-Faber en Rebel over het hergebruik van datadragers van de overheid

MPs Dik-Faber and Rebel asked why government destroys reusable phones, tablets and computers instead of reusing them, and whether data safety can be guaranteed for reuse. The state secretary agreed reuse is preferable, cited AIVD security rules and a study due early 2014 into alternatives, and promised to consider them.
Since spring 2013 a study has been running that looks for alternatives.
Sedert het voorjaar 2013 loopt een onderzoek waarin er naar alternatieven wordt gezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over mogelijke monopolievorming bij de nationale databank OV in relatie tot de recente DDoS-aanvallen

An MP asks the State Secretary about possible monopoly formation in the national public transport data databank (NDOV) following DDoS attacks, including concerns about one provider's conflicting roles, delayed loket launches, and data access. The State Secretary replies that both NDOV loketten were tested and meet the criteria, that vervoerders may choose how to supply data, and that most requested tariff and rail data matters remain the responsibility of the vervoerders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, De Boer en De Rouwe over het project Zwolle Spoort

MPs asked the state secretary why the Zwolle Spoort rail project was delayed, what extra measures and budget are needed, whether the research report will be shared, and what the preferred variant and timetable consequences are. The government replied that a broader alternatives study is being deepened over the summer, a preferred alternative will be chosen in autumn in consultation with regional authorities, and a final report is expected in October and will be sent to parliament.
I can send this final report to your House.
Dit eindrapport kan ik aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat boeren in 2012 nog steeds veel antibiotica gebruikten

An MP asked the state secretaries whether farmers' antibiotic use remained high in 2012, why reduction stalled, and about illegal antibiotic use. The government answered that use fell about 15% in 2012 in line with the 70% target, that sectors must tackle structural high users, and that enforcement against illegal trade was intensified.
I agree with the SDa that sectors must above all focus on reducing use in this category of high users.
Ik ben het met de SDa eens dat sectoren zich met name moeten inzetten om het gebruik in deze categorie van veelgebruikers terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en De Boer over de verdeling van verantwoordelijkheden bij het opstellen van de Lange Termijn Spooragenda

MPs Dik-Faber and De Boer asked why the ministry assigns elaboration of the long-term rail agenda (LTSA) to NS and ProRail, and how FMN transport companies can be meaningfully involved. The state secretary answers that the ministry keeps the lead on priorities and concessions, that NS and ProRail are responsible for the operational rail concept under their concessions, and that FMN is being involved through meetings and invitations.
I have the lead in the recalibration and possible reprioritisation of rail programmes and projects based on the goals of the rail agenda.
Ik heb het voortouw bij de herijking en mogelijke herprioritering van de spoorprogramma’s en projecten op basis van de doelen van de Spooragenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de exportpositie naar Rusland na de uitbraak van vogelgriep

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs why Russia banned poultry exports from the whole province of Utrecht after a low-pathogenic avian influenza outbreak, whether the narrower municipal restriction was formally agreed, and how to secure binding terms with the Customs Union. The state secretary confirmed the province-wide ban, said Russia had orally agreed to limit restrictions to the municipality and later confirmed this in writing for the Tzum outbreak, and committed to continued efforts on exports.
Following the latest LPAI outbreak in Tzum, Russia has confirmed in writing that import restrictions will only be imposed on the municipality of Franekeradeel.
Inmiddels heeft Rusland naar aanleiding van de laatste LPAI uitbraak in Tzum schriftelijk bevestigd dat alleen importbeperkende maatregelen worden genomen voor de gemeente Franekeradeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over knelpunten bij invoering van het Wijzigingsbesluit Bodemenergiesystemen

An MP asked the minister about implementation problems with the Wijzigingsbesluit bodemenergiesystemen, including provinces and municipalities using exceptions, inconsistent permit rules, and a proposed evaluation. The minister replied that it is too early to draw conclusions, that provinces have regional discretion, and agreed to monitor implementation and shorten the evaluation period to three years.
I propose that my ministry, together with these parties, will draft the evaluation questions for the amendment decision in the short term
Ik stel voor dat mijn ministerie samen met deze partijen de vraagstelling voor de evaluatie van het Wijzigingsbesluit op korte termijn gaat opstellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de spoorplannen bij station Naarden-Bussum

An MP asked the state secretary about ProRail's plans for Naarden-Bussum station, including removing overtaking tracks, level-crossing closure times, underpass options and future-proofing. The state secretary answered that a ProRail proposal is in preparation, crossing closure data will only be available in 2014, no additional overtaking is needed on the line according to studies, and no underpass or lowered-track study by the ministry is underway.
I cannot go further into the breakdown you asked for at the Naarden-Bussum level crossing now, since I do not yet have the measurement data for the crossings in Naarden-Bussum.
Ik kan op de door u gevraagde uitsplitsing op de overweg in Naarden-Bussum nu niet verder ingaan, aangezien ik nog niet beschik over de meetgegevens van de overwegen in Naarden-Bussum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het spoor bij station Elst en bouwplannen van de gemeente Overbetuwe

An MP asked the state secretary about a proposed fourth track at Elst station, a municipal town hall construction plan, and rail safety distances. The state secretary answered that a fourth track is not spatially or financially feasible, that the planned building respects the statutory rail buffer, and that no provincial or national funding for a fourth track is foreseen.
I am still awaiting the definitive proposal from the regional authorities in East Netherlands on the use of that one-off €25 million.
Ik ben nog in afwachting van het definitieve voorstel van de betrokken regionale overheden uit Oost Nederland voor de inzet van die eenmalige € 25 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Drinken tijdens zwangerschap kan gewoon’

MPs Bruins Slot, Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether a UK study suggesting moderate drinking in pregnancy is harmless changes government advice, and how professional guidance and a warning logo will be addressed. The State Secretary answered that the advice to avoid alcohol in pregnancy stands, will be raised with professional groups, and that talks with the drinks sector on a voluntary pregnancy logo continue, with a report to follow after summer.
The government's position remains that it is best to avoid drinking alcohol when you want to become pregnant, are pregnant or are breastfeeding.
Het standpunt van de overheid is nog altijd dat het het beste is het drinken van alcohol te vermijden wanneer je zwanger wilt worden, zwanger bent of borstvoeding geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over medische beslissingen rond het levenseinde bij pasgeborenen met zeer ernstige afwijkingen

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the health minister about the KNMG position on end-of-life decisions for newborns with severe anomalies, including the omission of prior research, spina bifida controversy, the role of neurosurgeons, pre-approval review, and the reliability of 'suffering' as a criterion. Minister Schippers answered that the position fills a need for clarity, that decisions are reviewed afterwards rather than in advance, and that the regulatory framework evaluation is expected in autumn.
After it is sent to your House, I will send your House a position giving the cabinet's view on the Regulation.
Na toezending aan uw Kamer zal ik uw Kamer een standpunt doen toekomen waarin ik de kabinetsvisie zal geven op de Regeling.
Vragen van het lid Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over de consumptie van «Schipholganzen» (ingezonden 21 juni 2013).

MP Dik-Faber asks the state secretary whether geese killed near Schiphol for airport safety are properly used as food, whether provinces' permits require their use, where they go, and whether the government will ensure all culled geese enter the food chain and consider goose meat in sustainable procurement and food-waste talks. The state secretary replies that the geese are sold via a poulterer to restaurants and food banks, about 63% entered the human food chain this year, the rest going to animal feed, and commits to pursue maximum human use and to discuss it with provinces and the implementing agency.
This year 63% of the total number of captured geese has entered the human food chain.
Dit jaar is 63% van het totaal aantal gevangen ganzen de menselijke voedselketen ingegaan.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber en Schouten over mantelzorgers die weinig steun hebben aan hun baas

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked whether the government recognises that informal carers receive little support from their employers, whether it will convene social partners to improve workplace arrangements, and what further measures it will take. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to a planned labour-and-care summit with social partners in autumn and to extended leave rules, and said the carers letter would address the work-care link only briefly.
In the coming period we will work together with the minister and state secretary of OCW to prepare a 'labour-and-care summit' which is expected to take place in the autumn.
De komende tijd werken wij samen met de minister en staatssecretaris van OCW een «arbeid-en-zorgtop» uit die naar verwachting in het najaar zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber inzake de permanente structuur OV-chipkaart

MP Dik-Faber asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the permanent structure for the OV-chipkaart, including the kwartiermaker's letter, a feasibility study on single check-in/check-out, deadlines, consumer representation, and whether a legislative proposal for an authority with binding power will be introduced. The state secretary answered by referring each question to a letter to the Tweede Kamer of 11 July 2013 and to an earlier answer, without providing the substance requested.
I refer you for this to my letter to the House of Representatives of 11 July 2013 on motions and commitments regarding the OV-chipkaart
Ik verwijs hiervoor naar mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 11 juli 2013 over moties en toezeggingen OV-Chipkaart

Vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over spoedige oplossingen voor abonnementen in het scholie

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the state secretaries whether regional public transport operators and authorities had reached agreements protecting pupils from steep fare increases, including the Amersfoort/Zeewolde case, and proposed a national pupil discount and a joint solution. The government replied that decentralisation allows regional differences, that a national discount framework is being pursued via a vision process and future OV-chipkaart rules, and that regions remain responsible for fares, offering no immediate binding fix.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de argumenten voor het afwijzen van het bewonersalternatief Portway 2012 c.q. Portway Budget voor de A13/A16

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the minister why the Portway 2012 residents' alternative to the A13/A16 was rejected, citing noise screens, traffic, robustness and the consultation process. The minister answered that the regional authority found the project goals of A13/16 not met and Portway 2012 not fundable within budget, and defended the treatment of the citizens' initiative.
Portway 2012 was tested by the Rotterdam city region on goal achievement (mainly traffic performance and environmental effects), compared with A13/16.
De Portway 2012 is door de stadregio Rotterdam getoetst op doelbereik (voornamelijk verkeerskundige prestatie en milieueffecten), in vergelijking met A13/16.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de veiligheid van stationsgebieden bij vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether legal requirements should be set for sewerage at rail locations, such as mandatory separation of rainwater and wastewater, and whether the minister would map risky rail-site sewers and consider isolation measures. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold the sewerage and incident-preparedness duty under the Leidraad Riolering, that the national government sets generic norms while local authorities implement them, and that no judgement on rail-specific requirements can be made until the Belgian investigation into the Wetteren accident is available.
Once the results of the investigation in Belgium become available, I will examine whether the specific situation in Wetteren could also occur in the Netherlands.
Zodra de resultaten van het onderzoek in België beschikbaar komen zal ik nagaan of de specifieke situatie in Wetteren zich ook in Nederland kan voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de coöperatie Laatste Wil

An MP asked the health minister about the newly founded cooperative Laatste Wil, which plans to distribute lethal means for assisted dying, and whether this conflicts with the criminal ban on providing means for suicide. The minister answered that the cooperative says it will work within legal limits, that its activities do not currently fall under article 294 of the Criminal Code, and that no changes to coroner procedures or prosecution guidelines are needed.
I do not share that concern, since the cooperative explicitly states that it wants to work within the framework of the law.
Ik deel die zorg niet, aangezien de coöperatie expliciet aangeeft binnen de kaders van de wet te willen werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over euthanasie bij dementie

An MP asked the health minister about euthanasia for patients with dementia, including the status of written euthanasia declarations, whether the Euthanasia Act or the prosecution guideline should be amended, and whether physicians must communicate with patients. The minister said a working group will seek clarity on written declarations but declined to amend the Act or guideline, and the questions were not answered before the scheduled debate.
Together with those present at the consultation, I decided to have a working group including VWS, V&J and KNMG take up this issue quickly.
Ik heb samen met de aanwezigen bij het overleg besloten om een werkgroep van onder meer VWS, V&J en KNMG dit vraagstuk snel verder te laten oppakken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat het aandeel hernieuwbare energie vrijwel gelijk is gebleven

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why renewable energy's share barely rose in 2012 and what will be done about energy efficiency, wind targets and innovation. The minister attributed the stagnation to rising total energy consumption, said the SDE+ scheme will still reach the 16% target by 2020, and promised a further letter on energy efficiency soon.
There are currently two tracks underway regarding energy efficiency.
Op dit moment lopen er twee trajecten ten aanzien van energie-efficiëntie
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de plannen voor Doorstroomstation Utrecht

The MP Dik-Faber asks the state secretary about the plans for the Utrecht doorstroomstation (flow-through station), including its costs, the loss of a direct Gouda-Utrecht-Arnhem intercity, robustness against disruptions, reroute options, and ERTMS. The state secretary answers that the design follows the chosen variant, cost breakdown is withheld as tender-sensitive, a direct intercity is not included but remains technically possible, and that ERTMS choices are still under study.
The further breakdown of costs concerns tender-sensitive information and therefore cannot be released.
De nadere onderverdeling in kosten betreft aanbestedingsgevoelige informatie en kan om die reden niet worden vrijgegeven.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber over de binnenvaartblokkades in België

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked the Infrastructure and Environment minister about Belgian inland shipping blockades, the sector crisis, a possible EU crisis declaration, a scrapping fund, and support measures. The minister condemned the blockades, reported contacts with Belgian counterparts, committed to forwarding the sector report to Belgium, and promised a transparency study by the October 2013 committee meeting, while deferring EU and competition-law matters.
I have promised my Belgian colleagues my support for their crisis notification.
Ik heb mijn Belgische collega's mijn steun toegezegd bij hun crisismelding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Dik-Faber over het meetellen van het persoonsgebonden budget in box 3

MPs Schouten and Dik-Faber asked whether unspent personal budget (PGB) advances count as box 3 wealth, lowering the fairness of the AWBZ own-contribution rules, and whether the government will investigate alternatives. The government confirmed PGB advances count as liquid assets, noted that payment timing by two care offices can create a small effect, and promised a letter after the Spring Memorandum on possible remedies.

During the debate of 4 April 2013 on the unintended effects of the wealth income add-on, I committed to indicate in a letter following the Spring Memorandum whether there are options to remedy the identified effects of the PGB on the wealth income add-on for the AWBZ own contribution.

Tijdens het debat van 4 april 2013 over de ongewenste effecten van de vermogensinkomensbijtelling heb ik toegezegd dat ik in een brief naar aanleiding van de Voorjaarsnota zal aangeven of er mogelijkheden zijn om de geconstateerde gevolgen van het PGB voor de vermogensinkomensbijtelling voor de eigen bijdrage AWBZ te verhelpen.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het bericht “ziekenhuizen mogen abortus niet weigeren”

Two MPs asked the health and education ministers about a minister's radio remarks on abortion and a hospital board's decision to offer abortion, including whether conscientious objectors are protected under the Termination of Pregnancy Act. The government answered that the law protects non-participation, that hospital decision-making and ethics committee involvement are internal matters, and that it expects conscientious objectors' position to be sufficiently secured.
I regard this as an internal matter.
Ik zie dit als een interne aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, De Rouwe, De Boer en Dik-Faber over het geluidsniveau langs de HSL-Zuid

MPs asked when TNO's noise measurements and the pilot along the HSL-Zuid in Lansingerland would be reported and completed, whether the 57 dB(A) limit is exceeded, and about costs, planning, speed reduction and a local residents' plan. The state secretary replied that five of eight measured homes will likely exceed the limit in the end situation by 1 to 6 dB, that the first pilot phase costs about 5.5 million euros with effect measurements planned for autumn, and that speed reduction is undesirable and not legally possible under the Spoorwegwet.

TNO currently concludes that for five of the eight homes (in the municipalities of Hoogmade and Lansingerland) where noise was measured, the calculated noise load in the final situation will be higher than the limit values in the Tracébesluit, namely 57 dB(A).

TNO concludeert op dit moment dat bij vijf van de acht woningen (in de gemeenten Hoogmade en Lansingerland) waar het geluid is gemeten, de berekende geluidbelasting in de eindsituatie hoger zal zijn dan de grenswaarden uit het Tracébesluit, namelijk57 dB(A).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de cumulatieve effecten op natuur en milieu van activiteiten in het Waddengebied

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about cumulative effects on nature and environment of activities in the Wadden Sea, including salt extraction increasing sand hunger, and whether a central overview of effects should be kept. The State Secretary answers that impact assessments and permit conditions will address sand hunger mitigation, that cumulative effects are handled by the competent authority per project, and that a data-access taskforce will report by end May 2013.
I agree with you on that.
Dat ben ik met u eens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber over natuurontwikkeling in het Binnenveld

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about the stalled nature development and Natura 2000 management plan for the Binnenveld, including a possible 20 cm water level rise, the lack of local support, and whether Staatsbosbeheer would sell land. The state secretary answered that the process is complex, that a consultation with the competent authorities is planned, that Staatsbosbeheer will not sell Natura 2000 or EHS land, and that talks with the provinces and water board will take place at the end of April.
It is my intention to soon consult administratively with the other competent authorities about possible solutions.
Het is mijn voornemen om binnenkort bestuurlijk met de andere bevoegde instanties te overleggen over mogelijke oplossingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber met betrekking tot schaliegas

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Cuadrilla's preliminary shale gas research near Luttelgeest or Marknesse amounts to test drilling, what the studies cover, whether the municipality was consulted, and how other shale gas drilling requests will be assessed. The minister answered that no drilling will take place during the research, that only an exploration permit has been granted with further permits needed before drilling, and that an independent study on the risks of shale gas is due on 1 July.
I want to emphasise that no test drilling will be carried out in the announced Cuadrilla research.
Ik wil hierbij benadrukken dat er bij het aangekondigde onderzoek van Cuadrilla geen proefboringen geplaatst worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over nieuwe bezuinigingen op het infrastructuurfonds

An ChristenUnie MP asked the infrastructure minister about the reported €2.6 billion cut from withholding the price-indexation tranche for the infrastructure fund, the effect on MIRT project planning, the total cuts since 2010, and job losses. The minister confirmed the maximum effect on the infrastructure fund is €1.6 billion through 2028, that there is no current effect on MIRT projects yet, a net cut of over €10 billion since 2010, and gave an EIB-based estimate of roughly 3,200 job-years per year without giving a precise figure for this measure.
The maximum effect of the measure on the Infrastructure Fund is therefore 1.6 billion euros for the entire period through 2028.
Het maximale effect van de maatregel op het Infrastructuurfonds is daarmee 1,6 miljard euro voor de totale periode tot en met 2028.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de veiling van GSM-frequenties en de mogelijke interferentie met GSM-rail

An MP asked the state secretary and economic affairs minister about GSM-R rail interference from the 4G frequency auction, including cost allocation, EU access rules, and legal options. The government replied that a coordination model is nearly finished and that it will answer the questions substantively in April, deferring full answers until then.
For a correct and complete answer to the questions posed, it is in our view desirable that the development of this model has been completed.
Voor een juiste en volledige beantwoording van de gestelde Kamervragen is het volgens ons gewenst dat de ontwikkeling van dit model is afgerond.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de opening van een babyhuis met vondelingenkamer te Dordrecht

An MP asked whether a baby house with an anonymous foundling hatch in Dordrecht conflicts with children's right to know their parents and with better care for pregnant women in need. The government answered that such a hatch breaches children's rights, pointed to a confidential-birth protocol and planned reforms of women's shelter care, and said babyhouse carers are not screened as foster parents under youth-care law.
The babyhouse therefore does not fall under the regular supervision of the inspectorate.
Het babyhuis valt daardoor niet onder het reguliere toezicht van de inspectie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het tariefsysteem op het spoor

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about rail fare inconsistencies, including higher fares on parallel routes, unexplained tariff units and the Hanzelijn pricing, and asked for a distance-based fare system in the new concession. The state secretary defended the current tariff-unit system as offering traveller flexibility, admitted some anomalies, and refused to impose a distance-based fare condition in the concession.
I see no reason to change my policy on this point.
Ik zie geen aanleiding mijn beleid op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over de opvang van tienermoeders

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the risk that Siriz's shelter for teenage mothers loses funding after 2014, and what happens to this group after decentralisation to municipalities. The state secretary answers that shelter for teenage mothers should remain available, that advice from VNG and Federatie Opvang is expected before summer 2013, and that the group will move to municipal shelter funding from 2015 without explicit mention in the Wmo.
I consider it important that support and, where necessary, shelter for teenage mothers with (serious) problems remain available.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat ondersteuning en zo nodig opvang voor tienermoeders met (ernstige) problemen beschikbaar blijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over energiebesparing door minder en duurzame verlichting

An MP asked the government about reducing energy use through less and more sustainable road and building lighting, including switching off road lighting after 21:00, dimmable or presence-sensitive lighting, LED road markings, cooperation with provinces and municipalities, night-time lighting rules for offices and shops, and designating dark areas. The state secretary answered that the road-lighting switch-off was being prepared for spring 2013, that presence-sensitive lighting is unsuitable on main roads, that existing rules already cover energy-saving measures in buildings, and that dark-area designation is a provincial responsibility, though the topic can be raised with local climate ambassadors.
However, I am willing to raise this topic at the local level in the consultations with the 'climate ambassadors'.
Wel ben ik bereid om in het overleg met de «klimaatambassadeurs» dit onderwerp op lokaal niveau te agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat de winstgevendheid van warmtekrachtkoppelingsinstallaties (WKK) in de glastuinbouw sterk is gedaald

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the profitability of combined heat and power (WKK) installations in horticulture has fallen, partly due to coal-fired plants, and about CO2 effects, ETS, flexibility, gas price manipulation and possible support for WKK. The minister answered that electricity production is a market outcome, that investment risk lies with entrepreneurs, that energy policy is technology-neutral, and that REMIT legislation on market integrity has been submitted to parliament.
Energy and climate policy aims at generic promotion of clean and efficient production, leaving technology choice to market parties as far as possible.
Het energie- en klimaatbeleid is gericht op generieke stimulering van schone en efficiënte productie, waarbij zoveel mogelijk de technologiekeuze bij marktpartijen wordt gelaten.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de stijgende regionale vervoertarieven voor scholieren vanaf het schooljaar 2013-2014

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked about sharp regional public transport fare increases for pupils from 2013-2014, the lack of clarity for schools and parents, and whether alternative subscriptions or harmonisation were agreed. The state secretary said fare decisions are regional, acknowledged the criticism, pointed to a compensation scheme in Zuid-Holland and to a planned permanent structure for harmonising discount products, but declined to take formal action or set a maximum increase.
From my current role, however, I have no formal powers to act against this.
Vanuit mijn huidige rol heb ik echter geen formele bevoegdheden om hier tegen op te treden.
Vragen van het lid Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de afrit Hoevelaken (ingezonden 17 januari 2013).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Infrastructure and Environment minister about a newly proposed alternative to keep the Hoevelaken motorway exit by moving it eastward, its cost, traffic scores, land ownership and the rail clearance zone. The minister answers that the new alternative differs from the one assessed in the Nota van Antwoord, so comparisons cannot be made, that it appears infeasible, and that the closure decision will not be reconsidered, leaving the matter to the Raad van State appeal.
I therefore see no reason to reconsider the decision on the Hoevelaken exit as laid down in the Wegaanpassingsbesluit A28 Utrecht – Amersfoort.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om de beslissing ten aanzien van de afrit Hoevelaken zoals is vastgelegd in het Wegaanpassingsbesluit A28 Utrecht – Amersfoort te heroverwegen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over een hardheidsclausule bij annulering van rijexamens door het winterweer

An MP asked the minister whether the CBR's cancellation of motorcycle exams due to winter weather could be remedied through a hardship clause for under-24 candidates facing the new licence rules, and how many were affected. The minister said the EU directive is binding and leaves no room for old-style licences, but agreed to financially compensate affected under-24 candidates for extra costs and asked the CBR to elaborate this.

I am willing to financially compensate candidates for a motorcycle licence under 24 who could not take their exam in January due to weather conditions for the extra costs they face under the new regulation.

Ik ben bereid om de kandidaten voor het motorrijbewijs onder de 24 jaar die vanwege de weersomstandigheden in januari geen examen konden doen, financieel tegemoet te komen in de extra kosten die zij onder de nieuwe regeling hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Gemeente verdient aan kledinginzamelaars’

An MP asked whether municipalities profit from charity clothing-collection containers by charging fees that exceed costs and using the proceeds to balance municipal budgets. The government answered that municipalities are autonomous in organising textile collection and it lacks an overview of fees and revenues, but agreed that fees should not cover other municipal costs and will consult the VNG.
I am of the view that a municipality may charge third parties a fee that is necessary to cover the costs the municipality must incur.
Ik ben van mening dat een gemeente aan derden een vergoeding in rekening mag brengen die noodzakelijk is voor het voldoen van de kosten die de gemeente moet maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de cumulatieve effecten op natuur en milieu van activiteiten in het Waddengebied

An MP asked about the cumulative effects on nature and environment of activities in the Wadden Sea, including salt mining by Frisia, shrinking ebb-tidal deltas, the number of permits, and whether the ministry will coordinate cumulative assessment. The State Secretary answered that permits for Frisia are still pending, that effects will be monitored with a hand-on-the-tap approach, that cumulative effects are assessed by each competent authority, and that no ministry coordination or regional talks are deemed necessary.
I am of the view that the cumulative effects on nature and environment are adequately mapped through the legal instruments described above when assessing new activities.
Ik ben van mening dat de cumulatieve effecten op natuur en milieu door bovenbeschreven wettelijk instrumentarium adequaat in beeld worden gebracht bij het toetsen van nieuwe activiteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verdwijnen van de Beneluxtrein en het ontbreken van een alternatieve snelle verbinding voor West-Brabant

An MP asked whether the Amsterdam–Brussels intercity was being replaced by the more expensive Fyra with no West-Brabant stop and lower frequency, and asked about capacity, the reservation requirement and an alternative Antwerp–Roosendaal–Breda connection. The state secretary confirmed the Beneluxtrein ended and the Fyra runs with reduced frequency, announced a fast Breda–Antwerp link from April 2013 without reservation, and explained the reservation rules are a matter for the operators.
That is why I have made every effort to secure a direct and fast rail connection between Belgium and North Brabant.
Daarom heb ik mij tot het uiterste ingespannen voor een directe en snelle treinverbinding tussen België en Noord-Brabant.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouw over het terugtrekken van de overheid uit het Platform Verduurzaming Voedsel

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouw asked whether the government's cooperation agreement on the Platform Verduurzaming Voedsel ends on 1 January 2013 and whether the state withdraws, and how that fits a parliamentary motion requiring active continuation. The state secretary confirmed the agreement expires, says the government stays involved via a regiegroep and topsector policy, and promises a 3-year overview and an evaluation around summer 2013.
The government remains directly involved in the sustainability process of the food chain through the Regiegroep Duurzame Veehouderij en Agroketens.
De overheid blijft via de Regiegroep Duurzame Veehouderij en Agroketens direct betrokken bij het verduurzamingsproces van de voedselketen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over aanpassing van het station Meppel

An MP asked the state secretary why the Meppel station adjustments for extra trains from Leeuwarden were delayed until spring 2013 and what this means for passengers. The state secretary answered that the works turned out larger than estimated (platform and signalling), that passengers must wait until May 2013, and that earlier delivery is not possible.
Mainly because of the mentioned change in the signalling installation, earlier delivery is however not possible.
Vooral vanwege de genoemde wijziging in de beveiligingsinstallatie is een eerdere oplevering echter niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber, Segers en Van der Staaij over berichten dat er binnen Europa een lijst in omloop is waarop ‘anti-choice personalities’ met naam worden genoemd

MPs asked whether a list naming 'anti-choice personalities' circulated by the European Parliamentary Forum for Population and Development (EPF), partly funded by the European Commission, is acceptable, and whether the Dutch government would raise the matter with the EPF or the Commission or question the funding. The minister answered that the EPF is a private initiative operating within EU law, that organisations choose their own strategies, and that she sees no reason to act or to question the funding.
An organisation is itself responsible for a chosen strategy to make its position clear.
Een organisatie is zelf verantwoordelijk voor een gekozen strategie om haar standpunt duidelijk te maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over de studenten OV-chipkaart

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why students cannot use the temporary replacement and refund arrangements available to other OV-chipkaart holders, and whether one uniform scheme could be created. The minister replied that student data protection rules prevent carriers from verifying students, so the differences remain, though the government judges the refund process not unduly complicated.
For privacy reasons, individual carriers may never have access to students' personal data.
Om privacyredenen zullen individuele vervoerders nooit over de persoonsgegevens van studenten mogen beschikken.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber over de kosten voor een (defecte) OV-chipkaart

An MP asked why Trans Link Systems now charges €11 for replacing a defective OV-chipkaart versus €7.50 for a new card, who decided the increase, whether consumer groups were consulted, and whether the price should be lowered. The minister confirmed the new replacement price, said operators and TLS decided it without a formal consumer role, noted replacement costs include transferring subscriptions, and declined to lower the price.
The General Conditions of the OV-chipkaart apply to the application, issue, use and surrender of a personal and anonymous OV-chipkaart issued by TLS.
De Algemene Voorwaarden OV-chipkaart zijn van toepassing op de aanvraag, uitgifte, gebruik en inname van een door TLS uitgegeven persoonlijke en anonieme OV-chipkaart.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de import van mengsels kunststoffen met PVC

An MP asked the state secretary whether mixed plastics containing more than 2% PVC are treated as red-list waste under the EU waste shipment regulation, requiring burdensome notification, and whether this blocks recycling imports. The state secretary confirmed the Bijlage IV regime applies to such mixtures, defended the rules as necessary for environmental control, said he would raise the issue in the EU correspondents' consultation and review regulatory burden with Belgium and Germany.

However, in the context of a motion by MP Van Veldhoven, I am examining whether, together with Belgium and Germany, the regulatory burden and required permits for cross-border waste transport can be reduced to stimulate recycling of raw materials.

Wel ben ik in het kader van een motie van lid Van Veldhoven ( 32852 nr.9 ) aan het bekijken of, samen met België en Duitsland, de regeldruk en de vereiste vergunningen voor grensoverschrijdend afvaltransport kunnen worden beperkt om recycling van grondstoffen te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de abortusboot

MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked whether the Women on Waves abortion boat's planned visit to Morocco, where abortion is illegal, risks prosecution, whether the government had contact with Morocco, what permits the foundation holds, its past activities and whether it receives subsidy. The minister answered that the trip is a private initiative, that Morocco regards it as an NGO matter, that the Dutch Waz permit requires a temporary permit and IGZ review for the mobile clinic which the foundation has not requested, and that it receives no ministry subsidy.
However, WoW has not applied for the temporary permit.
WoW heeft de tijdelijke vergunning echter niet aangevraagd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber en Schouten over de subsidietoekenning 2013-2016 aan Slot Loevestein

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked the state secretary whether cutting the 2013-2016 subsidy to Slot Loevestein, which may close the castle to the public, fits his earlier praise for its cultural entrepreneurship, and why such entrepreneurship is penalised. The state secretary replied that the subsidy follows his policy priorities and the Raad voor Cultuur advice, that the lower grant is not a punishment, and that whether the monument stays open is for the castle's management to decide.
I follow the substantive advice of the Raad voor Cultuur and want to secure the preservation and management of the state collection through subsidy.
Ik volg het inhoudelijk advies van de Raad voor Cultuur en wil het behoud en beheer van de rijkscollectie zeker stellen door middel van subsidie.

m: Motie Van der Ham en Jasper van Dijk over herijking van het museumbestel
Asks the government to fully include museums where cuts are possible in the review of the Dutch museum system.
requests the government to make the museums where cuts are possible fully part of the review of the Dutch museum system
verzoekt de regering, de musea waar mogelijk op wordt gekort, volledig onderdeel te laten zijn van de herijking van het Nederlandse museumbestel
Motie Van der Ham over de charitatieve sector
Asks the government, together with the Postcodeloterij, to create a private fund for charitable support to culture-sector entrepreneurship.
requests the government, in consultation with the Postcodeloterij, to arrive at a fourth pillar
verzoekt de regering, om in samenspraak met de Postcodeloterij te komen tot een vierde pijler
Motie van het lid Paulus Jansen c.s. over verruimen van de keuzevrijheid tot alle gemeenten
Asks the government to map the possibilities and obstacles of extending the freedom to choose between in-house and outsourced public transport to all municipalities.
requests the government to map the possibilities and obstacles of extending the freedom of choice to all municipalities
verzoekt de regering, om de mogelijkheden en belemmeringen van het verruimen van de keuzevrijheid tot alle gemeenten in kaart te brengen
Motie van de leden Klaver en Van der Ham over volwasseneneducatie voor vrijwillige inburgeraars
Motion asks the government to examine how adult education access for voluntary integration participants can be improved, for example by allowing them student loans.
requests the government to examine how the accessibility of adult education for voluntary integration participants can be promoted
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe de toegankelijkheid van volwasseneneducatie voor vrijwillige inburgeraars kan worden bevorderd
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Lucas en Van der Ham ter vervanging van nr. 27 over het mogelijk maken van "collegegeldvrij besturen"
Allows institutions to give financial support to non-enrolled students doing board or social activities, without losing study finance entitlements.
The institutional board may make provisions for financial support of a person who is not enrolled
Het instellingsbestuur kan voorzieningen treffen voor de financiële ondersteuning van een persoon die: a. niet is ingeschreven
Amendement van de leden Lucas en Van der Ham over het mogelijk maken van "collegegeldvrij besturen"
Lets institutions offer financial support to students who take a year off for board activities without enrolling, a higher education rule without bearing on executive checks.
The institution's board may make provisions for the financial support of that person

verzoekt de regering te komen met voorstellen om de watertoets juridisch te versterken
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over binnenstedelijk bouwen niet ten koste laten gaan van binnenstedelijk groen
Asks the government to encourage municipalities to limit urban infill harm to inner-city green space and favour higher building.
requests the government to encourage municipalities to minimise harm to inner-city green from inner-city building targets
verzoekt de regering bij gemeenten te bevorderen dat zij de doelstellingen binnenstedelijk bouwen zo min mogelijk ten koste laten gaan van binnenstedelijk groen
Motie Van der Ham over één methodiek voor de prijszetting voor bedrijfsontwikkeling
Asks the government to propose, with municipalities, one pricing method for business-site land based on the value at building, including a redistribution arrangement.
requests the government, in its policy response to the Taskforce, to make proposals with municipalities for one pricing methodology
verzoekt de regering in de beleidsreactie op de Taskforce herontwikkeling bedrijventerreinen voorstellen te doen om samen met gemeenten tot één methodiek te komen
Motie Ouwehand c.s. over verkleining van de ecologische voetafdruk
Asks the government to formulate measurable targets and measures to reduce the Dutch ecological footprint and inform the House within a month.
requests the government to formulate measurable targets and take appropriate measures to reduce the ecological footprint and inform the House within a month
verzoekt de regering afrekenbare doelstellingen te formuleren en passende maatregelen te nemen voor de verkleining van de ecologische voetafdruk en de Kamer hierover binnen een maand te informeren
Motie Spies c.s. over fundamentele herbezinning op het geluidbeleid
Asks the government to fundamentally rethink noise policy, prioritising source-oriented measures over effect-oriented ones, with results in the 2010 budget.
requests the government to carry out a fundamental rethink of noise policy
verzoekt de regering een fundamentele herbezinning op het geluidbeleid uit te voeren
Motie Ouwehand c.s. over de informatievoorziening rondom bouwplannen
Asks the government to propose ways to improve information to stakeholders living near building plans, beyond a small local newspaper notice.
requests the government to come up with proposals to improve information provision to stakeholders around building plans
verzoekt de regering met voorstellen te komen om de informatievoorziening aan belanghebbenden rondom bouwplannen in de omgeving te verbeteren
Motie Ouwehand c.s. over het nader uitwerken van het principe "de vervuiler betaalt"
Asks the government to further develop the polluter-pays principle as a possible policy instrument for making protein consumption more sustainable.
requests the government to further elaborate the polluter-pays principle as a possible policy instrument for sustainable protein consumption
verzoekt de regering het «de vervuiler betaalt»-principe nader uit te werken als mogelijk beleidsinstrument in het kader van de verduurzaming van de eiwitconsumptie
Motie Spies c.s. over een nieuwe bestemming voor het budget voor de subsidie voor roetfilters
Asks the government not to provide subsidies for soot filters once they can be made mandatory, and to reallocate the remaining budget within air quality and transport.
requests the government not to make subsidies available for soot filters at the moment they can also be made mandatory
verzoekt de regering om geen subsidies beschikbaar te stellen voor roetfilters op het moment dat deze ook verplicht gesteld kunnen worden
Motie Spies c.s. over afspraken met de branche over stille banden
Asks the government to agree with the tyre industry that silent tyres become the standard.
requests the government to reach agreements with the industry that lead to silent tyres becoming standard
verzoekt de regering in overleg met de branche te komen tot afspraken die ertoe leiden dat stille banden standaard worden
Motie Vendrik c.s. over een maximale norm voor de uitstoot van broeikasgassen
Asks the government to include a maximum greenhouse gas emission norm in the Miljoenennota 2010, with sector split and additional measures.
to include a maximum norm for greenhouse gas emissions in the Netherlands in the coming year
een maximale norm op te nemen voor de uitstoot van broeikasgassen in Nederland in het komend jaar
Motie Van der Ham monitoren van de relevantie van gevolgde opleidingen
Asks the government to monitor the relevance of training taken by single parents on benefits and to report to the House one year after the law takes effect.
requests the government to monitor the relevance of the training followed and to report to the House one year after the law takes effect
verzoekt de regering de relevantie van de gevolgde opleidingen te monitoren, en de Kamer hierover een jaar na in werking treden van de wet te rapporteren
Amendement van de leden Van der Ham en Nicolaï over het niet generiek toekennen van de ontheffing van de sollicitatieplicht
Shortens the maximum period of exemption from the job-search obligation for benefit recipients from twelve to six years in three benefit acts.
In the fourth paragraph of article 9, '12 years' is replaced by: six years.
In het vierde lid van artikel 9 wordt «12 jaar» vervangen door: zes jaar.
Amendement van het lid Van der Ham c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het niet generiek toekennen van de ontheffing van de sollicitatieplicht

Replaces the articles of the bill so the maximum exemption period from the job-search obligation for single parents with a child under five is cut from twelve to six years rather than granted generically.
In the fourth paragraph of article 9, '12 years' is replaced by six years.
In het vierde lid van artikel 9 wordt «12 jaar» vervangen door: zes jaar.
Amendement van het lid Van der Ham over aan de slag gaan van alleenstaande bijstandsgerechtigde ouders als hun kind vier jaar is
Lowers the child age threshold from five to four for the work-integration duty of single parents on welfare.
The age of the child, applicable to the exemption, can therefore be lowered from five to four years.
De leeftijd van het kind, geldend voor de ontheffing, kan dus worden verlaagd van vijf naar vier jaar.
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over het niet beëindigen van lopende initiatieven van de creatieve industrie alvorens evaluatie heeft plaatsgevonden
Asks the government not to end ongoing creative industry initiatives before an evaluation, and to inform the House about this before the spring budget memorandum.
requests the government not to end ongoing initiatives before an evaluation has taken place and to inform the House about this before the spring memorandum 2009
verzoekt de regering lopende initiatieven niet te beëindigen alvorens evaluatie heeft plaatsgevonden en de Kamer hier vóór de behandeling van de voorjaarsnota 2009 over te informeren
Amendement van het lid Van der Ham om middelen te oormerken voor alle instellingen in de basisinfrastructuur podiumkunsten
Amendment earmarking culture budget funds for all institutions in the performing arts basic infrastructure, excluding certain categories.
to earmark funds for all institutions in the basic infrastructure, except the culture funds
middelen te oormerken voor alle instellingen in de basisinfrastructuur, met uitzondering van de cultuurfondsen
Motie Ten Hoopen c.s. over een analyse van de werking van de gasmarkt
Asks the government to re-analyse the functioning of the gas market and propose measures to improve market competition.
requests the government to re-analyse the functioning of the gas market on this point
verzoekt de regering om de werking van de gasmarkt op dit punt opnieuw te analyseren
Motie Van der Ham en Aptroot over het budget voor de InnovatiePrestatieContracten
Asks the government to examine by the spring memorandum whether the budget for the InnovatiePrestatieContracten matches demand and to raise it or develop an alternative.
requests the government to have examined by the spring memorandum whether demand for this scheme matches the budget
verzoekt de regering bij de voorjaarsnota te hebben onderzocht of de vraag naar deze regeling aansluit bij het budget
Amendement van het lid Van der Ham om het budget voor de innovatieprestatie-contracten (IPC) te verruimen om innovatie in het MKB te ondersteunen
Shifts budget within the economics ministry from international economic relations to the innovation performance contracts for SMEs.
This amendment aims to expand the budget for innovation performance contracts to support innovation in SMEs.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe het budget voor de innovatieprestatie-contracten (IPC) te verruimen om innovatie in het MKB te ondersteunen.
Amendement van het lid Van der Ham over verhoging van het budget voor het Nederlands Bureau voor Toerisme en Congressen (NBTC)
Shifts €3.3 million within the economics budget from international economic relations to the tourism bureau NBTC.
With this amendment the budget for the Netherlands Bureau for Tourism and Conventions (NBTC) is raised from €16.7 million to €20 million.
Door dit amendement wordt het budget voor het Nederlands Bureau voor Toerisme en Congressen (NBTC) verhoogd van € 16,7 mln naar € 20 mln.
qa: Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Ham inzake het bericht dat basisscholen meer zullen moeten snijden

MP Van der Ham asked whether a Deloitte study showing primary schools cutting staff while still facing shortfalls, and claims that cuts stem from overstaffing rather than funding cuts, justify the pressure on schools and quality. The state secretary answered that staff fell 5% against a 1% drop in pupils, that quality is reported as rising, that funding is protected but declines with pupil numbers, and that the Audit Office study and an interdepartmental policy study on demographic decline have been commissioned.
Following the Linthorst motion, I have asked the Algemene Rekenkamer to investigate the adequacy of the funding.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van de motie Linthorst c.s. de Algemene Rekenkamer verzocht onderzoek te doen naar de toereikendheid van de bekostiging
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Ham over de langstudeerdersboete voor olympiërs

MP Van der Ham (D66) asks whether the government will scrap or adjust the long-term student fine for top athletes, after reports that a quarter of Dutch Olympic team student-athletes face it. Secretary Zijlstra refuses, saying students already get extra years before the higher tuition applies, can borrow the fee, can appeal to institutional hardship funds, and that institutions may set their own rules.
I want to promote student freedom of choice and the diversity of institutions.
Ik wil de keuzevrijheid van de student en de diversiteit van de instellingen bevorderen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Ham over de handdruk van de directeur van de Wereldomroep

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the general director of the Wereldomroep would receive over 1 million euro upon departure and whether such amounts should be avoided in future. The minister answered that departure is uncertain, that the Supervisory Board sets pay and severance and was urged to apply the kantonrechter formula, and that the director is willing to discuss a lower amount.
The Supervisory Board (RvT) is responsible for employment conditions, including a possible severance payment, and will therefore determine what amount the general director is offered.
De Raad van Toezicht (hierna: RvT) gaat over de arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder mogelijke ontslagvergoeding en zal dan ook bepalen welk bedrag de algemeen directeur aangeboden krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Ham over berichtgeving excellente leerlingen

The MP asks how the minister responds to reports that a quarter of excellent pupils fail to obtain their VWO diploma within six years, and how this relates to PISA results and the Actieplan Beter Presteren. The minister answers that the signal supports continuing the existing gifted-pupil policy, describes roles for parents, higher education and business, and cites 30 million euros per year and the School aan Zet programme.
This signal underlines the need to continue my policy for gifted and excellent pupils.
Dit signaal onderstreept de noodzaak om mijn beleid voor hoogbegaafde en excellente leerlingen voort te zetten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Ham over mogelijke discriminatie van een school en de regels van het ministerie omtrent examens

An MP asked the education minister how he views a school's alleged discrimination against a dyscalculic pupil denied a formula card at exams, and why the ministry refused exceptions despite the Commission for Equal Treatment's view. The minister refused exceptions citing the value of the diploma and exam requirements, said no conflict with equal treatment law exists, and pointed to a protocol and a research project in progress.
I already made clear immediately that there would be no exceptions because the central exam was about to begin.
Ik heb al meteen laten weten dat er geen uitzonderingen zullen komen omdat het centraal examen op het punt stond te beginnen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Ham over het verdwijnen van de studie Fries

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether the disappearance of the only Dutch university Frisian language and culture programme at the RuG is acceptable, and how Frisian expertise will be safeguarded. The State Secretary replied that the bachelor's programme remains a separate, registered programme and will be embedded in a new broad European languages and cultures bachelor, which he considers the best way to preserve Frisian knowledge.

I understand that the bachelor's programme in Frisian language and culture – contrary to earlier reports – will be maintained as a separate programme and will remain registered in the Central Register of Higher Education Programmes.

Ik heb begrepen dat de bacheloropleiding Friese taal en cultuur – in afwijking van eerdere berichtgeving daarover – als afzonderlijke opleiding wordt gehandhaafd en geregistreerd blijft in het Centraal Register Opleidingen Hoger Onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over het bericht ‘Overheid verplicht Uitzending Gemist tot tijdslot’

An MP asked whether the 22:00 time-slot rule for 16+ programmes on the public broadcaster's online service is effective given YouTube and commercial platforms lack such a rule, and whether it unduly restricts adults. The minister defends the measure as a child-protection step within the Mediawet, applied only to public broadcasting, and says a better age-verification system would be preferred but is not yet available.
