I realise that this does not produce a watertight system.
Ik realiseer me dat dit geen waterdicht systeem oplevert.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over het bericht dat scholengroep Amarantis in acute financiële nood zit door het kopen van renteverzekeringen

An MP asked the education minister about reports that school group Amarantis was in acute financial distress partly due to interest-rate derivatives, whether such purchases are policy, and whether other institutions hold derivatives. The minister replied that the distress stems from operating deficits and a lender's threatened call of financing, that derivatives hedging interest risk are permitted under the 2010 investment regulation, and that the Inspectorate will conduct a critical risk analysis of publicly funded vocational education finances, with results after the summer.
The use of derivatives does not necessarily have to be reported in detail in the annual reports.
Het gebruik van derivaten hoeft namelijk niet in detail in de jaarverslagen vermeld te worden.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over het terugtrekken van een satirisch tv-item

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why a satirical item about God and Allah on the AVRO programme Neonletters was withdrawn, and whether fear of public uproar is a valid reason not to broadcast such material. The minister replied that broadcasters have programmatic autonomy and that it is not for her to judge editorial choices, and that the AVRO stated uproar was not the reason for dropping the item.
Broadcasters in the Netherlands have programmatic autonomy.
Omroepen in Nederland hebben programmatische autonomie.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over de medezeggenschap aan het Stedelijk Lyceum te Enschede.

An MP asked whether works council members can enforce a Geschillencommissie ruling against a school board, and whether the Ondernemingskamer procedure and a lack of legal remedy create a gap in protection. The minister confirmed the Ondernemingskamer handles compliance disputes but a works council lacks legal personality, so individual members must go to the voorzieningenrechter, declined a funding sanction, and saw no gap as she considers the existing route adequate.
Therefore in this case one or more members of the works council, as natural persons, will have to go to the interim relief judge to enforce compliance with the ruling.
Daarom zal in dit geval een of meerdere leden van het medezeggenschapsorgaan als natuurlijk persoon naar de voorzieningenrechter dienen te gaan om naleving van de uitspraak af te dwingen.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over beschadiging en roof van openbare kunstwerken

An MP asked the state secretary how the government responds to theft and damage of public artworks for their bronze, and whether theft is rising and how heritage protection and expert advice are used. The government answered that thefts rose about 20% in 2011, pointed to the Actie Koperslag covenant and heritage protection programmes, and said that casts are rarely preserved but new ones can be made.
In response to the rising number of copper thefts, the minister of Security and Justice took additional measures and signed the Actie Koperslag covenant on 30 June 2011.
In reactie op het stijgende aantal koperdiefstallen heeft de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie extra maatregelen genomen en op 30 juni 2011 het convenant Actie Koperslag ondertekend.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over de lange termijn voor het terugstorten van de borg op gratis schoolboeken

MP Van der Ham asked the Education Minister whether a legal deadline exists for refunding the deposit on free school textbooks, how long refunds take, and how much money is involved. The minister answered that no statutory deadline exists, deposits are arranged between schools and parents, and agreed conditions apply; she referred to the evaluation for the deposit amounts, noting about three quarters of schools with external book funds charged a deposit, typically 75 euros.
No deadline for refunding the deposit is included in the education legislation.
Er is in de onderwijswetgeving geen termijn opgenomen voor terugstorting van de borg.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over de financiering van de wetenschappelijke functie van het Geld- en Bankmuseum

MP Van der Ham asked whether the Geld- en Bankmuseum is ceasing most of its scholarly work after a temporary Finance Ministry subsidy ended, and whether that work could be moved to another institution to preserve expertise. The state secretary confirmed that the temporary supplementary subsidy ended while the regular subsidy continues, and said the museum itself must decide how to handle its scholarly function, which is not among the exceptions to the subsidy cut.
I am happy to leave it to the Geld- en Bankmuseum itself to decide how the museum's scholarly function is handled.
Ik laat graag aan het Geld- en Bankmuseum zelf over hoe met de wetenschappelijke functie van het museum omgegaan wordt.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de grote vertraging van het innen van boetes door de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) en een coulanceregeling (inge

MP Van der Ham asked why about 20,000 students are only now being billed for exceeding the side-job income limit from two years ago, and whether DUO informed them adequately and should offer a hardship scheme. The state secretary answered that the delay stems from the tax-data process, the rules in force at the time apply, information was adequate per the Ombudsman, and no hardship scheme will be created.
I am of the opinion that the side-job income limit and the way the claim can be settled are lenient enough.
Ik ben van mening dat de bijverdiengrens en de wijze waarop de vordering kan worden voldaan coulant genoeg is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Ham over het minder zwaar maken van de eisen op de TU Delft

An MP asks the state secretary whether TU Delft's plan to reduce study load and allow compensation between exams is a lowering of academic standards, and whether ministry will consult the university. The state secretary answers that the changes are part of a quality-improvement plan funded by the ministry, that compensation is legally permitted, and that no new consultation is needed since programmes are accredited by NVAO.
I do not consider this a negative lowering of the level.
Ik vind dit geen negatieve niveaubijstelling.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold, Berndsen en Van der Ham (allen D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat justitie een blunder heeft begaan in een kunstroofzaak (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

The D66 MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Public Prosecution Service delayed an art theft case by failing to hand it over in time to a new prosecutor, and whether a national art crime prosecutor and registry agreements with the police have been realised. The Minister acknowledges the delay, attributing it to multiple causes such as defence requests and a suspect's illness, and says a national art crime specialisation is being built as police capacity becomes available.
Although I regret the delay, I attach importance to criminal cases in general, and complex criminal cases in particular, being prepared and handled carefully and optimally.
Hoewel ik de vertraging betreur hecht ik eraan dat strafzaken in het algemeen, en complexe strafzaken in het bijzonder, zorgvuldig en optimaal worden voorbereid en behandeld.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham inzake medezeggenschap Stedelijk Lyceum Enschede

An MP asked the education minister how the government responds to a school board ignoring binding rulings of the national school dispute commission and the Enterprise Chamber on participation rights at Stedelijk Lyceum Enschede, and whether the WMS should give councils stronger enforcement tools, including cost reimbursement and an enquiry right. The minister said parties must comply with rulings, that councils can seek enforcement at the Enterprise Chamber and funding can be withdrawn, that the WMS is under evaluation with proposals to be considered in a policy response, and that no enquiry right is planned for primary and secondary education.
At present I am having the WMS evaluated, examining the effectiveness and effects of the law in practice.
Op dit moment laat ik de WMS evalueren, waarbij gekeken wordt naar de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van de wet in de praktijk.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over nog steeds ontbrekende voorzieningen voor leerlingen zonder verblijfsvergunning die op stage moeten (in

D66 MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a 'stoutfonds' that would reimburse employers' fines for hosting internship students without residence permits, and about the lack of a legal solution for such students. The minister said he finds funding fines improper and that the cabinet will not propose a way to allow illegally resident youths to do internships, nor make any interim arrangement.
The cabinet will not submit proposals to make it possible for young people residing illegally in the Netherlands to do internships.
Het kabinet zal geen voorstellen indienen om het mogelijk te maken dat jongeren die illegaal in Nederland verblijven stage kunnen lopen.
Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks) en Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanscherping van de gedoogcriteria (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Dibi and Van der Ham asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the tightened coffeeshop criteria (wietpas/club card) should not wait for a plenary drugs debate, how many municipal councils oppose it, and whether irreversible measures could be deferred. The minister replied that the policy is government policy, that enforcement will be phased in from 1 May 2012 in three southern provinces with municipalities and the Public Prosecution Service enforcing under existing responsibilities, and that the change is not irreversible.
I would have preferred to hold the debate with your House earlier.
Ik zou liever eerder het debat met uw Kamer hebben gevoerd.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de verschraling van profileringsfondsen van hoger onderwijsinstellingen (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

Van der Ham (D66) asked the state secretary of Education, Culture and Science how the size of universities' and colleges' profileringsfondsen (profiling funds for student grants) is developing, what this means for grants, whether spending priorities are shifting, and how claims and their total value have evolved. The secretary said he has no current data, will receive institutional figures in mid-2012, and cited a 2010 Inspectorate report showing fund sizes rising from 2004 to 2008 with no clear shift between categories.
I have ensured that from 2011 institutions will include data on the size of the profiling fund in their annual accounts.
Ik heb ervoor gezorgd dat de instellingen vanaf 2011 in hun jaarrekening gegevens over de hoogte van het profileringsfonds gaan opnemen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over grensoverschrijdend leerlingenvervoer (ingezonden 15 november 2011).

An MP asks the Education minister about a deaf boy from Maastricht who must travel 120 km or board to reach deaf education, while a nearer school in Hasselt, Belgium exists, and whether cross-border school transport should be enabled. The minister replies that school transport is decentralised to municipalities, which may decide case by case, that no similar cases are known, and that no law change is needed.
The implementation of pupil transport has been decentralised to the municipality.
De uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer is gedecentraliseerd naar de gemeente.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over borg en handel rond schoolboeken (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An MP asked the education minister whether the government knew of Van Dijk Educatie's book-exchange and deposit actions, whether it is acceptable that commercial parties earn interest on deposits and convert part of them into shop credit, and whether similar actions by other suppliers exist. The minister replied that the deposit is a matter between schools, parents and the supplier, that the government sees no reason to intervene in these commercial arrangements, that it will not regulate the deposit amount, and that other such actions are not known to her, while urging all parties to follow agreed deposit principles.

As long as initiatives do not conflict with this purpose, there is no compulsory shop purchasing, and the interests of the school, pupil or parent are not jeopardised, I see no reason to interfere in this kind of commercial action.

Zolang initiatieven niet strijdig zijn met dit doel, er geen sprake is van gedwongen winkelnering en de belangen van de school, leerling of ouder niet in het gedrang komen, zie ik geen reden mij te mengen in dit soort commerciële acties.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat duizenden leerlingen onterecht thuis zitten (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

MP Van der Ham (D66) asked the education minister about reports that thousands of pupils are wrongly kept at home (thuiszitters), whether research into their numbers will be done, how their right to education and legal protection are guaranteed, and how school pupil files and their privacy are handled. The minister answered that a 2010 Ingrado study exists, that new figures come in early 2012, that legal remedies (objection, appeal, civil court, complaints committees) exist, and that policy on passend onderwijs and pupil-file rules will be reviewed.
I see no reason to carry out further supplementary research on this theme.
Ik zie geen reden om op dit thema verder aanvullend onderzoek te doen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over thuiszittende leerlingen (ingezonden 22 november 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Education to address the case of a nearly 13-year-old pupil in Den Bosch who has been staying at home from school after illness and bullying. The minister replied that the case has her attention, that it is not a hopeless home-schooling situation, and that school, truancy officer, parents and support services are seeking a solution with other schools willing to take the pupil.
The talks with the parents will continue and I have every confidence that a solution will be found in the short term.
De gesprekken met de ouders worden voortgezet en ik heb er alle vertrouwen in dat op korte termijn een oplossing wordt gevonden.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het Tropenmuseum (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

MP Van der Ham (D66) asked how the government will keep supporting the Tropenmuseum now that its funding through the development cooperation budget is being removed, and how this fits with its pledge to spare heritage management from irresponsible cuts. State secretary Zijlstra answered that the museum must present a viable plan, possibly through closer cooperation or merger within the OCW museum system, and that the foreign affairs state secretary may consider a contribution under conditions.
The state secretary of Foreign Affairs will ask the Tropenmuseum to come up with a plan to offer a viable perspective within the OCW museum system after decoupling from the KIT.
De staatsecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken zal het Tropenmuseum vragen met een plan te komen om, na ontkoppeling van het KIT, een levensvatbaar perspectief in het museale bestel van OCW te bieden.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het tekort aan leraren Duits (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about the shortage of German teachers, including how many German teachers from Germany teach in the Netherlands, whether pupils can follow lessons fully in German, the size of the shortage, and the number of students in German teacher training. The state secretary said the number of German teachers from Germany is unknown, had no concrete signals about pupils' comprehension, reported a 1.7 vacancy ratio for German in secondary education for 2010-2011, and gave student enrolment figures rising from 572 in 2005 to 810 in 2010.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretarissen van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Financiën over het bericht dat de verkoop van kaarten voor het komende theaterseizoen sterk is gedaald (ingezond

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries whether theatre ticket presales fell 18% after the VAT increase on performing arts, what this means for supply, budget revenue, and whether the VAT rise should be reversed. The government said the only data are from the sector association, that demand may fall given price elasticity, that it is too early to judge effects, and that it sees no reason to reverse the decision, while promising to monitor developments.
As promised during the treatment of the Tax Plan 2011 in the Senate, developments in the performing arts sector will be monitored.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2011 in de Eerste Kamer, zullen de ontwikkelingen in de podiumkunstensector gemonitord worden.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister en staatsecretaris van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap inzake de nieuwste OESO-cijfers «education at a glance» (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

An MP asked the education minister and state secretary to react to OECD Education at a Glance 2011 figures showing Dutch education spending near the OECD average, whether this undermines the ambition to be a top-five knowledge economy, why higher-education spending has not kept pace with student numbers, and whether the government will reconsider its policy. The government answered that spending is around the OECD average, that per-student higher-education spending is roughly unchanged, rejected the characterisation of underinvestment and said it sees no reason to change policy.
The cabinet explicitly distances itself from the characterisation 'falling short' and sees no reason to reconsider the policy.
Het kabinet neemt nadrukkelijk afstand van de kwalificatie «tekortschietend» en ziet ook geen aanleiding om het beleid te heroverwegen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Van der Ham (beiden D66) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over onjuiste informatie in debat met de Kamer, met name over onderwijsuitgaven (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

D66 MPs Pechtold and Van der Ham asked Prime Minister Rutte whether his claim that the Netherlands ranks fifth on the Global Competitiveness Index for education spending was correct, given that the GCI ranks it eighth and contains few education indicators. Rutte answered that his statements were based on the GCI and OECD data, that the Kennisinvesteringsagenda is not a better basis, and that the cabinet will keep drawing on multiple sources.
No. The statements were supported by the cited GCI and OECD figures.
Nee. De uitspraken waren onderbouwd door de genoemde cijfers van GCI en OESO.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht inzake de negatieve gevolgen van het verhogen van de m

MPs Schouw and Van der Ham (D66) asked why residence fees for non-EU students rose on 1 July 2011, whether this harms access and was properly communicated, and whether the effects will be reported. The minister confirmed the increase (e.g. EUR 433 to 600 for an MVV application), said it is meant to raise cost recovery and will not deter students, offered coulance for applications already paid, and agreed to report instroomcijfers alongside fee levels, while noting a causal link is hard to establish.
Of course I am willing to inform the House.
Vanzelfsprekend ben ik bereid om de Kamer te informeren.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de kwaliteit van onderwijsassistenten (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP asks the education minister about the poor Dutch-language skills of teaching assistants found in an Amsterdam survey, how the inspectorate supervised this, and what will be done to raise their level. The minister replies that competence is the responsibility of school boards and the Amsterdam municipality, that the inspectorate does not assess individual staff, and that new language reference levels in vocational training will be centrally examined from 2013-2014.
The inspectorate does not assess the quality of individual staff members working at primary schools; this is the exclusive responsibility of the school board.
De inspectie beoordeelt niet de kwaliteit van individuele personeelsleden werkzaam aan basisscholen; dit is de exclusieve verantwoordelijkheid van het bestuur van de school.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretarissen van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het Holland Paviljoen in New York (ingezo

MP Van der Ham (D66) asked whether the Holland Pavilion in New York, costing 1.7 million euro, functions well, whether its use fulfils its intended cultural purpose, what the opening cost, and whether the government will evaluate and improve its use. The minister replied that the project meets its 2008 objectives, that the pavilion now serves as an information point and café, that the opening-related costs were 39,052 euro, and that no further evaluation is planned because primary functions are performed satisfactorily.
Are you willing to evaluate the functioning of the Holland Pavilion and to examine how it can still be used in a better way?
Bent u bereid het functioneren van het Holland Paviljoen te evalueren en te bezien hoe het alsnog op een betere wijze benut kan worden?

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een uitzonderingspositie voor Godsdienst Pastoraal Werk (GPW) inzake tweede-studieregeling (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011

An MP asks why the education ministry made an exception for the Godsdienst Pastoraal Werk programme regarding extra fees for a second study, and why other programmes are not treated the same. The state secretary replies that the exception is a temporary compensation for transition problems under the new funding model for 2011-2015, based on HBO-raad criteria, and that it is not funding of a second study; he accepts that second studies aid talent but says public funds are limited.
On the basis of these criteria, only the Godsdienst-Pastoraalwerk programme qualifies for compensation during 2011-2015, after which an evaluation will take place.
Aan de hand van deze criteria komt alleen de opleiding Godsdienst-Pastoraalwerk in aanmerking voor compensatie gedurende de periode 2011–2015, waarna een evaluatie zal plaatsvinden.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over uitspraken van de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap betreffende de BTW-verhoging op Podiumkunsten

MP Van der Ham asks whether the state secretary considers the VAT increase on performing arts a poorly considered policy decision, whether such decisions should be well-founded, and whether the increase will be reversed. The government denies calling it poorly considered, says it was adopted by majority in both chambers, and refuses to reverse it.
The cabinet sees no reason to reverse the decision-making, which was reached with the approval of a majority of your House.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de besluitvorming, die met instemming van een meerderheid van uw Kamer tot stand is gekomen, terug te draaien.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het beter aanbesteden van de «gratis schoolboeken» (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP asks the Education Minister whether she agrees with a newspaper article's criticisms of the free school textbooks law and its procurement, and whether the evaluation can be brought forward. The minister answers that the topics are covered in the evaluation nearing completion and promises to send it in September.
I will send you the evaluation and my response in September, in which I will address the topics mentioned.
Ik stuur u in september de evaluatie en mijn reactie, waarin ik in ga op genoemde onderwerpen, toe.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de website van DUO onveilig is (ingezond

D66 MPs asked the education and interior ministers how the DUO website could be hacked again despite an earlier audit, whether other government sites are similarly vulnerable, and what will prevent recurrence. The minister regrets the incident, says the flaw was repaired and sites checked, denies the system is unreliable, notes that incidents cannot be fully prevented, and points to the audit recommendations and a criminal complaint.
I regret that for the second time an incident has occurred on the DUO website.
Ik betreur dat er voor de tweede keer een incident op de website van DUO heeft plaatsgevonden.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya, Van der Ham en Schouw (allen D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de belemmeringen voor het lop

MPs from D66 asked why youths awaiting a residence permit cannot do internships during regular education, and whether the government will drop the work permit requirement and suspend fines for employers. The government answered that such internships count as work under the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen, that it will not change the law or suspend fines, and only urges schools to issue school statements.
The cabinet will therefore not change the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen on this point.
Dit kabinet zal de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen op dit punt dan ook niet wijzigen.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretarissen van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Veiligheid en Justitie over naburige rechten medewerkers en makers van film en tvproducties (ingezonden 11 mei 2

An MP asked why the amended Article 45d of the Dutch Neighbouring Rights Act considers only the producer's position, not the makers' such as directors and actors, and about low fees and weak bargaining positions of makers in film and TV, including comparison with Germany. The government answered that the rules seek a balance between producers and makers, that makers are structurally weaker in negotiations, that disputes over fees are for courts, and that a copyright contract law bill to strengthen makers' position will go to the Council of Ministers in summer 2011.
Strengthening the contractual position of the author and performing artist vis-à-vis their exploiter I have designated as one of the priorities of my policy.
Het versterken van de contractuele positie van de auteur en uitvoerende kunstenaar in de verhouding tot zijn exploitant heb ik als een van de speerpunten van mijn beleid aangemerkt.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over betrokkenheid van het bedrijfsleven bij het hbo (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science how he would respond to calls by MKB-Nederland and VNO-NCW for stronger business involvement in higher vocational education, and how that involvement could be strengthened. The state secretary agreed business involvement matters but rejected a statutory role for employers as in vocational education, favouring stronger dialogue, centres of expertise and planned labour-market analyses and pilots instead.
For higher vocational education, I see more benefit in intensifying dialogue and cooperation between institutions and employers (organisations) than in establishing a statutory role for employers.
Voor het hbo zie ik meer heil in intensivering van de dialoog en samenwerking tussen instellingen en werkgevers(organisaties) dan in het vastleggen van een wettelijke rol voor werkgevers.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschappen over gouden handdrukken bij InHolland (ingezonden 20 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about golden handshakes and lease-car benefits paid to two top executives of Inholland, and whether the money could be reclaimed. The state secretary confirmed the facts, said the severance stayed within the applicable limits, and declined to claw back the payments.
Since in these cases there is no question of excessive severance payments, I see no reason to proceed to reclaim the money.
Aangezien er in deze gevallen geen sprake is van bovenmatige ontslagvergoedingen, zie ik geen aanleiding om tot terugvordering over te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over buitenlandse beurzen (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MPs Van der Ham and Verhoeven asked why the government is ending the Huygens Scholarship Programme for Dutch students at top foreign universities, and what the effects and alternatives are. The state secretary defended the cut as affecting a small group relative to the wider internationalisation infrastructure, pointed to other scholarships, Erasmus and student finance, and said no quantitative target would be set.
In filling the subsidy cut target I gave priority to maintaining the infrastructure for internationalisation of higher education, which has a wider reach.
Ik heb bij het invullen van de subsidietaakstelling prioriteit gegeven aan het in stand houden van de infrastructuur voor de internationalisering van het hoger onderwijs, die een breder bereik heeft.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de gevolgen voor het uitgaansleven van gewijzigde BUMA regels (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

MPs Van der Ham and Verhoeven asked the state secretary about BUMA's lowered fee threshold for live performances, its effects on clubs and venues, the number of events affected, the VAT increase, and the expected revenue. The state secretary answered that the threshold change was agreed with Koninklijke Horeca Nederland, costs are hard to estimate, about 5000 events of roughly 100000 may be affected, the VAT increase played no role, and BUMA distributes collected amounts under its rules.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen met de financiering van de lokale omroep (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why several municipalities are not meeting their statutory duty under the Mediawet 2008 to fund local public media, and whether the minister will enforce compliance. The minister replies that funding is the municipalities' responsibility, that the Commissariaat voor de Media handles enforcement and has acted only once, and that affected media organisations can appeal in court.
Funding of local public media institutions is a responsibility of the municipalities.
De bekostiging van de lokale publieke media-instellingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten.
Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de actuele situatie ten aanzien van medicinale cannabis (ingezonden 18 april 2011).

MPs Van der Ham and Dijkstra asked the health minister about medicinal cannabis: a cancer-appetite study, the BMC's evidence review and research duties, patient supply and alternatives, insurance coverage, and registration prospects. The minister answered that the evidence is not yet sufficient for a formal assessment, that research is a pharmaceutical-industry task, that varieties will be added only if demand is substantial, and that certain information (prescription counts, manufacturer plans) is unavailable or confidential.
No, this information is not available.
Nee, deze informatie is niet beschikbaar.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over verdwenen kunstvoorwerpen (ingezonden 8 maart 2011).

MP Van der Ham asks the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science and the Justice minister about reports that the central government has lost thousands of artworks from its collection, whether searches have failed, what action will recover them, and the status of a register of stolen art. The government replies that the losses were already reported to parliament in 2005, 2007 and 2008, that the missing works remain listed online and an evaluation of the materiel management scheme will be sent to parliament before summer 2011 with an updated list, and that a stolen-art register has been operational since early 2010 for police and justice use.
I will then also publish an updated list of missing artworks and examine the possibility of adding images to that list.
Ik zal dan ook een geactualiseerde lijst van vermiste kunstwerken publiceren en de mogelijkheid onderzoeken om die lijst te voorzien van afbeeldingen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over aanpak wietteelt (ingezonden 13 april 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responds to a police report finding too little follow-up investigation in cannabis cultivation cases, and what he will do to make investigations deeper rather than focused on low-hanging fruit. The minister rejected the claim that the approach is failing, agreed that priority should go to organised crime and neighbourhood safety, and said the approach already targets criminal networks and their finances.
I do not share the article's conclusion that the approach to cannabis cultivation is failing.
Ik deel niet de conclusie van het artikel dat de aanpak van hennepteelt faalt.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het behoud van onderwijsaanbod op Texel (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

An MP asks the education minister why compensation for De Hogeberg school on Texel is no longer justified, what the loss of a broad vocational curriculum means for school dropout and whether talks with the school board are possible. The minister explains the new exception-school policy, says the school does not meet the enrolment criterion, places curriculum decisions with the school board and agrees to talks within existing rules.
Yes, within the framework of existing regulations I am prepared to enter into consultation with the board of De Hogeberg on Texel
Ja, binnen de kaders van de bestaande regelgeving ben ik bereid in overleg te treden met het bestuur van De Hogeberg op Texel
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over subsidie religieus vormingsonderwijs op openbare scholen (ingezonden 23 maart 2011).

The MP asks the Minister of Education about the state of religious and worldview education in public schools, its numbers and costs, whether schools must buy it from the Dienstencentrum GVO/HVO, and why it is subsidised since 2009 given separation of church and state. The Minister answers that about 70,000 pupils receive it at EUR 10 million per year, that the organisations employing the teachers are responsible for content and schools buy it from them, and that subsidy followed parliamentary pressure, with the Onderwijsraad seeing no constitutional bar.
Yes, G/HVO has been subsidised since 1 August 2009, after a long debate between successive cabinets and the House and at the House's urging.
Ja het G/HVO wordt na een langdurig debat tussen opeenvolgende kabinetten en de Kamer en op aandrang van de Kamer vanaf 1 augustus 2009 gesubsidieerd.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gratis schoolboeken (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education whether she would respond to the competition authority's finding that competition and prices in school book provision had not improved under the free school books law, and asked about the small number of publishers and whether she would reconsider the scheme. The Minister replied that the findings will be considered within the broader evaluation of the Free School Books Act, overseen by an expert committee, and that she will send the evaluation report to parliament once available.
When the results of the evaluation of the WGS are known, I will send the evaluation report with my response to your House.
Wanneer de resultaten van de evaluatie van de WGS bekend zijn, stuur ik het evaluatierapport met mijn reactie naar uw Kamer.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham (D66), Lucas (VVD), Jadnanansing (PvdA), De Rouwe (CDA), Jasper van Dijk (SP), Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de boeten rond de bijve

MPs asked the state secretary about DUO's letters to about 20,000 students who exceeded the income limit for study grants in 2008, the switch to gross income, appeal options, repayment of OV-card costs and possible hardship relief. The state secretary said the number fits a rising trend, that appeals against DUO decisions are possible while the income figure itself must be contested with the tax authority, and that no hardship scheme is planned.
I see no possibilities to arrive at a hardship scheme for this group.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om voor deze groep tot een coulance-regeling te komen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over hulp bij GHB-verslaving (partydrug) (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about shortfalls in treatment capacity and detoxification protocols for GHB addiction, and about information provision on GHB. The minister replied that waiting lists exist mainly in Brabant and the north, that a new detoxification protocol is being developed with participating institutions, and that existing drug information measures are considered sufficient.
Given the health risks that can arise in the detoxification process as part of treating GHB addiction, I am promoting a project in which addiction care institutions participate

Mede gelet op de gezondheidsrisico's die kunnen optreden bij het detoxificatieproces als onderdeel van de behandeling van GHB-verslaving stimuleer ik een project waarbij de verslavingszorginstellingen participeren

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebrek aan talent, kennis en kunde als grootste act

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Education and Economic Affairs how they respond to business concerns that budget cuts to education threaten Dutch attractiveness for talent and growth, and how German business confidence relates to German knowledge investment. The minister answered that the cuts match intensifications, that Dutch attractiveness rests on multiple factors, that the top-sector policy will help, and that German confidence reflects export performance rather than knowledge investment.
The cabinet faces the task of restoring public finances to order.
Het kabinet staat voor de opgave om de overheidsfinanciën weer op orde te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over spreidingsbeleid (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Education whether her policy has shifted from black schools to weak schools, and how she would deal with local governments still pursuing postal-code based placement, and whether such forced dispersal limits free school choice. The Minister answers that she values freedom of education and does not oppose local initiatives within the bounds of the law that bring pupils of different backgrounds together.
I attach value to freedom of education.
Ik hecht aan de vrijheid van onderwijs.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een quotum voor «allochtone deskundigen» op de publieke omroep (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

MP Van der Ham asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the public broadcaster NPO counting non-Western immigrants on screen by appearance and whether this quota-like practice harms people judged on merit. The Minister said the NPO disputed the reported method, that broadcasters bear responsibility for programming under the statutory mandate and performance agreement, and that she would discuss representativeness with the broadcasters in periodic consultation.
How the public broadcaster gives shape to its statutory mandate and programmes in the performance agreement is up to the public broadcaster.
Hoe de publieke omroep in de programma's vorm geeft aan zijn wettelijke taakopdracht en de programma's in de prestatieovereenkomst, is aan de publieke omroep.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat scholen nog steeds formeel homoseksuele leraren weigeren (ingezonden 19 januari 2011).

An MP asked the education minister how she views the VGS reformed school federation's new identity profile on hiring gay teachers, after reports that schools still refuse them. The minister replied that the profile replaces earlier controversial declarations, that VGS consulted the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling and clarified the legal limits on discrimination based on homosexuality, and that VGS will remind member schools of these limits.
VGS considers it very important that the reformed schools remain within the limits of the law when applying the new identity profile.
VGS acht het van groot belang dat de reformatorische scholen bij het hanteren van het nieuwe identiteitsprofiel binnen de grenzen van de wet blijven.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschappen over «Verklaringen omtrent Gedrag» (VOG’s) voor jongeren en werk (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

Rep. Van der Ham (D66) asked the minister about the problem that refusals of Certificates of Conduct (VOG) can block young people's internships and jobs, and how to balance this against their chances after minor offences. The state secretary answered that refusals are rare (under 1% of applications by under-25s in 2010), that each case is weighed individually, and that employers may still hire a refused applicant unless a VOG is legally required.
Only in cases where, given the risk to society, it is necessary is the issuing of the VOG refused.
Slechts in de gevallen waarin het, gelet op het risico voor de samenleving, noodzakelijk is wordt de afgifte van de VOG geweigerd.

Vragen van lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over openbaarheid gebruik gemeenschapsgeld door (bijzonder) onderwijsinstellingen in het Hoger Onderwijs (ingezonden 4 februar

MP Van der Ham asked whether higher education institutions, including special (bijzondere) ones, should be obliged to make expense claims of their executives public, and whether the Wob applies to them. The state secretary replied that no duty exists but transparency is expected, that the annual accounts and Wopt cover executive pay, and that he will explore publishing categories of declarations.
I do not think it is right that there can be a difference in insight into declaration data between public universities and special institutions.
Ik vind het niet juist dat er verschil kan bestaan in inzicht in gegevens over declaraties tussen openbare universiteiten en bijzondere instellingen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over fraude op de Hogeschool Zwolle (ingezonden 4 februari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that exam fraud via easily forged student cards was possible at Hogeschool Windesheim in Zwolle, and about how widespread such systems and verification are. The state secretary answered that the institution did not identify the students involved and no whistleblower scheme was used, that identity verification is the institution's responsibility, and that fraud can be sanctioned and prosecuted, while expecting institutions to review their systems.
I am not aware whether other institutions use the same system as Hogeschool Windesheim.
Het is mij niet bekend of andere instellingen met hetzelfde systeem als Hogeschool Windesheim werken.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over onderzoek dat uitwijst dat de uitgangspunten voor het beleid om scholen geen geld te geven voor het wegwerken van

MPs Van der Ham and Schouw (D66) asked the education minister whether a study showing ethnic origin still matters for early school disadvantage undermines the policy of not using ethnicity in the school weighting scheme. The minister replied that the findings were not new, that ethnicity was deliberately not used in favour of parental education, income and benefit dependency via the impulse regime, and that no further research was needed.
At the time it was decided, with very broad support from the House, that apart from parental education level, ethnicity would not be used as a second criterion, but another criterion instead.
Destijds is besloten met zeer brede steun van de Kamer dat naast opleidingsniveau van de ouders niet de etniciteit als tweede criterium gebruikt zou worden, maar een ander criterium.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de bezuiniging op het hoger onderwijs (ingezonden 4 februari 2011).

Van der Ham (D66) asks the state secretary to justify his claim that cuts to universities, hogescholen and a fine on long-term students are also an investment in higher education, and how much net money goes to higher education. Zijlstra answers that the net effect is a small cut of EUR 10 million by 2015, that the education budget as a whole is not part of the EUR 18 billion savings, and that the cuts are meant to improve quality and efficiency, with investment mainly from 2016 onward.
I will come back to this in the Spring Memorandum.
Ik kom hierop terug bij de Voorjaarsnota.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de maatschappelijke stage (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

An MP asked the education minister about criticism that many schools do not properly implement the mandatory social internship (maatschappelijke stage) and underspend the per-pupil funding on supervision. The minister rejects the criticism, defends school autonomy and the mandatory internship, and declines to set an hourly supervision rate.
I stand behind the national obligation.
Ik sta achter de landelijke verplichting.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister en de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een lijst met «ongewenste» kinderboeken (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asks the minister and state secretary of Education, Culture and Science how they view publishers using a list of 'sensitive' topics for Protestant-Christian schools, and whether government does business with such publishers. The minister says she has taken note of the matter and that the government does not do business with educational publishers, since schools choose their own methods to meet the core objectives.
No. The government does not do business with educational publishers.
Neen. De overheid doet geen zaken met educatieve uitgevers.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de Nederlandse Film (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

MP Van der Ham (D66) asked the state secretary how he views the Film Fund director's warning that Dutch film is in a difficult position without adequate fiscal tools to attract international productions, whether he will reconsider the fiscal regime, and what employment and revenue effects a contraction of the film industry would have. The state secretary replied that he has asked the Council for Culture to examine a tax shelter mechanism to attract investment in Dutch film as part of a broader review of cultural tax measures, and that the sector reports revenue losses of 15 to 20 percent at post-production firms and suppliers.
In this connection I have asked the Council for Culture to examine options for introducing a tax shelter mechanism
In dit verband heb ik de Raad voor Cultuur gevraagd in te gaan op mogelijkheden voor de introductie van een «tax shelter»-mechanisme
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een inventarisatie naar de sluiting van coffeeshops door voorgenomen kabinetsbeleid (ingezonden 6 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that most coffeeshops would close under the coalition's 350-metre school-distance rule, whether a list of affected shops would be published, and whether a baseline study on street drug dealing would be conducted. The minister declined to publish a list, said the effects on street dealing must be awaited, and indicated consultation with municipalities within the coalition framework.
I therefore see no reason to draw up a list as you intend.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om een lijst zoals door u bedoeld op te stellen.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de ontwikkeling van passend onderwijs en de betrokkenheid van ouders daarbij (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

An MP asks the minister how and when parent organisations are involved in drafting the bill to legally anchor inclusive education, and what actions have been taken to strengthen parents' position since February 2010. The minister lists consultations with parent and sector organisations, notes that sector bodies and unions stopped talks, describes a separate meeting with parent groups in January 2011, and says the reference framework work has resumed with parent involvement.
To keep involving the parent organisations in preparing the bill, a separate meeting with the parent organisations was held on 6 January.
Om de ouderorganisaties bij de voorbereiding van het wetsvoorstel te blijven betrekken, is er op 6 januari jl. een apart overleg met de ouderorganisaties geweest.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de ministers voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Buitenlandse Zaken over de nieuwste cijfers over vermoorde journalisten (ingezonden 31 december 2010).

An MP asked ministers about the latest Reporters without Borders figures on journalists killed or kidnapped in 2010, and whether the Netherlands would press the issue of press freedom internationally and ask more of UNESCO. The government condemned violence against journalists, said it already advocates press freedom in the EU, Council of Europe and UN, and considers further UNESCO initiatives unnecessary.
The Dutch government sees the annual Reporters without Borders overview as an incentive to continue this advocacy with force and conviction.
De Nederlandse regering ziet het jaarlijks overzicht van Reporters without borders als een aansporing om dit pleidooi met kracht en overtuiging voort te zetten.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister-president over uitspraken over het hoger onderwijs (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Prime Minister how budget cuts and quality investments in higher education relate over 2011-2015, what evidence supports claims of insufficient quality, how contact hours will increase, which red tape will be cut, and how school consolidation will be curbed. The government answered that a quality boost of 50 to 300 million euros is planned alongside cuts, that quality is largely in order but needs improvement via agreements with institutions, and described existing instruments such as a merger test law and red-tape reduction programmes.
Your House will be informed annually about the progress of these agreements.
Uw Kamer wordt jaarlijks geïnformeerd over de voortgang daarvan.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof dat de financiering van de Nederlandse publieke omroep deels staatssteun betreft (ingezonde

MP Van der Ham asks the Education, Culture and Science minister how she responds to the EU General Court ruling that part of Dutch public broadcasting funding is state aid requiring repayment of 76 million euro from the NOS, and what financing is involved and what consequences follow. The minister answers that repayment (86.5 million euro including interest) was already made in 2006 since the appeal had no suspensive effect, that she is still considering a further appeal, and that because the amount is repaid the ruling has no consequences for broadcasting policy or programming.
The amount of 86.5 million euro (repayment amount plus interest) has therefore already been repaid by the public broadcaster to the State.
Het bedrag van € 86,5 miljoen (terugvorderingsbedrag + rente) is dus al door de publieke omroep aan de Staat terugbetaald.

Vragen van de leden Koolmees en Van der Ham (beiden D66) aan de minister van Financiën en de staatsecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de financiële gevolgen van de BTW-verhoging op kunst voor alternatie

MPs Koolmees and Van der Ham asked whether art dealers importing art via the UK to avoid the 2011 VAT increase is legal, and about the revenue loss and competitiveness effects. The government answered that such imports are legal if genuine transactions, that no evasion was factored into revenue estimates, and that the revenue loss cannot yet be quantified, while giving illustrative examples and an EU rate overview.
If supervision by the Tax Authority shows that sham constructions are being used to avoid VAT on imports that actually take place in the Netherlands, these constructions will be tackled.

Indien in het toezicht door de Belastingdienst blijkt dat sprake is van schijnconstructies met het doel te voorkomen dat btw wordt geheven over de invoer die feitelijk in Nederland plaatsvindt, zullen deze constructies worden aangepakt.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat het verbod op zittenblijven op de havo voor doorstromers uit het vmbo funest is (ingezonden 25 november 2010)

Van der Ham (D66) asks the Education Minister to react to reports that the ban on repeating years for vmbo transfers into havo is harmful, and to say how unequal school standards for vmbo and other students will be remedied. The minister calls differing standards within one class objectionable, says school rules on repeating must be transparent and equal, orders an Inspectorate study of havo admission and repeating policy by late 2011, and reports ongoing VO-raad consultations with possible tightening of rules if warranted.
At my request, the Inspectorate of Education will in the course of 2011 investigate the transparency of the admission policy that havo schools apply.
De Onderwijsinspectie doet op mijn verzoek in de loop van 2011 onderzoek naar de transparantie van het toelatingsbeleid dat havo-scholen hanteren.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat door fouten bij Dienst Uitvoering Onderw

Two MPs asked the ministers about a reported DUO web-portal fault that exposed students' personal and study data to other users. The minister acknowledged the incident, explained it was a capacity-overload bug in the 'Mijn DUO' application, reported it was fixed and an external audit ordered, and denied DigiD was the cause.
An external audit of the technical causes has now been commissioned.
Er is inmiddels opdracht gegeven om een externe audit uit te voeren naar de technische oorzaken.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de financiering van de Lokale Omroep (ingezonden 30 november 2010).

An MP asks the education and culture minister about the funding of local broadcasting after a report found 42% of municipalities do not pay the basic amount, and asks whether they can be held to account and given a year to correct this. The minister says the report offers municipalities enough guidance to evaluate and tighten their policy, and states there is no legal minimum municipal funding, only an indicative amount of 1.30 euro per dwelling.
However, there is no statutory minimum for funding by municipalities.
Er geldt echter geen wettelijke minimum voor financiering door gemeenten.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van het softdrugsbeleid voor stede

An MP asked ministers about the Tilburg study of the coffeeshop pass system, the differences between Amsterdam and border towns, and consultation with municipalities. The ministers said they took note of the report and will address it in a drugs policy letter, that Amsterdam's circumstances differ from border towns but do not justify changing national policy, and that consultation with municipalities and regions is already taking place.
We acknowledge that the circumstances in Amsterdam are different from those in border towns.
Wij erkennen dat de omstandigheden in Amsterdam anders zijn dan die in grensplaatsen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de bibliotheca philosofica hermetica (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the Bibliotheca Philosophica Hermetica, a collection whose state-owned part is inaccessible due to seizure amid a dispute with a bank, and about whether a former minister had promised to take over the collection. The state secretary said the state part must remain accessible and is being pursued, and denied that the former minister made any such promise.
Former minister Van der Hoeven made no promise regarding taking over the book collection.
Voormalig minister Van der Hoeven heeft geen belofte gedaan inzake het overnemen van de boekenverzameling.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya en Van der Ham (beiden D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over terugvordering van Wet werk en bijstand (WWB)budgetten door het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgel

D66 MPs asked the minister whether the ministry recovered WWB funds from Rotterdam that were spent on ROC contracts for at-risk youth, whether rules have changed since, and whether a rigid rule application should block effective spending. The state secretary confirmed a 25 million euro recovery decision for 2008 spending, explained that the Participatiebudget from 2009 now allows such support under conditions, and declined to say whether the spending is lawful now because no accountant audit has occurred.
Yes, I have taken a decision to recover 25 million from the municipality of Rotterdam.
Ja, ik heb een besluit tot terugvordering van 25 mln. van de gemeente Rotterdam genomen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap aangaande kinderen die noodgedwongen thuis zitten vanwege volle scholen (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

An MP from D66 asked the education minister how she would respond to reports that children with psychological and behavioural problems cannot find places in special schools, whether schools will have to refuse pupils over the Christmas period, and her reaction to criticism of an upcoming 300 million euro budget cut. The minister replied that pupils with an indication retain a legal right to enrolment under current law, that there is no question of refusing pupils, and that regional expertise centres and partnerships can agree on who really needs special education while passend onderwijs and teacher training are pursued.
As long as the current legislation is in force, an indication gives the right to enrolment at a (v)so school.
Zolang de huidige wetgeving van kracht is, geeft een indicatie recht op inschrijving bij een (v)so-school.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over aanwijzingen dat er toch druk op de staf van InHolland is gelegd inzake sjoemelen met diploma’s (ingezonden 2 novembe

An MP asks the state secretary for Education whether reports that InHolland teachers were pressured to award diplomas too easily, based on material held by a newspaper, are true, and whether the Inspectorate will re-examine the Leers committee's interviews. The state secretary replies that the Leers committee found no proven improper pressure, that the Inspectorate's ongoing investigation will explicitly address pressure on staff and speak with the MEM teachers, and that no grounds exist to doubt the committee's thoroughness.
In the discussions the Inspectorate is conducting with InHolland, including with the Executive Board, 'pressure on staff' is explicitly addressed.
In de gesprekken die de Inspectie hierover voert met InHolland, inclusief die met het CvB, komt «druk op personeel» expliciet aan de orde.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over pilot met diploma’s bij InHolland (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about InHolland's alternative graduation pilot that awarded diplomas to about 250 students, including its quality and the Inspectorate's role. The state secretary called the situation worrying, found that 104 diplomas were issued without adequate safeguards and that the Higher Education Act was not complied with, and announced further Inspectorate investigations and possible measures.
Unacceptable risks have arisen for the value of diplomas.
Er zijn onacceptabele risico's ontstaan voor de waarde van diploma's.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over mogelijke trucs bij diplomaverstrekking op de Hanzehogeschool (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether alternative graduation routes for long-term students at the Hanzehogeschool (oral exams, extra-curricular competences) are of sufficient quality, and whether the inspectorate was involved. The state secretary said there is cause for concern, the inspectorate has started a sector-wide investigation with interim findings on risks, and a definitive quality judgment must await the April 2011 final report.
The inspectorate started an investigation in July into alternative graduation routes across all institutions in higher education.
De inspectie is in juli jl. een onderzoek gestart naar alternatieve afstudeertrajecten onder alle instellingen in het hoger onderwijs.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de kwaliteit van de diploma’s in het hoger onderwijs (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister how she responds to an EenVandaag broadcast alleging diploma fraud and pressure on teachers at Dutch universities of applied sciences, and whether the inspectorate will check that standards are in place before the coming academic year. The state secretary says the inspectorate will investigate, that the Leers committee found pressure on teachers not proven though possibly experienced, and that the inspectorate will report on InHolland's improvement plan by mid-January.
The inspectorate will therefore get to the bottom of these matters.
De inspectie zal deze zaken dan ook tot op de bodem uitzoeken.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de oproep van negen wethouders van de grote steden inzake de voorgenomen bezuinigingen op kunst en cultuur (ingezonde

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science to respond to a letter from nine big-city aldermen calling the planned culture cuts disproportionate, asking whether the cuts should be staggered, and whether they should be preceded by further research. The state secretary replied that the regeerakkoord framework is leading, that he is still deliberating on how to implement the culture paragraph, and that he will inform the House in a letter on 13 December.
Before the culture budget debate on 13 December I will inform you in an outline letter about how I intend to implement the culture component of the coalition agreement.
Ik informeer u voor de cultuurbegroting op 13 december in een brief op hoofdlijnen over de wijze waarop ik uitvoering wil geven aan het onderdeel cultuur van het regeerakkoord.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het weigeren van vmbo-t-gediplomeerden bij de HAVO (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Education why some schools refuse vmbo-t graduates entry to havo and whether this breaches the law, and asks what the government will do. The minister answers that the diploma gives no entitlement to admission, that schools may set their own admission criteria and are not supervised on this by the inspectorate, estimates about 1,100 refusals per year, and promises to ask the Inspectorate to check whether schools publish their admission policies.
Admission policy for the higher year groups is therefore not part of the inspectorate's supervisory framework.
Het toelatingsbeleid tot de hogere leerjaren vormt dan ook geen onderdeel van het toezichtskader van de onderwijsinspectie.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat door bezuinigingen minder leerlingen een kans maken alsnog een diploma te halen (ingezonden 16 september 2010

An MP asks the education minister about cuts reducing the chance for pupils to obtain a diploma later, including how many municipalities and places in adult secondary education (VAVO) are affected and whether regional differences are acceptable. The state secretary answers that municipal education budgets were cut and redirected, that VAVO funding for school pupils is unchanged, that municipalities have discretion leading to regional differences, and that the new cabinet will decide on any unwanted effects.
It is up to the new cabinet to decide how any unwanted effects will be dealt with.
Het is aan het nieuwe kabinet om te bepalen hoe zal worden omgegaan met eventuele ongewenste effecten.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de hoogte van de collegegelden voor tweede studies na wijziging van de Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about how tuition fees for second bachelor's and master's programmes have developed since the WHW amendment, including fee differences, enrolment effects, the five-times-statutory-fee loan ceiling and the three-year compensation scheme. The state secretary said institutions set their own fees with works-council advice, OCW does not have full insight, monitoring and evaluation are planned for 2013, and the loan ceiling will be studied.
OCW has no role in this matter and does not have comprehensive insight into the development of institutional tuition fees.
OCW heeft in dezen geen rol en beschikt niet over een omvattend inzicht in de ontwikkeling van het instellingscollegegeld.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Justitie en de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het verhoor van een journalist in relatie tot eerdere uitlatingen van de minister (ingezon

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a journalist questioned for allegedly threatening and inciting hatred by publishing someone else's tweet, and whether prosecutors applied their stated policy of careful contextual assessment of expressive offences. The minister confirmed awareness of the case but declined to describe the facts or the prosecution decision because the Public Prosecution Service had not yet decided, saying the case is still under assessment and the earlier policy reminder was specific to the Ravage case.
Since the Public Prosecution Service has not yet made a prosecution decision in this case, I cannot provide any information on the factual course of events.
Aangezien het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) in deze zaak nog geen vervolgingsbeslissing heeft genomen, kan ik over de feitelijke gang van zaken thans geen mededeling doen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschappen over het onderzoek over lerarentekort en schoolprestaties (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

The MP asks the minister for a reaction to a professor's study linking teacher shortages to weaker pupil performance, especially in science, and to the role of good teachers for pupils with migrant backgrounds. The minister agrees teacher quality matters, points to the Leerkracht van Nederland action plan and rising salary grades, says exact-science gains would be hard to quantify, and notes teacher training and continuing education can address migrant-pupil needs.
With the Leerkracht van Nederland action plan, this cabinet is therefore investing heavily in tackling the quantitative and qualitative shortage on the education labour market.
Met het actieplan Leerkracht van Nederland wordt daarom door dit kabinet fors geïnvesteerd in de aanpak van het kwantitatieve en kwalitatieve tekort op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afschaffing van de afstandsindicatie AWBZ (ingezonden 30 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the minister why boarding places at the Haren deaf institute were still granted via an AWBZ distance indication while the Grave blind school was refused, and whether parents were given too little notice of the CIZ decision. The minister explained the 2009 transition arrangement ended distance indications from 2010–2011, that the Haren case was a coulance exception due to a CIZ error, and that the CIZ decided within legal deadlines.
The coulance arrangement for the Haren deaf boarding school for the 2010–2011 intake was made solely because the CIZ mistakenly still issued positive distance indication decisions.
De coulance afspraak voor het doveninternaat te Haren voor de lichting 2010–2011 is uitsluitend gemaakt omdat het CIZ abusievelijk toch positieve besluiten voor «afstandsindicaties» heeft afgegeven.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de ministers van Justitie, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verschuivende problemen drugshandel in Brabant (ingezonden 10 august

MP Van der Ham asks the ministers about the Franzel commission's findings on drug policy in Brabant cities and about displacement of drug problems from Bergen op Zoom and Roosendaal to neighbouring towns. The government says most recommendations will be taken over, that regional coffeeshop limits are not yet adopted, and that a one-year impact study will report in late 2010.
At the end of 2010 the final report will be published.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over berichten over middelbare scholen die sjoemelen met cijfers (ingezonden 26 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether secondary schools are inflating grades under pressure from boards, citing a press report and AOb claims. The state secretary answered that no concrete cases are known to the union or the inspectorate, cited the 0.5-point SE-CE gap norm, and saw no reason for an investigation.
Neither Mr Dresscher of the AOb nor the Inspectorate of Education is aware of concrete examples of grade manipulation in secondary education.
Er zijn bij de heer Dresscher van de AOb en bij de Inspectie van het Onderwijs geen concrete voorbeelden bekend van gesjoemel met cijfers in het voortgezet onderwijs.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat Nederlandse scholieren wat betreft burgerschapsvaardigheden onder het Europees gemiddelde scoren (ingezonden

An MP asked the minister how the ICCS findings on weak civic skills of Dutch pupils relate to earlier warnings from the Raad van State, Ombudsman and inspectorate, and what would be done to strengthen civic education. The minister said it is unclear which warnings were meant, that schools have a statutory civic duty since 2006 supervised by the inspectorate, and that further policy on civic education is left to the next cabinet.
Whether and how policy is deployed to further promote citizenship is left to the next cabinet.
Of en hoe beleidsmatig wordt ingezet om burgerschap verder te stimuleren wordt overgelaten aan het volgende kabinet.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham (D66) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het publiceren van historische stukken door de Koninklijke B

MPs Van der Ham and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether Justice had warned the National Library it could face prosecution for putting wartime NSB and communist newspapers online, and how such historical material should be judged. The minister answered that online publication for news reporting is not punishable under article 137e of the Criminal Code, that prosecution and judgment are for the Openbaar Ministerie and the courts, and that he is consulting the Library on technical safeguards such as warnings to users.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to examine, on the basis of the facts, whether conduct qualifies for criminal prosecution.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om op basis van de feiten te bezien of gedragingen in aanmerking komen voor strafrechtelijke vervolging.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over substitutie van XTC (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An MP asks the health and justice ministers about the shift from XTC to more dangerous substitutes such as crystal meth, GHB and new drugs, and whether drug policy backfires. The ministers answer that current data do not justify major policy changes, that GHB prompts targeted measures, and that the Opiumwet listing system will be reviewed by an expert commission.

We sent Parliament a letter on 12 July 2010 stating that, although the main-lines drug policy letter had been declared controversial, there is sufficient reason to thoroughly re-examine the listing system of the Opium Act.

Wel hebben we op 12 juli 2010 een brief aan uw Kamer gezonden, waarin is aangegeven dat, hoewel de hoofdlijnenbrief drugsbeleid controversieel is verklaard, er voldoende aanleiding is om de lijstensystematiek van de Opiumwet grondig tegen het licht te houden.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat Engelse les aan kleuters beter kan (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

MP Van der Ham asked the minister whether the Van Hell research on English teaching in primary schools changes policy, how teaching quality will be strengthened, and whether pabo teacher training gives enough attention to English proficiency. The minister answered that the research is positive, that the findings do not change current early-foreign-language policy, that schools meet legal requirements, and that pabo accreditation and a planned knowledge base will ensure adequate English training.
The outcome of this research has no consequences for the policy I am currently pursuing regarding early foreign language education (vvto).
De uitkomst van dit onderzoek heeft geen gevolgen voor het beleid dat ik op dit moment voer rondom het vroeg vreemdetalenonderwijs (vvto).

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat een succesvol concept voor het opvangen van kinderen met een lichamelijke handicap in het reguliere onderwijs

MP Van der Ham asks the minister why the Rotterdam Pluspunt school must stop receiving special-education funding for physically disabled pupils integrated in regular education after 18 years, how this fits with positive inspection reports, and how many other schools face the same problem. The minister answers that the arrangement is unlawful because pupils are enrolled in special education but attend a regular school, that regularisation via leerlinggebonden financiering is possible, and that other such cases exist, which underlines the need for passend onderwijs reform.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over tv-evenementen (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science to react to a press critique that the TROS broadcaster now organises the Dutch Eurovision entry and whether this is consistent with the Eurovision Song Contest being a national matter under the media decree. The state secretary answered that programming decisions belong to the public broadcaster under the Mediawet, and that the event, listed as Category A, was broadcast fully and live as required.
This concerns a programming matter and I can and will not interfere with it.
Dit betreft een programmatische aangelegenheid en daarmee kan en wil ik mij niet bemoeien.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het beperken van de instroom van studenten op succesvolle opleidingen van de TU Delft (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

An MP asked the education minister whether it is acceptable that TU Delft, for financial reasons, introduces a numerus fixus on popular bachelor programmes despite national science-promotion goals, and how this relates to earlier funding corrections. The state secretary answered that the institution has autonomous authority over intake, that funding is a given framework, that the earlier compensation issue is unrelated, that bèta intake overall has grown, and that the government cannot make statements on future funding due to its caretaker status.
An institutional board has its own authority to set annually the number of students who may at most be enrolled for the first time in a given programme.
Een instellingsbestuur heeft een eigen bevoegdheid jaarlijks het aantal studenten vast te stellen dat ten hoogste voor de eerste keer kan worden ingeschreven voor een bepaalde opleiding.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de olieramp in de Golf van Mexico en de mogelijke risico’s verbonden met de o
