MP Van der Ham (D66) asked the economics and spatial planning ministers about the Gulf of Mexico oil spill and risks from North Sea oil extraction, including inspections, safety rules, blow-out preventers, cross-border response and whether the government would act on the US investigation. Minister Van der Hoeven answered that a spill of that scale is unlikely in Dutch waters, that existing North Sea safety rules are already standardised and cooperation with other states is in place, and that the government will review the US report's recommendations when available.
Once the results are known I will examine whether there is reason to take further steps to translate the recommendations into the Dutch situation.
Zodra de resultaten bekend zijn zal ik nagaan of er aanleiding toe is om verdere stappen te nemen om de aanbevelingen te vertalen naar de Nederlandse situatie.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatsecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over homofobe geweldincidenten (ingezonden 1

An MP asked ministers whether a violent incident against a gay man in Amsterdam should be seen as part of a wider problem of anti-LGBT violence, asked for 2010 figures and progress on hate-crime reporting, registration and the integrated approach. The government said the criminal investigation is ongoing, that 2010 figures are not yet available, described the hatecrimes.nl reporting website and campaigns, and said the homophobic-violence plan will be addressed in the June progress report.
The criminal investigation into this incident is still ongoing.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar dit incident loopt nog.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de keuring van mobiele handbediening voor auto’s (ingezonden 17 mei 2010).

An MP asked whether the RDW must test a removable mobile hand-control system for disabled drivers before market admission and why it refuses to develop a test. The minister replied that the RDW has no approval role for such removable systems, that approval would not guarantee safe installation across vehicles, and that enforcement would be difficult, while promising to monitor further developments.
I will therefore closely monitor any further steps in the development.
Ik zal daarom eventuele verdere stappen in de ontwikkeling nauwgezet volgen.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Justitie over de bedreigingen in de richting van een Deense cartoonist en het debat over de vrijheid van

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister how they view the Danish cartoonist Kurt Westergaard's decision to stop working after threats, and what they will do to promote free expression and protect opinion-makers. The government says it regards any threat against the cartoonist as serious and points to its human rights strategy, UN resolutions and Dutch-funded media and journalist safety projects abroad.
Ik maak mij sterk voor de vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een bericht over dwangarbeid voor homo’s in Malawi (ingezonden 21 mei 2010).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Paternotte over het tekort aan studentenhuisvesting in Delft en elders

MPs Vijlbrief and Paternotte asked about a shortage of student housing in Delft and elsewhere, including the threatened loss of student rooms, the effect of the rent freeze, the exclusion of students from the rent allowance (huurtoeslag), falling student purchasing power and rent-regulation rules. The minister responds by pointing to the national student housing action plan, a 25% rise in the WWSO point price, planned temporary contracts and hospitality rental incentives, a new subsidy scheme, and reasons why rent allowance extension is not currently feasible, while deferring several items to future reports.
The current cabinet is continuing this approach.

MPs Rooderkerk and Vijlbrief (D66) asked whether public investment in the electricity grid should be financed by cutting other public services or by letting national debt rise, and whether future generations should share the cost. The minister answered that options were weighed in the spring decision-making (raising the energy tax reduction on electricity, the IBO options), that grid investment is financed by public grid operators recouped via tariffs, and that all users, present and future, pay through tariffs, without committing to a specific cut or debt choice.
The cabinet endorses that it is desirable for all users of the electricity grid to contribute to the investments in, and maintenance of, the grid.
Het kabinet onderschrijft dat het wenselijk is dat alle gebruikers van het elektriciteitsnet meebetalen aan de investeringen in, en het onderhoud van het net.

The minister answered that the government is in talks with local authorities, that ozb is excluded from forecasts with only small effects, and that setting local taxes is a matter for municipal councils.
It is up to the municipal councils to make choices here, weighing among other things the tax burden, the level of services and other matters.
Het is aan de gemeenteraden hierin keuzes te maken, waarbij onder meer belastingdruk, voorzieningenniveau en andere zaken tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.

The minister answered that the amendment weakens intergenerational solidarity, risks compulsory participation, causes transition delays and legal conflict, conflicts with ILO conventions on collective bargaining, and that he considers it undesirable and will address this in the government's response.
From my administrative responsibility for compliance with the Pension Agreement, orderly legislation and predictability for implementation, I consider this undesirable.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Paulusma over de gevolgen van het halveren van het eigen risico op de hoogte van de zorgpremies

MPs Vijlbrief and Paulusma (D66) asked the health and finance ministers about the premium rise, longer waiting lists, and income and poverty effects from halving the mandatory deductible (eigen risico). Minister Agema answered that the premium rise (about 199 euro in 2027) is a financing effect partly offset by compensation, that the rise in care demand is estimated at about 64 euro, and that the bill was in internet consultation and would reach the House after the Raad van State advice.
It is customary for a bill to first go to internet consultation and then be submitted via the Council of Ministers to the Council of State for advice, before it is submitted to the House.
Het is gebruikelijk dat een wetsvoorstel éérst in internetconsultatie gaat en daarna via de ministerraad aan de Raad van State wordt aangeboden voor advies, voordat het bij de Kamer wordt aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vijlbrief over de uitspraak van de Raad van State om een bouwplan voor jongerenwoningen te schrappen vanwege een afrondingsverschil in de parkeerbehoefte

An MP asks the housing minister about a Council of State ruling that struck down a Haarlem zoning plan for young people's housing over a rounding issue in parking requirements, and whether the process should be faster. The minister says multiple defects, including use of unadopted parking policy, were found, expresses regret about the delay, and points to existing procedural options and the housing bill without committing to new legislation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Rooderkerk over het uitblijven van duurzame investeringen door bedrijven en beleggers

MPs Vijlbrief and Rooderkerk asked whether unclear climate policy is delaying green investment, whether a climate package will be in place this spring, and about the cost of delayed action and government cuts to the green economy. The minister replied that the government is committed to the Climate Act targets, cited grid congestion, CCS capacity and electricity prices as the main reasons for delayed investment, promised clarity in the Klimaatplan and Voorjaarsnota, and deferred several points to the spring budget.
The cabinet has committed in the Coalition Agreement and Government Programme to the existing agreements on the 2030 and 2050 climate targets as formulated in the Climate Act.
Het kabinet heeft zich in het Hoofdlijnenakkoord en het Regeerprogramma gecommitteerd aan de bestaande afspraken voor de klimaatdoelen van 2030 en 2050 zoals geformuleerd in de Klimaatwet.
Antwoord op van het lid Vijlbrief over 'de verhouding tussen KLM (en Transavia) en pilotenvakbond VNV'

An MP (D66) asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about KLM and Transavia favouring members of pilots' union VNV in collective agreement benefits, and about the state's role as shareholder regarding the union's influence on KLM management. The minister answered that wage and union matters are management's responsibility, that the state as shareholder raised disappointment at the 2024 AGM, and that discrimination disputes are for the courts, which she could not prejudge.
KLM's management is responsible for the day-to-day management of the organisation.
De directie van KLM is verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van de organisatie.

Antwoord op vragen die leden Aartsen, Inge van Dijk, Vijlbrief, Rikkers en Flach over het bericht “Hoge Raad: bij beoordeling of sprake is van arbeidsovereenkomst geldt geen rangorde tussen de mee te wegen omstandigheden

Five MPs asked the minister how the Supreme Court ruling that no hierarchy exists among factors in classifying employment, including entrepreneurship, affects the online tool hetjuistecontract.nl, Belastingdienst practice, government hiring of freelancers and the VBAR bill. The minister answered that the tool already covers external entrepreneurship, that no change or takedown is needed, that the Belastingdienst weighs all factors, and that the VBAR follow-up will be communicated soon.
Because, in line with the Supreme Court ruling, all factors are weighed in the web module, there is no reason to take the web module offline.
Omdat, in lijn met de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad, alle gezichtspunten worden meegewogen in de webmodule, is er geen reden om de webmodule offline te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Rooderkerk over de klimaataanpak van de minister

Two MPs from D66 asked the minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about the climate approach for the built environment: emissions, energy-cost differences by label, buildings in the public sector, grid congestion, labour shortages, funding, the heat pump subsidy and whether targets could be dropped. The minister answered with emissions and cost tables, described existing public-sector instruments and funding, said the grid and labour effects were not fully quantified, and deferred the overall climate package and the question of dropping targets to the Minister of Climate and Green Growth and the spring budget decision.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Vijlbrief over de verplichte jaarlijkse WOZ-waardebepaling door gemeenten

MPs Sneller and Vijlbrief asked the government about replacing the mandatory annual WOZ property valuation with a biennial one, following a VNG motion, and about related costs and private users. The state secretary replied that a VNG-commissioned study is underway, that no reaction is yet warranted, that municipalities cannot set their own valuation frequency due to uniformity requirements, and that the cost and revenue data are not available, promising to consider the option in the Ombuigingslijst.
At this moment such figures are not available.
Op dit moment zijn dergelijke cijfers niet beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Rikkers-Oosterkamp en Vijlbrief over signalen dat de belastingdienst zich niet houdt aan de handhavingsstrategie van de zachte landing en geen waarschuwingen geeft bij de handhavi

MPs from VVD, BBB and D66 asked whether the Tax Authority is following the agreed soft-landing enforcement strategy on sham self-employment, including giving warnings before audits. The State Secretary answered that such signals had not reached them, described the warning practice and the lack of formal registration, and provided the requested counts of visits and audits while promising to report progress in a separate letter.
The number of letters is not centrally registered.
Het aantal brieven wordt niet centraal geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk en Haage over de memo in handen van RTL aangaande het ingediende amendement Joseph c.s. over een referendum over het invaren van pensioenfondsen

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie, CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the government would publish a leaked ministry memo on the budgetary cost of the NSC-backed Joseph amendment on a pension-fund referendum, and whether an MP had access to cabinet-internal documents. The minister confirmed the memo exists and attached it, denied it was a cabinet-internal document shared with the MP, and committed to publish the advice and appreciation of the amended amendment when the cabinet appreciation is issued.

As requested by the standing parliamentary committee on Social Affairs and Employment, the amended amendment will be accompanied by a cabinet appreciation, advice from the Council of State, and views from supervisors, the Tax Authority, pension administrators and social partners.

Zoals door de vaste Kamercommissie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid gevraagd, wordt het gewijzigde amendement voorzien van een kabinetsappreciatie, advies van de Raad van State, en zienswijzen van onder andere de toezichthouders, Belastingdienst, pensioenuitvoerders en sociale partners.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk, Stultiens, Vijlbrief, Koekkoek, Grinwis en Ergin over de brandbrief van enkele fracties inzake voortgang van de Hersteloperatie Toeslagen na het aftreden van Staatssec

Seven MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister to respond to a letter raising concern that the Toeslagen recovery operation was stalling after the resignation of State Secretary Achahbar. The new State Secretary Palmen responded that a rapid-advice commission will report on 23 January, a pilot for bereaved relatives has started, the claims portal opens in late January, and the government commits to finishing Integrale Beoordelingen by end 2025, while acknowledging backlogs in objections and dossier provision.
This commission has the task, with regard to the needs of those affected, of examining how the implementation of the Toeslagen recovery operation can be accelerated and improved.
Deze commissie heeft tot taak om, met oog voor de behoeften van de gedupeerden, te onderzoeken op welke wijze de uitvoering van de hersteloperatie toeslagen kan worden versneld en verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Inge van Dijk, Grinwis en Maatoug over ‘het uiterst kritische Raad van State advies over het nieuwe box 3 stelsel’

MPs from D66, CDA, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks-PvdA asked how the government views the Raad van State's critical advice on the new box 3 wealth tax system, including delay, budgetary shortfall, the Hoge Raad's view on the forfait, and wealth inequality. The Staatssecretaris answers that a one-year delay to 2028 is expected, a shortfall of about 2.4 billion euro in 2027 will be covered by raising the forfait on other assets and lowering the tax-free allowance, and that alternatives including a wealth tax are being studied, with a reply to the advice to follow.
In a further report on that advice the cabinet will provide a full response, and I cannot anticipate that now.
In een nader rapport op dat advies komt het kabinet met een uitgebreide reactie, daarop kan ik nu niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Grinwis en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Kabinet krijgt tik op de vingers uit Brussel'

MPs Vijlbrief, Grinwis and Inge van Dijk asked Finance Minister Heinen how the cabinet will respond to a European Commission warning that debt and deficits rise beyond EU reference values over the longer term, and why it added 8 billion in spending despite low debt. The minister says the cabinet stays within EU reference values during its term apart from a one-off 2026 deficit overshoot, that further consolidation is for future cabinets, and gives no concrete additional cuts or measures.
The cabinet will not submit to the European Commission a different budgetary path than the frameworks set by the cabinet.
Het kabinet zal niet een ander budgettair pad aan de Europese Commissie voorleggen dan de door het kabinet vastgestelde kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Vijlbrief, Ceder en Patijn over het bericht 'Crisis UWV nog groter, ook missers bij mogelijk duizenden jonggehandicapten: 'Kommer en kwel''

MPs from CDA, D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the ministry knew earlier of problems at UWV affecting Wajong disability benefit assessments, and whether it would commission independent research, extend the Court of Audit request, and address WW and Ziektewet. The minister answered that Wajong quality measurements were discontinued from 2020 so quality cannot be verified, promised further investigations, a letter on remedies, and a check on WW and Ziektewet, but declined to commit to an Algemene Rekenkamer investigation until ongoing studies finish.
Unfortunately, quality measurements were scaled down from 2020 onward, and it is now insufficiently clear how the quality of Wajong assessments stands, because it is not traceable.
Helaas zijn de kwaliteitsmetingen vanaf 2020 afgeschaald en is het nu onvoldoende duidelijk hoe het is gesteld met de kwaliteit van de Wajong-beoordelingen, omdat dit niet navolgbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Vijlbrief over de Meerjarige Productie Prognose 2024-II

MPs Podt and Vijlbrief asked the Minister of Finance whether he knew of the MPP 2024-II forecast for Asylum and Migration, why the budget cuts for COA and IND were approved despite gaps with the forecast, and how he responded to the Court of Audit's concerns. The minister confirmed knowledge of the forecast, said the 2024-I version was known when the budget was set, pointed to the coalition agreement's planned asylum spending cuts, and promised to address budget adjustments in Voorjaarsnota 2025 using MPP 2024-2 data.
As usual, the cabinet will inform your House in the Voorjaarsnota 2025 about any budgetary adjustments to the Asylum and Migration budget.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal het kabinet uw Kamer bij Voorjaarsnota 2025 informeren over eventuele budgettaire bijstellingen voor de begroting van Asiel en Migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vijlbrief over het bericht «Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is»

An MP asks the housing minister whether she agrees that the coalition programme is insufficient to meet 2030 climate targets, whether dropping the hybrid heat pump norm and energy tax change cuts CO2 reductions, whether additional buildings policy is needed, and how often she has met the climate minister. The minister agrees there is a considerable challenge, refers the quantitative and policy questions to the climate minister's answers to other MPs, says she is in frequent contact with the climate minister, and admits the answers could not be provided before the budget debate.
For the answer to these questions I refer to the answers of the Minister of KGG to the questions with the same intent.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik naar de antwoorden van de Minister van KGG op de vragen met dezelfde strekking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Vijlbrief over de financiële positie van studenten

MPs Paternotte and Vijlbrief asked the government about student financial pressure: whether to lower interest on student loans, avoid cutting the basic grant, drop the long-study fine, and extend the supplementary grant to mbo students. The minister answered that there is no room for further measures, that the temporary grant increase ends and a higher basic grant cannot be applied retroactively, and that a second loan compensation of 1.4 billion euro is planned.
That is why this cabinet has chosen to invest 1.4 billion euro one-off to raise the compensation for student-loan-system students.
Daarom heeft dit kabinet ervoor gekozen om incidenteel € 1,4 miljard in te zetten voor het verhogen van de tegemoetkoming van leenstelselstudenten
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Maatoug, Stultiens, Grinwis, Teunissen, Dijk, Van Baarle, Vijlbrief en Dassen over de kosten van het afschaffen van de belasting op de inkoop van eigen aandelen

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance about a SOMO study criticising the revenue estimate for abolishing the share buyback tax facility, including its data basis, behavioural assumptions and whether a new CPB estimate should be requested. The State Secretary answered that the estimate used the best available data at the time, explained the 70% behavioural discount, noted the cabinet has since kept the facility so no new study is needed, but will discuss updating the research with SOMO and SEO.
I will discuss this with both SOMO and SEO.
Ik zal hiervoor met zowel SOMO als SEO in gesprek treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Paternotte, Rooderkerk, Paulusma en Sneller  over de btw-verhogingen op boeken, cultuur, sport en logies

D66 MPs asked the government what it aims to achieve by raising VAT on books, newspapers, culture, sport and accommodation, and about impact analyses, exemptions, legal risks, household purchasing power, sector and education effects, regional effects and the 40-organisation appeal. The state secretary answers that the rate change yields about 2.3 billion euros structurally, that no specific impact analysis was done and none is planned (only monitoring), that some reduced-rate categories are kept for policy-weighing reasons, and that most distributional, sectoral and regional effects cannot be quantified.
I do not intend to carry out a further impact analysis, but the effect of the tariff increase will be monitored.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren, wel zal het effect van de tariefsverhoging worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Vijlbrief over het bericht ‘Influencers zamelen via Nederland geld in voor uitrusting Russische militairen’

Two D66 MPs asked whether crowdfunding via Dutch platform Boosty for equipping Russian soldiers constitutes sanctions evasion, about the corporate ownership chain, and what the government will do to deter sanctions evasion via the Netherlands. Minister Veldkamp replied that the government cannot comment on individual cases, that sanctions enforcement is for courts, supervisors or the prosecutor, and that the government raises signals with authorities and works through existing coordination platforms, without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet cannot publicly comment on individual cases.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Sneller over het betrekken van deTweede Kamer bij de budgettaire besluitvorming

D66 MPs Vijlbrief and Sneller asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about the role of the Prime Minister, the cabinet's budget decision-making and how parliament would be involved before Prinsjesdag 2024. The government answered that decisions are taken collectively in the Council of Ministers, promised talks with parliament's financial spokespeople and the Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen, and said the budget would be presented on Prinsjesdag, but gave limited concrete detail on timing and content.
The deliberations of the Council of Ministers are therefore secret.
De beraadslagingen van de ministerraad zijn derhalve geheim.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Groningers die door immateriële schadevergoeding buitengesloten worden voor kwijtschelding van waterschaps- en gemeentebelasting

An SP MP asked whether Groningen residents receiving immaterial damages from the IMG are excluded from waterschap and municipal tax relief because the payment counts as wealth, and what is being done about it. The government confirms the payment counts as wealth, says municipalities and water boards can waive collection and are cooperative in practice, points residents to the Noordelijk Belastingkantoor, and says the energy allowance system cannot be copied.

Although this touches on the autonomy of municipalities and water boards, which I cannot intervene in, contacts with the municipalities and water board concerned have shown that they apply this option benevolently in the case of damages paid by the IMG and NCG.

Hoewel dit raakt aan de autonomie van gemeenten en waterschappen waar ik niet in kan treden, is uit contacten met de desbetreffende gemeenten en het desbetreffende waterschap gebleken dat ze deze mogelijkheid in het geval van schadevergoeding door het IMG en de NCG welwillend toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Groningers die door een ZAV-vergoeding uitgesloten worden voor toeslagen

An SP MP asked why the ZAV compensation for Groningen earthquake damage is not exempt from the asset test for benefits such as rent and childcare allowances, and how to prevent recipients losing entitlements. The government answered that the ZAV payment is not an exempt asset, that three rent-allowance and one child-benefit claims were compensated by the NCG and IMG, and that information and support are offered to affected residents.
Affected Groningen residents are not disadvantaged in applying for allowances because of receiving the ZAV payment.
Gedupeerde Groningers worden niet achtergesteld met het aanvragen van toeslagen door het ontvangen van de ZAV-vergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Chakor over de gaswinning boven Schiermonnikoog

MPs Bushoff and Chakor asked why the N05-A gas extraction permit above Schiermonnikoog was granted despite earlier refusal, why ONE-Dyas may proceed while appeals are pending, and about compensation, German permits and fossil-fuel planning. The minister answered that the permits were repaired after court rulings on nitrogen and harbour porpoise, that interim relief lifted the suspension so production can proceed pending appeal, and that the project is justified by supply security and lower emissions.
On 18 April 2024 the Hague District Court ruled that the environmental permit for the platform was insufficiently substantiated on two aspects and annulled the permit on those two points.
Op 18 april 2024 heeft de Rechtbank Den Haag geoordeeld dat de omgevingsvergunning voor het platform op twee aspecten onvoldoende onderbouwd is en heeft de vergunning op deze twee punten vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het toenemend aantal acuut onveilige situaties (AOS) in Groningen

An SP MP asked why acute unsafe situations (AOS) in Groningen rose, how quickly residents are helped, and how IMG and NCG cooperate. The government says the rise in valid reports is within a stable multi-year range, that inspections happen within 48 hours, that temporary measures are taken but structural fixes can take long, and that no faster process is currently foreseen.
In answering parliamentary questions, however, I cannot go into the personal situations of residents.
In de beantwoording van Kamervragen kan ik echter niet ingaan op persoonlijke situaties van bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Bushoff over gasboring in de Waddenzee

Two MPs from GroenLinks/PvdA asked the government why it cannot refuse the NAM's gas production drilling at Ternaard under the Waddenzee, citing the NAM's track record, the Mijnbouwwet grounds for refusal and withdrawal, and the UNESCO World Heritage status. The state secretary answered that existing permits cannot be refused under article 9, that withdrawal under article 21 is limited by property protection under ECHR Protocol 1, that article 36 grounds are limited, and that a decision on the winningsplan is still pending after new subsidence advice.
Withdrawing a production permit can, however, only take place if the requirements of Article 1 of the First Protocol of the European Convention on Human Rights are met.
Intrekken van een winningsvergunning kan echter alleen als is voldaan aan artikel 1 van het Eerste Protocol van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het uitsluiten van bewoners van Annerveenschekanaal voor de waardedalingsregeling

An SP MP asked why residents of Annerveenschekanaal are excluded from the value-decline compensation scheme for Groningen earthquake damage while neighbouring villages qualify, and why expert analyses of postcode-level discrepancies and risk-area boundaries were not acted on. The State Secretary answered that the independent advisory committee reviewed the case twice and found no objective ground for an exception, that the methodology was validated, and that the area received a €10,000 housing improvement subsidy instead.
That is why in September 2023, after the meeting with residents you refer to, I asked the IMG to have the Advisory Committee on Value Decline reconsider this.
Daarom heb ik in september 2023, na het gesprek met bewoners waar u naar verwijst, het IMG verzocht de adviescommissie Waardedaling te vragen om dit nogmaals te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over oliewinning onder Rotterdam

A GroenLinks-PvdA MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the status of gas extraction under Rotterdam, the appeal by the city of Rotterdam to the Council of State, subsidence, residents' information, and revenue sharing. The State Secretary said the appeal is pending, promised to talk with residents and asked NAM to improve information, but declined substantive comment on the pending case and refused to propose a revenue redistribution, calling that a political choice for a new cabinet.
Since this appeal case is still before the court, I cannot go into the substance of the appeal petition and my defence further.
Nu deze beroepszaak nog onder de rechter is, kan ik verder niet inhoudelijk ingaan op de inhoud van het beroepschrift en mijn verweer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over het Akkoord voor de Noordzee

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked about Greenpeace leaving the North Sea Consultation, gas extraction acceleration versus the Paris Agreement, and delays in closing parts of the North Sea to bottom trawling. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that the government stays within Paris-aligned targets, that accelerated extraction only shifts production forward in time, and that the 2023 trawling closure target was missed but will be pursued via an EU procedure with a proposal by end 2024.
I have told the NZO that our aim is to submit the joint recommendation (to reach 13.7%) to the European Commission by the end of 2024.
Ik heb aan het NZO aangegeven dat onze inzet is om de gezamenlijke aanbeveling (om te komen tot 13,7%) uiterlijk eind 2024 bij de Europese Commissie in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over compensatie van gedupeerden die eigen geld hebben moeten inleggen voor de versterking of sloop-nieuwbouw van hun woning

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff asked about residents who paid their own money for Groningen house reinforcement or demolition-rebuilding and are still waiting for compensation, including the NCG complaint point, numbers, timing, payment method and confusion between NCG and municipalities. The Secretary of State answers that 186 reports totaling over eleven million euros have been received, individual assessment of first reports is done, Batch 1588 cases take longer, and the NCG will handle them with municipalities.
I have asked the NCG to take on the handling of these reports jointly with the municipalities.
Ik heb de NCG gevraagd gezamenlijk met de gemeenten de uitvoering van deze meldingen ter hand te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Gasbedrijf wil boren en kijkt naar minister, Woerden blijft tegen gaswinning in Papekop'

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about Vermilion's plans to extract gas from the Papekop field in a peat meadow area opposed by local municipalities, covering project procedure, subsidence, compensation for damage, pipeline routing and information to parliament. The state secretary answered that the request for the national project procedure is under study, explained the legal criteria and the mining damage compensation system, and committed to informing the House about the decision.
I will inform the House of my decision on whether or not to declare the project procedure applicable to Vermilion's application, and of my considerations.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer informeren over mijn beslissing over het wel of niet van toepassing verklaren van de projectprocedure op de aanvraag van Vermilion en mijn afwegingen daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de ongelijkheid voor bewoners van de Stadsweg in Ten Boer

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked why residents of the Stadsweg in Ten Boer are treated unequally in reinforcement and insulation compared to neighbours, and whether the government will fix this. The State Secretary says a full insulation subsidy up to 40,000 euro with retroactive effect applies, that the municipality and NCG will address remaining differences via area-based planning, and that no parties are blocking a solution.
I will inform your House soon in more detail about the progress on this motion.
Ik zal uw Kamer binnenkort nader informeren over de voortgang op deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de gebiedsbijdrage uit de oliewinning in Schoonebeek

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why the central government would not contribute directly from its budget to the Schoonebeek area contribution from oil extraction, and why the amount fell short of earlier estimates. The State Secretary answered that the contribution, about 40 million euro, is channelled via state company EBN and NAM, that a direct budget contribution lacks a legal basis for now, and that talks with the province continue.
I have agreed that I will talk again with NAM about the level and form of the financial contribution.
Ik heb afgesproken dat ik nog eens met NAM in gesprek ga over de hoogte en de vorm van de financiële bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor, Bromet en Bushoff over het rapport ‘De Europees- en Internationaalrechtelijke status van de Waddenzee’

Opposition MPs Chakor, Bromet and Bushoff asked the government about the Waddenacademie report on the European and international legal status of the Wadden Sea, including whether the Ternaard gas extraction permit was tested against World Heritage obligations and the fragmentation of Wadden Sea governance. The Minister replied that the report is still being studied, that the permit is assessed under the Nature Conservation Act with only indirect World Heritage considerations, and that the landsadvocaat's advice cannot be shared because it could harm the state's litigation position.
I cannot share this advice with you now, because it could harm the position of the state in any future legal proceedings.
Dit advies kan ik nu niet met u delen, omdat dit de positie van de staat in een eventueel proces zou kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de aangespannen arbitragezaak tegen de Staat van Shell en ExxonMobil

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked the state secretary about the arbitration launched by Shell and ExxonMobil against the Dutch state, whether it could slow Groningen damage settlement and reinforcement, the costs of billing the companies, and whether other means exist to make them pay. The government answered that the arbitration does not affect damage handling or reinforcement, that the NAM has paid all damage invoices but about half of the reinforcement bill remains unpaid, and that it is still studying the arbitration's effect on talks and the options for a broader levy, to return to parliament soon.
I can assure you that the discussions between the NAM or Shell and ExxonMobil about the costs have no effect whatsoever on the implementation of the damage settlement and reinforcement operation.
Ik kan u verzekeren dat de discussies tussen de NAM of Shell en ExxonMobil over de kosten geen enkel effect hebben op de uitvoering van de schadeafhandeling en versterkingsoperatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de acuut onveilige situatie van de Vlamovenflat in Delfzijl

An MP asked the State Secretary about the acutely unsafe Vlamoven flat in Delfzijl, where bricks are falling and residents feel unheard, and about damage claims, timelines, and support for residents. The State Secretary answered that IMG has secured the building with fencing, that the structure meets the earthquake safety norm, that the damage claim is prioritised but no timeline can yet be given, and that residents can seek support or contact the Huurcommissie.
IMG cannot yet make any statements about the exact processing time of the damage claim.
Het IMG kan op dit moment nog geen uitspraken doen over de precieze doorlooptijd van de schademelding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het Nationaal Programma Groningen

An MP from BBB asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the governance, democratic accountability, oversight and participation in the Nationaal Programma Groningen and Nij Begun, including the lack of a governance evaluation and who supervises the programme. The State Secretary answers that accountability runs through local councils, the Staat van Groningen and annual parliamentary reporting, that evaluation will wait until 2025, and that broad participation is being arranged.
The cabinet will annually provide political accountability to the House via the Staat van Groningen on the results of the generation-long approach announced in Nij Begun.
Het kabinet zal jaarlijks via de Staat van Groningen politieke verantwoording afleggen aan de Kamer over de resultaten van de generatielange aanpak die in Nij Begun is aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman naar aanleiding van de vragen over het opstarten van twee productielocaties op het Groningenveld

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why two Groningen gas production sites were restarted on the cold-weather waakvlam regime, whether industry demand reduction was considered, and how Groningers are affected. The State Secretary answered that the restart follows the 2023-2024 determination (capacity shortfall at low temperatures, not a volume shortage), that alternatives like industry curtailment cannot act fast enough, and that the field will still close on 1 October 2024, while acknowledging the unrest caused by late notice to local authorities.
Should this situation unexpectedly occur again, I will inform the authorities in Groningen earlier.
Mocht zich deze situatie onverhoopt nog een keer voor doen, dan zal ik de overheden in Groningen eerder informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance

An MP asked the government whether it recognises the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance call for a fossil fuel phase-out in line with 5-degree IPCC scenarios, how this differs from its commitment to a 1.5-degree phase-out path, why the Netherlands has not joined, and whether the answers could come before the climate debate. The minister answered that the government pursues phase-out but keeps domestic small-field gas production, declines to join the alliance as it does not fit national policy, and admitted the answers came too late for the debate.
Because the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance insufficiently aligns with the Netherlands' national policy, this cabinet currently does not intend to join this initiative.
Omdat de Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance onvoldoende aansluit op het nationale beleid van Nederland, is dit kabinet nu niet voornemens om bij dit initiatief aan te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel “NAM: ‘Laatste aardgas uit velden halen, is niet voor meer ruimte afvalwater oliewinning’”

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about NAM's plan to restart gas extraction in southeast Drenthe, its link to wastewater storage for oil extraction, municipal and provincial objections, subsidence and damage claims, and participation procedures. The State Secretary answered that the plan has no link to oil wastewater storage, that TNO and SodM advise on subsidence (about 0.5 mm extra, with 6 cm cumulative per NAM), that the public participation and appeal procedure applies, and that the Schoonebeek process will be evaluated in early 2024.
I find it regrettable that the municipalities of Emmen and Coevorden feel taken by surprise.
Ik vind het vervelend dat de gemeenten Emmen en Coevorden zich overvallen voelen.
antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het debat tijdens de begroting EZK

An MP asks whether NAM's September 2022 statement of claim in the Groningen arbitration was submitted to the parliamentary inquiry, whether a staff member's report of non-disclosure was handled, and whether the 2019 settlement reduced NAM's liability for damage. The state secretary answers that the claim fell outside the inquiry's requests, that the internal signal was checked and found unfounded, and that the 2019 agreement did not limit NAM's payment duty.
NAM's statement of claim dates from September 2022 and for that reason fell outside the scope of the requests.
De memorie van eis van de NAM dateert van september 2022, viel om die reden buiten de reikwijdte van de vorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over schade in Groningen

An MP asked the state secretary why the NAM arbitration memorandum was withheld from the Groningen gas enquiry committee, whether the Wiebes agreements narrowed NAM's liability for reinforcement costs, and whether a state aid notification was needed. The government answered in detail, denying any narrowing of NAM's liability, denying state aid, and declining to disclose arbitration substance to protect the state's litigation position while offering confidential briefing.
Publicly informing about substantive elements of these procedures would harm the State's procedural position.
Openbaar informeren over inhoudelijke elementen van deze procedures schaadt de procespositie van de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger en Nijboer over de vergunningverlening locatie Schoonebeek van NAM

MPs Kröger and Nijboer asked whether a temporary carbon-filter installation permit for NAM at Schoonebeek signals a resumption of oil extraction and Twente water injection, and about decommissioning costs, e-boiler plans, state subsidies and grid use. The state secretary answered that the permit is only valid until 31 December 2023, that water injection in Twente will not resume under an agreement, and gave cost, subsidy and e-boiler details while noting some matters are NAM's responsibility.
Furthermore, I have agreed with NAM that water injection in Twente will not be resumed, and I will hold NAM to this agreement.
Daarnaast heb ik met de NAM afgesproken dat de waterinjectie in Twente niet zal worden hervat en ik zal de NAM houden aan deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boulakjar over de Unesco brief over de voorgenomen gaswinning

D66 MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Boulakjar asked the ministers whether UNESCO's concerns about the planned Ternaard gas extraction under the Wadden Sea justify refusing the nature permit, how cumulative effects and the World Heritage Outstanding Universal Value will be assessed, and whether the NAM's notice of default and the Mining Act grounds for refusal apply. The government answered that the permit decision cannot be prejudged, that Natura 2000 and World Heritage tests apply, that it will report to UNESCO by 1 February 2024 and assess cumulative effects, but declined to guarantee no leakage or to commit to refusing the permit.
The Minister for Nature and Nitrogen cannot anticipate a formal decision on the permit application at this stage.
De Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof kan nu niet vooruit lopen op een formeel besluit op de vergunningaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over de extra belasting van woningcorporaties met betrekking tot schadevergoedingen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked why compensation paid to housing corporations for Groningen mining damage is taxed as corporate profit, and whether it should be exempted or compensated. The government replied that the compensation is fiscally neutral over time because associated repair costs offset it, that it sees no reason to defiscalise or compensate, and that the EUR 135 million subsidy, including EUR 750 per tenant, benefits tenants.
However, a compensation payment is fiscally neutral for housing corporations.
Een schadevergoeding pakt voor woningcorporaties echter fiscaal neutraal uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Pure Energie aast op bouw windpark tussen Woltersum, Ten Boer en Ten Post. Boeren worden verleid om grond beschikbaar te stellen

An SP MP asked the Cabinet whether it finds it undesirable that commercial firm Pure Energie approaches landowners for high wind turbines near Groningen's earthquake zone, and how participation and trust can be safeguarded. The minister answered that the area is not designated for large-scale wind, that local decision-making lies with regional and municipal authorities, and that participation and financial participation are being pursued without committing to halt or block the project.
It is up to the decentralised authorities to assess the plans of (commercial) parties, including those not within the RES search areas.
Het is aan de decentrale overheden om de plannen van (commerciële) partijen – ook die niet binnen de RES-zoekgebieden vallen – te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de winning van gas in Norg door NAM

An MP asks the government whether it will allow NAM to extract cushion gas from the Norg gas storage facility, citing supply security and local residents' concerns. The minister answers that NAM needs a permit approval from the minister, with advice from SodM, the Mijnraad, regional authorities and ACM on safety and supply security, and that residents' concerns will be addressed in a consultation process.
In doing so I will seek advice from, among others, the supervisory authority SodM, the Mijnraad and regional authorities.
Daarbij win ik advies in van onder andere toezichthouder SodM, de Mijnraad en regionale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'NAM dient winningsplan Norg in'

An SP MP asks the government whether it opposes NAM's winning plan for cushion gas at the Norg storage field near Groningen, whether the state should have taken over the storage sites, and questions the Norg agreement's financial benefits for NAM. The minister answers that the winning plan will be assessed under the Mining Act with advice from SodM, the Mijnraad and regional authorities over one and a half to two years, that ACM must assess supply security, and that the Norg agreement does not bring extra income to NAM but compensates it for its disadvantage.
In my role as licensing authority I am obliged to assess this winning plan under the procedure of the Mining Act.
In mijn rol als vergunningverlener ben ik verplicht dit winningsplan te beoordelen volgens de procedure uit de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het verpatsen van NAM

MP Nijboer asked whether Shell and ExxonMobil, shareholders of NAM, can be held liable for Groningen gas damage if NAM sells small fields or is split up, and what the government will do to prevent this. The Staatssecretaris answered that Groningen field and storage remain within NAM BV, that NAM is liable under civil law, that Shell and ExxonMobil provide guarantees under the Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen, and that a bill on definitive closure will follow with further information on security arrangements.

Under the Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen, Shell and ExxonMobil are obliged to provide replacement adequate security before the guarantees expire, for damage handling and reinforcement costs for the period after gas extraction ends.

Shell en ExxonMobil zijn op grond van het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen verplicht om voorafgaand aan het vervallen van de garanties (vervangende) passende zekerheden te stellen voor kosten met betrekking tot de schadeafhandeling en versterkingsoperatie voor de periode na de beëindiging van de gaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over directe en indirecte lozingen en/of afvalinjecties onder de Waddenzee

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether wastewater from gas and oil extraction near the Wadden Sea, including injection at Borgsweer and Ameland-Westgat, could reach the Natura 2000 area, and whether the operator's classification of cadmium and other substances as less hazardous was acceptable. The Secretary of State answered that migration beneath the Wadden Sea cannot be excluded but poses no realistic contamination risk due to thick impermeable layers, and that produced water may contain hazardous substances, to be tested by the license holder under existing waste rules.
I cannot rule out that wastewater released in the production of oil and gas contains hazardous substances.
Ik kan niet uitsluiten dat afvalwater dat vrijkomt bij de productie van olie en gas gevaarlijke stoffen bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Drost over de forse krimp van de Groningse economie door afbouw van de gaswinning

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the 13% contraction of the Groningen economy caused by phasing out gas extraction, the lower figures for Delfzijl, whether past statistics overstated Groningen's wealth, and how the economic recovery programme and monitoring will work. The State Secretary attributed the contraction to gas phase-out and high energy prices, rejected the premise that statistics misled, and committed to informing parliament in December and presenting the first Staat van Groningen in April.
I will inform your House in December in broad outline about how, among other things, the progress of the economic and social agenda will be monitored.
Ik zal uw Kamer in december op hoofdlijnen informeren over de manier waarop onder andere de voortgang van de economische en sociale agenda zal worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘Groninger gedupeerden die nog steeds de prijs betalen’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about Groningen earthquake victims who still pay out of pocket for reinforcement, demolition-rebuilding, defects and lost compensation, citing several parliamentary motions. The government acknowledges some residents paid their own costs, promises a reporting point by 1 October 2023 with full reimbursement where proven, an extra 23% budget for batch 1588, and further checks on indexation and compensation, while rejecting some claims.

For cases where this is the case, a reporting point will be set up where residents can register if they believe they have incurred costs themselves for necessary reinforcement measures or costs directly arising from them.

Voor de gevallen waar dit wel het geval is, zal een meldpunt worden ingericht waar bewoners zich kunnen melden die menen dat zij zelf kosten hebben gemaakt voor noodzakelijke versterkingsmaatregelen of kosten die daar direct uit voortkomen.
Antwoord op van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'Miljoenen nodig voor sloop kerncentrale Dodewaard bij aandeelhouders beland'

MPs Boucke and Hagen asked how the state came to bear decommissioning costs for the Dodewaard nuclear plant while shareholders received payouts, and about financing rules for decommissioning other energy infrastructure. The minister explains that GKN could not secure approved financial guarantees, that a term sheet transfers NEA's assets to the state, and that a broader reform of mining decommissioning rules is planned for after summer.
The downside is that the state thereby becomes (indirectly) responsible for dismantling GKN.
Keerzijde is dat de Staat hiermee (indirect) verantwoordelijk wordt GKN te ontmantelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het gasveld Middelie

An MP asked the State Secretary about public support for, seismic risks of, and justification for continuing gas extraction at Middelie until 2035, including the Groningen enquiry's conclusions and the Beemster World Heritage status. The State Secretary answered that objections are being reviewed, that advisory bodies see only a small earthquake risk, that no intensification is planned without new permits, and that a site visit will precede a final decision.
I only grant permission to continue existing gas extraction if this can be done safely.
Ik geef alleen toestemming voor het voortzetten van de bestaande winning van gas als dit veilig kan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over directe en indirecte lozingen en/of afvalinjecties onder de Waddenzee

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked about direct and indirect discharges and waste injection of oil and gas production water under the Wadden Sea, including legal storage duties, alternatives, and whether NAM could be denied new permits if prosecuted. The state secretary answered that no waste is injected under the Wadden Sea, that reporting on production water exists, and that he cannot anticipate prosecution consequences for future permit decisions.
I cannot anticipate a possible prosecution of NAM and its possible consequences for future permit granting.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op een mogelijke vervolging van NAM en de eventuele gevolgen daarvan voor toekomstige vergunningverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de staat die doorprocedeert tegen inwoners

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the state keeps appealing losing mining-damage cases against Groningen residents, and whether this conflicts with the government's stated aim of standing beside residents. The State Secretary agrees appeals burden residents, says IMG will use prejudicial questions instead, not reclaim compensation if it appeals, and promises a less legalistic approach, with a letter this spring.
I have discussed with the IMG that in these distressing cases it will not reclaim the compensation paid if the IMG is found to be right.
Ik heb met het IMG besproken dat het voor deze schrijnende gevallen de uitgekeerde vergoeding niet zal terugvorderen als het IMG in het gelijk wordt gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘de vertraagde versterking in Ten Post’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about delays in reinforcement (versterking) of homes in Ten Post, the trust deficit with residents, compensation for higher energy costs, and SodM's criticism of slow execution. The State Secretary acknowledges delays and residents' distress, outlines a new timetable (completion in H2 2024), improved communication and a review of processes, but declines to commit to compensation for energy costs, citing existing schemes and an ongoing identification exercise.
At the committee debate on Mining Groningen on 1 February I committed to this Chamber that I would talk with these residents and inform this Chamber of the outcome.
Tijdens het commissiedebat Mijnbouw Groningen van 1 februari jl. heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd met deze bewoners in gesprek te gaan en uw Kamer over de uitkomst hiervan te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het melden en afhandelen van mijnbouwschade in Limburg

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why a promised scheme for handling mining damage from former coal mining in South Limburg, announced in 2015, is still not ready, and what the state of play is regarding a single contact point, the role of the Commissie Mijnbouwschade and the Calamiteitenfonds, the reduction of bureaucracy, the Calamiteitenfonds method, the number of affected properties, and SodM's supervision of after-effects. The State Secretary answers that a damage protocol and compensation scheme are expected by mid-2023, with the ministry taking over claims and pursuing successors, and promises a single point of contact and oversight changes to the Mijnbouwwet, while stating that the exact number of affected homes is not known.
I expect to have the required damage protocol ready by mid-2023.
Ik verwacht het benodigde schadeprotocol medio 2023 gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het dreigende vertrek van gasbedrijven uit Nederland

An MP asks the state secretary about the threat of gas companies leaving the Netherlands due to the temporary excise increase and solidarity contribution, including the tax burden, investment effects, economic contribution, and legal feasibility. The government defends the 65% cijns rate and solidarity levy as proportionate, says investment is still profitable, notes an investment incentive is being considered, and says the measures are legally and administratively feasible.

The cabinet is still examining, also in consultation with the sector, whether there are options to build investment incentives alongside the increased mining levies so that companies keep investing in gas production in the Netherlands.

Het kabinet kijkt nog nader, ook in overleg met de sector, of er mogelijkheden zijn om naast de verhoogde mijnbouwheffingen ook investeringsprikkels in te bouwen om te zorgen dat bedrijven blijven investeren in de gasproductie in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boulakjar over het protest op 26 november tegen de gaswinning in de Waddenzee

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the 26 November 2022 protest against gas extraction under the Wadden Sea near Ternaard, and whether he would urge Shell (NAM) to withdraw its permit application. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said no new Wadden Sea extraction permits will be issued and that the Ternaard procedure is the last one, but postponed any talks with NAM until the outcome of a supplementary nitrogen assessment ordered after the Porthos ruling.
At this moment I first want to await those outcomes before I can take a next step in the decision-making on the Ternaard project together with the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen
Op dit moment wil ik eerst die uitkomsten afwachten, voordat ik samen met de Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof een volgende stap kan zetten in de besluitvorming over het project Ternaard
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over misbruik datalek IMG en bedrijven die verdienen aan schadeafhandeling

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the IMG data leak and commercial firms that take a commission on Groningen earthquake damage claims, including a misleading letter from 'loket bevingsschade'. The State Secretary confirms the two IMG data leaks and the firm's misleading branding, says a commercial service is unnecessary, notes IMG cannot quantify the firms' earnings, and points to existing independent support and the Tijdelijke wet Groningen amendment on compensation for legal and technical assistance.
IMG regrets that people's data was wrongly shared and has announced it will file a criminal complaint against the company concerned.
Het IMG betreurt dat er onterecht gegevens van mensen zijn gedeeld en heeft inmiddels bekend gemaakt aangifte te doen tegen het bedrijf in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over terugtreden aannemer bij sloop-nieuwbouw in het kader van de versterkingsoperatie in Groningen

An SP MP asks the state secretary about a contractor withdrawing from a demolition-and-rebuild job in Loppersum, the delay this causes for a resident, and recurring problems with NCG budgets, planning and payments. The state secretary says the withdrawal is exceptional and not caused by NCG, commits to a replacement contractor and talks with contractors, but gives no concrete fix for the delays.
However, a proposal for a replacement contractor will be made as quickly as possible.
Er wordt echter zo snel als mogelijk een voorstel gedaan voor een vervangende aannemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Boulakjar over de gevolgen van de Porthos uitspraak van de Raad van State voor de vergunningaanvraag voor gaswinning bij Ternaard

Two D66 MPs asked how the Council of State's Porthos ruling affects the permit process for gas extraction near Ternaard and when a decision can be made. The minister answered that construction-phase nitrogen deposition must now be assessed, that the NAM has until Q1 2023 to supplement its application, and that she cannot yet give a completion date.
At this moment I cannot yet indicate when the decision-making can be concluded exactly.
Op dit moment kan ik nog niet aangeven wanneer de besluitvorming precies kan worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Boulakjar over het IMG die de wachttijd voor schadeafhandeling laat oplopen naar 21 maanden

MPs Beckerman and Boulakjar asked why Groningen mining-damage claimants now face waits of up to 21 months, with extended decision periods, and what the government will do. The Secretary of State acknowledges the wait is unacceptable, says IMG operates independently without consulting the ministry on procedures, and commits to monitoring and steering IMG toward faster handling of complex files.
The IMG does not keep separate records of how many letters extending decision periods it has sent.
Het IMG houdt niet separaat bij in hoeveel gevallen zij een brief met een verlenging van beslistermijnen hebben verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Grutte fragen by Waadferiening: wat betsjut ferkeap NAM foar gaswinning?

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether a planned sale of NAM's gas-extraction activities, including the Ternaard field under the Wadden Sea, would leave unclear which company would operate there and how permits and oversight would apply. The State Secretary answered that the buyer would take over the permit holder's rights and duties under the Mining Act, that the minister must consent to any transfer and test the new holder's technical and financial capacity, and that the same enforcement applies.
In this regard I note that my consent is required for the transfer of the permit and that I test the proposed new permit holder against the requirements of the Mining Act.
Daarbij merk ik op dat voor de overdracht van de vergunning mijn toestemming nodig is en ik daarvoor de beoogde nieuwe vergunninghouder toets aan de eisen van de Mijnbouwwet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens en Valstar over versnelling geothermie

MPs Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens and Valstar asked how to accelerate geothermal heat projects amid the gas crisis, including exceptions to SDE++ deadlines, a correction scheme for glasshouse horticulture, and simpler permitting and risk frameworks. The Staatssecretaris answered that retroactive SDE++ changes are unfair to other bidders, that a temporary correction scheme is being explored with a decision expected soon, and that permitting and risk rules will change in spring 2023 with a taskforce being set up.
An adjustment after the tender has closed, with retroactive effect, affects equal treatment of projects for two reasons and therefore also the government's reliability.
Een aanpassing na afloop van de tender – met terugwerkende kracht – raakt om twee redenen aan de gelijke behandeling van projecten en daarmee ook aan de betrouwbaarheid van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de waterinjectie in Twente

An MP asked whether NAM intends to restart wastewater injection in Twente in 2023, what permit is needed, and whether it can be refused. The State Secretary says he wants injection in Twente stopped, will discuss this with NAM, and will treat any extension request under the normal procedure, while noting SodM has found risk management in order.
I want the water injection in Twente not to be restarted.
Ik wil dat de waterinjectie in Twente niet meer wordt opgestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de recente aardbevingen in Groningen, schadeherstel en versterking

An MP from the SP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about renewed earthquakes in Groningen, damage settlement and reinforcement, including the IMG's damage handling, legal support, the Woo transparency requests, and reinforcement delays. The State Secretary largely acknowledges the problems and commits to several reviews and follow-up letters, but declines to legally fix the end date of gas extraction and rejects raising immaterial damage compensation.
I am doing everything I can to carry out the reinforcement operation as quickly as possible so that unsafe houses meet the safety standard.
Ik zet alles op alles om de versterkingsoperatie zo snel als mogelijk uit te voeren zodat onveilige huizen aan de veiligheidsnorm voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boulakjar over de brief van 372 wetenschappers met zorgen over de mijnbouw in de Waddenzee

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Boulakjar asked the ministers how concerns from 372 scientists about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea would be weighed in the Ternaard permit decision and whether the permit is legally sound. The minister answered that the concerns are taken into account, that a permit must be based on an appropriate assessment showing no harm to Natura 2000 sites, and that the decision is delayed because nitrogen effects of the construction phase must be reassessed after a Council of State ruling, with no firm timeline given.
I cannot currently state concretely when the decision-making will be concluded.
Ik kan op dit moment niet concreet aangeven wanneer de besluitvorming zal worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat Shell en ExxonMobil de Nederlandse Aardoliemaatschappij (NAM) in de verkoop zetten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about Shell and ExxonMobil selling parts of NAM and the consequences for Groningen compensation, guarantees, gas storage and supply security. The State Secretary answered that small fields will be transferred to regional subsidiaries needing prior ministerial consent under the Mining Act, that Groningen obligations, guarantees and the Norg Accord are unaffected, and that no action is needed.
For the transfer of an interest in a field, prior consent from the State Secretary for Mining is required under the Mining Act.
Voor de overdracht van een belang in een veld is op grond van de Mijnbouwwet voorafgaande toestemming van de Staatssecretaris van Mijnbouw vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht 'Shell en ExxonMobil zetten NAM in de verkoop'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the planned sale of NAM's small fields by Shell and ExxonMobil affects Groningen earthquake damage compensation and the reinforcement operation, and what the sale means for NAM's activities. The State Secretary answered that transfers to regional subsidiaries require ministerial consent under the Mining Act, that the Groningen field and storage sites stay within NAM BV, and that the sale therefore does not change how Groningen costs are charged to NAM.
For the transfer of an interest in a field, prior consent from the State Secretary for Mining is required under the Mining Act.
Voor de overdracht van een belang in een veld is op grond van de Mijnbouwwet voorafgaande toestemming van de Staatssecretaris van Mijnbouw vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het weigeren van dhr. Van Roost (voormalig CEO Esso Nederland) om voor de parlementaire enquêtecommissie te verschijnen

An MP asked whether a former ExxonMobil executive refusing to appear before the Groningen gas parliamentary inquiry was morally objectionable, and whether government contact with ExxonMobil should be halted. The State Secretary agreed witnesses affecting Groningen should cooperate, noted no legal obligation exists for non-Dutch residents abroad, said he would personally contact ExxonMobil, and rejected halting contacts given its role as shareholder.
I note that where persons do not have Dutch nationality and live abroad, there is no obligation to cooperate under the Parliamentary Inquiry Act.
Ik merk daarbij op dat wanneer personen geen Nederlandse nationaliteit hebben en in het buitenland wonen, er op grond van de Wet op de parlementaire enquête geen verplichting tot medewerking bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over gaswinning in Nederland

An MP asked why GasTerra, 50% state-owned, sold almost all Dutch gas to foreign buyers under long-term contracts, and asked for the contracts and prices to be made public. The minister answered that the contracts are private, commercially sensitive, and cannot be shared with MPs, while explaining the legal constraints, market pricing and the government's energy-bill support measures.
No. These are contracts between private parties containing commercially sensitive information.
Nee. Het betreft hier contracten tussen privaatrechtelijke partijen met commercieel gevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over twaalf extra te plaatsen zoutcavernes door Nobian

MP Beckerman (SP) asked about residents' concerns over twelve new salt caverns planned by Nobian near Winschoten, the lack of damage-claim evidence in stacked mining areas, the handling of damage claims by the IMG and the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, and seismicity and monitoring at existing caverns. The State Secretary answered that the procedure is in the environmental assessment stage, that the two agencies cooperate and that the government is reviewing the process and commissioning research on cumulative effects, while stating that no structural end to mining is warranted.
I have asked the agencies to work out options for this and will inform the House about it.
Ik heb de instanties gevraagd om mogelijkheden hierover uit te werken en zal u Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de casus met betrekking tot ‘(bouwkundige) problemen die ontstaan tijdens versterking en sloop-nieuwbouw in Groningen'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about construction defects in Groningen's earthquake-strengthening and demolition-rebuild projects, including the Overschild and Woltersum cases, bewilderment of residents, and inspection and liability arrangements. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems and said compensation and repairs were agreed in Overschild and that inspection, quality-assurance and warranty rules are in place, but did not track how many defects arise.
It is not recorded how many errors this concerns exactly, or how many of them are of a structural nature.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden om hoeveel fouten dit precies gaat, of hoeveel hiervan van bouwkundige aard zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ’het gebruik van Energie en de plek waar de miljardenwinsten terecht komen, terwijl de Nederlandse huishoudens in Energie-armoede vervallen’

Omtzigt asked the ministers how much gas is extracted in the Netherlands in 2022, where it goes, what long-term contracts and prices the state and its companies have, how much the state earns from gas, and whether consumers are overcharged, including whether electricity producers' profits and subsidies are fair. The government answered that the gas cannot be traced to a final destination, that contract terms are confidential, that the state earns gas revenue through specified channels, and that it is examining targeted relief for vulnerable households.
The content of these contracts is confidential, and this confidentiality is also agreed in the contracts themselves.
De inhoud van deze contracten is vertrouwelijk en deze vertrouwelijkheid is ook in de contracten zelf afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Rusland knijpt ook gaskraan naar Duitsland af, olieprijs naar 125 dollar per vat'

MPs Boucke and Boulakjar asked whether Gazprom's reduced gas deliveries to Germany via Nord Stream 1 were political, how long the reduction would last, and what it meant for Dutch gas storage and LNG supply after the Freeport explosion. The minister confirmed the reduction, said the July maintenance was planned, noted that Germany's supply security was not yet affected and that Dutch storage filling was proceeding, and declined to disclose confidential commercial contracts while pointing to the fully contracted Eemshaven LNG terminal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, en Nijboer over het boren van een zoutput door Nedmag

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether the ministry allowed Nedmag to drill toward well VE-7 without a permit and before the required analysis, and why enforcement was refused. The state secretary answered that a permit was granted for the drilling under the environmental-permit procedure, that mining from VE-7 still requires a separate winning-plan change, and that SodM found no grounds for enforcement.
I also want to make a working visit to speak with residents and Nedmag.
Ik wil daarnaast ook op werkbezoek gaan om te spreken met inwoners en Nedmag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Kabinet, schep duidelijkheid over de verhuisboete voor bedrijven'

An MP from the VVD asks the government about the proposed conditional final dividend tax settlement (Spoedwet conditionele eindafrekening dividendbelasting) and its effects on the Dutch investment climate, legal soundness, EU and treaty obligations, and SMEs. The government replies that it has serious objections on effectiveness, treaty conflict, free movement of capital, state aid risk and legal uncertainty, and that the Council of State advised against proceeding.
The cabinet has several objections to the bill.
Het kabinet heeft meerdere bezwaren tegen het initiatiefwetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over “de door Nederland uitgesproken steun aan diepzeemijnbouw”

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked about Dutch support for deep-sea mining, scientific uncertainty about deep-sea ecosystems, how the Dutch position was formed and who was involved, and the timeline for ISA decisions. The government answered that Dutch aims are environmentally strict conditions and a precautionary approach before exploitation, that the final position will be sent to parliament in Q3 2022, and gave partial detail on the process.
The cabinet will inform the House further about the Dutch position in the third quarter of 2022.
Het kabinet zal Uw Kamer in het derde kwartaal van 2022 nader informeren over het Nederlands standpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de opslag van aardgascondensaat in Roodeschool

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked about the State Supervision of Mines' advice to relocate the condensate loading station at Roodeschool and whether the current activities are permissible. The State Secretary acknowledged SodM's findings, said activities are halted until a gravel bed is repaired, prefers relocation, and promised to update the permit and report after the summer recess.
I have taken note of SodM's advice, in which it states that it currently assumes the activities permitted in 2004 at this location are not permittable.
Ik heb kennis genomen van het advies van SodM, waarin zij stelt dat zij er op dit moment van uitgaan dat de in 2004 vergunde activiteiten op deze locatie niet vergunbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over het bericht 'Meer sterfgevallen door Groningse aardbevingsstress'

MPs Kröger and Westerveld asked the government about a report linking Groningen earthquake stress to possible deaths, and about actions taken, the link to research, psychological effects on residents and children, and the implementation of a motion on children's wellbeing. The state secretary said he was shocked, committed to ending gas extraction in 2023 or 2024, listed funding for social-emotional support and the Commission for Special Situations, and said the child-wellbeing motion was implemented through a research project and follow-up actions.
I am shocked by these figures and will meet with the researchers in July.
Ik ben geschrokken van deze cijfers en ga in juli met de onderzoekers in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de antwoorden op eerder gestelde vragen over de gasopslag in Bergermeer

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister and State Secretary about Gazprom's control rights over the Bergermeer gas storage, whether the contracts will be shared with parliament, whether Gazprom can delay filling, why no filling obligation was imposed, what steps are being taken to end Gazprom's 40% usage right, and what additional measures will follow German escalation. The government answers that Gazprom holds a 5% participating interest with limited decision rights, the agreements are confidential and under discussion, Gazprom cannot block filling, a filling obligation was judged risky, legal options are being examined with the state advocate, and weekly fill-level updates will be provided.
The Gas Storage Agreement and Joint Operating Agreement were provided to me confidentially by EBN because they contain commercially confidential information.
De Gas Storage Agreement en Joint Operating Agreement zijn vertrouwelijk door EBN aan mij verstrekt omdat deze bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de UNESCO-brief over gaswinning in het Waddengebied

An MP from D66 asked the ministers how UNESCO and IUCN's concerns about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea fit with the government's position, what Netherlands' World Heritage obligations require, and whether a ban on new permits will be proposed. The government replies that it is weighing the submitted objections, will take UNESCO/IUCN concerns into account in the final decisions, and will send the Mining Act proposal and Wadden policy framework later, without committing to a permit ban before the summer.
Substantive concerns of UNESCO and IUCN on that point, I will take into account in the final decisions.
Inhoudelijke zorgpunten van UNESCO en IUCN op dat punt, zal ik betrekken bij de definitieve besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gaswinning onder Unesco werelderfgoed

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about gas extraction plans near the Unesco World Heritage Koloniën van Weldadigheid and whether permits should be refused. The State Secretary said the impact assessment, including a heritage study, is ongoing, that extraction will only be allowed if no irreparable harm to the heritage is expected, and that permits would likely be refused if such harm or unsafe extraction were found.
Gas extraction will only be permitted here if careful research shows that no irreparable damage to the World Heritage site is to be expected from gas extraction.
