Gaswinning zal hier uitsluitend worden toegestaan als uit zorgvuldig onderzoek blijkt dat door gaswinning geen onherstelbare schade aan het werelderfgoed te verwachten is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over woningverbeteringssubsidie Groningers

MP Van Haga asks the Minister why the Groningen home-improvement subsidy is being paid out in phases rather than by the 1 May deadline, whether the minister will commit to complete payment before the summer recess, and challenges the minister's excuse for withholding information during the recess. The minister rejects the criticism, explains that the motion only required information on the plan by 1 May, and says the subsidy opens in phases from 6 July 2022 on SNN advice, with the agency working to process applications as quickly as possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het niet nakomen van afspraken

An MP asked why the state secretary broke the promise to inform Groningen residents about the 10,000 euro home-improvement subsidy by 1 May 2022, and whether the subsidy would be paid before the summer recess. The state secretary apologised for the delay, explained the preparations and reasons for later notification, and said the scheme opens in phases from 6 July 2022 with payment within 15 working days of approval.
I apologise that it did not succeed by 1 May 2022 to inform Groningers about the new round for applying for the home-improvement subsidy.
Ik bied mijn excuses aan dat het niet voor 1 mei 2022 gelukt is om Groningers te informeren over de nieuwe ronde voor het aanvragen van de woningverbeteringssubsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over vertraging bij de afhandeling van smartegeld in Groningen

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about delays in paying immaterial damage (smartegeld) in Groningen, the repeated promises to speed things up, the coordination problems between the NCG and IMG, and whether a crisis approach will be taken. The State Secretary acknowledged delays, pointed to faster processing and the phased rollout at IMG, defended the two-organisation structure and listed acceleration measures, and committed to informing parliament on a crisis approach at short notice.
I will inform the House about this at very short notice.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hierover op zeer korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'NAM zet Rijk onder druk om in Groningen minder huizen te versterken'

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether NAM's pressure on the government to reinforce fewer homes in Groningen has delayed reinforcement, whether the cost-recovery arrangement still holds, and how residents' safety and trust will be protected amid a possible legal dispute. The State Secretary answered that NAM's position does not affect NCG's execution, that the state will recover all costs from NAM with arbitration already started, and pointed to the multi-year reinforcement plan finishing in 2028 with a further letter promised before the debate.

The multi-year reinforcement plan (MJVP), on which the former Minister of the Interior informed the House at the end of last year, contains the planning to complete the reinforcement operation by 2028.

Het meerjaren versterkingsplan (MJVP), waarover toenmalig Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties uw Kamer eind vorig jaar heeft geïnformeerd, bevat de planning om de versterkingsoperatie in 2028 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de opslag van aardgascondensaat in Roodeschool

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why a gas condensate transfer facility remains in the village of Roodeschool despite earlier statements that it should move, and what the government will do about relocation, funding, inspections and resident information. The State Secretary answered that relocation cannot be enforced because the permit and risk levels are within legal norms, that relocation is in principle possible but funding is not available, and that a broad review of mining permits and inspections is underway with results expected in May 2022.
Ik kan een verplaatsing niet afdwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Boulakjar over risico’s op zinkgaten en milieuschade in Twente

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the risk that a salt cavern under the Twence waste dump near Enschede has collapsed, possibly causing a sinkhole and soil or groundwater contamination, and about the unclear division of responsibilities between Nobian, Twence, SodM and local authorities. The State Secretary answered that the cavern has collapsed, that three scenarios are being investigated with results expected in May 2022 for SodM to assess, and that responsibilities are clear and supervisors coordinate.
SodM has asked Nobian to determine which of the three scenarios mentioned above applies.
SodM heeft Nobian gevraagd om vast stellen welke van de drie hierboven genoemde scenario’s van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over gaswinning op de Noordzee

Erkens (VVD) asked the ministers how North Sea gas production can be kept from declining and reduce dependence on Russian gas, including reserves, emissions and investment climate compared with the UK. The state secretary answered that output will decline regardless, that an acceleration plan with industry will be sent to parliament by July, and that a comparison with the UK's licensing and tax regime is provided with noted differences.
I am working with the sector on an acceleration plan to bring projects forward and stimulate additional gas extraction.
Ik werk samen met de sector aan een versnellingsplan om projecten naar voren te halen en extra gaswinning te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de uitvoering van de subsidieregeling ter verduurzaming en verbetering Groningen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Groningen sustainability subsidy: incomplete applications asked for more information within two weeks, the handling of applications, and the unpaid €250 million for those who were turned away. The State Secretary answered that SNN asks for supplementary information rather than rejecting applicants, that about 990 applicants were asked for more detail, and that a new application round with the funds will be communicated before 1 May.
I regret the course of events surrounding the opening in January of this year.
Ik betreur de gang van zaken rondom de openstelling in januari van dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de waterinjectie door NAM in Twente

An MP from BBB asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the chemicals NAM uses in its wastewater injection in Twente, the gas tariff and emergency gas status of the Schoonebeek steam supply, the legal basis for the injection without a storage permit, whether the oil permit could be revoked, and related safety and drinking water questions. The State Secretary answered in detail, describing the chemicals and safety measures, stating that revoking the permit would likely be overturned in court, and committing to work toward ending the injection by end 2022 and moving processing to Drenthe.
This means that if I nevertheless decide to revoke the permit, the court will most likely annul that decision.
Dit betekent dat als ik toch besluit de vergunning in te trekken, de rechter hoogstwaarschijnlijk dit besluit zal vernietigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het Interventieteam

The SP MP Beckerman asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the Groningen intervention team for stuck earthquake-damage and reinforcement cases, including whether the 50 million euro budget suffices, how residents are involved, whether some were pressured into settlements, and how the team relates to other bodies. The State Secretary answered that the budget is currently sufficient with 1.2 million spent, that the team offers tailored solutions but residents decide whether to accept, declined to discuss individual cases, and committed to further monitoring reports.
Unfortunately, I cannot go into individual situations.
Op individuele situaties kan ik helaas niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het artikel 'Gasmarkt toont nu weinig vrees, maar komende winter kan weer spannend worden'

An MP asked the government about gas storage filling, Russian ownership links (Gazprom's stake in Bergermeer), LNG alternatives and the price impact on households ahead of winter 2022. The minister answered that mandatory storage levels are planned, that Bergermeer is operated by TAQA with Gazprom holding certain control rights, and that LNG import capacity is limited, while many answers refer to a separate letter.
Yes, the coalition agreement already announces that the cabinet wants to introduce mandatory filling percentages for gas storage.
Ja, in het coalitieakkoord staat dan ook al aangekondigd dat het kabinet wil komen tot verplichte vullingspercentages voor de gasopslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de tv-uitzending 'Energierekening óók fors omhoog als je huis niet met gas wordt verwarmd'

MP Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a broadcast claiming heat-network households pay high prices because heat tariffs are linked to the gas price, and about options to regulate energy prices, the gas crisis plan, and gas use by industry. The Minister said cost-based tariff regulation is being prepared, that ACM has new powers and closer oversight, and that the government is preparing crisis measures and examining Groningen gas output limits.
I therefore agree with ACM's warning to heat suppliers not to raise their tariffs.
Ik sluit me dan ook aan bij de waarschuwing van de ACM aan warmteleveranciers om de tarieven niet te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over gelijke gevallen die ongelijk worden behandeld

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked why homes in similar situations in Groningen (Ten Boer, Delfzijl, Ganzenerf) are treated differently under the earthquake-damage reinforcement and compensation rules, and whether the six-month decision period for joint reinforcement is justified. The state secretary answered that unexplained differences will be reviewed for a letter to parliament before summer, that the same six-month period applies to all owners, and that compensation and subsidy options exist for some cases, without committing to a specific change now.

As stated, I am looking at the differences that have arisen over the years in an integrated way and will inform the House of the options the cabinet sees to limit the unexplainable differences as much as possible.

Zoals benoemd, kijk ik integraal naar de verschillen die door de jaren heen zijn ontstaan en zal ik de Kamer berichten welke mogelijkheden het kabinet ziet om de onuitlegbare verschillen zoveel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over zandsuppletie bij gaswinning onder het UNESCO Werelderfgoed

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked whether UNESCO has been informed that sand nourishment may compensate gas- and salt-extraction subsidence in the Wadden Sea World Heritage site, and what UNESCO's view is. The minister answers that UNESCO was informed via the 2008 nomination file, that sand nourishment is coastal maintenance rather than a mitigation measure, that IUCN will assess the Ternaard gas extraction impact, and that no delisting is currently in question.
I do not consider that necessary.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het winnen van extra gas uit het Groningenveld

GroenLinks MP Kröger asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about how much extra gas might be extracted from the Groningen field, German supply rights, the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas, Groningen subsidy problems, and appeal options. The State Secretary largely deferred decisions to a 1 April 2022 choice on production levels and promised further letters, while describing the supply and crisis-plan arrangements and the subsidy increases.
Before 1 April 2022 I will take a final decision on the production level.
Voor 1 april 2022 zal ik een definitief besluit nemen over het winningsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de brief van 6 januari 2022 'Mogelijke verhoging gaswinning Groningenveld gasjaar 2021-2022'

An MP asked whether extra Groningen gas extraction for 2021-2022 is legally and ethically permissible given the delayed nitrogen plant, the earlier decision to phase out extraction, and export obligations, and whether new advice should be sought. The government answered that the Mijnbouwwet allows annual and in-year adjustments, that appeals remain open, that the phase-out aim stands, that export contracts are a matter for the parties involved, and that it will inform parliament and decide on the extraction level before 1 April 2022.
Before 1 April 2022 I will take a final decision on the extraction level.
Voor 1 april 2022 zal ik een definitief besluit nemen over het winningsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Ook 200 belastingadviseurs bestempeld als fraudeur: onterecht volgens Achmed, die nu dak- en werkloos is'

An MP asked the government about the Combiteam Aanpak Facilitators (CAF), which labelled about 200 tax advisers as fraudsters, and about asset seizure and compensation for affected advisers and clients. The State Secretary answered that the CAF handled 218 cases, that an external investigation into its working method will be commissioned, and that there is no separate compensation scheme for tax advisers while the restoration operation concerns mainly childcare-benefit victims.
I have decided to have this investigation carried out by an external party.
Ik heb besloten dit onderzoek door een externe partij te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Opnieuw stormloop op SNN-subsidie, wachttijd loopt op tot enkele uren'

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about reports of a rush for the SNN housing improvement subsidy in Groningen, with waiting times of several hours, and whether this could create inequality or arbitrariness. The state secretary said extra budget will be made available so all eligible Groningers can apply, and that applications are processed in order of arrival.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de 10.000 euro subsidie voor verbetering/verduurzaming van woningen in het gaswinningsgebied

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why the 10,000 euro Groningen home-improvement subsidy ran out of budget, why applicants queued for hours, and whether this was fair. The State Secretary admitted the budget was underestimated, added 250 million euro, acknowledged the queuing and technical problems, and committed to further review and a policy letter.
I informed your House on 14 January 2022 by letter that the cabinet is allocating an additional 250 million euro for this scheme.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 14 januari 2022 per brief («Benutting budget woningverbeteringssubsidie») gemeld dat het kabinet 250 miljoen euro extra voor deze regeling uittrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kröger over de uitzending van het programma Hofbar op 2 februari 2022

MPs Omtzigt and Kröger asked why the state secretary took part in a TV broadcast on wastewater injection in Twente while questions on the same issue were still pending, and why the ministry published a 'milieuneutral' permit change that loosened toluene limits. The state secretary answered that the broadcast reflected transparency toward media, that the injection was halted by the regulator and operator, that the permit application was withdrawn, and that the motion would be implemented via a separate letter.
The manner in which the motion by Member Mulder et al. will be implemented will be communicated to the House today by letter.
Over de wijze waarop de motie van lid Mulder c.s. wordt uitgevoerd wordt uw Kamer heden via een brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de lozing van NAM-afvalwater in Dinkelland

An MP asks why NAM's wastewater discharge into Dinkelland will take at least three years to stop, and raises questions about subsurface pressure, earthquake risk, liability, the Commissie Mijnbouwschade's competence, and the division of oversight tasks. The State Secretary answers that the timeline is needed to obtain permits and build new treatment, denies expected extreme effects, says the State is owner of the deep subsurface but NAM is liable, and describes the overlapping responsibilities of SodM, the Mijnraad and other bodies.
The State owns the deep subsurface. NAM is the permit holder and responsible for the water injection and any consequences.
De Staat is eigenaar van de diepe ondergrond. NAM is de vergunninghouder en verantwoordelijk voor de waterinjectie en de eventuele gevolgen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de afvalwaterinjectie in Twente

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the Twente wastewater injection, including the adopted motion to suspend it, toluene exceedances, and inspection records since 2011. The State Secretary replied that NAM must submit a re-evaluation by 1 July and a decision will follow, that the operator shut injection temporarily over toluene and CO2 exceedances, that the permits were sent to Parliament in 2016, and that operator violation reporting is largely left to NAM, while SodM supplied an inspection overview.
I am implementing the motion by setting NAM a shorter deadline to deliver the re-evaluation and then taking a decision myself as quickly as possible.
Ik geeft uitvoering aan de motie door NAM een kortere termijn te stellen voor het opleveren van de herevaluatie en zelf daarna zo snel mogelijk een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het via Nederland wegsluizen van vaccinwinsten door Pfizer

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Pfizer routed about 15 billion dollars of profits, including vaccine profits, through a Dutch conduit company to the United States, why this is possible given the ban on retaining profits, and whether this prompts faster action on the Ter Haar committee's recommendations. The government refused to discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer citing tax secrecy, and pointed to recent anti-avoidance measures, a pending EU proposal and a forthcoming reaction on the committee's recommendations.
Under the tax secrecy obligation laid down in Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.

Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht die is neergelegd in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de compensatieregelingen bij hogere energiekosten

An MP asked whether residents of large complexes such as students and elderly people, who often lack their own energy contract, benefit from the energy tax cut and the extra 200 euro compensation for low incomes. The government answered that residents receive compensation through the energy tax reduction and that targeted support exists, but acknowledged that the distribution cannot be tailored to each household and promised to report on energy prices every two months.
The cabinet therefore continues to closely monitor the development of energy prices.
Het kabinet blijft daarom de ontwikkeling van de energieprijzen nauwlettend in de gaten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Arrest vermogenstaks volgend hoofpijndossier voor fiscus'

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Finance, after two court rulings finding the current box 3 wealth tax unlawful, whether the tax can stay in place until 2025, what could be done to bring forward a tax based on actual returns, and when the cabinet will respond. The State Secretary replies that the current legislation is not in line with the Supreme Court ruling, that keeping it until 2025 is undesirable, that options to amend it earlier are being studied, and that a debate is scheduled for 2 February.
The legislation is currently not in line with the Supreme Court ruling.
De wetgeving is momenteel niet in lijn met het arrest van de Hoge Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Alkaya en Dassen over het bericht ‘Belasting besparen: zo doen Zuidas-partners dat’

MPs asked whether Zuidas partners' use of BV structures and DGA arrangements lets them pay less tax than employees, whether the Tax Authority's agreements on reasonable salaries are acceptable, and whether a 20-partner BV constructions should be banned. The State Secretary acknowledges a possible gap, describes the excessive-lending bill and the reasonable-salary rules, says new policy options are unnecessary, and states that ministers' business interests were disclosed under a motion.
The Tax Authority does not address individual cases because of its statutory duty of confidentiality.
De Belastingdienst gaat in verband met zijn wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad dat de vermogenstaks 2017 en 2018 in strijd zijn met het eigendomsrecht

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance how the government will respond to the Supreme Court ruling that the 2017 and 2018 box 3 wealth levy, based on a fictitious return, violates property rights, including the scope of refunds, budget costs, and whether the switch to actual-return taxation can be accelerated. The State Secretary answers that the consequences and the restoration operation are still being worked out, that the legislation will be amended earlier than 2025 if feasible, and that the Chamber will be informed in early February.
Once the details are clear, I will inform the Chamber about this.
Zodra de uitwerking helder is, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het arrest van de Hoge Raad op 24 december 2021 over Box 3

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance how the government will respond to the Supreme Court's December 2021 ruling that the Box 3 wealth tax violates property rights and non-discrimination, including whether it will provide restitution, share prior advice, and estimate costs. The State Secretary says restitution is being prepared, a list of advice will follow within two months, and no restitution will be given for 2013-2016 before the European Court of Human Rights rules.
I therefore assume that Mr Omtzigt also means internal notes that were submitted as advice to the political office holders.
Ik ga er daarom vanuit dat de heer Omtzigt ook interne notities bedoelt die als advies aan de bewindspersonen zijn gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Idsinga over het bericht 'Meer dan miljoen spaarders lopen fiscale teruggave mis door wetswijziging'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that over a million savers may miss box 3 tax refunds because of the 2016 change to the mass objection procedure, asking about objection numbers, budgetary effects, and how the government will handle the Supreme Court ruling and pending ECtHR cases. The State Secretary answered that about 120,000 objections were lodged, the scope of the group eligible for redress is not yet determined, budget impacts are being mapped, and the government will inform parliament once options are clear.
Once the elaboration is clear, I will inform the House about this.
Zodra de uitwerking helder is, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel ‘Huizentekort? Schaf de straf op samenwonen af’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about an article claiming that cohabitation can cause large net income losses through tax and benefit rules, pushing people to keep two homes; the questions included worked examples of losses for single-parent and pensioner couples. The government answered that cohabitants share living costs, that the outcomes reflect the ability-to-pay principle, that the examples look different once cost-sharing is standardised, and that it plans to stop counting young adults up to 27 as cost-sharers under the benefit rule.
I cannot estimate the extent to which the situations described in the article occur in practice.
Ik kan geen inschatting maken van de mate waarin de in het artikel beschreven situaties zich in de praktijk voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Conflicten bij Deloitte en EY leggen bom onder verdienmodel Zuidas'

MP Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance about partner holding structures at Zuidas advisory firms, the tax burden of partners versus employees, governance and oversight of partners not in employment, and Tax Authority supervision. The State Secretary explained the box 1/2/3 and corporate tax treatment of direct and indirect partner participations, said the tax-secrecy rule prevents comment on individual cases, rejected the view that holding structures amount to tax avoidance, and pointed to existing accountancy oversight and planned reforms.
Based on the fiscal confidentiality obligation laid down in article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I furthermore cannot discuss the tax position of individual taxpayers.

Op grond van fiscale geheimhoudingplicht die is neergelegd in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik bovendien niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Is belasting betalen weer iets voor de dommen?'

MPs Nijboer and Van der Lee asked whether the 2021-2022 increase of the corporate tax low-rate bracket invites companies to split into multiple BVs to avoid tax, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answers that the effect is not yet known, the government will monitor fragmentation and report next year, and no legislative change is currently committed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de COP26-verklaring voor het in lijn brengen van internationale overheidssteun met de groene energie

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development how the COP26 pledge to align public international support with clean energy would affect SMEs, renewable exporters, workers, fossil export credit, and the scope of exceptions. The government answered that it will implement the pledge by end-2022, will inform parliament by Q2 2022, and gave partial answers on definitions, CCS, and transparency, while several questions were deferred.

The cabinet will use the coming months to reach a careful implementation with the sectors involved and will endeavour to inform the House about this by the second quarter of 2022 at the latest, in line with the adopted Klink motion.

Het kabinet zal de komende maanden benutten om met de betrokken sectoren tot een zorgvuldige implementatie te komen en zich inspannen de Kamer hierover uiterlijk in het tweede kwartaal van 2022 over te informeren, conform de aangenomen motie Klink c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘Onderzoeker: truc met dividend hield zeker 12 miljard euro weg van Nederlandse Belastingdienst’

MP Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that dividend stripping cost the Dutch tax authority up to 12 billion euro, including whether the government has contact with other EU countries and what the scale and remedies are. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of dividend stripping, said the 2001 anti-abuse rule is hard to enforce, identified about 250 million euro in corrections over 2000-2020, declined to estimate total losses as unreliable, and promised a consultation document on alternative measures by year-end.
It is very difficult to make visible how much tax revenue is not paid due to fraud and avoidance.
Het is heel moeilijk inzichtelijk te maken hoeveel belastinggeld door fraude en ontwijking niet wordt betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ‘foute investeringen die de klimaatramp verergeren’

Leijten (SP) asked the state secretaries about an IMF finding of 5.9 trillion dollars in fossil fuel subsidies in 2020, the rise in public investment in fossil fuels since the Paris Agreement, G7 phase-out plans, and the role of hedge funds buying fossil shares divested by institutional investors. The government acknowledged the IMF figure is mainly unpriced external costs, stressed carbon pricing and international coordination, and rejected a private investment ban on oil and gas and a 'Klimaatbank' as not opportune.
I do not have cumulative data on what share of this has been invested in oil and gas.
Ik beschik niet over cumulatieve data over welk aandeel hiervan is geïnvesteerd in olie en gas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over ontwikkelingen rond de exportkredietverzekering voor een gasproject in Mozambique

An MP asked the government about export credit insurance for the Mozambique LNG gas project, including the use of a 2°C climate analysis, the due diligence on security and human rights risks, and whether to end export support for new oil and gas projects. The government answered that the insurance follows IFC emissions standards rather than specific temperature scenarios, that due diligence was conducted carefully though risks materialised, and that it will work on new policy to end fossil fuel export support by end 2022.
The cabinet signed the COP26 declaration on international public support for the green energy transition on 8 November.
Het kabinet heeft op 8 november de COP26 verklaring over internationale publieke steun voor de groene energietransitie ondertekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de COP26-verklaring over het in lijn brengen van internationale overheidssteun met de groene energietransitie

An MP asked whether the government knows of and what its position is on the COP26 statement on aligning international public support with the green energy transition, and asked for a strategy by early 2022 on phasing out fossil fuel use, including in export credit insurance. The government confirms it signed the statement, says the E3F coalition will serve as a forum for implementing it on export credit, and commits to new policy by end-2022 with a report to parliament early 2022 as requested by motion.
As indicated in the parliamentary letter, the cabinet will work in 2022 on new policy to end international public support for the fossil energy sector, particularly regarding export credit insurance.

Zoals in de Kamerbrief aangegeven zal het kabinet in 2022 werken aan nieuw beleid voor het beëindigen van internationale overheidssteun aan de fossiele energiesector, in het bijzonder voor wat betreft de exportkredietverzekering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling

MP Hammelburg (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the business succession exemption (BOR) mainly benefits a small group of entrepreneurs, its annual budgetary cost, the effect of an adviser proposal to widen and reshape it, and feasible efficiency improvements. The State Secretary largely agreed the benefits concentrate among few entrepreneurs, provided budget figures for 2012-2017, said the combined proposal's budget effect cannot be given, and pointed to an ongoing evaluation due in Q1 2022.
Based on this outline of the proposal, it cannot be stated what the budgetary effect would be of the combination of all these proposals.
Op basis van dit voorstel op hoofdlijnen is niet aan te geven wat het budgettaire effect zou zijn van de combinatie van al deze voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de hoge benzineprijzen

An MP asked why petrol prices are high while oil prices fall, whether government can lower them, whether it will ask the competition authority to investigate abuse of market power, and whether it will compensate for the cost-of-living effect. The government answered that pump prices depend on market factors and that it has no direct influence beyond excise and VAT, will forward the abuse questions to the ACM which sets its own priorities, and declined a separate compensation.
I can however commit to forwarding these questions to the ACM.
Ik kan wel toezeggen dat ik deze vragen zal doorgeleiden aan de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Idsinga over het artikel 'De Tweede Kamer opnieuw geschoffeerd…'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Idsinga asked why the State Secretary no longer responded integrally to comments from the NOB and RB on tax bills, and whether this practice would continue, asking for prompt answers before the debate. The State Secretary defended selective answering as avoiding duplication with MPs' own questions and promised a reply to the NOB and RB comments shortly.
The cabinet will respond to the comments of the NOB and the RB in the short term.
Het kabinet zal de commentaren van de NOB en het RB op korte termijn van een reactie voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Ondernemers met betalingsregeling voor corona-belastingschulden aan de goden overgeleverd’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax-debt payment arrangements for entrepreneurs hit by COVID, including loss of the arrangement for missed payments, the lack of a judicial appeal route, and possible hardship relief. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority may end arrangements in limited cases with a 14-day cure period, that appeal to the tax court is planned but postponed, and that relief and a more lenient restructuring approach are being examined.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het aanvragen van loonkostenvoordelen door werkgevers

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries about how employers apply for wage-cost subsidies for hiring people with work disabilities, including whether the correction deadline is clear and whether a legal succession changes entitlement. The government answered that guidance is published in several places, that corrections are possible until 1 May of the following year, and that the subsidy right does not pass to a successor company in a takeover or legal merger.
I am of the view that the conditions and the process are sufficiently clear because sufficient communication has taken place about them.
Ik ben van mening dat de voorwaarden en het proces voldoende duidelijk zijn omdat hierover voldoende wordt gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over burgers die worden vermorzeld in de raderen van de fiscus

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about citizens crushed by the tax authority, including reports of people losing homes, the unobserved beslagvrije voet, fines making up most of debts, and legal protection gaps. The State Secretary apologised where errors were made, pointed to outreach channels and a review of cases, and said he would inform parliament further on several points.
I want to emphasise that in all cases where the Tax Authority has made mistakes, I would in any case like to apologise for the problems these people have ended up in partly due to the Tax Authority.

Ik wil benadrukken dat in alle gevallen waarin de Belastingdienst fouten heeft gemaakt ik in ieder geval excuses wil maken voor de problemen waarin deze mensen mede door toedoen van de Belastingdienst terecht zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Weer schrik door storing bij fiscus'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary of Finance about erroneous tax penalty letters sent to businesses after an IT disruption at the Tax Authority, asking how many were affected, how the error occurred, whether COVID payment-deferral applicants were affected, and how to inform and compensate them. The State Secretary answered that 37,700 entrepreneurs wrongly received assessments and fines due to a human error during disruption repair, that affected businesses are being informed by letter and will not need to object, that costs for legal aid may be reimbursed under normal rules, and that a structural system replacement is being prepared.
In total, 37,700 entrepreneurs were wrongly issued a additional assessment and a late-filing fine.
In totaal hebben 37.700 ondernemers onterecht een naheffingsaanslag en een aangifteverzuimboete opgelegd gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Stoffer over de afhandeling van bezwaren tegen de spaartaks

MP Stoffer asks why the Tax Authority processes individual objections against the box 3 assessment while the collective mass-objection procedure is pending, and whether it will hold individual objections in abeyance to protect citizens' legal protection. The State Secretary answers that individual and legal questions are separate and must be handled apart, that the Tax Authority will not hold individual objections in abeyance, and that doing so would not increase legal protection.
The Tax Authority does not make use of this possibility.
De Belastingdienst maakt geen gebruik van deze mogelijkheid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over schriftelijke vragen van 27 augustus 2021 over de beantwoording van prejudiciële vragen van het Hof Arnhem-Leeuwarden door de Hoge Raad van 2 juli 2021

MP Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance to respond urgently to earlier written questions about the Supreme Court's answers to preliminary questions from the Arnhem-Leeuwarden Court, since taxpayers face deadlines in their objection procedures. The State Secretary acknowledged the urgency, said the questions could not be answered within a week, and stated that taxpayers lose no rights and that the normal statutory objection procedure still applies, with the tax authority not suspending individual objections.
Nevertheless, I hope and expect that taxpayers will take from the answers the reassurance that they do not lose any rights and that their legal position is not harmed.
Niettemin hoop en verwacht ik dat belastingplichtigen uit de beantwoording van de vragen de geruststelling halen dat zij geen rechten verliezen en dat hun rechtspositie niet wordt geschaad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over toeslaggedupeerden met een zakelijke schuld

The SP MP Alkaya asked the State Secretary of Finance about childcare-benefit victims who took business loans under the Bbz scheme to repay tax debts, and whether such business debts can be written off since municipalities lack the legal basis. The State Secretary said business debts will be addressed only up to the EU state-aid limit of 200,000 euro over three years, with write-offs for personally liable business forms and hardship clauses for municipalities, and that implementation is planned later this year.
I intend to offer a solution for business debts that can be recovered from the private assets of the affected parent or their partner
Ik ben voornemens een oplossing te bieden voor zakelijke schulden die op het privévermogen van de gedupeerde ouder dan wel zijn/haar toeslagpartner kunnen worden verhaald
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de beantwoording van prejudiciële vragen van het Hof Arnhem-Leeuwarden door de Hoge Raad van 2 juli 2021

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority refuses to hold the individual part of box 3 tax objections in abeyance while the Supreme Court's collective (mass objection) procedure runs, and whether taxpayers risk losing individual rights. The State Secretary answers that the individual and collective questions are separate, that taxpayers can withdraw the individual part without losing collective rights, and that holding them in abeyance would impose an administrative burden, while the answer to the questions was not given within one week.
Withdrawing the objection insofar as it concerns the individual, specific issue of the taxpayer therefore does nothing to affect the taxpayer's rights in the mass objection procedure.

Het intrekken van het bezwaar voor zover dat ziet op de individuele, specifieke kwestie van de belastingplichtige doet dus niets af aan de rechten van de belastingplichtige in de massaalbezwaarprocedure
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportsteun uit Nederlands belastinggeld voor een omstreden project op de Filipijnen

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked whether the government will grant an export credit insurance (ekv) to Boskalis for a contested airport project in Manila Bay, citing forced relocations and mangrove destruction. The state secretary confirmed a conditional coverage commitment ('mvo-mits') pending an unfinished environmental and social risk assessment, declined to disclose the amount, and said no policy is yet determined on the allegations.
I cannot yet make statements about the amount that may be insured. This concerns business, competition and price-sensitive information.
Over het eventueel te verzekeren bedrag kan ik op dit moment (nog) geen uitspraken doen. Dit betreft namelijk bedrijfs-, concurrentie- en koersgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over mensen die vermorzeld worden door de Belastingdienst

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about people crushed by the Tax Authority, including harsh collection practices, stacked penalties, legislation-caused hardship, IND-related problems and access to legal aid. The State Secretary responds that the Stella team is reviewing 25 cases with 11 contacted so far, that improvements to collection strategy and legal protection are underway, and that individual tax matters cannot be discussed due to confidentiality.
Because of the fiscal confidentiality obligation, I cannot go into the personal situations of the people named in the article.
Antwoord 8 Ik kan omwille van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht 7 niet in gaan op de persoonlijke situaties van de mensen genoemd in het artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel “Het belastingstelsel zit intussen vol met fouten”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Elsevier article listing errors in the tax system is accurate, whether the examples (marginal tax pressure, the treatment of certain income components, alimony, the IACK child credit timing, savings BVs for allowances, and box 3 taxation) are justified, and whether a fix and an overview of unintended effects will be provided before Budget Day. The State Secretary generally agrees that trade-offs cause friction, defends most examples as consistent with policy goals, promises to pursue a box 3 return-based tax in preparation for a new cabinet, and says the questions could not be answered before Prinsjesdag.
In general terms I agree that bottlenecks can arise in the current tax system.
In algemene zin ben ik het ermee eens dat er knelpunten kunnen optreden in het huidige belastingstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de exportkredietverzekering rond een groot gasproject in Mozambique

An MP asked the government about export credit insurance issued for a large gas project in northern Mozambique, including the insured values, the decision process, the armed-violence risk, and the force majeure situation. The state secretary answered that the decisions followed national policy and due diligence, acknowledged the mitigation proved inadequate in hindsight, and said conditions will be set before any resumption of the project.
The cabinet agrees that, in hindsight, the risk analysis and mitigating measures on security proved inadequate.
Het kabinet deelt de mening dat de risicoanalyse en mitigerende maatregelen op veiligheidsgebied achteraf gezien ontoereikend zijn gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de exportkredietverzekering voor het omstreden gasproject in Mozambique

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan ask whether export credit insurance granted for the Total Mozambique LNG project was justified given escalating violence, human rights abuses and climate concerns, and why the policy was not withdrawn. The government answers that the risk assessment was careful and based on the information then available, that the force majeure situation was not foreseen, that the policy is not currently withdrawn, and that a new security, human rights and environmental review plus remedial action plan will be required before the project resumes.
The cabinet asks the multilateral development banks to systematically test for Paris alignment from 2023 onwards.
Het kabinet vraagt de multilaterale ontwikkelingsbanken om uiterlijk vanaf 2023 systematisch te toetsen op Paris alignment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rechtbank: Vermogensbelasting is discriminerend voor spaarders'

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling that the box 3 wealth tax discriminates against savers, and urged faster reform, retroactive remedy, and a firm deadline. The State Secretary answered that the appeal cases are pending before the Supreme Court, that retroactive redress is premature, and that a contour note on taxing actual returns will be presented in 2021, with the decision left to the next cabinet.
Providing legal redress does not fit within the ongoing mass objection procedures for 2017 and 2018 and is moreover premature.
Het bieden van rechtsherstel past niet in de nog lopende massaal bezwaarprocedures over de betreffende jaren 2017 en 2018 en is bovendien prematuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de cv/bv-structuur

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the cv/bv structure, including the Commission's state aid concerns, the 2005 hybrid-entity decision IFZ2005/546M, and whether the government informed the European Commission or the Chamber. The government answered that it had no contact with the Commission on state aid for the structure, that the state aid risks were limited, that the Commission had not found unlawful aid, and that the revenue involved cannot be traced.
It cannot be determined which money flows are related to the cv/bv structure.
Het is niet te achterhalen welke geldstromen aan de cv/bv-structuur gerelateerd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een familie die vermalen wordt in de molens van de overheid

Parliamentary questions from MP Van Nispen (SP) asked why a family was harmed by government action over a small cannabis plantation, including Tax Authority estimates, closure of their home under article 13b Opiumwet, and denial of subsidised legal aid. The ministers declined to discuss the specific case, citing tax secrecy and the judge's role, defended the legal framework and noted ongoing evaluations and a planned legal-aid review.
A specific case cannot be discussed.
Er kan niet worden ingegaan op een specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een ondernemer die van de Belastingdienst duizenden euro’s voor gezonde lunch voor werknemers moet (terug)betalen

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether it is acceptable that an entrepreneur must pay back tens of thousands of euros in tax on healthy lunches provided to staff, and what will be done to ease rules for such employers. The State Secretary said healthy meals are supported by tax rules, explained the meal valuation and free-space regime, and stated that existing law already allows favourable treatment of healthy meals.
Employers who want their staff to eat healthily are also supported in this with tax measures.
Werkgevers die personeel gezond willen laten eten worden hierin ook met belastingmaatregelen ondersteund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over invoeren prijsopdrijvende startersvrijstelling

An MP asks why the government introduced the first-time buyer exemption from transfer tax despite advice from officials and Dialogic reports warning of price effects and inefficiency, and why it did not consult the market. The State Secretary answers that the effect on house prices is too early to judge, that the final design differs from the studied variants, that the scheme was introduced quickly in line with a parliamentary motion, and that a 2024 evaluation will follow.
In 2024 the Act on differentiated transfer tax will be evaluated.
In 2024 zal de Wet differentiatie overdrachtsbelasting worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over de positie van Nederland als financiële draaischijf in de wapenindustrie

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch tax rules let major arms manufacturers route large sums through the Netherlands to avoid tax, and whether substance requirements and arms-export presumptions of denial should be tightened. The State Secretary of Finance acknowledged that the Dutch tax system has been used for avoidance structures, pointed to existing and planned anti-avoidance measures and a committee on conduit companies, but declined to comment on individual taxpayers and did not commit to tightening substance requirements.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot address the tax position of individual taxpayers.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over Temper

Two PvdA MPs asked why the Inspectorate SZW treats Temper as a temporary-work agency while the Tax Authority treats it as a client, and whether the Tax Authority's position undermines the Inspectorate and leaves vulnerable workers unprotected. The minister answered that the two bodies have different purposes and methods, that individual cases and inspection reports cannot be disclosed, and that workers can bring civil claims or register-based enforcement remains available.
I cannot make any statements about individual cases and investigations of the Inspectorate SZW.
Over individuele zaken en onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Idsinga en Erkens over de fiscale behandeling van thuiswerkdagen in relatie met Duitsland en België

Two VVD MPs asked whether the temporary tax arrangements with Germany and Belgium on home-working days during COVID, currently valid until 30 September 2021, would be extended and whether a permanent arrangement is possible. The State Secretary answered that extension to the end of 2021 is sought but depends on the partner countries, no changes are expected if extended, and a permanent arrangement is being raised in talks without any outcome yet.
I am partly dependent on Belgium and Germany for this.
Ik ben hiervoor mede afhankelijk van België en Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de wateroverlast in Limburg

An MP asked the government about end-June flooding in Limburg (Eygelshoven, Meerssen), whether it shares the cause of the mid-July disaster, and whether victims and entrepreneurs can get compensation when insurers do not pay. The minister answered that the June rains are not comparable to the July disaster, that the Wts does not apply, that no separate fund is planned, and that loss of turnover is excluded from Wts compensation but the government will discuss it with the region, pointing to the NOW 4 wage subsidy.
The cabinet does however want to discuss this with the region and entrepreneurs' representatives, paying attention to proportionality, feasibility and precedent.
Het kabinet wil evenwel het gesprek hierover met de regio en ondernemersvertegenwoordigers voeren, waarbij ook aandacht is voor proportionaliteit, uitvoerbaarheid en precedentwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over falend schuldenbeleid van de Belastingdienst

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten (SP) asked why the Tax Administration offset benefit debts without applying the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) and how it will fix this and inform debtors. The State Secretary admits the practice was wrong, promises talks with the Ombudsman and LOSR, outlines plans to improve information and access to payment arrangements, and refers to an attached letter for details.
Given the purpose and intent of the Simplification of the Protected Minimum Act, I now conclude together with Toeslagen and the Tax Administration that this method should not have been applied.
Gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet (Wet vBVV) concludeer ik nu met Toeslagen en de Belastingdienst dat deze werkwijze niet had mogen worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over het lage btw-tarief op sierteeltproducten

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked the government about the reduced 9% VAT rate on ornamental horticulture products, questioning its original justifications, its environmental impact, reliance on migrant labour, and whether it should continue. Minister Schouten answered that the reduced rate remains justified for affordability and sector support, that the sector's pesticide use per hectare has declined, and that a broad evaluation of the reduced rate will take place in 2022.
A broad evaluation of the reduced VAT rate, including ornamental horticulture, will take place in 2022.
Er zal in 2022 een brede evaluatie van het lage btw-tarief, inclusief sierteelt, plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Schuldenbeleid van Belastingdienst onder vuur’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Administration offset childcare and other allowances against debts without applying the minimum-existence protection (beslagvrije voet), possibly pushing people below subsistence. The State Secretary acknowledged the practice should not have been applied, described the meetings with the Ombudsman and advice bodies, and outlined interim fixes and a planned communication strategy, while noting offsetting has been halted since 18 December 2020.

In view of the purpose and intent of the Simplification of the Minimum Protected Amount Act, I now conclude, together with Toeslagen and the Tax Administration, that this method should not have been applied.
Gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet (Wet vBVV) concludeer ik nu met Toeslagen en de Belastingdienst dat deze werkwijze niet had mogen worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht 'Duizenden euro’s schade bij gepensioneerden door nabetaling pensioen'

MP Den Haan asked whether pensioners harmed by lump-sum back-payments from ABP, and whether the Tax Authority should proactively inform them or find a generic solution. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that the matter is mainly the paying pension fund's responsibility, explained the tax treatment and averaging options, and said ABP offers compensation for residual harm.
I see no role for myself or the Tax Authority in the arrangements between ABP and pension recipients.
Voor een rol in de afspraken tussen ABP en de pensioengerechtigden zie ik geen plaats voor mijzelf of de Belastingdienst.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over brieven die de Belastingdienst in Heerlen heeft gestuurd aan Nederlandse pensioengerechtigden die wonen in België en pensioen- en lijfrente-uitkeringen ontvangen uit Nederland

An MP asked why the Heerlen tax office sent pre-announcement letters to Dutch pensioners living in Belgium about possible back taxation for 2016-2018, and whether this conflicts with earlier correspondence and the 2018 bilateral agreement. The State Secretary answered that the letters concern 2018 with requests for 2016-2017 information, that case-by-case assessment applies, that double taxation can be addressed via the mutual agreement procedure, and that renegotiation details cannot be disclosed.
Regarding ongoing negotiations, in the interest of confidentiality (including towards treaty partners) I do not make substantive statements.
Over lopende onderhandelingen doe ik in het belang van de vertrouwelijkheid (ook richting verdragspartners) geen inhoudelijke mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het onterecht terugvorderen van toeslagen van zelfstandigen

MP Snels asked about the wrongful clawback of allowances from self-employed people caused by the Bbz loan-to-gift rule, the delayed fix, and the limited 2014–2016 compensation scheme. The State Secretary replied that the problem stemmed from a legal interaction rather than administrative error, that the compensation scheme reached only 1,169 claimants, and that whether to extend compensation to pre-2014 cases is still under review, with promised letters on documents and advice.
Currently, following a question from MP Omtzigt, all written documents on the leenbijstand from 2006 onward are being reviewed.
Momenteel wordt, naar aanleiding van een vraag van het lid Omtzigt, gekeken naar alle schriftelijke documenten over de leenbijstand vanaf het jaar 2006.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de leenbijstand

An MP (Omtzigt) asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs why the 2014 to 2016 compensation for entrepreneurs hit by the leenbijstand problem was not reported on, why the problem took so long to resolve, and what will be done for those excluded or in debt restructuring. The government admits the long delay, promises to report on compensation use and to examine extending compensation to pre-2014 cases, but declines to hand over the requested memos for now.
Unfortunately it has not yet been possible to report in line with the commitment made.
Het is helaas nog niet gelukt om te rapporteren conform de gedane toezegging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Edgar Mulder over de brandstofprijzen in Nederland

PVV MPs Madlener and Mulder asked the ministers why Dutch fuel prices are among the highest in the world, whether this harms purchasing power and border-region businesses, whether it creates dangerous cross-border jerrycan transport, and whether fuel taxes will be cut. The government answered that Dutch prices are high mainly due to world oil market supply and demand, acknowledged possible purchasing-power effects, found no evidence of rule-breaking on jerrycan limits, and said it has no plans to lower fuel taxes.
The cabinet does not intend to lower taxes on fuels.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens de belastingen op brandstoffen te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over belastingontwijking door Uber

The MP Alkaya asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by Uber through Dutch BVs, the use of the Netherlands as a conduit for profits, the arm's length principle in internal loans, APA/ruling practice, facilitators, and the non-filing of annual accounts. The government declined to discuss Uber's individual tax position under article 67 AWR, but described its anti-avoidance measures (conditional withholding tax, dividend measures from 2024, rulings policy, DAC6, the commission on conduit companies) and committed to a monitoring letter and a study of conduit companies.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over belastingontwijking door Pfizer

MP Snels (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by Pfizer through a Dutch-US cv-bv hybrid mismatch structure, its persistence despite ATAD II, state aid rules, possible subsidies for Pfizer's R&D, and further measures. The State Secretary replied that ATAD II removed the tax advantage of the cv-bv structure, that new such structures have largely ceased, that impact will be monitored with a report in 2024, that Dutch treaty policy blocks the dividend-withholding gap for the US, and that Pfizer was not found as a subsidy recipient, citing tax confidentiality for fiscal details.
Under the fiscal confidentiality obligation laid down in article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.

Op grond van fiscale geheimhoudingplicht die is neergelegd in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over mensenrechtenschending, milieuvervuiling en belastingontwijking door oliebedrijf Pluspetrol

Two MPs asked the Dutch government about alleged human rights violations, pollution and tax avoidance by Pluspetrol, including its refusal to cooperate with the Dutch OECD National Contact Point and whether business misconduct should be sanctioned or made legally enforceable. The ministers answered that OECD guidelines are voluntary, that CSR policy is being strengthened toward a due diligence obligation (preferably at EU level), and that enforcement options are still being worked out.
The cabinet is currently developing building blocks for CSR legislation.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment bouwstenen uit voor IMVO-wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het onterecht aanmerken van mensen als fraudeur

MP Nijboer asks why about 60,000 people received letters after being registered in the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), on what grounds they were registered, and how unjust consequences will be investigated. The State Secretaries answer that FSV was used for varied purposes, that its origins are often not traceable, that people will receive letters explaining registration where possible, and that a PwC study of effects will be completed around September 2021.
To carry out this work well, it is important to be able to assess whether the return or application is in all likelihood correct and complete.
Om dit werk goed uit te kunnen voeren, is het belangrijk om te kunnen beoordelen of de aangifte of aanvraag naar alle waarschijnlijkheid juist en volledig is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de Fraude Signaleringsvoorziening (FSV)

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including the number of people listed, possible ethnic profiling, legal basis, responsibility for its creation, compensation, and access to documents. The government answers that the FSV did not meet GDPR requirements and was shut down, that independent investigations by PwC and the Data Protection Authority are ongoing with results expected around September 2021, that it cannot rule out nationality-related information in free-text fields, and that documents will be provided only in a limited, interpreted manner under the Wob-like approach.
No, I cannot rule that out.
Nee, dit kan ik niet uitsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over publieke country-by-country-reporting

Member Snels asked whether Member States, including France, proposed weakening the EU public country-by-country tax reporting directive (opt-outs for six years, no CBC reporting on profits outside the EU, and dropping intra-group versus external transaction reporting). The Minister replied that the trilogue has concluded, that the contested points were either already in the negotiating mandate or are not in the text, that the Netherlands was not involved in the position paper, and that the final text will be presented to the Council for approval.
I cannot go into France's position concretely, because of the confidentiality of deliberations in the Council.
Op de positie van Frankrijk kan ik overigens niet concreet ingaan, vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de beraadslagingen in de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Arbeidsmigrant krijgt belastingkorting die Nederlander niet krijgt’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why foreign taxpayers (mostly Polish labour migrants) can claim the income-dependent combination tax credit (IACK) that Dutch families in the same situation may not get, and why a loophole identified in 2015 and 2018 was not fixed. The State Secretary acknowledges an unintended effect of the non-partner exception, provides claim figures, says the legislation will be amended with a bill before Prinsjesdag and in force 1 January 2022, and rejects reopening past assessments.
I intend to amend the legislation so that the treatment of foreign taxpayers and of domestic taxpayers married to a partner living abroad is equated with that of domestic taxpayers.

Ik ben voornemens de wetgeving zodanig aan te passen dat de uitwerking voor de buitenlandse belastingplichtige en voor de binnenlandse belastingplichtige die gehuwd is met een partner woonachtig in het buitenland, wordt gelijkgesteld met die van de binnenlandse belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de belastingheffing over Duitse oorlogsgerelateerde uitkeringen

MP Inge van Dijk asked whether the twelve-year back-assessment period could be used for income tax and social premiums on German war-related benefits, whether penalties apply, whether heirs are liable, and why GDPR is applied to protect possible war criminals when the Tax Authority breached GDPR in fraud enforcement. The State Secretary answered that the twelve-year period applies to assets held abroad case by case, that understatement fines require intent or gross negligence, that heirs are liable, and that the Tax Authority has no information on convictions and the data-protection improvement programme is ongoing.
Moreover, the Tax Authority may not hold such (criminal) information, since this information is not relevant and necessary for the Tax Authority's statutory task.

Bovendien mag de Belastingdienst niet over dergelijke (strafrechtelijke) informatie beschikken, aangezien deze informatie niet relevant en noodzakelijk is voor de wettelijke taak van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de fiscale verschillen tussen werknemers en zelfstandigen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Finance about tax differences between employees and self-employed workers, including assumptions behind tax-burden figures, the threshold profit at which self-employment is cheaper, the effect of old-age reserve limits and insurance, and comparisons by occupation. The State Secretary answered with detailed tables and assumptions, but declined to model the additional differences the MP asked about, citing methodological reasons.
Although in principle it is possible to calculate all kinds of cases, I consider it methodologically incorrect to take other differences into account in comparing the tax treatment by contract type.

Hoewel het in beginsel mogelijk is allerlei casussen door te rekenen, acht ik het methodologisch niet correct om in de vergelijking van de fiscale behandeling naar contractvorm rekening te houden met andere verschillen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de consultatie op het conceptwetsvoorstel Wet aanpassing fiscaal kwalificatiebeleid rechtsvormen, waarmee wordt beoogd hybride mismatches aan te pakken én de plannen van de Ame
