An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Dutch box 3 wealth tax should be widened to cover shareholdings and loans to companies, as in Biden's plans, and whether the draft tax-classification bill would lead entities to restructure to avoid box 3. The State Secretary rejected the claim of a box 2 loophole, defended existing rules, and said the government would study real-return taxation and submit the bill separately.
The research report will be sent to the House of Representatives in the short term.
Het onderzoeksrapport zal op korte termijn aan de Tweede Kamer worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het artikel 'Tozo-uitkering is halve sigaar uit eigen doos'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the State Secretary of Finance about how child maintenance is treated as income under the Participatiewet and tax law, the legal basis for Belastingdienst tax assessments on Tozo benefits paid to partners, and whether those assessments should be scrapped. The minister defended the current treatment, said the Tozo is a household benefit with a legal basis for the tax assessments, and declined to offer a general solution, citing the lack of a legal basis for waiving the assessments.
There is no legal basis for waiving that levy.
Voor het achterwege laten van die heffing bestaat geen wettelijke basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het verder escalerende geweld in Noord-Mozambique

An MP asked the government about escalating violence in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique, including the Palma attack, human rights abuses, the Total gas project, export credit insurance and humanitarian access. The government answered at length, largely describing the situation and EU and SADC responses, stating it is concerned, that Total declared force majeure, and that Atradius DSB monitors the situation without committing to a change in insurance policy.
The cabinet is closely monitoring the situation.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over de aanslagen in Mozambique en de rol van de Nederlandse overheid bij gaswinningsprojecten in deze regio

SP MPs asked why the Dutch government still provides export credit insurance for a Mozambique gas project amid jihadist violence and human rights concerns, and whether it will withdraw. The government answered that the insurance was granted under international standards, that the situation is being monitored, and that the abuses were committed by insurgents rather than the project, so it will continue to monitor and act within policy conditions.
The State and Atradius DSB are closely monitoring the situation and will act appropriately within the terms of the policies, depending on what the situation requires.
De Staat en Atradius DSB volgen de situatie nauwgezet en zullen op passende wijze handelen binnen de voorwaarden van de polissen en al naargelang waar de situatie om vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportkredietverzekeringen voor omstreden gasprojecten in Mozambique

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the Dutch government about export credit insurance for the contested Mozambique LNG gas project in Cabo Delgado, including security, human rights, status of policies and climate compatibility. The government answered that policies were issued in March 2021 after financial close, that the state would not recover losses from Mozambique, that a new security analysis would be needed for any restart, and that the project was assessed against OECD/IFC standards.
We therefore cannot provide you with information on this, insofar as it is not already public.
Wij kunnen u hierover dus geen informatie verstrekken voor zover niet reeds openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst weer in de fout: veel te veel toeslag voor arbeidsmigranten’

Two VVD MPs asked why the Tax Administration keeps granting the child-related budget with the single-parent supplement to migrant workers whose foreign partners are not registered, despite known errors since 2015. The government admits the verification process is complex, lists partial fixes since 2015 and promises proposals this year, but gives no count of affected migrants and no firm date for a structural solution.
It is not known in how many cases the Tax Administration wrongly assumes there is no partner.
Het is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen er door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onterecht van wordt uitgegaan dat geen sprake is van een toeslagpartner.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het ongevraagd uitkeren van een te hoog kindgebonden budget

Two SP MPs asked why the Tax Administration over-pays the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget) to migrant workers and why these people face large recoveries, and how many cases are known. The ministers answer that the system relies on BRN/BSN partner data which is often missing for partners abroad, describe partial fixes and planned improvements, and say they will review collection policy and make some changes but do not quantify harm or commit to individual redress.
It is not known in how many cases the Tax Administration wrongly assumes there is no partner.
Het is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen er door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onterecht wordt uitgegaan dat geen sprake is van een toeslagpartner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over nieuwe fouten met de uitkering van toeslagen

Snels (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about new errors in child-related allowance payments to migrant workers who are wrongly treated as single parents because their partner lives abroad, including delays, repayments and whether the Belastingdienst acts on evidence. The government acknowledged the structural difficulty in verifying foreign partner data, described the verwantschapsquery, the stopknop for refugees and new partner-submission forms, and said improvement proposals are expected this year, while declining to give figures on affected migrant workers.
It is not known how many migrant workers have reported that they wrongly received the single-parent supplement.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel arbeidsmigranten hebben aangeven dat zij onterecht een alo-kop hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat een op de vier belastingbetalers meer betaalt dan nodig is

The MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that one in four taxpayers pays more than necessary, including how income splitting between fiscal partners works, why the split cannot be changed after six weeks, and the reasons for not optimising it. The State Secretary says the Tax Administration does not hold data on non-optimal splits, explains the six-week irrevocability rule and the five-year correction limit, and admits answers could not be given before the filing deadline.
It is not possible for the Tax Administration to investigate in which individual situations an optimal allocation is present.
Het is voor de Belastingdienst niet mogelijk om te onderzoeken in welke individuele situaties sprake is van een optimale toedeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over het bericht dat de politie jarenlang onterecht informatie met de belastingdienst heeft gedeeld

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers why police in Oost-Nederland shared suspects' data with the Tax Authority for years allegedly without proper basis, and what was done about it. The government answers that a legal basis exists under the Bpg and RIEC convention but its practical application needs attention, that police suspended sharing in Oost-Nederland, is developing a uniform working method with the Tax Authority and RIEC's, and that the Data Protection Authority would be consulted later if needed.
In addition, the police will work with the Tax Authority and the RIEC's to develop a uniform working method that guarantees careful information sharing.
Daarnaast gaat de politie samen met de Belastingdienst en de RIEC’s een uniforme werkwijze ontwikkelen waarbij een zorgvuldige informatiedeling gegarandeerd wordt.
Antwoord op van het lid Omtzigt over de betaalde belasting over uitkeringen aan mensen die in Nederland wonen en in de Tweede Wereldoorlog in Duitse krijgsdienst getreden zijn (zoals bij de SS)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how much German war pension income was declared by Dutch residents who served in German forces in WWII, whether back taxes can be levied, and whether convicted war criminals are among recipients. The State Secretary answered that about 20% of recipients declared the payments, that additional assessments and invitations to file are being issued and back-assessment is possible up to five years, but could not confirm whether any recipients are convicted war criminals as this is not held by the tax authority.
I am not aware whether there are convicted war criminals among the benefit recipients.
Het is mij niet bekend of zich onder de uitkeringsgerechtigden veroordeelde oorlogsmisdadigers bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over één mondiaal minimumtarief voor winstbelasting

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked whether the US push for a global minimum corporate tax, the Yellen proposal, is a good tool against a race to the bottom, and what the government will do to avoid Dutch tax-haven reputation. The state secretary answered that Nederland supports the OECD Inclusive Framework Pillar 2 minimum tax and an agreement by mid-2021, distinguished it from the EU CCCTB, and pointed to existing anti-avoidance measures and commitment to promote the plan internationally.
The Netherlands will continue to work to reach agreements in the OECD Inclusive Framework by mid-2021.
Nederland zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten om halverwege 2021 tot afspraken te komen in het Inclusive Framework van de OESO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘Janet Yellen calls for global minimum corporate tax’

The MP Idsinga asked the state secretary of Finance how the US proposals for a global minimum corporate tax and a new profit allocation regime affect the Netherlands, whether the government will use the momentum to reach an OECD agreement, what obstacles exist, and the state of EU and OECD talks. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands supports the Inclusive Framework's aim of agreement by mid-2021, sees the US proposals as a major step, and described the remaining obstacles and timetable, promising to inform the House before the next plenary.
Prior to the plenary meeting of the Inclusive Framework, I will inform your House further on this matter.
Voorafgaand aan de plenaire vergadering van het Inclusive Framework zal ik uw Kamer daarover verder informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst weer op zijn kop werd gezet

The MP asks why the Minister of Finance decided to split the Belastingdienst into separate Douane, Toeslagen and Belastingdienst organisations, on what advice, how workers were involved, and whether the promised feasibility test will be sent to parliament. The government answers that the split improves focus and span of control, relies on earlier reports, involves staff in working groups, and promises feasibility tests in Q2 2021, while stating that ministerial responsibility for the Belastingdienst is shared with the state secretaries.
Once the feasibility tests have been carried out, we will inform your House of the results and send the tests to the House.
Wanneer de haalbaarheidstoetsen zijn uitgevoerd zullen wij uw Kamer over de resultaten van deze toetsen informeren en de toetsen aan de Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de noodzaak van een progressieve vliegbelasting voor veelvliegers

An MP asked the government about introducing a progressive flight tax for frequent flyers, citing a report on elite flying and public support. The State Secretary answered that the current per-passenger tax already charges frequent flyers more, and that a frequent-flyer levy raises implementation and privacy problems, so the government did not commit to such a tax.
The cabinet is aware that not everyone in the Netherlands flies equally.
Het kabinet is zich ervan bewust dat niet iedereen in Nederland evenveel vliegt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over burgers die in 2021 ongevraagd een voorlopige aanslag krijgen

An SP MP asked why many people received unsolicited provisional tax assessments in 2021, why they were assessed individually rather than with their partner, and whether this conflicts with the Tax Administration's personal approach and the Toeslagenaffaire trust damage. The Secretary of State said the number of first-time positive provisional assessments actually fell (265,000 in 2021 versus 277,000 in 2020), defended proactive assessment to avoid large year-end payments, and promised to improve communication and study simplifying adjustments.
I want to look at how communication about the provisional assessment can be further improved, because I realise that especially when taxpayers receive one for the first time, this raises questions.

Ik wil kijken hoe de communicatie rond de voorlopige aanslag verder verbeterd kan worden omdat ik me realiseer dat vooral wanneer belastingplichtigen deze voor de eerste keer ontvangen dit vragen oproept.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de langdurige storing bij de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the prolonged outage of the Tax Administration's online filing systems during the 2021 filing campaign, including its cause, communication, and link to IT modernisation. The State Secretary attributed the outage to unclosed failed login attempts overloading the access channels, said it is fixed, denied links to the ETM system replacement, and committed to evaluating the campaign.
Each year the course of the filing campaign is evaluated in order to further improve the process.
Ieder jaar wordt het verloop van de aangiftecampagne geëvalueerd om het proces verder te kunnen verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten en het lid Van Weyenberg over ongevraagde voorlopige aanslagen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about unsolicited provisional tax assessments sent to about 1.3 million taxpayers in January 2021, and their burden and timing. The State Secretary confirmed the figures, explained the rationale for provisional assessments, acknowledged payment difficulties, and pointed to instalment and payment-arrangement options while promising to improve communication.
I want to look at how the communication about the provisional assessment can be further improved.
Ik wil kijken hoe de communicatie rond de voorlopige aanslag verder verbeterd kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sienot over de postcoderoosregeling

Two D66 MPs asked whether the conversion of the postcoderoos tax scheme into a subsidy scheme was meant to cut back support, and why the transitional arrangement does not let new members join and avoids cooperative bankruptcies when members leave. The State Secretary denies that a cutback was intended, admits the transitional rule may not achieve its aim, and says the government is studying an additional transitional rule in the next tax package.
That is why we are examining whether it is possible to introduce additional transitional arrangements in the upcoming Tax Plan package.
Daarom laten wij uitzoeken of het mogelijk is om aanvullend overgangsrecht te introduceren in het komende Belastingplanpakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Linda's zoon (13) is over een paar maanden wees: 'Ik wil hem goed achterlaten'

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of the Interior about a 13-year-old orphan who may have to sell the family home to pay inheritance tax. The State Secretary answered that the existing rules offer no sufficient relief, that the Tax Authority can grant only limited instalment payment, and that he intends to legislate an interest-free long-term payment arrangement for such hardship cases, to be included in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2023.
I therefore intend to prepare an amendment to laws and regulations so that a general solution can be offered for this and other comparable hardship situations.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om een wijziging van wet- en regelgeving voor te bereiden zodat een algemene oplossing kan worden geboden voor deze en andere vergelijkbare schrijnende situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het Belastingverdrag tussen Nederland en Ierland en het betalen van dubbele belasting door luchtvaartpersoneel

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about double taxation of Dutch airline crew working for an Irish airline, despite the tax treaty assigning taxing rights to the Netherlands as residence state, and whether this can be resolved bilaterally. The State Secretary confirmed Dutch taxing rights, described Irish refund procedures that have improved, a central contact point, and the mutual agreement procedure for persistent cases.
Ireland must withdraw on the basis of these agreements.
Ierland moet op basis van deze afspraken terugtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Subsidieregeling Elektrische Personenauto’s Particulieren’

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked about the oversubscribed 2021 EV subsidy for private buyers, budget allocation, lottery use, and whether the subsidy should be cut to stimulate more purchases. The state secretary answered that the 2021 budget was EUR 14.4 million, that the rules were changed in 2020 to stop carrying over applications, and that she sees no reason to lower the per-car subsidy before an interim evaluation.
I will inform your House about the results of the planned interim evaluation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de geplande tussentijdse evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de versoepeling van het urencriterium in 2020 als fiscale steunmaatregel

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the hours criterion for entrepreneurs' tax facilities was relaxed in 2020 as a Covid measure, why the relaxation ended in October 2020 and was reinstated for the first half of 2021, and whether it should be extended retroactively to the last quarter of 2020. The State Secretary explained the relaxation as a temporary, non-retroactive measure to avoid losing entrepreneurs' facilities during the crisis, acknowledged that lockdowns affect entrepreneurs' ability to work, and declined to extend it retroactively.
There is no insight into how many entrepreneurs who would normally have met the hours criterion in 2020 would have benefited from an extension of the relaxation to the last quarter of 2020.

Er is geen inzicht in hoeveel ondernemers, die onder normale omstandigheden in 2020 aan het urencriterium zouden voldoen, van een uitbreiding van een versoepeling naar het laatste kwartaal van 2020 zouden hebben geprofiteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitzending van Radar van 8 februari 2021  ‘Afschaffen levensloopregeling: ‘Overheid verandert halverwege de spelregels’’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the planned end of the levensloopregeling (life-course savings scheme), its transition rules, the impact on participants, communication and tax consequences. The State Secretary answers that the scheme was abolished in 2012 because it barely served its goal, that transitional rules were agreed with parliament, and that participants have several options to move their savings, while stating communication was adequate.
It is not possible for me to address these two individual situations specifically, because the information provided is insufficient to give a correct and complete response to the questions.

Het is voor mij niet mogelijk om specifiek in te gaan op deze twee individuele situaties, omdat de verstrekte informatie onvoldoende is om een juiste en volledige reactie te kunnen geven op de vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over bilaterale Belastingverdragen ter voorkoming van dubbele belasting

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the timing of tax treaty negotiations, the 2020 fiscal treaty policy note, pension and artist/athlete taxation under treaties, and treaties with Poland, Switzerland and France. The State Secretary answered that a letter on negotiation status will follow in April, that negotiations with France are not ongoing, and that Nederland will consider the artist/athlete treatment and possible reintroduction of source taxation, without firm dates.
I expect to send this letter to your House in April.
Ik verwacht deze brief in april aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en van der Linde over het bericht ‘Ook ING stopt met inning coronasteun uit VS’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister why Dutch banks stopped cashing US COVID stimulus cheques for dual nationals and why the US-Dutch FATCA reciprocity commitment has not been met. The minister said the cheques can be claimed back via a US tax Recovery Rebate Credit, that banks are free to stop offering services such as cheque cashing, and that he keeps raising reciprocity with the US and European partners.
I remain in discussion with the US embassy on this subject.
Ik blijf in gesprek met de Amerikaanse ambassade over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over de keuze om digitale uitzendingen van culturele evenementen als elektronische dienst te beschouwen

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 21% VAT rate on digital broadcasts of cultural events, classed as electronic services, should be revised in light of the Geelen case and a critical academic commentary, and about cultural municipal support. The State Secretary replied that Geelen does not settle whether such broadcasts are electronic services, that the EU VAT Directive bars the reduced rate, that no legislative change is planned until EU negotiations conclude, and that the existing support measures are adequate.
The cabinet therefore does not intend to provide for legislative measures for this at this time.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens hiervoor op dit moment te voorzien in wettelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de antwoorden op de vragen naar aanleiding van bericht 'Schonere diesel tanken kan sinds kort ook in Roden'

Two VVD MPs asked why government policy favours zero-emission cars over HVO100 and bioLNG, which they say are costly for businesses, and what the government will do to increase demand. The State Secretary answers that HVO and bioLNG are transition fuels for heavy transport under the renewable energy obligation, that accijns refunds are possible under conditions, and that supply-side measures are being pursued.
I regularly speak with market parties and am always open to talking with parties that switch to renewable fuels.
Ik spreek regelmatig partijen uit de markt en sta altijd open om het gesprek aan te gaan met partijen die overstappen op hernieuwbare brandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van Weyenberg over de onbelaste vaste reiskostenvergoeding

MPs Palland and Van Weyenberg asked whether the tax-free fixed travel allowance measure expires on 1 April 2021, what considerations underlie extending it, how employers view it, and when clarity will be given. The government answered that the measure is extended to 1 July 2021, explained the trade-offs, said it is studying a supplementary scheme for home-working costs, and said the Tax Administration cannot see how many employers kept unchanged allowances.
The Tax Administration therefore has no information on how many employers have not adjusted the travel allowance despite no actual travel costs being incurred.
De Belastingdienst beschikt daardoor niet over informatie hoeveel werkgevers de reiskostenvergoeding niet hebben aangepast ondanks dat er geen daadwerkelijk gemaakte reiskosten tegenover staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over de tijdelijke Bbz-compensatieregeling

An MP asked how many entrepreneurs used the temporary Bbz compensation scheme, why the 2010–2014 cohort was excluded, and whether it could be extended. The minister answered that 1169 people applied, about 2.8 million euro was paid out, the cohort was excluded because the scheme followed a parliamentary motion limited to 2014–2016, and a briefing and an investigation into pre-2014 cases were promised.
1169 people applied for this compensation scheme, which was limited to persons harmed in 2014, 2015 and 2016.
Er hebben 1169 personen een beroep gedaan op deze compensatieregeling die beperkt was tot personen die in de jaren 2014, 2015 en 2016 gedupeerd waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een overzicht van alle wetten waar de Belastingdienst zich de afgelopen zeven jaar niet aan gehouden heeft

Omtzigt asked the government to provide, as required by a unanimously adopted motion, an overview of all laws the Tax Administration has not complied with over the past seven years, and questioned the government's compensation and resignation. The government answered that a single unambiguous overview is not possible, referred to examples in an accompanying letter, and said compensation in the childcare benefits case is not solely linked to breaking laws.
As set out in the accompanying letter, it is not possible to make an unambiguous overview.
Zoals volgt uit de begeleidende brief is het maken van een eenduidig overzicht niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aangenomen resolutie van het Europees Parlement op 21 januari 2021 over de herziening van de EU-lijst van belastingparadijzen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about EP resolution on the EU tax haven blacklist, including whether the Cayman Islands were delisted and whether zero-tax countries should be automatically listed. The State Secretary confirms the Cayman Islands met the criteria, supports stricter criteria such as automatic listing for zero corporate tax, promises more transparency of the Code of Conduct Group, and says the Commission will evaluate defensive measures in 2022.
The Netherlands has long been in favour of promoting greater transparency of the Code of Conduct Group.
Nederland is al een tijd voorstander van het bevorderen van meer transparantie van de Gedragscodegroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het SchuldenLabNL

MPs asked why the government appointed former finance minister Zalm, who is under OM investigation for money laundering, as chair of SchuldenLabNL, and whether private creditors would cooperate on debts of parents in the childcare benefits affair. The state secretary replied that SchuldenLabNL is an independent foundation the cabinet had no role in appointing its board, that the board is unpaid, and that talks with public and private creditors are ongoing to give affected parents a fresh start.
The cabinet has no involvement whatsoever in appointing Mr Zalm as chair or in appointing the other board members of SchuldenLabNL.
Het kabinet heeft geen enkele bemoeienis met het benoemen van de heer Zalm als voorzitter alsmede met de benoeming van andere leden van het bestuur van SchuldenlabNL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat gebrekkige gegevensuitwisseling belastingontwijking in de hand werkt

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that poor cross-border tax data exchange enables tax avoidance, including which data is exchanged, its quality, and the possibility of public country-by-country reporting. The State Secretary answered in detail on the DAC framework, data quality issues, and planned DAC7/DAC8 improvements, while stating the government supports public country-by-country reporting only through international agreement.
Making country-by-country reports by multinationals public, for example by including them as an annex to the annual accounts, can be an effective means of promoting fiscal transparency.
Het publiek maken van landenrapporten door multinationals, bijvoorbeeld door deze als bijlage op te nemen bij de jaarrekening, kan een effectief middel zijn om fiscale transparantie te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de gaswinning en het escalerende geweld in Noord-Mozambique

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about escalating violence in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique, linked to gas extraction, including Dutch export credit insurance for the project. The government answered that it monitors the situation, pressures Mozambique and the EU, supports humanitarian aid, and that Atradius DSB has issued a cover commitment for the gas project while withholding details of the insured parties and amounts as commercially sensitive.
Information on which companies and/or financial institutions are involved and for which insured amounts cannot yet be shared with the House because the insurance policies have not yet been issued.

Informatie over welke bedrijven en/of financiële instellingen dit betreft en voor welke te verzekeren bedragen kan echter nog niet met uw Kamer gedeeld worden omdat de verzekeringspolissen nog niet zijn afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het aflopen van het overgangsrecht voor saldolijfrenten

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the expiry on 31 December 2020 of the transitional regime for saldolijfrentes, including how their value is calculated, the Net Present Value method, and whether the tax burden can be reduced. The State Secretary confirmed that holders must settle the value in box 1 on that date, explained the Net Present Value method and the differences from insurers' surrender values, and refused to change the valuation method, while offering payment arrangements for those unable to pay.
No, I am not willing to do that, because a valuation other than the Net Present Value method does not match the value of the insurance for the insured and therefore does not fit the statutory system.

Nee, hier ben ik niet toe bereid, omdat een andere waardering dan de Netto Contante Waarde-methode niet aansluit bij de waarde van de verzekering voor de verzekerde en daarmee niet past binnen de wettelijke systematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over de hoge BTW-heffing over digitale popevenementen

Two MPs asked why digital pop-event tickets are taxed at the 21% standard VAT rate rather than the 9% reduced rate and whether this should change. The State Secretary confirmed that electronic services fall outside the reduced rate under EU law, rejected a reduced rate for online cultural events, and pointed to subsidy packages and the Geefwet instead.
Under EU law it is not permitted to place online cultural events under the reduced rate.
Het is op grond van het EU-recht niet toegestaan online culturele evenementen onder het verlaagd tarief te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Tielen over het bericht ‘Zzp’ers verbaasd over minieme betalingskorting Belastingdienst’

MPs Lodders and Tielen (VVD) asked why the payment discount on the 2021 provisional income tax assessment was almost nil, since it is tied to the temporarily lowered collection interest rate. Staatssecretaris Vijlbrief answered that the link is set by law, that the Belastingdienst cannot decouple it without a system change not possible before 2023, that the rate returns to 4% from 2022, and that the communication could have explained the reason more clearly in the letter.

It would have been better to state directly in the text, after the sentence 'When paying the total assessment in one go you receive a payment discount of (PM)', why the discount is lower this year than normal.

Het was beter geweest meteen in de tekst, na de zin «Bij betaling in één keer van de totale aanslag krijgt u een betalingskorting van (PM)» aan te geven waarom de betalingskorting dit jaar lager is dan normaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Voorstel: 'Track & Trace' voor de Belastingdienst'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Finance about lost and slow mail at the Tax Authority and proposed a track-and-trace system, including pilots for private and business taxpayers. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, agreed on the need for better handling, said investigation into track-and-trace is ongoing with results to be shared in Q2, and will consider the pilot proposal in planning.

Research is currently underway within the Tax Authority into the further possibilities of a track-and-trace-like system. In the second quarter, the results of the research will be shared with your House.

Momenteel loopt er onderzoek binnen de Belastingdienst naar de verdere mogelijkheden van een systeem als track & trace. In het tweede kwartaal worden de resultaten van het onderzoek met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht 'Ontwikkelaar corona-sneltest ontwijkt op grote schaal belastingen'

SP MPs asked the health minister and finance state secretary about reports that Qiagen, a supplier of COVID-19 test kits, avoided Dutch taxes while receiving public subsidies, and about public investment via the Dutch Venture Initiative. The minister answered that the government cannot comment on individual taxpayers under article 67 AWR, that no test orders were placed with Qiagen, and that the government will pursue anti-avoidance measures and study public country-by-country reporting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat een glastuinbouwbedrijf door de verhoogde Opslag Duurzame Energieheffing (ODE) overschakelt van elektriciteit naar gas

An MP asked the ministers whether the rise in the ODE energy levy, which pushes a greenhouse firm back from electricity to gas, undermines electrification and whether compensation will be paid. The government acknowledged the fiscal incentive problem, promised a compensation scheme and an evaluation in spring, but refused to revisit the levy rates in the short term.
I am not prepared to reconsider the rates in the short term.
Ik ben niet bereid om de tarieven op korte termijn te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asks the government about Maastricht Aachen Airport growth, noise in Limburg quiet areas, and conflicting studies on tourism impacts, and asks whether the growth doctrine influenced commissioned research. The minister answers that the province of Limburg is responsible for quiet areas and for MAA's future, that the independent advice is pending, and that he does not take positions on the Breda and Ecorys studies, while also replying on the air-freight levy report and rejecting a growth doctrine.

Since I am not the commissioning party for either study and there is no formal application for an airport decision yet that I must consider, I do not think it is appropriate to make statements about either study.

Aangezien ik geen opdrachtgever ben van beide onderzoeken en er nog geen formele aanvraag voor een luchthavenbesluit ligt waarover ik mij moet buigen acht ik het niet opportuun om uitspraken te doen over beide onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een overzicht van delen van wetten die wel door het parlement zijn aangenomen maar nooit in de werking zijn getreden

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked why many tax and benefit provisions adopted by parliament never entered into force, and requested a full overview with reasons and information given to the Chamber. The State Secretary provided an annex listing unimplemented tax and benefit provisions over ten years, with stated reasons for delay, and acknowledged the ministry kept no central overview, promising to include the topic in annual reports.
The Ministry of Finance does not keep a central overview of whether tax or benefit legislation has entered into force; of course this is known within the responsible departments.
Het Ministerie van Financiën houdt niet centraal een overzicht bij of fiscale of toeslagen wet- en regelgeving in werking is getreden; uiteraard is dat wel bij de behandelende afdelingen bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Mag de bank weigeren om je een bankrekening te geven? Dat gaat AFM onderzoeken’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about press reports that banks may refuse or close accounts of Accidental Americans lacking a US TIN, and whether the AFM's investigation is justified. The minister answered that the AFM has started an exploratory investigation into banks' FATCA-related account practices, that banks should assess individual cases rather than exclude a group, and that he is discussing the issue with the banks and will report by letter.

I have therefore asked DNB, as supervisor of compliance with the Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Act (Wwft), and the AFM, as supervisor of the rules on the basic payment account, to respond on the closing or freezing of bank accounts.

Ik heb daarom gevraagd aan DNB, als toezichthouder op de naleving van de Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financiering van terrorisme (Wwft), en aan de AFM, als toezichthouder op de naleving van de regels over de basisbetaalrekening, om een reactie over het sluiten dan wel bevriezen van bankrekeningen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de beslissing van de rechtbank Midden-Nederland in de casus van een Accidental American tegen de Volksbank en het bericht 'Annie Brouwer uit Harkema is Amerikaan tegen wil en d

MPs Lodders asked the Finance Minister about a court ruling allowing a bank to close the account of an accidental American, the AFM investigation into banks refusing basic accounts for lack of a TIN, FATCA-IGA privacy and double taxation, and access to basic payment accounts. The minister answered that banks may refuse accounts only on legal grounds, that the FATCA obligation stems from US law and cannot be unilaterally changed, and that banks have promised not to close accounts solely for lack of a US TIN in 2021.
The AFM supervises compliance with the rules on the basic payment account.
De AFM houdt toezicht op de naleving van de regels over de basisbetaalrekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snoeren, Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht 'Woonbelasting weer omhoog: uitschieters tot +27%!'

VVD MPs asked the government about reported large rises in local property and waste charges for 2021, the effect of abolishing the macro norm and introducing the local-cost benchmark, and possible caps and measures against rising fees. The minister answered that the national picture awaits the COELO atlas, that the benchmark is too recent to evaluate (evaluation planned for 2025), that local councils decide on charges, and that the rise in the import-waste tax is unlikely to raise local waste fees.
It is still too early to determine the effects of introducing the local-cost benchmark, because the benchmark was only introduced in 2020.
Het is nog te vroeg om te kunnen constateren wat de gevolgen van de invoering van de benchmark lokale lasten zijn, omdat de benchmark pas in 2020 is ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de uitvoering van de compensatieregeling eHerkenning

VVD MPs asked why businesses that obtained standard eHerkenning before the special Belastingdienst login became available must downgrade it, possibly at cost, to claim compensation, and about the status of the scheme. The Secretary of State answered that downgrading is free at five of six providers, that 1014 claims had been filed and paid by 25 January 2021 (no split by route possible), and that the Belastingdienst contacted about 540 organisations unable to register in the Trade Register.
RVO cannot see, when logging in with the specific eHerkenning Belastingdienst means, whether this was first a generic eH3 login means.
RVO kan bij het inloggen met het specifieke «eHerkenning Belastingdienst» middel niet zien of dit eerst een generiek te gebruiken eH3 inlogmiddel is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Slootweg en Amhaouch over het gedrag van Centric-topman Gerard Sanderink

CDA MPs asked ministers about Centric executive Gerard Sanderink's alleged threats to an inspector, destruction of evidence, ignored court rulings, and DNB's reliance on Centric software. The government answered that it would not publish his correspondence absent a request from investigators, that DNB as a contract partner monitors Centric, and that it cannot judge a private firm, while describing supervisory board powers in general terms.
At this moment I see no reason to make the correspondence in question public without a request from the bodies you mention.
Ik zie op dit moment geen redenen om bedoelde correspondentie openbaar te maken zonder dat daar een verzoek ligt van door u genoemde instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de dreiging van Rusland om het belastingverdrag met het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden op te zeggen en de gevolgen voor het Nederlandse mkb

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Russia's threat to terminate the tax treaty with the Netherlands and the consequences for Dutch SMEs. The State Secretary answered that Russia requested revisions to the agreed partial renegotiation, that no formal termination notice has been received, that termination could take effect at the earliest on 1 January 2022, and that the government aims to reach an agreement.
Should the treaty nevertheless be unilaterally terminated, I will ensure that information about the termination of the tax treaty with Russia becomes available.
Mocht het verdrag toch onverhoopt eenzijdig worden opgezegd, dan zal ik ervoor zorgdragen dat informatie beschikbaar komt over de beëindiging van het belastingverdrag met Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Miljardenvermogen vlucht uit Nederland wegens btw-plicht'

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the end of the VAT exemption for fund management affecting CLO vehicles, the financial and employment consequences, the October 2020 summary proceedings and the Supreme Court rulings of 4 December 2020. The State Secretary answered that the VAT exemption follows EU case law and the Dutch policy decree, estimated the VAT burden at about EUR 3.7 million per year, reported that 81 CLO vehicles have transferred their portfolios to Ireland, and said the transition period was extended to 1 July 2021 while a fresh assessment is made.
I aim to provide clarity to the CLOs as soon as possible, well before the transition period ends on 1 July 2021.
Ik streef ernaar om zo spoedig mogelijk duidelijkheid te geven aan de CLO's, ruim voor ommekomst van de overgangstermijn per 1 juli 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over het bericht ‘Schonere diesel tanken kan sinds kort ook in Roden’

MPs Ziengs and Lodders (VVD) asked about HVO100 renewable diesel, its CO2 savings, price and taxation, and what policy would promote it. The government answered that HVO is a renewable diesel substitute covered by existing excise rules, that supply is driven by the rising renewable energy obligation, and that a future CO2-chain system (BKE) is planned.
HVO is a high-quality renewable diesel substitute.
HVO is een hoogwaardige hernieuwbare dieselvervanger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over documenten in het toeslagenschandaal

An MP asks the State Secretary about a Landsadvocaat advice on document disclosure in childcare-benefit appeal cases, who received it, the 2018 CAF-11 directive, and related documents; the government confirms the advice exists, provides several documents, and states it could not answer all questions by the requested deadline. Most questions are answered with documents, though some items (full case files, names) are withheld.
This concerns the memo Assignment Strengthening quality assurance at the Tax Administration/Benefits, from the FJZ and UHB directorates to the Director-General of the Tax Administration.
Het betreft hier het memo Opdracht Versterking kwaliteitsborging bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen van de directie FJZ en UHB aan de directeur-generaal van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en het informeren van de Kamer

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked about delayed Wob freedom-of-information requests, the government's answers on the childcare benefit scandal, and the adequacy of earlier answers to parliament. The government denies deliberate delay for political reasons, says it knows of no such cases, admits some earlier answers were incomplete and promises to keep providing relevant information.
I will ask my colleagues to be more transparent going forward about the handling of a Wob request when handling it has taken a long time.
Ik zal mijn collega’s verzoeken in het vervolg transparanter te zijn over de afhandeling van een Wob-verzoek wanneer met de afhandeling van een Wob-verzoek veel tijd gemoeid is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Nederlandse sekteleider (58) verdacht van gijzeling en misbruik kinderen'

MPs Lodders and Van Wijngaarden asked about a report on a cult leader suspected of abuse and whether the tax authority can revoke the ANBI charity status of such organisations, including the Orde der Transformanten. The State Secretary answered that the status can be revoked via the existing integrity test or the new VOG requirement from 1 January 2021, that enforcement is risk-based, and that he will inform parliament in early 2021.

Following MP Lodders' question during Question Hour of 13 October about organisations offering homosexuality 'healing' therapies, I asked for a review of whether and what the Tax Authority can do regarding the ANBI status of such organisations and whether a legal amendment is needed.

Naar aanleiding van de vraag van het lid Lodders (VVD) tijdens het Vragenuur van 13 oktober jl. over organisaties die homogenezingstherapieën aanbieden, heb ik verzocht om nader te bezien of en wat de Belastingdienst kan doen met de ANBI-status van dergelijke organisaties en of daarvoor wetswijziging nodig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat Oeganda 21 miljoen misloopt door Nederland

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked whether the Netherlands-Uganda tax treaty lets companies such as Airtel and CNOOC avoid Ugandan tax, how much Uganda loses, and what the government will do. The Staatssecretaris answered that individual taxpayers cannot be discussed, that the treaty lacks anti-abuse rules that the government wants to add quickly, and that renegotiation has been pursued since 2013 with Uganda slow to respond.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het bericht 'Oeganda loopt €21 miljoen mis door Nederland (en dat is het topje van de ijsberg)'

MPs Snels and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked the government about a Volkskrant report that Uganda loses tax revenue through Dutch structures, including dividend exemption under the Netherlands-Uganda treaty and the adequacy of anti-abuse rules. The Secretary of State answered all 12 questions substantively, defending the treaty's purpose, citing confidentiality limits for individual taxpayers, and committing to add anti-abuse provisions to the Uganda treaty and new conditional withholding taxes.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot comment on the situation of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de situatie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Volksbank houdt vol: we moeten rekening 'onbedoelde Amerikaan' afsluiten'

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether banks may close the accounts of 'accidental Americans' who do not obtain a US TIN or CLN, and whether this is fair and consistent with the basic payment account right. The minister answers that closing such accounts is premature and unnecessary where banks have made sufficient efforts, that talks with the banking association and US authorities are ongoing, and that the lack of a US TIN alone is not a ground to refuse a basic account, though other facts may be.
I therefore cannot go into the substance of that. It is for the court to judge the lawfulness of the Volksbank's conduct.
Ik kan daar daarom niet inhoudelijk op ingaan. Het is immers aan de rechter om te oordelen over de rechtmatigheid van de handelwijze van de Volksbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vaststelling van de rendementen in box 3

The MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance how the box 3 return percentages were set, including the statutory formula, the MSCI index used, and past calculation errors. The State Secretary answered that the correct indices and percentages were applied, pointed to the earlier calculation letter for the 2019 derivation, and acknowledged in March 2020 a correction of small errors in the 2019 and 2020 forfaitaire returns that was made retroactively.
I would like to refer you for this to the fiscal motions and commitments letter of 18 September 2018.
Ik verwijs hiervoor graag naar de fiscale moties- en toezeggingenbrief van 18 september 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de kosten van WOZ-bezwaren voor gemeenten

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether no-cure-no-pay agencies profit from WOZ property-valuation objections while citizens gain little, and about the costs to municipalities. The minister says a WODC study is expected by end 2020, cites over EUR 12 million in cost reimbursements paid by municipalities in 2019, and states that objection procedures are already easy for citizens, with no further access measures planned for now.
The WODC study is expected to be delivered by the end of 2020.
Het onderzoek van het WODC wordt naar verwachting voor het eind van 2020 opgeleverd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over “de hoge marginale druk over een pensioenuitkering ineens en het feit dat het van je geboortedatum afhangt of je soms 20% extra belasting moet betalen over een uitkering ineens

MP Omtzigt asked whether the marginal tax burden on a lump-sum pension payment depends on the recipient's birth month, with rates up to 55% for those reaching AOW age in December versus 19-28% for January, and whether this is justified and legally sound under age-discrimination rules. The minister confirmed the mechanism, defended it as inherent to the tax system and as a voluntary option, and acknowledged the burden varies but declined to see it as unjust.
It is important to emphasise that the lump-sum amount is an optional choice.
Het is belangrijk hierbij te benadrukken dat het bedrag ineens een keuzemogelijkheid is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over afwikkeling belastingteruggave nabestaanden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the Tax Authority handles tax refunds to heirs when no bank account is known, including how often it contacts heirs, the F-form for deceased persons, and response deadlines. The State Secretary explained the notification process, reported figures on unclaimed refunds, said a digital F-form is being worked on, and declined to change response periods.
I therefore see no reason to revise the response periods for taxpayers or the Tax Authority.
Ik zie hierom geen aanleiding om de reactietermijnen voor belastingplichtigen of de Belastingdienst te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de btw-aftrek op scholings-/opleidingskosten

Lodders (VVD) asked whether employers can deduct VAT on mandatory training and certification costs, including when the training provider bills the employee under privacy rules. The State Secretary answered that VAT is deductible only if the employer is the contracting party and receives the invoice, so when the employee contracts and is billed directly, the employer cannot deduct it, and the rules apply equally to all.
The VAT Directive 2006 does not allow deduction of VAT on training costs when an employee follows training in their own name and for their own account.
De Btw-richtlijn 2006 staat geen aftrek toe van btw op scholings-/opleidingskosten wanneer een werknemer op eigen naam en voor eigen rekening een opleiding volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het bericht 'Miljarden vliegen weg bij Tata'

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked the ministers whether reports that billions of euros flowed from Tata Steel Netherlands to its Indian parent show unpaid corporate tax, mismanagement, or threats to investment. Minister Wiebes answered that tax secrecy (art. 67 AWR) prevents comment on an individual taxpayer, that the Tax Authority supervises on a risk basis, that he sees no grounds for intervention, and that Tata Steel's investment plans are sound, while rejecting new rules restricting profit transfers.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het besluit rond de verlaging van de belasting- en invorderingsrente als onderdeel van de coronamaatregelen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the end of the temporarily reduced tax interest (4% from 1 October 2020) creates unequal treatment between businesses that requested payment deferral and those that did not, and why the tax interest was not kept at 0.01% until 1 January 2021. The State Secretary answers that the situations are not legally comparable, that tax interest is meant to incentivise timely filing and provisional assessments and is therefore reinstated, and that the end date was foreseeable from March 2020.
Legally, however, the situations are not comparable; in one case there is an established tax assessment paid late, while in the other the assessment has not yet been established.

Fiscaal-juridisch zijn de situaties echter niet vergelijkbaar; in het ene geval is sprake van een vastgestelde belastingaanslag die te laat wordt betaald terwijl in het andere geval sprake is van een nog niet vastgestelde aanslag.
Antwoord op het lid Omtzigt over de parallelimport van auto's

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the volume of parallel-imported cars, the BPM and VAT collected on them, the share that were damaged or used, and the ten-year trend. The State Secretary provided tables on imports, BPM revenue, VAT reasoning and multi-year figures, while noting that data was compiled from several applications because the Databank Auto analysis environment was out of use.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van der Linde over het experiment van DNB met uitgifte betaalrekeningen

VVD MPs Lodders and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about a Dutch bank closing an Accidental American's account under FATCA, where Accidental Americans may lose their bank access, and about the DNB digital euro experiment. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to basic payment account options and the Convenant Basisbankrekening, said the digital euro is separate from this problem, and promised to press the US and EU for talks on FATCA.
I cannot go into individual cases in which accounts have been terminated.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken waarin sprake is van stopzetten van rekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat 80% van de witwasmeldingen bij Nederlandse toezichthouder Financial Intelligence Unit in een la verdwijnen

MPs Alkaya (SP) asked the Minister and State Secretary of Finance about a report that 80% of money-laundering reports at the FIU-Nederland are left unactioned, asking about backlogs, reliance on automated matching, digitalisation, and staffing relative to neighbouring countries. The Minister (Justice and Security) answers that FIU-Nederland screens all reports automatically against police and CJIB data, prioritises risk-based analysis, reports are held for five years, and staffing is being expanded by about 19 fte alongside technology investment.
FIU-Nederland has indicated, when asked, that it does not recognise the journalists' conclusion that 80% of unusual transaction reports from banks are not acted upon by FIU-Nederland.

FIU-Nederland heeft desgevraagd aangegeven zich niet te her- en erkennen in de conclusie van de journalisten dat op 80% van de meldingen van ongebruikelijke transacties afkomstig van banken niet zou worden geacteerd door de FIU-Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het artikel ‘Subsidie op elektrische auto loopt als een trein’

An MP asked the state secretaries about the rapid exhaustion of the EV purchase subsidy, its expected effects on emissions and future applications, and how it will be evaluated and promoted. The government explained the fast uptake (manufacturer discounts, postponed sales), estimated CO2 and NOx benefits, said it plans to stop carrying unused budget forward, and committed to monitoring in early 2021 and results by mid-2021.
As I recently reported to your House, the cabinet intends to stop this carry-over provision in the scheme (for both new and used EVs) in the short term.
Zoals ik uw Kamer recent heb gemeld, is het kabinet voornemens deze doorschuifbepaling in de regeling (zowel voor nieuwe als gebruikte EV's) op korte termijn stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra  en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Subsidiepot stroomauto’s nu al op’

MPs Lodders, Remco Dijkstra and Omtzigt asked whether the EV subsidy budget running out within eight days, the cost per avoided tonne of CO2, the limited climate gain and the Court of Audit's criticism of car taxes justify the scheme. The state secretary answered that the costs per avoided tonne fall to about 450 euro by 2025, that the scheme stays within budget and the Klimaatakkoord commitments, and that the carry-over rule for unused budget will be stopped, but gave no definitive per-tonne benchmark.
All calculations that have been carried out have already been sent to you on 3 July 2019.
Alle berekeningen die zijn uitgevoerd, heeft u reeds ontvangen op 3 juli 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het eindigen van de levensloopregeling per 1 januari 2022

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the termination of the levensloopregeling (life-course savings scheme) on 1 January 2022, its effects on savers and their benefits, and how savers are informed. The State Secretary answered that the end date is moved to 1 November 2021 as a fictional enjoyment moment, that savings institutions will act as withholding agents, and that the Tax Authority will communicate about it.
The Tax Authority will again communicate about this through the regular communication channels.
De Belastingdienst zal hierover wederom communiceren via de reguliere communicatiekanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Nieuwe auto fors duurder door aanpassing bpm’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Plan 2021 change moving the bpm (car registration tax) taxable event to registration in the vehicle register is meant to level the playing field with parallel imports, and whether it changes VAT treatment. The State Secretary confirmed the aim of ending the tax advantage of parallel imports, stated VAT treatment is unchanged, and agreed to talk with the trade associations BOVAG and RAI to clarify confusion.
Yes. The proposed bill text has caused unintended unrest in the sector, particularly at BOVAG, regarding VAT and bpm.
Ja. Door de voorgestelde wettekst is in de sector en dan met name bij de BOVAG onbedoeld onrust ontstaan ten aanzien van de btw en bpm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Postma en Omtzigt over de toepassing van het tonnageregime voor de offshoresector

MPs Mulder, Postma and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch tonnage tax regime is stricter than in other EU countries, whether it covers vessels used to build offshore wind farms, and what this means for cost and competitiveness. The government answered that the Dutch regime is stricter on some points (e.g. Denmark allows construction-vessel profits), that wind-farm operation profits are excluded, that transport vessels to offshore parks can qualify, and that it will await an evaluation due in early 2021 before deciding on any change.
The cabinet wants to await the aforementioned evaluation before making statements on the desirability and design of any possible adjustment to the tonnage regime.
Het kabinet wil de hiervoor genoemde evaluatie afwachten, alvorens uitspraken te doen over de wenselijkheid en vormgeving van een eventuele aanpassing van de tonnageregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over mensen die in de problemen komen door hun belastingadviseur

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about taxpayers harmed by malicious tax advisers, including the number of advisers and victims, the misuse of DigiD and beconnummers, liability, disciplinary law and competence requirements. The government answered that the Tax Authority lacks an overview of victims, described enforcement against facilitators, rejected mandatory disciplinary law, competence requirements and VOG, and promised to examine whether existing instruments are adequate.
I am therefore willing to examine whether the existing instruments to act against malicious tax advisers are adequate and sufficiently used.
Ik ben dan ook bereid om te onderzoeken of het bestaande instrumentarium om op te treden tegen malafide belastingadviseurs toereikend is en voldoende wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de fraudejacht bij de inkomstenbelasting

MP Leijten asked the state secretaries of Finance about the Belastingdienst's tax fraud targeting, including project code 1043 (AKI 1043), facilitator-linked CAF investigations, whether people were targeted year after year, the use of 'black-list'-like selection lists, deletion of records and call-centre instructions. The government explained how AKI codes are set and lifted, admitted instruction errors and that 1043 targeting is paused with extra safeguards, promised a dienst-wide review and to keep data, and sent the instructions and handbook.
Until the investigation is completed, we are ensuring additional safeguards around the supervisory processes (including the four-eyes principle).
Totdat het onderzoek is afgerond, zorgen wij voor extra waarborgen rondom de toezichtprocessen (o.m. meerogenprincipes).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over tienduizenden burgers die jaren last hadden van 'fraudevermoedens' van de Belastingdienst

The MP Azarkan asks the State Secretary of Finance about tens of thousands of citizens who for years faced tax fraud suspicions under Belastingdienst project 1043, including ethnicity-based selection, profiling, and institutional bias. The government answers that the project is not secret, that the investigation is ongoing with interim measures, that selection on ethnicity or second nationality no longer plays a role, and provides figures on the number of tax returns assessed, while withholding some details pending further research.
To prevent risks of disproportionate treatment during the follow-up investigation, we are taking the following measures, at least for the duration of the follow-up investigation.
Om te voorkomen dat er, gedurende het vervolgonderzoek, risico's voor een disproportionele behandeling zijn, nemen wij, in ieder geval voor de duur van het vervolgonderzoek, de volgende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘EU-hof: Amerikaanse privacybescherming onvoldoende’

An MP asked whether the EU Court's invalidation of the Privacy Shield (Schrems II) affects personal data transfers to the US, including by Dutch banks under FATCA and by organisations with US-national signatories. The minister answered that transfers now need AVG safeguards such as standard contractual clauses, that the Commission is negotiating a replacement adequacy decision, and that the Data Protection Authority is the route for complaints about unlawful transfers.
The Court based its finding that the Privacy Shield contains insufficient safeguards for EU citizens on the role US investigative and intelligence services can play after a transfer has taken place.

Het Hof heeft zijn oordeel dat het Privacy Shield onvoldoende waarborgen bevat voor EU- burgers, onderbouwd met een verwijzing naar de rol die opsporings- en inlichtingendiensten in de VS kunnen spelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Snels over belastingontwijking ten koste van ontwikkelingslanden

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether developing countries lose money to tax avoidance via the Netherlands, citing a ActionAid estimate of 1.8 billion euros a year, and asked about policy goals, coherence, and specific recommendations. The government disputes the estimate's basis, says it has no reliable measure of avoidance, and describes existing and planned anti-avoidance measures while rejecting several recommendations such as broader withholding taxes and a UN tax body.
The government itself does not make estimates of lost tax revenue in other countries.
Het kabinet maakt zelf geen schattingen van misgelopen belastinginkomsten in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Kifid: bank mag betaalrekening beëindigen als consument geen US TIN of CLN wil aanvragen' en het bericht 'Wijziging annex II FATCA-verdrag'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Kifid ruling allowing a bank to close a basic payment account when a US-linked consumer will not supply a US TIN, and about an amendment to Annex II of the FATCA agreement affecting sponsored entities. The minister answered that the Kifid case has specific facts and that banks and the Belastingdienst have provided FATCA information, and that the amendment preserves the status quo for Dutch sponsored entities without extra reporting.
I will ask banks to keep paying attention to clear information provision about FATCA.
Ik zal banken vragen aandacht te blijven houden voor duidelijke informatieverstrekking over FATCA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over investeringen in de plasticindustrie

MP Van Raan asked the government about investments in the plastics industry, including Shell and financial institutions, recyclate requirements, a tax on virgin plastic and OECD guidelines. The government answered that it expects firms to follow OECD and UN guidance, will raise the plastics pact and recyclate use at EU level, sees no national import levy as current, and will not yet decide on additional measures.

The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally, including banks, insurers and pension funds, to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal ondernemen, waaronder banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen, dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen (OESO-richtlijnen) en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's) naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Brussels plans attack on low tax member states'

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the European Commission was considering using Article 116 TFEU to attack low-tax member states, and whether this threatens national tax competence. The State Secretary answered that the proposal is still at an exploratory stage, that the Netherlands has taken many anti-avoidance measures, and that the Chamber will be informed via a BNC fiche once a concrete proposal is published, but did not address the Commission's inconsistent legal-basis position.
At this moment there is therefore no proposal yet and it is, in my view, too premature to respond to this subject.
Op dit moment ligt er dus nog geen voorstel en is het, naar mijn mening, te prematuur om op dit onderwerp te reageren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de illegale vernietiging van archieven bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen, mogelijke strafbaarheid daarvan en een stop op elke vernietiging van archieven van de Belastingdienst/T

An MP asked whether the destruction of around 9,000 Toeslagen appeal files under a Belastingdienst selection list was unlawful, whether it could amount to a criminal offence, and whether all destruction of Toeslagen archives should be halted. The State Secretary regretted the destruction, admitted the wrong selection list was applied due to mixing of files, stopped further destruction of Toeslagen files and management records, and declined to qualify the conduct as an intentional criminal offence while providing destruction declarations and promising to consult parliament before lifting the moratorium.
As long as it is not known whether the process has been fully completed or the allowance has ended, under the 2015 Toeslagen selection list destruction may not proceed.
Zolang niet bekend is of het proces volledig is afgehandeld, dan wel de toeslag is beëindigd mag conform de selectielijst Toeslagen van 2015 niet tot vernietiging worden overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht ‘Brussels ready to clamp down on sweetheart corporate tax deals’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Minister and State Secretary of Finance about a Financial Times report that Brussels is ready to clamp down on sweetheart corporate tax deals, including whether the Commission will use Article 116 TFEU to remove member-state vetoes on tax. The State Secretary answered that he supports Commission efforts against tax avoidance, that the Article 116 proposal has not yet been published, and that he will uphold parliamentary motions opposing giving up the Dutch veto on tax.
I have no intention other than to respect these motions in my position in the EU.
Ik heb geen ander voornemen dan deze moties bij mijn inzet in de EU te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Nijboer over vermogen van het Wit-Russische regime bij Nederlandse brievenbusfirma’s

MPs Ploumen and Nijboer asked whether the Belarusian Lukashenko regime holds assets in Dutch letterbox companies, whether such assets should be frozen and how to prevent them. The minister answered that the government is unaware of such assets, that individual cases cannot be commented on absent sanctions, and that EU sanctions, client due diligence and tighter trust office rules are the instruments, while national unilateral measures are not possible under current law.
I cannot make statements about individual cases as long as no sanctions apply to those persons or regimes.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik geen uitspraken doen, zolang er geen sprake is van sancties die van toepassing zijn op die personen of regimes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het incomplete AVG-verwerkingsregister en over onbeantwoorde belangrijke vragen over de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Tax Authority knew of other blacklists beyond FSV, why KPMG's June 2020 draft findings were not reported to parliament, what project 1043 is, and when the Tax Authority will have a complete, up-to-date processing register under the GDPR. The state secretaries answered that KPMG's drafts only pointed to possibly comparable systems, that project 1043 is a risk-detection project code, that a complete register is at least three years away, and that questions on the childcare benefit scandal would be answered later.
On 10 July the final report was adopted and sent to your House that same day.
Op 10 juli jl. is het definitieve rapport vastgesteld en dat is die dag nog aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Omtzigt over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer ‘Autobelastingen als instrument’

MPs Lodders, Remco Dijkstra and Omtzigt asked the state secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure about the Court of Audit report on car taxes, questioning the cost per avoided tonne of CO2, the climate gain, the clarity of policy goals and whether the 'hand aan de kraan' monitoring system prevents overstimulation. The government rejected the report's conclusions, arguing the costs are overstated, promising to send the first hand-aan-de-kraan analysis results to Parliament shortly.
The cabinet will send the outcomes to your House in the short term.
Het kabinet zal de uitkomsten op korte termijn uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van Wijngaarden en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Verdachten zaak sushiketen Sumo krijgen geen straf vanwege inbreuk op hun privacy’

MPs asked the government about a court ruling that suspects in the Sumo sushi case received no sentence because their privacy was violated by a KRO-NCRV documentary filmed with the FIOD and the public prosecutor's cooperation, and about the prosecutor's role in the documentary's content and non-disclosure. The Minister of Justice answered that the prosecution has appealed, that the prosecutor had a media contract allowing review of footage, and that the revised prosecution guidelines of September 2020 aim to prevent similar cases.
As long as the case has not become final, I do not wish to anticipate the possible consequences of (part of) the judgment for other criminal cases of the OM.
Zolang de zaak niet onherroepelijk is geworden wil ik niet vooruitlopen op de mogelijke gevolgen van (een deel van) het vonnis voor andere strafzaken van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Omtzigt, van Weyenberg en Bruins over het bericht ‘Storing Belastingdienst: ondernemers krijgen week extra voor btw-aangifte’

MPs asked whether the Tax Authority's portal outage on 31 July 2020 justified a general extension and no fines for late VAT returns and payments. The state secretary confirmed the outage and the extension to 7 August, with fines waived under existing policy and the Covid emergency measures.
That is correct; between 30 July 23:35 and 31 July 14:15 it was not possible to submit VAT returns online because the MijnBelastingdienst/Zakelijk portal was unavailable.
Dat klopt, tussen 30 juli 23:35 uur en 31 juli 14:15 uur was het niet mogelijk btw-aangiften in te dienen via internet omdat het betreffende portaal MijnBelastingdienst/Zakelijk onbereikbaar was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Experts: liquiditeitscrisis vraagt om soepelere btw-teruggave'

MP Lodders asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the VAT refund period for uncollectable VAT should be shortened from one year to three months to ease SME liquidity, and what steps the cabinet takes on liquidity. The State Secretary answers that a shorter period would add little value, would conflict with the EU VAT Directive and would raise administrative burdens, and that existing COVID-related payment deferrals and support schemes are sufficient, with no further policy options planned.

Unlike the Dutch Association of Tax Advisers (NOB), I believe the limited improvement in liquidity for the entrepreneur receiving a faster refund hardly outweighs the increase in administrative burdens for that same entrepreneur.

Ik meen, anders dan de Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs (NOB), dat de beperkte vooruitgang in de liquiditeitspositie van de ondernemer die een snellere teruggaaf krijgt niet of nauwelijks opweegt tegen de toename van de administratieve lasten voor diezelfde ondernemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het Nederlandse fiscaal verdragsbeleid

An MP from the SP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Netherlands' tax treaty policy toward developing countries, including why withholding rates agreed since 2011 are lower than OECD averages, why treaties with Kenya and Malawi are not in force, and whether conditional withholding taxes on interest and royalties will curb treaty abuse. The State Secretary rejects the claim that Dutch treaties undermine developing countries' taxing rights, cites the 2011 policy of accommodating developing countries, and announces treaty submissions, monitoring of conditional withholding tax effects, and possible dividend measures.
I attach importance, in line with treaty policy, to including anti-abuse provisions in tax treaties so that the developing country is not wrongly limited in its taxing rights.

Voorts hecht ik, in lijn met verdragsbeleid, belang aan het opnemen van antimisbruikbepalingen in belastingverdragen zodat het ontwikkelingsland niet ten onrechte in zijn heffingsbevoegdheid wordt beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over FATCA en de Accidental Americans

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about banks closing or blocking accounts of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality (Accidental Americans) due to FATCA, and about the costs and procedures for renouncing US citizenship. The government answered that banks must follow Dutch rules, that talks with the US and EU partners are ongoing, that complaints can go to Kifid or courts, and that the government will not advise on US law or costs but will keep pressing the US to lower them.
I cannot go into individual cases involving the closure or blocking of accounts or threats thereof.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken waarin sprake is van stopzetten van rekeningen, het blokkeren van rekeningen of dreiging daarmee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het ondersteunen van de fossiele energiesector in Nederland naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van Oil Change International en Milieudefensie

An MP asked the government about a study by Milieudefensie and Oil Change International claiming over EUR 8 billion a year in support for the fossil sector, about export credit insurance for fossil projects, about ending support for new North Sea gas drilling, and about implementing a motion to phase out fiscal incentives. The minister disputes many of the study's figures, says export credit premiums are cost-covering, refuses to end fossil support unilaterally or to push other North Sea states to abolish their incentives, and sends a letter on phasing out fossil incentives.
At this time I do not think it wise to seek, together with the other North Sea countries, the abolition of fiscal incentives for new gas drilling in the North Sea.
Ik vind het op dit moment niet verstandig om met de andere Noordzeelanden te streven naar afschaffing van fiscale prikkels voor nieuwe gasboringen in de Noordzee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over een verschillend btw-tarief op verschillende vormen van educatie

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked why VAT rates differ across forms of education (music, sport, driving lessons) and how other EU states treat them.
