The Secretary of State explained that VAT rules follow EU directive obligations and CJEU case law, with discretion only over reduced rates, and that driving lessons fall under the standard 21% rate.
The Netherlands has no policy room to unilaterally deviate from applicable European rules as far as mandatory exemptions are concerned.
Nederland heeft geen beleidsruimte eenzijdig van die geldende Europese regelgeving af te wijken voor zover het gaat om verplichte vrijstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Consument merkt niks van lagere btw op e-books'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the reduced VAT on e-books, newspapers and magazines has not lowered consumer prices, and whether the government will act and bring forward the evaluation. The State Secretary answered that the measure primarily aims at a level playing field, that prices are set by market players, that the evaluation will be brought forward to 2022, and that CBS price monitoring will continue.
Because the market for electronic publications is relatively new, the market mechanism may not yet be working optimally.
Doordat de markt voor elektronische publicaties relatief nieuw is, werkt het marktmechanisme mogelijk nog niet optimaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Rog en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Haast geboden met ventilatie op scholen’

Three CDA MPs asked ministers whether ventilation rules for schools were known before the school year, how many schools meet current Bouwbesluit ventilation standards, and what measures RIVM, the Belastingdienst and ministries took. The government answered that existing building code rules apply, that school boards are responsible and no data on school ventilation is collected, and that the answers to the questions were delayed.
No data are collected or kept on the ventilation of school buildings.
Er worden geen gegevens verzameld of bijgehouden over de ventilatie van schoolgebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over informeelkapitaalstructuren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about informal capital structures, including whether advance rulings can still indirectly cover them and how often they are used. The State Secretary answered that since 1 July 2019 no advance certainty is given where tax saving is the sole or decisive motive, that a study will follow, and that roughly 157 informal-capital cases with an international character were identified for 2016 and 126 for 2017.
That is why I also announced a study into informal capital structures.
Daarom heb ik ook een onderzoek aangekondigd naar informeel-kapitaalstructuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het lopende onderzoek van de FIOD naar scheepsbouwbedrijf Damen Shipyards

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Defence and Finance when the FIOD investigation into alleged corruption at Damen Shipyards would conclude, whether criminal investigations into other defence suppliers are known, whether the appeal on disclosure of documents is resolved, and whether pending criminal investigations should be considered in defence procurement. The government declined to comment on ongoing investigations, reported that the Wob appeal was withdrawn and the documents disclosed in September 2019, and stated that pending investigations and suspicions are not grounds for exclusion under procurement rules, which require a final conviction, citing the presumption of innocence and proportionality; it also described compliance measures taken at Damen after the World Bank sanction.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad inzake premieplicht Rijnvarenden

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a Supreme Court ruling that Rhine boatmen employed by a Luxembourg employer are liable for Dutch social insurance premiums and that the Netherlands is not responsible for undoing double premium collection, and about the government's plans to resolve it. The government confirms the ruling, says it is pursuing a solution with Luxembourg, keeps a temporary halt on collection, and states that premium restitution or offsetting cannot be included in the Rhine Boatmen Convention but will be addressed through data exchange and the Rhine Commission.
We continue to work towards a solution for this.
Wij blijven ons inzetten voor een oplossing hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het keihard liegen door de Belastingdienst/toeslagen

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary whether the Belastingdienst knowingly misled the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, withheld documents from parents and courts, and what sanctions apply to lying to the tax authority. The State Secretary acknowledged the 2017 information to the AP was incorrect and regrettable but found no concrete evidence of intent, described remedial steps such as more generous document disclosure and apologies, and gave a partial answer on sanctions.
From the above it appears that in 2017 there was indeed an incorrect presentation of facts, but it cannot be concluded that this happened knowingly and deliberately.
Uit het vorenstaande komt naar voren dat in 2017 weliswaar sprake was van een onjuiste voorstelling van zaken, maar dat niet valt te concluderen dat dit willens en wetens gebeurde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV)

MP Leijten asked the State Secretaries of Finance about the Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV), a Tax Authority fraud-signal database, including its legal basis, data retention, deletion, sharing with other agencies and privacy assessment. The government answered that FSV was taken offline, that a deletion action removed 143,574 records with a backup preserved, that the privacy impact assessment was deficient, and that FSV will not be reused.
In the meantime it has been decided not to use FSV any more and to redesign the processes for processing signals and the associated support.
Ondertussen is besloten om FSV niet meer te gaan gebruiken en de processen voor het verwerken van signalen en de bijbehorende ondersteuning opnieuw te ontwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bestaan van een geheime zwarte lijst van vermeende fraudeurs die veel mensen gedupeerd heeft

MP Azarkan asked the State Secretary of Finance about a secret blacklist of alleged fraudsters (the FSV application) that reportedly harmed many people, including whether it was hidden from parliament and citizens and whether people could object. The answers confirm about 180,000 registrations before the February 2020 cleanup, admit parliament was not explicitly informed, say registrations cannot themselves be appealed but follow-up acts can be challenged via AVG rights and administrative appeal, and state the application was stopped due to GDPR concerns.
The existence of an administration of signals was not explicitly shared with your House.
Het bestaan van een administratie met signalen is niet expliciet gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de «Fraude Signalering Voorziening» (FSV) en de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance how the Tax Authority's Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV) and its data protection impact assessment related to GDPR duties to consult the data protection officer and the Dutch DPA. The answers explain the timeline, that FSV was switched off after a critical assessment, that the DPA was informed on 2 March 2020 and is investigating, and commit to further information, redesign of processes and a letter on the matter.
The Tax Authority informed the Dutch DPA on 2 March 2020 about FSV because an application was in use for which the mitigating measures were insufficiently implemented.
De Belastingdienst heeft op 2 maart 2020 de AP geïnformeerd over FSV omdat er een applicatie in gebruik was waarbij de mitigerende maatregelen onvoldoende geïmplementeerd waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Lodders over het artikel ‘Unilever wake-upcall voor het kabinet’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the potential departure of head offices such as Unilever's, its effects on the economy and on SMEs, and the investment climate. The minister answered that head offices matter as decision centres, that Unilever's structural simplification leaves Dutch activities unchanged, and that the government will study how to strengthen the investment climate by early 2021 while pointing to earlier tax and labour-cost policy reviews.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Otterloo over de berichten dat in België en Duitsland de btw op korte termijn omlaag gaat

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary of Finance about reported VAT cuts in Belgium and Germany and whether the Netherlands could do the same, including costs, IT feasibility, a retroactive VAT rebate and targeted measures. The government answered that IT systems cannot adopt a new rate in the short term, that general VAT cuts are not effective or efficient, and that targeted support such as NOW, TOGS and TGVL is preferred.
The cabinet closely monitors how the pandemic and the economy develop, and then considers which measures are appropriate and feasible for a next period.
Het kabinet monitort nauwlettend hoe de pandemie en de economie zich ontwikkelen, en beraadt zich vervolgens welke maatregelen voor een volgende periode passend en haalbaar zijn.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over onterechte huurverhogingen door foutieve huishoudverklaringen door de Belastingdienst

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked how 932 household statements with a wrong AOW age led to unlawful higher rent increases, and what happens if landlords do not reverse them. The government answered that the error stemmed from an outdated parameter in software, that the Tax Authority informed landlords and tenants by letter and phone, and that reversing increases is the landlord's responsibility under civil rental law.
The Tax Authority is not leaving it to the tenants.
De Belastingdienst laat het niet over aan de huurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee inzake het bericht 'Oplossing dubbele heffing energiebelasting loopt vertraging op'

An MP asks the ministers whether the double levy of energy tax on battery storage will be resolved, given the delay and the absence of a fix in Budget 2021. The State Secretary answers that the issue is being studied with the sector, is delayed by the Climate Agreement, COVID-19 and forthcoming EU rules, and will be part of the upcoming energy tax evaluation.
The cabinet continues to actively work on developing a solution to implement this motion in consultation with the sector.
Het kabinet blijft actief inzetten op het uitwerken van een oplossing ter uitvoering van deze motie in overleg met de branche.

Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Raan over de benoeming van de oud-staatssecretaris van Financiën, de heer Menno Snel, tot commissaris bij IHC en de directeur van Atradius DSB als bestuurder in de Stichting Continuïteit IH

An MP asked whether the appointment of former state secretary Menno Snel to IHC's supervisory board and of the Atradius DSB director to the Stichting Continuïteit IHC board created conflicts of interest and why parliament was not informed earlier. The government answered that the timing of communication depended on IHC's final agreement, and that the foundation's board has no involvement in IHC's transactions, so no conflict of interest arises.
Changes to the Supervisory Board could only be communicated once there was final agreement on the takeover and refinancing of IHC.
Over wijzigingen in de Raad van Commissarissen kon pas worden gecommuniceerd op het moment dat er definitieve overeenstemming was over de overname en herfinanciering van IHC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het door de Belastingdienst toekennen van verzuimboetes terwijl uitstel van aangifte is aangevraagd

MP Leijten asked how many businesses obtained deferral of tax returns during the COVID-19 crisis, why late-payment fines were still imposed despite deferral requests, why individual rather than categorical deferral was chosen, and how businesses can easily cancel fines. The State Secretary answered that all deferral-of-payment requests were granted, that fines for VAT were automatically annulled after a request while payroll-tax fines were not imposed, that the process is automated, and that businesses need not act because the fines are cancelled.
No breakdown is available by self-employed persons and other businesses/legal forms.
Er is geen uitsplitsing beschikbaar naar zelfstandigen en andere bedrijven/rechtsvormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Grote verschillen tussen rechters bij beoordelen van fiscale zaken’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Legal Protection about a report that tax courts differ widely in outcomes, and whether taxpayers' rights are adequately protected, including calls for a taxpayers' charter and further research. The government answered that the Deloitte analysis rests on a very small share of published rulings and does not establish inconsistency, that case-win data are unavailable, that no charter is planned, and that an advisory committee on practical legal protection in tax matters is examining the issue.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de ondersteuning van mkb-bedrijven tijdens de Corona-crisis

Member Stoffer (SGP) asked the government about support for SMEs during the COVID-19 crisis, covering BMKB loan guarantees, TOGS and NOW subsidy eligibility, payment terms, and tax payment relief. The minister answered most questions with concrete measures such as lower BMKB provisions, extended loan terms, expanded TOGS sector lists, and an extension of the tax payment deferral to 1 October 2020, while declining to make blanket changes such as broad rate alignment or suspending labour law obligations.
The cabinet has decided to extend the term of the BMKB-C to 4 years.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om de looptijd van de BMKB-C te verlengen tot 4 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Eijs over het bericht 'Regio vraagt minister om hulp bij verkoop Vestia-woningen'

MPs Ronnes and Van Eijs asked about the stalled sale of Vestia housing in six municipalities and the transfer-tax treatment of corporation takeovers. The minister reported intention agreements signed in May 2020, explained conditions for the transfer-tax exemption for task transfers, and said the Rijk will examine remaining facilitating measures.

Whether the transaction price in the planned transactions in the custom-made municipalities is expected to be at least market value in rented condition cannot currently be assessed, because the planned transactions still need to be worked out.

Of bij de voorgenomen transacties in de maatwerkgemeenten de transactieprijs naar verwachting minimaal marktwaarde-in-verhuurde-staat is, kan op dit moment niet worden beoordeeld, omdat de voorgenomen transacties nog moeten worden uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Snels en Bruins over de maatregelen om handelsstromen op gang te houden

MPs Sneller, Snels and Bruins asked how the COVID-19 export credit insurance (ekv) relaxation measures were designed, including their composition of the Rijkscommissie, links to debt relief, green transition, and fossil-fuel financing, and whether France's approach should be followed. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered substantively on most points, stating the measures are temporary, open to all sectors, additional to the private market, and that the government will pursue greening of ekv internationally without committing to a fossil-fuel phase-out scenario.
The cabinet will study with interest the French report focusing on scenarios for a full stop of ekv coverage for fossil-fuel-related projects.

Het kabinet zal het Franse rapport dat zich concentreert op scenario's voor volledige stopzetting van dekkingsmogelijkheden vanuit de ekv voor fossiel-gerelateerde projecten met belangstelling bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale straf voor woningcorporaties

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of the Interior whether the corporate tax treatment of housing corporations (depreciation limits, ban on write-downs, earningsstripping under ATAD1, reserves) unfairly penalises them compared with commercial landlords and restricts their investment capacity. The government answers that equal treatment requires no special regime, that the rules apply generically, that corporations cannot be carved out under ATAD1, and that the investment capacity and withholding of a broader review will be sent to parliament before summer.
The cabinet is examining whether housing corporations will also have sufficient room for the necessary investments in the medium and long term.
Het kabinet onderzoekt of woningcorporaties ook op middellange en lange termijn voldoende ruimte hebben voor de benodigde investeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over ‘400 miljoen voor IHC’ 2020

Two SP MPs asked why IHC, a shipbuilder with losses predating COVID-19, received state support worth about 400 million euros, questioning market logic, the absence of a state stake, management accountability, and the use of emergency procedure. The minister answered that losses began in 2016, that the state's support consists of insurance, guarantees and a bridge loan rather than a direct 400 million, and that a private consortium is taking over with governance seats for the state, while declining to disclose several financial details.
It is not for the State to disclose the amounts these parties contribute.
Het is niet aan de Staat om de bedragen die deze partijen inbrengen bekend te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat andere Europese landen 10 miljard dollar aan belastinginkomsten mislopen door belastingontwijking via Nederland

An SP MP asked the Dutch Finance ministers about a Tax Justice Network report claiming the Netherlands costs other EU countries about $10bn a year in corporate tax through avoidance, and whether Dutch anti-avoidance measures, a withholding tax, and limits on loss deductions would be adopted. The State Secretary disputes the scale of the claim, notes the data's limitations, and lists measures already taken (a withholding tax from 2021, the multilateral instrument, ATAD implementation, loss-deduction limits) while rejecting an unconditional withholding tax and promising a cabinet response to the advisory committee report in summer.
The cabinet considers an unconditional withholding tax undesirable.
Het kabinet acht een onvoorwaardelijke bronbelasting ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de evaluatie van de verhuurderheffing

An MP asks the government about the rental levy (verhuurderheffing) on housing corporations, whether it has halved social rental construction, and whether it should be lowered to stimulate building affordable homes. The minister disputes that the levy alone caused the investment drop, notes corporations have investment room, and points to a planned study under the Ronnes motion and measures to keep building.
Before the summer I will send the results of this to the House.
Voor de zomer zal ik de resultaten hiervan aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het bericht “Kabinet schuift vanwege corona ook CO2-heffing industrie voor zich uit”

GreenLeft MPs asked why a press report said the government was postponing the industry CO2 levy due to COVID-19, whether the 2022 start date still held, and why climate plans were leaked to the press rather than shared with parliament. The State Secretary replied that the levy is still planned for 1 January 2021 as agreed in the Climate Agreement, that the bill goes to parliament with Budget Day, and that the Urgenda package was already sent to parliament.
The bill will be presented to your House as part of the 2021 tax package on Budget Day.
Het wetsvoorstel zal als onderdeel van het belastingplanpakket 2021 met Prinsjesdag worden aangeboden aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het uitstellen van klimaatmaatregelen en het bericht dat de CO2-heffing mogelijk wordt uitgesteld

An MP asked whether the CO2 levy for industry and the aviation tax were being postponed due to the COVID-19 crisis, and how climate and biodiversity goals fit with the economic recovery. The minister denied that the CO2 levy is postponed, said the aviation tax may be delayed under its entry-into-force clause, and gave only general answers on the broader questions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van den Berg over importheffingen en btw op mondkapjes en andere persoonlijke beschermingsmaterialen, die gebruikt worden in de strijd tegen het coronavirus

MPs Omtzigt and Van den Berg asked the State Secretaries of Finance about import duties and VAT on face masks and protective equipment during the coronavirus crisis, including whether healthcare institutions could be exempted and whether VAT could be lowered and competition rules clarified. The government answered that exemptions are available via EU rules and a Customs permit procedure, that the Netherlands applied for and obtained EU authorisation, that VAT on consumer masks was cut to 0% from 25 May 2020, and that the ACM provides guidance on cooperative purchasing.
The cabinet has decided to temporarily reduce the VAT on domestic sales of face masks to 0%.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om tijdelijk de btw op de binnenlandse verkoop van mondkapjes te verlagen naar 0%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over kortingen aan verhuurders op de verhuurderheffing

Labour MP Beckerman asked whether housing-association rent reductions on the landlord levy (RVV) produced permanent affordable homes, how long rents must stay regulated, whether Vestia's Tweebosbuurt project abuses the scheme, and whether the levy should be abolished. Minister Knops gave detailed counts of applications and realised investments, said there is no fixed holding period and rejected a 20-year term as too burdensome, and promised a study of corporations' finances before summer 2020.
If there is evidence and RVO receives signals that the rent has risen excessively shortly after the dwelling is realised, RVO has the option to withdraw the definitive levy reduction.

Indien er wel bewijs is en RVO signalen ontvangt dat de huur op korte termijn na realisatie van de woning excessief is gestegen, heeft RVO de mogelijkheid over te gaan tot intrekking van de definitieve heffingsvermindering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over de voorwaarden voor steun aan bedrijven

MPs Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether Booking.com's dividends and share buybacks should bar it from state support, whether NOW wage subsidies allow dismissals, what conditions apply to support, and whether it uses tax schemes. The state secretary answered that companies are responsible for their dividends, that support will generally exclude dividends, bonuses and buybacks, and that tax secrecy prevents comment on Booking.com's tax position, while promising further anti-avoidance work.
Due to the statutory tax secrecy obligation, the cabinet cannot make statements about the tax position of an individual taxpayer such as Booking.com.
Door de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige als Booking.com.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Te hoge belasting omdat gemeente VvE- reserve meerekent in WOZ bepaling’

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether municipalities wrongly include a homeowners' association (VvE) reserve when valuing apartments for WOZ property tax, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answered that municipalities use uniform methods, that significant VvE reserves are taken into account in sales analysis, that the Waarderingskamer found no shortcomings, and that no further measures are considered necessary.
No problem is experienced with the way municipalities take into account the share in the VvE reserve when determining WOZ values.
Er wordt geen probleem ervaren met de wijze waarop gemeenten rekening houden met het aandeel in de VvE-reserve bij het vaststellen van WOZ-waarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over over tienduizenden appartementeigenaren die een te hoge WOZ-beschikking ontvangen

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked whether municipalities wrongly include the owner's share of the VvE reserve in WOZ valuations of apartments, contrary to a court ruling, and how this interacts with box 1 and box 3 taxation. The State Secretary answered that the reserve share is excluded from the WOZ value, that municipalities only adjust for significant reserves when analysing comparable sales, and that no change to box 3 treatment is needed.
For all municipalities, the (possible) share in the Owners' Association (VvE) reserve does not count in the valuation of the apartment under the WOZ Act.

Voor alle gemeenten geldt dat het (eventuele) aandeel in de reserve van de Vereniging van Eigenaren (hierna: VvE-reserve) niet meetelt bij de waardebepaling van het betreffende appartement in het kader van de Wet WOZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Tegemoetkoming Specifieke Ziektekosten (TSZ)

An MP asked whether delays in determining 2018 tax assessments caused late Tegemoetkoming Specifieke Zorgkosten (TSZ) decisions for 2018 and whether affected people were compensated. The State Secretary denied any delay, showed rising numbers of late-year TSZ decisions as part of the regular process, and said no compensation was needed.
No, that is not correct. The determination of final assessments for 2018 proceeded at a slightly higher pace than was the case for 2017.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Het vaststellen van de definitieve aanslagen over 2018 heeft in een iets hoger tempo gelopen dan over het jaar 2017 het geval was.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een uitspraak van de Raad van State waardoor waarschijnlijk miljoenen beschikkingen van de belastingdienst/toeslagen over terugvordering of herzieningen van voorschotten op toe

MP Omtzigt asked whether a Council of State ruling showed that millions of Tax Administration/Toeslagen decisions on childcare and other benefit advances, including reductions and reclaims, were not legally in force because they were sent only electronically, and what the consequences were. The State Secretary acknowledged the ruling, admitted about 20 million revised advance decisions since 2015 were sent only digitally, and announced a regulatory amendment from 1 July 2020 to continue the practice, with a limited group of objectors given a path to contest.
Due to the Council of State ruling, part of the first step has proven not legally valid.
Door de uitspraak van de Raad van State is een deel van de eerste stap niet rechtsgeldig gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over morele corruptie bij de Belastingdienst door het stellen van een minimumbedrag voor het terugvorderen van toeslagen

The SP MP Leijten asked whether the Tax Authority applied minimum recovery amounts for childcare and other benefit (toeslag) fraud enforcement that had to be met regardless of cost, and what consequences this had for objections and appeals. The State Secretary answers that a budgeted fraud-yield target of 25-33 million per year existed from 2014, that monitoring of the yield stopped in 2019, that the target was not a management KPI, and that backlogs in objections and appeals arose from capacity shortages and have been addressed.
The budget amount thereby became a binding target for the yield of enforcement, and I find that undesirable.
Het begrotingsbedrag werd daarmee taakstellend voor de opbrengst van de uitvoering en dat vind ik onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de extra maatregelen om handelsstromen op gang te houden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary of Finance about the expanded COVID-19 export credit insurance measures, including consultation with businesses, environmental and human rights screening by Atradius DSB, pricing, and state risk exposure. The government answered that consultation went through the Rijkscommissie voor Export, that documents are not disclosed because they are internal and contain commercial information, that sustainability screening continues under existing policy, and that the measures run until 31 December 2020 with the state taking on risks the private market will not cover.
To the extent minutes of these consultations were made, they were intended for internal use and contain personal policy views of officials and possibly commercially sensitive information.

Voor zover er verslaglegging van deze overleggen is gemaakt, is deze voor intern gebruik bedoeld geweest en bevatten deze persoonlijke beleidsopvattingen van ambtenaren en mogelijk bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor het urencriterium, de zelfstandigenaftrek en de startersaftrek

An MP asked whether the government could relax the 1,225-hour test for the self-employed deduction and starter deduction given COVID-19 lockdown effects, and whether it would use crisis-year leniency as in 2009-2010. The Secretary of State answered that the government will relax the test by treating entrepreneurs as having worked 24 hours per week from 1 March to 31 May 2020, and that the questions were answered late due to ongoing studies.

The cabinet has however preferred a variant under which an entrepreneur in the period from 1 March 2020 to 31 May 2020 is deemed to have spent at least 24 hours per week on his business, even if he did not actually spend those hours.

Het kabinet heeft echter de voorkeur gegeven aan een variant waarbij een ondernemer in de periode van 1 maart 2020 tot en met 31 mei 2020 geacht wordt ten minste 24 uren per week aan zijn onderneming te hebben besteed, ook als hij die uren niet daadwerkelijk heeft besteed.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van den Bosch over de berichten ‘Gemeentelijke belastingen voor huiseigenaren stijgen hard in 2020‘, en ‘Miljoenenstrop voor gemeenten door bedrijfjes die WOZ-waarde aanvechten‘

MPs Lodders and Van den Bosch asked whether local taxes rising in 2020, the cost of no-cure-no-pay WOZ objection firms to municipalities, and the fairness of the local tax system warrant reform. The Minister answered that a reform of local taxes is desirable, that a WODC study on WOZ objection costs is pending, and that the WOZ system is still sound, rejecting the claim that 40% of WOZ values are wrong.
A systemic reform of local taxes seems desirable to me indeed.
Een systeemherziening in de lokale belastingen lijkt mij inderdaad wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over uitstel voor het doen van belastingaangifte voor particulieren in verband met de verlenging van coronamaatregelen tot 1 juni

An SP MP asked whether people who need assistance to file their tax return can request individual extensions, and whether the State Secretary will allow late filing without penalty given new corona measures. The State Secretary acknowledged that not everyone can request an extension independently, and agreed to an automatic extension to 1 September for the group that files with assistance (about 660,000 people), while rejecting generic extensions for everyone.
I am prepared to implement automatic extension for the above group that is not self-reliant regarding the tax return, to make it beyond doubt that people do not file late unintentionally.
ben om buiten twijfel te stellen dat mensen ongewild hun aangifte te laat indienen, bereid een automatisch uitstel te realiseren voor de bovengenoemde groep
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden van Van Raan, Alkaya, Van den Hul, Nijboer, Diks en Snels over schending van de OESO-richtlijnen door Pluspetrol

MPs asked the government about an OECD guidelines complaint against Pluspetrol over pollution and indigenous rights in the Peruvian Amazon, the Dutch oil and gas sector's responsible business conduct plan, Tax Authority transparency requirements on financial flows to low-tax jurisdictions, and binding due diligence legislation. The government acknowledged the concerns, said the sector had not published the promised plan and it would reach out again, and described existing tax transparency measures and a study on enforceable due diligence instruments.
The oil and gas sector has not published an action plan. The cabinet cannot establish whether any improvement has taken place.
De olie- en gassector heeft geen plan van aanpak gepubliceerd. Het kabinet kan niet vaststellen of er verbetering heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul, Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about measures during the coronavirus crisis across care, education, housing, debt, and the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered most questions by referring to earlier letters, while giving substantive answers on mantelzorg communication, eviction restrictions, and utility disconnection protections.
Because there may be obvious reasons for eviction, such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance, the cabinet is not willing to impose a moratorium.
Omdat er evidente redenen kunnen zijn om tot huisuitzetting over te gaan, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast, is het kabinet niet bereid om tot een moratorium over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over Rijkssteun bij overname van Vestia-woningen

Nijboer (PvdA) asked whether the national government would waive transfer tax so that social rental homes held by Vestia could be sold to other housing corporations rather than investors, and what the consequences would be if no sale succeeded. The minister said a sale to non-corporations is not currently on the table, that a new transfer-tax exemption for corporations cannot be reintroduced, and that options within existing exemptions will be explored and reported before summer 2020.

If there is no room within the existing exemptions for a transfer tax exemption, I will examine policy alternatives outside the sphere of transfer tax and inform your House of the outcome around the summer.

Ingeval binnen de bestaande vrijstellingen geen ruimte bestaat voor een vrijstelling van overdrachtsbelasting, dan zal ik beleidsalternatieven buiten de sfeer van de overdrachtsbelasting onderzoeken en rond de zomer aan uw Kamer over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Schaf de zorgtoeslag af, zonder inkomenseffecten’

D66 MPs asked the government about a proposal to abolish the healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag) and lower the nominal premium, covering income effects, costs, state-aid risk and premium competition. The minister answered at length, noting that roughly 3 million households would lose out without compensation, that the proposal is unclear on compensation and feasibility for the tax authority, and that a lower premium would require EU state-aid notification, while promising alternatives will be explored in the response to the IBO-toeslagen.
Regarding cost-awareness and the level of the nominal premium, two aspects play a role.
Met betrekking tot kostenbewustzijn en de hoogte van de nominale premie spelen twee aspecten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inkomensongelijkheid en de gevolgen van statistische keuzes

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about a claim that statistical choices (deducting interest, excluding capital gains) make income inequality look smaller, and whether indirect and local taxes make the tax system regressive. The State Secretary acknowledged wealth inequality, defended CBS and OECD statistical conventions, and argued that indirect taxes are not necessarily more burdensome for low incomes.
I am aware of the article. I agree that wealth is distributed more unequally than income.
Ik ben bekend met het artikel. Ik onderschrijf dat vermogens ongelijker verdeeld zijn dan inkomens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het Zwartboek van de Stichting Afkoop Belastingschulden

Lawmaker Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance about a blacklist report from the Stichting Afkoop Belastingschulden concerning the Belastingdienst Rivierenland and the ministry, including its handling, long-running disputes and whether similar cases warrant investigation. The State Secretary confirmed receipt of the report, declined substantive comment on individual cases citing tax secrecy, noted that the related proceedings had ended in final rulings, and declined to launch an investigation into comparable long-running cases.
In view of the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act and article 67 of the Collection Act 1990, no substantive statements can be made about individual cases.

Gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen en artikel 67 van de Invorderingswet 1990 kunnen geen inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale straf voor woningcorporaties

Parliamentary questions from MP Nijboer asked whether the tax treatment of housing corporations (depreciation limits, the ATAD earnings-stripping rule and the lack of a state-aid-compatible exemption) punishes investment in social housing. The State Secretary answered that corporations are taxed like other companies, that they have sufficient funds for now, that the sector's financial capacity will be examined in a study following the Ronnes motion, and that no exemption from the earnings-stripping rule is possible.
Because of their activities under the Services of General Economic Interest (DAEB) assigned to them, housing corporations receive a number of support measures (compensations).
Vanwege hun activiteiten in het kader van de aan hen opgedragen Dienst van Algemeen Economisch Belang (DAEB) ontvangen woningcorporaties een aantal steunmaatregelen (compensaties).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Weyenberg en Lodders over banken die op grond van de FATCA-wetgeving financiële dienstverlening weigeren aan Nederlanders met (ook) de Amerikaanse nationaliteit

Three MPs asked whether banks may block or close accounts of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality (Accidental Americans) for lacking a US TIN under FATCA, and what the government will do. The Secretary of State answers that closure is not required by FATCA or the IGA, that supervisors DNB and AFM apply case-by-case rules, that no closures had yet occurred, and that the government keeps pressing the US for solutions while declining to restrict data exchange unilaterally.
I am aware of what my predecessor wrote to the House.
Ik ben bekend met hetgeen mijn ambtsvoorganger aan uw Kamer heeft geschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de daadwerkelijke inkomensongelijkheid in Nederland

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about actual income inequality in the Netherlands, including a critique of the official income statistics, wealth inequality, regressivity of taxes and whether the government will change how inequality is measured. The minister partly disputes the article's assumptions, defends CBS conventions, says wealth inequality is not a policy target, and declines to change the measurement method.
I am aware of the article. I agree that wealth is distributed more unequally than income.
Ik ben bekend met het artikel. Ik onderschrijf dat vermogens ongelijker verdeeld zijn dan inkomens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Weyenberg over een overzicht van aftrekposten, grondslagversmallers en belastingregelingen in de vennootschapsbelasting

MPs Leijten and Van Weyenberg asked why the liquidation loss scheme is not listed among tax arrangements and whether the Chamber will get a full list of provisions that reduce the corporate tax base. The state secretary provided a 2017 corporate tax base overview, explaining that the Miljoenennota list covers only non-primary-structure items, and committed to consider regular updates.
The overview omits banks and the gas sector because publishing their tax base figures could lead to identifiable information.
In het overzicht zijn de banken en de gassector weggelaten omdat publicatie van de grondslagbedragen bij deze specifieke sectoren kan leiden tot herleidbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Nijkerken-de Haan en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Limburg vreest verlies duizenden banen door luchtvrachttaks'

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the national aviation tax would cost jobs and traffic at Maastricht Aachen Airport and whether further research and consultation with Limburg had taken place. The government answered that no airport-specific analysis was made, that national effects show a small emissions decline and limited job effects, and that the EU-level alternative remains uncertain.
No specific research was conducted into the position of Maastricht Aachen Airport.
Er is geen specifiek onderzoek gedaan naar de positie van Maastricht Aachen Airport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Lodders over het bericht 'Verkoper van 'tweedehands' e-boeken stopt ermee'

MPs El Yassini and Lodders asked the ministers about a CJEU ruling on resale of second-hand e-books and how it relates to the e-lending convenant for public libraries, plus e-book market size, VAT reduction effects and innovation. The minister answered that the ruling is separate from the convenant, gave market figures, and deferred several questions to forthcoming policy letters or evaluations.
The State Secretary for Finance will inform the House before the summer about the results of this research.
De Staatssecretaris van Financiën zal uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Snels over de bedreiging van de publieke taak van woningcorporaties

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the housing minister whether falling net cash flow at housing associations threatens their public task, citing unrealised property value gains, weak new building, the ATAD1 tax effects and the call to move dead capital to social housing. The minister confirmed most premises, said the lower cash flow is substantial but financial ratios remain sufficient, blamed the cause only partly on factors outside associations' control, and pointed to pending studies and a stronger binding nature for local performance agreements.
I will consult with VNG and Aedes on how this starting point can concretely take shape.
Ik ga in overleg met VNG en Aedes bezien hoe dit uitgangspunt concreet vorm kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Geen gehoor bij Belastingtelefoon’

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance about reports that the Tax Phone line is unreachable, including waiting times, call-handling figures, the reasons for rising waits, alternative contact channels and planned improvements. The government answered with figures showing about one in twenty callers could not be connected in 2019, explained capacity and staff turnover as causes, and outlined planned measures such as callback options and an external review.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de teruggekeerde belastingdienstmedewerkers die met de vertrekregeling waren vertrokken

An SP MP asked how former Tax Authority staff who left under the departure scheme were rehired, whether they repaid the premium, and how re-entry is prevented. The State Secretary answered that two former staff were rehired as regular civil servants and three were hired as temporary workers, that repayment rules did not apply because re-hiring occurred after the premium months had passed, and that monthly controls were tightened.
At a check at the end of April 2019 it was found that three employees who had used the departure scheme had been hired as temporary or agency workers.
Bij een controle eind april 2019 is vastgesteld dat drie medewerkers als inhuur- of uitzendkracht zijn ingehuurd die gebruik hadden gemaakt van de vertrekregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de reorganisatie van de Belastingdienst

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the planned split of the Tax Administration, Benefits and Customs, staff concerns, IT modernisation, and the timeline and cost of the reorganisation. The government answered that the split will be done only where useful, that staff will be involved, that a plan of action and an impact assessment will be sent to parliament before the summer, and that culture and leadership will be addressed.
Before the summer we will send parliament a plan of action, as requested by Ms Lodders, in which the voice of employees will also explicitly have a place.
Voor de zomer zullen wij een plan van aanpak aan uw Kamer toesturen, zoals gevraagd door mevrouw Lodders, waarin ook nadrukkelijk het geluid van de medewerkers een plek in krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de harde aanpak van eigen ambtenaren bij de Belastingdienst

An MP asked the state secretary about the Tax Authority's appeal against a court ruling that overturned the dismissal of an employee, and about the broader climate of fear and open culture within the Belastingdienst. The state secretary declined to comment on individual cases but acknowledged concerns about openness and announced a leadership and culture programme, dialogue sessions and an external culture study by Deloitte.
I cannot, however, make statements about individual employees or taxpayers, both in my role as employer and in terms of tax matters given the tax confidentiality obligation.
Ik kan echter geen uitspraken doen over individuele medewerkers of belastingplichtigen, zowel vanuit de rol van werkgever als vanuit de fiscaliteit in verband met de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Omvang belastingontwijking multinationals zwaar overschat’

Member Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a newspaper report claiming that estimates of profit-shifting by multinationals are greatly overstated, asking for an assessment, the OECD method, Dutch-specific amounts and comparisons across models. The State Secretary answered that the estimates remain uncertain and contested, explained the differing data and assumptions of the OECD, European Parliament and Blouin-Robinson studies, cited an unofficial 22 billion euro figure from Lejour, and said no study has calculated losses over ten years and that a separate letter on the Lejour research will follow.
To my knowledge, there are no studies that have calculated how much tax has been avoided over a period of 10 years.
Bij mijn weten zijn er geen studies die voor een periode van 10 jaar hebben berekend hoeveel belasting er ontweken is.

m: Motie van de leden Bouali en Weverling over rekening houden met bedrijfsgrootte en administratieve draagkracht
Asks the government to take applicant size and administrative capacity into account when Invest International applies additional criteria such as IMVO requirements.
account is taken of the size of the company and the administrative capacity of the applicant
er rekening gehouden wordt met de bedrijfsgrootte en de administratieve draagkracht van de aanvrager
Amendement van het lid Bouali c.s. over middelen voor opvang en bescherming van vluchtelingen in de regio
Amendment shifts 10 million euro within the budget from security and rule-of-law development to funding for refugee protection and aid in the region.
Coverage for this amendment is found in the non-legally mandatory expenditure in article 4.3 security and rule-of-law development.
Dekking voor dit amendement wordt gevonden in de niet-juridisch verplichte uitgaven in artikel 4.3 veiligheid en rechtsstaatontwikkeling.
Motie van het lid Bouali c.s. over EU-maatregelen tegen producten die bijdragen aan de ontbossing van de Amazone
Asks the government to push at EU level for effective measures so that products sold in the EU are not linked to Amazon deforestation, and to convene like-minded member states.

requests the government to work at EU level for effective measures ensuring products on the European market are produced sustainably and without direct or indirect contribution to deforestation of the Amazon

verzoekt de regering, zich in Europees verband in te zetten voor effectieve maatregelen die ervoor zorgen dat producten die op de Europese markt komen duurzaam en zonder directe en indirecte bijdragen aan de ontbossing van de Amazone zijn geproduceerd
Motie van het lid Bouali over mogelijkheden om het Holland Alumni network te behouden
Asks the government to explore ways to keep the Holland Alumni network going.
requests the government to explore options to keep the Holland Alumni network
verzoekt de regering, mogelijkheden te verkennen om het Holland Alumni network te behouden
Motie van de leden Bouali en Alkaya over het ondertekenen van het Charter Diversiteit bevorderen onder organisaties die subsidie ontvangen van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken
Motion asking the government to promote signing of the Diversity Charter among organisations receiving foreign ministry subsidies and include it in their progress reports.
requests the government to promote signing of the Diversity Charter among organisations receiving subsidies from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
verzoekt de regering, het ondertekenen van het Charter Diversiteit te bevorderen onder organisaties die subsidie ontvangen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken
Motie van het lid Bouali over het verlagen van de transactiekosten van remittances in Nederland
Asks the government to investigate how transaction costs of migrant remittances can be reduced and access to formal financial services improved.
asks the government to investigate how transaction costs of remittances in the Netherlands can be lowered
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe transactiekosten van remittances in Nederland verlaagd kunnen worden
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over toegroeien naar een besteding van 0,7% van het bni aan ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Asks the government to map what is needed to return to spending 0.7% of GNI on development cooperation within this cabinet period.
within this cabinet period to map out what is needed to again grow to spending 0.7% of GNI
nog in deze kabinetsperiode in kaart te brengen wat nodig is om toe te groeien tot wederom de besteding van 0,7% van het bni
Motie van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen c.s. over een WRR-onderzoek naar het behalen van de duurzameontwikkelingsdoelen in de post-coronacontext
Asks the government to request the WRR to study policy options for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals in the post-COVID context, with attention to policy coherence, and report in Q1 2021.
to ask the Scientific Council for Government Policy to conduct broader research
om de Wetenschappelijke Raad voor het Regeringsbeleid te vragen om een breder onderzoek te doen
Motie van de leden Bouali en Weverling over het ondersteunen van de initiatieven van NLinBusiness voor uitbreiding van Holland Houses
Asks the government to support NLinBusiness initiatives to expand Holland Houses abroad to help exporters during COVID-19.
requests the government to support NLinBusiness initiatives for further expansion of the Holland Houses
verzoekt de regering, de initiatieven van NLinBusiness ten behoeve van de verdere uitbreiding van de Holland Houses
Motie van de leden Jetten en Bouali over het gezamenlijk optrekken van de EU en Canada voor klimaatdoelstellingen en dierenwelzijn
Asks the government to use the EU-Canada free trade agreement to work jointly with Canada on climate goals and animal welfare, both at EU and bilateral level.
requests the government to use the free trade agreement with Canada to take the initiative both European and bilaterally
verzoekt de regering, het vrijhandelsverdrag met Canada te gebruiken om zowel Europees als bilateraal het initiatief te nemen
Amendement van het lid Bouali over tegengaan ontbossing en verduurzaming landbouw
Amendment shifting 5 million euro within the foreign development budget to combat deforestation and support sustainable local farming abroad.
With this amendment the submitter seeks an allocation of 5 million euro to combating deforestation
De indiener wenst met dit amendement een toekenning van 5 miljoen EUR aan het tegengaan van ontbossing
Motie van het lid Van Helvert c.s. over oprichting van een parlementaire contactgroep Verenigde Staten
Asks the Speaker to establish a parliamentary contact group with the United States Congress this calendar year.
requests the Speaker to establish the United States contact group this calendar year
verzoekt de Voorzitter, om nog dit kalenderjaar de contactgroep Verenigde Staten op te richten
Motie van het lid Kuik c.s. over de keuze van focuslanden en Afrika
Motion asks the government to set and send the House clear criteria for choosing focus countries and Africa before the policy note is presented.
requests the government to draw up clear criteria with analysis well before the policy note and send them to the House
verzoekt de regering om, ruim voor verschijning van de beleidsnota eenduidige criteria op te stellen met bijbehorende analyse en deze naar de Kamer te sturen
Motie van het lid Van den Hul c.s. over een prominente rol voor onderwijs
Asks the government to give education a prominent role in development cooperation and to inform the House before the Spring Memorandum.
requests the government to give education a prominent role in development cooperation and to inform the House before the Spring Memorandum about efforts in this area
verzoekt de regering, onderwijs een prominente rol te laten spelen in OS en de Kamer voor de Voorjaarsnota te informeren over de inspanningen op dit gebied
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over 60 miljoen voor het samenwerkingsverband voor noodhulp
Asks the government to provide 60 million euro in 2018 for emergency aid through the Dutch Relief Alliance.
requests the government further to make 60 million euro available in 2018 for emergency aid via the DRA
verzoekt de regering voorts, in 2018 60 miljoen euro ter beschikking te stellen voor noodhulp via de DRA
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over een gecombineerde aanpak van klimaat en ontwikkeling
Asks the government to use the national climate fund for a combined climate and development approach in low-income countries.
requests the government to deploy the climate fund for a combined approach to climate and development
verzoekt de regering, het klimaatfonds in te zetten voor een gecombineerde aanpak van klimaat en ontwikkeling
Motie van de leden Bouali en Van den Hul over de bevordering van SRGR
Asks the government to explain to the House in its new development policy agenda how it will give effect to sexual and reproductive health and rights and what funds it will allocate.

requests the government to explain to the House in the new policy note on the development cooperation, trade and investment agenda how this priority will be given effect and which financial resources will be made available

verzoekt de regering, de Kamer bij de nieuwe beleidsnota met de agenda voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking, handel en investeringen te expliciteren op welke wijze invulling wordt gegeven aan deze prioriteit en welke financiële middelen daartoe worden vrijgemaakt
Motie van het lid Kuik c.s. over de kennispositie op het gebied van water en voedsel
Asks the government to recognise and fully use the Dutch knowledge position on water and food in international trade policy.
requests the government to recognise this Dutch knowledge position in water and food and to make optimal use of it in international trade policy
verzoekt de regering, deze kennispositie van Nederland op het terrein van water en voedsel te erkennen en optimaal te benutten in het internationaal handelsbeleid
Motie van het lid Becker c.s. over een proactieve handelsagenda
Asks the cabinet for a proactive trade agenda addressing entrepreneurs' access to finance and information, to be sent to the House before the summer recess.
requests the government to come up with a proactive trade agenda
verzoekt de regering, met een proactieve handelsagenda te komen
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over in volgende jaarverslagen ook duidelijk aangeven wat niet goed ging
Asks that future annual reports clearly state what went wrong, lessons learned, and how this leads to policy changes.
requests the government, in future annual reports, to also clearly state what did not go well
verzoekt de regering, in volgende jaarverslagen ook duidelijk aan te geven wat niet goed ging
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over het zichtbaar maken van de resultaten van de convenanten
Asks the government with the SER to develop an instrument to make the progress and results of sector agreements (convenanten) visible.
requests the government, together with the SER, to explore how to arrive at an instrument to make visible the progress, results or conclusions of the agreements
verzoekt de regering om, samen met de SER te onderzoeken hoe tot een instrument te komen op basis waarvan de voortgang, resultaten of conclusies van de convenanten zichtbaar gemaakt kunnen worden
Motie van het lid Bouali over de ontwikkelingsuitdagingen in delen van Marokko
Asks the government to explore intensifying cooperation with Morocco on aid and trade, with attention to sexual and reproductive health, women's rights, sustainability and responsible business.
requests the government to consider how intensified cooperation, to promote aid and trade, can take place within the financial framework
verzoekt de regering, te bezien op welke wijze intensivering van de samenwerking, ter bevordering van hulp en handel, kan plaatsvinden binnen het financiële raamwerk
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Bosman, Bouali, Leijten, Asscher en Van Ojik over het juridische advies van de commissie over de Brexit-deal.

Six MPs and a Green MP asked the ministers whether the Council's Legal Service had put its advice on the Brexit deal in writing, and requested all internal and external legal advice on the deal, plus options for a smooth transition if the deal is mixed. The minister replied that the Legal Service confirmed its view only orally, that the conclusions will be written into the Council decision and a Commission statement, that the EU-only route is a political choice not binding on future deals, and that interim application of mixed parts is not possible, while the legal analysis and a confidential annex were shared with the Chamber.
There are no written opinions from the Council's Legal Service (JDR) on these questions; the JDR confirmed both points orally.
Er zijn over deze vraagstukken geen schriftelijke adviezen van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad (JDR) verschenen; de JDR heeft beide punten mondeling bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bouali over het bericht '5 things to know about Post-Brexit aviation'

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the effects of a no-deal Brexit on aviation, including emergency measures, route permits, border checks and a possible return to the 1946 bilateral air agreement. The minister answered that an EU emergency measure would serve as the fallback, that a bilateral agreement is not currently needed, and that several matters remain undecided.
It is not precisely clear what Minister Shapps means by his remark about 'sensible additional flexibilities' and I do not want to anticipate this at this stage.
Het is niet precies duidelijk wat Minister Shapps met zijn opmerking over «sensible additional flexibilities» bedoelt en ik wil daar in dit stadium ook niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Sjoerdsma, Van den Hul en Van den Niewenhuijzen over het bericht dat Palestijnse kinderen worden mishandeld en vernederd in Israëlische gevangenissen

MPs from D66, PvdA and GroenLinks asked the ministers whether they knew of Save the Children reports of mistreatment of Palestinian children in Israeli detention, and what the government would do about military trial of minors. The minister acknowledged the reports, condemned the practices, said Nederland has raised the issue with Israeli authorities and will keep doing so, and mentioned support for NGO projects.
The Netherlands will continue to voice its concerns to the Israeli government.
Nederland zal haar zorgen blijven uitspreken naar de Israëlische regering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp, Özütok, Bouali en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over aandacht voor de kwetsbare positie van oa. LHBTI’s in de nationale en internationale COVID-19 respons

MPs asked the government about the vulnerable position of LHBTI people during the COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands and internationally, including healthcare access for transgender people and UN recommendations. The Minister answered that impacts are being studied (Movisie survey due in autumn), referred healthcare questions to another minister, said the UN refugee camp reports were not confirmed, and described Dutch advocacy at the UN.
This question falls under the policy area of the Minister for Medical Care and Sport (MZS).
Deze vraag ligt op het beleidsterrein van de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport (MZS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en De Groot over het bericht dat een onomkeerbare ontwikkeling van regenwoud naar savanne dreigt voor de Amazone

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the government is aware of a study warning the Amazon is nearing a tipping point toward savannah, whether this warrants intensified forest protection, and what measures can keep deforestation-linked products out of the European market. The minister confirmed the study fits earlier warnings, said Dutch forest efforts were stepped up this year and will continue, pointed to EU-level legislative and non-legislative work on deforestation-free supply chains, and reported that Brazil has agreed to dialogue following the Amsterdam Declarations Partnership letter.

Within the European Union, legislative and non-legislative measures are being developed, partly under the Green Deal, to help reduce the ecological footprint of EU consumption and make supply chains deforestation-free.

Binnen de Europese Unie wordt, mede in het kader van de Green Deal, gewerkt aan wetgevende en niet-wetgevende maatregelen, die helpen bij het verkleinen van de ecologische voetafdruk van de EU-consumptie en het ontbossingsvrij maken van handelsketens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bouali, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Israël martelde verdachte Palestijnen van een NGO gesteund door Nederland'

MPs asked whether the Israeli detention and alleged torture of two former staff of the Palestinian NGO UAWC, which the Netherlands supports, breaches international law, and about military trial, access to counsel and administrative detention. The ministers say the Netherlands is concerned, has raised torture and fair-trial rights with Israel and the EU, notes an Israeli Justice Ministry inquiry without published results, and will keep monitoring the case.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the progress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over misstanden bij hulporganisatie ZOA

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reported misconduct at aid organisation ZOA, including alleged corruption and conflicts of interest in its Sudan office, and whether an investigation would be launched. The minister confirmed ZOA receives development funds, said internal and DfID reviews found the allegations unfounded so far, and said the Netherlands is discussing a further joint review with Sweden and the EU, with the House to be informed if warranted.
The Netherlands is in discussion with Sweden and the European Union about a joint further review of ZOA's country office in Sudan.
Nederland is in gesprek met Zweden en de Europese Unie over gezamenlijke verdere doorlichting van het landenkantoor van ZOA in Soedan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Van Weyenberg over het heropenen van de sekswerksector

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the Dutch sex work sector could reopen under a hygiene protocol like Belgium's, and why not if not. The minister answered that the sector may reopen from 1 July under sector-drafted protocols that follow RIVM guidance, with EZK giving further advice on the protocols.
The sex work sector may reopen from 1 July.
De sekswerksector mag per 1 juli weer open.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Van Weyenberg over “de steunmaatregelen voor sekswerkers”

D66 MPs Bouali and Van Weyenberg asked whether sex workers, including opting-in workers without employee premiums, can access COVID-19 support schemes (Tozo, WW, NOW), how many are affected, and why sex work may only resume on 1 September. Minister Koolmees answered that lawfully resident persons may claim Tozo, WW or general assistance if they meet criteria, that opting-in workers cannot claim WW or NOW, that sex work reopening on 1 September follows the cabinet route map and expert advice, and that he sees no way to reopen earlier.
It is not known how many sex workers there are in the Netherlands.
Niet bekend is hoeveel sekswerkers er in Nederland zijn.
Antwoord op vagen van de leden Kuik, Bouali en Voordewind over de opschorting van de steun van de VS aan de WHO

Three MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the Netherlands was warned about the US suspension of WHO funding, what consequences it has for COVID-19 response, and whether the EU will press the US to reverse it. The minister answered that the Netherlands learned of it via media, opposes suspension, will press US counterparts and coordinate an EU resolution, and pledged additional funds to the WHO.
On behalf of the Dutch government I have expressed support for the WHO.
Namens de Nederlandse regering heb ik steun uitgesproken voor de WHO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Voordewind over het bericht dat Corona de armoede versterkt

Two MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation about the effects of COVID-19 on poverty and health systems in developing countries, the overview of EU and other donor funding, the impact of the expected economic crisis on the 0.7% ODA budget, and what Dutch action is planned. The minister answered that Nederland has released EUR 100 million, supports Team Europe coordination, asked the Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken for urgent advice, and that the ODA budget will be assessed later once economic forecasts are clearer.
I have immediately earmarked EUR 100 million from my budget as part of this internationally coordinated effort.
Om die reden heb ik per direct EUR 100 mln vrijgemaakt op mijn begroting als onderdeel van deze internationale gecoördineerde inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over het bericht dat Afrika geteisterd wordt door een sprinkhanenplaag

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Netherlands would contribute to the FAO's USD 138 million appeal against the desert locust plague in Africa, and how Dutch-funded food security projects were affected. The minister answered that the Netherlands pledged EUR 1 million plus EUR 10 million via CERF, that the impact on Dutch projects was not yet clear, and that additional emergency funding would be reconsidered if the situation worsened.
The Netherlands, like 10 other countries, responded positively to these requests and makes EUR 1 million available from the food security programme.
Nederland heeft net als 10 andere landen positief gereageerd op deze verzoeken en stelt EUR 1 miljoen beschikbaar vanuit het voedselzekerheidsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Diks, Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het VN-rapport waarin wordt geconstateerd dat diverse landen het VN-wapenembargo tegen Libië schenden

MPs from GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about a UN Panel of Experts report finding that several states violated the Libya arms embargo, including the possible Dutch role of Van der Kamp Shipsales in a warship sale. The minister said the Netherlands raised enforcement at EU level, is investigating the company without yet deciding on measures, and sees no need for additional rules, while noting the limits of post-export controls.
Further investigation is currently ongoing, so the cabinet cannot now say whether there is cause to take measures against the company.
Nader onderzoek loopt op dit moment, daarom kan het kabinet nu geen uitspraak doen over de vraag of er aanleiding bestaat om maatregelen tegen het bedrijf te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Bouali over het bericht ‘Hoe aquaria wereldwijd het koraalrif bedreigen; Vissen op Nemo’s’

MPs De Groot and Bouali asked ministers about imports of tropical aquarium fish and coral through Schiphol, possible illegal wild capture, and EU enforcement under CITES. The minister answered with 2019 import figures for CITES-listed species, described CITES permit and customs controls, and said the EU and Switzerland and the US had proposed a CITES study of unprotected species trade.
For species not protected under CITES, no figures are available.
Voor de soorten die niet beschermd zijn onder CITES zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Groeiend verzet tegen Saudisch vrachtship Bahri Yanbu vol wapens’ en ‘Don't let Saudi arms ship dock in UK, say campaigners’

MPs Bouali and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether a Saudi cargo ship carrying arms bound for Yemen would be allowed to dock in EU ports, and whether EU states should refuse it under the Arms Trade Treaty and EU Common Position. The government said it lacks information on transit through other EU ports, would not have granted a Dutch transit licence to this ship, and will keep raising the matter with EU partners.
The cabinet continues to point EU member states on several occasions to the tightened Dutch policy and to call on other countries to adopt comparable measures.
Het kabinet blijft EU-lidstaten bij meerdere gelegenheden wijzen op het aangescherpte Nederlandse beleid en andere landen oproepen vergelijkbare maatregelen te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over het bericht ‘Baggerbedrijf Van Oord betrokken bij mensenrechtenschendingen in Angola’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Van Oord, ING and Atradius DSB were linked to forced evictions of about 3,000 families in Angola and whether due diligence failed. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said the evictions were in a separate sub-project in 2013 unknown to those parties, defended the due diligence process while promising a general evaluation of the CSR policy for export credit insurance, and declined to assign any liability or compensation to the Dutch state.
After this evaluation, the 'CSR policy document for export credit insurance' will be adjusted where necessary and presented to your House.
Na deze evaluatie wordt het «mvo-beleidsdocument voor de exportkredietverzekering» waar nodig aangepast en aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over de Bilateral Investment Agreement tussen de EU en Taiwan

An MP from D66 asked whether the EU and Taiwan are negotiating a bilateral investment agreement, about trade and investment flows, and whether the government would press the Commission to start talks. The minister answered that no negotiations are under way, the Commission has no Council mandate, and the government sees no urgent need to press for talks.
No negotiations are taking place between the EU and Taiwan on an investment agreement.
Er wordt niet onderhandeld tussen de EU en Taiwan over een investeringsovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over het bericht 'Leaked letter suggests US is rallying UN member states top oppose abortion'

An MP asked the minister whether a leaked US letter urging UN states to oppose sexual and reproductive health rights and abortion had been received by the Netherlands, and how the government views this trend. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not receive the letter, that 19 countries backed a US-led statement on UHC, and that the Netherlands will keep actively defending SRGR and women's rights in UN and EU forums.
The Netherlands did not receive this letter.
Nederland heeft deze brief niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Diks, Bouali en Van de Hul over de moord op de Braziliaanse activist Paulo Paulino Guajajara

Four MPs asked the government about the murder of Brazilian indigenous activist Paulo Paulino Guajajara, whether Brazil's environment and indigenous rights are deteriorating under Bolsonaro, and what concrete action the Netherlands will take. The government said illegal loggers likely were involved but could not confirm it, said violence against indigenous people appears to have grown, and outlined diplomatic dialogue, EU-Mercosur review and support for rights defenders without committing to a new concrete measure.
It seems very likely that illegally operating loggers were involved in his death, although we cannot confirm that.
Het lijkt zeer waarschijnlijk dat illegaal opererende houthakkers betrokken waren bij zijn dood, hoewel wij dat niet kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over het bericht dat door het anti-abortusbeleid van president Trump het aantal abortussen in ontwikkelingslanden toeneemt

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Trump administration's expanded Mexico City Policy is raising abortion rates in developing countries and reducing US-funded health services, and what the Netherlands and the EU could do to offset the gap. The minister confirmed the reports, described harmful effects on about fifty health projects including HIV, maternal care and cancer screening, and listed Dutch diplomatic efforts on sexual and reproductive health rights without committing to new funding.
In addition to the financial support to organisations in the field of sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRGR) as set out in my answers
Naast de financiële steun aan organisaties op het terrein van seksuele en reproductieve gezondheid en rechten (SRGR) zoals uiteengezet in mijn antwoorden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over de ontbossing van de Amazone

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about deforestation of the Amazon, including the Corredor Centro-Norte infrastructure, Dutch companies' involvement, and support for a WWF protected-area initiative. The Minister answered that the Netherlands does not fund the corridor's development, that policy has not changed, and that the government is studying an additional contribution to be reported to parliament this autumn.
This autumn the House will be informed about this in a letter.
Dit najaar zal de Kamer daar per brief over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ouwehand, Voordewind en Bouali over het bericht ‘de zwarte kant van het voetbal’

Four MPs from SGP, PvdD, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about reported deaths of migrant workers building World Cup facilities in Qatar and what the government is doing about labour abuse there. The ministers answered that every death is one too many, that Qatar has begun reforms with the ILO and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and multilaterally, while declining to boycott the tournament.
It does not fit Dutch policy to boycott sporting events because of political situations.
Het past niet in het Nederlandse beleid om sportevenementen te boycotten vanwege politieke situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over het bericht 'Aanval op WTO door Trump dwingt Europa tot noodgreep'

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade about reports that US obstruction of WTO Appellate Body appointments will leave the body inoperative from December 2019, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing about it. The minister confirmed the risk, said the EU is working on an interim appeal arrangement with other WTO members, and said the Netherlands supports the Commission in pressing to lift the blockage.
The Netherlands supports the European Commission in conveying the importance of the multilateral trading system, with a system of binding dispute settlement.
Nederland steunt de Europese Commissie in het uitdragen van het belang van het multilaterale handelssysteem, met een systeem van bindende geschillenbeslechting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat het Rode Kruis Venezuela mag betreden met hulpgoederen

MPs Bouali and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government knows that the Red Cross received permission from Maduro to deliver emergency aid to Venezuela, and about shortages of medicine and food, the scale of the operation and Dutch funding. Minister Kaag confirmed the crisis and noted that Dutch contributions since 2018 total over EUR 1.6 million, with an additional EUR 2 million, while stressing that aid must be neutral and reach those most in need.
The Netherlands has contributed at various moments over the past year to Red Cross relief efforts in Venezuela and the region.
Nederland heeft het afgelopen jaar op verschillende momenten bijgedragen aan de hulpverlening van het Rode Kruis in Venezuela en de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over de humanitaire crisis in Venezuela en de erkenning van Juan Guaidó als interim-president

An MP from D66 asked the government about the humanitarian crisis in Venezuela, aid channels, the recognition of Juan Guaidó, and support to Caribbean parts of the Kingdom. The ministers answered that aid is limited without Maduro's cooperation, outlined Dutch contributions via UN and Red Cross channels, and announced in principle that Curaçao may serve as a logistics hub for humanitarian aid.
The Netherlands continues to press Venezuela to make this possible.
Nederland blijft er op aandringen dat Venezuela dit mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Diertens en Bouali over het bericht 'Caribische eilanden kunnen grotere toestroom Venezolanen verwachten'

MPs Groothuizen, Diertens and Bouali asked whether UNHCR projections of a rising Venezuelan refugee flow to the Caribbean reflect a real threat, and about funding, detention, asylum procedures and rights on Aruba and Curaçao. The government answered that the UNHCR figures cover the wider Caribbean, that interceptions fell in 2018, that Curaçao has requested assistance on detention and the asylum procedure, and that asylum applications are assessed individually.
