The Ministry of Justice and Security asks the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a country report when a high number of asylum applications from nationals of a given country is lodged in the Netherlands.

Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid vraagt het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken om een ambtsbericht als er in Nederland een hoog aantal asielaanvragen wordt ingediend van personen uit een bepaald land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bouali over gedwongen huwelijken van vrouwen uit Myanmar in China

MPs Kuik and Bouali asked the minister about a John Hopkins/KWAT study on forced marriages of women and girls from Myanmar in China, Dutch support for victim protection, and whether Dutch aid and diplomacy address trafficking. The minister described the study's estimates as hard to verify, listed Dutch-funded projects in Kachin and China, and said the issue will be raised in the next human rights dialogue with China.
The Netherlands will raise the issue during the next round of the bilateral human rights dialogue with China.
Nederland zal de kwestie ter sprake brengen tijdens de eerstvolgende ronde van de bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog met China
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Groothuizen over het verdwijnen van Vietnamese minderjarigen uit opvanglocaties

MPs Bouali and Groothuizen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the disappearance of Vietnamese unaccompanied minors from reception locations, including whether the protocol will be revised and whether prosecutors will start a people-smuggling investigation. The State Secretary gave yearly figures (7 to 31 per year, 13 in 2018), said the protocol is being updated, and stated that no criminal facts have been established and the Public Prosecution Service assesses signals case by case without commenting on ongoing investigations.
The protocol no longer matches current work processes and is therefore being updated at this time.
Het protocol komt niet meer overeen met de huidige werkprocessen en wordt daarom op dit moment geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul, Bouali, Ouwehand en Stoffer over hongerlonen en schendingen van arbeidsrechten in H&M’s productieketen

MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report on starvation wages and labour-rights violations in H&M's supply chain in Bulgaria, including whether H&M would be held to account, whether the textile covenant targets are slipping, whether the government will discuss freedom of association with covenant parties, and the state of a roadmap to extend covenants internationally. The minister said living wages are a human right, that H&M bears responsibility and should act and that she is willing to talk with H&M, pointed to covenant activities on living wages and union freedom and to ongoing EU-level IMVO coalition-building, but declined a separate meeting on union freedom.
I am willing to discuss this with H&M.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met H&M.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Bouali over het bericht ‘Zorgen om verdwijnen van minderjarige asielzoekers’

MPs Groothuizen and Bouali asked about reports that unaccompanied minor asylum seekers are disappearing and falling victim to trafficking and sexual violence, and what measures prevent this. The State Secretary replied that protective reception measures, risk analyses and police notification have been strengthened and that the reception model is under evaluation, awaiting its outcome before further steps.
The asylum minors reception model is currently being evaluated. I look forward to the outcome of this study.
Op dit moment wordt het amv-opvangmodel geëvalueerd. Ik wacht graag de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Kuik en Voordewind over de opvang van Venezolanen in Colombia

MPs Bouali, Kuik and Voordewind asked the minister about the number of Venezuelan refugees in Colombia and neighbouring countries, Dutch contributions and support, and the situation of women and girls forced into prostitution. The minister replied with estimates of roughly 600,000 to 700,000 (UNHCR: about 1 million) Venezuelans in Colombia, a EUR 500,000 unearmarked contribution, and general statements on monitoring vulnerable groups, while stating that further support depends on priorities and available funds.
The cabinet is concerned about the humanitarian crisis in Venezuela and its consequences for the region, and will continue to closely monitor the situation.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over de humanitaire crisis in Venezuela en de gevolgen voor de regio, en blijft de situatie nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Voordewind, Kuik en Bouali over het bericht dat OS-ontvanger Rwanda de nieuwe shirtsponsor van voetbalclub Arsenal wordt

MPs from VVD, ChristenUnie, CDA and D66 asked the minister whether Rwanda, a development aid recipient, becoming Arsenal's shirt sponsor is consistent with aid dependency concerns and whether the government would raise this with Rwanda. The minister answered that the choice of partner is Rwanda's, that the Netherlands continues a transition relationship with bilateral aid being phased out, and that it will keep discussing the effectiveness of such tourism investments with Rwanda's development board.
The Rwanda Development Board has made no statements about the costs associated with this partnership.
De Rwanda Development Board heeft geen uitspraken gedaan over de kosten die gepaard gaan met dit partnerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Voortman en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Strengere regels inburgering: geslaagde migranten moeten opnieuw toets afleggen’

MPs asked whether migrants who passed the state NT2 language exam must now take extra civic tests (KNM and ONA) before the IND grants a permanent residence permit, and why DUO and the IND apply different rules. The minister answered that the stricter requirement since 2015 applies to the Vreemdelingenwet for applications filed from 1 January 2015, that information for the target group will be improved, and refused to drop the extra test while promising to monitor effects.

It is therefore possible that someone who holds the NT2 diploma and became subject to the civic integration obligation before 1 January 2015 is exempt from the integration obligation under the Wet inburgering but still must pass the KNM and ONA components if they file an application for a stronger residence right after 1 January 2015.

Het is dus mogelijk dat iemand die in het bezit is van het NT2 diploma en vóór 1 januari 2015 inburgeringsplichtig is geworden, is vrijgesteld van de inburgeringsplicht op grond van de Wet inburgering maar nog wel de onderdelen KNM en ONA moet behalen indien hij ná 1 januari 2015 een aanvraag indient voor een sterker verblijfsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bouali over voortdurende demonstraties in Marokko

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bouali asked the ministers about protests in Morocco, including police violence and arrests in Jerada and the Rif, and whether the government would raise these with Morocco. The ministers answered that violence and arrests had occurred, that the Dutch embassy and ministers have raised freedom of assembly and fair trial concerns with Moroccan authorities, and that Dutch programmes support socio-economic development in the north.
The right to peaceful demonstration is laid down in international human rights treaties and in the Moroccan Constitution.
Het recht op vreedzaam demonstreren is vastgelegd in internationale mensenrechtenverdragen en in de Marokkaanse Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over de opvang van Venezolaanse vluchtelingen

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about support for Venezuelan refugees, including UN aid to Colombia, the Netherlands' role, reception on the Caribbean islands, and Dutch citizens stranded in Venezuela. The minister answered that the government backs UN aid to Colombia, funds UN agencies through unearmarked contributions, sees no added value in raising the issue at the UN Security Council, and described reception arrangements and departure flights for stranded Dutch nationals.
The cabinet currently sees no added value in placing the reception of Venezuelan refugees on the agenda of the UN Security Council.
Het kabinet ziet op dit moment geen toegevoegde waarde in het agenderen van de opvang van Venezolaanse vluchtelingen in de VN Veiligheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de invloed van salafisten in Nederlandse moskeeën

MPs from D66 asked ministers about Saudi-funded study places at the Islamic University of Medina, salafist takeovers of mosques, violence in mosque power struggles, and whether municipalities monitor foreign funding of religious institutions. The government answered that registration data are incomplete, Saudi scholarships are a voluntary choice not disclosed in Notes Verbales, it lacks data on violent incidents or lecture funding, and it promised a tri-track municipal approach and a further handling framework.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police do not register violent incidents at mosques in the context of the power struggle as referred to in the question.
Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie registreren niet op gewelddadige incidenten bij moskeeën in het kader van de machtsstrijd zoals in de vraag bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Groothuizen over een recordaantal kinderen dat op de vlucht is

Two D66 MPs asked about the record number of children on the move, including whether the Netherlands would lead an alliance, how EU child-rights violations are prevented, the status of the pledge to bring 750 refugee children from Italy and Greece, and whether NGOs would be invited. The minister answered that the government supports child-focused programmes abroad, cannot provide a full overview of EU violations, reports about 750 minors relocated, and will invite the NGOs to talk.
The cabinet does not have a complete overview of reported violations and the actions taken against them.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een totaaloverzicht van gemelde schendingen en de acties die daartegen worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Groothuizen en Bouali over het bericht dat verdachte schepen niet worden gecontroleerd

MPs Jetten, Groothuizen and Bouali (D66) asked whether ships that switched off their AIS signal or changed identification before entering Dutch waters are being properly checked, and what the consequences for security and enforcement are. The government answers that AIS gaps have many legitimate causes, that the Kustwacht and Douane use risk profiling and treat AIS switch-offs as a risk indicator, that the numbers from Winward cannot be confirmed, and that modernisation and EU cooperation are underway.
The Coast Guard does not have the investigation data on which Winward based its conclusions and therefore cannot confirm the numbers Winward cites.
De Kustwacht beschikt niet over de onderzoekgegevens waarop Winward haar conclusies heeft gebaseerd en kan derhalve de door Winward genoemde aantallen niet bevestigen.

m: Motie van het lid De Kort c.s. over het delen van de resultaten van de invoeringstoets met de Kamer één jaar na de invoering van de wetswijziging

Asks the government to share the results of the implementation test with the House one year after the Participatiewet change for visually impaired people, and to examine whether job coaching should move to the UWV central service point.
requests the government to share the results of the implementation test with the House one year after introduction of the legislative amendment
verzoekt de regering de resultaten van de invoeringstoets één jaar na invoering van de wetswijziging met de Kamer te delen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Warmerdam over het functioneren van de arbeidswetgeving in de vrije culture sector

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about labour rights, union fears, employment contract chains and working conditions in the free culture sector, such as musicals. The government answers that collective agreements and sector dialogue (via Platform ACCT) are the main route, that existing labour protections including the chain rule should remain, and that it will continue dialogue within the sector rather than launch a new initiative.
It is of great importance to conduct the dialogue with and within the sector to improve working conditions in the sector.
Het is van groot belang de dialoog met én binnen de sector te voeren om de arbeidsomstandigheden in de sector te verbeteren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Warmerdam en Van Baarle over het illegaal verzamelen van gegevens van uitkeringsgerechtigden door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz, Warmerdam and Van Baarle asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV's unlawful collection of benefit recipients' data via cookies and IP addresses for a fraud risk scan, its ethics and human-rights checks, the discrimination risk, data deletion, costs and proportionality. The minister acknowledged the cookie-based IP data was collected unlawfully and proportionality was lacking, stopped the scan, reopened 460 cases, and promised a technical briefing and further information, while withholding operational details for inspection reasons.
In the interest of inspection, control and supervision I cannot make this public.
In het belang van inspectie, controle en toezicht kan ik dit niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Warmerdam over cao’s met afspraken over zelfstandigen

Two D66 MPs asked the government about collective agreements (cao's) that set terms for self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including whether such terms restrict contractual freedom, how many workers and self-employed are affected, whether these agreements belong in cao's, and how member participation and enforcement against false self-employment work. The minister answers that the competition-law exception allows collective bargaining for vulnerable self-employed, that only a small number of cao's contain such provisions, that enforcement and a legal presumption against false self-employment are being pursued, and that the questions could not be answered by the requested deadline.
Exact numbers of self-employed workers in the sectors are not available.
Exacte aantallen van zelfstandigen in de branches zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Warmerdam en Van der Werf over het NOS artikel 'Met steun van Nederland wankelt nieuwe EU-wet voor vrouwenrechten'

MPs Warmerdam and Van der Werf asked the government whether the Netherlands opposed parts of the EU directive on violence against women, including the rape harmonisation article, and why. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports the directive overall, opposed article 5 on rape harmonisation on legal-basis grounds following the Council Legal Service advice, and that the Dutch Wet seksuele misdrijven offers broader protection.
To protect the confidentiality of the negotiations, it is not customary to go into the individual positions of other member states in the negotiations.
Om de vertrouwelijkheid van de onderhandelingen te beschermen is het niet gebruikelijk om in te gaan op de individuele posities van andere lidstaten in de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Warmerdam over het artikel 'Italië begint met schrappen namen van niet-biologische moeders uit geboorteakten'

An MP asked the government about Italy's order to remove non-biological mothers' names from children's birth certificates, its consequences for parental rights, children's rights, and LGBTQ+ rights, and whether the Netherlands would speak out. The government answered that the consequences are uncertain and that it shares concerns, will raise the matter bilaterally with Italy, judges a public statement premature, and is monitoring implications for Dutch parents in Italy under EU law.
The cabinet also has concerns about the possible consequences of this development.
Het kabinet heeft ook zorgen over de eventuele gevolgen van deze ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op van de leden Warmerdam en Romke de Jong over het artikel 'Loonkloof tussen man en vrouw in Nederland is groter dan in veel andere EU-landen'

MPs Warmerdam and Romke de Jong asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the gender pay gap in the Netherlands compared with other EU countries, why the decline has stalled, the timing and scope of the EU pay transparency directive implementation, and related questions on company size thresholds and temp workers. The minister attributed the gap largely to part-time work and sector differences, acknowledged slow progress, committed to implementing the directive by mid-2024, and answered most questions, with consultation planned.
I see the introduction of this directive as an important step in promoting equality in the labour market.
Ik zie de invoering van deze richtlijn als een belangrijke stap in het bevorderen van gelijkheid op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Warmerdam over het gebruik van het stroomstootwapen bij patiënten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg

An MP asked the Justice and Security and Long-term Care ministers about police use of the taser on psychiatric patients, including the LOC's call for a ban, the status of promised independent health-effects research, alternatives and the risks for vulnerable people. The minister says police use there is exceptional and a ban is undesirable, that police cannot count taser use in care settings, that the promised research is more complex than expected and will be reported later, and that no equivalent alternatives are known.
This question cannot be answered. The police do not explicitly register a mental health institution as an 'incident location' in their registration system.
Deze vraag kan niet worden beantwoord. De politie registreert niet expliciet een ggz-instelling als «incident locatie» in haar registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Warmerdam, Paulusma en Sneller over therapeutisch gebruik van psychedelica zoals psilocybine, mdma en ketamine

D66 MPs asked the health minister about therapeutic use of psychedelics (psilocybin, MDMA, ketamine), including research funding, FDA-style fast-track approval, risks of uncoordinated use, and a central steering role. The minister agreed research is needed, pointed to ZonMw funding and a planned state commission on MDMA, and said central steering is for medical professional groups, with the government playing a facilitating and advisory role.
Central steering of research and implementation is for the medical professional groups to shape.
Centrale aansturing op onderzoek en implementatie is aan de medische beroepsgroepen om vorm te geven.

m: Amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 36 over middelen voor renovaties en extra plaatsen in het gevangeniswezen
Amendment adds 25 million euro in 2025 to the prison system budget, funded by shifting money reserved for a constitutional court, with the reserved funds partly kept for the Council of State.
The funding for this amendment is found in the funds reserved for a constitutional court
De dekking voor dit amendement wordt gevonden in de middelen gereserveerd voor een constitutioneel hof
Amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 37 over middelen voor renovaties en extra plaatsen in het gevangeniswezen

An MP asks the State Secretary about the Temporary Energy Emergency Fund, including whether it is enough to prevent energy poverty, how much aid households get, and whether those without a prior application can get help. The State Secretary answers that a broader approach is in place, that €30 million goes to municipalities via a decentralised grant rather than per-household aid, that a public energy fund is planned, and that municipalities decide who qualifies.
It is currently not known whether these scenarios accurately reflect the actual situation in 2025.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend of deze scenario’s de werkelijke situatie in 2025 goed weergeven.

MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that a harsh sick-leave policy at Detentiecentrum Rotterdam pressures staff, blocks access to occupational doctors and may breach good employer rules. The State Secretary denied the policy is structural or that absenteeism there is significantly above the DJI average, acknowledged an incidental misapplication, and declined a separate investigation while noting ongoing verzuim monitoring.
However, this does not concern a structural practice or standing policy.
Het gaat hier echter niet om een structurele werkwijze of staand beleid.

The minister confirms work on a statutory ban, says it is in principle legally possible and that a consultation bill is planned this year, while leaving the design, exemptions and police concerns open.
The cabinet shares the concerns of MP Lahlah about the safety of demonstrators who face a security risk when they demonstrate recognisably.
Het deelt daarbij de zorgen van het lid Lahlah over de veiligheid van demonstranten die een veiligheidsrisico lopen wanneer zij herkenbaar demonstreren.

The State Secretary answered that DJI is harmonising and tightening access rules to curb contraband and crime from detention, that lawyers will be allowed one device with case-by-case exceptions, and that DJI is in ongoing talks with the NOvA with a target policy date in Q1 2026.
Lawyers will in any case be given permission to bring one device (laptop, tablet or telephone).
Advocaten zullen in ieder geval toestemming krijgen voor het meenemen van één device (laptop, tablet of telefoon).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Lahlah over raadsleden met een uitkering

MPs Chakor and Lahlah asked whether councillors receiving benefits are unduly deterred from office, citing a report on benefit-related salary offsetting. The minister acknowledges the signals but rejects the report's proposals as unworkable, instead pointing to clarification of existing rules and an ongoing WIA policy review.
But I do want to make an effort toward improved and clearer implementation.
Ik wil mij wel inspannen voor een verbeterde en duidelijkere uitvoering.

An MP asked why the Prime Minister called self-run border checks by citizens at Ter Apel a form of demonstration, given that such checks are legally reserved for authorities and risk vigilantism. The Minister of Justice answered that demonstrating is free within legal limits, that carrying out border checks is reserved for authorities like the Marechaussee, and that there is no room for vigilantism, while leaving the local mayor responsible for handling demonstrations.
Carrying out border checks is legally reserved for authorities such as the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee and is bound by strict national and European rules.
Het uitvoeren van grenscontroles is wettelijk voorbehouden aan autoriteiten zoals de Koninklijke Marechaussee en is aan strenge nationale en Europese regels gebonden.

The minister defended the practice as proportionate information-gathering, pointed to a tightened internal police framework and a pending WODC study, and declined to provide figures on how often unannounced visits occur, while committing to register future contacts.
I have previously indicated that these figures are not available and that it is not possible to provide the requested overview.
Eerder heb ik aangegeven dat deze cijfers niet beschikbaar zijn en dat het niet mogelijk is om dit gevraagde overzicht te geven.

Restriction of the right to demonstrate, or consideration of it in the context of this visit, has not been an issue.
Beperking van het demonstratierecht of overweging daartoe in het kader van het onderhavige bezoek is niet aan de orde geweest.

Zonder aanvullende investeringen kan ik geen structurele capaciteitsuitbreidingen realiseren en kunnen veel van de noodzakelijke renovaties niet uitgevoerd worden.

The award is not yet final, as a court procedure is ongoing.
De gunning is nog niet definitief, aangezien er een procedure loopt bij de rechter.

I consider it important to remain alert to this at all times and to take measures where necessary.
Ik vind het van belang hier altijd alert op te zijn en neem indien nodig maatregelen.

Merely a person's presence at demonstrations is not a reason for a home visit.
Alleen iemands aanwezigheid bij demonstraties is geen reden voor een huisbezoek.
