MPs Lahlah and Kathmann asked the Justice and Security minister about police home visits to demonstrators, the legal basis and limits for police data collection and retention on protesters, complaint outcomes, and remedies, including Amnesty's call for stronger oversight. The minister answered that police contact with citizens is standard practice and that the Ombudsman study and WODC research will be followed by policy responses, while data oversight rests with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and the police chief, and that the answers were late.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to comment on the recommendations made to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, because the exercise of supervision is independent.

Het is daarbij niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om mij uit te laten over de aanbevelingen die zijn gedaan richting de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, omdat de uitoefening van het toezicht onafhankelijk geschiedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Lahlah en Bushoff over de vergoeding van hulpmiddelen aan kinderen

MPs asked whether children's basic necessities and healthcare aids, such as incontinence material, glasses, braces and special learning materials, are being left to charities and whether insurers and municipalities are failing to cover them. The Minister says the government knows of rising requests, points to the basic insurance rules, municipal responsibilities and ongoing work on child glasses, but largely defers responsibility to insurers, schools and municipalities.
I consider it important that children have access to sufficient incontinence material when they need it due to a medical indication or disability.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat kinderen toegang hebben tot voldoende incontinentiemateriaal als ze die vanwege een medische indicatie of beperking nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Lahlah en Kröger over “het sluiten van het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie”

Three GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about the closure of the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie after a rush of applications, technical problems, and the mandatory DigiD requirement. The State Secretary acknowledged the frustration and access problems, but said no additional public or third-party funds were available, the fund had to close, and a DigiD was required to verify income.
To prevent administrative risks, the central government can only contribute funds when third parties also contribute more than one third of the total sum.
Het Rijk kan om bestuurlijke risico's te voorkomen enkel middelen inleggen wanneer derde partijen ook meer dan één derde van de totale som financieel bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de berichten 'Toegang tot het recht krimpt, terwijl maatwerk faalt' en 'Maatregelen regeerprogramma inkomenszekerheid: waarom de gemeente aan zet blijft'

An MP asks the ministers about news reports saying access to justice is shrinking and that gemeenten remain responsible for income support, and whether the government shares the ombudsman's view that citizens are sent from desk to desk. The ministers answer that the government is committed to accessible services, cite a kwartiermaker to map legal aid gaps, the expansion of overheidsbrede loketten to 25 initiatives, and a proactive services bill to be submitted in 2025.
To implement the Van Nispen/Palmen motion, a kwartiermaker will be appointed before the summer (J&V, BZK, SZW) to explore how a nationwide network of socio-legal services can best be organised.

Ter uitvoering van de motie Van Nispen/Palmen 4 wordt voor de zomer een kwartiermaker benoemd (J&V, BZK, SZW) die verkent hoe een landelijk dekkend netwerk van sociaaljuridische dienstverlening het best vormgegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de vrees van gevangenispersoneel voor meerpersoonscellen

MP Lahlah asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about prison staff fears over multi-person cells, incidents, staff shortages, sick leave, leave policy and capacity. The State Secretary answers that staff safety and inmate safety remain guaranteed, that extra multi-person cells will be created only where staffing and buildings allow, and that measures on capacity (including sentencing reform and capacity leave) are being pursued.
Antwoord op n van de leden Welzijn en Lahlah over "het bericht dat het aantal gemeentelijke meldpunten (kliklijnen) voor uitkeringsfraude blijft stijgen."

MPs Welzijn and Lahlah asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the rising number of municipal anonymous fraud hotlines for benefit fraud and whether they fit a trust-based view of citizens, citing Rotterdam's experience with many unfounded accusations. The State Secretary answered that municipalities decide on their own enforcement instruments, that a hotline is one enforcement tool, that complaints are checked before any action, and that exact figures on hotlines and reports are not available.
I do not have the requested data.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de gaten in de Nederlandse rechtsbescherming en het effect daarvan op het vertrouwen in de overheid

An MP asks the State Secretary about regional gaps in access to social legal aid, the falling supply of social lawyers, cost and travel barriers, and whether this weakens citizens' legal protection. The government acknowledges the concerns, points to ongoing studies, a planned national network for social legal aid, and a visioning process, but rejects some premises (e.g. no 12% cut, indexation continues) and commits to no new funding now.

I am also currently working with, among others, the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, the Dutch Bar Association and the Vereniging Sociaal Advocatuur Nederland on a vision for the future of social legal practice.

Ik werk bovendien op dit moment samen met onder meer de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, Nederlandse orde van advocaten en de Vereniging Sociaal Advocatuur Nederland aan een visie op de toekomst van de sociale advocatuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Lahlah over de financiële achteruitgang van mensen met een beperking door kabinetsbeleid

MPs Westerveld and Lahlah asked the state secretaries about financial losses for people with disabilities, including higher Wlz own contributions and lower take-home pay for sheltered-work staff from tax changes and an expired CAO. The government says the Wlz increase follows from the minimum wage rise, that the tax changes cause losses of up to about 15 euro per month, and that it is talking with the VNG about financing sheltered work, but that it is not a party to the CAO negotiations.
The cabinet is not a party to the CAO negotiations for the group working at social development companies and therefore takes a cautious stance on the CAO Aan de slag.
Het kabinet is geen partij in de cao-onderhandelingen voor de doelgroep die werkt bij sociaal ontwikkelbedrijven en stelt zich daarom terughoudend op ten aanzien van de cao Aan de slag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Lahlah over onderwijs in justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

MPs Westerveld and Lahlah asked the government about education in youth detention institutions (JJI's), citing Education Council and Inspectorate reports on lack of guaranteed schooling, staffing shortages, examination barriers and detained youths in adult prisons. The government acknowledges the concerns, lists funding increases and a mbo-coordinator, and promises further reactions and letters before the summer recess, though it refers many structural questions to later responses.
That there are ongoing concerns about education in the JJIs we take extremely seriously.
Dat er aanhoudende zorgen zijn over het onderwijs in de JJI's nemen wij uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de onrust na het dodelijke steekincident in Den Dolder

An MP asks the State Secretaries about the unrest after a fatal stabbing in Den Dolder, the promised relocation of the Fivoor forensic clinic by 2025 or 2027, and whether the clinic will close. The government answers that it has no power to force a relocation or closure, that the 2025 date was an intention by the owner and not a promise by the minister, and that it will explore support such as Rijksvastgoed for a move.
It is not for the Minister to close the clinic or to steer towards a timeline for the intended departure.
Het is niet aan de Minister om de kliniek te sluiten of aan te sturen op een tijdspad richting het voorgenomen vertrek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtspraak

MP Lahlah asks the Justice Minister and State Secretary about judicial independence after press reports of judges' concerns and academics warning of political influence over the judiciary, including whether the Minister should be removed from Raad voor de rechtspraak appointments and whether constitutional entrenchment is needed. The State Secretary replies that judicial independence is well guaranteed in law and surveys, that the government takes the concerns seriously, and that a letter to parliament on appointments, the Raad voor de rechtspraak and a constitutional court will follow in mid-2025.
I of course take the judges' concerns seriously. I intend to send parliament a letter in mid-2025 in which I will go into these constitutional starting points in more detail.
Ik neem de zorgen van de rechters uiteraard serieus. Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer medio 2025 een brief te sturen waarin ik nader in zal gaan op deze constitutionele uitgangspunten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Lahlah en Postma over private financiële middelen met betrekking tot een energiefonds

MPs asked why private funding for an energy fund for low and middle income households could not be secured and what efforts were made, including the gap with the amount sought and the future of the Noodfonds infrastructure. The government explains that energy suppliers have agreed to an energy fund for 2025 but the state will carry more than two thirds of the funding to avoid state aid risks, and that the fund will open once the energy sector's contribution is settled.
The Chamber will be informed about this as soon as possible.
De Kamer wordt hier zo snel mogelijk nader over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over ‘schuldhulpverlening’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the limited effectiveness of debt relief, the role of municipalities, the lack of a central national approach, and measures to reduce problematic debt. The government replied that its policy agenda (basisdienstverlening, Nationaal Programma Armoede en Schulden, extra funding) will be detailed in spring 2025, and largely pointed to existing measures and municipal responsibility.
The cabinet sees it as its responsibility to work on reducing the number of people with problematic debts.
Het kabinet ziet het als haar verantwoordelijkheid om in te zetten op het terugdringen van het aantal mensen met problematische schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over het bericht ‘Grondrechten onder druk: demonstratierecht splijt politiek en samenleving’

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Justice and Security how peaceful demonstrations are defined, how the balance between public order and the right to protest is kept, and how the criterion of public-order disruption is prevented from being applied against politically unwelcome protests. The minister answered that a sharper distinction between peaceful protest and disruptive action is being explored via a WODC study due in summer 2025, that the purpose or message of a demonstration should play no role, and that a broad dialogue will be held, while stating that the government will not tolerate deliberately disruptive or unlawful acts.
The purpose or message of an action may play no role in the assessment of a demonstration.
Het doel of de boodschap van een actie mogen geen rol spelen bij de beoordeling van een demonstratie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Tseggai en Lahlah over het bericht 'Kamermotie over onderzoek naar Nederlanders met migratieachtergrond maakt veel los', en het verzoek van het lid Timmermans om een brief te o

MPs Timmermans, Tseggai and Lahlah asked the cabinet whether it still stands by its statement that no opinions of people with a migration background would be recorded, given the Becker motion requiring research into people with a migration background, and how this fits with the non-discrimination principle. The cabinet answered that the SCP research will cover the whole population without distinguishing by migration background, that it sees no break in cabinet policy, and that it will consider how to provide the requested information within legal frameworks.
The cabinet observes no break in the unity of cabinet policy.
Het kabinet constateert geen breuk in de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Lahlah en Mutluer over gezichtsherkenning bij de politie

MPs Kathmann, Lahlah and Mutluer asked about police use of facial recognition and camera surveillance at peaceful demonstrations, citing an Amnesty report, and asked about oversight, data sources, retention and procurement. The Minister replied that police do not use real-time facial recognition at demonstrations, only retrospectively against suspects of crimes, that the Dutch DPA has adequate expertise to supervise, and that a national legal framework and an AI-regulation-based transparency register are being explored and will follow.
Only when criminal offences have been committed can the police subsequently use facial recognition technology to identify suspects.
Enkel wanneer sprake is van strafbare feiten kan door de politie achteraf gezichtsherkenningstechnologie worden ingezet om verdachten te identificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Lahlah over de omgang met het parlement en de problemen in het gevangeniswezen

MPs Van Nispen and Lahlah asked whether a PVV motion on prison clothing was coordinated with the state secretary and whether the government is serious about parliament and prison staff concerns. The state secretary denied any pre-arranged contact or media plan, said plans to restrict branded clothing predate the motion, and said he takes parliament and staff seriously.
There was no contact between the PVV MP and me before the two-minute debate regarding the motion submitted by the PVV MP, other than the usual sounding out by my political assistant.

Er is geen sprake geweest van contact tussen het PVV-Kamerlid en mij voorafgaand aan het tweeminutendebat ten aanzien van de door het PVV-Kamerlid ingediende motie, anders dan de gebruikelijke sondering door mijn politiek assistent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Lahlah, Boswijk, Helder en Michon-Derkzen over de voorgenomen sluiting van het politiebureau in Wolvega

MPs from several parties ask the Minister of Justice and Security why the police plan to close the Wolvega station and replace it with a smaller police post, questioning the decision's basis, its effect on police presence, consultation with local government, and the link to coalition plans for more police presence in neighbourhoods. The Minister answers that station locations are a police responsibility, that the transformation follows a 2015 housing plan aimed at more mobile policing on the street, that no final location has been chosen, and that a new police post is planned by end 2025 with the municipality of Weststellingwerf.
Decisions on which police stations or posts are added, stay open or close are a responsibility of the police.
Keuzes over welke politiebureaus of posten die worden toegevoegd, geopend blijven of sluiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Abassi en Lahlah over het bericht 'CJIB wil bevoegdheid om te kunnen stoppen met het verhogen van verkeersboetes'

MPs Lahlah and El Abassi asked the Justice Minister about reports that the CJIB wants powers to stop raising traffic fine surcharges where these cause unreasonable hardship, and about the proportionality and fairness of fines and collection costs compared with commercial agencies. The minister acknowledges the CJIB's signal, points to planned measures (a free reminder before collection costs, and power to waive surcharges in cases of force majeure) and ongoing studies, but does not commit to a legislative change before summer 2025 and gives no firm answer on the fine levels.
First, that the CJIB can first send a free payment reminder before collection costs are charged.
Ten eerste dat het CJIB eerst een gratis betalingsherinnering kan sturen voordat aanmaningskosten in rekening worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Welzijn over de vermogensgrenzen voor lokale kwijtscheldingen

MPs Lahlah and Welzijn asked about the asset limits for local tax exemptions after a Council of State ruling that municipalities must follow national rules even when they want to allow beneficiaries a savings buffer. The minister acknowledged the wish for a buffer, noted the existing €2,000 allowance, and said a study on raising the asset limit is underway, with the Chamber to be informed before the budget debate.
I am now having a study carried out, partly in response to the amended motion by Palmen and Mohandis, into the questions in that motion and the policy issues.
Ik laat nu, mede naar aanleiding van de Nader gewijzigde motie van de leden Palmen en Mohandis 5 een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de vragen uit deze motie en de beleidsvraagstukken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over beloningsverschillen binnen de rechterlijke macht,

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a 3.5% starting-salary gap between female and male judges- and prosecutors-in-training and whether the government would tackle it. The state secretary admitted the gap, agreed with the judiciary to replace the last-earned-salary criterion with unweighted work experience, and said the government will leave the detailed implementation to the employers.
On 18 July, the Dutch Association for the Judiciary (NVvR) and I reached agreement that the old arrangement, scaling based on last-earned salary, will be abandoned.
Op 18 juli jl. zijn de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Rechtspraak (NVvR) en ik tot overeenstemming gekomen dat de oude afspraak – inschaling op basis van het laatstverdiende loon – wordt losgelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over beloningsverschillen binnen de rechterlijke macht,

An MP asks the State Secretary why the pay gap between female and male judges and prosecutors has not been addressed proactively, and why two female judges had to complain to the Human Rights Commission. The government says it has acted proactively through the sector consultation, reached an agreement with the judges' association to drop salary-based placement, and plans implementation by December 2024 with evaluations.

On the day your parliamentary questions 2024Z12073 were received, I reached an agreement within the SORM with the Dutch Association for the Judiciary (NVvR) to drop the arrangement that placement is based on the last earned salary.

Op de dag van ontvangst van uw Kamervragen met kenmerk 2024Z12073 heb ik in SORM verband een akkoord bereikt met de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Rechtspraak (NVvR) over het loslaten van de afspraak dat inschaling op basis van laatstverdiende salaris plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Lahlah, Boswijk en Helder over de sluiting van het politiebureau in Wolvega

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and BBB asked the Minister of Justice about the planned closure of the Wolvega police station, its consistency with the coalition's commitment to visible policing, the reasons for closure, and talks with the municipality. The Minister answered that a smaller police post will replace it, the police decide closures in consultation with local authorities, and talks with the municipality are ongoing.
Decisions on which police stations or posts are added, remain open or close are a responsibility of the police.
Keuzes over welke politiebureaus of posten die worden toegevoegd, geopend blijven of sluiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over het onvoldoende benutten van mediation in strafzaken

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why mediation in criminal cases is underused, despite benefits for victims and suspects, and what barriers and legal or budgetary changes are needed. The minister agrees mediation is valuable, cites WODC findings on untapped potential, and promises a policy response after summer on embedding mediation in the process, a possible statutory right to request mediation in the new Criminal Procedure Code, and says budget is sufficient.

I will examine with the Public Prosecution Service and the judiciary whether and which fixed moments in the criminal process can be found at which the possibility of mediation can be considered by default and in time.

Ik zal met het OM en de rechtspraak onderzoeken of en zo ja welke vaste momenten te vinden zijn in het strafproces waarop de mogelijkheid van mediation in ieder geval standaard en tijdig kan worden overwogen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Lahlah, El Abassi en Palmen over mankementen in het huidige boetesysteem in Nederland

MPs Van Nispen, Lahlah, El Abassi and Palmen asked the Justice Minister about problems in the Dutch traffic fine system, including imprisonment for unpaid fines (gijzeling), debt, child welfare effects, insurance fines, proportionality of escalating reminders, and the possibility of income-dependent fines. The Minister answered that gijzeling is subject to judicial review and that payment arrangements exist, but declined to adopt income-based fines, a 30% reduction, or a maximum of 150 euro, citing costs and burden on the criminal justice chain, while promising a WODC evaluation and a ministry study on escalation.
We cannot entirely rule out that children were placed out of home at the time because their parent was imprisoned for non-payment.
Wij kunnen niet geheel uitsluiten dat kinderen destijds uit huis zijn geplaatst doordat hun ouder werd gegijzeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Chakor over verbieden van hoofddoekjes en andere religieuze uitingen bij boa’s

MPs Lahlah and Chakor asked whether a national ban on headscarves and other religious symbols for municipal enforcement officers (boa's) conflicts with municipal autonomy and the Code of Interadministrative Relations, and whether the Council of State should advise. The Minister said municipalities have not followed the neutrality guideline since November 2023, so a statutory basis will be sought, while noting no boa is known to wear religious symbols.
That is why I feel compelled to enshrine the neutrality requirement in legislation or regulation, as a majority of the House has requested.
Daarom zie ik mij genoodzaakt om de eis van neutraliteit in wet- of regelgeving vast te leggen, zoals een meerderheid van Uw Kamer heeft verzocht.
Antwoord op van het lid Lahlah over het bericht ‘de veiligheid in vrouwengevangenis is onvoldoende’

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about sexual misconduct and safety in the women's prison Nieuwersluis, including implementation of inspection and RCGOG recommendations, complaint accessibility, focal persons, and timelines. The minister answers that recommendations have been adopted and partly implemented, with some measures still being worked out and progress to be reported in the next progress letter.
In my response I indicated that I adopt all recommendations of the Inspection report.
In mijn reactie heb ik aangegeven alle aanbevelingen van het Inspectierapport over te nemen.

m: Motie Hazekamp over toevoegingen aan de lijst met bejaagbare soorten c.q. wild
Asks the government to drop its plan to add grey goose and greylag goose to the list of huntable species.
requests the government to refrain from its intention to add grey goose and greylag goose to the list of huntable species
verzoekt de regering, om af te zien van haar voornemen om grauwe gans en kolgans toe te voegen aan de lijst met bejaagbare soorten c.q. wild
qa: Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over aangespoelde zeehonden en verminkte bruinvissen

An MP asked the state secretary about many dead seals and mutilated porpoises washed ashore in the Grevelingen and Ouddorp, asking about protection, nets, causes of injury, prosecution and research. The state secretary said protection is adequate, bycatch research is planned, a pathology study from Utrecht will be published in 2013, and a progress report on the porpoise protection plan will follow by end 2012.
Last year I received the Porpoise Protection Plan.
Ik heb vorig jaar het Bruinvisbeschermingsplan in ontvangst genomen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het weigeren van hulp aan gewonde dieren waarvan de eigenaar onvindbaar is

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police and emergency services left an injured sheep unaided for days because its owner could not be found, and why the 144 animal-emergency line passed a caller around. The minister answered that the 144 line only routes reports, that police and other services may help animals without a known owner, and that the handling problem is being addressed by an improved animal-aid convenant.
It is not correct that the animal police and emergency services may only help animals when the owner is known and can be found.
Het is niet correct dat de dierenpolitie en hulpdiensten alleen dieren hulp mogen bieden wanneer de eigenaar bekend en vindbaar is.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hazekamp, Van Gerven, Grashoff en Graus over de voortgang van de bouw van megastallen ondanks het nadrukkelijk verzoek van de Tweede Kamer voor een moratorium op de bouw van deze

Five MPs asked the state secretary why construction of mega-stables continues despite a Chamber request for a moratorium, including a municipality's decision to proceed with a Horst aan de Maas project after a health risk assessment. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the Witveldweg zoning procedure started before the motion so it is not a new application, reiterated restrictive policy, and said a legislative cap on animal numbers would be left to a next cabinet.
There is therefore no question of new applications as referred to in the motion by the members Grashoff and Van Veldhoven.
Er is derhalve geen sprake van nieuwe aanvragen als bedoeld in de motie van de leden Grashoff en Van Veldhoven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over beschietingen van roofvogelnesten

An MP asked the state secretary whether proceedings had been brought for destroying raptor nests, how often offenders were traced, whether supervision would be tightened, and whether convictions should lead to permanent revocation of hunting licences. The state secretary said detection is very difficult, that nest destruction should be punished severely under the Economic Offences Act, and that prevention and enforcement policy will be pursued, but declined to subsidise more field supervision.
The government does not have databases that allow distinctions at the level of modus operandi and/or threatened species for violations of the Flora and Fauna Act.
De overheid beschikt niet over databases waarmee tot op het niveau van modus operandi en/of bedreigde soorten onderscheid gemaakt kan worden bij overtredingen van de Flora- en faunawet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over het rapen van kievitseieren op de Werelderfgoedlijst van Unesco

An MP asked whether the Chamber's April 2012 approval of the UNESCO Intangible Heritage convention changes the government's earlier answers that listing egg-collecting was not on the agenda. The state secretary replied that ratification does not change earlier answers, because the Kingdom only becomes party three months after deposit and inventorying will come first.
The fact that the House of Representatives approved ratification of the UNESCO Convention for Intangible Cultural Heritage changes nothing about the earlier answers.
Het feit dat de Tweede Kamer heeft ingestemd met de ratificatie van het UNESCO-verdrag voor Immaterieel Erfgoed verander niets aan de eerdere antwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over het uitsterven van de witte kievitsbloem (sts ELI)

An MP asked the state secretary whether the white meadow lady's-smock (kievitsbloem) is at risk of extinction because groundwater is kept low for farmers in a Haren nature area, and whether measures will be taken with nature organisations, water boards and provinces. The state secretary answered that the species is protected, that existing Natura 2000 and provincial measures are sufficient, and that the claim about the last 15 plants in Haren is incorrect since the largest population is in the Uiterwaarden Zwarte Water en Vecht area.
It is incorrect that the last 15 wild kievitsbloemen (or white variants thereof) in Haren would be found anywhere in the world or even in the Netherlands.
Het is onjuist dat in Haren de laatste 15 wilde kievitsbloemen (of witte varianten daarvan) ter wereld of zelfs maar van Nederland zouden voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over CO2-opslag onder de zeebodem

An MP asked the minister about reported plans by RWE/Essent to store CO2 under the seabed in depleted gas fields, the government's role, EU or government funding, Wadden Sea environmental risks, and coal-plant policy. The minister denied knowledge of a concrete plan, said environmental assessments would be required for any project near Natura 2000 areas, and defended coal plants as supply-secure while pointing to a coal tax in the coalition agreement.
I am not aware of any concrete plan for storing CO2 from the RWE/Essent coal plant under the seabed.
Er is mij geen concreet voornemen voor de opslag van CO 2 uit de kolencentrale van RWE/Essent onder de zeebodem bekend.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over nazorg bij ruiming in de veehouderij om dierziekte

An MP asked whether aftercare exists for human victims of animal disease crises such as Q fever, and what lessons were drawn from the earlier Q fever outbreak. The minister answered that patients use regular care, GGD informed medical professionals, the Q-uestion patient association was subsidised, and a multidisciplinary guideline and research were funded.
Patients needing aftercare following such an infectious disease can, like patients with other serious illnesses, rely on regular healthcare provision.
Patiënten die nazorg nodig hebben ten gevolge van een dergelijke infectieziekte, kunnen net als patiënten met een andere ernstige ziekte een beroep doen op het reguliere zorgaanbod.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over een jager die een auto op de A15 raakt met een kogel

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about a hunter who hit a car on the A15 motorway with a bullet, including whether a report was filed, whether his hunting permit was revoked, and whether lead ammunition and hunting near public roads should be banned. The minister answered that a criminal investigation is ongoing, the permit may be revoked after review, no general ban on lead ammunition or hunting near roads is planned, and details cannot be given while the case is pending.
In the interest of the investigation, no statements can be made about that.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen daarover geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de aanwezigheid van pathogenen in kippenvlees

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers about pathogens in chicken meat, citing a US study on E. coli, and asked how many Dutch products are contaminated, whether products should be pathogen-free, who bears liability, whether consumers' burden of proof should be eased, and the government's role in tracing infection sources. The minister replied that the US situation is not comparable, that Salmonella is declining, that Campylobacter is found on 20% of chicken, that producers bear primary responsibility, that no special burden-of-proof rules are planned, and described the GGD/NVWA reporting and investigation routes.
I am currently considering additional measures regarding Campylobacter on poultry meat.
Momenteel beraad ik mij op aanvullende maatregelen ten aanzien van Campylobacter op pluimveevlees
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het stimuleren van duurzame eiwitconsumptie

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the price gap between meat and plant-based meat substitutes should be closed through taxes or subsidies and whether the external costs of meat should be included in its price. The government answered that it sees no short-term options, is awaiting a LEI study on external costs, uses voluntary sustainability initiatives and does not plan stimulation schemes for meat substitutes.
At the request of my ministry, the LEI will publish a study on this subject this summer.
Op verzoek van mijn ministerie brengt het LEI deze zomer nog een studie uit over dit onderwerp
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de plezierjacht op beschermde dieren door hoogwaardigheidsbekleders

An MP asked the ministers whether the government would object to King Juan Carlos's elephant hunting, ban trophy hunting offers and gifts to officials, and bar Dutch royals from hunting protected species. The state secretary replied that trophy hunting is legal and may fund conservation, declined to disclose royal hunting or trophy details citing privacy, and saw no need for a ban on hunting-trip advertising.
Providing information on participation in hunting and the presence of hunting trophies in palaces and homes is incompatible with protecting the privacy of the Royal House.

Verstrekking van gegevens over deelname aan de jacht en aanwezigheid van jachttrofeën in paleizen en woningen is niet verenigbaar met de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van het Koninklijk Huis.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de mogelijke schending van privacy door mormonen

An MP asked whether government archives cooperate with Mormons on digitising records containing deceased persons' data, whether this fits the public task and privacy protection, and whether derived religious baptism of deceased citizens should be prevented. The minister answered that archive cooperation is a facility for visitors and falls under the Archives Act, that data protection does not extend to deceased persons, that there is no full overview, and that no measures will be taken citing religious freedom.
There is no complete overview of which archive repositories and when Mormons made copies of these files and on what scale, nor of institutions.
Er is geen compleet overzicht van bij welke archiefbewaarplaatsen wanneer mormonen afschriften hebben gemaakt van deze bestanden en op welke schaal, noch van instellingen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het naderen van een post-antibioticatijdperk

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers about the WHO warning of a post-antibiotic era, whether voluntary reduction targets in livestock farming are adequate, and whether binding measures will follow. The minister answered that existing policy is serious and based on self-regulation combined with strict state supervision, that the 50% reduction target is not the end goal, and that a transition to sustainable farming is needed, without committing to new legislation.
I do not share your view that only non-binding agreements have been made with the livestock sectors, without a stick behind the door.
Ik deel uw mening niet dat er daarbij slechts vrijblijvende afspraken zijn gemaakt met de betreffende veehouderijsectoren, zonder stok achter de deur.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over reeën die zich dood lopen tegen de afrastering van de Betuwelijn

An MP asked how high the Betuwe railway fencing is, why deer died against it, and whether a fine mesh top edge should be mandatory for wildlife fencing. The state secretary confirmed the fence is about 1.80 m with no barbed wire, but said the technical design of the fence is not his responsibility.
The (technical) implementation of the fencing along the Betuwe line does not fall within my responsibilities.
De (technische) uitvoering van de afrastering langs de Betuwelijn hoort niet tot mijn verantwoordelijkheden.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over het conflict tussen de Nederlandse dierenbeschermer Edwin Wiek en de Thaise overheid over de handel in uit het wild gevangen babyolifanten voor de toeristenindustrie

Hazekamp (PvdD) asked the ministers whether the Thai government and its park officials were complicit in poaching baby elephants for tourism and in harassing Dutch animal welfare activist Edwin Wiek's shelter, and whether the Netherlands would raise these concerns. The minister answered that the matter is under investigation by Traffic, that Thailand is responsible for CITES enforcement, and that the Netherlands would raise concerns with Thailand if official involvement is established, but could not rule out that seized animals fall prey to traders.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het subsidiëren van de promotie van geitenzuivel en geitenvlees

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation and the minister of Health about government subsidies for promoting goat dairy and goat meat, linked to surplus male kids, antibiotic use and intensification in goat farming. The state secretary denied that the ministry funded goat-dairy promotion, explained that a small EU- and ministry-co-funded practice-network website covered goat-kid meat, acknowledged antibiotic use in goat kid fattening is a concern, and said the sector must take responsibility and provide insight into antibiotic use.
At present there is no central overview of antibiotic use in the goat sector, and there is no insight into the quantities and categories of antibiotics used.
Op dit moment is er nog geen centraal zicht op het gebruik van antibiotica in de geitensector en is er geen inzicht in het gebruik van hoeveelheden en categorieën antibiotica.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over gekleurde duiven in pasteltinten die te verkrijgen zijn via duivenverhuurservice.nl

An MP asked the state secretary whether dyed pastel pigeons rented for parties, and pigeons with whistles fitted to their tails, are legally restricted and whether their welfare is harmed. The state secretary answered that no specific law regulates dyeing animals, that the general animal-cruelty ban applies, that the whistle option has been removed due to low demand, and that no clear welfare harm has been identified so no action is planned.
At this moment I have no indications that the welfare or health of the animal is affected to such an extent that action should be taken against it.
Ik heb op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat sprake is van een dusdanige aantasting van het welzijn of de gezondheid van het dier dat hiertegen opgetreden zou moeten worden.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de geconstateerde overtredingen met betrekking tot de productie van filet americain

An MP asked the state secretary and minister about food safety violations in filet americain following a television investigation, including bacteria levels and undisclosed pork. The minister answered that no legal bacteria norm exists for this product, TNO found no pathogens, and she sees no reason to tighten nVWA oversight or add sanctions.
In my view the nVWA oversight is sufficiently adequate on this point, and the television programme has provided no new insights regarding the effectiveness of the oversight.
Naar mijn mening is het nVWA-toezicht voldoende adequaat op dit punt en heeft het televisieprogramma geen nieuwe inzichten opgeleverd ten aanzien van de effectiviteit van het toezicht.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over EHEC-besmetting bij herten

An MP asked the government whether venison from wild deer, found in a German study to be largely carrying EHEC-type bacteria, is adequately controlled and who is liable for food safety in the wild game chain. State Secretary Bleker answered that the bacteria found are mostly harmless STEC, that existing EU and national inspection rules adequately control the risks, and that no new measures or ban are warranted.
I therefore see no reason to ban the consumption of meat from wild animals.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om de consumptie van vlees van in het wild levende dieren te verbieden.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het rapen van kievitseieren op de Werelderfgoedlijst van Unesco

MP Hazekamp asked whether the traditional collecting of lapwing eggs (Aaisykjen) belongs on the UNESCO heritage list and whether its declining lapwing population justifies restricting it. The minister replied that the list concerned is the intangible heritage list, to which the Netherlands is not yet a party, so listing is not at issue, and that falling lapwing numbers are taken into account in exemption decisions.
The decline is taken into account in the assessment for future exemption grants.
De daling wordt meegenomen bij de beoordeling voor toekomstige ontheffingverlening.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het voorkomen van mastitis en klauwproblemen bij melkkoeien in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about rising painkiller use in dairy cows, the prevalence of mastitis and hoof problems, milk yield and pasture access, and what policy is planned to reduce these problems. The secretary said painkiller monitoring is a task for the vets' and farmers' sector rather than government, cited prevalence figures from research, and pointed to sector-led projects and an integrated sustainability agenda without committing to new binding measures.
Monitoring the use of painkillers in animals is not primarily a task for the government but rather for the professional association of veterinarians and the livestock sector itself.
Het volgen van het gebruik van pijnstilling bij dieren is niet in de eerste plaats de taak voor de overheid maar eerder voor de beroepsvereniging van de dierenartsen en de veehouderijsector zelf.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over koeien die dansend de wei in gaan

An MP asked whether the excitement of cows entering pasture shows that year-round housing is harmful, and whether pasture grazing should be made mandatory given reduced grazing from farm scale-up. The minister welcomed sector initiatives promoting grazing but rejected mandatory grazing, leaving it to chain partners.
I consider making grazing mandatory undesirable; it is up to the partners in the chain to give substance to grazing, as is also happening.
Verplichten van weidegang acht ik ongewenst, het is aan de partners in de keten om aan weidegang invulling te geven, zoals ook gebeurt.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over verkoop woning Mozambique

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the Crown Prince actively promoted the sale of his Mozambique villa in a magazine ad, whether this contradicted the government's January letter saying the royal couple had no further involvement, and about the ad's cost and timing. The Prime Minister said his only surprise was the unverified online article, that the ad was placed by the estate agent and involved no tax money, and that the sale ended the legal ties, while the royal couple helping sell the house through the owners' association does not conflict with the government's position that private property sales of royals do not touch the public interest.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp en Ouwehand over het ontduiken van de m.e.r.-plicht voor vergunningverlening van intensieve veehouderij

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether municipalities are evading the EIA (MER) obligation for intensive livestock permits by approving stepwise expansions just below the threshold, and what consequences, oversight and enforcement follow. The minister answered that the matter rests with competent authorities (municipalities), that only incidental signals were received, that a mandatory EIA screening applies below the threshold, that inspection can act against structural negligence, and that supervision will shift to provinces under the pending Revitalisering Generiek Toezicht bill.
However, these are incidental reports, which gives me no reason to launch broader research into this.
Het gaat echter om incidentele berichten, hetgeen mij geen aanleiding geeft om hier een breder onderzoek naar in te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over afschot van zogende wilde zwijnen

An MP asks whether the wild boar shooting period is being extended into the gestation and nursing period, risking starvation of piglets, and whether a national ban or enforcement of animal welfare duties is planned. The state secretary confirms the extension and piglet sightings, says shooting is necessary for road safety and delegates the decision to the province, rejects a national ban and leaves enforcement to case-by-case assessment.
Killing wild boar is necessary, among other things, for the safety of road users on the North Veluwe. The province is authorised to make decisions on this.
Het doden van zwijnen is noodzakelijk voor onder meer de veiligheid van verkeersdeelnemers op de Noord-Veluwe. De provincie is bevoegd om hier besluiten over te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over schokkende beelden van dierenmishandeling op een Brits veebedrijf

An MP asked the state secretary whether Dutch meat from a UK factory-farm abuse case could be stopped at the border, whether Dutch consumers can be protected, and what enforcement safeguards exist. The state secretary replied that closing borders on welfare grounds is not possible under EU law, that enforcement is shared with member states and the NVWA does risk-based inspections, and promised to push for better EU enforcement without committing to a specific step.
No, I cannot rule that out.
Nee, dat kan ik niet uitsluiten.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp en Van Dekken over gesjoemel met tellen van reeën

MPs Hazekamp and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about reports that Drenthe hunting units inflated or manipulated deer counts to obtain larger culling quotas, and whether the state would investigate, ban the mixing of roles, or fund independent research. The state secretary said deliberately overstating counts is unacceptable but that provincial Gedeputeerde Staten are responsible for oversight and enforcement, declined to investigate population dynamics, and said the Faunabeheereenheid's multi-party composition sufficiently guarantees independence.
However, it is the responsibility of the Provincial Executives of the provinces to investigate this and take measures where necessary.
Het is echter de verantwoordelijkheid van de Gedeputeerde Staten van de provincies om dit te onderzoeken en in voorkomende gevallen maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over een bij strenge vorst buiten vastgeketende hond in Breskens

An MP asked why police did not act on repeated reports of a labrador kept chained outside without adequate shelter or water in Breskens during severe frost, and whether current rules and enforcement are adequate. The minister answered that police found no criminal offence, that existing rules offer sufficient grounds for enforcement, that a forthcoming decree will clarify animal cruelty, and that no data exist on how many dogs are chained 24 hours a day.
The police have been unable to establish a criminal offence concerning the dog in this case.
De politie heeft geen strafbaar feit met betrekking tot de hond in deze casus kunnen aantonen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over een transport van 38 Heckrunderen, in eigendom van Staatsbosbeheer, waarvan 16 runderen het niet hebben overleefd

An MP asked the state secretary about a transport of 38 Heck cattle owned by Staatsbosbeheer in which 16 died, asking how it happened, whether the animals stabbed each other, the condition of the survivors, why a distant slaughterhouse was chosen, and whether extra transport rules apply. The government answered that a criminal investigation by the NVWA and Public Prosecution Service is ongoing, the deaths cannot be fully explained yet, the choice of slaughterhouse is left to the parties, EU rules contain no special Heck cattle requirements, and it will inform parliament once the investigation results are known.
Following the incident mentioned above, the NVWA has launched a criminal investigation under the direction of the Functional Prosecution Service of the Public Prosecution Service.
Naar aanleiding van bovengenoemd voorval is door de NVWA een strafrechtelijk onderzoek ingesteld onder leiding van het Functioneel Parket van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Vragen van het lid Hazekamp (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het schieten van dieren nabij ecoducten (ingezonden 3 februari 2012).

An MP asked the state secretary whether hunters may shoot animals near wildlife overpasses (ecoducten), whether a nationwide shooting ban around them should be introduced, and which overpasses link poor and rich habitats. The state secretary answered that no shooting near overpasses is known, that Staatsbosbeheer and the province of Gelderland keep hunting blinds at least 250-500 metres away, that no change warrants a ban, and that the province, not the ministry, is responsible for the remaining questions.
That is not known to the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation. The provinces are responsible for this.
Dat is niet bij het ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie bekend. Hier gaan de provincies over.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het feit dat de 99 procent van het kippenvlees in de supermarkt besmet is met ESBL-producerende bacteriën

An MP asks the health minister whether it is acceptable that 99 percent of supermarket chicken carries ESBL-producing bacteria, and what has become of the 1996 government pledge to ban contaminated chicken products. The minister acknowledges the problem as unacceptable, points to existing measures and a Campylobacter covenant, and says she is considering additional measures, while stating that contact with ESBL-contaminated products is not a direct risk for consumers and that a legal ban has not been justified by the EU.
I am therefore considering additional measures regarding Campylobacter and aim to come up with concrete proposals before the end of this year.
Ik beraad mij daarom op aanvullende maatregelen ten aanzien van Campylobacter en streef ernaar nog voor het eind van dit jaar met concrete voorstellen te komen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het via een website tegen betaling aanbieden van jachtuitjes aan jagers

An MP asked whether the government shares concern that a website offering paid hunting trips to any location encourages hunting tourism and recreational killing, and whether it will restrict such trips or stop new hunting licences. The state secretary answered that hunters are responsible for hunting within the Flora and Fauna Act and sustainable management, pointed to a forthcoming nature conservation bill, and said hunter training is not subsidised and that cross-regional kill data is not available.
There is a WBE database that records culling of various animal species. However, it is not possible to extract data from this database on culling outside one's own hunting grounds.
Er is een WBE-databank die afschot van diverse dierensoorten registreert. Echter het is niet mogelijk om uit deze databank gegevens op te dissen over het afschot buiten de eigen jachtvelden.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over 2578 onderschepte dode zeepaardjes op Schiphol

MP Hazekamp asked why a Peruvian woman caught with 2,578 dead seahorses at Schiphol paid only a fine, and questioned enforcement against wildlife trafficking and its deterrent effect. The minister answered that a €3,500 transaction was accepted per Openbaar Ministerie policy, that prison sentences are reserved for complex organised cases, and that a CITES-related pilot against organised wildlife crime will start in 2012.
The Public Prosecution Service informed me that in this case a settlement of €3,500 was offered, which the suspect accepted.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld dat in dit geval een transactie is aangeboden van € 3500, die door verdachte is geaccepteerd.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het gebruik van chemische toevoegingen in dierlijke producten

MP Hazekamp asked the ministers whether ammonium hydroxide (E527) and meat glue (trombine/fibrinogen) are permitted in Dutch meat products, whether they are safe, and how labelling and an EU ban would be handled. Minister Schippers answered that E527 is considered safe and remains permitted under EU rules until a 2013 change, that the Commission is still deciding on enzyme measures, that labelling of meat glue is required on packaged meat but not on unpackaged meat, and that the matter should be settled at EU level.
No, I believe this discussion should be resolved at European level.
Nee, Ik vind dat deze discussie op Europees niveau moet worden beslecht.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de bevalling van een koe op Schiphol

An MP asked the state secretary about a pregnant cow that gave birth during export transport at Schiphol, whether pregnant animals should be exported given Schmallenberg virus, export and inspection statistics, and whether the NVWA investigation results will be shared. The state secretary answered that the transport met the rules, that a ban on pregnant animal exports would be disproportionate, that inspection statistics are provided, and that the Chamber will be informed of the investigation results depending on whether criminal steps follow.
Depending on whether the investigation leads to criminal steps, I will inform the Chamber of the results of the investigation.
Afhankelijk van het antwoord op de vraag of het onderzoek leidt tot strafrechtelijke stappen zal ik de Kamer informeren over de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het advies om zwangere vrouwen te waarschuwen voor het Schmallenbergvirus

An MP asks the health minister whether pregnant women should be warned about Schmallenberg virus risks, given uncertain transmission to humans, and asks about awareness of zoonoses, public information, disclosure of affected farm addresses and research. The minister answers that transmission cannot be excluded, so precautionary hygiene advice for pregnant women is justified, that information is already available, that farm locations are published on the NVWA website, and that RIVM has prepared a research proposal discussed with experts.
Transmission of the virus to humans indeed cannot be ruled out, and therefore preventive measures are justified from the precautionary principle.
Overdracht van het virus naar mensen kan inderdaad niet worden uitgesloten en daarom zijn preventieve maatregelen vanuit het voorzorgprincipe gerechtvaardigd.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over een afschotverbod voor in het wild levende dieren in verband met de aanhoudende vorst

An MP asked the State Secretary to ban hunting of wild animals during the prolonged frost, arguing they are weakened and cannot find food, and questioned whether beheer and schadebestrijding shooting is covered by the winter hunting bans. The State Secretary answered that most animals have sufficient reserves, that the Flora- en faunawet hunting bans apply to hunting rather than management and pest control, and that provinces are better placed to decide on suspending management culls.
Incidentally, I would not have imposed a temporary general shooting ban during persistent frost.
Overigens zou ik bij aanhoudende vorst geen tijdelijk algeheel afschotverbod hebben ingesteld.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de ergernis van veehouders aan het wisselend beleid van ziekenhuizen rond MRSA

An MP asked the health minister about veterinary farmers' frustration over inconsistent hospital policy on MRSA and ESBL bacteria, and whether a uniform national protocol, a national reporting point, cost assessments and clearance certificates for farmers are warranted. The minister answered that national guidelines from the WIP already exist, that hospitals are responsible for implementing them, that carrier data are provided, that no further cost study is needed, and that clearance certificates are of doubtful value given the Gezondheidsraad advice to keep current policy.
A national protocol therefore already exists.
Een landelijk protocol bestaat dus al.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de subsidiëring van onderzoek naar het eten van insecten

An MP asked the state secretary whether the government funds research and promotion of insect eating, how much it spends on this compared with plant-based protein alternatives, and whether it favours plant-based over animal protein. The state secretary answered that roughly 950,000 euros goes to insect production research and several small pilots, that protein sustainability is left largely to industry and consumers, and that he will not push the EU to shift funds away from insects.
There are no specific amounts reserved for 2012 and beyond.
Er zijn geen specifieke bedragen voor 2012 en verder gereserveerd.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de onbeheersbaarheid van de populatie wilde zwijnen bij het Leenderbos door toedoen van jagers

An MP asked the state secretary whether hunters have made the wild boar population near Leenderbos uncontrollable, whether night hunting with artificial light breaches Benelux rules, and whether rivalry between hunters and farmers poses security risks, and asked about a provincial official's remark against joint hunting. The state secretary answered that the Benelux light-hunting ban does not apply to damage control for non-huntable species, that the province is responsible for management, that no armed conflict or threat exists, and that regional hunters are capable of contributing.
The province of Noord-Brabant is responsible for managing damage-causing species in the province.
Provincie Noord-Brabant is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van schadeveroorzakende soorten in de provincie.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het thuis ontvangen van jachtlobbyisten

An MP asked whether the minister received hunting lobby representatives at home, whether officials attend such meetings, and whether this creates an appearance of conflict of interest. The minister says he meets many civil society organisations in various settings, including sometimes at home, and that all stakeholders could comment on the nature conservation bill.
These meetings take place at the ministry, in the country, at the organisations, and sometimes also at my home.
Deze gesprekken vinden plaats op het departement, in het land, bij de organisaties en soms ook bij mij thuis.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand en Hazekamp over de Natuurbeschermingswet-vergunning voor de staand want visserij op het Markermeer

Two MPs asked the state secretary to respond to the province of Flevoland's permit allowing staand want fishing in the Markermeer, which kills large numbers of protected waterbirds, and whether this breaches nature protection law. The secretary answered that the province is the competent authority and judged that no significant negative effects were shown, that he sees no reason to issue a direction against the permit, and that objections can be lodged through the usual channels.
However, I see no reason to use my power to issue a direction regarding the permit granted by Flevoland.
Ik zie echter geen aanleiding gebruik te maken van mijn bevoegdheid een aanwijzing te geven ter zake van de door Flevoland verleende vergunning.
Vragen van het lid De Nerée tot Babberich (CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over fraude bij Goldman Sachs (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

The MP asks whether ABN Amro or RBS suffered damage from Goldman Sachs fraud, whether it affected the consortium unwinding, whether ING and others are similarly affected, and whether the AFM is investigating similar practices. The minister confirms damage of about USD 841 million borne by RBS (not state-held ABN Amro), says the matter is for RBS, declines to comment on other institutions, and states the AFM operates independently and he has no overview of its investigations.
It is unknown to me whether the AFM is currently investigating practices comparable to the fraud Goldman Sachs is accused of.
Het is bij mij onbekend of de AFM thans onderzoek doet naar praktijken die vergelijkbaar zijn met de fraude waar Goldman Sachs van wordt beschuldigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Lange over de mogelijke steun van Rwanda aan de rebellen in de Democratische Republiek van Congo (DRC)

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Rwanda is supporting Congolese rebels and war crimes suspect Bosco Ntaganda, and what the government has done about it. The minister confirmed the reports are troubling, said Rwanda must answer the UN findings, and listed diplomatic demarches through the Great Lakes contact group, the EU and the Kigali embassy.
Reports of support from Rwanda to mutinying soldiers in the DRC and to Bosco Ntaganda are disturbing.
De berichten over steun vanuit Rwanda aan muitende soldaten in de DRC en aan Bosco Ntaganda zijn verontrustend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, De Lange en Smeets over Shell’s gebrekkige rapportage over olielekkages in Nigeria en compensatie daarvan

MPs Dikkers, De Lange and Smeets asked the government about Shell's inaccurate reporting of oil spills in Nigeria, independent investigation, cleanup and compensation. The minister answered that the Bodo spill is under litigation and a NCP complaint is pending, that Nigerian law assigns spill investigations to joint teams, and that the Netherlands supports dialogue and oversight initiatives while Shell has accepted responsibility for the Bodo cleanup.
The extent of the pollution and the amount of compensation are the subject of a civil case.
De omvang van de vervuiling en de hoogte van de schadeloosstelling zijn onderwerp van een civiel proces.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, De Lange en Smeets over de vernieuwing van de licentie van Shell in Nigeria

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they accept the renewal of Shell's Nigerian licence despite pollution from oil spills, what the Dutch government thinks of Shell Netherlands' remarks on polluted water, and whether they have discussed compensation for local residents with Shell. The government answered that licence renewals are a matter between Nigeria and the companies, that it has intensive contact with Shell on MVO and the Niger Delta, and that it facilitates a dialogue on pollution there.
Renewal of licences is a matter between the Nigerian government and companies with which the Nigerian government wishes to do business.
Verlenging van licenties is een zaak tussen de Nigeriaanse overheid en bedrijven waar de Nigeriaanse overheid zaken mee wenst te doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Lange en Timmermans over het bericht dat het gehele Noorden van Mali in handen is van extremisten

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that extremist groups control northern Mali, asking about threats to security, Dutch and EU responses, a contact group, ECOWAS progress, humanitarian aid and food security. The minister answered that the Netherlands backs multilateral, ECOWAS-led efforts, supports regional anti-crime programmes and humanitarian funding, and will assess any request to join an international Mali group.
The Netherlands favours an approach within a multilateral framework.
Nederland is voorstander van een aanpak in multilateraal verband.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ferrier, Van der Staaij, El Fassed, De Lange, Ouwehand, Hachchi en Irrgang over het bericht dat ruim 18 miljoen mensen in de Sahel worden bedreigd door een humanitaire ramp

MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the Sahel food crisis affecting 18 million people, its urgency, past prevention efforts, Dutch funding levels, disaster risk reduction, and support for smallholders. The State Secretary answered that the situation is very serious, outlined past Dutch development projects, reported modest extra Dutch emergency contributions and planned bilateral and multilateral efforts, but gave no specific DRR funding breakdown and declined to pledge larger increases.
At present so-called aid tracking of DRR activities, labelling the DRR dimension of development cooperation activities, is not yet possible.
Op dit moment is het zogenoemde «aid tracking» van DRR activiteiten, het labellen van de DRR-dimensie van OS activiteiten, nog niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen lid De Lange over uitkomst van de 13e conferentie van de United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)

MP De Lange asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about the outcome of the 13th UNCTAD conference, including retention of its mandate, Dutch contributions to the final text, and UNCTAD's role in studying trade, finance and liberalisation. The state secretary answered that the final text was broadly acceptable, that UNCTAD can usefully analyse the financial crisis within its mandate, and that its past record was mixed.
Although the negotiations occasionally went with difficulty, the shared outcome on UNCTAD's new Doha mandate showed goodwill and laid a basis for mutual cooperation.
Hoewel de onderhandelingen nu en dan stroef verliepen, heeft de gedeelde uitkomst omtrent het nieuwe Doha Mandaat van UNCTAD de goede wil getoond en basis gelegd voor wederzijdse samenwerking.
Antwoord vragen De Lange en El Fassed over het dumpen van kippenvlees in Afrika

MPs De Lange and El Fassed asked whether EU and Dutch chicken meat dumping in Africa harms local farmers and undermines food security policy, and whether such export subsidies persist. The government answered that developing countries should use existing WTO trade tools themselves, that the EU's export restitutions will be phased out by 2013, and that effects on food security cannot be generalised.
The Netherlands is of the view that the EU should phase out all export restitutions by 2013 at the latest, regardless of the outcome of the Doha round.
Nederland is daarover overigens van mening dat de EU alle exportrestituties uiterlijk in 2013 uit moet faseren, los van de uitkomst van de Doha-ronde.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, De Lange, Van Bommel en Peters over het ILO rapport 'Burried in Bricks' en de betrokkenheid van NAVO/ISAF bij dwangarbeid in steenbakkerijen

MPs Voordewind, De Lange, Van Bommel and Peters asked the government about the ILO report 'Buried in Bricks' on bonded child and adult labour in Afghan brick kilns and whether NATO/ISAF supply chains use such bricks. The government answered that it shares the aim of ending child labour, that NATO/ISAF can not fully trace brick supply lines, and that NATO agreed four concrete follow-up steps while Afghanistan bears primary responsibility.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en De Lange over het bericht dat Zuid- Sudan afstevent op een hongersnood

MPs Timmermans and De Lange asked whether the government knows of WFP/FAO reports that South Sudan is heading toward famine, whether Dutch food aid is requested and how it will be funded, whether it will support cash transfers, helicopter support, and a role in preventing famine. The state secretary confirmed the reports, outlined a EUR 4 million contribution via the UN humanitarian fund plus multi-agency contributions, said FAO will assess cash transfers, and said no formal helicopter request was received while transport capacity is adequate.
The Netherlands plans to contribute EUR 4 million to this humanitarian action plan.
Nederland is van plan EUR 4 miljoen bij te dragen aan dit humanitaire actieplan.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans, De Lange en Marcouch over een anti-homoseksualiteitswet in Oeganda

MPs Timmermans, De Lange and Marcouch asked the foreign minister whether she knows the anti-homosexuality bill providing for the death penalty has been reintroduced in Uganda's parliament, whether she considers it a human rights violation, and how she will increase pressure on Uganda. The minister confirmed the bill violates human rights and Uganda's international obligations, said the Netherlands has repeatedly raised this bilaterally and multilaterally, and noted the Ugandan prime minister distanced himself from the proposal in a written statement.
The Netherlands has repeatedly pointed out to the Ugandan authorities, both bilaterally and multilaterally, that such a law violates human rights and Uganda's international obligations in this area.

Nederland heeft herhaaldelijk in zowel bi- als multilateraal verband de Oegandese autoriteiten erop gewezen dat een dergelijke wet in strijd is met de mensenrechten en de Oegandese internationale verplichtingen op dit terrein.
